name: Bhishma Parva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM yuyudhire vIrAH kurupANDavasomakAH |
pArthivAshcha mahAbhAgA nAnAdeshasamAgatAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yathA yuyudhire vIrAH kurupANDavasomakAH |
kurukShetre tapaHkShetre shRRiNu tatpRRithivIpate
shlokas.3:
avatIrya kurukShetraM pANDavAH sahasomakAH |
kauravAnabhyavartanta jigIShanto mahAbalAH
shlokas.4:
vedAdhyayanasampannAH sarve yuddhAbhinandinaH |
Asha.nsanto jayaM yuddhe vadhaM vAbhimukhA raNe
shlokas.5:
abhiyAya cha durdharShAM dhArtarAShTrasya vAhinIm |
prA~NmukhAH pashchime bhAge nyavishanta sasainikAH
shlokas.6:
samantapa~nchakAdbAhyaM shibirANi sahasrashaH |
kArayAmAsa vidhivatkuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.7:
shUnyeva pRRithivI sarvA bAlavRRiddhAvasheShitA |
nirashvapuruShA chAsIdrathaku~njaravarjitA
shlokas.8:
yAvattapati sUryo hi jambUdvIpasya maNDalam |
tAvadeva samAvRRittaM balaM pArthivasattama
shlokas.9:
ekasthAH sarvavarNAste maNDalaM bahuyojanam |
paryAkrAmanta deshA.nshcha nadIH shailAnvanAni cha
shlokas.10:
teShAM yudhiShThiro rAjA sarveShAM puruSharShabha |
Adidesha savAhAnAM bhakShyabhojyamanuttamam
shlokas.11:
sa~nj~nAshcha vividhAstAstAsteShAM chakre yudhiShThiraH |
eva.nvAdI veditavyaH pANDaveyo.ayamityuta
shlokas.12:
abhij~nAnAni sarveShAM sa~nj~nAshchAbharaNAni cha |
yojayAmAsa kauravyo yuddhakAla upasthite
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA dhvajAgraM pArthAnAM dhArtarAShTro mahAmanAH |
saha sarvairmahIpAlaiH pratyavyUhata pANDavAn
shlokas.14:
pANDureNAtapatreNa dhriyamANena mUrdhani |
madhye nAgasahasrasya bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritam
shlokas.15:
dRRiShTvA duryodhanaM hRRiShTAH sarve pANDavasainikAH |
dadhmuH sarve mahAsha~NkhAnbherIrjaghnuH sahasrashaH
shlokas.16:
tataH prahRRiShTAM svAM senAmabhivIkShyAtha pANDavAH |
babhUvurhRRiShTamanaso vAsudevashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.17:
tato yodhAnharShayantau vAsudevadhana~njayau |
dadhmatuH puruShavyAghrau divyau sha~Nkhau rathe sthitau
shlokas.18:
pA~nchajanyasya nirghoShaM devadattasya chobhayoH |
shrutvA savAhanA yodhAH shakRRinmUtraM prasusruvuH
shlokas.19:
yathA siMhasya nadataH svanaM shrutvetare mRRigAH |
traseyustadvadevAsIddhArtarAShTrabalaM tadA
shlokas.20:
udatiShThadrajo bhaumaM na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana |
antardhIyata chAdityaH sainyena rajasAvRRitaH
shlokas.21:
vavarSha chAtra parjanyo mA.nsashoNitavRRiShTimAn |
vyukShansarvANyanIkAni tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.22:
vAyustataH prAdurabhUnnIchaiH sharkarakarShaNaH |
vinighna.nstAnyanIkAni vidhama.nshchaiva tadrajaH
shlokas.23:
ubhe sene tadA rAjanyuddhAya mudite bhRRisham |
kurukShetre sthite yatte sAgarakShubhitopame
shlokas.24:
tayostu senayorAsIdadbhutaH sa samAgamaH |
yugAnte samanuprApte dvayoH sAgarayoriva
shlokas.25:
shUnyAsItpRRithivI sarvA bAlavRRiddhAvasheShitA |
tena senAsamUhena samAnItena kauravaiH
shlokas.26:
tataste samayaM chakruH kurupANDavasomakAH |
dharmA.nshcha sthApayAmAsuryuddhAnAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.27:
nivRRitte chaiva no yuddhe prItishcha syAtparasparam |
yathApuraM yathAyogaM na cha syAchChalanaM punaH
shlokas.28:
vAchA yuddhe pravRRitte no vAchaiva pratiyodhanam |
niShkrAntaH pRRitanAmadhyAnna hantavyaH katha~nchana
shlokas.29:
rathI cha rathinA yodhyo gajena gajadhUrgataH |
ashvenAshvI padAtishcha padAtenaiva bhArata
shlokas.30:
yathAyogaM yathAvIryaM yathotsAhaM yathAvayaH |
samAbhAShya prahartavyaM na vishvaste na vihvale
shlokas.31:
pareNa saha sa.nyuktaH pramatto vimukhastathA |
kShINashastro vivarmA cha na hantavyaH katha~nchana
shlokas.32:
na sUteShu na dhuryeShu na cha shastropanAyiShu |
na bherIsha~NkhavAdeShu prahartavyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.33:
evaM te samayaM kRRitvA kurupANDavasomakAH |
vismayaM paramaM jagmuH prekShamANAH parasparam
shlokas.34:
nivishya cha mahAtmAnastataste puruSharShabhAH |
hRRiShTarUpAH sumanaso babhUvuH sahasainikAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH pUrvApare sandhye samIkShya bhagavAnRRiShiH |
sarvavedavidAM shreShTho vyAsaH satyavatIsutaH
shlokas.2:
bhaviShyati raNe ghore bharatAnAM pitAmahaH |
pratyakShadarshI bhagavAnbhUtabhavyabhaviShyavit
shlokas.3:
vaichitravIryaM rAjAnaM sa rahasyaM bravIdidam |
shochantamArtaM dhyAyantaM putrANAmanayaM tadA
shlokas.4:
vyAsa uvAcha||
rAjanparItakAlAste putrAshchAnye cha bhUmipAH |
te haniShyanti sa~NgrAme samAsAdyetaretaram
shlokas.5:
teShu kAlaparIteShu vinashyatsu cha bhArata |
kAlaparyAyamAj~nAya mA sma shoke manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.6:
yadi tvichChasi sa~NgrAme draShTumenaM vishAM pate |
chakShurdadAni te hanta yuddhametannishAmaya
shlokas.7:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
na rochaye j~nAtivadhaM draShTuM brahmarShisattama |
yuddhametattvasheSheNa shRRiNuyAM tava tejasA
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminnanichChati draShTuM sa~NgrAmaM shrotumichChati |
varANAmIshvaro dAtA sa~njayAya varaM dadau
shlokas.9:
vyAsa uvAcha||
eSha te sa~njayo rAjanyuddhametadvadiShyati |
etasya sarvaM sa~NgrAme naparokShaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.10:
chakShuShA sa~njayo rAjandivyenaiSha samanvitaH |
kathayiShyati te yuddhaM sarvaj~nashcha bhaviShyati
shlokas.11:
prakAshaM vA rahasyaM vA rAtrau vA yadi vA divA |
manasA chintitamapi sarvaM vetsyati sa~njayaH
shlokas.12:
nainaM shastrANi bhetsyanti nainaM bAdhiShyate shramaH |
gAvalgaNirayaM jIvanyuddhAdasmAdvimokShyate
shlokas.13:
ahaM cha kIrtimeteShAM kurUNAM bharatarShabha |
pANDavAnAM cha sarveShAM prathayiShyAmi mA shuchaH
shlokas.14:
diShTametatpurA chaiva nAtra shochitumarhasi |
na chaiva shakyaM sa.nyantuM yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA sa bhagavAnkurUNAM prapitAmahaH |
punareva mahAbAhuM dhRRitarAShTramuvAcha ha
shlokas.16:
iha yuddhe mahArAja bhaviShyati mahAnkShayaH |
yathemAni nimittAni bhayAyAdyopalakShaye
shlokas.17:
shyenA gRRidhrAshcha kAkAshcha ka~NkAshcha sahitA balaiH |
sampatanti vanAnteShu samavAyA.nshcha kurvate
shlokas.18:
atyugraM cha prapashyanti yuddhamAnandino dvijAH |
kravyAdA bhakShayiShyanti mA.nsAni gajavAjinAm
shlokas.19:
khaTAkhaTeti vAshanto bhairavaM bhayavedinaH |
kahvAH prayAnti madhyena dakShiNAmabhito disham
shlokas.20:
ubhe pUrvApare sandhye nityaM pashyAmi bhArata |
udayAstamane sUryaM kabandhaiH parivAritam
shlokas.21:
shvetalohitaparyantAH kRRiShNagrIvAH savidyutaH |
trivarNAH parighAH sandhau bhAnumAvArayantyuta
shlokas.22:
jvalitArkendunakShatraM nirvisheShadinakShapam |
ahorAtraM mayA dRRiShTaM tatkShayAya bhaviShyati
shlokas.23:
alakShyaH prabhayA hInaH paurNamAsIM cha kArttikIm |
chandro.abhUdagnivarNashcha samavarNe nabhastale
shlokas.24:
svapsyanti nihatA vIrA bhUmimAvRRitya pArthivAH |
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha shUrAH parighabAhavaH
shlokas.25:
antarikShe varAhasya vRRiShada.nshasya chobhayoH |
praNAdaM yudhyato rAtrau raudraM nityaM pralakShaye
shlokas.26:
devatApratimAshchApi kampanti cha hasanti cha |
vamanti rudhiraM chAsyaiH svidyanti prapatanti cha
shlokas.27:
anAhatA dundubhayaH praNadanti vishAM pate |
ayuktAshcha pravartante kShatriyANAM mahArathAH
shlokas.28:
kokilAH shatapatrAshcha chAShA bhAsAH shukAstathA |
sArasAshcha mayUrAshcha vAcho mu~nchanti dAruNAH
shlokas.29:
gRRihItashastrAbharaNA varmiNo vAjipRRiShThagAH |
aruNodayeShu dRRishyante shatashaH shalabhavrajAH
shlokas.30:
ubhe sandhye prakAshete dishAM dAhasamanvite |
AsIdrudhiravarShaM cha asthivarShaM cha bhArata
shlokas.31:
yA chaiShA vishrutA rAja.nstrailokye sAdhusaMmatA |
arundhatI tayApyeSha vasiShThaH pRRiShThataH kRRitaH
shlokas.32:
rohiNIM pIDayanneSha sthito rAja~nshanaishcharaH |
vyAvRRittaM lakShma somasya bhaviShyati mahadbhayam
shlokas.33:
anabhre cha mahAghoraM stanitaM shrUyate.anisham |
vAhanAnAM cha rudatAM prapatantyashrubindavaH

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
kharA goShu prajAyante ramante mAtRRibhiH sutAH |
anArtavaM puShpaphalaM darshayanti vane drumAH
shlokas.2:
garbhiNyo rAjaputryashcha janayanti vibhIShaNAn |
kravyAdAnpakShiNashchaiva gomAyUnaparAnmRRigAn
shlokas.3:
triviShANAshchaturnetrAH pa~nchapAdA dvimehanAH |
dvishIrShAshcha dvipuchChAshcha daMShTriNaH pashavo.ashivAH
shlokas.4:
jAyante vivRRitAsyAshcha vyAharanto.ashivA giraH |
tripadAH shikhinastArkShyAshchaturdaMShTrA viShANinaH
shlokas.5:
tathaivAnyAshcha dRRishyante striyashcha brahmavAdinAm |
vainateyAnmayUrA.nshcha janayantyaH pure tava
shlokas.6:
govatsaM vaDavA sUte shvA sRRigAlaM mahIpate |
krakarA~nshArikAshchaiva shukA.nshchAshubhavAdinaH
shlokas.7:
striyaH kAshchitprajAyante chatasraH pa~ncha kanyakAH |
tA jAtamAtrA nRRityanti gAyanti cha hasanti cha
shlokas.8:
pRRithagjanasya kuDakAH stanapAH stenaveshmani |
nRRityanti parigAyanti vedayanto mahadbhayam
shlokas.9:
pratimAshchAlikhantyanye sashastrAH kAlachoditAH |
anyonyamabhidhAvanti shishavo daNDapANayaH
uparundhanti kRRitvA cha nagarANi yuyutsavaH
shlokas.10:
padmotpalAni vRRikSheShu jAyante kumudAni cha |
viShvagvAtAshcha vAntyugrA rajo na vyupashAmyati
shlokas.11:
abhIkShNaM kampate bhUmirarkaM rAhustathAgrasat |
shveto grahastathA chitrAM samatikramya tiShThati
shlokas.12:
abhAvaM hi visheSheNa kurUNAM pratipashyati |
dhUmaketurmahAghoraH puShyamAkramya tiShThati
shlokas.13:
senayorashivaM ghoraM kariShyati mahAgrahaH |
maghAsva~NgArako vakraH shravaNe cha bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.14:
bhAgyaM nakShatramAkramya sUryaputreNa pIDyate |
shukraH proShThapade pUrve samAruhya vishAM pate
uttare tu parikramya sahitaH pratyudIkShate
shlokas.15:
shyAmo grahaH prajvalitaH sadhUmaH sahapAvakaH |
aindraM tejasvi nakShatraM jyeShThAmAkramya tiShThati
shlokas.16:
dhruvaH prajvalito ghoramapasavyaM pravartate |
chitrAsvAtyantare chaiva dhiShThitaH paruSho grahaH
shlokas.17:
vakrAnuvakraM kRRitvA cha shravaNe pAvakaprabhaH |
brahmarAshiM samAvRRitya lohitA~Ngo vyavasthitaH
shlokas.18:
sarvasasyapratichChannA pRRithivI phalamAlinI |
pa~nchashIrShA yavAshchaiva shatashIrShAshcha shAlayaH
shlokas.19:
pradhAnAH sarvalokasya yAsvAyattamidaM jagat |
tA gAvaH prasnutA vatsaiH shoNitaM prakSharantyuta
shlokas.20:
nishcherurapidhAnebhyaH khaDgAH prajvalitA bhRRisham |
vyaktaM pashyanti shastrANi sa~NgrAmaM samupasthitam
shlokas.21:
agnivarNA yathA bhAsaH shastrANAmudakasya cha |
kavachAnAM dhvajAnAM cha bhaviShyati mahAnkShayaH
shlokas.22:
dikShu prajvalitAsyAshcha vyAharanti mRRigadvijAH |
atyAhitaM darshayanto vedayanti mahadbhayam
shlokas.23:
ekapakShAkShicharaNaH shakuniH khacharo nishi |
raudraM vadati sa.nrabdhaH shoNitaM ChardayanmuhuH
shlokas.24:
grahau tAmrAruNashikhau prajvalantAviva sthitau |
saptarShINAmudArANAM samavachChAdya vai prabhAm
shlokas.25:
sa.nvatsarasthAyinau cha grahau prajvalitAvubhau |
vishAkhayoH samIpasthau bRRihaspatishanaishcharau
shlokas.26:
kRRittikAsu grahastIvro nakShatre prathame jvalan |
vapUMShyapaharanbhAsA dhUmaketuriva sthitaH
shlokas.27:
triShu pUrveShu sarveShu nakShatreShu vishAM pate |
budhaH sampatate.abhIkShNaM janayansumahadbhayam
shlokas.28:
chaturdashIM pa~nchadashIM bhUtapUrvAM cha ShoDashIm |
imAM tu nAbhijAnAmi amAvAsyAM trayodashIm
shlokas.29:
chandrasUryAvubhau grastAvekamAse trayodashIm |
aparvaNi grahAvetau prajAH sa~NkShapayiShyataH
shlokas.30:
rajovRRitA dishaH sarvAH pA.nsuvarShaiH samantataH |
utpAtameghA raudrAshcha rAtrau varShanti shoNitam
shlokas.31:
mA.nsavarShaM punastIvramAsItkRRiShNachaturdashIm |
ardharAtre mahAghoramatRRipya.nstatra rAkShasAH
shlokas.32:
pratisroto.avahannadyaH saritaH shoNitodakAH |
phenAyamAnAH kUpAshcha nardanti vRRiShabhA iva
patantyulkAH sanirghAtAH shuShkAshanivimishritAH
shlokas.33:
adya chaiva nishAM vyuShTAmudaye bhAnurAhataH |
jvalantIbhirmaholkAbhishchaturbhiH sarvatodisham
shlokas.34:
AdityamupatiShThadbhistatra choktaM maharShibhiH |
bhUmipAlasahasrANAM bhUmiH pAsyati shoNitam
shlokas.35:
kailAsamandarAbhyAM tu tathA himavato gireH |
sahasrasho mahAshabdaM shikharANi patanti cha
shlokas.36:
mahAbhUtA bhUmikampe chaturaH sAgarAnpRRithak |
velAmudvartayanti sma kShobhayantaH punaH punaH
shlokas.37:
vRRikShAnunmathya vAntyugrA vAtAH sharkarakarShiNaH |
patanti chaityavRRikShAshcha grAmeShu nagareShu cha
shlokas.38:
pItalohitanIlashcha jvalatyagnirhuto dvijaiH |
vAmArchiH shAvagandhI cha dhUmaprAyaH kharasvanaH
sparshA gandhA rasAshchaiva viparItA mahIpate
shlokas.39:
dhUmAyante dhvajA rAj~nAM kampamAnA muhurmuhuH |
mu~nchantya~NgAravarShANi bheryo.atha paTahAstathA
shlokas.40:
prAsAdashikharAgreShu puradvAreShu chaiva hi |
gRRidhrAH paripatantyugrA vAmaM maNDalamAshritAH
shlokas.41:
pakvApakveti subhRRishaM vAvAshyante vayA.nsi cha |
nilIyante dhvajAgreShu kShayAya pRRithivIkShitAm
shlokas.42:
dhyAyantaH prakirantashcha vAlAnvepathusa.nyutAH |
rudanti dInAsturagA mAta~NgAshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.43:
etachChrutvA bhavAnatra prAptakAlaM vyavasyatAm |
yathA lokaH samuchChedaM nAyaM gachCheta bhArata
shlokas.44:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
piturvacho nishamyaitaddhRRitarAShTro.abravIdidam |
diShTametatpurA manye bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.45:
kShatriyAH kShatradharmeNa vadhyante yadi sa.nyuge |
vIralokaM samAsAdya sukhaM prApsyanti kevalam
shlokas.46:
iha kIrtiM pare loke dIrghakAlaM mahatsukham |
prApsyanti puruShavyAghrAH prANA.nstyaktvA mahAhave

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukto munistattvaM kavIndro rAjasattama |
putreNa dhRRitarAShTreNa dhyAnamanvagamatparam
shlokas.2:
punarevAbravIdvAkyaM kAlavAdI mahAtapAH |
asa.nshayaM pArthivendra kAlaH sa~NkShipate jagat
shlokas.3:
sRRijate cha punarlokAnneha vidyati shAshvatam |
j~nAtInAM cha kurUNAM cha sambandhisuhRRidAM tathA
shlokas.4:
dharmyaM deshaya panthAnaM samartho hyasi vAraNe |
kShudraM j~nAtivadhaM prAhurmA kuruShva mamApriyam
shlokas.5:
kAlo.ayaM putrarUpeNa tava jAto vishAM pate |
na vadhaH pUjyate vede hitaM naitatkatha~nchana
shlokas.6:
hanyAtsa eva yo hanyAtkuladharmaM svakAM tanum |
kAlenotpathagantAsi shakye sati yathApathi
shlokas.7:
kulasyAsya vinAshAya tathaiva cha mahIkShitAm |
anartho rAjyarUpeNa tyajyatAmasukhAvahaH
shlokas.8:
luptapraj~naH pareNAsi dharmaM darshaya vai sutAn |
kiM te rAjyena durdharSha yena prApto.asi kilbiSham
shlokas.9:
yasho dharmaM cha kIrtiM cha pAlayansvargamApsyasi |
labhantAM pANDavA rAjyaM shamaM gachChantu kauravAH
shlokas.10:
evaM bruvati viprendre dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
AkShipya vAkyaM vAkyaj~no vAkpathenApyayAtpunaH
shlokas.11:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yathA bhavAnveda tathAsmi vettA; bhAvAbhAvau viditau me yathAvat |
svArthe hi saMmuhyati tAta loko; mAM chApi lokAtmakameva viddhi
shlokas.12:
prasAdaye tvAmatulaprabhAvaM; tvaM no gatirdarshayitA cha dhIraH |
na chApi te vashagA me maharShe; na kalmaShaM kartumihArhase mAm
shlokas.13:
tvaM hi dharmaH pavitraM cha yashaH kIrtirdhRRitiH smRRitiH |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha mAnyashchAsi pitAmahaH
shlokas.14:
vyAsa uvAcha||
vaichitravIrya nRRipate yatte manasi vartate |
abhidhatsva yathAkAmaM ChettAsmi tava sa.nshayam
shlokas.15:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yAni li~NgAni sa~NgrAme bhavanti vijayiShyatAm |
tAni sarvANi bhagava~nshrotumichChAmi tattvataH
shlokas.16:
vyAsa uvAcha||
prasannabhAH pAvaka UrdhvarashmiH; pradakShiNAvartashikho vidhUmaH |
puNyA gandhAshchAhutInAM pravAnti; jayasyaitadbhAvino rUpamAhuH
shlokas.17:
gambhIraghoShAshcha mahAsvanAshcha; sha~NkhA mRRida~NgAshcha nadanti yatra |
vishuddharashmistapanaH shashI cha; jayasyaitadbhAvino rUpamAhuH
shlokas.18:
iShTA vAchaH pRRiShThato vAyasAnAM; samprasthitAnAM cha gamiShyatAM cha |
ye pRRiShThataste tvarayanti rAja;nye tvagrataste pratiShedhayanti
shlokas.19:
kalyANavAchaH shakunA rAjaha.nsAH; shukAH krau~nchAH shatapatrAshcha yatra |
pradakShiNAshchaiva bhavanti sa~Nkhye; dhruvaM jayaM tatra vadanti viprAH
shlokas.20:
ala~NkAraiH kavachaiH ketubhishcha; mukhaprasAdairhemavarNaishcha nR^INAm |
bhrAjiShmatI duShpratiprekShaNIyA; yeShAM chamUste vijayanti shatrUn
shlokas.21:
hRRiShTA vAchastathA sattvaM yodhAnAM yatra bhArata |
na mlAyante srajashchaiva te taranti raNe ripUn
shlokas.22:
iShTo vAtaH praviShTasya dakShiNA pravivikShataH |
pashchAtsa.nsAdhayatyarthaM purastAtpratiShedhate
shlokas.23:
shabdarUparasasparshagandhAshchAviShkRRitAH shubhAH |
sadA yodhAshcha hRRiShTAshcha yeShAM teShAM dhruvaM jayaH
shlokas.24:
anveva vAyavo vAnti tathAbhrANi vayA.nsi cha |
anuplavante meghAshcha tathaivendradhanUMShi cha
shlokas.25:
etAni jayamAnAnAM lakShaNAni vishAM pate |
bhavanti viparItAni mumUrShUNAM janAdhipa
shlokas.26:
alpAyAM vA mahatyAM vA senAyAmiti nishchitam |
harSho yodhagaNasyaikaM jayalakShaNamuchyate
shlokas.27:
eko dIrNo dArayati senAM sumahatImapi |
taM dIrNamanudIryante yodhAH shUratamA api
shlokas.28:
durnivAratamA chaiva prabhagnA mahatI chamUH |
apAmiva mahAvegastrastA mRRigagaNA iva
shlokas.29:
naiva shakyA samAdhAtuM saMnipAte mahAchamUH |
dIrNA ityeva dIryante yodhAH shUratamA api
bhItAnbhagnA.nshcha samprekShya bhayaM bhUyo vivardhate
shlokas.30:
prabhagnA sahasA rAjandisho vibhrAmitA paraiH |
naiva sthApayituM shakyA shUrairapi mahAchamUH
shlokas.31:
sambhRRitya mahatIM senAM chatura~NgAM mahIpatiH |
upAyapUrvaM medhAvI yateta satatotthitaH
shlokas.32:
upAyavijayaM shreShThamAhurbhedena madhyamam |
jaghanya eSha vijayo yo yuddhena vishAM pate
mahAdoShaH saMnipAtastato vya~NgaH sa uchyate
shlokas.33:
parasparaj~nAH saMhRRiShTA vyavadhUtAH sunishchitAH |
pa~nchAshadapi ye shUrA mathnanti mahatIM chamUm
atha vA pa~ncha ShaTsapta vijayantyanivartinaH
shlokas.34:
na vainateyo garuDaH prasha.nsati mahAjanam |
dRRiShTvA suparNopachitiM mahatImapi bhArata
shlokas.35:
na bAhulyena senAyA jayo bhavati bhArata |
adhruvo hi jayo nAma daivaM chAtra parAyaNam
jayanto hyapi sa~NgrAme kShayavanto bhavantyuta

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA yayau vyAso dhRRitarAShTrAya dhImate |
dhRRitarAShTro.api tachChrutvA dhyAnamevAnvapadyata
shlokas.2:
sa muhUrtamiva dhyAtvA viniHshvasya muhurmuhuH |
sa~njayaM sa.nshitAtmAnamapRRichChadbharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
sa~njayeme mahIpAlAH shUrA yuddhAbhinandinaH |
anyonyamabhinighnanti shastrairuchchAvachairapi
shlokas.4:
pArthivAH pRRithivIhetoH samabhityaktajIvitAH |
na cha shAmyanti nighnanto vardhayanto yamakShayam
shlokas.5:
bhaumamaishvaryamichChanto na mRRiShyante parasparam |
manye bahuguNA bhUmistanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.6:
bahUni cha sahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
koTyashcha lokavIrANAM sametAH kurujA~Ngale
shlokas.7:
deshAnAM cha parImANaM nagarANAM cha sa~njaya |
shrotumichChAmi tattvena yata ete samAgatAH
shlokas.8:
divyabuddhipradIpena yuktastvaM j~nAnachakShuShA |
prasAdAttasya viprarShervyAsasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.9:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yathApraj~naM mahAprAj~na bhaumAnvakShyAmi te guNAn |
shAstrachakShuravekShasva namaste bharatarShabha
shlokas.10:
dvividhAnIha bhUtAni trasAni sthAvarANi cha |
trasAnAM trividhA yoniraNDasvedajarAyujAH
shlokas.11:
trasAnAM khalu sarveShAM shreShThA rAja~njarAyujAH |
jarAyujAnAM pravarA mAnavAH pashavashcha ye
shlokas.12:
nAnArUpANi bibhrANAsteShAM bhedAshchaturdasha |
araNyavAsinaH sapta saptaiShAM grAmavAsinaH
shlokas.13:
siMhavyAghravarAhAshcha mahiShA vAraNAstathA |
RRikShAshcha vAnarAshchaiva saptAraNyAH smRRitA nRRipa
shlokas.14:
gaurajo manujo meSho vAjyashvataragardabhAH |
ete grAmyAH samAkhyAtAH pashavaH sapta sAdhubhiH
shlokas.15:
ete vai pashavo rAjangrAmyAraNyAshchaturdasha |
vedoktAH pRRithivIpAla yeShu yaj~nAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.16:
grAmyANAM puruShaH shreShThaH siMhashchAraNyavAsinAm |
sarveShAmeva bhUtAnAmanyonyenAbhijIvanam
shlokas.17:
udbhijjAH sthAvarAH proktAsteShAM pa~nchaiva jAtayaH |
vRRikShagulmalatAvallyastvaksArAstRRiNajAtayaH
shlokas.18:
eShAM vi.nshatirekonA mahAbhUteShu pa~nchasu |
chaturvi.nshatiruddiShTA gAyatrI lokasaMmatA
shlokas.19:
ya etAM veda gAyatrIM puNyAM sarvaguNAnvitAm |
tattvena bharatashreShTha sa lokAnna praNashyati
shlokas.20:
bhUmau hi jAyate sarvaM bhUmau sarvaM praNashyati |
bhUmiH pratiShThA bhUtAnAM bhUmireva parAyaNam
shlokas.21:
yasya bhUmistasya sarvaM jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam |
tatrAbhigRRiddhA rAjAno vinighnantItaretaram

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
nadInAM parvatAnAM cha nAmadheyAni sa~njaya |
tathA janapadAnAM cha ye chAnye bhUmimAshritAH
shlokas.2:
pramANaM cha pramANaj~na pRRithivyA api sarvashaH |
nikhilena samAchakShva kAnanAni cha sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pa~nchemAni mahArAja mahAbhUtAni sa~NgrahAt |
jagatsthitAni sarvANi samAnyAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.4:
bhUmirApastathA vAyuragnirAkAshameva cha |
guNottarANi sarvANi teShAM bhUmiH pradhAnataH
shlokas.5:
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha raso gandhashcha pa~nchamaH |
bhUmerete guNAH proktA RRiShibhistattvavedibhiH
shlokas.6:
chatvAro.apsu guNA rAjangandhastatra na vidyate |
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha tejaso.atha guNAstrayaH
shabdaH sparshashcha vAyostu AkAshe shabda eva cha
shlokas.7:
ete pa~ncha guNA rAjanmahAbhUteShu pa~nchasu |
vartante sarvalokeShu yeShu lokAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.8:
anyonyaM nAbhivartante sAmyaM bhavati vai yadA |
yadA tu viShamIbhAvamAvishanti parasparam
tadA dehairdehavanto vyatirohanti nAnyathA
shlokas.9:
AnupUrvyAdvinashyanti jAyante chAnupUrvashaH |
sarvANyaparimeyAni tadeShAM rUpamaishvaram
shlokas.10:
tatra tatra hi dRRishyante dhAtavaH pA~nchabhautikAH |
teShAM manuShyAstarkeNa pramANAni prachakShate
shlokas.11:
achintyAH khalu ye bhAvA na tA.nstarkeNa sAdhayet |
prakRRitibhyaH paraM yattu tadachintyasya lakShaNam
shlokas.12:
sudarshanaM pravakShyAmi dvIpaM te kurunandana |
parimaNDalo mahArAja dvIpo.asau chakrasa.nsthitaH
shlokas.13:
nadIjalapratichChannaH parvataishchAbhrasaMnibhaiH |
puraishcha vividhAkArai ramyairjanapadaistathA
shlokas.14:
vRRikShaiH puShpaphalopetaiH sampannadhanadhAnyavAn |
lAvaNena samudreNa samantAtparivAritaH
shlokas.15:
yathA cha puruShaH pashyedAdarshe mukhamAtmanaH |
evaM sudarshanadvIpo dRRishyate chandramaNDale
shlokas.16:
dvira.nshe pippalastatra dvira.nshe cha shasho mahAn |
sarvauShadhisamAvApaiH sarvataH paribRRiMhitaH
Apastato.anyA vij~neyA eSha sa~NkShepa uchyate

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ukto dvIpasya sa~NkShepo vistaraM brUhi sa~njaya |
yAvadbhUmyavakAsho.ayaM dRRishyate shashalakShaNe
tasya pramANaM prabrUhi tato vakShyasi pippalam
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa rAj~nA tu sa~njayo vAkyamabravIt |
prAgAyatA mahArAja ShaDete ratnaparvatAH
avagADhA hyubhayataH samudrau pUrvapashchimau
shlokas.3:
himavAnhemakUTashcha niShadhashcha nagottamaH |
nIlashcha vaiDUryamayaH shvetashcha rajataprabhaH
sarvadhAtuvinaddhashcha shRRi~NgavAnnAma parvataH
shlokas.4:
ete vai parvatA rAjansiddhachAraNasevitAH |
teShAmantaraviShkambho yojanAni sahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
tatra puNyA janapadAstAni varShANi bhArata |
vasanti teShu sattvAni nAnAjAtIni sarvashaH
shlokas.6:
idaM tu bhArataM varShaM tato haimavataM param |
hemakUTAtparaM chaiva harivarShaM prachakShate
shlokas.7:
dakShiNena tu nIlasya niShadhasyottareNa cha |
prAgAyato mahArAja mAlyavAnnAma parvataH
shlokas.8:
tataH paraM mAlyavataH parvato gandhamAdanaH |
parimaNDalastayormadhye meruH kanakaparvataH
shlokas.9:
AdityataruNAbhAso vidhUma iva pAvakaH |
yojanAnAM sahasrANi ShoDashAdhaH kila smRRitaH
shlokas.10:
uchchaishcha chaturAshItiryojanAnAM mahIpate |
Urdhvamantashcha tiryakcha lokAnAvRRitya tiShThati
shlokas.11:
tasya pArshve tvime dvIpAshchatvAraH sa.nsthitAH prabho |
bhadrAshvaH ketumAlashcha jambUdvIpashcha bhArata
uttarAshchaiva kuravaH kRRitapuNyapratishrayAH
shlokas.12:
vihagaH sumukho yatra suparNasyAtmajaH kila |
sa vai vichintayAmAsa sauvarNAnprekShya vAyasAn
shlokas.13:
meruruttamamadhyAnAmadhamAnAM cha pakShiNAm |
avisheShakaro yasmAttasmAdenaM tyajAmyaham
shlokas.14:
tamAdityo.anuparyeti satataM jyotiShAM patiH |
chandramAshcha sanakShatro vAyushchaiva pradakShiNam
shlokas.15:
sa parvato mahArAja divyapuShpaphalAnvitaH |
bhavanairAvRRitaH sarvairjAmbUnadamayaiH shubhaiH
shlokas.16:
tatra devagaNA rAjangandharvAsurarAkShasAH |
apsarogaNasa.nyuktAH shaile krIDanti nityashaH
shlokas.17:
tatra brahmA cha rudrashcha shakrashchApi sureshvaraH |
sametya vividhairyaj~nairyajante.anekadakShiNaiH
shlokas.18:
tumbururnAradashchaiva vishvAvasurhahA huhUH |
abhigamyAmarashreShThAH stavai stunvanti chAbhibho
shlokas.19:
saptarShayo mahAtmAnaH kashyapashcha prajApatiH |
tatra gachChanti bhadraM te sadA parvaNi parvaNi
shlokas.20:
tasyaiva mUrdhanyushanAH kAvyo daityairmahIpate |
tasya hImAni ratnAni tasyeme ratnaparvatAH
shlokas.21:
tasmAtkubero bhagavA.nshchaturthaM bhAgamashnute |
tataH kalA.nshaM vittasya manuShyebhyaH prayachChati
shlokas.22:
pArshve tasyottare divyaM sarvartukusumaM shivam |
karNikAravanaM ramyaM shilAjAlasamudgatam
shlokas.23:
tatra sAkShAtpashupatirdivyairbhUtaiH samAvRRitaH |
umAsahAyo bhagavAnramate bhUtabhAvanaH
shlokas.24:
karNikAramayIM mAlAM bibhratpAdAvalambinIm |
tribhirnetraiH kRRitoddyotastribhiH sUryairivoditaiH
shlokas.25:
tamugratapasaH siddhAH suvratAH satyavAdinaH |
pashyanti na hi durvRRittaiH shakyo draShTuM maheshvaraH
shlokas.26:
tasya shailasya shikharAtkShIradhArA nareshvara |
tri.nshadbAhuparigrAhyA bhImanirghAtanisvanA
shlokas.27:
puNyA puNyatamairjuShTA ga~NgA bhAgIrathI shubhA |
patatyajasravegena hrade chAndramase shubhe
tayA hyutpAditaH puNyaH sa hradaH sAgaropamaH
shlokas.28:
tAM dhArayAmAsa purA durdharAM parvatairapi |
shataM varShasahasrANAM shirasA vai maheshvaraH
shlokas.29:
merostu pashchime pArshve ketumAlo mahIpate |
jambUShaNDashcha tatraiva sumahAnnandanopamaH
shlokas.30:
Ayurdasha sahasrANi varShANAM tatra bhArata |
suvarNavarNAshcha narAH striyashchApsarasopamAH
shlokas.31:
anAmayA vItashokA nityaM muditamAnasAH |
jAyante mAnavAstatra niShTaptakanakaprabhAH
shlokas.32:
gandhamAdanashRRi~NgeShu kuberaH saha rAkShasaiH |
sa.nvRRito.apsarasAM sa~Nghairmodate guhyakAdhipaH
shlokas.33:
gandhamAdanapAdeShu pareShvaparagaNDikAH |
ekAdasha sahasrANi varShANAM paramAyuShaH
shlokas.34:
tatra kRRiShNA narA rAja.nstejoyuktA mahAbalAH |
striyashchotpalapatrAbhAH sarvAH supriyadarshanAH
shlokas.35:
nIlAtparataraM shvetaM shvetAddhairaNyakaM param |
varShamairAvataM nAma tataH shRRi~NgavataH param
shlokas.36:
dhanuHsa.nsthe mahArAja dve varShe dakShiNottare |
ilAvRRitaM madhyamaM tu pa~ncha varShANi chaiva ha
shlokas.37:
uttarottarametebhyo varShamudrichyate guNaiH |
AyuShpramANamArogyaM dharmataH kAmato.arthataH
shlokas.38:
samanvitAni bhUtAni teShu varSheShu bhArata |
evameShA mahArAja parvataiH pRRithivI chitA
shlokas.39:
hemakUTastu sumahAnkailAso nAma parvataH |
yatra vaishravaNo rAjA guhyakaiH saha modate
shlokas.40:
astyuttareNa kailAsaM mainAkaM parvataM prati |
hiraNyashRRi~NgaH sumahAndivyo maNimayo giriH
shlokas.41:
tasya pArshve mahaddivyaM shubhaM kA~nchanavAlukam |
ramyaM bindusaro nAma yatra rAjA bhagIrathaH
dRRiShTvA bhAgIrathIM ga~NgAmuvAsa bahulAH samAH
shlokas.42:
yUpA maNimayAstatra chityAshchApi hiraNmayAH |
tatreShTvA tu gataH siddhiM sahasrAkSho mahAyashAH
shlokas.43:
sRRiShTvA bhUtapatiryatra sarvalokAnsanAtanaH |
upAsyate tigmatejA vRRito bhUtaiH samAgataiH
naranArAyaNau brahmA manuH sthANushcha pa~nchamaH
shlokas.44:
tatra tripathagA devI prathamaM tu pratiShThitA |
brahmalokAdapakrAntA saptadhA pratipadyate
shlokas.45:
vasvokasArA nalinI pAvanA cha sarasvatI |
jambUnadI cha sItA cha ga~NgA sindhushcha saptamI
shlokas.46:
achintyA divyasa~NkalpA prabhoreShaiva sa.nvidhiH |
upAsate yatra satraM sahasrayugaparyaye
shlokas.47:
dRRishyAdRRishyA cha bhavati tatra tatra sarasvatI |
etA divyAH sapta ga~NgAstriShu lokeShu vishrutAH
shlokas.48:
rakShA.nsi vai himavati hemakUTe tu guhyakAH |
sarpA nAgAshcha niShadhe gokarNe cha tapodhanAH
shlokas.49:
devAsurANAM cha gRRihaM shvetaH parvata uchyate |
gandharvA niShadhe shaile nIle brahmarShayo nRRipa
shRRi~NgavA.nstu mahArAja pitR^INAM pratisa~ncharaH
shlokas.50:
ityetAni mahArAja sapta varShANi bhAgashaH |
bhUtAnyupaniviShTAni gatimanti dhruvANi cha
shlokas.51:
teShAmRRiddhirbahuvidhA dRRishyate daivamAnuShI |
ashakyA parisa~NkhyAtuM shraddheyA tu bubhUShatA
shlokas.52:
yAM tu pRRichChasi mA rAjandivyAmetAM shashAkRRitim |
pArshve shashasya dve varShe ubhaye dakShiNottare
karNau tu nAgadvIpaM cha kashyapadvIpameva cha
shlokas.53:
tAmravarNaH shiro rAja~nshrImAnmalayaparvataH |
etaddvitIyaM dvIpasya dRRishyate shashasa.nsthitam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
merorathottaraM pArshvaM pUrvaM chAchakShva sa~njaya |
nikhilena mahAbuddhe mAlyavantaM cha parvatam
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dakShiNena tu nIlasya meroH pArshve tathottare |
uttarAH kuravo rAjanpuNyAH siddhaniShevitAH
shlokas.3:
tatra vRRikShA madhuphalA nityapuShpaphalopagAH |
puShpANi cha sugandhIni rasavanti phalAni cha
shlokas.4:
sarvakAmaphalAstatra kechidvRRikShA janAdhipa |
apare kShIriNo nAma vRRikShAstatra narAdhipa
shlokas.5:
ye kSharanti sadA kShIraM ShaDrasaM hyamRRitopamam |
vastrANi cha prasUyante phaleShvAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.6:
sarvA maNimayI bhUmiH sUkShmakA~nchanavAlukA |
sarvatra sukhasa.nsparshA niShpa~NkA cha janAdhipa
shlokas.7:
devalokachyutAH sarve jAyante tatra mAnavAH |
tulyarUpaguNopetAH sameShu viShameShu cha
shlokas.8:
mithunAni cha jAyante striyashchApsarasopamAH |
teShAM te kShIriNAM kShIraM pibantyamRRitasaMnibham
shlokas.9:
mithunaM jAyamAnaM vai samaM tachcha pravardhate |
tulyarUpaguNopetaM samaveShaM tathaiva cha
ekaikamanuraktaM cha chakravAkasamaM vibho
shlokas.10:
nirAmayA vItashokA nityaM muditamAnasAH |
dasha varShasahasrANi dasha varShashatAni cha
jIvanti te mahArAja na chAnyonyaM jahatyuta
shlokas.11:
bhAruNDA nAma shakunAstIkShNatuNDA mahAbalAH |
te nirharanti hi mRRitAndarIShu prakShipanti cha
shlokas.12:
uttarAH kuravo rAjanvyAkhyAtAste samAsataH |
meroH pArshvamahaM pUrvaM vakShyAmyatha yathAtatham
shlokas.13:
tasya pUrvAbhiShekastu bhadrAshvasya vishAM pate |
bhadrasAlavanaM yatra kAlAmrashcha mahAdrumaH
shlokas.14:
kAlAmrashcha mahArAja nityapuShpaphalaH shubhaH |
dvIpashcha yojanotsedhaH siddhachAraNasevitaH
shlokas.15:
tatra te puruShAH shvetAstejoyuktA mahAbalAH |
striyaH kumudavarNAshcha sundaryaH priyadarshanAH
shlokas.16:
chandraprabhAshchandravarNAH pUrNachandranibhAnanAH |
chandrashItalagAtryashcha nRRittagItavishAradAH
shlokas.17:
dasha varShasahasrANi tatrAyurbharatarShabha |
kAlAmrarasapItAste nityaM sa.nsthitayauvanAH
shlokas.18:
dakShiNena tu nIlasya niShadhasyottareNa tu |
sudarshano nAma mahA~njambUvRRikShaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.19:
sarvakAmaphalaH puNyaH siddhachAraNasevitaH |
tasya nAmnA samAkhyAto jambUdvIpaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.20:
yojanAnAM sahasraM cha shataM cha bharatarShabha |
utsedho vRRikSharAjasya divaspRRi~Nmanujeshvara
shlokas.21:
aratnInAM sahasraM cha shatAni dasha pa~ncha cha |
pariNAhastu vRRikShasya phalAnAM rasabhedinAm
shlokas.22:
patamAnAni tAnyurvyAM kurvanti vipulaM svanam |
mu~nchanti cha rasaM rAja.nstasminrajatasaMnibham
shlokas.23:
tasyA jambvAH phalaraso nadI bhUtvA janAdhipa |
meruM pradakShiNaM kRRitvA samprayAtyuttarAnkurUn
shlokas.24:
pibanti tadrasaM hRRiShTA janA nityaM janAdhipa |
tasminphalarase pIte na jarA bAdhate cha tAn
shlokas.25:
tatra jAmbUnadaM nAma kanakaM devabhUShaNam |
taruNAdityavarNAshcha jAyante tatra mAnavAH
shlokas.26:
tathA mAlyavataH shRRi~Nge dIpyate tatra havyavAT |
nAmnA sa.nvartako nAma kAlAgnirbharatarShabha
shlokas.27:
tathA mAlyavataH shRRi~Nge pUrve pUrvAntagaNDikA |
yojanAnAM sahasrANi pa~nchAshanmAlyavAnsthitaH
shlokas.28:
mahArajatasa~NkAshA jAyante tatra mAnavAH |
brahmalokAchchyutAH sarve sarve cha brahmavAdinaH
shlokas.29:
tapastu tapyamAnAste bhavanti hyUrdhvaretasaH |
rakShaNArthaM tu bhUtAnAM pravishanti divAkaram
shlokas.30:
ShaShTistAni sahasrANi ShaShTireva shatAni cha |
aruNasyAgrato yAnti parivArya divAkaram
shlokas.31:
ShaShTiM varShasahasrANi ShaShTimeva shatAni cha |
AdityatApataptAste vishanti shashimaNDalam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
varShANAM chaiva nAmAni parvatAnAM cha sa~njaya |
AchakShva me yathAtattvaM ye cha parvatavAsinaH
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dakShiNena tu shvetasya nIlasyaivottareNa tu |
varShaM ramaNakaM nAma jAyante tatra mAnavAH
shlokas.3:
shuklAbhijanasampannAH sarve supriyadarshanAH |
ratipradhAnAshcha tathA jAyante tatra mAnavAH
shlokas.4:
dasha varShasahasrANi shatAni dasha pa~ncha cha |
jIvanti te mahArAja nityaM muditamAnasAH
shlokas.5:
dakShiNe shRRi~NgiNashchaiva shvetasyAthottareNa cha |
varShaM hairaNvataM nAma yatra hairaNvatI nadI
shlokas.6:
yakShAnugA mahArAja dhaninaH priyadarshanAH |
mahAbalAstatra sadA rAjanmuditamAnasAH
shlokas.7:
ekAdasha sahasrANi varShANAM te janAdhipa |
AyuShpramANaM jIvanti shatAni dasha pa~ncha cha
shlokas.8:
shRRi~NgANi vai shRRi~NgavatastrINyeva manujAdhipa |
ekaM maNimayaM tatra tathaikaM raukmamadbhutam
shlokas.9:
sarvaratnamayaM chaikaM bhavanairupashobhitam |
tatra svayamprabhA devI nityaM vasati shANDilI
shlokas.10:
uttareNa tu shRRi~Ngasya samudrAnte janAdhipa |
varShamairAvataM nAma tasmAchChRRi~NgavataH param
shlokas.11:
na tatra sUryastapati na te jIryanti mAnavAH |
chandramAshcha sanakShatro jyotirbhUta ivAvRRitaH
shlokas.12:
padmaprabhAH padmavarNAH padmapatranibhekShaNAH |
padmapatrasugandhAshcha jAyante tatra mAnavAH
shlokas.13:
aniShpandAH sugandhAshcha nirAhArA jitendriyAH |
devalokachyutAH sarve tathA virajaso nRRipa
shlokas.14:
trayodasha sahasrANi varShANAM te janAdhipa |
AyuShpramANaM jIvanti narA bharatasattama
shlokas.15:
kShIrodasya samudrasya tathaivottarataH prabhuH |
harirvasati vaikuNThaH shakaTe kanakAtmake
shlokas.16:
aShTachakraM hi tadyAnaM bhUtayuktaM manojavam |
agnivarNaM mahAvegaM jAmbUnadapariShkRRitam
shlokas.17:
sa prabhuH sarvabhUtAnAM vibhushcha bharatarShabha |
sa~NkShepo vistarashchaiva kartA kArayitA cha saH
shlokas.18:
pRRithivyApastathAkAshaM vAyustejashcha pArthiva |
sa yaj~naH sarvabhUtAnAmAsyaM tasya hutAshanaH
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa~njayena dhRRitarAShTro mahAmanAH |
dhyAnamanvagamadrAjA putrAnprati janAdhipa
shlokas.20:
sa vichintya mahArAja punarevAbravIdvachaH |
asa.nshayaM sUtaputra kAlaH sa~NkShipate jagat
sRRijate cha punaH sarvaM neha vidyati shAshvatam
shlokas.21:
naro nArAyaNashchaiva sarvaj~naH sarvabhUtabhRRit |
devA vaikuNTha ityAhurvedA viShNuriti prabhum

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yadidaM bhArataM varShaM yatredaM mUrChitaM balam |
yatrAtimAtraM lubdho.ayaM putro duryodhano mama
shlokas.2:
yatra gRRiddhAH pANDusutA yatra me sajjate manaH |
etanme tattvamAchakShva kushalo hyasi sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
na tatra pANDavA gRRiddhAH shRRiNu rAjanvacho mama |
gRRiddho duryodhanastatra shakunishchApi saubalaH
shlokas.4:
apare kShatriyAshchApi nAnAjanapadeshvarAH |
ye gRRiddhA bhArate varShe na mRRiShyanti parasparam
shlokas.5:
atra te varNayiShyAmi varShaM bhArata bhAratam |
priyamindrasya devasya manorvaivasvatasya cha
shlokas.6:
pRRithoshcha rAjanvainyasya tathekShvAkormahAtmanaH |
yayAterambarIShasya mAndhAturnahuShasya cha
shlokas.7:
tathaiva muchukundasya shiberaushInarasya cha |
RRiShabhasya tathailasya nRRigasya nRRipatestathA
shlokas.8:
anyeShAM cha mahArAja kShatriyANAM balIyasAm |
sarveShAmeva rAjendra priyaM bhArata bhAratam
shlokas.9:
tatte varShaM pravakShyAmi yathAshrutamari.ndama |
shRRiNu me gadato rAjanyanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.10:
mahendro malayaH sahyaH shuktimAnRRikShavAnapi |
vindhyashcha pAriyAtrashcha saptaite kulaparvatAH
shlokas.11:
teShAM sahasrasho rAjanparvatAstu samIpataH |
abhij~nAtAH sAravanto vipulAshchitrasAnavaH
shlokas.12:
anye tato.aparij~nAtA hrasvA hrasvopajIvinaH |
AryA mlechChAshcha kauravya tairmishrAH puruShA vibho
shlokas.13:
nadIH pibanti bahulA ga~NgAM sindhuM sarasvatIm |
godAvarIM narmadAM cha bAhudAM cha mahAnadIm
shlokas.14:
shatadruM chandrabhAgAM cha yamunAM cha mahAnadIm |
dRRiShadvatIM vipAshAM cha vipApAM sthUlavAlukAm
shlokas.15:
nadIM vetravatIM chaiva kRRiShNaveNAM cha nimnagAm |
irAvatIM vitastAM cha payoShNIM devikAmapi
shlokas.16:
vedasmRRitiM vetasinIM tridivAmiShkumAlinIm |
karIShiNIM chitravahAM chitrasenAM cha nimnagAm
shlokas.17:
gomatIM dhUtapApAM cha vandanAM cha mahAnadIm |
kaushikIM tridivAM kRRityAM vichitrAM lohatAriNIm
shlokas.18:
rathasthAM shatakumbhAM cha sarayUM cha nareshvara |
charmaNvatIM vetravatIM hastisomAM dishaM tathA
shlokas.19:
shatAvarIM payoShNIM cha parAM bhaimarathIM tathA |
kAverIM chulukAM chApi vApIM shatabalAmapi
shlokas.20:
nichIrAM mahitAM chApi suprayogAM narAdhipa |
pavitrAM kuNDalAM sindhuM vAjinIM puramAlinIm
shlokas.21:
pUrvAbhirAmAM vIrAM cha bhImAmoghavatIM tathA |
palAshinIM pApaharAM mahendrAM pippalAvatIm
shlokas.22:
pAriSheNAmasiknIM cha saralAM bhAramardinIm |
puruhIM pravarAM menAM moghAM ghRRitavatIM tathA
shlokas.23:
dhUmatyAmatikRRiShNAM cha sUchIM ChAvIM cha kaurava |
sadAnIrAmadhRRiShyAM cha kushadhArAM mahAnadIm
shlokas.24:
shashikAntAM shivAM chaiva tathA vIravatImapi |
vAstuM suvAstuM gaurIM cha kampanAM sahiraNvatIm
shlokas.25:
hiraNvatIM chitravatIM chitrasenAM cha nimnagAm |
rathachitrAM jyotirathAM vishvAmitrAM kapi~njalAm
shlokas.26:
upendrAM bahulAM chaiva kucharAmambuvAhinIm |
vainandIM pi~njalAM veNNAM tu~NgaveNAM mahAnadIm
shlokas.27:
vidishAM kRRiShNaveNNAM cha tAmrAM cha kapilAmapi |
shaluM suvAmAM vedAshvAM harisrAvAM mahApagAm
shlokas.28:
shIghrAM cha pichChilAM chaiva bhAradvAjIM cha nimnagAm |
kaushikIM nimnagAM shoNAM bAhudAmatha chandanAm
shlokas.29:
durgAmantaHshilAM chaiva brahmamedhyAM bRRihadvatIm |
charakShAM mahirohIM cha tathA jambunadImapi
shlokas.30:
sunasAM tamasAM dAsIM trasAmanyAM varANasIm |
loloddhRRitakarAM chaiva pUrNAshAM cha mahAnadIm
shlokas.31:
mAnavIM vRRiShabhAM chaiva mahAnadyo janAdhipa |
sadAnirAmayAM vRRityAM mandagAM mandavAhinIm
shlokas.32:
brahmANIM cha mahAgaurIM durgAmapi cha bhArata |
chitropalAM chitrabarhAM ma~njuM makaravAhinIm
shlokas.33:
mandAkinIM vaitaraNIM kokAM chaiva mahAnadIm |
shuktimatImaraNyAM cha puShpaveNyutpalAvatIm
shlokas.34:
lohityAM karatoyAM cha tathaiva vRRiShabha~NginIm |
kumArImRRiShikulyAM cha brahmakulyAM cha bhArata
shlokas.35:
sarasvatIH supuNyAshcha sarvA ga~NgAshcha mAriSha |
vishvasya mAtaraH sarvAH sarvAshchaiva mahAbalAH
shlokas.36:
tathA nadyastvaprakAshAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
ityetAH sarito rAjansamAkhyAtA yathAsmRRiti
shlokas.37:
ata UrdhvaM janapadAnnibodha gadato mama |
tatreme kurupA~nchAlAH shAlvamAdreyajA~NgalAH
shlokas.38:
shUrasenAH kali~NgAshcha bodhA maukAstathaiva cha |
matsyAH sukuTyaH saubalyAH kuntalAH kAshikoshalAH
shlokas.39:
chedivatsAH karUShAshcha bhojAH sindhupulindakAH |
uttamaujA dashArNAshcha mekalAshchotkalaiH saha
shlokas.40:
pA~nchAlAH kaushijAshchaiva ekapRRiShThA yugandharAH |
saudhA madrA bhuji~NgAshcha kAshayo.aparakAshayaH
shlokas.41:
jaTharAH kukkushAshchaiva sudAshArNAshcha bhArata |
kuntayo.avantayashchaiva tathaivAparakuntayaH
shlokas.42:
govindA mandakAH ShaNDA vidarbhAnUpavAsikAH |
ashmakAH pA.nsurAShTrAshcha goparAShTrAH panItakAH
shlokas.43:
AdirAShTrAH sukuTTAshcha balirAShTraM cha kevalam |
vAnarAsyAH pravAhAshcha vakrA vakrabhayAH shakAH
shlokas.44:
videhakA mAgadhAshcha suhmAshcha vijayAstathA |
a~NgA va~NgAH kali~NgAshcha yakRRillomAna eva cha
shlokas.45:
mallAH sudeShNAH prAhUtAstathA mAhiShakArShikAH |
vAhIkA vATadhAnAshcha AbhIrAH kAlatoyakAH
shlokas.46:
aparandhrAshcha shUdrAshcha pahlavAshcharmakhaNDikAH |
aTavIshabarAshchaiva marubhaumAshcha mAriSha
shlokas.47:
upAvRRishchAnupAvRRishchasurAShTrAH kekayAstathA |
kuTTAparAntA dvaidheyAH kAkShAH sAmudraniShkuTAH
shlokas.48:
andhrAshcha bahavo rAjannantargiryAstathaiva cha |
bahirgiryA~NgamaladA mAgadhA mAnavarjakAH
shlokas.49:
mahyuttarAH prAvRRiSheyA bhArgavAshcha janAdhipa |
puNDrA bhArgAH kirAtAshcha sudoShNAH pramudAstathA
shlokas.50:
shakA niShAdA niShadhAstathaivAnartanairRRitAH |
dugUlAH pratimatsyAshcha kushalAH kunaTAstathA
shlokas.51:
tIragrAhAstaratoyA rAjikA rasyakAgaNAH |
tilakAH pArasIkAshcha madhumantaH prakutsakAH
shlokas.52:
kAshmIrAH sindhusauvIrA gAndhArA darshakAstathA |
abhIsArA kulUtAshcha shaivalA bAhlikAstathA
shlokas.53:
darvIkAH sakachA darvA vAtajAmarathoragAH |
bahuvAdyAshcha kauravya sudAmAnaH sumallikAH
shlokas.54:
vadhrAH karIShakAshchApi kulindopatyakAstathA |
vanAyavo dashApArshvA romANaH kushabindavaH
shlokas.55:
kachChA gopAlakachChAshcha lA~NgalAH paravallakAH |
kirAtA barbarAH siddhA videhAstAmrali~NgakAH
shlokas.56:
oShTrAH puNDrAH sasairandhrAH pArvatIyAshcha mAriSha |
athApare janapadA dakShiNA bharatarShabha
shlokas.57:
draviDAH keralAH prAchyA bhUShikA vanavAsinaH |
unnatyakA mAhiShakA vikalpA mUShakAstathA
shlokas.58:
karNikAH kuntikAshchaiva saudbhidA nalakAlakAH |
kaukuTTakAstathA cholAH ko~NkaNA mAlavANakAH
shlokas.59:
sama~NgAH kopanAshchaiva kukurA~NgadamAriShAH |
dhvajinyutsavasa~NketAstrigartAH sarvasenayaH
shlokas.60:
trya~NgAH kekarakAH proShThAH parasa~ncharakAstathA |
tathaiva vindhyapulakAH pulindAH kalkalaiH saha
shlokas.61:
mAlakA mallakAshchaiva tathaivAparavartakAH |
kulindAH kulakAshchaiva karaNThAH kurakAstathA
shlokas.62:
mUShakA stanabAlAshcha satiyaH pattipa~njakAH |
AdidAyAH sirAlAshcha stUbakA stanapAstathA
shlokas.63:
hRRiShIvidarbhAH kAntIkAsta~NgaNAH parata~NgaNAH |
uttarAshchApare mlechChA janA bharatasattama
shlokas.64:
yavanAshcha sakAmbojA dAruNA mlechChajAtayaH |
sakShaddruhaH kuntalAshcha hUNAH pAratakaiH saha
shlokas.65:
tathaiva maradhAshchInAstathaiva dashamAlikAH |
kShatriyopaniveshAshcha vaishyashUdrakulAni cha
shlokas.66:
shUdrAbhIrAtha daradAH kAshmIrAH pashubhiH saha |
khashikAshcha tukhArAshcha pallavA girigahvarAH
shlokas.67:
AtreyAH sabharadvAjAstathaiva stanayoShikAH |
aupakAshcha kali~NgAshcha kirAtAnAM cha jAtayaH
shlokas.68:
tAmarA ha.nsamArgAshcha tathaiva karabha~njakAH |
uddeshamAtreNa mayA deshAH sa~NkIrtitAH prabho
shlokas.69:
yathAguNabalaM chApi trivargasya mahAphalam |
duhyeddhenuH kAmadhukcha bhUmiH samyaganuShThitA
shlokas.70:
tasyAM gRRidhyanti rAjAnaH shUrA dharmArthakovidAH |
te tyajantyAhave prANAnrasAgRRiddhAstarasvinaH
shlokas.71:
devamAnuShakAyAnAM kAmaM bhUmiH parAyaNam |
anyonyasyAvalumpanti sArameyA ivAmiSham
shlokas.72:
rAjAno bharatashreShTha bhoktukAmA vasundharAm |
na chApi tRRiptiH kAmAnAM vidyate cheha kasyachit
shlokas.73:
tasmAtparigrahe bhUmeryatante kurupANDavAH |
sAmnA dAnena bhedena daNDenaiva cha pArthiva
shlokas.74:
pitA mAtA cha putrashcha khaM dyaushcha narapu~Ngava |
bhUmirbhavati bhUtAnAM samyagachChidradarshinI

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bhAratasyAsya varShasya tathA haimavatasya cha |
pramANamAyuShaH sUta phalaM chApi shubhAshubham
shlokas.2:
anAgatamatikrAntaM vartamAnaM cha sa~njaya |
AchakShva me vistareNa harivarShaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
chatvAri bhArate varShe yugAni bharatarShabha |
kRRitaM tretA dvAparaM cha puShyaM cha kuruvardhana
shlokas.4:
pUrvaM kRRitayugaM nAma tatastretAyugaM vibho |
sa~NkShepAddvAparasyAtha tataH puShyaM pravartate
shlokas.5:
chatvAri cha sahasrANi varShANAM kurusattama |
AyuHsa~NkhyA kRRitayuge sa~NkhyAtA rAjasattama
shlokas.6:
tathA trINi sahasrANi tretAyAM manujAdhipa |
dvisahasraM dvApare tu shate tiShThati samprati
shlokas.7:
na pramANasthitirhyasti puShye.asminbharatarShabha |
garbhasthAshcha mriyante.atra tathA jAtA mriyanti cha
shlokas.8:
mahAbalA mahAsattvAH prajAguNasamanvitAH |
ajAyanta kRRite rAjanmunayaH sutapodhanAH
shlokas.9:
mahotsAhA mahAtmAno dhArmikAH satyavAdinaH |
jAtAH kRRitayuge rAjandhaninaH priyadarshanAH
shlokas.10:
AyuShmanto mahAvIrA dhanurdharavarA yudhi |
jAyante kShatriyAH shUrAstretAyAM chakravartinaH
shlokas.11:
sarvavarNA mahArAja jAyante dvApare sati |
mahotsAhA mahAvIryAH parasparavadhaiShiNaH
shlokas.12:
tejasAlpena sa.nyuktAH krodhanAH puruShA nRRipa |
lubdhAshchAnRRitakAshchaiva puShye jAyanti bhArata
shlokas.13:
IrShyA mAnastathA krodho mAyAsUyA tathaiva cha |
puShye bhavanti martyAnAM rAgo lobhashcha bhArata
shlokas.14:
sa~NkShepo vartate rAjandvApare.asminnarAdhipa |
guNottaraM haimavataM harivarShaM tataH param

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
jambUkhaNDastvayA prokto yathAvadiha sa~njaya |
viShkambhamasya prabrUhi parimANaM cha tattvataH
shlokas.2:
samudrasya pramANaM cha samyagachChidradarshana |
shAkadvIpaM cha me brUhi kushadvIpaM cha sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
shAlmalaM chaiva tattvena krau~nchadvIpaM tathaiva cha |
brUhi gAvalgaNe sarvaM rAhoH somArkayostathA
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAjansubahavo dvIpA yairidaM santataM jagat |
sapta tvahaM pravakShyAmi chandrAdityau grahA.nstathA
shlokas.5:
aShTAdasha sahasrANi yojanAnAM vishAM pate |
ShaTshatAni cha pUrNAni viShkambho jambuparvataH
shlokas.6:
lAvaNasya samudrasya viShkambho dviguNaH smRRitaH |
nAnAjanapadAkIrNo maNividrumachitritaH
shlokas.7:
naikadhAtuvichitraishcha parvatairupashobhitaH |
siddhachAraNasa~NkIrNaH sAgaraH parimaNDalaH
shlokas.8:
shAkadvIpaM cha vakShyAmi yathAvadiha pArthiva |
shRRiNu me tvaM yathAnyAyaM bruvataH kurunandana
shlokas.9:
jambUdvIpapramANena dviguNaH sa narAdhipa |
viShkambheNa mahArAja sAgaro.api vibhAgashaH
kShIrodo bharatashreShTha yena samparivAritaH
shlokas.10:
tatra puNyA janapadA na tatra mriyate janaH |
kuta eva hi durbhikShaM kShamAtejoyutA hi te
shlokas.11:
shAkadvIpasya sa~NkShepo yathAvadbharatarShabha |
ukta eSha mahArAja kimanyachChrotumichChasi
shlokas.12:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
shAkadvIpasya sa~NkShepo yathAvadiha sa~njaya |
uktastvayA mahAbhAga vistaraM brUhi tattvataH
shlokas.13:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathaiva parvatA rAjansaptAtra maNibhUShitAH |
ratnAkarAstathA nadyasteShAM nAmAni me shRRiNu
atIvaguNavatsarvaM tatra puNyaM janAdhipa
shlokas.14:
devarShigandharvayutaH paramo meruruchyate |
prAgAyato mahArAja malayo nAma parvataH
yato meghAH pravartante prabhavanti cha sarvashaH
shlokas.15:
tataH pareNa kauravya jaladhAro mahAgiriH |
yatra nityamupAdatte vAsavaH paramaM jalam
yato varShaM prabhavati varShAkAle janeshvara
shlokas.16:
uchchairgirI raivatako yatra nityaM pratiShThitaH |
revatI divi nakShatraM pitAmahakRRito vidhiH
shlokas.17:
uttareNa tu rAjendra shyAmo nAma mahAgiriH |
yataH shyAmatvamApannAH prajA janapadeshvara
shlokas.18:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sumahAnsa.nshayo me.adya proktaM sa~njaya yattvayA |
prajAH kathaM sUtaputra samprAptAH shyAmatAmiha
shlokas.19:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sarveShveva mahAprAj~na dvIpeShu kurunandana |
gauraH kRRiShNashcha varNau dvau tayorvarNAntaraM nRRipa
shlokas.20:
shyAmo yasmAtpravRRitto vai tatte vakShyAmi bhArata |
Aste.atra bhagavAnkRRiShNastatkAntyA shyAmatAM gataH
shlokas.21:
tataH paraM kauravendra durgashailo mahodayaH |
kesarI kesarayuto yato vAtaH pravAyati
shlokas.22:
teShAM yojanaviShkambho dviguNaH pravibhAgashaH |
varShANi teShu kauravya samproktAni manIShibhiH
shlokas.23:
mahAmerurmahAkAsho jaladaH kumudottaraH |
jaladhArAtparo rAjansukumAra iti smRRitaH
shlokas.24:
raivatasya tu kaumAraH shyAmasya tu maNIchakaH |
kesarasyAtha modAkI pareNa tu mahApumAn
shlokas.25:
parivArya tu kauravya dairghyaM hrasvatvameva cha |
jambUdvIpena vikhyAtastasya madhye mahAdrumaH
shlokas.26:
shAko nAma mahArAja tasya dvIpasya madhyagaH |
tatra puNyA janapadAH pUjyate tatra sha~NkaraH
shlokas.27:
tatra gachChanti siddhAshcha chAraNA daivatAni cha |
dhArmikAshcha prajA rAja.nshchatvAro.atIva bhArata
shlokas.28:
varNAH svakarmaniratA na cha steno.atra dRRishyate |
dIrghAyuSho mahArAja jarAmRRityuvivarjitAH
shlokas.29:
prajAstatra vivardhante varShAsviva samudragAH |
nadyaH puNyajalAstatra ga~NgA cha bahudhAgatiH
shlokas.30:
sukumArI kumArI cha sItA kAverakA tathA |
mahAnadI cha kauravya tathA maNijalA nadI
ikShuvardhanikA chaiva tathA bharatasattama
shlokas.31:
tataH pravRRittAH puNyodA nadyaH kurukulodvaha |
sahasrANAM shatAnyeva yato varShati vAsavaH
shlokas.32:
na tAsAM nAmadheyAni parimANaM tathaiva cha |
shakyate parisa~NkhyAtuM puNyAstA hi saridvarAH
shlokas.33:
tatra puNyA janapadAshchatvAro lokasaMmatAH |
magAshcha mashakAshchaiva mAnasA mandagAstathA
shlokas.34:
magA brAhmaNabhUyiShThAH svakarmaniratA nRRipa |
mashakeShu tu rAjanyA dhArmikAH sarvakAmadAH
shlokas.35:
mAnaseShu mahArAja vaishyAH karmopajIvinaH |
sarvakAmasamAyuktAH shUrA dharmArthanishchitAH
shUdrAstu mandage nityaM puruShA dharmashIlinaH
shlokas.36:
na tatra rAjA rAjendra na daNDo na cha daNDikAH |
svadharmeNaiva dharmaM cha te rakShanti parasparam
shlokas.37:
etAvadeva shakyaM tu tasmindvIpe prabhAShitum |
etAvadeva shrotavyaM shAkadvIpe mahaujasi

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
uttareShu tu kauravya dvIpeShu shrUyate kathA |
yathAshrutaM mahArAja bruvatastannibodha me
shlokas.2:
ghRRitatoyaH samudro.atra dadhimaNDodako.aparaH |
surodaH sAgarashchaiva tathAnyo gharmasAgaraH
shlokas.3:
paraspareNa dviguNAH sarve dvIpA narAdhipa |
sarvatashcha mahArAja parvataiH parivAritAH
shlokas.4:
gaurastu madhyame dvIpe girirmAnaHshilo mahAn |
parvataH pashchimaH kRRiShNo nArAyaNanibho nRRipa
shlokas.5:
tatra ratnAni divyAni svayaM rakShati keshavaH |
prajApatimupAsInaH prajAnAM vidadhe sukham
shlokas.6:
kushadvIpe kushastambo madhye janapadasya ha |
sampUjyate shalmalishcha dvIpe shAlmalike nRRipa
shlokas.7:
krau~nchadvIpe mahAkrau~ncho girI ratnachayAkaraH |
sampUjyate mahArAja chAturvarNyena nityadA
shlokas.8:
gomandaH parvato rAjansumahAnsarvadhAtumAn |
yatra nityaM nivasati shrImAnkamalalochanaH
mokShibhiH sa.nstuto nityaM prabhurnArAyaNo hariH
shlokas.9:
kushadvIpe tu rAjendra parvato vidrumaishchitaH |
sudhAmA nAma durdharSho dvitIyo hemaparvataH
shlokas.10:
dyutimAnnAma kauravya tRRitIyaH kumudo giriH |
chaturthaH puShpavAnnAma pa~nchamastu kusheshayaH
shlokas.11:
ShaShTho harigirirnAma ShaDete parvatottamAH |
teShAmantaraviShkambho dviguNaH pravibhAgashaH
shlokas.12:
audbhidaM prathamaM varShaM dvitIyaM veNumaNDalam |
tRRitIyaM vai rathAkAraM chaturthaM pAlanaM smRRitam
shlokas.13:
dhRRitimatpa~nchamaM varShaM ShaShThaM varShaM prabhAkaram |
saptamaM kApilaM varShaM saptaite varShapu~njakAH
shlokas.14:
eteShu devagandharvAH prajAshcha jagatIshvara |
viharanti ramante cha na teShu mriyate janaH
shlokas.15:
na teShu dasyavaH santi mlechChajAtyo.api vA nRRipa |
gauraprAyo janaH sarvaH sukumArashcha pArthiva
shlokas.16:
avashiShTeShu varSheShu vakShyAmi manujeshvara |
yathAshrutaM mahArAja tadavyagramanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.17:
krau~nchadvIpe mahArAja krau~ncho nAma mahAgiriH |
krau~nchAtparo vAmanako vAmanAdandhakArakaH
shlokas.18:
andhakArAtparo rAjanmainAkaH parvatottamaH |
mainAkAtparato rAjangovindo giriruttamaH
shlokas.19:
govindAttu paro rAjannibiDo nAma parvataH |
parastu dviguNasteShAM viShkambho va.nshavardhana
shlokas.20:
deshA.nstatra pravakShyAmi tanme nigadataH shRRiNu |
krau~nchasya kushalo desho vAmanasya manonugaH
shlokas.21:
manonugAtparashchoShNo deshaH kurukulodvaha |
uShNAtparaH prAvarakaH prAvarAdandhakArakaH
shlokas.22:
andhakArakadeshAttu munideshaH paraH smRRitaH |
munideshAtparashchaiva prochyate dundubhisvanaH
shlokas.23:
siddhachAraNasa~NkIrNo gauraprAyo janAdhipa |
ete deshA mahArAja devagandharvasevitAH
shlokas.24:
puShkare puShkaro nAma parvato maNiratnamAn |
tatra nityaM nivasati svayaM devaH prajApatiH
shlokas.25:
taM paryupAsate nityaM devAH sarve maharShibhiH |
vAgbhirmanonukUlAbhiH pUjayanto janAdhipa
shlokas.26:
jambUdvIpAtpravartante ratnAni vividhAnyuta |
dvIpeShu teShu sarveShu prajAnAM kurunandana
shlokas.27:
viprANAM brahmacharyeNa satyena cha damena cha |
ArogyAyuHpramANAbhyAM dviguNaM dviguNaM tataH
shlokas.28:
eko janapado rAjandvIpeShveteShu bhArata |
uktA janapadA yeShu dharmashchaikaH pradRRishyate
shlokas.29:
Ishvaro daNDamudyamya svayameva prajApatiH |
dvIpAnetAnmahArAja rakSha.nstiShThati nityadA
shlokas.30:
sa rAjA sa shivo rAjansa pitA sa pitAmahaH |
gopAyati narashreShTha prajAH sajaDapaNDitAH
shlokas.31:
bhojanaM chAtra kauravya prajAH svayamupasthitam |
siddhameva mahArAja bhu~njate tatra nityadA
shlokas.32:
tataH paraM samA nAma dRRishyate lokasa.nsthitiH |
chaturashrA mahArAja trayastri.nshattu maNDalam
shlokas.33:
tatra tiShThanti kauravya chatvAro lokasaMmatAH |
diggajA bharatashreShTha vAmanairAvatAdayaH
supratIkastathA rAjanprabhinnakaraTAmukhaH
shlokas.34:
tasyAhaM parimANaM tu na sa~NkhyAtumihotsahe |
asa~NkhyAtaH sa nityaM hi tiryagUrdhvamadhastathA
shlokas.35:
tatra vai vAyavo vAnti digbhyaH sarvAbhya eva cha |
asambAdhA mahArAja tAnnigRRihNanti te gajAH
shlokas.36:
puShkaraiH padmasa~NkAshairvarShmavadbhirmahAprabhaiH |
te shanaiH punarevAshu vAyUnmu~nchanti nityashaH
shlokas.37:
shvasadbhirmuchyamAnAstu diggajairiha mArutAH |
AgachChanti mahArAja tatastiShThanti vai prajAH
shlokas.38:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
paro vai vistaro.atyarthaM tvayA sa~njaya kIrtitaH |
darshitaM dvIpasa.nsthAnamuttaraM brUhi sa~njaya
shlokas.39:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
uktA dvIpA mahArAja grahAnme shRRiNu tattvataH |
svarbhAnuH kauravashreShTha yAvadeSha prabhAvataH
shlokas.40:
parimaNDalo mahArAja svarbhAnuH shrUyate grahaH |
yojanAnAM sahasrANi viShkambho dvAdashAsya vai
shlokas.41:
pariNAhena ShaTtri.nshadvipulatvena chAnagha |
ShaShTimAhuH shatAnyasya budhAH paurANikAstathA
shlokas.42:
chandramAstu sahasrANi rAjannekAdasha smRRitaH |
viShkambheNa kurushreShTha trayastri.nshattu maNDalam
ekonaShaShTirvaipulyAchChItarashmermahAtmanaH
shlokas.43:
sUryastvaShTau sahasrANi dve chAnye kurunandana |
viShkambheNa tato rAjanmaNDalaM tri.nshataM samam
shlokas.44:
aShTapa~nchAshataM rAjanvipulatvena chAnagha |
shrUyate paramodAraH pata~Ngo.asau vibhAvasuH
etatpramANamarkasya nirdiShTamiha bhArata
shlokas.45:
sa rAhushChAdayatyetau yathAkAlaM mahattayA |
chandrAdityau mahArAja sa~NkShepo.ayamudAhRRitaH
shlokas.46:
ityetatte mahArAja pRRichChataH shAstrachakShuShA |
sarvamuktaM yathAtattvaM tasmAchChamamavApnuhi
shlokas.47:
yathAdRRiShTaM mayA proktaM saniryANamidaM jagat |
tasmAdAshvasa kauravya putraM duryodhanaM prati
shlokas.48:
shrutvedaM bharatashreShTha bhUmiparva manonugam |
shrImAnbhavati rAjanyaH siddhArthaH sAdhusaMmataH
AyurbalaM cha vIryaM cha tasya tejashcha vardhate
shlokas.49:
yaH shRRiNoti mahIpAla parvaNIdaM yatavrataH |
prIyante pitarastasya tathaiva cha pitAmahAH
shlokas.50:
idaM tu bhArataM varShaM yatra vartAmahe vayam |
pUrvaM pravartate puNyaM tatsarvaM shrutavAnasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha gAvalgaNirdhImAnsamarAdetya sa~njayaH |
pratyakShadarshI sarvasya bhUtabhavyabhaviShyavit
shlokas.2:
dhyAyate dhRRitarAShTrAya sahasopetya duHkhitaH |
AchaShTa nihataM bhIShmaM bharatAnAmamadhyamam
shlokas.3:
sa~njayo.ahaM mahArAja namaste bharatarShabha |
hato bhIShmaH shAntanavo bharatAnAM pitAmahaH
shlokas.4:
kakudaM sarvayodhAnAM dhAma sarvadhanuShmatAm |
sharatalpagataH so.adya shete kurupitAmahaH
shlokas.5:
yasya vIryaM samAshritya dyUtaM putrastavAkarot |
sa shete nihato rAjansa~Nkhye bhIShmaH shikhaNDinA
shlokas.6:
yaH sarvAnpRRithivIpAlAnsamavetAnmahAmRRidhe |
jigAyaikarathenaiva kAshipuryAM mahArathaH
shlokas.7:
jAmadagnyaM raNe rAmamAyodhya vasusambhavaH |
na hato jAmadagnyena sa hato.adya shikhaNDinA
shlokas.8:
mahendrasadRRishaH shaurye sthairye cha himavAniva |
samudra iva gAmbhIrye sahiShNutve dharAsamaH
shlokas.9:
sharadaMShTro dhanurvaktraH khaDgajihvo durAsadaH |
narasiMhaH pitA te.adya pA~nchAlyena nipAtitaH
shlokas.10:
pANDavAnAM mahatsainyaM yaM dRRiShTvodyantamAhave |
pravepata bhayodvignaM siMhaM dRRiShTveva gogaNaH
shlokas.11:
parirakShya sa senAM te dasharAtramanIkahA |
jagAmAstamivAdityaH kRRitvA karma suduShkaram
shlokas.12:
yaH sa shakra ivAkShobhyo varShanbANAnsahasrashaH |
jaghAna yudhi yodhAnAmarbudaM dashabhirdinaiH
shlokas.13:
sa shete niShTananbhUmau vAtarugNa iva drumaH |
tava durmantrite rAjanyathA nArhaH sa bhArata

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM kurUNAmRRiShabho hato bhIShmaH shikhaNDinA |
kathaM rathAtsa nyapatatpitA me vAsavopamaH
shlokas.2:
kathamAsa.nshcha me putrA hInA bhIShmeNa sa~njaya |
balinA devakalpena gurvarthe brahmachAriNA
shlokas.3:
tasminhate mahAsattve maheShvAse mahAbale |
mahArathe naravyAghre kimu AsInmanastadA
shlokas.4:
ArtiH parA mAvishati yataH sha.nsasi me hatam |
kurUNAmRRiShabhaM vIramakampyaM puruSharShabham
shlokas.5:
ke taM yAntamanupreyuH ke chAsyAsanpurogamAH |
ke.atiShThanke nyavartanta ke.abhyavartanta sa~njaya
shlokas.6:
ke shUrA rathashArdUlamachyutaM kShatriyarShabham |
rathAnIkaM gAhamAnaM sahasA pRRiShThato.anvayuH
shlokas.7:
yastamo.arka ivApohanparasainyamamitrahA |
sahasrarashmipratimaH pareShAM bhayamAdadhat
akarodduShkaraM karma raNe kauravashAsanAt
shlokas.8:
grasamAnamanIkAni ya enaM paryavArayan |
kRRitinaM taM durAdharShaM samyagyAsyantamantike
kathaM shAntanavaM yuddhe pANDavAH pratyavArayan
shlokas.9:
nikRRintantamanIkAni sharadaMShTraM tarasvinam |
chApavyAttAnanaM ghoramasijihvaM durAsadam
shlokas.10:
atyanyAnpuruShavyAghrAnhrImantamaparAjitam |
pAtayAmAsa kaunteyaH kathaM tamajitaM yudhi
shlokas.11:
ugradhanvAnamugreShuM vartamAnaM rathottame |
pareShAmuttamA~NgAni prachinvantaM shiteShubhiH
shlokas.12:
pANDavAnAM mahatsainyaM yaM dRRiShTvodyantamAhave |
kAlAgnimiva durdharShaM samaveShTata nityashaH
shlokas.13:
parikRRiShya sa senAM me dasharAtramanIkahA |
jagAmAstamivAdityaH kRRitvA karma suduShkaram
shlokas.14:
yaH sa shakra ivAkShayyaM varShaM sharamayaM sRRijan |
jaghAna yudhi yodhAnAmarbudaM dashabhirdinaiH
shlokas.15:
sa shete niShTananbhUmau vAtarugNa iva drumaH |
mama durmantritenAsau yathA nArhaH sa bhArataH
shlokas.16:
kathaM shAntanavaM dRRiShTvA pANDavAnAmanIkinI |
prahartumashakattatra bhIShmaM bhImaparAkramam
shlokas.17:
kathaM bhIShmeNa sa~NgrAmamakurvanpANDunandanAH |
kathaM cha nAjayadbhIShmo droNe jIvati sa~njaya
shlokas.18:
kRRipe saMnihite tatra bharadvAjAtmaje tathA |
bhIShmaH praharatAM shreShThaH kathaM sa nidhanaM gataH
shlokas.19:
kathaM chAtirathastena pA~nchAlyena shikhaNDinA |
bhIShmo vinihato yuddhe devairapi durutsahaH
shlokas.20:
yaH spardhate raNe nityaM jAmadagnyaM mahAbalam |
ajitaM jAmadagnyena shakratulyaparAkramam
shlokas.21:
taM hataM samare bhIShmaM mahArathabalochitam |
sa~njayAchakShva me vIraM yena sharma na vidmahe
shlokas.22:
mAmakAH ke maheShvAsA nAjahuH sa~njayAchyutam |
duryodhanasamAdiShTAH ke vIrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.23:
yachChikhaNDimukhAH sarve pANDavA bhIShmamabhyayuH |
kachchinna kuravo bhItAstatyajuH sa~njayAchyutam
shlokas.24:
maurvIghoShastanayitnuH pRRiShatkapRRiShato mahAn |
dhanurhvAdamahAshabdo mahAmegha ivonnataH
shlokas.25:
yadabhyavarShatkaunteyAnsapA~nchAlAnsasRRi~njayAn |
nighnanpararathAnvIro dAnavAniva vajrabhRRit
shlokas.26:
iShvastrasAgaraM ghoraM bANagrAhaM durAsadam |
kArmukormiNamakShayyamadvIpaM samare.aplavam
gadAsimakarAvartaM hayagrAhaM gajAkulam
shlokas.27:
hayAngajAnpadAtA.nshcha rathA.nshcha tarasA bahUn |
nimajjayantaM samare paravIrApahAriNam
shlokas.28:
vidahyamAnaM kopena tejasA cha parantapam |
veleva makarAvAsaM ke vIrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.29:
bhIShmo yadakarotkarma samare sa~njayArihA |
duryodhanahitArthAya ke tadAsya puro.abhavan
shlokas.30:
ke.arakShandakShiNaM chakraM bhIShmasyAmitatejasaH |
pRRiShThataH ke parAnvIrA upAsedhanyatavratAH
shlokas.31:
ke purastAdavartanta rakShanto bhIShmamantike |
ke.arakShannuttaraM chakraM vIrA vIrasya yudhyataH
shlokas.32:
vAme chakre vartamAnAH ke.aghnansa~njaya sRRi~njayAn |
sametAgramanIkeShu ke.abhyarakShandurAsadam
shlokas.33:
pArshvataH ke.abhyavartanta gachChanto durgamAM gatim |
samUhe ke parAnvIrAnpratyayudhyanta sa~njaya
shlokas.34:
rakShyamANaH kathaM vIrairgopyamAnAshcha tena te |
durjayAnAmanIkAni nAjaya.nstarasA yudhi
shlokas.35:
sarvalokeshvarasyeva parameShThiprajApateH |
kathaM prahartumapi te shekuH sa~njaya pANDavAH
shlokas.36:
yasmindvIpe samAshritya yudhyanti kuravaH paraiH |
taM nimagnaM naravyAghraM bhIShmaM sha.nsasi sa~njaya
shlokas.37:
yasya vIrye samAshvasya mama putro bRRihadbalaH |
na pANDavAnagaNayatkathaM sa nihataH paraiH
shlokas.38:
yaH purA vibudhaiH sendraiH sAhAyye yuddhadurmadaH |
kA~NkShito dAnavAnghnadbhiH pitA mama mahAvrataH
shlokas.39:
yasmi~njAte mahAvIrye shantanurlokasha~Nkare |
shokaM duHkhaM cha dainyaM cha prAjahAtputralakShmaNi
shlokas.40:
praj~nA parAyaNaM tajj~naM saddharmanirataM shuchim |
vedavedA~Ngatattvaj~naM kathaM sha.nsasi me hatam
shlokas.41:
sarvAstravinayopetaM dAntaM shAntaM manasvinam |
hataM shAntanavaM shrutvA manye sheShaM balaM hatam
shlokas.42:
dharmAdadharmo balavAnsamprApta iti me matiH |
yatra vRRiddhaM guruM hatvA rAjyamichChanti pANDavAH
shlokas.43:
jAmadagnyaH purA rAmaH sarvAstravidanuttamaH |
ambArthamudyataH sa~Nkhye bhIShmeNa yudhi nirjitaH
shlokas.44:
tamindrasamakarmANaM kakudaM sarvadhanvinAm |
hataM sha.nsasi bhIShmaM me kiM nu duHkhamataH param
shlokas.45:
asakRRitkShatriyavrAtAH sa~Nkhye yena vinirjitAH |
jAmadagnyastathA rAmaH paravIranighAtinA
shlokas.46:
tasmAnnUnaM mahAvIryAdbhArgavAdyuddhadurmadAt |
tejovIryabalairbhUyA~nshikhaNDI drupadAtmajaH
shlokas.47:
yaH shUraM kRRitinaM yuddhe sarvashAstravishAradam |
paramAstravidaM vIraM jaghAna bharatarShabham
shlokas.48:
ke vIrAstamamitraghnamanvayuH shatrusa.nsadi |
sha.nsa me tadyathA vRRittaM yuddhaM bhIShmasya pANDavaiH
shlokas.49:
yoSheva hatavIrA me senA putrasya sa~njaya |
agopamiva chodbhrAntaM gokulaM tadbalaM mama
shlokas.50:
pauruShaM sarvalokasya paraM yasya mahAhave |
parAsikte cha vastasminkathamAsInmanastadA
shlokas.51:
jIvite.apyadya sAmarthyaM kimivAsmAsu sa~njaya |
ghAtayitvA mahAvIryaM pitaraM lokadhArmikam
shlokas.52:
agAdhe salile magnAM nAvaM dRRiShTveva pAragAH |
bhIShme hate bhRRishaM duHkhAnmanye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.53:
adrisAramayaM nUnaM sudRRiDhaM hRRidayaM mama |
yachChrutvA puruShavyAghraM hataM bhIShmaM na dIryate
shlokas.54:
yasminnastraM cha medhA cha nItishcha bharatarShabhe |
aprameyANi durdharShe kathaM sa nihato yudhi
shlokas.55:
na chAstreNa na shauryeNa tapasA medhayA na cha |
na dhRRityA na punastyAgAnmRRityoH kashchidvimuchyate
shlokas.56:
kAlo nUnaM mahAvIryaH sarvalokaduratyayaH |
yatra shAntanavaM bhIShmaM hataM sha.nsasi sa~njaya
shlokas.57:
putrashokAbhisantapto mahadduHkhamachintayan |
Asha.nse.ahaM purA trANaM bhIShmAchChantanunandanAt
shlokas.58:
yadAdityamivApashyatpatitaM bhuvi sa~njaya |
duryodhanaH shAntanavaM kiM tadA pratyapadyata
shlokas.59:
nAhaM sveShAM pareShAM vA buddhyA sa~njaya chintayan |
sheShaM ki~nchitprapashyAmi pratyanIke mahIkShitAm
shlokas.60:
dAruNaH kShatradharmo.ayamRRiShibhiH sampradarshitaH |
yatra shAntanavaM hatvA rAjyamichChanti pANDavAH
shlokas.61:
vayaM vA rAjyamichChAmo ghAtayitvA pitAmaham |
kShatradharme sthitAH pArthA nAparAdhyanti putrakAH
shlokas.62:
etadAryeNa kartavyaM kRRichChrAsvApatsu sa~njaya |
parAkramaH paraM shaktyA tachcha tasminpratiShThitam
shlokas.63:
anIkAni vinighnantaM hrImantamaparAjitam |
kathaM shAntanavaM tAta pANDuputrA nyapAtayan
shlokas.64:
kathaM yuktAnyanIkAni kathaM yuddhaM mahAtmabhiH |
kathaM vA nihato bhIShmaH pitA sa~njaya me paraiH
shlokas.65:
duryodhanashcha karNashcha shakunishchApi saubalaH |
duHshAsanashcha kitavo hate bhIShme kimabruvan
shlokas.67:
prAvishankitavA mandAH sabhAM yudhi durAsadAm |
prANadyUte pratibhaye ke.adIvyanta nararShabhAH
shlokas.68:
ke.ajayanke jitAstatra hRRitalakShA nipAtitAH |
anye bhIShmAchChAntanavAttanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.69:
na hi me shAntirastIha yudhi devavrataM hatam |
pitaraM bhImakarmANaM shrutvA me duHkhamAvishat
shlokas.70:
ArtiM me hRRidaye rUDhAM mahatIM putrakAritAm |
tvaM si~nchansarpiShevAgnimuddIpayasi sa~njaya
shlokas.71:
mahAntaM bhAramudyamya vishrutaM sArvalaukikam |
dRRiShTvA vinihataM bhIShmaM manye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.72:
shroShyAmi tAni duHkhAni duryodhanakRRitAnyaham |
tasmAnme sarvamAchakShva yadvRRittaM tatra sa~njaya
shlokas.73:
sa~NgrAme pRRithivIshAnAM mandasyAbuddhisambhavam |
apanItaM sunItaM vA tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.74:
yatkRRitaM tatra bhIShmeNa sa~NgrAme jayamichChatA |
tejoyuktaM kRRitAstreNa sha.nsa tachchApyasheShataH
shlokas.75:
yathA tadabhavadyuddhaM kurupANDavasenayoH |
krameNa yena yasmi.nshcha kAle yachcha yathA cha tat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tvadyukto.ayamanuprashno mahArAja yathArhasi |
na tu duryodhane doShamimamAsaktumarhasi
shlokas.2:
ya Atmano dushcharitAdashubhaM prApnuyAnnaraH |
enasA tena nAnyaM sa upAsha~Nkitumarhati
shlokas.3:
mahArAja manuShyeShu nindyaM yaH sarvamAcharet |
sa vadhyaH sarvalokasya ninditAni samAcharan
shlokas.4:
nikAro nikRRitipraj~naiH pANDavaistvatpratIkShayA |
anubhUtaH sahAmAtyaiH kShAntaM cha suchiraM vane
shlokas.5:
hayAnAM cha gajAnAM cha shUrANAM chAmitaujasAm |
pratyakShaM yanmayA dRRiShTaM dRRiShTaM yogabalena cha
shlokas.6:
shRRiNu tatpRRithivIpAla mA cha shoke manaH kRRithAH |
diShTametatpurA nUnamevambhAvi narAdhipa
shlokas.7:
namaskRRitvA pituste.ahaM pArAsharyAya dhImate |
yasya prasAdAddivyaM me prAptaM j~nAnamanuttamam
shlokas.8:
dRRiShTishchAtIndriyA rAjandUrAchChravaNameva cha |
parachittasya vij~nAnamatItAnAgatasya cha
shlokas.9:
vyutthitotpattivij~nAnamAkAshe cha gatiH sadA |
shastrairasa~Ngo yuddheShu varadAnAnmahAtmanaH
shlokas.10:
shRRiNu me vistareNedaM vichitraM paramAdbhutam |
bhAratAnAM mahadyuddhaM yathAbhUllomaharShaNam
shlokas.11:
teShvanIkeShu yatteShu vyUDheShu cha vidhAnataH |
duryodhano mahArAja duHshAsanamathAbravIt
shlokas.12:
duHshAsana rathAstUrNaM yujyantAM bhIShmarakShiNaH |
anIkAni cha sarvANi shIghraM tvamanuchodaya
shlokas.13:
ayaM mA samanuprApto varShapUgAbhichintitaH |
pANDavAnAM sasainyAnAM kurUNAM cha samAgamaH
shlokas.14:
nAtaH kAryatamaM manye raNe bhIShmasya rakShaNAt |
hanyAdgupto hyasau pArthAnsomakA.nshcha sasRRi~njayAn
shlokas.15:
abravIchcha vishuddhAtmA nAhaM hanyAM shikhaNDinam |
shrUyate strI hyasau pUrvaM tasmAdvarjyo raNe mama
shlokas.16:
tasmAdbhIShmo rakShitavyo visheSheNeti me matiH |
shikhaNDino vadhe yattAH sarve tiShThantu mAmakAH
shlokas.17:
tathA prAchyAH pratIchyAshcha dAkShiNAtyottarApathAH |
sarvashastrAstrakushalAste rakShantu pitAmaham
shlokas.18:
arakShyamANaM hi vRRiko hanyAtsiMhaM mahAbalam |
mA siMhaM jambukeneva ghAtayAmaH shikhaNDinA
shlokas.19:
vAmaM chakraM yudhAmanyuruttamaujAshcha dakShiNam |
goptArau phalgunasyaitau phalguno.api shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.20:
sa.nrakShyamANaH pArthena bhIShmeNa cha vivarjitaH |
yathA na hanyAdgA~NgeyaM duHshAsana tathA kuru
shlokas.21:
tato rajanyAM vyuShTAyAM shabdaH samabhavanmahAn |
kroshatAM bhUmipAlAnAM yujyatAM yujyatAmiti
shlokas.22:
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShaiH siMhanAdaishcha bhArata |
hayaheShitashabdaishcha rathanemisvanaistathA
shlokas.23:
gajAnAM bRRiMhatAM chaiva yodhAnAM chAbhigarjatAm |
kShveDitAsphoTitotkruShTaistumulaM sarvato.abhavat
shlokas.24:
udatiShThanmahArAja sarvaM yuktamasheShataH |
sUryodaye mahatsainyaM kurupANDavasenayoH
tava rAjendra putrANAM pANDavAnAM tathaiva cha
shlokas.25:
tatra nAgA rathAshchaiva jAmbUnadapariShkRRitAH |
vibhrAjamAnA dRRishyante meghA iva savidyutaH
shlokas.26:
rathAnIkAnyadRRishyanta nagarANIva bhUrishaH |
atIva shushubhe tatra pitA te pUrNachandravat
shlokas.27:
dhanurbhirRRiShTibhiH khaDgairgadAbhiH shaktitomaraiH |
yodhAH praharaNaiH shubhraiH sveShvanIkeShvavasthitAH
shlokas.28:
gajA rathAH padAtAshcha turagAshcha vishAM pate |
vyatiShThanvAgurAkArAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.29:
dhvajA bahuvidhAkArA vyadRRishyanta samuchChritAH |
sveShAM chaiva pareShAM cha dyutimantaH sahasrashaH
shlokas.30:
kA~nchanA maNichitrA~NgA jvalanta iva pAvakAH |
archiShmanto vyarochanta dhvajA rAj~nAM sahasrashaH
shlokas.31:
mahendraketavaH shubhrA mahendrasadaneShviva |
saMnaddhAsteShu te vIrA dadRRishuryuddhakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.32:
udyatairAyudhaishchitrAstalabaddhAH kalApinaH |
RRiShabhAkShA manuShyendrAshchamUmukhagatA babhuH
shlokas.33:
shakuniH saubalaH shalyaH saindhavo.atha jayadrathaH |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau kAmbojashcha sudakShiNaH
shlokas.34:
shrutAyudhashcha kAli~Ngo jayatsenashcha pArthivaH |
bRRihadbalashcha kaushalyaH kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH
shlokas.35:
dashaite puruShavyAghrAH shUrAH parighabAhavaH |
akShauhiNInAM patayo yajvAno bhUridakShiNAH
shlokas.36:
ete chAnye cha bahavo duryodhanavashAnugAH |
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha nItimanto mahAbalAH
shlokas.37:
saMnaddhAH samadRRishyanta sveShvanIkeShvavasthitAH |
baddhakRRiShNAjinAH sarve dhvajino mu~njamAlinaH
shlokas.38:
sRRiShTA duryodhanasyArthe brahmalokAya dIkShitAH |
samRRiddhA dasha vAhinyaH parigRRihya vyavasthitAH
shlokas.39:
ekAdashI dhArtarAShTrI kauravANAM mahAchamUH |
agrataH sarvasainyAnAM yatra shAntanavo.agraNIH
shlokas.40:
shvetoShNIShaM shvetahayaM shvetavarmANamachyutam |
apashyAma mahArAja bhIShmaM chandramivoditam
shlokas.41:
hematAladhvajaM bhIShmaM rAjate syandane sthitam |
shvetAbhra iva tIkShNA.nshuM dadRRishuH kurupANDavAH
shlokas.42:
dRRiShTvA chamUmukhe bhIShmaM samakampanta pANDavAH |
sRRi~njayAshcha maheShvAsA dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH
shlokas.43:
jRRimbhamANaM mahAsiMhaM dRRiShTvA kShudramRRigA yathA |
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhAH sarve samudvivijire muhuH
shlokas.44:
ekAdashaitAH shrIjuShTA vAhinyastava bhArata |
pANDavAnAM tathA sapta mahApuruShapAlitAH
shlokas.45:
unmattamakarAvartau mahAgrAhasamAkulau |
yugAnte samupetau dvau dRRishyete sAgarAviva
shlokas.46:
naiva nastAdRRisho rAjandRRiShTapUrvo na cha shrutaH |
anIkAnAM sametAnAM samavAyastathAvidhaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yathA sa bhagavAnvyAsaH kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt |
tathaiva sahitAH sarve samAjagmurmahIkShitaH
shlokas.2:
maghAviShayagaH somastaddinaM pratyapadyata |
dIpyamAnAshcha sampeturdivi sapta mahAgrahAH
shlokas.3:
dvidhAbhUta ivAditya udaye pratyadRRishyata |
jvalantyA shikhayA bhUyo bhAnumAnudito divi
shlokas.4:
vavAshire cha dIptAyAM dishi gomAyuvAyasAH |
lipsamAnAH sharIrANi mA.nsashoNitabhojanAH
shlokas.5:
ahanyahani pArthAnAM vRRiddhaH kurupitAmahaH |
bharadvAjAtmajashchaiva prAtarutthAya sa.nyatau
shlokas.6:
jayo.astu pANDuputrANAmityUchaturari.ndamau |
yuyudhAte tavArthAya yathA sa samayaH kRRitaH
shlokas.7:
sarvadharmavisheShaj~naH pitA devavratastava |
samAnIya mahIpAlAnidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.8:
idaM vaH kShatriyA dvAraM svargAyApAvRRitaM mahat |
gachChadhvaM tena shakrasya brahmaNashcha salokatAm
shlokas.9:
eSha vaH shAshvataH panthAH pUrvaiH pUrvatarairgataH |
sambhAvayata chAtmAnamavyagramanaso yudhi
shlokas.10:
nAbhAgo hi yayAtishcha mAndhAtA nahuSho nRRigaH |
sa.nsiddhAH paramaM sthAnaM gatAH karmabhirIdRRishaiH
shlokas.11:
adharmaH kShatriyasyaiSha yadvyAdhimaraNaM gRRihe |
yadAjau nidhanaM yAti so.asya dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.12:
evamuktA mahIpAlA bhIShmeNa bharatarShabha |
niryayuH svAnyanIkAni shobhayanto rathottamaiH
shlokas.13:
sa tu vaikartanaH karNaH sAmAtyaH saha bandhubhiH |
nyAsitaH samare shastraM bhIShmeNa bharatarShabha
shlokas.14:
apetakarNAH putrAste rAjAnashchaiva tAvakAH |
niryayuH siMhanAdena nAdayanto disho dasha
shlokas.15:
shvetaishChatraiH patAkAbhirdhvajavAraNavAjibhiH |
tAnyanIkAnyashobhanta rathairatha padAtibhiH
shlokas.16:
bherIpaNavashabdaishcha paTahAnAM cha nisvanaiH |
rathanemininAdaishcha babhUvAkulitA mahI
shlokas.17:
kA~nchanA~NgadakeyUraiH kArmukaishcha mahArathAH |
bhrAjamAnA vyadRRishyanta ja~NgamAH parvatA iva
shlokas.18:
tAlena mahatA bhIShmaH pa~nchatAreNa ketunA |
vimalAdityasa~NkAshastasthau kuruchamUpatiH
shlokas.19:
ye tvadIyA maheShvAsA rAjAno bharatarShabha |
avartanta yathAdeshaM rAja~nshAntanavasya te
shlokas.20:
sa tu govAsanaH shaibyaH sahitaH sarvarAjabhiH |
yayau mAta~NgarAjena rAjArheNa patAkinA
padmavarNastvanIkAnAM sarveShAmagrataH sthitaH
shlokas.21:
ashvatthAmA yayau yattaH siMhalA~NgUlaketanaH |
shrutAyushchitrasenashcha purumitro vivi.nshatiH
shlokas.22:
shalyo bhUrishravAshchaiva vikarNashcha mahArathaH |
ete sapta maheShvAsA droNaputrapurogamAH
syandanairvaravarNAbhairbhIShmasyAsanpuraHsarAH
shlokas.23:
teShAmapi mahotsedhAH shobhayanto rathottamAn |
bhrAjamAnA vyadRRishyanta jAmbUnadamayA dhvajAH
shlokas.24:
jAmbUnadamayI vediH kamaNDaluvibhUShitA |
keturAchAryamukhyasya droNasya dhanuShA saha
shlokas.25:
anekashatasAhasramanIkamanukarShataH |
mahAnduryodhanasyAsInnAgo maNimayo dhvajaH
shlokas.26:
tasya pauravakAli~Ngau kAmbojashcha sudakShiNaH |
kShemadhanvA sumitrashcha tasthuH pramukhato rathAH
shlokas.27:
syandanena mahArheNa ketunA vRRiShabheNa cha |
prakarShanniva senAgraM mAgadhashcha nRRipo yayau
shlokas.28:
tada~NgapatinA guptaM kRRipeNa cha mahAtmanA |
shAradAbhrachayaprakhyaM prAchyAnAmabhavadbalam
shlokas.29:
anIkapramukhe tiShThanvarAheNa mahAyashAH |
shushubhe ketumukhyena rAjatena jayadrathaH
shlokas.30:
shataM rathasahasrANAM tasyAsanvashavartinaH |
aShTau nAgasahasrANi sAdinAmayutAni ShaT
shlokas.31:
tatsindhupatinA rAjanpAlitaM dhvajinImukham |
anantarathanAgAshvamashobhata mahadbalam
shlokas.32:
ShaShTyA rathasahasraistu nAgAnAmayutena cha |
patiH sarvakali~NgAnAM yayau ketumatA saha
shlokas.33:
tasya parvatasa~NkAshA vyarochanta mahAgajAH |
yantratomaratUNIraiH patAkAbhishcha shobhitAH
shlokas.34:
shushubhe ketumukhyena pAdapena kali~NgapaH |
shvetachChatreNa niShkeNa chAmaravyajanena cha
shlokas.35:
ketumAnapi mAta~NgaM vichitraparamA~Nkusham |
AsthitaH samare rAjanmeghastha iva bhAnumAn
shlokas.36:
tejasA dIpyamAnastu vAraNottamamAsthitaH |
bhagadatto yayau rAjA yathA vajradharastathA
shlokas.37:
gajaskandhagatAvAstAM bhagadattena saMmitau |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau ketumantamanuvratau
shlokas.38:
sa rathAnIkavAnvyUho hastya~NgottamashIrShavAn |
vAjipakShaH patannugraH prAharatsarvatomukhaH
shlokas.39:
droNena vihito rAjanrAj~nA shAntanavena cha |
tathaivAchAryaputreNa bAhlIkena kRRipeNa cha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato muhUrtAttumulaH shabdo hRRidayakampanaH |
ashrUyata mahArAja yodhAnAM prayuyutsatAm
shlokas.2:
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShairvAraNAnAM cha bRRiMhitaiH |
rathAnAM nemighoShaishcha dIryatIva vasundharA
shlokas.3:
hayAnAM heShamANAnAM yodhAnAM tatra garjatAm |
kShaNena khaM dishashchaiva shabdenApUritaM tadA
shlokas.4:
putrANAM tava durdharSha pANDavAnAM tathaiva cha |
samakampanta sainyAni parasparasamAgame
shlokas.5:
tatra nAgA rathAshchaiva jAmbUnadavibhUShitAH |
bhrAjamAnA vyadRRishyanta meghA iva savidyutaH
shlokas.6:
dhvajA bahuvidhAkArAstAvakAnAM narAdhipa |
kA~nchanA~Ngadino rejurjvalitA iva pAvakAH
shlokas.7:
sveShAM chaiva pareShAM cha samadRRishyanta bhArata |
mahendraketavaH shubhrA mahendrasadaneShviva
shlokas.8:
kA~nchanaiH kavachairvIrA jvalanArkasamaprabhaiH |
saMnaddhAH pratyadRRishyanta grahAH prajvalitA iva
shlokas.9:
udyatairAyudhaishchitraistalabaddhAH patAkinaH |
RRiShabhAkShA maheShvAsAshchamUmukhagatA babhuH
shlokas.10:
pRRiShThagopAstu bhIShmasya putrAstava narAdhipa |
duHshAsano durviShaho durmukho duHsahastathA
shlokas.11:
vivi.nshatishchitraseno vikarNashcha mahArathaH |
satyavrataH purumitro jayo bhUrishravAH shalaH
shlokas.12:
rathA vi.nshatisAhasrAstathaiShAmanuyAyinaH |
abhIShAhAH shUrasenAH shibayo.atha vasAtayaH
shlokas.13:
shAlvA matsyAstathAmbaShThAstrigartAH kekayAstathA |
sauvIrAH kitavAH prAchyAH pratIchyodIchyamAlavAH
shlokas.14:
dvAdashaite janapadAH sarve shUrAstanutyajaH |
mahatA rathava.nshena te.abhyarakShanpitAmaham
shlokas.15:
anIkaM dashasAhasraM ku~njarANAM tarasvinAm |
mAgadho yena nRRipatistadrathAnIkamanvayAt
shlokas.16:
rathAnAM chakrarakShAshcha pAdarakShAshcha dantinAm |
abhUvanvAhinImadhye shatAnAmayutAni ShaT
shlokas.17:
pAdAtAshchAgrato.agachChandhanushcharmAsipANayaH |
anekashatasAhasrA nakharaprAsayodhinaH
shlokas.18:
akShauhiNyo dashaikA cha tava putrasya bhArata |
adRRishyanta mahArAja ga~Ngeva yamunAntare

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
akShauhiNyo dashaikAM cha vyUDhAM dRRiShTvA yudhiShThiraH |
kathamalpena sainyena pratyavyUhata pANDavaH
shlokas.2:
yo veda mAnuShaM vyUhaM daivaM gAndharvamAsuram |
kathaM bhIShmaM sa kaunteyaH pratyavyUhata pANDavaH
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dhArtarAShTrANyanIkAni dRRiShTvA vyUDhAni pANDavaH |
abhyabhAShata dharmAtmA dharmarAjo dhana~njayam
shlokas.4:
maharShervachanAttAta vedayanti bRRihaspateH |
saMhatAnyodhayedalpAnkAmaM vistArayedbahUn
shlokas.5:
sUchImukhamanIkaM syAdalpAnAM bahubhiH saha |
asmAkaM cha tathA sainyamalpIyaH sutarAM paraiH
shlokas.6:
etadvachanamAj~nAya maharShervyUha pANDava |
tachChrutvA dharmarAjasya pratyabhAShata phalguNaH
shlokas.7:
eSha vyUhAmi te rAjanvyUhaM paramadurjayam |
achalaM nAma vajrAkhyaM vihitaM vajrapANinA
shlokas.8:
yaH sa vAta ivoddhUtaH samare duHsahaH paraiH |
sa naH puro yotsyati vai bhImaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.9:
tejA.nsi ripusainyAnAM mRRidnanpuruShasattamaH |
agre.agraNIryAsyati no yuddhopAyavichakShaNaH
shlokas.10:
yaM dRRiShTvA pArthivAH sarve duryodhanapurogamAH |
nivartiShyanti sambhrAntAH siMhaM kShudramRRigA iva
shlokas.11:
taM sarve sa.nshrayiShyAmaH prAkAramakutobhayam |
bhImaM praharatAM shreShThaM vajrapANimivAmarAH
shlokas.12:
na hi so.asti pumA.Nlloke yaH sa~NkruddhaM vRRikodaram |
draShTumatyugrakarmANaM viShaheta nararShabham
shlokas.13:
bhImaseno gadAM bibhradvajrasAramayIM dRRiDhAm |
charanvegena mahatA samudramapi shoShayet
shlokas.14:
kekayA dhRRiShTaketushcha chekitAnashcha vIryavAn |
eta tiShThanti sAmAtyAH prekShakAste nareshvara
shlokas.15:
dhRRitarAShTrasya dAyAdA iti bIbhatsurabravIt |
bruvANaM tu tathA pArthaM sarvasainyAni mAriSha
apUjaya.nstadA vAgbhiranukUlAbhirAhave
shlokas.16:
evamuktvA mahAbAhustathA chakre dhana~njayaH |
vyUhya tAni balAnyAshu prayayau phalgunastadA
shlokas.17:
samprayAtAnkurUndRRiShTvA pANDavAnAM mahAchamUH |
ga~Ngeva pUrNA stimitA syandamAnA vyadRRishyata
shlokas.18:
bhImaseno.agraNIsteShAM dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha dhRRiShTaketushcha vIryavAn
shlokas.19:
samudyojya tataH pashchAdrAjApyakShauhiNIvRRitaH |
bhrAtRRibhiH saha putraishcha so.abhyarakShata pRRiShThataH
shlokas.20:
chakrarakShau tu bhImasya mAdrIputrau mahAdyutI |
draupadeyAH sasaubhadrAH pRRiShThagopAstarasvinaH
shlokas.21:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pA~nchAlyasteShAM goptA mahArathaH |
sahitaH pRRitanAshUrai rathamukhyaiH prabhadrakaiH
shlokas.22:
shikhaNDI tu tataH pashchAdarjunenAbhirakShitaH |
yatto bhIShmavinAshAya prayayau bharatarShabha
shlokas.23:
pRRiShThagopo.arjunasyApi yuyudhAno mahArathaH |
chakrarakShau tu pA~nchAlyau yudhAmanyUttamaujasau
shlokas.24:
rAjA tu madhyamAnIke kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
bRRihadbhiH ku~njarairmattaishchaladbhirachalairiva
shlokas.25:
akShauhiNyA cha pA~nchAlyo yaj~naseno mahAmanAH |
virATamanvayAtpashchAtpANDavArthe parAkramI
shlokas.26:
teShAmAdityachandrAbhAH kanakottamabhUShaNAH |
nAnAchihnadharA rAjanratheShvAsanmahAdhvajAH
shlokas.27:
samutsarpya tataH pashchAddhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH |
bhrAtRRibhiH saha putraishcha so.abhyarakShadyudhiShThiram
shlokas.28:
tvadIyAnAM pareShAM cha ratheShu vividhAndhvajAn |
abhibhUyArjunasyaiko dhvajastasthau mahAkapiH
shlokas.29:
pAdAtAstvagrato.agachChannasishaktyRRiShTipANayaH |
anekashatasAhasrA bhImasenasya rakShiNaH
shlokas.30:
vAraNA dashasAhasrAH prabhinnakaraTAmukhAH |
shUrA hemamayairjAlairdIpyamAnA ivAchalAH
shlokas.31:
kSharanta iva jImUtA madArdrAH padmagandhinaH |
rAjAnamanvayuH pashchAchchalanta iva parvatAH
shlokas.32:
bhImaseno gadAM bhImAM prakarShanparighopamAm |
prachakarSha mahatsainyaM durAdharSho mahAmanAH
shlokas.33:
tamarkamiva duShprekShyaM tapantaM rashmimAlinam |
na shekuH sarvato yodhAH prativIkShitumantike
shlokas.34:
vajro nAmaiSha tu vyUho durbhidaH sarvatomukhaH |
chApavidyuddhvajo ghoro gupto gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.35:
yaM prativyUhya tiShThanti pANDavAstava vAhinIm |
ajeyo mAnuShe loke pANDavairabhirakShitaH
shlokas.36:
sandhyAM tiShThatsu sainyeShu sUryasyodayanaM prati |
prAvAtsapRRiShato vAyuranabhre stanayitnumAn
shlokas.37:
viShvagvAtAshcha vAntyugrA nIchaiH sharkarakarShiNaH |
rajashchoddhUyamAnaM tu tamasAchChAdayajjagat
shlokas.38:
papAta mahatI cholkA prA~NmukhI bharatarShabha |
udyantaM sUryamAhatya vyashIryata mahAsvanA
shlokas.39:
atha sajjIyamAneShu sainyeShu bharatarShabha |
niShprabho.abhyudiyAtsUryaH saghoSho bhUshchachAla ha
vyashIryata sanAdA cha tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.40:
nirghAtA bahavo rAjandikShu sarvAsu chAbhavan |
prAdurAsIdrajastIvraM na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.41:
dhvajAnAM dhUyamAnAnAM sahasA mAtarishvanA |
ki~NkiNIjAlanaddhAnAM kA~nchanasragvatAM ravaiH
shlokas.42:
mahatAM sapatAkAnAmAdityasamatejasAm |
sarvaM jhaNajhaNIbhUtamAsIttAlavaneShviva
shlokas.43:
evaM te puruShavyAghrAH pANDavA yuddhanandinaH |
vyavasthitAH prativyUhya tava putrasya vAhinIm
shlokas.44:
sra.nsanta iva majjAno yodhAnAM bharatarShabha |
dRRiShTvAgrato bhImasenaM gadApANimavasthitam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sUryodaye sa~njaya ke nu pUrvaM; yuyutsavo hRRiShyamANA ivAsan |
mAmakA vA bhIShmanetrAH samIke; pANDavA vA bhImanetrAstadAnIm
shlokas.2:
keShAM jaghanyau somasUryau savAyU; keShAM senAM shvApadA vyAbhaShanta |
keShAM yUnAM mukhavarNAH prasannAH; sarvaM hyetadbrUhi tattvaM yathAvat
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ubhe sene tulyamivopayAte; ubhe vyUhe hRRiShTarUpe narendra |
ubhe chitre vanarAjiprakAshe; tathaivobhe nAgarathAshvapUrNe
shlokas.4:
ubhe sene bRRihatI bhImarUpe; tathaivobhe bhArata durviShahye |
tathaivobhe svargajayAya sRRiShTe; tathA hyubhe satpuruShAryagupte
shlokas.5:
pashchAnmukhAH kuravo dhArtarAShTrAH; sthitAH pArthAH prA~NmukhA yotsyamAnAH |
daityendraseneva cha kauravANAM; devendraseneva cha pANDavAnAm
shlokas.6:
shukro vAyuH pRRiShThataH pANDavAnAM; dhArtarAShTrA~nshvApadA vyAbhaShanta |
gajendrANAM madagandhA.nshcha tIvrA;nna sehire tava putrasya nAgAH
shlokas.7:
duryodhano hastinaM padmavarNaM; suvarNakakShyaM jAtibalaM prabhinnam |
samAsthito madhyagataH kurUNAM; sa.nstUyamAno bandibhirmAgadhaishcha
shlokas.8:
chandraprabhaM shvetamasyAtapatraM; sauvarNI sragbhrAjate chottamA~Nge |
taM sarvataH shakuniH pArvatIyaiH; sArdhaM gAndhAraiH pAti gAndhArarAjaH
shlokas.9:
