bhIShmo.agrataH sarvasainyasya vRRiddhaH; shvetachChatraH shvetadhanuH sasha~NkhaH |
shvetoShNIShaH pANDureNa dhvajena; shvetairashvaiH shvetashailaprakAshaH
shlokas.10:
tasya sainyaM dhArtarAShTrAshcha sarve; bAhlIkAnAmekadeshaH shalashcha |
ye chAmbaShThAH kShatriyA ye cha sindhau; tathA sauvIrAH pa~nchanadAshcha shUrAH
shlokas.11:
shoNairhayai rukmaratho mahAtmA; droNo mahAbAhuradInasattvaH |
Aste guruH prayashAH sarvarAj~nAM; pashchAchchamUmindra ivAbhirakShan
shlokas.12:
vArddhakShatriH sarvasainyasya madhye; bhUrishravAH purumitro jayashcha |
shAlvA matsyAH kekayAshchApi sarve; gajAnIkairbhrAtaro yotsyamAnAH
shlokas.13:
shAradvatashchottaradhUrmahAtmA; maheShvAso gautamashchitrayodhI |
shakaiH kirAtairyavanaiH pahlavaishcha; sArdhaM chamUmuttarato.abhipAti
shlokas.14:
mahArathairandhakavRRiShNibhojaiH; saurAShTrakairnairRRitairAttashastraiH |
bRRihadbalaH kRRitavarmAbhigupto; balaM tvadIyaM dakShiNato.abhipAti
shlokas.15:
sa.nshaptakAnAmayutaM rathAnAM; mRRityurjayo vArjunasyeti sRRiShTAH |
yenArjunastena rAjankRRitAstrAH; prayAtA vai te trigartAshcha shUrAH
shlokas.16:
sAgraM shatasahasraM tu nAgAnAM tava bhArata |
nAge nAge rathashataM shataM chAshvA rathe rathe
shlokas.17:
ashve.ashve dasha dhAnuShkA dhAnuShke dasha charmiNaH |
evaM vyUDhAnyanIkAni bhIShmeNa tava bhArata
shlokas.18:
avyUhanmAnuShaM vyUhaM daivaM gAndharvamAsuram |
divase divase prApte bhIShmaH shAntanavo.agraNIH
shlokas.19:
mahArathaughavipulaH samudra iva parvaNi |
bhIShmeNa dhArtarAShTrANAM vyUhaH pratya~Nmukho yudhi
shlokas.20:
anantarUpA dhvajinI tvadIyA; narendra bhImA na tu pANDavAnAm |
tAM tveva manye bRRihatIM duShpradhRRiShyAM; yasyA netArau keshavashchArjunashcha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bRRihatIM dhArtarAShTrANAM dRRiShTvA senAM samudyatAm |
viShAdamagamadrAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
vyUhaM bhIShmeNa chAbhedyaM kalpitaM prekShya pANDavaH |
abhedyamiva samprekShya viShaNNo.arjunamabravIt
shlokas.3:
dhana~njaya kathaM shakyamasmAbhiryoddhumAhave |
dhArtarAShTrairmahAbAho yeShAM yoddhA pitAmahaH
shlokas.4:
akShobhyo.ayamabhedyashcha bhIShmeNAmitrakarshinA |
kalpitaH shAstradRRiShTena vidhinA bhUritejasA
shlokas.5:
te vayaM sa.nshayaM prAptAH sasainyAH shatrukarshana |
kathamasmAnmahAvyUhAdudyAnaM no bhaviShyati
shlokas.6:
athArjuno.abravItpArthaM yudhiShThiramamitrahA |
viShaNNamabhisamprekShya tava rAjannanIkinIm
shlokas.7:
praj~nayAbhyadhikA~nshUrAnguNayuktAnbahUnapi |
jayantyalpatarA yena tannibodha vishAM pate
shlokas.8:
tattu te kAraNaM rAjanpravakShyAmyanasUyave |
nAradastamRRiShirveda bhIShmadroNau cha pANDava
shlokas.9:
etamevArthamAshritya yuddhe devAsure.abravIt |
pitAmahaH kila purA mahendrAdIndivaukasaH
shlokas.10:
na tathA balavIryAbhyAM vijayante jigIShavaH |
yathA satyAnRRisha.nsyAbhyAM dharmeNaivodyamena cha
shlokas.11:
tyaktvAdharmaM cha lobhaM cha mohaM chodyamamAsthitAH |
yudhyadhvamanaha~NkArA yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.12:
evaM rAjanvijAnIhi dhruvo.asmAkaM raNe jayaH |
yathA me nAradaH prAha yataH kRRiShNastato jayaH
shlokas.13:
guNabhUto jayaH kRRiShNe pRRiShThato.anveti mAdhavam |
anyathA vijayashchAsya saMnatishchAparo guNaH
shlokas.14:
anantatejA govindaH shatrupUgeShu nirvyathaH |
puruShaH sanAtanatamo yataH kRRiShNastato jayaH
shlokas.15:
purA hyeSha harirbhUtvA vaikuNTho.akuNThasAyakaH |
surAsurAnavasphUrjannabravItke jayantviti
shlokas.16:
anu kRRiShNaM jayemeti yairuktaM tatra tairjitam |
tatprasAdAddhi trailokyaM prAptaM shakrAdibhiH suraiH
shlokas.17:
tasya te na vyathAM kA~nchidiha pashyAmi bhArata |
yasya te jayamAshAste vishvabhuktridasheshvaraH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA svAM senAM samachodayat |
prativyUhannanIkAni bhIShmasya bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
yathoddiShTAnyanIkAni pratyavyUhanta pANDavAH |
svargaM paramabhIpsantaH suyuddhena kurUdvahAH
shlokas.3:
madhye shikhaNDino.anIkaM rakShitaM savyasAchinA |
dhRRiShTadyumnasya cha svayaM bhImena paripAlitam
shlokas.4:
anIkaM dakShiNaM rAjanyuyudhAnena pAlitam |
shrImatA sAtvatAgryeNa shakreNeva dhanuShmatA
shlokas.5:
mahendrayAnapratimaM rathaM tu; sopaskaraM hATakaratnachitram |
yudhiShThiraH kA~nchanabhANDayoktraM; samAsthito nAgakulasya madhye
shlokas.6:
samuchChritaM dAntashalAkamasya; supANDuraM ChatramatIva bhAti |
pradakShiNaM chainamupAcharanti; maharShayaH sa.nstutibhirnarendram
shlokas.7:
purohitAH shatruvadhaM vadanto; maharShivRRiddhAH shrutavanta eva |
japyaishcha mantraishcha tathauShadhIbhiH; samantataH svastyayanaM prachakruH
shlokas.8:
tataH sa vastrANi tathaiva gAshcha; phalAni puShpANi tathaiva niShkAn |
kurUttamo brAhmaNasAnmahAtmA; kurvanyayau shakra ivAmarebhyaH
shlokas.9:
sahasrasUryaH shataki~NkiNIkaH; parArdhyajAmbUnadahemachitraH |
ratho.arjunasyAgnirivArchimAlI; vibhrAjate shvetahayaH suchakraH
shlokas.10:
tamAsthitaH keshavasa~NgRRihItaM; kapidhvajaM gANDivabANahastaH |
dhanurdharo yasya samaH pRRithivyAM; na vidyate no bhavitA vA kadAchit
shlokas.11:
udvartayiShya.nstava putrasenA;matIva raudraM sa bibharti rUpam |
anAyudho yaH subhujo bhujAbhyAM; narAshvanAgAnyudhi bhasma kuryAt
shlokas.12:
sa bhImasenaH sahito yamAbhyAM; vRRikodaro vIrarathasya goptA |
taM prekShya mattarShabhasiMhakhelaM; loke mahendrapratimAnakalpam
shlokas.13:
samIkShya senAgragataM durAsadaM; pravivyathuH pa~NkagatA ivoShTrAH |
vRRikodaraM vAraNarAjadarpaM; yodhAstvadIyA bhayavignasattvAH
shlokas.14:
anIkamadhye tiShThantaM rAjaputraM durAsadam |
abravIdbharatashreShThaM guDAkeshaM janArdanaH
shlokas.15:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
ya eSha goptA pratapanbalastho; yo naH senAM siMha ivekShate cha |
sa eSha bhIShmaH kuruva.nshaketu;ryenAhRRitAstri.nshato vAjimedhAH
shlokas.16:
etAnyanIkAni mahAnubhAvaM; gUhanti meghA iva gharmarashmim |
etAni hatvA puruShapravIra; kA~NkShasva yuddhaM bharatarShabheNa
shlokas.17:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
keShAM prahRRiShTAstatrAgre yodhA yudhyanti sa~njaya |
udagramanasaH ke.atra ke vA dInA vichetasaH
shlokas.18:
ke pUrvaM prAhara.nstatra yuddhe hRRidayakampane |
mAmakAH pANDavAnAM vA tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.19:
kasya senAsamudaye gandhamAlyasamudbhavaH |
vAchaH pradakShiNAshchaiva yodhAnAmabhigarjatAm
shlokas.20:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ubhayoH senayostatra yodhA jahRRiShire mudA |
sragdhUpapAnagandhAnAmubhayatra samudbhavaH
shlokas.21:
saMhatAnAmanIkAnAM vyUDhAnAM bharatarShabha |
sa.nsarpatAmudIrNAnAM vimardaH sumahAnabhUt
shlokas.22:
vAditrashabdastumulaH sha~NkhabherIvimishritaH |
ku~njarANAM cha nadatAM sainyAnAM cha prahRRiShyatAm

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
dharmakShetre kurukShetre samavetA yuyutsavaH |
mAmakAH pANDavAshchaiva kimakurvata sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dRRiShTvA tu pANDavAnIkaM vyUDhaM duryodhanastadA |
AchAryamupasa~Ngamya rAjA vachanamabravIt
shlokas.3:
pashyaitAM pANDuputrANAmAchArya mahatIM chamUm |
vyUDhAM drupadaputreNa tava shiShyeNa dhImatA
shlokas.4:
atra shUrA maheShvAsA bhImArjunasamA yudhi |
yuyudhAno virATashcha drupadashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.5:
dhRRiShTaketushchekitAnaH kAshirAjashcha vIryavAn |
purujitkuntibhojashcha shaibyashcha narapu~NgavaH
shlokas.6:
yudhAmanyushcha vikrAnta uttamaujAshcha vIryavAn |
saubhadro draupadeyAshcha sarva eva mahArathAH
shlokas.7:
asmAkaM tu vishiShTA ye tAnnibodha dvijottama |
nAyakA mama sainyasya sa~nj~nArthaM tAnbravImi te
shlokas.8:
bhavAnbhIShmashcha karNashcha kRRipashcha samiti~njayaH |
ashvatthAmA vikarNashcha saumadattistathaiva cha
shlokas.9:
anye cha bahavaH shUrA madarthe tyaktajIvitAH |
nAnAshastrapraharaNAH sarve yuddhavishAradAH
shlokas.10:
aparyAptaM tadasmAkaM balaM bhIShmAbhirakShitam |
paryAptaM tvidameteShAM balaM bhImAbhirakShitam
shlokas.11:
ayaneShu cha sarveShu yathAbhAgamavasthitAH |
bhIShmamevAbhirakShantu bhavantaH sarva eva hi
shlokas.12:
tasya sa~njanayanharShaM kuruvRRiddhaH pitAmahaH |
siMhanAdaM vinadyochchaiH sha~NkhaM dadhmau pratApavAn
shlokas.13:
tataH sha~NkhAshcha bheryashcha paNavAnakagomukhAH |
sahasaivAbhyahanyanta sa shabdastumulo.abhavat
shlokas.14:
tataH shvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau |
mAdhavaH pANDavashchaiva divyau sha~Nkhau pradadhmatuH
shlokas.15:
pA~nchajanyaM hRRiShIkesho devadattaM dhana~njayaH |
pauNDraM dadhmau mahAsha~NkhaM bhImakarmA vRRikodaraH
shlokas.16:
anantavijayaM rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha sughoShamaNipuShpakau
shlokas.17:
kAshyashcha parameShvAsaH shikhaNDI cha mahArathaH |
dhRRiShTadyumno virATashcha sAtyakishchAparAjitaH
shlokas.18:
drupado draupadeyAshcha sarvashaH pRRithivIpate |
saubhadrashcha mahAbAhuH sha~NkhAndadhmuH pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.19:
sa ghoSho dhArtarAShTrANAM hRRidayAni vyadArayat |
nabhashcha pRRithivIM chaiva tumulo vyanunAdayan
shlokas.20:
atha vyavasthitAndRRiShTvA dhArtarAShTrAnkapidhvajaH |
pravRRitte shastrasampAte dhanurudyamya pANDavaH
shlokas.21:
hRRiShIkeshaM tadA vAkyamidamAha mahIpate |
senayorubhayormadhye rathaM sthApaya me.achyuta
shlokas.22:
yAvadetAnnirIkShe.ahaM yoddhukAmAnavasthitAn |
kairmayA saha yoddhavyamasminraNasamudyame
shlokas.23:
yotsyamAnAnavekShe.ahaM ya ete.atra samAgatAH |
dhArtarAShTrasya durbuddheryuddhe priyachikIrShavaH
shlokas.24:
evamukto hRRiShIkesho guDAkeshena bhArata |
senayorubhayormadhye sthApayitvA rathottamam
shlokas.25:
bhIShmadroNapramukhataH sarveShAM cha mahIkShitAm |
uvAcha pArtha pashyaitAnsamavetAnkurUniti
shlokas.26:
tatrApashyatsthitAnpArthaH pitR^Inatha pitAmahAn |
AchAryAnmAtulAnbhrAtR^InputrAnpautrAnsakhI.nstathA
shlokas.27:
shvashurAnsuhRRidashchaiva senayorubhayorapi |
tAnsamIkShya sa kaunteyaH sarvAnbandhUnavasthitAn
shlokas.28:
kRRipayA parayAviShTo viShIdannidamabravIt |
dRRiShTvemAnsvajanAnkRRiShNa yuyutsUnsamavasthitAn
shlokas.29:
sIdanti mama gAtrANi mukhaM cha parishuShyati |
vepathushcha sharIre me romaharShashcha jAyate
shlokas.30:
gANDIvaM sra.nsate hastAttvakchaiva paridahyate |
na cha shaknomyavasthAtuM bhramatIva cha me manaH
shlokas.31:
nimittAni cha pashyAmi viparItAni keshava |
na cha shreyo.anupashyAmi hatvA svajanamAhave
shlokas.32:
na kA~NkShe vijayaM kRRiShNa na cha rAjyaM sukhAni cha |
kiM no rAjyena govinda kiM bhogairjIvitena vA
shlokas.33:
yeShAmarthe kA~NkShitaM no rAjyaM bhogAH sukhAni cha |
ta ime.avasthitA yuddhe prANA.nstyaktvA dhanAni cha
shlokas.34:
AchAryAH pitaraH putrAstathaiva cha pitAmahAH |
mAtulAH shvashurAH pautrAH syAlAH sambandhinastathA
shlokas.35:
etAnna hantumichChAmi ghnato.api madhusUdana |
api trailokyarAjyasya hetoH kiM nu mahIkRRite
shlokas.36:
nihatya dhArtarAShTrAnnaH kA prItiH syAjjanArdana |
pApamevAshrayedasmAnhatvaitAnAtatAyinaH
shlokas.37:
tasmAnnArhA vayaM hantuM dhArtarAShTrAnsabAndhavAn |
svajanaM hi kathaM hatvA sukhinaH syAma mAdhava
shlokas.38:
yadyapyete na pashyanti lobhopahatachetasaH |
kulakShayakRRitaM doShaM mitradrohe cha pAtakam
shlokas.39:
kathaM na j~neyamasmAbhiH pApAdasmAnnivartitum |
kulakShayakRRitaM doShaM prapashyadbhirjanArdana
shlokas.40:
kulakShaye praNashyanti kuladharmAH sanAtanAH |
dharme naShTe kulaM kRRitsnamadharmo.abhibhavatyuta
shlokas.41:
adharmAbhibhavAtkRRiShNa praduShyanti kulastriyaH |
strIShu duShTAsu vArShNeya jAyate varNasa~NkaraH
shlokas.42:
sa~Nkaro narakAyaiva kulaghnAnAM kulasya cha |
patanti pitaro hyeShAM luptapiNDodakakriyAH
shlokas.43:
doShairetaiH kulaghnAnAM varNasa~NkarakArakaiH |
utsAdyante jAtidharmAH kuladharmAshcha shAshvatAH
shlokas.44:
utsannakuladharmANAM manuShyANAM janArdana |
narake niyataM vAso bhavatItyanushushruma
shlokas.45:
aho bata mahatpApaM kartuM vyavasitA vayam |
yadrAjyasukhalobhena hantuM svajanamudyatAH
shlokas.46:
yadi mAmapratIkAramashastraM shastrapANayaH |
dhArtarAShTrA raNe hanyustanme kShemataraM bhavet
shlokas.47:
evamuktvArjunaH sa~Nkhye rathopastha upAvishat |
visRRijya sasharaM chApaM shokasa.nvignamAnasaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
taM tathA kRRipayAviShTamashrupUrNAkulekShaNam |
viShIdantamidaM vAkyamuvAcha madhusUdanaH
shlokas.2:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
kutastvA kashmalamidaM viShame samupasthitam |
anAryajuShTamasvargyamakIrtikaramarjuna
shlokas.3:
klaibyaM mA sma gamaH pArtha naitattvayyupapadyate |
kShudraM hRRidayadaurbalyaM tyaktvottiShTha parantapa
shlokas.4:
arjuna uvAcha||
kathaM bhIShmamahaM sa~Nkhye droNaM cha madhusUdana |
iShubhiH pratiyotsyAmi pUjArhAvarisUdana
shlokas.5:
gurUnahatvA hi mahAnubhAvA;~nshreyo bhoktuM bhaikShamapIha loke |
hatvArthakAmA.nstu gurUnihaiva; bhu~njIya bhogAnrudhirapradigdhAn
shlokas.6:
na chaitadvidmaH kataranno garIyo; yadvA jayema yadi vA no jayeyuH |
yAneva hatvA na jijIviShAma;ste.avasthitAH pramukhe dhArtarAShTrAH
shlokas.7:
kArpaNyadoShopahatasvabhAvaH; pRRichChAmi tvAM dharmasaMmUDhachetAH |
yachChreyaH syAnnishchitaM brUhi tanme; shiShyaste.ahaM shAdhi mAM tvAM prapannam
shlokas.8:
na hi prapashyAmi mamApanudyA;dyachChokamuchChoShaNamindriyANAm |
avApya bhUmAvasapatnamRRiddhaM; rAjyaM surANAmapi chAdhipatyam
shlokas.9:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA hRRiShIkeshaM guDAkeshaH parantapa |
na yotsya iti govindamuktvA tUShNIM babhUva ha
shlokas.10:
tamuvAcha hRRiShIkeshaH prahasanniva bhArata |
senayorubhayormadhye viShIdantamidaM vachaH
shlokas.11:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
ashochyAnanvashochastvaM praj~nAvAdA.nshcha bhAShase |
gatAsUnagatAsU.nshcha nAnushochanti paNDitAH
shlokas.12:
na tvevAhaM jAtu nAsaM na tvaM neme janAdhipAH |
na chaiva na bhaviShyAmaH sarve vayamataH param
shlokas.13:
dehino.asminyathA dehe kaumAraM yauvanaM jarA |
tathA dehAntaraprAptirdhIrastatra na muhyati
shlokas.14:
mAtrAsparshAstu kaunteya shItoShNasukhaduHkhadAH |
AgamApAyino.anityAstA.nstitikShasva bhArata
shlokas.15:
yaM hi na vyathayantyete puruShaM puruSharShabha |
samaduHkhasukhaM dhIraM so.amRRitatvAya kalpate
shlokas.16:
nAsato vidyate bhAvo nAbhAvo vidyate sataH |
ubhayorapi dRRiShTo.antastvanayostattvadarshibhiH
shlokas.17:
avinAshi tu tadviddhi yena sarvamidaM tatam |
vinAshamavyayasyAsya na kashchitkartumarhati
shlokas.18:
antavanta ime dehA nityasyoktAH sharIriNaH |
anAshino.aprameyasya tasmAdyudhyasva bhArata
shlokas.19:
ya enaM vetti hantAraM yashchainaM manyate hatam |
ubhau tau na vijAnIto nAyaM hanti na hanyate
shlokas.20:
na jAyate mriyate vA kadA chi;nnAyaM bhUtvA bhavitA vA na bhUyaH |
ajo nityaH shAshvato.ayaM purANo; na hanyate hanyamAne sharIre
shlokas.21:
vedAvinAshinaM nityaM ya enamajamavyayam |
kathaM sa puruShaH pArtha kaM ghAtayati hanti kam
shlokas.22:
vAsA.nsi jIrNAni yathA vihAya; navAni gRRihNAti naro.aparANi |
tathA sharIrANi vihAya jIrNA;nyanyAni sa.nyAti navAni dehI
shlokas.23:
nainaM Chindanti shastrANi nainaM dahati pAvakaH |
na chainaM kledayantyApo na shoShayati mArutaH
shlokas.24:
achChedyo.ayamadAhyo.ayamakledyo.ashoShya eva cha |
nityaH sarvagataH sthANurachalo.ayaM sanAtanaH
shlokas.25:
avyakto.ayamachintyo.ayamavikAryo.ayamuchyate |
tasmAdevaM viditvainaM nAnushochitumarhasi
shlokas.26:
atha chainaM nityajAtaM nityaM vA manyase mRRitam |
tathApi tvaM mahAbAho nainaM shochitumarhasi
shlokas.27:
jAtasya hi dhruvo mRRityurdhruvaM janma mRRitasya cha |
tasmAdaparihArye.arthe na tvaM shochitumarhasi
shlokas.28:
avyaktAdIni bhUtAni vyaktamadhyAni bhArata |
avyaktanidhanAnyeva tatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.29:
Ashcharyavatpashyati kashchidena;mAshcharyavadvadati tathaiva chAnyaH |
AshcharyavachchainamanyaH shRRiNoti; shrutvApyenaM veda na chaiva kashchit
shlokas.30:
dehI nityamavadhyo.ayaM dehe sarvasya bhArata |
tasmAtsarvANi bhUtAni na tvaM shochitumarhasi
shlokas.31:
svadharmamapi chAvekShya na vikampitumarhasi |
dharmyAddhi yuddhAchChreyo.anyatkShatriyasya na vidyate
shlokas.32:
yadRRichChayA chopapannaM svargadvAramapAvRRitam |
sukhinaH kShatriyAH pArtha labhante yuddhamIdRRisham
shlokas.33:
atha chettvamimaM dharmyaM sa~NgrAmaM na kariShyasi |
tataH svadharmaM kIrtiM cha hitvA pApamavApsyasi
shlokas.34:
akIrtiM chApi bhUtAni kathayiShyanti te.avyayAm |
sambhAvitasya chAkIrtirmaraNAdatirichyate
shlokas.35:
bhayAdraNAduparataM ma.nsyante tvAM mahArathAH |
yeShAM cha tvaM bahumato bhUtvA yAsyasi lAghavam
shlokas.36:
avAchyavAdA.nshcha bahUnvadiShyanti tavAhitAH |
nindantastava sAmarthyaM tato duHkhataraM nu kim
shlokas.37:
hato vA prApsyasi svargaM jitvA vA bhokShyase mahIm |
tasmAduttiShTha kaunteya yuddhAya kRRitanishchayaH
shlokas.38:
sukhaduHkhe same kRRitvA lAbhAlAbhau jayAjayau |
tato yuddhAya yujyasva naivaM pApamavApsyasi
shlokas.39:
eShA te.abhihitA sA~Nkhye buddhiryoge tvimAM shRRiNu |
buddhyA yukto yayA pArtha karmabandhaM prahAsyasi
shlokas.40:
nehAbhikramanAsho.asti pratyavAyo na vidyate |
svalpamapyasya dharmasya trAyate mahato bhayAt
shlokas.41:
vyavasAyAtmikA buddhirekeha kurunandana |
bahushAkhA hyanantAshcha buddhayo.avyavasAyinAm
shlokas.42:
yAmimAM puShpitAM vAchaM pravadantyavipashchitaH |
vedavAdaratAH pArtha nAnyadastIti vAdinaH
shlokas.43:
kAmAtmAnaH svargaparA janmakarmaphalapradAm |
kriyAvisheShabahulAM bhogaishvaryagatiM prati
shlokas.44:
bhogaishvaryaprasaktAnAM tayApahRRitachetasAm |
vyavasAyAtmikA buddhiH samAdhau na vidhIyate
shlokas.45:
traiguNyaviShayA vedA nistraiguNyo bhavArjuna |
nirdva.ndvo nityasattvastho niryogakShema AtmavAn
shlokas.46:
yAvAnartha udapAne sarvataH samplutodake |
tAvAnsarveShu vedeShu brAhmaNasya vijAnataH
shlokas.47:
karmaNyevAdhikAraste mA phaleShu kadAchana |
mA karmaphalaheturbhUrmA te sa~Ngo.astvakarmaNi
shlokas.48:
yogasthaH kuru karmANi sa~NgaM tyaktvA dhana~njaya |
siddhyasiddhyoH samo bhUtvA samatvaM yoga uchyate
shlokas.49:
dUreNa hyavaraM karma buddhiyogAddhana~njaya |
buddhau sharaNamanvichCha kRRipaNAH phalahetavaH
shlokas.50:
buddhiyukto jahAtIha ubhe sukRRitaduShkRRite |
tasmAdyogAya yujyasva yogaH karmasu kaushalam
shlokas.51:
karmajaM buddhiyuktA hi phalaM tyaktvA manIShiNaH |
janmabandhavinirmuktAH padaM gachChantyanAmayam
shlokas.52:
yadA te mohakalilaM buddhirvyatitariShyati |
tadA gantAsi nirvedaM shrotavyasya shrutasya cha
shlokas.53:
shrutivipratipannA te yadA sthAsyati nishchalA |
samAdhAvachalA buddhistadA yogamavApsyasi
shlokas.54:
arjuna uvAcha||
sthitapraj~nasya kA bhAShA samAdhisthasya keshava |
sthitadhIH kiM prabhASheta kimAsIta vrajeta kim
shlokas.55:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
prajahAti yadA kAmAnsarvAnpArtha manogatAn |
AtmanyevAtmanA tuShTaH sthitapraj~nastadochyate
shlokas.56:
duHkheShvanudvignamanAH sukheShu vigataspRRihaH |
vItarAgabhayakrodhaH sthitadhIrmuniruchyate
shlokas.57:
yaH sarvatrAnabhisnehastattatprApya shubhAshubham |
nAbhinandati na dveShTi tasya praj~nA pratiShThitA
shlokas.58:
yadA saMharate chAyaM kUrmo.a~NgAnIva sarvashaH |
indriyANIndriyArthebhyastasya praj~nA pratiShThitA
shlokas.59:
viShayA vinivartante nirAhArasya dehinaH |
rasavarjaM raso.apyasya paraM dRRiShTvA nivartate
shlokas.60:
yatato hyapi kaunteya puruShasya vipashchitaH |
indriyANi pramAthIni haranti prasabhaM manaH
shlokas.61:
tAni sarvANi sa.nyamya yukta AsIta matparaH |
vashe hi yasyendriyANi tasya praj~nA pratiShThitA
shlokas.62:
dhyAyato viShayAnpu.nsaH sa~NgasteShUpajAyate |
sa~NgAtsa~njAyate kAmaH kAmAtkrodho.abhijAyate
shlokas.63:
krodhAdbhavati saMmohaH saMmohAtsmRRitivibhramaH |
smRRitibhra.nshAdbuddhinAsho buddhinAshAtpraNashyati
shlokas.64:
rAgadveShaviyuktaistu viShayAnindriyaishcharan |
AtmavashyairvidheyAtmA prasAdamadhigachChati
shlokas.65:
prasAde sarvaduHkhAnAM hAnirasyopajAyate |
prasannachetaso hyAshu buddhiH paryavatiShThate
shlokas.66:
nAsti buddhirayuktasya na chAyuktasya bhAvanA |
na chAbhAvayataH shAntirashAntasya kutaH sukham
shlokas.67:
indriyANAM hi charatAM yanmano.anuvidhIyate |
tadasya harati praj~nAM vAyurnAvamivAmbhasi
shlokas.68:
tasmAdyasya mahAbAho nigRRihItAni sarvashaH |
indriyANIndriyArthebhyastasya praj~nA pratiShThitA
shlokas.69:
yA nishA sarvabhUtAnAM tasyAM jAgarti sa.nyamI |
yasyAM jAgrati bhUtAni sA nishA pashyato muneH
shlokas.70:
ApUryamANamachalapratiShThaM; samudramApaH pravishanti yadvat |
tadvatkAmA yaM pravishanti sarve; sa shAntimApnoti na kAmakAmI
shlokas.71:
vihAya kAmAnyaH sarvAnpumA.nshcharati niHspRRihaH |
nirmamo niraha~NkAraH sa shAntimadhigachChati
shlokas.72:
eShA brAhmI sthitiH pArtha nainAM prApya vimuhyati |
sthitvAsyAmantakAle.api brahmanirvANamRRichChati

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
jyAyasI chetkarmaNaste matA buddhirjanArdana |
tatkiM karmaNi ghore mAM niyojayasi keshava
shlokas.2:
vyAmishreNaiva vAkyena buddhiM mohayasIva me |
tadekaM vada nishchitya yena shreyo.ahamApnuyAm
shlokas.3:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
loke.asmindvividhA niShThA purA proktA mayAnagha |
j~nAnayogena sA~NkhyAnAM karmayogena yoginAm
shlokas.4:
na karmaNAmanArambhAnnaiShkarmyaM puruSho.ashnute |
na cha saMnyasanAdeva siddhiM samadhigachChati
shlokas.5:
na hi kashchitkShaNamapi jAtu tiShThatyakarmakRRit |
kAryate hyavashaH karma sarvaH prakRRitijairguNaiH
shlokas.6:
karmendriyANi sa.nyamya ya Aste manasA smaran |
indriyArthAnvimUDhAtmA mithyAchAraH sa uchyate
shlokas.7:
yastvindriyANi manasA niyamyArabhate.arjuna |
karmendriyaiH karmayogamasaktaH sa vishiShyate
shlokas.8:
niyataM kuru karma tvaM karma jyAyo hyakarmaNaH |
sharIrayAtrApi cha te na prasidhyedakarmaNaH
shlokas.9:
yaj~nArthAtkarmaNo.anyatra loko.ayaM karmabandhanaH |
tadarthaM karma kaunteya muktasa~NgaH samAchara
shlokas.10:
sahayaj~nAH prajAH sRRiShTvA purovAcha prajApatiH |
anena prasaviShyadhvameSha vo.astviShTakAmadhuk
shlokas.11:
devAnbhAvayatAnena te devA bhAvayantu vaH |
parasparaM bhAvayantaH shreyaH paramavApsyatha
shlokas.12:
iShTAnbhogAnhi vo devA dAsyante yaj~nabhAvitAH |
tairdattAnapradAyaibhyo yo bhu~Nkte stena eva saH
shlokas.13:
yaj~nashiShTAshinaH santo muchyante sarvakilbiShaiH |
bhu~njate te tvaghaM pApA ye pachantyAtmakAraNAt
shlokas.14:
annAdbhavanti bhUtAni parjanyAdannasambhavaH |
yaj~nAdbhavati parjanyo yaj~naH karmasamudbhavaH
shlokas.15:
karma brahmodbhavaM viddhi brahmAkSharasamudbhavam |
tasmAtsarvagataM brahma nityaM yaj~ne pratiShThitam
shlokas.16:
evaM pravartitaM chakraM nAnuvartayatIha yaH |
aghAyurindriyArAmo moghaM pArtha sa jIvati
shlokas.17:
yastvAtmaratireva syAdAtmatRRiptashcha mAnavaH |
Atmanyeva cha santuShTastasya kAryaM na vidyate
shlokas.18:
naiva tasya kRRitenArtho nAkRRiteneha kashchana |
na chAsya sarvabhUteShu kashchidarthavyapAshrayaH
shlokas.19:
tasmAdasaktaH satataM kAryaM karma samAchara |
asakto hyAcharankarma paramApnoti pUruShaH
shlokas.20:
karmaNaiva hi sa.nsiddhimAsthitA janakAdayaH |
lokasa~NgrahamevApi sampashyankartumarhasi
shlokas.21:
yadyadAcharati shreShThastattadevetaro janaH |
sa yatpramANaM kurute lokastadanuvartate
shlokas.22:
na me pArthAsti kartavyaM triShu lokeShu ki~nchana |
nAnavAptamavAptavyaM varta eva cha karmaNi
shlokas.23:
yadi hyahaM na varteyaM jAtu karmaNyatandritaH |
mama vartmAnuvartante manuShyAH pArtha sarvashaH
shlokas.24:
utsIdeyurime lokA na kuryAM karma chedaham |
sa~Nkarasya cha kartA syAmupahanyAmimAH prajAH
shlokas.25:
saktAH karmaNyavidvA.nso yathA kurvanti bhArata |
kuryAdvidvA.nstathAsaktashchikIrShurlokasa~Ngraham
shlokas.26:
na buddhibhedaM janayedaj~nAnAM karmasa~NginAm |
joShayetsarvakarmANi vidvAnyuktaH samAcharan
shlokas.27:
prakRRiteH kriyamANAni guNaiH karmANi sarvashaH |
aha~NkAravimUDhAtmA kartAhamiti manyate
shlokas.28:
tattvavittu mahAbAho guNakarmavibhAgayoH |
guNA guNeShu vartanta iti matvA na sajjate
shlokas.29:
prakRRiterguNasaMmUDhAH sajjante guNakarmasu |
tAnakRRitsnavido mandAnkRRitsnavinna vichAlayet
shlokas.30:
mayi sarvANi karmANi saMnyasyAdhyAtmachetasA |
nirAshIrnirmamo bhUtvA yudhyasva vigatajvaraH
shlokas.31:
ye me matamidaM nityamanutiShThanti mAnavAH |
shraddhAvanto.anasUyanto muchyante te.api karmabhiH
shlokas.32:
ye tvetadabhyasUyanto nAnutiShThanti me matam |
sarvaj~nAnavimUDhA.nstAnviddhi naShTAnachetasaH
shlokas.33:
sadRRishaM cheShTate svasyAH prakRRiterj~nAnavAnapi |
prakRRitiM yAnti bhUtAni nigrahaH kiM kariShyati
shlokas.34:
indriyasyendriyasyArthe rAgadveShau vyavasthitau |
tayorna vashamAgachChettau hyasya paripanthinau
shlokas.35:
shreyAnsvadharmo viguNaH paradharmAtsvanuShThitAt |
svadharme nidhanaM shreyaH paradharmo bhayAvahaH
shlokas.36:
arjuna uvAcha||
atha kena prayukto.ayaM pApaM charati pUruShaH |
anichChannapi vArShNeya balAdiva niyojitaH
shlokas.37:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
kAma eSha krodha eSha rajoguNasamudbhavaH |
mahAshano mahApApmA viddhyenamiha vairiNam
shlokas.38:
dhUmenAvriyate vahniryathAdarsho malena cha |
yatholbenAvRRito garbhastathA tenedamAvRRitam
shlokas.39:
AvRRitaM j~nAnametena j~nAnino nityavairiNA |
kAmarUpeNa kaunteya duShpUreNAnalena cha
shlokas.40:
indriyANi mano buddhirasyAdhiShThAnamuchyate |
etairvimohayatyeSha j~nAnamAvRRitya dehinam
shlokas.41:
tasmAttvamindriyANyAdau niyamya bharatarShabha |
pApmAnaM prajahihyenaM j~nAnavij~nAnanAshanam
shlokas.42:
indriyANi parANyAhurindriyebhyaH paraM manaH |
manasastu parA buddhiryo buddheH paratastu saH
shlokas.43:
evaM buddheH paraM buddhvA sa.nstabhyAtmAnamAtmanA |
jahi shatruM mahAbAho kAmarUpaM durAsadam

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
imaM vivasvate yogaM proktavAnahamavyayam |
vivasvAnmanave prAha manurikShvAkave.abravIt
shlokas.2:
evaM paramparAprAptamimaM rAjarShayo viduH |
sa kAleneha mahatA yogo naShTaH parantapa
shlokas.3:
sa evAyaM mayA te.adya yogaH proktaH purAtanaH |
bhakto.asi me sakhA cheti rahasyaM hyetaduttamam
shlokas.4:
arjuna uvAcha||
aparaM bhavato janma paraM janma vivasvataH |
kathametadvijAnIyAM tvamAdau proktavAniti
shlokas.5:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
bahUni me vyatItAni janmAni tava chArjuna |
tAnyahaM veda sarvANi na tvaM vettha parantapa
shlokas.6:
ajo.api sannavyayAtmA bhUtAnAmIshvaro.api san |
prakRRitiM svAmadhiShThAya sambhavAmyAtmamAyayA
shlokas.7:
yadA yadA hi dharmasya glAnirbhavati bhArata |
abhyutthAnamadharmasya tadAtmAnaM sRRijAmyaham
shlokas.8:
paritrANAya sAdhUnAM vinAshAya cha duShkRRitAm |
dharmasa.nsthApanArthAya sambhavAmi yuge yuge
shlokas.9:
janma karma cha me divyamevaM yo vetti tattvataH |
tyaktvA dehaM punarjanma naiti mAmeti so.arjuna
shlokas.10:
vItarAgabhayakrodhA manmayA mAmupAshritAH |
bahavo j~nAnatapasA pUtA madbhAvamAgatAH
shlokas.11:
ye yathA mAM prapadyante tA.nstathaiva bhajAmyaham |
mama vartmAnuvartante manuShyAH pArtha sarvashaH
shlokas.12:
kA~NkShantaH karmaNAM siddhiM yajanta iha devatAH |
kShipraM hi mAnuShe loke siddhirbhavati karmajA
shlokas.13:
chAturvarNyaM mayA sRRiShTaM guNakarmavibhAgashaH |
tasya kartAramapi mAM viddhyakartAramavyayam
shlokas.14:
na mAM karmANi limpanti na me karmaphale spRRihA |
iti mAM yo.abhijAnAti karmabhirna sa badhyate
shlokas.15:
evaM j~nAtvA kRRitaM karma pUrvairapi mumukShubhiH |
kuru karmaiva tasmAttvaM pUrvaiH pUrvataraM kRRitam
shlokas.16:
kiM karma kimakarmeti kavayo.apyatra mohitAH |
tatte karma pravakShyAmi yajj~nAtvA mokShyase.ashubhAt
shlokas.17:
karmaNo hyapi boddhavyaM boddhavyaM cha vikarmaNaH |
akarmaNashcha boddhavyaM gahanA karmaNo gatiH
shlokas.18:
karmaNyakarma yaH pashyedakarmaNi cha karma yaH |
sa buddhimAnmanuShyeShu sa yuktaH kRRitsnakarmakRRit
shlokas.19:
yasya sarve samArambhAH kAmasa~NkalpavarjitAH |
j~nAnAgnidagdhakarmANaM tamAhuH paNDitaM budhAH
shlokas.20:
tyaktvA karmaphalAsa~NgaM nityatRRipto nirAshrayaH |
karmaNyabhipravRRitto.api naiva ki~nchitkaroti saH
shlokas.21:
nirAshIryatachittAtmA tyaktasarvaparigrahaH |
shArIraM kevalaM karma kurvannApnoti kilbiSham
shlokas.22:
yadRRichChAlAbhasantuShTo dva.ndvAtIto vimatsaraH |
samaH siddhAvasiddhau cha kRRitvApi na nibadhyate
shlokas.23:
gatasa~Ngasya muktasya j~nAnAvasthitachetasaH |
yaj~nAyAcharataH karma samagraM pravilIyate
shlokas.24:
brahmArpaNaM brahmahavirbrahmAgnau brahmaNA hutam |
brahmaiva tena gantavyaM brahmakarmasamAdhinA
shlokas.25:
daivamevApare yaj~naM yoginaH paryupAsate |
brahmAgnAvapare yaj~naM yaj~nenaivopajuhvati
shlokas.26:
shrotrAdInIndriyANyanye sa.nyamAgniShu juhvati |
shabdAdInviShayAnanya indriyAgniShu juhvati
shlokas.27:
sarvANIndriyakarmANi prANakarmANi chApare |
Atmasa.nyamayogAgnau juhvati j~nAnadIpite
shlokas.28:
dravyayaj~nAstapoyaj~nA yogayaj~nAstathApare |
svAdhyAyaj~nAnayaj~nAshcha yatayaH sa.nshitavratAH
shlokas.29:
apAne juhvati prANaM prANe.apAnaM tathApare |
prANApAnagatI ruddhvA prANAyAmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.30:
apare niyatAhArAH prANAnprANeShu juhvati |
sarve.apyete yaj~navido yaj~nakShapitakalmaShAH
shlokas.31:
yaj~nashiShTAmRRitabhujo yAnti brahma sanAtanam |
nAyaM loko.astyayaj~nasya kuto.anyaH kurusattama
shlokas.32:
evaM bahuvidhA yaj~nA vitatA brahmaNo mukhe |
karmajAnviddhi tAnsarvAnevaM j~nAtvA vimokShyase
shlokas.33:
shreyAndravyamayAdyaj~nAjj~nAnayaj~naH parantapa |
sarvaM karmAkhilaM pArtha j~nAne parisamApyate
shlokas.34:
tadviddhi praNipAtena pariprashnena sevayA |
upadekShyanti te j~nAnaM j~nAninastattvadarshinaH
shlokas.35:
yajj~nAtvA na punarmohamevaM yAsyasi pANDava |
yena bhUtAnyasheSheNa drakShyasyAtmanyatho mayi
shlokas.36:
api chedasi pApebhyaH sarvebhyaH pApakRRittamaH |
sarvaM j~nAnaplavenaiva vRRijinaM santariShyasi
shlokas.37:
yathaidhA.nsi samiddho.agnirbhasmasAtkurute.arjuna |
j~nAnAgniH sarvakarmANi bhasmasAtkurute tathA
shlokas.38:
na hi j~nAnena sadRRishaM pavitramiha vidyate |
tatsvayaM yogasa.nsiddhaH kAlenAtmani vindati
shlokas.39:
shraddhAvA.Nllabhate j~nAnaM tatparaH sa.nyatendriyaH |
j~nAnaM labdhvA parAM shAntimachireNAdhigachChati
shlokas.40:
aj~nashchAshraddadhAnashcha sa.nshayAtmA vinashyati |
nAyaM loko.asti na paro na sukhaM sa.nshayAtmanaH
shlokas.41:
yogasaMnyastakarmANaM j~nAnasa~nChinnasa.nshayam |
AtmavantaM na karmANi nibadhnanti dhana~njaya
shlokas.42:
tasmAdaj~nAnasambhUtaM hRRitsthaM j~nAnAsinAtmanaH |
ChittvainaM sa.nshayaM yogamAtiShThottiShTha bhArata

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
saMnyAsaM karmaNAM kRRiShNa punaryogaM cha sha.nsasi |
yachChreya etayorekaM tanme brUhi sunishchitam
shlokas.2:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
saMnyAsaH karmayogashcha niHshreyasakarAvubhau |
tayostu karmasaMnyAsAtkarmayogo vishiShyate
shlokas.3:
j~neyaH sa nityasaMnyAsI yo na dveShTi na kA~NkShati |
nirdva.ndvo hi mahAbAho sukhaM bandhAtpramuchyate
shlokas.4:
sA~Nkhyayogau pRRithagbAlAH pravadanti na paNDitAH |
ekamapyAsthitaH samyagubhayorvindate phalam
shlokas.5:
yatsA~NkhyaiH prApyate sthAnaM tadyogairapi gamyate |
ekaM sA~NkhyaM cha yogaM cha yaH pashyati sa pashyati
shlokas.6:
saMnyAsastu mahAbAho duHkhamAptumayogataH |
yogayukto munirbrahma nachireNAdhigachChati
shlokas.7:
yogayukto vishuddhAtmA vijitAtmA jitendriyaH |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtAtmA kurvannapi na lipyate
shlokas.8:
naiva ki~nchitkaromIti yukto manyeta tattvavit |
pashya~nshRRiNvanspRRisha~njighrannashnangachChansvapa~nshvasan
shlokas.9:
pralapanvisRRijangRRihNannunmiShannimiShannapi |
indriyANIndriyArtheShu vartanta iti dhArayan
shlokas.10:
brahmaNyAdhAya karmANi sa~NgaM tyaktvA karoti yaH |
lipyate na sa pApena padmapatramivAmbhasA
shlokas.11:
kAyena manasA buddhyA kevalairindriyairapi |
yoginaH karma kurvanti sa~NgaM tyaktvAtmashuddhaye
shlokas.12:
yuktaH karmaphalaM tyaktvA shAntimApnoti naiShThikIm |
ayuktaH kAmakAreNa phale sakto nibadhyate
shlokas.13:
sarvakarmANi manasA saMnyasyAste sukhaM vashI |
navadvAre pure dehI naiva kurvanna kArayan
shlokas.14:
na kartRRitvaM na karmANi lokasya sRRijati prabhuH |
na karmaphalasa.nyogaM svabhAvastu pravartate
shlokas.15:
nAdatte kasyachitpApaM na chaiva sukRRitaM vibhuH |
aj~nAnenAvRRitaM j~nAnaM tena muhyanti jantavaH
shlokas.16:
j~nAnena tu tadaj~nAnaM yeShAM nAshitamAtmanaH |
teShAmAdityavajj~nAnaM prakAshayati tatparam
shlokas.17:
tadbuddhayastadAtmAnastanniShThAstatparAyaNAH |
gachChantyapunarAvRRittiM j~nAnanirdhUtakalmaShAH
shlokas.18:
vidyAvinayasampanne brAhmaNe gavi hastini |
shuni chaiva shvapAke cha paNDitAH samadarshinaH
shlokas.19:
ihaiva tairjitaH sargo yeShAM sAmye sthitaM manaH |
nirdoShaM hi samaM brahma tasmAdbrahmaNi te sthitAH
shlokas.20:
na prahRRiShyetpriyaM prApya nodvijetprApya chApriyam |
sthirabuddhirasaMmUDho brahmavidbrahmaNi sthitaH
shlokas.21:
bAhyasparsheShvasaktAtmA vindatyAtmani yatsukham |
sa brahmayogayuktAtmA sukhamakShayamashnute
shlokas.22:
ye hi sa.nsparshajA bhogA duHkhayonaya eva te |
AdyantavantaH kaunteya na teShu ramate budhaH
shlokas.23:
shaknotIhaiva yaH soDhuM prAkSharIravimokShaNAt |
kAmakrodhodbhavaM vegaM sa yuktaH sa sukhI naraH
shlokas.24:
yo.antaHsukho.antarArAmastathAntarjyotireva yaH |
sa yogI brahmanirvANaM brahmabhUto.adhigachChati
shlokas.25:
labhante brahmanirvANamRRiShayaH kShINakalmaShAH |
ChinnadvaidhA yatAtmAnaH sarvabhUtahite ratAH
shlokas.26:
kAmakrodhaviyuktAnAM yatInAM yatachetasAm |
abhito brahmanirvANaM vartate viditAtmanAm
shlokas.27:
sparshAnkRRitvA bahirbAhyA.nshchakShushchaivAntare bhruvoH |
prANApAnau samau kRRitvA nAsAbhyantarachAriNau
shlokas.28:
yatendriyamanobuddhirmunirmokShaparAyaNaH |
vigatechChAbhayakrodho yaH sadA mukta eva saH
shlokas.29:
bhoktAraM yaj~natapasAM sarvalokamaheshvaram |
suhRRidaM sarvabhUtAnAM j~nAtvA mAM shAntimRRichChati

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
anAshritaH karmaphalaM kAryaM karma karoti yaH |
sa saMnyAsI cha yogI cha na niragnirna chAkriyaH
shlokas.2:
yaM saMnyAsamiti prAhuryogaM taM viddhi pANDava |
na hyasaMnyastasa~Nkalpo yogI bhavati kashchana
shlokas.3:
ArurukShormuneryogaM karma kAraNamuchyate |
yogArUDhasya tasyaiva shamaH kAraNamuchyate
shlokas.4:
yadA hi nendriyArtheShu na karmasvanuShajjate |
sarvasa~NkalpasaMnyAsI yogArUDhastadochyate
shlokas.5:
uddharedAtmanAtmAnaM nAtmAnamavasAdayet |
Atmaiva hyAtmano bandhurAtmaiva ripurAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
bandhurAtmAtmanastasya yenAtmaivAtmanA jitaH |
anAtmanastu shatrutve vartetAtmaiva shatruvat
shlokas.7:
jitAtmanaH prashAntasya paramAtmA samAhitaH |
shItoShNasukhaduHkheShu tathA mAnAvamAnayoH
shlokas.8:
j~nAnavij~nAnatRRiptAtmA kUTastho vijitendriyaH |
yukta ityuchyate yogI samaloShTAshmakA~nchanaH
shlokas.9:
suhRRinmitrAryudAsInamadhyasthadveShyabandhuShu |
sAdhuShvapi cha pApeShu samabuddhirvishiShyate
shlokas.10:
yogI yu~njIta satatamAtmAnaM rahasi sthitaH |
ekAkI yatachittAtmA nirAshIraparigrahaH
shlokas.11:
shuchau deshe pratiShThApya sthiramAsanamAtmanaH |
nAtyuchChritaM nAtinIchaM chailAjinakushottaram
shlokas.12:
tatraikAgraM manaH kRRitvA yatachittendriyakriyaH |
upavishyAsane yu~njyAdyogamAtmavishuddhaye
shlokas.13:
samaM kAyashirogrIvaM dhArayannachalaM sthiraH |
samprekShya nAsikAgraM svaM dishashchAnavalokayan
shlokas.14:
prashAntAtmA vigatabhIrbrahmachArivrate sthitaH |
manaH sa.nyamya machchitto yukta AsIta matparaH
shlokas.15:
yu~njannevaM sadAtmAnaM yogI niyatamAnasaH |
shAntiM nirvANaparamAM matsa.nsthAmadhigachChati
shlokas.16:
nAtyashnatastu yogo.asti na chaikAntamanashnataH |
na chAtisvapnashIlasya jAgrato naiva chArjuna
shlokas.17:
yuktAhAravihArasya yuktacheShTasya karmasu |
yuktasvapnAvabodhasya yogo bhavati duHkhahA
shlokas.18:
yadA viniyataM chittamAtmanyevAvatiShThate |
niHspRRihaH sarvakAmebhyo yukta ityuchyate tadA
shlokas.19:
yathA dIpo nivAtastho ne~Ngate sopamA smRRitA |
yogino yatachittasya yu~njato yogamAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
yatroparamate chittaM niruddhaM yogasevayA |
yatra chaivAtmanAtmAnaM pashyannAtmani tuShyati
shlokas.21:
sukhamAtyantikaM yattadbuddhigrAhyamatIndriyam |
vetti yatra na chaivAyaM sthitashchalati tattvataH
shlokas.22:
yaM labdhvA chAparaM lAbhaM manyate nAdhikaM tataH |
yasminsthito na duHkhena guruNApi vichAlyate
shlokas.23:
taM vidyAdduHkhasa.nyogaviyogaM yogasa~nj~nitam |
sa nishchayena yoktavyo yogo.anirviNNachetasA
shlokas.24:
sa~NkalpaprabhavAnkAmA.nstyaktvA sarvAnasheShataH |
manasaivendriyagrAmaM viniyamya samantataH
shlokas.25:
shanaiH shanairuparamedbuddhyA dhRRitigRRihItayA |
Atmasa.nsthaM manaH kRRitvA na ki~nchidapi chintayet
shlokas.26:
yato yato nishcharati manashcha~nchalamasthiram |
tatastato niyamyaitadAtmanyeva vashaM nayet
shlokas.27:
prashAntamanasaM hyenaM yoginaM sukhamuttamam |
upaiti shAntarajasaM brahmabhUtamakalmaSham
shlokas.28:
yu~njannevaM sadAtmAnaM yogI vigatakalmaShaH |
sukhena brahmasa.nsparshamatyantaM sukhamashnute
shlokas.29:
sarvabhUtasthamAtmAnaM sarvabhUtAni chAtmani |
IkShate yogayuktAtmA sarvatra samadarshanaH
shlokas.30:
yo mAM pashyati sarvatra sarvaM cha mayi pashyati |
tasyAhaM na praNashyAmi sa cha me na praNashyati
shlokas.31:
sarvabhUtasthitaM yo mAM bhajatyekatvamAsthitaH |
sarvathA vartamAno.api sa yogI mayi vartate
shlokas.32:
Atmaupamyena sarvatra samaM pashyati yo.arjuna |
sukhaM vA yadi vA duHkhaM sa yogI paramo mataH
shlokas.33:
arjuna uvAcha||
yo.ayaM yogastvayA proktaH sAmyena madhusUdana |
etasyAhaM na pashyAmi cha~nchalatvAtsthitiM sthirAm
shlokas.34:
cha~nchalaM hi manaH kRRiShNa pramAthi balavaddRRiDham |
tasyAhaM nigrahaM manye vAyoriva suduShkaram
shlokas.35:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
asa.nshayaM mahAbAho mano durnigrahaM chalam |
abhyAsena tu kaunteya vairAgyeNa cha gRRihyate
shlokas.36:
asa.nyatAtmanA yogo duShprApa iti me matiH |
vashyAtmanA tu yatatA shakyo.avAptumupAyataH
shlokas.37:
arjuna uvAcha||
ayatiH shraddhayopeto yogAchchalitamAnasaH |
aprApya yogasa.nsiddhiM kAM gatiM kRRiShNa gachChati
shlokas.38:
kachchinnobhayavibhraShTashChinnAbhramiva nashyati |
apratiShTho mahAbAho vimUDho brahmaNaH pathi
shlokas.39:
etanme sa.nshayaM kRRiShNa ChettumarhasyasheShataH |
tvadanyaH sa.nshayasyAsya ChettA na hyupapadyate
shlokas.40:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
pArtha naiveha nAmutra vinAshastasya vidyate |
na hi kalyANakRRitkashchiddurgatiM tAta gachChati
shlokas.41:
prApya puNyakRRitA.NllokAnuShitvA shAshvatIH samAH |
shuchInAM shrImatAM gehe yogabhraShTo.abhijAyate
shlokas.42:
atha vA yoginAmeva kule bhavati dhImatAm |
etaddhi durlabhataraM loke janma yadIdRRisham
shlokas.43:
tatra taM buddhisa.nyogaM labhate paurvadehikam |
yatate cha tato bhUyaH sa.nsiddhau kurunandana
shlokas.44:
pUrvAbhyAsena tenaiva hriyate hyavasho.api saH |
jij~nAsurapi yogasya shabdabrahmAtivartate
shlokas.45:
prayatnAdyatamAnastu yogI sa.nshuddhakilbiShaH |
anekajanmasa.nsiddhastato yAti parAM gatim
shlokas.46:
tapasvibhyo.adhiko yogI j~nAnibhyo.api mato.adhikaH |
karmibhyashchAdhiko yogI tasmAdyogI bhavArjuna
shlokas.47:
yoginAmapi sarveShAM madgatenAntarAtmanA |
shraddhAvAnbhajate yo mAM sa me yuktatamo mataH

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
mayyAsaktamanAH pArtha yogaM yu~njanmadAshrayaH |
asa.nshayaM samagraM mAM yathA j~nAsyasi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.2:
j~nAnaM te.ahaM savij~nAnamidaM vakShyAmyasheShataH |
yajj~nAtvA neha bhUyo.anyajj~nAtavyamavashiShyate
shlokas.3:
manuShyANAM sahasreShu kashchidyatati siddhaye |
yatatAmapi siddhAnAM kashchinmAM vetti tattvataH
shlokas.4:
bhUmirApo.analo vAyuH khaM mano buddhireva cha |
aha~NkAra itIyaM me bhinnA prakRRitiraShTadhA
shlokas.5:
apareyamitastvanyAM prakRRitiM viddhi me parAm |
jIvabhUtAM mahAbAho yayedaM dhAryate jagat
shlokas.6:
etadyonIni bhUtAni sarvANItyupadhAraya |
ahaM kRRitsnasya jagataH prabhavaH pralayastathA
shlokas.7:
mattaH parataraM nAnyatki~nchidasti dhana~njaya |
mayi sarvamidaM protaM sUtre maNigaNA iva
shlokas.8:
raso.ahamapsu kaunteya prabhAsmi shashisUryayoH |
praNavaH sarvavedeShu shabdaH khe pauruShaM nRRiShu
shlokas.9:
puNyo gandhaH pRRithivyAM cha tejashchAsmi vibhAvasau |
jIvanaM sarvabhUteShu tapashchAsmi tapasviShu
shlokas.10:
bIjaM mAM sarvabhUtAnAM viddhi pArtha sanAtanam |
buddhirbuddhimatAmasmi tejastejasvinAmaham
shlokas.11:
balaM balavatAM chAhaM kAmarAgavivarjitam |
dharmAviruddho bhUteShu kAmo.asmi bharatarShabha
shlokas.12:
ye chaiva sAttvikA bhAvA rAjasAstAmasAshcha ye |
matta eveti tAnviddhi na tvahaM teShu te mayi
shlokas.13:
tribhirguNamayairbhAvairebhiH sarvamidaM jagat |
mohitaM nAbhijAnAti mAmebhyaH paramavyayam
shlokas.14:
daivI hyeShA guNamayI mama mAyA duratyayA |
mAmeva ye prapadyante mAyAmetAM taranti te
shlokas.15:
na mAM duShkRRitino mUDhAH prapadyante narAdhamAH |
mAyayApahRRitaj~nAnA AsuraM bhAvamAshritAH
shlokas.16:
chaturvidhA bhajante mAM janAH sukRRitino.arjuna |
Arto jij~nAsurarthArthI j~nAnI cha bharatarShabha
shlokas.17:
teShAM j~nAnI nityayukta ekabhaktirvishiShyate |
priyo hi j~nAnino.atyarthamahaM sa cha mama priyaH
shlokas.18:
udArAH sarva evaite j~nAnI tvAtmaiva me matam |
AsthitaH sa hi yuktAtmA mAmevAnuttamAM gatim
shlokas.19:
bahUnAM janmanAmante j~nAnavAnmAM prapadyate |
vAsudevaH sarvamiti sa mahAtmA sudurlabhaH
shlokas.20:
kAmaistaistairhRRitaj~nAnAH prapadyante.anyadevatAH |
taM taM niyamamAsthAya prakRRityA niyatAH svayA
shlokas.21:
yo yo yAM yAM tanuM bhaktaH shraddhayArchitumichChati |
tasya tasyAchalAM shraddhAM tAmeva vidadhAmyaham
shlokas.22:
sa tayA shraddhayA yuktastasyA rAdhanamIhate |
labhate cha tataH kAmAnmayaiva vihitAnhi tAn
shlokas.23:
antavattu phalaM teShAM tadbhavatyalpamedhasAm |
devAndevayajo yAnti madbhaktA yAnti mAmapi
shlokas.24:
avyaktaM vyaktimApannaM manyante mAmabuddhayaH |
paraM bhAvamajAnanto mamAvyayamanuttamam
shlokas.25:
nAhaM prakAshaH sarvasya yogamAyAsamAvRRitaH |
mUDho.ayaM nAbhijAnAti loko mAmajamavyayam
shlokas.26:
vedAhaM samatItAni vartamAnAni chArjuna |
bhaviShyANi cha bhUtAni mAM tu veda na kashchana
shlokas.27:
ichChAdveShasamutthena dva.ndvamohena bhArata |
sarvabhUtAni saMmohaM sarge yAnti parantapa
shlokas.28:
yeShAM tvantagataM pApaM janAnAM puNyakarmaNAm |
te dva.ndvamohanirmuktA bhajante mAM dRRiDhavratAH
shlokas.29:
jarAmaraNamokShAya mAmAshritya yatanti ye |
te brahma tadviduH kRRitsnamadhyAtmaM karma chAkhilam
shlokas.30:
sAdhibhUtAdhidaivaM mAM sAdhiyaj~naM cha ye viduH |
prayANakAle.api cha mAM te viduryuktachetasaH

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
kiM tadbrahma kimadhyAtmaM kiM karma puruShottama |
adhibhUtaM cha kiM proktamadhidaivaM kimuchyate
shlokas.2:
adhiyaj~naH kathaM ko.atra dehe.asminmadhusUdana |
prayANakAle cha kathaM j~neyo.asi niyatAtmabhiH
shlokas.3:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
akSharaM brahma paramaM svabhAvo.adhyAtmamuchyate |
bhUtabhAvodbhavakaro visargaH karmasa~nj~nitaH
shlokas.4:
adhibhUtaM kSharo bhAvaH puruShashchAdhidaivatam |
adhiyaj~no.ahamevAtra dehe dehabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.5:
antakAle cha mAmeva smaranmuktvA kalevaram |
yaH prayAti sa madbhAvaM yAti nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.6:
yaM yaM vApi smaranbhAvaM tyajatyante kalevaram |
taM tamevaiti kaunteya sadA tadbhAvabhAvitaH
shlokas.7:
tasmAtsarveShu kAleShu mAmanusmara yudhya cha |
mayyarpitamanobuddhirmAmevaiShyasyasa.nshayaH
shlokas.8:
abhyAsayogayuktena chetasA nAnyagAminA |
paramaM puruShaM divyaM yAti pArthAnuchintayan
shlokas.9:
kaviM purANamanushAsitAra;maNoraNIyA.nsamanusmaredyaH |
sarvasya dhAtAramachintyarUpa;mAdityavarNaM tamasaH parastAt
shlokas.10:
prayANakAle manasAchalena; bhaktyA yukto yogabalena chaiva |
bhruvormadhye prANamAveshya samya;ksa taM paraM puruShamupaiti divyam
shlokas.11:
yadakSharaM vedavido vadanti; vishanti yadyatayo vItarAgAH |
yadichChanto brahmacharyaM charanti; tatte padaM sa~NgraheNa pravakShye
shlokas.12:
sarvadvArANi sa.nyamya mano hRRidi nirudhya cha |
mUrdhnyAdhAyAtmanaH prANamAsthito yogadhAraNAm
shlokas.13:
omityekAkSharaM brahma vyAharanmAmanusmaran |
yaH prayAti tyajandehaM sa yAti paramAM gatim
shlokas.14:
ananyachetAH satataM yo mAM smarati nityashaH |
tasyAhaM sulabhaH pArtha nityayuktasya yoginaH
shlokas.15:
mAmupetya punarjanma duHkhAlayamashAshvatam |
nApnuvanti mahAtmAnaH sa.nsiddhiM paramAM gatAH
shlokas.16:
A brahmabhuvanAllokAH punarAvartino.arjuna |
mAmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate
shlokas.17:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaNo viduH |
rAtriM yugasahasrAntAM te.ahorAtravido janAH
shlokas.18:
avyaktAdvyaktayaH sarvAH prabhavantyaharAgame |
rAtryAgame pralIyante tatraivAvyaktasa~nj~nake
shlokas.19:
bhUtagrAmaH sa evAyaM bhUtvA bhUtvA pralIyate |
rAtryAgame.avashaH pArtha prabhavatyaharAgame
shlokas.20:
parastasmAttu bhAvo.anyo.avyakto.avyaktAtsanAtanaH |
yaH sa sarveShu bhUteShu nashyatsu na vinashyati
shlokas.21:
avyakto.akShara ityuktastamAhuH paramAM gatim |
yaM prApya na nivartante taddhAma paramaM mama
shlokas.22:
puruShaH sa paraH pArtha bhaktyA labhyastvananyayA |
yasyAntaHsthAni bhUtAni yena sarvamidaM tatam
shlokas.23:
yatra kAle tvanAvRRittimAvRRittiM chaiva yoginaH |
prayAtA yAnti taM kAlaM vakShyAmi bharatarShabha
shlokas.24:
agnirjyotirahaH shuklaH ShaNmAsA uttarAyaNam |
tatra prayAtA gachChanti brahma brahmavido janAH
shlokas.25:
dhUmo rAtristathA kRRiShNaH ShaNmAsA dakShiNAyanam |
tatra chAndramasaM jyotiryogI prApya nivartate
shlokas.26:
shuklakRRiShNe gatI hyete jagataH shAshvate mate |
ekayA yAtyanAvRRittimanyayAvartate punaH
shlokas.27:
naite sRRitI pArtha jAnanyogI muhyati kashchana |
tasmAtsarveShu kAleShu yogayukto bhavArjuna
shlokas.28:
vedeShu yaj~neShu tapaHsu chaiva; dAneShu yatpuNyaphalaM pradiShTam |
atyeti tatsarvamidaM viditvA; yogI paraM sthAnamupaiti chAdyam

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
idaM tu te guhyatamaM pravakShyAmyanasUyave |
j~nAnaM vij~nAnasahitaM yajj~nAtvA mokShyase.ashubhAt
shlokas.2:
rAjavidyA rAjaguhyaM pavitramidamuttamam |
pratyakShAvagamaM dharmyaM susukhaM kartumavyayam
shlokas.3:
ashraddadhAnAH puruShA dharmasyAsya parantapa |
aprApya mAM nivartante mRRityusa.nsAravartmani
shlokas.4:
mayA tatamidaM sarvaM jagadavyaktamUrtinA |
matsthAni sarvabhUtAni na chAhaM teShvavasthitaH
shlokas.5:
na cha matsthAni bhUtAni pashya me yogamaishvaram |
bhUtabhRRinna cha bhUtastho mamAtmA bhUtabhAvanaH
shlokas.6:
yathAkAshasthito nityaM vAyuH sarvatrago mahAn |
tathA sarvANi bhUtAni matsthAnItyupadhAraya
shlokas.7:
sarvabhUtAni kaunteya prakRRitiM yAnti mAmikAm |
kalpakShaye punastAni kalpAdau visRRijAmyaham
shlokas.8:
prakRRitiM svAmavaShTabhya visRRijAmi punaH punaH |
bhUtagrAmamimaM kRRitsnamavashaM prakRRitervashAt
shlokas.9:
na cha mAM tAni karmANi nibadhnanti dhana~njaya |
udAsInavadAsInamasaktaM teShu karmasu
shlokas.10:
mayAdhyakSheNa prakRRitiH sUyate sacharAcharam |
hetunAnena kaunteya jagadviparivartate
shlokas.11:
avajAnanti mAM mUDhA mAnuShIM tanumAshritam |
paraM bhAvamajAnanto mama bhUtamaheshvaram
shlokas.12:
moghAshA moghakarmANo moghaj~nAnA vichetasaH |
rAkShasImAsurIM chaiva prakRRitiM mohinIM shritAH
shlokas.13:
mahAtmAnastu mAM pArtha daivIM prakRRitimAshritAH |
bhajantyananyamanaso j~nAtvA bhUtAdimavyayam
shlokas.14:
satataM kIrtayanto mAM yatantashcha dRRiDhavratAH |
namasyantashcha mAM bhaktyA nityayuktA upAsate
shlokas.15:
j~nAnayaj~nena chApyanye yajanto mAmupAsate |
ekatvena pRRithaktvena bahudhA vishvatomukham
shlokas.16:
ahaM kraturahaM yaj~naH svadhAhamahamauShadham |
mantro.ahamahamevAjyamahamagnirahaM hutam
shlokas.17:
pitAhamasya jagato mAtA dhAtA pitAmahaH |
vedyaM pavitramo~NkAra RRiksAma yajureva cha
shlokas.18:
gatirbhartA prabhuH sAkShI nivAsaH sharaNaM suhRRit |
prabhavaH pralayaH sthAnaM nidhAnaM bIjamavyayam
shlokas.19:
tapAmyahamahaM varShaM nigRRihNAmyutsRRijAmi cha |
amRRitaM chaiva mRRityushcha sadasachchAhamarjuna
shlokas.20:
traividyA mAM somapAH pUtapApA; yaj~nairiShTvA svargatiM prArthayante |
te puNyamAsAdya surendraloka;mashnanti divyAndivi devabhogAn
shlokas.21:
te taM bhuktvA svargalokaM vishAlaM; kShINe puNye martyalokaM vishanti |
evaM trayIdharmamanuprapannA; gatAgataM kAmakAmA labhante
shlokas.22:
ananyAshchintayanto mAM ye janAH paryupAsate |
teShAM nityAbhiyuktAnAM yogakShemaM vahAmyaham
shlokas.23:
ye.apyanyadevatA bhaktA yajante shraddhayAnvitAH |
te.api mAmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipUrvakam
shlokas.24:
ahaM hi sarvayaj~nAnAM bhoktA cha prabhureva cha |
na tu mAmabhijAnanti tattvenAtashchyavanti te
shlokas.25:
yAnti devavratA devAnpitR^InyAnti pitRRivratAH |
bhUtAni yAnti bhUtejyA yAnti madyAjino.api mAm
shlokas.26:
patraM puShpaM phalaM toyaM yo me bhaktyA prayachChati |
tadahaM bhaktyupahRRitamashnAmi prayatAtmanaH
shlokas.27:
yatkaroShi yadashnAsi yajjuhoShi dadAsi yat |
yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruShva madarpaNam
shlokas.28:
shubhAshubhaphalairevaM mokShyase karmabandhanaiH |
saMnyAsayogayuktAtmA vimukto mAmupaiShyasi
shlokas.29:
samo.ahaM sarvabhUteShu na me dveShyo.asti na priyaH |
ye bhajanti tu mAM bhaktyA mayi te teShu chApyaham
shlokas.30:
api chetsudurAchAro bhajate mAmananyabhAk |
sAdhureva sa mantavyaH samyagvyavasito hi saH
shlokas.31:
kShipraM bhavati dharmAtmA shashvachChAntiM nigachChati |
kaunteya pratijAnIhi na me bhaktaH praNashyati
shlokas.32:
mAM hi pArtha vyapAshritya ye.api syuH pApayonayaH |
striyo vaishyAstathA shUdrAste.api yAnti parAM gatim
shlokas.33:
kiM punarbrAhmaNAH puNyA bhaktA rAjarShayastathA |
anityamasukhaM lokamimaM prApya bhajasva mAm
shlokas.34:
manmanA bhava madbhakto madyAjI mAM namaskuru |
mAmevaiShyasi yuktvaivamAtmAnaM matparAyaNaH

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
bhUya eva mahAbAho shRRiNu me paramaM vachaH |
yatte.ahaM prIyamANAya vakShyAmi hitakAmyayA
shlokas.2:
na me viduH suragaNAH prabhavaM na maharShayaH |
ahamAdirhi devAnAM maharShINAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.3:
yo mAmajamanAdiM cha vetti lokamaheshvaram |
asaMmUDhaH sa martyeShu sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.4:
buddhirj~nAnamasaMmohaH kShamA satyaM damaH shamaH |
sukhaM duHkhaM bhavo.abhAvo bhayaM chAbhayameva cha
shlokas.5:
ahi.nsA samatA tuShTistapo dAnaM yasho.ayashaH |
bhavanti bhAvA bhUtAnAM matta eva pRRithagvidhAH
shlokas.6:
maharShayaH sapta pUrve chatvAro manavastathA |
madbhAvA mAnasA jAtA yeShAM loka imAH prajAH
shlokas.7:
etAM vibhUtiM yogaM cha mama yo vetti tattvataH |
so.avikampena yogena yujyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.8:
ahaM sarvasya prabhavo mattaH sarvaM pravartate |
iti matvA bhajante mAM budhA bhAvasamanvitAH
shlokas.9:
machchittA madgataprANA bodhayantaH parasparam |
kathayantashcha mAM nityaM tuShyanti cha ramanti cha
shlokas.10:
teShAM satatayuktAnAM bhajatAM prItipUrvakam |
dadAmi buddhiyogaM taM yena mAmupayAnti te
shlokas.11:
teShAmevAnukampArthamahamaj~nAnajaM tamaH |
nAshayAmyAtmabhAvastho j~nAnadIpena bhAsvatA
shlokas.12:
arjuna uvAcha||
paraM brahma paraM dhAma pavitraM paramaM bhavAn |
puruShaM shAshvataM divyamAdidevamajaM vibhum
shlokas.13:
AhustvAmRRiShayaH sarve devarShirnAradastathA |
asito devalo vyAsaH svayaM chaiva bravIShi me
shlokas.14:
sarvametadRRitaM manye yanmAM vadasi keshava |
na hi te bhagavanvyaktiM vidurdevA na dAnavAH
shlokas.15:
svayamevAtmanAtmAnaM vettha tvaM puruShottama |
bhUtabhAvana bhUtesha devadeva jagatpate
shlokas.16:
vaktumarhasyasheSheNa divyA hyAtmavibhUtayaH |
yAbhirvibhUtibhirlokAnimA.nstvaM vyApya tiShThasi
shlokas.17:
kathaM vidyAmahaM yogi.nstvAM sadA parichintayan |
keShu keShu cha bhAveShu chintyo.asi bhagavanmayA
shlokas.18:
vistareNAtmano yogaM vibhUtiM cha janArdana |
bhUyaH kathaya tRRiptirhi shRRiNvato nAsti me.amRRitam
shlokas.19:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi divyA hyAtmavibhUtayaH |
prAdhAnyataH kurushreShTha nAstyanto vistarasya me
shlokas.20:
ahamAtmA guDAkesha sarvabhUtAshayasthitaH |
ahamAdishcha madhyaM cha bhUtAnAmanta eva cha
shlokas.21:
AdityAnAmahaM viShNurjyotiShAM ravira.nshumAn |
marIchirmarutAmasmi nakShatrANAmahaM shashI
shlokas.22:
vedAnAM sAmavedo.asmi devAnAmasmi vAsavaH |
indriyANAM manashchAsmi bhUtAnAmasmi chetanA
shlokas.23:
rudrANAM sha~NkarashchAsmi vittesho yakSharakShasAm |
vasUnAM pAvakashchAsmi meruH shikhariNAmaham
shlokas.24:
purodhasAM cha mukhyaM mAM viddhi pArtha bRRihaspatim |
senAnInAmahaM skandaH sarasAmasmi sAgaraH
shlokas.25:
maharShINAM bhRRigurahaM girAmasmyekamakSharam |
yaj~nAnAM japayaj~no.asmi sthAvarANAM himAlayaH
shlokas.26:
ashvatthaH sarvavRRikShANAM devarShINAM cha nAradaH |
gandharvANAM chitrarathaH siddhAnAM kapilo muniH
shlokas.27:
uchchaiHshravasamashvAnAM viddhi mAmamRRitodbhavam |
airAvataM gajendrANAM narANAM cha narAdhipam
shlokas.28:
AyudhAnAmahaM vajraM dhenUnAmasmi kAmadhuk |
prajanashchAsmi kandarpaH sarpANAmasmi vAsukiH
shlokas.29:
anantashchAsmi nAgAnAM varuNo yAdasAmaham |
pitR^INAmaryamA chAsmi yamaH sa.nyamatAmaham
shlokas.30:
prahlAdashchAsmi daityAnAM kAlaH kalayatAmaham |
mRRigANAM cha mRRigendro.ahaM vainateyashcha pakShiNAm
shlokas.31:
pavanaH pavatAmasmi rAmaH shastrabhRRitAmaham |
jhaShANAM makarashchAsmi srotasAmasmi jAhnavI
shlokas.32:
sargANAmAdirantashcha madhyaM chaivAhamarjuna |
adhyAtmavidyA vidyAnAM vAdaH pravadatAmaham
shlokas.33:
akSharANAmakAro.asmi dva.ndvaH sAmAsikasya cha |
ahamevAkShayaH kAlo dhAtAhaM vishvatomukhaH
shlokas.34:
mRRityuH sarvaharashchAhamudbhavashcha bhaviShyatAm |
kIrtiH shrIrvAkcha nArINAM smRRitirmedhA dhRRitiH kShamA
shlokas.35:
bRRihatsAma tathA sAmnAM gAyatrI ChandasAmaham |
mAsAnAM mArgashIrSho.ahamRRitUnAM kusumAkaraH
shlokas.36:
dyUtaM ChalayatAmasmi tejastejasvinAmaham |
jayo.asmi vyavasAyo.asmi sattvaM sattvavatAmaham
shlokas.37:
vRRiShNInAM vAsudevo.asmi pANDavAnAM dhana~njayaH |
munInAmapyahaM vyAsaH kavInAmushanA kaviH
shlokas.38:
daNDo damayatAmasmi nItirasmi jigIShatAm |
maunaM chaivAsmi guhyAnAM j~nAnaM j~nAnavatAmaham
shlokas.39:
yachchApi sarvabhUtAnAM bIjaM tadahamarjuna |
na tadasti vinA yatsyAnmayA bhUtaM charAcharam
shlokas.40:
nAnto.asti mama divyAnAM vibhUtInAM parantapa |
eSha tUddeshataH prokto vibhUtervistaro mayA
shlokas.41:
yadyadvibhUtimatsattvaM shrImadUrjitameva vA |
tattadevAvagachCha tvaM mama tejo.nshasambhavam
shlokas.42:
atha vA bahunaitena kiM j~nAtena tavArjuna |
viShTabhyAhamidaM kRRitsnamekA.nshena sthito jagat

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
madanugrahAya paramaM guhyamadhyAtmasa~nj~nitam |
yattvayoktaM vachastena moho.ayaM vigato mama
shlokas.2:
bhavApyayau hi bhUtAnAM shrutau vistarasho mayA |
tvattaH kamalapatrAkSha mAhAtmyamapi chAvyayam
shlokas.3:
evametadyathAttha tvamAtmAnaM parameshvara |
draShTumichChAmi te rUpamaishvaraM puruShottama
shlokas.4:
manyase yadi tachChakyaM mayA draShTumiti prabho |
yogeshvara tato me tvaM darshayAtmAnamavyayam
shlokas.5:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
pashya me pArtha rUpANi shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
nAnAvidhAni divyAni nAnAvarNAkRRitIni cha
shlokas.6:
pashyAdityAnvasUnrudrAnashvinau marutastathA |
bahUnyadRRiShTapUrvANi pashyAshcharyANi bhArata
shlokas.7:
ihaikasthaM jagatkRRitsnaM pashyAdya sacharAcharam |
mama dehe guDAkesha yachchAnyaddraShTumichChasi
shlokas.8:
na tu mAM shakyase draShTumanenaiva svachakShuShA |
divyaM dadAmi te chakShuH pashya me yogamaishvaram
shlokas.9:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA tato rAjanmahAyogeshvaro hariH |
darshayAmAsa pArthAya paramaM rUpamaishvaram
shlokas.10:
anekavaktranayanamanekAdbhutadarshanam |
anekadivyAbharaNaM divyAnekodyatAyudham
shlokas.11:
divyamAlyAmbaradharaM divyagandhAnulepanam |
sarvAshcharyamayaM devamanantaM vishvatomukham
shlokas.12:
divi sUryasahasrasya bhavedyugapadutthitA |
yadi bhAH sadRRishI sA syAdbhAsastasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
tatraikasthaM jagatkRRitsnaM pravibhaktamanekadhA |
apashyaddevadevasya sharIre pANDavastadA
shlokas.14:
tataH sa vismayAviShTo hRRiShTaromA dhana~njayaH |
praNamya shirasA devaM kRRitA~njalirabhAShata
shlokas.15:
arjuna uvAcha||
pashyAmi devA.nstava deva dehe; sarvA.nstathA bhUtavisheShasa~NghAn |
brahmANamIshaM kamalAsanastha;mRRiShI.nshcha sarvAnuragA.nshcha divyAn
shlokas.16:
anekabAhUdaravaktranetraM; pashyAmi tvA sarvato.anantarUpam |
nAntaM na madhyaM na punastavAdiM; pashyAmi vishveshvara vishvarUpa
shlokas.17:
kirITinaM gadinaM chakriNaM cha; tejorAshiM sarvato dIptimantam |
pashyAmi tvAM durnirIkShyaM samantA;ddIptAnalArkadyutimaprameyam
shlokas.18:
tvamakSharaM paramaM veditavyaM; tvamasya vishvasya paraM nidhAnam |
tvamavyayaH shAshvatadharmagoptA; sanAtanastvaM puruSho mato me
shlokas.19:
anAdimadhyAntamanantavIrya;manantabAhuM shashisUryanetram |
pashyAmi tvAM dIptahutAshavaktraM; svatejasA vishvamidaM tapantam
shlokas.20:
dyAvApRRithivyoridamantaraM hi; vyAptaM tvayaikena dishashcha sarvAH |
dRRiShTvAdbhutaM rUpamidaM tavograM; lokatrayaM pravyathitaM mahAtman
shlokas.21:
amI hi tvA surasa~NghA vishanti; kechidbhItAH prA~njalayo gRRiNanti |
svastItyuktvA maharShisiddhasa~NghAH; stuvanti tvAM stutibhiH puShkalAbhiH
shlokas.22:
rudrAdityA vasavo ye cha sAdhyA; vishve.ashvinau marutashchoShmapAshcha |
gandharvayakShAsurasiddhasa~NghA; vIkShante tvA vismitAshchaiva sarve
shlokas.23:
rUpaM mahatte bahuvaktranetraM; mahAbAho bahubAhUrupAdam |
bahUdaraM bahudaMShTrAkarAlaM; dRRiShTvA lokAH pravyathitAstathAham
shlokas.24:
nabhaHspRRishaM dIptamanekavarNaM; vyAttAnanaM dIptavishAlanetram |
dRRiShTvA hi tvAM pravyathitAntarAtmA; dhRRitiM na vindAmi shamaM cha viShNo
shlokas.25:
daMShTrAkarAlAni cha te mukhAni; dRRiShTvaiva kAlAnalasaMnibhAni |
disho na jAne na labhe cha sharma; prasIda devesha jagannivAsa
shlokas.26:
amI cha tvAM dhRRitarAShTrasya putrAH; sarve sahaivAvanipAlasa~NghaiH |
bhIShmo droNaH sUtaputrastathAsau; sahAsmadIyairapi yodhamukhyaiH
shlokas.27:
vaktrANi te tvaramANA vishanti; daMShTrAkarAlAni bhayAnakAni |
kechidvilagnA dashanAntareShu; sa.ndRRishyante chUrNitairuttamA~NgaiH
shlokas.28:
yathA nadInAM bahavo.ambuvegAH; samudramevAbhimukhA dravanti |
tathA tavAmI naralokavIrA; vishanti vaktrANyabhivijvalanti
shlokas.29:
yathA pradIptaM jvalanaM pata~NgA; vishanti nAshAya samRRiddhavegAH |
tathaiva nAshAya vishanti lokA;stavApi vaktrANi samRRiddhavegAH
shlokas.30:
lelihyase grasamAnaH samantA;llokAnsamagrAnvadanairjvaladbhiH |
tejobhirApUrya jagatsamagraM; bhAsastavogrAH pratapanti viShNo
shlokas.31:
AkhyAhi me ko bhavAnugrarUpo; namo.astu te devavara prasIda |
vij~nAtumichChAmi bhavantamAdyaM; na hi prajAnAmi tava pravRRittim
shlokas.32:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
kAlo.asmi lokakShayakRRitpravRRiddho; lokAnsamAhartumiha pravRRittaH |
RRite.api tvA na bhaviShyanti sarve; ye.avasthitAH pratyanIkeShu yodhAH
shlokas.33:
tasmAttvamuttiShTha yasho labhasva; jitvA shatrUnbhu~NkShva rAjyaM samRRiddham |
mayaivaite nihatAH pUrvameva; nimittamAtraM bhava savyasAchin
shlokas.34:
droNaM cha bhIShmaM cha jayadrathaM cha; karNaM tathAnyAnapi yodhavIrAn |
mayA hatA.nstvaM jahi mA vyathiShThA; yudhyasva jetAsi raNe sapatnAn
shlokas.35:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vachanaM keshavasya; kRRitA~njalirvepamAnaH kirITI |
namaskRRitvA bhUya evAha kRRiShNaM; sagadgadaM bhItabhItaH praNamya
shlokas.36:
arjuna uvAcha||
sthAne hRRiShIkesha tava prakIrtyA; jagatprahRRiShyatyanurajyate cha |
rakShA.nsi bhItAni disho dravanti; sarve namasyanti cha siddhasa~NghAH
shlokas.37:
kasmAchcha te na nameranmahAtma;ngarIyase brahmaNo.apyAdikartre |
ananta devesha jagannivAsa; tvamakSharaM sadasattatparaM yat
shlokas.38:
tvamAdidevaH puruShaH purANa;stvamasya vishvasya paraM nidhAnam |
vettAsi vedyaM cha paraM cha dhAma; tvayA tataM vishvamanantarUpa
shlokas.39:
vAyuryamo.agnirvaruNaH shashA~NkaH; prajApatistvaM prapitAmahashcha |
namo namaste.astu sahasrakRRitvaH; punashcha bhUyo.api namo namaste
shlokas.40:
namaH purastAdatha pRRiShThataste; namo.astu te sarvata eva sarva |
anantavIryAmitavikramastvaM; sarvaM samApnoShi tato.asi sarvaH
shlokas.41:
sakheti matvA prasabhaM yaduktaM; he kRRiShNa he yAdava he sakheti |
ajAnatA mahimAnaM tavedaM; mayA pramAdAtpraNayena vApi
shlokas.42:
yachchAvahAsArthamasatkRRito.asi; vihArashayyAsanabhojaneShu |
eko.atha vApyachyuta tatsamakShaM; tatkShAmaye tvAmahamaprameyam
shlokas.43:
pitAsi lokasya charAcharasya; tvamasya pUjyashcha gururgarIyAn |
na tvatsamo.astyabhyadhikaH kuto.anyo; lokatraye.apyapratimaprabhAva
shlokas.44:
tasmAtpraNamya praNidhAya kAyaM; prasAdaye tvAmahamIshamIDyam |
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuH; priyaH priyAyArhasi deva soDhum
shlokas.45:
adRRiShTapUrvaM hRRiShito.asmi dRRiShTvA; bhayena cha pravyathitaM mano me |
tadeva me darshaya deva rUpaM; prasIda devesha jagannivAsa
shlokas.46:
kirITinaM gadinaM chakrahasta;michChAmi tvAM draShTumahaM tathaiva |
tenaiva rUpeNa chaturbhujena; sahasrabAho bhava vishvamUrte
shlokas.47:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
mayA prasannena tavArjunedaM; rUpaM paraM darshitamAtmayogAt |
tejomayaM vishvamanantamAdyaM; yanme tvadanyena na dRRiShTapUrvam
shlokas.48:
na vedayaj~nAdhyayanairna dAnai;rna cha kriyAbhirna tapobhirugraiH |
eva.nrUpaH shakya ahaM nRRiloke; draShTuM tvadanyena kurupravIra
shlokas.49:
mA te vyathA mA cha vimUDhabhAvo; dRRiShTvA rUpaM ghoramIdRRi~Nmamedam |
vyapetabhIH prItamanAH punastvaM; tadeva me rUpamidaM prapashya
shlokas.50:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityarjunaM vAsudevastathoktvA; svakaM rUpaM darshayAmAsa bhUyaH |
AshvAsayAmAsa cha bhItamenaM; bhUtvA punaH saumyavapurmahAtmA
shlokas.51:
arjuna uvAcha||
dRRiShTvedaM mAnuShaM rUpaM tava saumyaM janArdana |
idAnImasmi sa.nvRRittaH sachetAH prakRRitiM gataH
shlokas.52:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
sudurdarshamidaM rUpaM dRRiShTavAnasi yanmama |
devA apyasya rUpasya nityaM darshanakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.53:
nAhaM vedairna tapasA na dAnena na chejyayA |
shakya eva.nvidho draShTuM dRRiShTavAnasi mAM yathA
shlokas.54:
bhaktyA tvananyayA shakya ahameva.nvidho.arjuna |
j~nAtuM draShTuM cha tattvena praveShTuM cha parantapa
shlokas.55:
matkarmakRRinmatparamo madbhaktaH sa~NgavarjitaH |
nirvairaH sarvabhUteShu yaH sa mAmeti pANDava

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
evaM satatayuktA ye bhaktAstvAM paryupAsate |
ye chApyakSharamavyaktaM teShAM ke yogavittamAH
shlokas.2:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
mayyAveshya mano ye mAM nityayuktA upAsate |
shraddhayA parayopetAste me yuktatamA matAH
shlokas.3:
ye tvakSharamanirdeshyamavyaktaM paryupAsate |
sarvatragamachintyaM cha kUTasthamachalaM dhruvam
shlokas.4:
saMniyamyendriyagrAmaM sarvatra samabuddhayaH |
te prApnuvanti mAmeva sarvabhUtahite ratAH
shlokas.5:
klesho.adhikatarasteShAmavyaktAsaktachetasAm |
avyaktA hi gatirduHkhaM dehavadbhiravApyate
shlokas.6:
ye tu sarvANi karmANi mayi saMnyasya matparAH |
ananyenaiva yogena mAM dhyAyanta upAsate
shlokas.7:
teShAmahaM samuddhartA mRRityusa.nsArasAgarAt |
bhavAmi nachirAtpArtha mayyAveshitachetasAm
shlokas.8:
mayyeva mana Adhatsva mayi buddhiM niveshaya |
nivasiShyasi mayyeva ata UrdhvaM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.9:
atha chittaM samAdhAtuM na shaknoShi mayi sthiram |
abhyAsayogena tato mAmichChAptuM dhana~njaya
shlokas.10:
abhyAse.apyasamartho.asi matkarmaparamo bhava |
madarthamapi karmANi kurvansiddhimavApsyasi
shlokas.11:
athaitadapyashakto.asi kartuM madyogamAshritaH |
sarvakarmaphalatyAgaM tataH kuru yatAtmavAn
shlokas.12:
shreyo hi j~nAnamabhyAsAjj~nAnAddhyAnaM vishiShyate |
dhyAnAtkarmaphalatyAgastyAgAchChAntiranantaram
shlokas.13:
adveShTA sarvabhUtAnAM maitraH karuNa eva cha |
nirmamo niraha~NkAraH samaduHkhasukhaH kShamI
shlokas.14:
santuShTaH satataM yogI yatAtmA dRRiDhanishchayaH |
mayyarpitamanobuddhiryo madbhaktaH sa me priyaH
shlokas.15:
yasmAnnodvijate loko lokAnnodvijate cha yaH |
harShAmarShabhayodvegairmukto yaH sa cha me priyaH
shlokas.16:
anapekShaH shuchirdakSha udAsIno gatavyathaH |
sarvArambhaparityAgI yo madbhaktaH sa me priyaH
shlokas.17:
yo na hRRiShyati na dveShTi na shochati na kA~NkShati |
shubhAshubhaparityAgI bhaktimAnyaH sa me priyaH
shlokas.18:
samaH shatrau cha mitre cha tathA mAnAvamAnayoH |
shItoShNasukhaduHkheShu samaH sa~NgavivarjitaH
shlokas.19:
tulyanindAstutirmaunI santuShTo yena kenachit |
aniketaH sthiramatirbhaktimAnme priyo naraH
shlokas.20:
ye tu dharmyAmRRitamidaM yathoktaM paryupAsate |
shraddadhAnA matparamA bhaktAste.atIva me priyAH

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
idaM sharIraM kaunteya kShetramityabhidhIyate |
etadyo vetti taM prAhuH kShetraj~na iti tadvidaH
shlokas.2:
kShetraj~naM chApi mAM viddhi sarvakShetreShu bhArata |
kShetrakShetraj~nayorj~nAnaM yattajj~nAnaM mataM mama
shlokas.3:
tatkShetraM yachcha yAdRRikcha yadvikAri yatashcha yat |
sa cha yo yatprabhAvashcha tatsamAsena me shRRiNu
shlokas.4:
RRiShibhirbahudhA gItaM ChandobhirvividhaiH pRRithak |
brahmasUtrapadaishchaiva hetumadbhirvinishchitaiH
shlokas.5:
mahAbhUtAnyaha~NkAro buddhiravyaktameva cha |
indriyANi dashaikaM cha pa~ncha chendriyagocharAH
shlokas.6:
ichChA dveShaH sukhaM duHkhaM sa~NghAtashchetanA dhRRitiH |
etatkShetraM samAsena savikAramudAhRRitam
shlokas.7:
amAnitvamadambhitvamahi.nsA kShAntirArjavam |
AchAryopAsanaM shauchaM sthairyamAtmavinigrahaH
shlokas.8:
indriyArtheShu vairAgyamanaha~NkAra eva cha |
janmamRRityujarAvyAdhiduHkhadoShAnudarshanam
shlokas.9:
asaktiranabhiShva~NgaH putradAragRRihAdiShu |
nityaM cha samachittatvamiShTAniShTopapattiShu
shlokas.10:
mayi chAnanyayogena bhaktiravyabhichAriNI |
viviktadeshasevitvamaratirjanasa.nsadi
shlokas.11:
adhyAtmaj~nAnanityatvaM tattvaj~nAnArthadarshanam |
etajj~nAnamiti proktamaj~nAnaM yadato.anyathA
shlokas.12:
j~neyaM yattatpravakShyAmi yajj~nAtvAmRRitamashnute |
anAdimatparaM brahma na sattannAsaduchyate
shlokas.13:
sarvataHpANipAdaM tatsarvatokShishiromukham |
sarvataHshrutimalloke sarvamAvRRitya tiShThati
shlokas.14:
sarvendriyaguNAbhAsaM sarvendriyavivarjitam |
asaktaM sarvabhRRichchaiva nirguNaM guNabhoktRRi cha
shlokas.15:
bahirantashcha bhUtAnAmacharaM charameva cha |
sUkShmatvAttadavij~neyaM dUrasthaM chAntike cha tat
shlokas.16:
avibhaktaM cha bhUteShu vibhaktamiva cha sthitam |
bhUtabhartRRi cha tajj~neyaM grasiShNu prabhaviShNu cha
shlokas.17:
jyotiShAmapi tajjyotistamasaH paramuchyate |
j~nAnaM j~neyaM j~nAnagamyaM hRRidi sarvasya viShThitam
shlokas.18:
iti kShetraM tathA j~nAnaM j~neyaM choktaM samAsataH |
madbhakta etadvij~nAya madbhAvAyopapadyate
shlokas.19:
prakRRitiM puruShaM chaiva viddhyanAdI ubhAvapi |
vikArA.nshcha guNA.nshchaiva viddhi prakRRitisambhavAn
shlokas.20:
kAryakAraNakartRRitve hetuH prakRRitiruchyate |
puruShaH sukhaduHkhAnAM bhoktRRitve heturuchyate
shlokas.21:
puruShaH prakRRitistho hi bhu~Nkte prakRRitijAnguNAn |
kAraNaM guNasa~Ngo.asya sadasadyonijanmasu
shlokas.22:
upadraShTAnumantA cha bhartA bhoktA maheshvaraH |
paramAtmeti chApyukto dehe.asminpuruShaH paraH
shlokas.23:
ya evaM vetti puruShaM prakRRitiM cha guNaiH saha |
sarvathA vartamAno.api na sa bhUyo.abhijAyate
shlokas.24:
dhyAnenAtmani pashyanti kechidAtmAnamAtmanA |
anye sA~Nkhyena yogena karmayogena chApare
shlokas.25:
anye tvevamajAnantaH shrutvAnyebhya upAsate |
te.api chAtitarantyeva mRRityuM shrutiparAyaNAH
shlokas.26:
yAvatsa~njAyate ki~nchitsattvaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
kShetrakShetraj~nasa.nyogAttadviddhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.27:
samaM sarveShu bhUteShu tiShThantaM parameshvaram |
vinashyatsvavinashyantaM yaH pashyati sa pashyati
shlokas.28:
samaM pashyanhi sarvatra samavasthitamIshvaram |
na hinastyAtmanAtmAnaM tato yAti parAM gatim
shlokas.29:
prakRRityaiva cha karmANi kriyamANAni sarvashaH |
yaH pashyati tathAtmAnamakartAraM sa pashyati
shlokas.30:
yadA bhUtapRRithagbhAvamekasthamanupashyati |
tata eva cha vistAraM brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.31:
anAditvAnnirguNatvAtparamAtmAyamavyayaH |
sharIrastho.api kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
shlokas.32:
yathA sarvagataM saukShmyAdAkAshaM nopalipyate |
sarvatrAvasthito dehe tathAtmA nopalipyate
shlokas.33:
yathA prakAshayatyekaH kRRitsnaM lokamimaM raviH |
kShetraM kShetrI tathA kRRitsnaM prakAshayati bhArata
shlokas.34:
kShetrakShetraj~nayorevamantaraM j~nAnachakShuShA |
bhUtaprakRRitimokShaM cha ye viduryAnti te param

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
paraM bhUyaH pravakShyAmi j~nAnAnAM j~nAnamuttamam |
yajj~nAtvA munayaH sarve parAM siddhimito gatAH
shlokas.2:
idaM j~nAnamupAshritya mama sAdharmyamAgatAH |
sarge.api nopajAyante pralaye na vyathanti cha
shlokas.3:
mama yonirmahadbrahma tasmingarbhaM dadhAmyaham |
sambhavaH sarvabhUtAnAM tato bhavati bhArata
shlokas.4:
sarvayoniShu kaunteya mUrtayaH sambhavanti yAH |
tAsAM brahma mahadyonirahaM bIjapradaH pitA
shlokas.5:
sattvaM rajastama iti guNAH prakRRitisambhavAH |
nibadhnanti mahAbAho dehe dehinamavyayam
shlokas.6:
tatra sattvaM nirmalatvAtprakAshakamanAmayam |
sukhasa~Ngena badhnAti j~nAnasa~Ngena chAnagha
shlokas.7:
rajo rAgAtmakaM viddhi tRRiShNAsa~Ngasamudbhavam |
tannibadhnAti kaunteya karmasa~Ngena dehinam
shlokas.8:
tamastvaj~nAnajaM viddhi mohanaM sarvadehinAm |
pramAdAlasyanidrAbhistannibadhnAti bhArata
shlokas.9:
sattvaM sukhe sa~njayati rajaH karmaNi bhArata |
j~nAnamAvRRitya tu tamaH pramAde sa~njayatyuta
shlokas.10:
rajastamashchAbhibhUya sattvaM bhavati bhArata |
rajaH sattvaM tamashchaiva tamaH sattvaM rajastathA
shlokas.11:
sarvadvAreShu dehe.asminprakAsha upajAyate |
j~nAnaM yadA tadA vidyAdvivRRiddhaM sattvamityuta
shlokas.12:
lobhaH pravRRittirArambhaH karmaNAmashamaH spRRihA |
rajasyetAni jAyante vivRRiddhe bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
aprakAsho.apravRRittishcha pramAdo moha eva cha |
tamasyetAni jAyante vivRRiddhe kurunandana
shlokas.14:
yadA sattve pravRRiddhe tu pralayaM yAti dehabhRRit |
tadottamavidAM lokAnamalAnpratipadyate
shlokas.15:
rajasi pralayaM gatvA karmasa~NgiShu jAyate |
tathA pralInastamasi mUDhayoniShu jAyate
shlokas.16:
karmaNaH sukRRitasyAhuH sAttvikaM nirmalaM phalam |
rajasastu phalaM duHkhamaj~nAnaM tamasaH phalam
shlokas.17:
sattvAtsa~njAyate j~nAnaM rajaso lobha eva cha |
pramAdamohau tamaso bhavato.aj~nAnameva cha
shlokas.18:
UrdhvaM gachChanti sattvasthA madhye tiShThanti rAjasAH |
jaghanyaguNavRRittasthA adho gachChanti tAmasAH
shlokas.19:
nAnyaM guNebhyaH kartAraM yadA draShTAnupashyati |
guNebhyashcha paraM vetti madbhAvaM so.adhigachChati
shlokas.20:
guNAnetAnatItya trIndehI dehasamudbhavAn |
janmamRRityujarAduHkhairvimukto.amRRitamashnute
shlokas.21:
arjuna uvAcha||
kairli~NgaistrInguNAnetAnatIto bhavati prabho |
kimAchAraH kathaM chaitA.nstrInguNAnativartate
shlokas.22:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
prakAshaM cha pravRRittiM cha mohameva cha pANDava |
na dveShTi sampravRRittAni na nivRRittAni kA~NkShati
shlokas.23:
udAsInavadAsIno guNairyo na vichAlyate |
guNA vartanta ityeva yo.avatiShThati ne~Ngate
shlokas.24:
samaduHkhasukhaH svasthaH samaloShTAshmakA~nchanaH |
tulyapriyApriyo dhIrastulyanindAtmasa.nstutiH
shlokas.25:
mAnAvamAnayostulyastulyo mitrAripakShayoH |
sarvArambhaparityAgI guNAtItaH sa uchyate
shlokas.26:
mAM cha yo.avyabhichAreNa bhaktiyogena sevate |
sa guNAnsamatItyaitAnbrahmabhUyAya kalpate
shlokas.27:
brahmaNo hi pratiShThAhamamRRitasyAvyayasya cha |
shAshvatasya cha dharmasya sukhasyaikAntikasya cha

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
UrdhvamUlamadhaHshAkhamashvatthaM prAhuravyayam |
ChandA.nsi yasya parNAni yastaM veda sa vedavit
shlokas.2:
adhashchordhvaM prasRRitAstasya shAkhA; guNapravRRiddhA viShayapravAlAH |
adhashcha mUlAnyanusantatAni; karmAnubandhIni manuShyaloke
shlokas.3:
na rUpamasyeha tathopalabhyate; nAnto na chAdirna cha sampratiShThA |
ashvatthamenaM suvirUDhamUla;masa~NgashastreNa dRRiDhena ChittvA
shlokas.4:
tataH padaM tatparimArgitavyaM; yasmingatA na nivartanti bhUyaH |
tameva chAdyaM puruShaM prapadye; yataH pravRRittiH prasRRitA purANI
shlokas.5:
nirmAnamohA jitasa~NgadoShA; adhyAtmanityA vinivRRittakAmAH |
dva.ndvairvimuktAH sukhaduHkhasa~nj~nai;rgachChantyamUDhAH padamavyayaM tat
shlokas.6:
na tadbhAsayate sUryo na shashA~Nko na pAvakaH |
yadgatvA na nivartante taddhAma paramaM mama
shlokas.7:
mamaivA.nsho jIvaloke jIvabhUtaH sanAtanaH |
manaHShaShThAnIndriyANi prakRRitisthAni karShati
shlokas.8:
sharIraM yadavApnoti yachchApyutkrAmatIshvaraH |
gRRihItvaitAni sa.nyAti vAyurgandhAnivAshayAt
shlokas.9:
shrotraM chakShuH sparshanaM cha rasanaM ghrANameva cha |
adhiShThAya manashchAyaM viShayAnupasevate
shlokas.10:
utkrAmantaM sthitaM vApi bhu~njAnaM vA guNAnvitam |
vimUDhA nAnupashyanti pashyanti j~nAnachakShuShaH
shlokas.11:
yatanto yoginashchainaM pashyantyAtmanyavasthitam |
yatanto.apyakRRitAtmAno nainaM pashyantyachetasaH
shlokas.12:
yadAdityagataM tejo jagadbhAsayate.akhilam |
yachchandramasi yachchAgnau tattejo viddhi mAmakam
shlokas.13:
gAmAvishya cha bhUtAni dhArayAmyahamojasA |
puShNAmi chauShadhIH sarvAH somo bhUtvA rasAtmakaH
shlokas.14:
ahaM vaishvAnaro bhUtvA prANinAM dehamAshritaH |
prANApAnasamAyuktaH pachAmyannaM chaturvidham
shlokas.15:
sarvasya chAhaM hRRidi saMniviShTo; mattaH smRRitirj~nAnamapohanaM cha |
vedaishcha sarvairahameva vedyo; vedAntakRRidvedavideva chAham
shlokas.16:
dvAvimau puruShau loke kSharashchAkShara eva cha |
kSharaH sarvANi bhUtAni kUTastho.akShara uchyate
shlokas.17:
uttamaH puruShastvanyaH paramAtmetyudAhRRitaH |
yo lokatrayamAvishya bibhartyavyaya IshvaraH
shlokas.18:
yasmAtkSharamatIto.ahamakSharAdapi chottamaH |
ato.asmi loke vede cha prathitaH puruShottamaH
shlokas.19:
yo mAmevamasaMmUDho jAnAti puruShottamam |
sa sarvavidbhajati mAM sarvabhAvena bhArata
shlokas.20:
iti guhyatamaM shAstramidamuktaM mayAnagha |
etadbuddhvA buddhimAnsyAtkRRitakRRityashcha bhArata

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
abhayaM sattvasa.nshuddhirj~nAnayogavyavasthitiH |
dAnaM damashcha yaj~nashcha svAdhyAyastapa Arjavam
shlokas.2:
ahi.nsA satyamakrodhastyAgaH shAntirapaishunam |
dayA bhUteShvaloluptvaM mArdavaM hrIrachApalam
shlokas.3:
tejaH kShamA dhRRitiH shauchamadroho nAtimAnitA |
bhavanti sampadaM daivImabhijAtasya bhArata
shlokas.4:
dambho darpo.atimAnashcha krodhaH pAruShyameva cha |
aj~nAnaM chAbhijAtasya pArtha sampadamAsurIm
shlokas.5:
daivI sampadvimokShAya nibandhAyAsurI matA |
mA shuchaH sampadaM daivImabhijAto.asi pANDava
shlokas.6:
dvau bhUtasargau loke.asmindaiva Asura eva cha |
daivo vistarashaH prokta AsuraM pArtha me shRRiNu
shlokas.7:
pravRRittiM cha nivRRittiM cha janA na vidurAsurAH |
na shauchaM nApi chAchAro na satyaM teShu vidyate
shlokas.8:
asatyamapratiShThaM te jagadAhuranIshvaram |
aparasparasambhUtaM kimanyatkAmahaitukam
shlokas.9:
etAM dRRiShTimavaShTabhya naShTAtmAno.alpabuddhayaH |
prabhavantyugrakarmANaH kShayAya jagato.ahitAH
shlokas.10:
kAmamAshritya duShpUraM dambhamAnamadAnvitAH |
mohAdgRRihItvAsadgrAhAnpravartante.ashuchivratAH
shlokas.11:
chintAmaparimeyAM cha pralayAntAmupAshritAH |
kAmopabhogaparamA etAvaditi nishchitAH
shlokas.12:
AshApAshashatairbaddhAH kAmakrodhaparAyaNAH |
Ihante kAmabhogArthamanyAyenArthasa~nchayAn
shlokas.13:
idamadya mayA labdhamidaM prApsye manoratham |
idamastIdamapi me bhaviShyati punardhanam
shlokas.14:
asau mayA hataH shatrurhaniShye chAparAnapi |
Ishvaro.ahamahaM bhogI siddho.ahaM balavAnsukhI
shlokas.15:
ADhyo.abhijanavAnasmi ko.anyo.asti sadRRisho mayA |
yakShye dAsyAmi modiShya ityaj~nAnavimohitAH
shlokas.16:
anekachittavibhrAntA mohajAlasamAvRRitAH |
prasaktAH kAmabhogeShu patanti narake.ashuchau
shlokas.17:
AtmasambhAvitAH stabdhA dhanamAnamadAnvitAH |
yajante nAmayaj~naiste dambhenAvidhipUrvakam
shlokas.18:
aha~NkAraM balaM darpaM kAmaM krodhaM cha sa.nshritAH |
mAmAtmaparadeheShu pradviShanto.abhyasUyakAH
shlokas.19:
tAnahaM dviShataH krUrAnsa.nsAreShu narAdhamAn |
kShipAmyajasramashubhAnAsurIShveva yoniShu
shlokas.20:
AsurIM yonimApannA mUDhA janmani janmani |
mAmaprApyaiva kaunteya tato yAntyadhamAM gatim
shlokas.21:
trividhaM narakasyedaM dvAraM nAshanamAtmanaH |
kAmaH krodhastathA lobhastasmAdetattrayaM tyajet
shlokas.22:
etairvimuktaH kaunteya tamodvAraistribhirnaraH |
AcharatyAtmanaH shreyastato yAti parAM gatim
shlokas.23:
yaH shAstravidhimutsRRijya vartate kAmakArataH |
na sa siddhimavApnoti na sukhaM na parAM gatim
shlokas.24:
tasmAchChAstraM pramANaM te kAryAkAryavyavasthitau |
j~nAtvA shAstravidhAnoktaM karma kartumihArhasi

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
ye shAstravidhimutsRRijya yajante shraddhayAnvitAH |
teShAM niShThA tu kA kRRiShNa sattvamAho rajastamaH
shlokas.2:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
trividhA bhavati shraddhA dehinAM sA svabhAvajA |
sAttvikI rAjasI chaiva tAmasI cheti tAM shRRiNu
shlokas.3:
sattvAnurUpA sarvasya shraddhA bhavati bhArata |
shraddhAmayo.ayaM puruSho yo yachChraddhaH sa eva saH
shlokas.4:
yajante sAttvikA devAnyakSharakShA.nsi rAjasAH |
pretAnbhUtagaNA.nshchAnye yajante tAmasA janAH
shlokas.5:
ashAstravihitaM ghoraM tapyante ye tapo janAH |
dambhAha~NkArasa.nyuktAH kAmarAgabalAnvitAH
shlokas.6:
karshayantaH sharIrasthaM bhUtagrAmamachetasaH |
mAM chaivAntaHsharIrasthaM tAnviddhyAsuranishchayAn
shlokas.7:
AhArastvapi sarvasya trividho bhavati priyaH |
yaj~nastapastathA dAnaM teShAM bhedamimaM shRRiNu
shlokas.8:
AyuHsattvabalArogyasukhaprItivivardhanAH |
rasyAH snigdhAH sthirA hRRidyA AhArAH sAttvikapriyAH
shlokas.9:
kaTvamlalavaNAtyuShNatIkShNarUkShavidAhinaH |
AhArA rAjasasyeShTA duHkhashokAmayapradAH
shlokas.10:
yAtayAmaM gatarasaM pUti paryuShitaM cha yat |
uchChiShTamapi chAmedhyaM bhojanaM tAmasapriyam
shlokas.11:
aphalAkA~NkShibhiryaj~no vidhidRRiShTo ya ijyate |
yaShTavyameveti manaH samAdhAya sa sAttvikaH
shlokas.12:
abhisandhAya tu phalaM dambhArthamapi chaiva yat |
ijyate bharatashreShTha taM yaj~naM viddhi rAjasam
shlokas.13:
vidhihInamasRRiShTAnnaM mantrahInamadakShiNam |
shraddhAvirahitaM yaj~naM tAmasaM parichakShate
shlokas.14:
devadvijaguruprAj~napUjanaM shauchamArjavam |
brahmacharyamahi.nsA cha shArIraM tapa uchyate
shlokas.15:
anudvegakaraM vAkyaM satyaM priyahitaM cha yat |
svAdhyAyAbhyasanaM chaiva vA~NmayaM tapa uchyate
shlokas.16:
manaHprasAdaH saumyatvaM maunamAtmavinigrahaH |
bhAvasa.nshuddhirityetattapo mAnasamuchyate
shlokas.17:
shraddhayA parayA taptaM tapastattrividhaM naraiH |
aphalAkA~NkShibhiryuktaiH sAttvikaM parichakShate
shlokas.18:
satkAramAnapUjArthaM tapo dambhena chaiva yat |
kriyate tadiha proktaM rAjasaM chalamadhruvam
shlokas.19:
mUDhagrAheNAtmano yatpIDayA kriyate tapaH |
parasyotsAdanArthaM vA tattAmasamudAhRRitam
shlokas.20:
dAtavyamiti yaddAnaM dIyate.anupakAriNe |
deshe kAle cha pAtre cha taddAnaM sAttvikaM smRRitam
shlokas.21:
yattu pratyupakArArthaM phalamuddishya vA punaH |
dIyate cha parikliShTaM taddAnaM rAjasaM smRRitam
shlokas.22:
adeshakAle yaddAnamapAtrebhyashcha dIyate |
asatkRRitamavaj~nAtaM tattAmasamudAhRRitam
shlokas.23:
oM tatsaditi nirdesho brahmaNastrividhaH smRRitaH |
brAhmaNAstena vedAshcha yaj~nAshcha vihitAH purA
shlokas.24:
tasmAdomityudAhRRitya yaj~nadAnatapaHkriyAH |
pravartante vidhAnoktAH satataM brahmavAdinAm
shlokas.25:
tadityanabhisandhAya phalaM yaj~natapaHkriyAH |
dAnakriyAshcha vividhAH kriyante mokShakA~NkShibhiH
shlokas.26:
sadbhAve sAdhubhAve cha sadityetatprayujyate |
prashaste karmaNi tathA sachChabdaH pArtha yujyate
shlokas.27:
yaj~ne tapasi dAne cha sthitiH saditi chochyate |
karma chaiva tadarthIyaM sadityevAbhidhIyate
shlokas.28:
ashraddhayA hutaM dattaM tapastaptaM kRRitaM cha yat |
asadityuchyate pArtha na cha tatpretya no iha

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
saMnyAsasya mahAbAho tattvamichChAmi veditum |
tyAgasya cha hRRiShIkesha pRRithakkeshiniShUdana
shlokas.2:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
kAmyAnAM karmaNAM nyAsaM saMnyAsaM kavayo viduH |
sarvakarmaphalatyAgaM prAhustyAgaM vichakShaNAH
shlokas.3:
tyAjyaM doShavadityeke karma prAhurmanIShiNaH |
yaj~nadAnatapaHkarma na tyAjyamiti chApare
shlokas.4:
nishchayaM shRRiNu me tatra tyAge bharatasattama |
tyAgo hi puruShavyAghra trividhaH samprakIrtitaH
shlokas.5:
yaj~nadAnatapaHkarma na tyAjyaM kAryameva tat |
yaj~no dAnaM tapashchaiva pAvanAni manIShiNAm
shlokas.6:
etAnyapi tu karmANi sa~NgaM tyaktvA phalAni cha |
kartavyAnIti me pArtha nishchitaM matamuttamam
shlokas.7:
niyatasya tu saMnyAsaH karmaNo nopapadyate |
mohAttasya parityAgastAmasaH parikIrtitaH
shlokas.8:
duHkhamityeva yatkarma kAyakleshabhayAttyajet |
sa kRRitvA rAjasaM tyAgaM naiva tyAgaphalaM labhet
shlokas.9:
kAryamityeva yatkarma niyataM kriyate.arjuna |
sa~NgaM tyaktvA phalaM chaiva sa tyAgaH sAttviko mataH
shlokas.10:
na dveShTyakushalaM karma kushale nAnuShajjate |
tyAgI sattvasamAviShTo medhAvI Chinnasa.nshayaH
shlokas.11:
na hi dehabhRRitA shakyaM tyaktuM karmANyasheShataH |
yastu karmaphalatyAgI sa tyAgItyabhidhIyate
shlokas.12:
aniShTamiShTaM mishraM cha trividhaM karmaNaH phalam |
bhavatyatyAginAM pretya na tu saMnyAsinAM kvachit
shlokas.13:
pa~nchaitAni mahAbAho kAraNAni nibodha me |
sA~Nkhye kRRitAnte proktAni siddhaye sarvakarmaNAm
shlokas.14:
adhiShThAnaM tathA kartA karaNaM cha pRRithagvidham |
vividhAshcha pRRithakcheShTA daivaM chaivAtra pa~nchamam
shlokas.15:
sharIravA~Nmanobhiryatkarma prArabhate naraH |
nyAyyaM vA viparItaM vA pa~nchaite tasya hetavaH
shlokas.16:
tatraivaM sati kartAramAtmAnaM kevalaM tu yaH |
pashyatyakRRitabuddhitvAnna sa pashyati durmatiH
shlokas.17:
yasya nAha~NkRRito bhAvo buddhiryasya na lipyate |
hatvApi sa imA.NllokAnna hanti na nibadhyate
shlokas.18:
j~nAnaM j~neyaM parij~nAtA trividhA karmachodanA |
karaNaM karma karteti trividhaH karmasa~NgrahaH
shlokas.19:
j~nAnaM karma cha kartA cha tridhaiva guNabhedataH |
prochyate guNasa~NkhyAne yathAvachChRRiNu tAnyapi
shlokas.20:
sarvabhUteShu yenaikaM bhAvamavyayamIkShate |
avibhaktaM vibhakteShu tajj~nAnaM viddhi sAttvikam
shlokas.21:
pRRithaktvena tu yajj~nAnaM nAnAbhAvAnpRRithagvidhAn |
vetti sarveShu bhUteShu tajj~nAnaM viddhi rAjasam
shlokas.22:
yattu kRRitsnavadekasminkArye saktamahaitukam |
atattvArthavadalpaM cha tattAmasamudAhRRitam
shlokas.23:
niyataM sa~NgarahitamarAgadveShataH kRRitam |
aphalaprepsunA karma yattatsAttvikamuchyate
shlokas.24:
yattu kAmepsunA karma sAha~NkAreNa vA punaH |
kriyate bahulAyAsaM tadrAjasamudAhRRitam
shlokas.25:
anubandhaM kShayaM hi.nsAmanapekShya cha pauruSham |
mohAdArabhyate karma yattattAmasamuchyate
shlokas.26:
muktasa~Ngo.anaha.nvAdI dhRRityutsAhasamanvitaH |
siddhyasiddhyornirvikAraH kartA sAttvika uchyate
shlokas.27:
rAgI karmaphalaprepsurlubdho hi.nsAtmako.ashuchiH |
harShashokAnvitaH kartA rAjasaH parikIrtitaH
shlokas.28:
ayuktaH prAkRRitaH stabdhaH shaTho naikRRitiko.alasaH |
viShAdI dIrghasUtrI cha kartA tAmasa uchyate
shlokas.29:
buddherbhedaM dhRRiteshchaiva guNatastrividhaM shRRiNu |
prochyamAnamasheSheNa pRRithaktvena dhana~njaya
shlokas.30:
pravRRittiM cha nivRRittiM cha kAryAkArye bhayAbhaye |
bandhaM mokShaM cha yA vetti buddhiH sA pArtha sAttvikI
shlokas.31:
yayA dharmamadharmaM cha kAryaM chAkAryameva cha |
ayathAvatprajAnAti buddhiH sA pArtha rAjasI
shlokas.32:
adharmaM dharmamiti yA manyate tamasAvRRitA |
