sarvArthAnviparItA.nshcha buddhiH sA pArtha tAmasI
shlokas.33:
dhRRityA yayA dhArayate manaHprANendriyakriyAH |
yogenAvyabhichAriNyA dhRRitiH sA pArtha sAttvikI
shlokas.34:
yayA tu dharmakAmArthAndhRRityA dhArayate.arjuna |
prasa~Ngena phalAkA~NkShI dhRRitiH sA pArtha rAjasI
shlokas.35:
yayA svapnaM bhayaM shokaM viShAdaM madameva cha |
na vimu~nchati durmedhA dhRRitiH sA pArtha tAmasI
shlokas.36:
sukhaM tvidAnIM trividhaM shRRiNu me bharatarShabha |
abhyAsAdramate yatra duHkhAntaM cha nigachChati
shlokas.37:
yattadagre viShamiva pariNAme.amRRitopamam |
tatsukhaM sAttvikaM proktamAtmabuddhiprasAdajam
shlokas.38:
viShayendriyasa.nyogAdyattadagre.amRRitopamam |
pariNAme viShamiva tatsukhaM rAjasaM smRRitam
shlokas.39:
yadagre chAnubandhe cha sukhaM mohanamAtmanaH |
nidrAlasyapramAdotthaM tattAmasamudAhRRitam
shlokas.40:
na tadasti pRRithivyAM vA divi deveShu vA punaH |
sattvaM prakRRitijairmuktaM yadebhiH syAttribhirguNaiH
shlokas.41:
brAhmaNakShatriyavishAM shUdrANAM cha parantapa |
karmANi pravibhaktAni svabhAvaprabhavairguNaiH
shlokas.42:
shamo damastapaH shauchaM kShAntirArjavameva cha |
j~nAnaM vij~nAnamAstikyaM brahmakarma svabhAvajam
shlokas.43:
shauryaM tejo dhRRitirdAkShyaM yuddhe chApyapalAyanam |
dAnamIshvarabhAvashcha kShatrakarma svabhAvajam
shlokas.44:
kRRiShigorakShyavANijyaM vaishyakarma svabhAvajam |
paricharyAtmakaM karma shUdrasyApi svabhAvajam
shlokas.45:
sve sve karmaNyabhirataH sa.nsiddhiM labhate naraH |
svakarmanirataH siddhiM yathA vindati tachChRRiNu
shlokas.46:
yataH pravRRittirbhUtAnAM yena sarvamidaM tatam |
svakarmaNA tamabhyarchya siddhiM vindati mAnavaH
shlokas.47:
shreyAnsvadharmo viguNaH paradharmAtsvanuShThitAt |
svabhAvaniyataM karma kurvannApnoti kilbiSham
shlokas.48:
sahajaM karma kaunteya sadoShamapi na tyajet |
sarvArambhA hi doSheNa dhUmenAgnirivAvRRitAH
shlokas.49:
asaktabuddhiH sarvatra jitAtmA vigataspRRihaH |
naiShkarmyasiddhiM paramAM saMnyAsenAdhigachChati
shlokas.50:
siddhiM prApto yathA brahma tathApnoti nibodha me |
samAsenaiva kaunteya niShThA j~nAnasya yA parA
shlokas.51:
buddhyA vishuddhayA yukto dhRRityAtmAnaM niyamya cha |
shabdAdInviShayA.nstyaktvA rAgadveShau vyudasya cha
shlokas.52:
viviktasevI laghvAshI yatavAkkAyamAnasaH |
dhyAnayogaparo nityaM vairAgyaM samupAshritaH
shlokas.53:
aha~NkAraM balaM darpaM kAmaM krodhaM parigraham |
vimuchya nirmamaH shAnto brahmabhUyAya kalpate
shlokas.54:
brahmabhUtaH prasannAtmA na shochati na kA~NkShati |
samaH sarveShu bhUteShu madbhaktiM labhate parAm
shlokas.55:
bhaktyA mAmabhijAnAti yAvAnyashchAsmi tattvataH |
tato mAM tattvato j~nAtvA vishate tadanantaram
shlokas.56:
sarvakarmANyapi sadA kurvANo madvyapAshrayaH |
matprasAdAdavApnoti shAshvataM padamavyayam
shlokas.57:
chetasA sarvakarmANi mayi saMnyasya matparaH |
buddhiyogamupAshritya machchittaH satataM bhava
shlokas.58:
machchittaH sarvadurgANi matprasAdAttariShyasi |
atha chettvamaha~NkArAnna shroShyasi vina~NkShyasi
shlokas.59:
yadaha~NkAramAshritya na yotsya iti manyase |
mithyaiSha vyavasAyaste prakRRitistvAM niyokShyati
shlokas.60:
svabhAvajena kaunteya nibaddhaH svena karmaNA |
kartuM nechChasi yanmohAtkariShyasyavasho.api tat
shlokas.61:
IshvaraH sarvabhUtAnAM hRRiddeshe.arjuna tiShThati |
bhrAmayansarvabhUtAni yantrArUDhAni mAyayA
shlokas.62:
tameva sharaNaM gachCha sarvabhAvena bhArata |
tatprasAdAtparAM shAntiM sthAnaM prApsyasi shAshvatam
shlokas.63:
iti te j~nAnamAkhyAtaM guhyAdguhyataraM mayA |
vimRRishyaitadasheSheNa yathechChasi tathA kuru
shlokas.64:
sarvaguhyatamaM bhUyaH shRRiNu me paramaM vachaH |
iShTo.asi me dRRiDhamiti tato vakShyAmi te hitam
shlokas.65:
manmanA bhava madbhakto madyAjI mAM namaskuru |
mAmevaiShyasi satyaM te pratijAne priyo.asi me
shlokas.66:
sarvadharmAnparityajya mAmekaM sharaNaM vraja |
ahaM tvA sarvapApebhyo mokShayiShyAmi mA shuchaH
shlokas.67:
idaM te nAtapaskAya nAbhaktAya kadAchana |
na chAshushrUShave vAchyaM na cha mAM yo.abhyasUyati
shlokas.68:
ya idaM paramaM guhyaM madbhakteShvabhidhAsyati |
bhaktiM mayi parAM kRRitvA mAmevaiShyatyasa.nshayaH
shlokas.69:
na cha tasmAnmanuShyeShu kashchinme priyakRRittamaH |
bhavitA na cha me tasmAdanyaH priyataro bhuvi
shlokas.70:
adhyeShyate cha ya imaM dharmyaM sa.nvAdamAvayoH |
j~nAnayaj~nena tenAhamiShTaH syAmiti me matiH
shlokas.71:
shraddhAvAnanasUyashcha shRRiNuyAdapi yo naraH |
so.api muktaH shubhA.NllokAnprApnuyAtpuNyakarmaNAm
shlokas.72:
kachchidetachChrutaM pArtha tvayaikAgreNa chetasA |
kachchidaj~nAnasaMmohaH pranaShTaste dhana~njaya
shlokas.73:
arjuna uvAcha||
naShTo mohaH smRRitirlabdhA tvatprasAdAnmayAchyuta |
sthito.asmi gatasa.ndehaH kariShye vachanaM tava
shlokas.74:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityahaM vAsudevasya pArthasya cha mahAtmanaH |
sa.nvAdamimamashrauShamadbhutaM romaharShaNam
shlokas.76:
rAjansa.nsmRRitya sa.nsmRRitya sa.nvAdamimamadbhutam |
keshavArjunayoH puNyaM hRRiShyAmi cha muhurmuhuH
shlokas.77:
tachcha sa.nsmRRitya sa.nsmRRitya rUpamatyadbhutaM hareH |
vismayo me mahAnrAjanhRRiShyAmi cha punaH punaH
shlokas.78:
yatra yogeshvaraH kRRiShNo yatra pArtho dhanurdharaH |
tatra shrIrvijayo bhUtirdhruvA nItirmatirmama

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato dhana~njayaM dRRiShTvA bANagANDIvadhAriNam |
punareva mahAnAdaM vyasRRijanta mahArathAH
shlokas.2:
pANDavAH somakAshchaiva ye chaiShAmanuyAyinaH |
dadhmushcha muditAH sha~NkhAnvIrAH sAgarasambhavAn
shlokas.3:
tato bheryashcha peshyashcha krakachA goviShANikAH |
sahasaivAbhyahanyanta tataH shabdo mahAnabhUt
shlokas.4:
atha devAH sagandharvAH pitarashcha janeshvara |
siddhachAraNasa~NghAshcha samIyuste didRRikShayA
shlokas.5:
RRiShayashcha mahAbhAgAH puraskRRitya shatakratum |
samIyustatra sahitA draShTuM tadvaishasaM mahat
shlokas.6:
tato yudhiShThiro dRRiShTvA yuddhAya susamudyate |
te sene sAgaraprakhye muhuH prachalite nRRipa
shlokas.7:
vimuchya kavachaM vIro nikShipya cha varAyudham |
avaruhya rathAttUrNaM padbhyAmeva kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.8:
pitAmahamabhiprekShya dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
vAgyataH prayayau yena prA~Nmukho ripuvAhinIm
shlokas.9:
taM prayAntamabhiprekShya kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
avatIrya rathAttUrNaM bhrAtRRibhiH sahito.anvayAt
shlokas.10:
vAsudevashcha bhagavAnpRRiShThato.anujagAma ha |
yathAmukhyAshcha rAjAnastamanvAjagmurutsukAH
shlokas.11:
arjuna uvAcha||
kiM te vyavasitaM rAjanyadasmAnapahAya vai |
padbhyAmeva prayAto.asi prA~Nmukho ripuvAhinIm
shlokas.12:
bhImasena uvAcha||
kva gamiShyasi rAjendra nikShiptakavachAyudhaH |
da.nshiteShvarisainyeShu bhrAtR^InutsRRijya pArthiva
shlokas.13:
nakula uvAcha||
eva~Ngate tvayi jyeShThe mama bhrAtari bhArata |
bhIrme dunoti hRRidayaM brUhi gantA bhavAnkva nu
shlokas.14:
sahadeva uvAcha||
asminraNasamUhe vai vartamAne mahAbhaye |
yoddhavye kva nu gantAsi shatrUnabhimukho nRRipa
shlokas.15:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamAbhAShyamANo.api bhrAtRRibhiH kurunandana |
novAcha vAgyataH ki~nchidgachChatyeva yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.16:
tAnuvAcha mahAprAj~no vAsudevo mahAmanAH |
abhiprAyo.asya vij~nAto mayeti prahasanniva
shlokas.17:
eSha bhIShmaM tathA droNaM gautamaM shalyameva cha |
anumAnya gurUnsarvAnyotsyate pArthivo.aribhiH
shlokas.18:
shrUyate hi purAkalpe gurUnananumAnya yaH |
yudhyate sa bhavedvyaktamapadhyAto mahattaraiH
shlokas.19:
anumAnya yathAshAstraM yastu yudhyenmahattaraiH |
dhruvastasya jayo yuddhe bhavediti matirmama
shlokas.20:
evaM bruvati kRRiShNe tu dhArtarAShTrachamUM prati |
hAhAkAro mahAnAsInniHshabdAstvapare.abhavan
shlokas.21:
dRRiShTvA yudhiShThiraM dUrAddhArtarAShTrasya sainikAH |
mithaH sa~NkathayAM chakrurnesho.asti kulapA.nsanaH
shlokas.22:
vyaktaM bhIta ivAbhyeti rAjAsau bhIShmamantikAt |
yudhiShThiraH sasodaryaH sharaNArthaM prayAchakaH
shlokas.23:
dhana~njaye kathaM nAthe pANDave cha vRRikodare |
nakule sahadeve cha bhIto.abhyeti cha pANDavaH
shlokas.24:
na nUnaM kShatriyakule jAtaH samprathite bhuvi |
yathAsya hRRidayaM bhItamalpasattvasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.25:
tataste kShatriyAH sarve prasha.nsanti sma kauravAn |
hRRiShTAH sumanaso bhUtvA chailAni dudhuvuH pRRithak
shlokas.26:
vyanindanta tataH sarve yodhAstatra vishAM pate |
yudhiShThiraM sasodaryaM sahitaM keshavena ha
shlokas.27:
tatastatkauravaM sainyaM dhikkRRitvA tu yudhiShThiram |
niHshabdamabhavattUrNaM punareva vishAM pate
shlokas.28:
kiM nu vakShyati rAjAsau kiM bhIShmaH prativakShyati |
kiM bhImaH samarashlAghI kiM nu kRRiShNArjunAviti
shlokas.29:
vivakShitaM kimasyeti sa.nshayaH sumahAnabhUt |
ubhayoH senayo rAjanyudhiShThirakRRite tadA
shlokas.30:
sa vigAhya chamUM shatroH sharashaktisamAkulAm |
bhIShmamevAbhyayAttUrNaM bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.31:
tamuvAcha tataH pAdau karAbhyAM pIDya pANDavaH |
bhIShmaM shAntanavaM rAjA yuddhAya samupasthitam
shlokas.32:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
Amantraye tvAM durdharSha yotsye tAta tvayA saha |
anujAnIhi mAM tAta AshiShashcha prayojaya
shlokas.33:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yadyevaM nAbhigachChethA yudhi mAM pRRithivIpate |
shapeyaM tvAM mahArAja parAbhAvAya bhArata
shlokas.34:
prIto.asmi putra yudhyasva jayamApnuhi pANDava |
yatte.abhilaShitaM chAnyattadavApnuhi sa.nyuge
shlokas.35:
vriyatAM cha varaH pArtha kimasmatto.abhikA~NkShasi |
evaM gate mahArAja na tavAsti parAjayaH
shlokas.36:
arthasya puruSho dAso dAsastvartho na kasyachit |
iti satyaM mahArAja baddho.asmyarthena kauravaiH
shlokas.37:
atastvAM klIbavadvAkyaM bravImi kurunandana |
hRRito.asmyarthena kauravya yuddhAdanyatkimichChasi
shlokas.38:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mantrayasva mahAprAj~na hitaiShI mama nityashaH |
yudhyasva kauravasyArthe mamaiSha satataM varaH
shlokas.39:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rAjankimatra sAhyaM te karomi kurunandana |
kAmaM yotsye parasyArthe brUhi yatte vivakShitam
shlokas.40:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM jayeyaM sa~NgrAme bhavantamaparAjitam |
etanme mantraya hitaM yadi shreyaH prapashyasi
shlokas.41:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na taM pashyAmi kaunteya yo mAM yudhyantamAhave |
vijayeta pumAnkashchidapi sAkShAchChatakratuH
shlokas.42:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
hanta pRRichChAmi tasmAttvAM pitAmaha namo.astu te |
jayopAyaM bravIhi tvamAtmanaH samare paraiH
shlokas.43:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na shatruM tAta pashyAmi samare yo jayeta mAm |
na tAvanmRRityukAlo me punarAgamanaM kuru
shlokas.44:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro vAkyaM bhIShmasya kurunandana |
shirasA pratijagrAha bhUyastamabhivAdya cha
shlokas.45:
prAyAtpunarmahAbAhurAchAryasya rathaM prati |
pashyatAM sarvasainyAnAM madhyena bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.46:
sa droNamabhivAdyAtha kRRitvA chaiva pradakShiNam |
uvAcha vAchA durdharShamAtmaniHshreyasaM vachaH
shlokas.47:
Amantraye tvAM bhagavanyotsye vigatakalmaShaH |
jayeyaM cha ripUnsarvAnanuj~nAtastvayA dvija
shlokas.48:
droNa uvAcha||
yadi mAM nAbhigachChethA yuddhAya kRRitanishchayaH |
shapeyaM tvAM mahArAja parAbhAvAya sarvashaH
shlokas.49:
tadyudhiShThira tuShTo.asmi pUjitashcha tvayAnagha |
anujAnAmi yudhyasva vijayaM samavApnuhi
shlokas.50:
karavANi cha te kAmaM brUhi yatte.abhikA~NkShitam |
evaM gate mahArAja yuddhAdanyatkimichChasi
shlokas.51:
arthasya puruSho dAso dAsastvartho na kasyachit |
iti satyaM mahArAja baddho.asmyarthena kauravaiH
shlokas.52:
atastvAM klIbavadbrUmo yuddhAdanyatkimichChasi |
yotsyAmi kauravasyArthe tavAshAsyo jayo mayA
shlokas.53:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
jayamAshAssva me brahmanmantrayasva cha maddhitam |
yudhyasva kauravasyArthe vara eSha vRRito mayA
shlokas.54:
droNa uvAcha||
dhruvaste vijayo rAjanyasya mantrI haristava |
ahaM cha tvAbhijAnAmi raNe shatrUnvijeShyasi
shlokas.55:
yato dharmastataH kRRiShNo yataH kRRiShNastato jayaH |
yudhyasva gachCha kaunteya pRRichCha mAM kiM bravImi te
shlokas.56:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pRRichChAmi tvAM dvijashreShTha shRRiNu me yadvivakShitam |
kathaM jayeyaM sa~NgrAme bhavantamaparAjitam
shlokas.57:
droNa uvAcha||
na te.asti vijayastAvadyAvadyudhyAmyahaM raNe |
mamAshu nidhane rAjanyatasva saha sodaraiH
shlokas.58:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
hanta tasmAnmahAbAho vadhopAyaM vadAtmanaH |
AchArya praNipatyaiSha pRRichChAmi tvAM namo.astu te
shlokas.59:
droNa uvAcha||
na shatruM tAta pashyAmi yo mAM hanyAdraNe sthitam |
yudhyamAnaM susa.nrabdhaM sharavarShaughavarShiNam
shlokas.60:
RRite prAyagataM rAjannyastashastramachetanam |
hanyAnmAM yudhi yodhAnAM satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.61:
shastraM chAhaM raNe jahyAM shrutvA sumahadapriyam |
shraddheyavAkyAtpuruShAdetatsatyaM bravImi te
shlokas.62:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etachChrutvA mahArAja bhAradvAjasya dhImataH |
anumAnya tamAchAryaM prAyAchChAradvataM prati
shlokas.63:
so.abhivAdya kRRipaM rAjA kRRitvA chApi pradakShiNam |
uvAcha durdharShatamaM vAkyaM vAkyavishAradaH
shlokas.64:
anumAnaye tvAM yotsyAmi guro vigatakalmaShaH |
jayeyaM cha ripUnsarvAnanuj~nAtastvayAnagha
shlokas.65:
kRRipa uvAcha||
yadi mAM nAbhigachChethA yuddhAya kRRitanishchayaH |
shapeyaM tvAM mahArAja parAbhAvAya sarvashaH
shlokas.66:
arthasya puruSho dAso dAsastvartho na kasyachit |
iti satyaM mahArAja baddho.asmyarthena kauravaiH
shlokas.67:
teShAmarthe mahArAja yoddhavyamiti me matiH |
atastvAM klIbavadbrUmi yuddhAdanyatkimichChasi
shlokas.69:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
hanta pRRichChAmi te tasmAdAchArya shRRiNu me vachaH |
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityuktvA vyathito rAjA novAcha gatachetanaH |
taM gautamaH pratyuvAcha vij~nAyAsya vivakShitam
avadhyo.ahaM mahIpAla yudhyasva jayamApnuhi
shlokas.70:
prItastvabhigamenAhaM jayaM tava narAdhipa |
AshAsiShye sadotthAya satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.71:
etachChrutvA mahArAja gautamasya vachastadA |
anumAnya kRRipaM rAjA prayayau yena madrarAT
shlokas.72:
sa shalyamabhivAdyAtha kRRitvA chAbhipradakShiNam |
uvAcha rAjA durdharShamAtmaniHshreyasaM vachaH
shlokas.73:
anumAnaye tvAM yotsyAmi guro vigatakalmaShaH |
jayeyaM cha mahArAja anuj~nAtastvayA ripUn
shlokas.74:
shalya uvAcha||
yadi mAM nAbhigachChethA yuddhAya kRRitanishchayaH |
shapeyaM tvAM mahArAja parAbhAvAya vai raNe
shlokas.75:
tuShTo.asmi pUjitashchAsmi yatkA~NkShasi tadastu te |
anujAnAmi chaiva tvAM yudhyasva jayamApnuhi
shlokas.76:
brUhi chaiva paraM vIra kenArthaH kiM dadAmi te |
evaM gate mahArAja yuddhAdanyatkimichChasi
shlokas.77:
arthasya puruSho dAso dAsastvartho na kasyachit |
iti satyaM mahArAja baddho.asmyarthena kauravaiH
shlokas.78:
kariShyAmi hi te kAmaM bhAgineya yathepsitam |
bravImyataH klIbavattvAM yuddhAdanyatkimichChasi
shlokas.79:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mantrayasva mahArAja nityaM maddhitamuttamam |
kAmaM yudhya parasyArthe varametadvRRiNomyaham
shlokas.80:
shalya uvAcha||
brUhi kimatra sAhyaM te karomi nRRipasattama |
kAmaM yotsye parasyArthe vRRito.asmyarthena kauravaiH
shlokas.81:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sa eva me varaH satya udyoge yastvayA kRRitaH |
sUtaputrasya sa~NgrAme kAryastejovadhastvayA
shlokas.82:
shalya uvAcha||
sampatsyatyeSha te kAmaH kuntIputra yathepsitaH |
gachCha yudhyasva visrabdhaM pratijAne jayaM tava
shlokas.83:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
anumAnyAtha kaunteyo mAtulaM madrakeshvaram |
nirjagAma mahAsainyAdbhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.84:
vAsudevastu rAdheyamAhave.abhijagAma vai |
tata enamuvAchedaM pANDavArthe gadAgrajaH
shlokas.85:
shrutaM me karNa bhIShmasya dveShAtkila na yotsyasi |
asmAnvaraya rAdheya yAvadbhIShmo na hanyate
shlokas.86:
hate tu bhIShme rAdheya punareShyasi sa.nyuge |
dhArtarAShTrasya sAhAyyaM yadi pashyasi chetsamam
shlokas.87:
karNa uvAcha||
na vipriyaM kariShyAmi dhArtarAShTrasya keshava |
tyaktaprANaM hi mAM viddhi duryodhanahitaiShiNam
shlokas.88:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tachChrutvA vachanaM kRRiShNaH saMnyavartata bhArata |
yudhiShThirapurogaishcha pANDavaiH saha sa~NgataH
shlokas.89:
atha sainyasya madhye tu prAkroshatpANDavAgrajaH |
yo.asmAnvRRiNoti tadahaM varaye sAhyakAraNAt
shlokas.90:
atha tAnsamabhiprekShya yuyutsuridamabravIt |
prItAtmA dharmarAjAnaM kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.91:
ahaM yotsyAmi miShataH sa.nyuge dhArtarAShTrajAn |
yuShmadarthe mahArAja yadi mAM vRRiNuShe.anagha
shlokas.92:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ehyehi sarve yotsyAmastava bhrAtR^InapaNDitAn |
yuyutso vAsudevashcha vayaM cha brUma sarvashaH
shlokas.93:
vRRiNomi tvAM mahAbAho yudhyasva mama kAraNAt |
tvayi piNDashcha tantushcha dhRRitarAShTrasya dRRishyate
shlokas.95:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato yuyutsuH kauravyaH parityajya sutA.nstava |
jagAma pANDuputrANAM senAM vishrAvya dundubhim
shlokas.96:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA samprahRRiShTaH sahAnujaiH |
jagrAha kavachaM bhUyo dIptimatkanakojjvalam
shlokas.97:
pratyapadyanta te sarve rathAnsvAnpuruSharShabhAH |
tato vyUhaM yathApUrvaM pratyavyUhanta te punaH
shlokas.98:
avAdayandundubhI.nshcha shatashashchaiva puShkarAn |
siMhanAdA.nshcha vividhAnvineduH puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.99:
rathasthAnpuruShavyAghrAnpANDavAnprekShya pArthivAH |
dhRRiShTadyumnAdayaH sarve punarjahRRiShire mudA
shlokas.100:
gauravaM pANDuputrANAM mAnyAnmAnayatAM cha tAn |
dRRiShTvA mahIkShitastatra pUjayAM chakrire bhRRisham
shlokas.101:
sauhRRidaM cha kRRipAM chaiva prAptakAlaM mahAtmanAm |
dayAM cha j~nAtiShu parAM kathayAM chakrire nRRipAH
shlokas.102:
sAdhu sAdhviti sarvatra nishcheruH stutisaMhitAH |
vAchaH puNyAH kIrtimatAM manohRRidayaharShiNIH
shlokas.103:
mlechChAshchAryAshcha ye tatra dadRRishuH shushruvustadA |
vRRittaM tatpANDuputrANAM ruruduste sagadgadAH
shlokas.104:
tato jaghnurmahAbherIH shatashashchaiva puShkarAn |
sha~NkhA.nshcha gokShIranibhAndadhmurhRRiShTA manasvinaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
evaM vyUDheShvanIkeShu mAmakeShvitareShu cha |
ke pUrvaM prAhara.nstatra kuravaH pANDavAstathA
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito rAjanputro duryodhanastava |
bhIShmaM pramukhataH kRRitvA prayayau saha senayA
shlokas.3:
tathaiva pANDavAH sarve bhImasenapurogamAH |
bhIShmeNa yuddhamichChantaH prayayurhRRiShTamAnasAH
shlokas.4:
kShveDAH kilakilAshabdAH krakachA goviShANikAH |
bherImRRida~NgamurajA hayaku~njaranisvanAH
shlokas.5:
ubhayoH senayo rAja.nstataste.asmAnsamAdravan |
vayaM pratinadantashcha tadAsIttumulaM mahat
shlokas.6:
mahAntyanIkAni mahAsamuchChraye; samAgame pANDavadhArtarAShTrayoH |
chakampire sha~NkhamRRida~NganisvanaiH; prakampitAnIva vanAni vAyunA
shlokas.7:
narendranAgAshvarathAkulAnA;mabhyAyatInAmashive muhUrte |
babhUva ghoShastumulashchamUnAM; vAtoddhutAnAmiva sAgarANAm
shlokas.8:
tasminsamutthite shabde tumule lomaharShaNe |
bhImaseno mahAbAhuH prANadadgovRRiSho yathA
shlokas.9:
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShaM vAraNAnAM cha bRRiMhitam |
siMhanAdaM cha sainyAnAM bhImasenaravo.abhyabhUt
shlokas.10:
hayAnAM heShamANAnAmanIkeShu sahasrashaH |
sarvAnabhyabhavachChabdAnbhImasenasya nisvanaH
shlokas.11:
taM shrutvA ninadaM tasya sainyAstava vitatrasuH |
jImUtasyeva nadataH shakrAshanisamasvanam
shlokas.12:
vAhanAni cha sarvANi shakRRinmUtraM prasusruvuH |
shabdena tasya vIrasya siMhasyevetare mRRigAH
shlokas.13:
darshayanghoramAtmAnaM mahAbhramiva nAdayan |
vibhIShaya.nstava sutA.nstava senAM samabhyayAt
shlokas.14:
tamAyAntaM maheShvAsaM sodaryAH paryavArayan |
ChAdayantaH sharavrAtairmeghA iva divAkaram
shlokas.15:
duryodhanashcha putraste durmukho duHsahaH shalaH |
duHshAsanashchAtirathastathA durmarShaNo nRRipa
shlokas.16:
vivi.nshatishchitraseno vikarNashcha mahArathaH |
purumitro jayo bhojaH saumadattishcha vIryavAn
shlokas.17:
mahAchApAni dhunvanto jaladA iva vidyutaH |
AdadAnAshcha nArAchAnnirmuktAshIviShopamAn
shlokas.18:
atha tAndraupadIputrAH saubhadrashcha mahArathaH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
shlokas.19:
dhArtarAShTrAnpratiyayurardayantaH shitaiH sharaiH |
vajrairiva mahAvegaiH shikharANi dharAbhRRitAm
shlokas.20:
tasminprathamasaMmarde bhImajyAtalanisvane |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha nAsItkashchitparA~NmukhaH
shlokas.21:
lAghavaM droNashiShyANAmapashyaM bharatarShabha |
nimittavedhinAM rAja~nsharAnutsRRijatAM bhRRisham
shlokas.22:
nopashAmyati nirghoSho dhanuShAM kUjatAM tathA |
vinishcheruH sharA dIptA jyotIMShIva nabhastalAt
shlokas.23:
sarve tvanye mahIpAlAH prekShakA iva bhArata |
dadRRishurdarshanIyaM taM bhImaM j~nAtisamAgamam
shlokas.24:
tataste jAtasa.nrambhAH parasparakRRitAgasaH |
anyonyaspardhayA rAjanvyAyachChanta mahArathAH
shlokas.25:
kurupANDavasene te hastyashvarathasa~Nkule |
shushubhAte raNe.atIva paTe chitragate iva
shlokas.26:
tataste pArthivAH sarve pragRRihItasharAsanAH |
sahasainyAH samApetuH putrasya tava shAsanAt
shlokas.27:
yudhiShThireNa chAdiShTAH pArthivAste sahasrashaH |
vinadantaH samApetuH putrasya tava vAhinIm
shlokas.28:
ubhayoH senayostIvraH sainyAnAM sa samAgamaH |
antardhIyata chAdityaH sainyena rajasAvRRitaH
shlokas.29:
prayuddhAnAM prabhagnAnAM punarAvartatAmapi |
nAtra sveShAM pareShAM vA visheShaH samajAyata
shlokas.30:
tasmi.nstu tumule yuddhe vartamAne mahAbhaye |
ati sarvANyanIkAni pitA te.abhivyarochata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pUrvAhNe tasya raudrasya yuddhamahno vishAM pate |
prAvartata mahAghoraM rAj~nAM dehAvakartanam
shlokas.2:
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha sa~NgrAme vijigIShatAm |
siMhAnAmiva saMhrAdo divamurvIM cha nAdayan
shlokas.3:
AsItkilakilAshabdastalasha~NkharavaiH saha |
jaj~nire siMhanAdAshcha shUrANAM pratigarjatAm
shlokas.4:
talatrAbhihatAshchaiva jyAshabdA bharatarShabha |
pattInAM pAdashabdAshcha vAjinAM cha mahAsvanAH
shlokas.5:
tottrA~NkushanipAtAshcha AyudhAnAM cha nisvanAH |
ghaNTAshabdAshcha nAgAnAmanyonyamabhidhAvatAm
shlokas.6:
tasminsamudite shabde tumule lomaharShaNe |
babhUva rathanirghoShaH parjanyaninadopamaH
shlokas.7:
te manaH krUramAdhAya samabhityaktajIvitAH |
pANDavAnabhyavartanta sarva evochChritadhvajAH
shlokas.8:
svayaM shAntanavo rAjannabhyadhAvaddhana~njayam |
pragRRihya kArmukaM ghoraM kAladaNDopamaM raNe
shlokas.9:
arjuno.api dhanurgRRihya gANDIvaM lokavishrutam |
abhyadhAvata tejasvI gA~NgeyaM raNamUrdhani
shlokas.10:
tAvubhau kurushArdUlau parasparavadhaiShiNau |
gA~Ngeyastu raNe pArthaM viddhvA nAkampayadbalI
tathaiva pANDavo rAjanbhIShmaM nAkampayadyudhi
shlokas.11:
sAtyakishcha maheShvAsaH kRRitavarmANamabhyayAt |
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.12:
sAtyakiH kRRitavarmANaM kRRitavarmA cha sAtyakim |
AnarChatuH sharairghoraistakShamANau parasparam
shlokas.13:
tau sharAchitasarvA~Ngau shushubhAte mahAbalau |
vasante puShpashabalau puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.14:
abhimanyurmaheShvAso bRRihadbalamayodhayat |
tataH kosalako rAjA saubhadrasya vishAM pate
dhvajaM chichCheda samare sArathiM cha nyapAtayat
shlokas.15:
saubhadrastu tataH kruddhaH pAtite rathasArathau |
bRRihadbalaM mahArAja vivyAdha navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.16:
athAparAbhyAM bhallAbhyAM pItAbhyAmarimardanaH |
dhvajamekena chichCheda pArShNimekena sArathim
anyonyaM cha sharaistIkShNaiH kruddhau rAja.nstatakShatuH
shlokas.17:
mAninaM samare dRRiptaM kRRitavairaM mahAratham |
bhImasenastava sutaM duryodhanamayodhayat
shlokas.18:
tAvubhau narashArdUlau kurumukhyau mahAbalau |
anyonyaM sharavarShAbhyAM vavRRiShAte raNAjire
shlokas.19:
tau tu vIkShya mahAtmAnau kRRitinau chitrayodhinau |
vismayaH sarvabhUtAnAM samapadyata bhArata
shlokas.20:
duHshAsanastu nakulaM pratyudyAya mahAratham |
avidhyannishitairbANairbahubhirmarmabhedibhiH
shlokas.21:
tasya mAdrIsutaH ketuM sasharaM cha sharAsanam |
chichCheda nishitairbANaiH prahasanniva bhArata
athainaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA kShudrakANAM samArdayat
shlokas.22:
putrastu tava durdharSho nakulasya mahAhave |
yugeShAM chichChide bANairdhvajaM chaiva nyapAtayat
shlokas.23:
durmukhaH sahadevaM tu pratyudyAya mahAbalam |
vivyAdha sharavarSheNa yatamAnaM mahAhave
shlokas.24:
sahadevastato vIro durmukhasya mahAhave |
shareNa bhRRishatIkShNena pAtayAmAsa sArathim
shlokas.25:
tAvanyonyaM samAsAdya samare yuddhadurmadau |
trAsayetAM sharairghoraiH kRRitapratikRRitaiShiNau
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThiraH svayaM rAjA madrarAjAnamabhyayAt |
tasya madrAdhipashchApaM dvidhA chichCheda mAriSha
shlokas.27:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
anyatkArmukamAdAya vegavadbalavattaram
shlokas.28:
tato madreshvaraM rAjA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
ChAdayAmAsa sa~NkruddhastiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.29:
dhRRiShTadyumnastato droNamabhyadravata bhArata |
tasya droNaH susa~NkruddhaH parAsukaraNaM dRRiDham
tridhA chichCheda samare yatamAnasya kArmukam
shlokas.30:
sharaM chaiva mahAghoraM kAladaNDamivAparam |
preShayAmAsa samare so.asya kAye nyamajjata
shlokas.31:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sAyakA.nshcha chaturdasha |
droNaM drupadaputrastu prativivyAdha sa.nyuge
tAvanyonyaM susa~Nkruddhau chakratuH subhRRishaM raNam
shlokas.32:
saumadattiM raNe sha~Nkho rabhasaM rabhaso yudhi |
pratyudyayau mahArAja tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.33:
tasya vai dakShiNaM vIro nirbibheda raNe bhujam |
saumadattistathA sha~NkhaM jatrudeshe samAhanat
shlokas.34:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM ghorarUpaM vishAM pate |
dRRiptayoH samare tUrNaM vRRitravAsavayoriva
shlokas.35:
bAhlIkaM tu raNe kruddhaM kruddharUpo vishAM pate |
abhyadravadameyAtmA dhRRiShTaketurmahArathaH
shlokas.36:
bAhlIkastu tato rAjandhRRiShTaketumamarShaNam |
sharairbahubhirAnarChatsiMhanAdamathAnadat
shlokas.37:
chedirAjastu sa~Nkruddho bAhlIkaM navabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha samare tUrNaM matto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.38:
tau tatra samare kruddhau nardantau cha muhurmuhuH |
samIyatuH susa~NkruddhAva~NgArakabudhAviva
shlokas.39:
rAkShasaM krUrakarmANaM krUrakarmA ghaTotkachaH |
alambusaM pratyudiyAdbalaM shakra ivAhave
shlokas.40:
ghaTotkachastu sa~Nkruddho rAkShasaM taM mahAbalam |
navatyA sAyakaistIkShNairdArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.41:
alambusastu samare bhaimaseniM mahAbalam |
bahudhA vArayAmAsa sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.42:
vyabhrAjetAM tatastau tu sa.nyuge sharavikShatau |
yathA devAsure yuddhe balashakrau mahAbalau
shlokas.43:
shikhaNDI samare rAjandrauNimabhyudyayau balI |
ashvatthAmA tataH kruddhaH shikhaNDinamavasthitam
shlokas.44:
nArAchena sutIkShNena bhRRishaM viddhvA vyakampayat |
shikhaNDyapi tato rAjandroNaputramatADayat
shlokas.45:
sAyakena supItena tIkShNena nishitena cha |
tau jaghnatustadAnyonyaM sharairbahuvidhairmRRidhe
shlokas.46:
bhagadattaM raNe shUraM virATo vAhinIpatiH |
abhyayAttvarito rAja.nstato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.47:
virATo bhagadattena sharavarSheNa tADitaH |
abhyavarShatsusa~Nkruddho megho vRRiShTyA ivAchalam
shlokas.48:
bhagadattastatastUrNaM virATaM pRRithivIpatim |
ChAdayAmAsa samare meghaH sUryamivoditam
shlokas.49:
bRRihatkShatraM tu kaikeyaM kRRipaH shAradvato yayau |
taM kRRipaH sharavarSheNa ChAdayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.50:
gautamaM kekayaH kruddhaH sharavRRiShTyAbhyapUrayat |
tAvanyonyaM hayAnhatvA dhanuShI vinikRRitya vai
shlokas.51:
virathAvasiyuddhAya samIyaturamarShaNau |
tayostadabhavadyuddhaM ghorarUpaM sudAruNam
shlokas.52:
drupadastu tato rAjA saindhavaM vai jayadratham |
abhyudyayau samprahRRiShTo hRRiShTarUpaM parantapa
shlokas.53:
tataH saindhavako rAjA drupadaM vishikhaistribhiH |
tADayAmAsa samare sa cha taM pratyavidhyata
shlokas.54:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM ghorarUpaM sudAruNam |
IkShitRRiprItijananaM shukrA~NgArakayoriva
shlokas.55:
vikarNastu sutastubhyaM sutasomaM mahAbalam |
abhyayAjjavanairashvaistato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.56:
vikarNaH sutasomaM tu viddhvA nAkampayachCharaiH |
sutasomo vikarNaM cha tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.57:
susharmANaM naravyAghraM chekitAno mahArathaH |
abhyadravatsusa~NkruddhaH pANDavArthe parAkramI
shlokas.58:
susharmA tu mahArAja chekitAnaM mahAratham |
mahatA sharavarSheNa vArayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.59:
chekitAno.api sa.nrabdhaH susharmANaM mahAhave |
prAchChAdayattamiShubhirmahAmegha ivAchalam
shlokas.60:
shakuniH prativindhyaM tu parAkrAntaM parAkramI |
abhyadravata rAjendra matto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.61:
yaudhiShThirastu sa~NkruddhaH saubalaM nishitaiH sharaiH |
vyadArayata sa~NgrAme maghavAniva dAnavam
shlokas.62:
shakuniH prativindhyaM tu pratividhyantamAhave |
vyadArayanmahAprAj~naH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.63:
sudakShiNaM tu rAjendra kAmbojAnAM mahAratham |
shrutakarmA parAkrAntamabhyadravata sa.nyuge
shlokas.64:
sudakShiNastu samare sAhadeviM mahAratham |
viddhvA nAkampayata vai mainAkamiva parvatam
shlokas.65:
shrutakarmA tataH kruddhaH kAmbojAnAM mahAratham |
sharairbahubhirAnarChaddArayanniva sarvashaH
shlokas.66:
irAvAnatha sa~NkruddhaH shrutAyuShamamarShaNam |
pratyudyayau raNe yatto yattarUpataraM tataH
shlokas.67:
Arjunistasya samare hayAnhatvA mahArathaH |
nanAda sumahannAdaM tatsainyaM pratyapUrayat
shlokas.68:
shrutAyustvatha sa~NkruddhaH phAlguneH samare hayAn |
nijaghAna gadAgreNa tato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.69:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau kuntibhojaM mahAratham |
sasenaM sasutaM vIraM sa.nsasajjaturAhave
shlokas.70:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma AvantyAnAM parAkramam |
yadayudhyansthirA bhUtvA mahatyA senayA saha
shlokas.72:
kuntibhojasutashchApi vindaM vivyAdha sAyakaiH |
sa cha taM prativivyAdha tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.73:
kekayA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha gAndhArAnpa~ncha mAriSha |
sasainyAste sasainyA.nshcha yodhayAmAsurAhave
shlokas.74:
vIrabAhushcha te putro vairATiM rathasattamam |
uttaraM yodhayAmAsa vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
uttarashchApi taM dhIraM vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.75:
chedirATsamare rAjannulUkaM samabhidravat |
ulUkashchApi taM bANairnishitairlomavAhibhiH
shlokas.76:
tayoryuddhaM samabhavadghorarUpaM vishAM pate |
dArayetAM susa~NkruddhAvanyonyamaparAjitau
shlokas.77:
evaM dva.ndvasahasrANi rathavAraNavAjinAm |
padAtInAM cha samare tava teShAM cha sa~Nkulam
shlokas.78:
muhUrtamiva tadyuddhamAsInmadhuradarshanam |
tata unmattavadrAjanna prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.79:
gajo gajena samare rathI cha rathinaM yayau |
ashvo.ashvaM samabhipretya padAtishcha padAtinam
shlokas.80:
tato yuddhaM sudurdharShaM vyAkulaM samapadyata |
shUrANAM samare tatra samAsAdya parasparam
shlokas.81:
tatra devarShayaH siddhAshchAraNAshcha samAgatAH |
praikShanta tadraNaM ghoraM devAsuraraNopamam
shlokas.82:
tato dantisahasrANi rathAnAM chApi mAriSha |
ashvaughAH puruShaughAshcha viparItaM samAyayuH
shlokas.83:
tatra tatraiva dRRishyante rathavAraNapattayaH |
sAdinashcha naravyAghra yudhyamAnA muhurmuhuH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAja~nshatasahasrANi tatra tatra tadA tadA |
nirmaryAdaM prayuddhAni tatte vakShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.2:
na putraH pitaraM jaj~ne na pitA putramaurasam |
na bhrAtA bhrAtaraM tatra svasrIyaM na cha mAtulaH
shlokas.3:
mAtulaM na cha svasrIyo na sakhAyaM sakhA tathA |
AviShTA iva yudhyante pANDavAH kurubhiH saha
shlokas.4:
rathAnIkaM naravyAghrAH kechidabhyapatanrathaiH |
abhajyanta yugaireva yugAni bharatarShabha
shlokas.5:
ratheShAshcha ratheShAbhiH kUbarA rathakUbaraiH |
saMhatAH saMhataiH kechitparasparajighA.nsavaH
shlokas.6:
na shekushchalituM kechitsaMnipatya rathA rathaiH |
prabhinnAstu mahAkAyAH saMnipatya gajA gajaiH
shlokas.7:
bahudhAdArayankruddhA viShANairitaretaram |
satomarapatAkaishcha vAraNAH paravAraNaiH
shlokas.8:
abhisRRitya mahArAja vegavadbhirmahAgajaiH |
dantairabhihatAstatra chukrushuH paramAturAH
shlokas.9:
abhinItAshcha shikShAbhistottrA~NkushasamAhatAH |
suprabhinnAH prabhinnAnAM saMmukhAbhimukhA yayuH
shlokas.10:
prabhinnairapi sa.nsaktAH kechittatra mahAgajAH |
krau~nchavanninadaM muktvA prAdravanta tatastataH
shlokas.11:
samyakpraNItA nAgAshcha prabhinnakaraTAmukhAH |
RRiShTitomaranArAchairnirviddhA varavAraNAH
shlokas.12:
vinedurbhinnamarmANo nipetushcha gatAsavaH |
prAdravanta dishaH kechinnadanto bhairavAnravAn
shlokas.13:
gajAnAM pAdarakShAstu vyUDhoraskAH prahAriNaH |
RRiShTibhishcha dhanurbhishcha vimalaishcha parashvadhaiH
shlokas.14:
gadAbhirmusalaishchaiva bhiNDipAlaiH satomaraiH |
AyasaiH parighaishchaiva nistri.nshairvimalaiH shitaiH
shlokas.15:
pragRRihItaiH susa.nrabdhA dhAvamAnAstatastataH |
vyadRRishyanta mahArAja parasparajighA.nsavaH
shlokas.16:
rAjamAnAshcha nistri.nshAH sa.nsiktA narashoNitaiH |
pratyadRRishyanta shUrANAmanyonyamabhidhAvatAm
shlokas.17:
avakShiptAvadhUtAnAmasInAM vIrabAhubhiH |
sa~njaj~ne tumulaH shabdaH patatAM paramarmasu
shlokas.18:
gadAmusalarugNAnAM bhinnAnAM cha varAsibhiH |
dantidantAvabhinnAnAM mRRiditAnAM cha dantibhiH
shlokas.19:
tatra tatra naraughANAM kroshatAmitaretaram |
shushruvurdAruNA vAchaH pretAnAmiva bhArata
shlokas.20:
hayairapi hayArohAshchAmarApIDadhAribhiH |
ha.nsairiva mahAvegairanyonyamabhidudruvuH
shlokas.21:
tairvimuktA mahAprAsA jAmbUnadavibhUShaNAH |
AshugA vimalAstIkShNAH sampeturbhujagopamAH
shlokas.22:
ashvairagryajavaiH kechidAplutya mahato rathAn |
shirA.nsyAdadire vIrA rathinAmashvasAdinaH
shlokas.23:
bahUnapi hayArohAnbhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
rathI jaghAna samprApya bANagocharamAgatAn
shlokas.24:
nagameghapratIkAshAshchAkShipya turagAngajAH |
pAdairevAvamRRidnanta mattAH kanakabhUShaNAH
shlokas.25:
pATyamAneShu kumbheShu pArshveShvapi cha vAraNAH |
prAsairvinihatAH kechidvineduH paramAturAH
shlokas.26:
sAshvArohAnhayAnkechidunmathya varavAraNAH |
sahasA chikShipustatra sa~Nkule bhairave sati
shlokas.27:
sAshvArohAnviShANAgrairutkShipya turagAndvipAH |
rathaughAnavamRRidnantaH sadhvajAnparichakramuH
shlokas.28:
pu.nstvAdabhimadatvAchcha kechidatra mahAgajAH |
sAshvArohAnhayA~njaghnuH karaiH sacharaNaistathA
shlokas.29:
kechidAkShipya kariNaH sAshvAnapi rathAnkaraiH |
vikarShanto dishaH sarvAH samIyuH sarvashabdagAH
shlokas.30:
AshugA vimalAstIkShNAH sampeturbhujagopamAH |
narAshvakAyAnnirbhidya lauhAni kavachAni cha
shlokas.31:
nipeturvimalAH shaktyo vIrabAhubhirarpitAH |
maholkApratimA ghorAstatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.32:
dvIpicharmAvanaddhaishcha vyAghracharmashayairapi |
vikoshairvimalaiH khaDgairabhijaghnuH parAnraNe
shlokas.33:
abhiplutamabhikruddhamekapArshvAvadAritam |
vidarshayantaH sampetuH khaDgacharmaparashvadhaiH
shlokas.34:
shaktibhirdAritAH kechitsa~nChinnAshcha parashvadhaiH |
hastibhirmRRiditAH kechitkShuNNAshchAnye tura~NgamaiH
shlokas.35:
rathaneminikRRittAshcha nikRRittA nishitaiH sharaiH |
vikroshanti narA rAja.nstatra tatra sma bAndhavAn
shlokas.36:
putrAnanye pitR^Inanye bhrAtR^I.nshcha saha bAndhavaiH |
mAtulAnbhAgineyA.nshcha parAnapi cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.37:
vikIrNAntrAH subahavo bhagnasakthAshcha bhArata |
bAhubhiH subhujAchChinnaiH pArshveShu cha vidAritAH
krandantaH samadRRishyanta tRRiShitA jIvitepsavaH
shlokas.38:
tRRiShNAparigatAH kechidalpasattvA vishAM pate |
bhUmau nipatitAH sa~Nkhye jalameva yayAchire
shlokas.39:
rudhiraughapariklinnAH klishyamAnAshcha bhArata |
vyanindanbhRRishamAtmAnaM tava putrA.nshcha sa~NgatAn
shlokas.40:
apare kShatriyAH shUrAH kRRitavairAH parasparam |
naiva shastraM vimu~nchanti naiva krandanti mAriSha
tarjayanti cha saMhRRiShTAstatra tatra parasparam
shlokas.41:
nirdashya dashanaishchApi krodhAtsvadashanachChadAn |
bhrukuTIkuTilairvaktraiH prekShante cha parasparam
shlokas.42:
apare klishyamAnAstu vraNArtAH sharapIDitAH |
niShkUjAH samapadyanta dRRiDhasattvA mahAbalAH
shlokas.43:
anye tu virathAH shUrA rathamanyasya sa.nyuge |
prArthayAnA nipatitAH sa~NkShuNNA varavAraNaiH
ashobhanta mahArAja puShpitA iva ki.nshukAH
shlokas.44:
sambabhUvuranIkeShu bahavo bhairavasvanAH |
vartamAne mahAbhIme tasminvIravarakShaye
shlokas.45:
ahanattu pitA putraM putrashcha pitaraM raNe |
svasrIyo mAtulaM chApi svasrIyaM chApi mAtulaH
shlokas.46:
sakhAyaM cha sakhA rAjansambandhI bAndhavaM tathA |
evaM yuyudhire tatra kuravaH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.47:
vartamAne bhaye tasminnirmaryAde mahAhave |
bhIShmamAsAdya pArthAnAM vAhinI samakampata
shlokas.48:
ketunA pa~nchatAreNa tAlena bharatarShabha |
rAjatena mahAbAhuruchChritena mahArathe
babhau bhIShmastadA rAja.nshchandramA iva meruNA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
gatapUrvAhNabhUyiShThe tasminnahani dAruNe |
vartamAne mahAraudre mahAvIravarakShaye
shlokas.2:
durmukhaH kRRitavarmA cha kRRipaH shalyo vivi.nshatiH |
bhIShmaM jugupurAsAdya tava putreNa choditAH
shlokas.3:
etairatirathairguptaH pa~nchabhirbharatarShabha |
pANDavAnAmanIkAni vijagAhe mahArathaH
shlokas.4:
chedikAshikarUSheShu pA~nchAleShu cha bhArata |
bhIShmasya bahudhA tAlashcharanketuradRRishyata
shlokas.5:
shirA.nsi cha tadA bhIShmo bAhU.nshchApi sahAyudhAn |
nichakarta mahAvegairbhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.6:
nRRityato rathamArgeShu bhIShmasya bharatarShabha |
kechidArtasvaraM chakrurnAgA marmaNi tADitAH
shlokas.7:
abhimanyuH susa~NkruddhaH pisha~NgaisturagottamaiH |
sa.nyuktaM rathamAsthAya prAyAdbhIShmarathaM prati
shlokas.8:
jAmbUnadavichitreNa karNikAreNa ketunA |
abhyavarShata bhIShmaM cha tA.nshchaiva rathasattamAn
shlokas.9:
sa tAlaketostIkShNena ketumAhatya patriNA |
bhIShmeNa yuyudhe vIrastasya chAnucharaiH saha
shlokas.10:
kRRitavarmANamekena shalyaM pa~nchabhirAyasaiH |
viddhvA navabhirAnarChachChitAgraiH prapitAmaham
shlokas.11:
pUrNAyatavisRRiShTena samyakpraNihitena cha |
dhvajamekena vivyAdha jAmbUnadavibhUShitam
shlokas.12:
durmukhasya tu bhallena sarvAvaraNabhedinA |
jahAra sAratheH kAyAchChiraH saMnataparvaNA
shlokas.13:
dhanushchichCheda bhallena kArtasvaravibhUShitam |
kRRipasya nishitAgreNa tA.nshcha tIkShNamukhaiH sharaiH
shlokas.14:
jaghAna paramakruddho nRRityanniva mahArathaH |
tasya lAghavamudvIkShya tutuShurdevatA api
shlokas.15:
labdhalakShyatayA karShNeH sarve bhIShmamukhA rathAH |
sattvavantamamanyanta sAkShAdiva dhana~njayam
shlokas.16:
tasya lAghavamArgasthamalAtasadRRishaprabham |
dishaH paryapatachchApaM gANDIvamiva ghoShavat
shlokas.17:
tamAsAdya mahAvegairbhIShmo navabhirAshugaiH |
vivyAdha samare tUrNamArjuniM paravIrahA
shlokas.18:
dhvajaM chAsya tribhirbhallaishchichCheda paramaujasaH |
sArathiM cha tribhirbANairAjaghAna yatavrataH
shlokas.19:
tathaiva kRRitavarmA cha kRRipaH shalyashcha mAriSha |
viddhvA nAkampayatkArShNiM mainAkamiva parvatam
shlokas.20:
sa taiH parivRRitaH shUro dhArtarAShTrairmahArathaiH |
vavarSha sharavarShANi kArShNiH pa~ncharathAnprati
shlokas.21:
tatasteShAM mahAstrANi sa.nvArya sharavRRiShTibhiH |
nanAda balavAnkArShNirbhIShmAya visRRija~nsharAn
shlokas.22:
tatrAsya sumahadrAjanbAhvorbalamadRRishyata |
yatamAnasya samare bhIShmamardayataH sharaiH
shlokas.23:
parAkrAntasya tasyaiva bhIShmo.api prAhiNochCharAn |
sa tA.nshchichCheda samare bhIShmachApachyutA~nsharAn
shlokas.24:
tato dhvajamamogheShurbhIShmasya navabhiH sharaiH |
chichCheda samare vIrastata uchchukrushurjanAH
shlokas.25:
sa rAjato mahAskandhastAlo hemavibhUShitaH |
saubhadravishikhaishChinnaH papAta bhuvi bhArata
shlokas.26:
dhvajaM saubhadravishikhaiH patitaM bharatarShabha |
dRRiShTvA bhImo.anadaddhRRiShTaH saubhadramabhiharShayan
shlokas.27:
atha bhIShmo mahAstrANi divyAni cha bahUni cha |
prAdushchakre mahAraudraH kShaNe tasminmahAbalaH
shlokas.28:
tataH shatasahasreNa saubhadraM prapitAmahaH |
avAkiradameyAtmA sharANAM nataparvaNAm
shlokas.29:
tato dasha maheShvAsAH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
rakShArthamabhyadhAvanta saubhadraM tvaritA rathaiH
shlokas.30:
virATaH saha putreNa dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
bhImashcha kekayAshchaiva sAtyakishcha vishAM pate
shlokas.31:
javenApatatAM teShAM bhIShmaH shAntanavo raNe |
pA~nchAlyaM tribhirAnarChatsAtyakiM nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.32:
pUrNAyatavisRRiShTena kShureNa nishitena cha |
dhvajamekena chichCheda bhImasenasya patriNA
shlokas.33:
jAmbUnadamayaH ketuH kesarI narasattama |
papAta bhImasenasya bhIShmeNa mathito rathAt
shlokas.34:
bhImasenastribhirviddhvA bhIShmaM shAntanavaM raNe |
kRRipamekena vivyAdha kRRitavarmANamaShTabhiH
shlokas.35:
pragRRihItAgrahastena vairATirapi dantinA |
abhyadravata rAjAnaM madrAdhipatimuttaraH
shlokas.36:
tasya vAraNarAjasya javenApatato rathI |
shalyo nivArayAmAsa vegamapratimaM raNe
shlokas.37:
tasya kruddhaH sa nAgendro bRRihataH sAdhuvAhinaH |
padA yugamadhiShThAya jaghAna chaturo hayAn
shlokas.38:
sa hatAshve rathe tiShThanmadrAdhipatirAyasIm |
uttarAntakarIM shaktiM chikShepa bhujagopamAm
shlokas.39:
tayA bhinnatanutrANaH pravishya vipulaM tamaH |
sa papAta gajaskandhAtpramuktA~NkushatomaraH
shlokas.40:
samAdAya cha shalyo.asimavaplutya rathottamAt |
vAraNendrasya vikramya chichChedAtha mahAkaram
shlokas.41:
bhinnamarmA sharavrAtaishChinnahastaH sa vAraNaH |
bhImamArtasvaraM kRRitvA papAta cha mamAra cha
shlokas.42:
etadIdRRishakaM kRRitvA madrarAjo mahArathaH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM bhAsvaraM kRRitavarmaNaH
shlokas.43:
uttaraM nihataM dRRiShTvA vairATirbhrAtaraM shubham |
kRRitavarmaNA cha sahitaM dRRiShTvA shalyamavasthitam
sha~NkhaH krodhAtprajajvAla haviShA havyavADiva
shlokas.44:
sa visphArya mahachchApaM kArtasvaravibhUShitam |
abhyadhAvajjighA.nsanvai shalyaM madrAdhipaM balI
shlokas.45:
mahatA rathava.nshena samantAtparivAritaH |
sRRijanbANamayaM varShaM prAyAchChalyarathaM prati
shlokas.46:
tamApatantaM samprekShya mattavAraNavikramam |
tAvakAnAM rathAH sapta samantAtparyavArayan
madrarAjaM parIpsanto mRRityordaMShTrAntaraM gatam
shlokas.47:
tato bhIShmo mahAbAhurvinadya jalado yathA |
tAlamAtraM dhanurgRRihya sha~NkhamabhyadravadraNe
shlokas.48:
tamudyatamudIkShyAtha maheShvAsaM mahAbalam |
santrastA pANDavI senA vAtavegahateva nauH
shlokas.49:
tatrArjunaH santvaritaH sha~NkhasyAsItpuraHsaraH |
bhIShmAdrakShyo.ayamadyeti tato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.50:
hAhAkAro mahAnAsIdyodhAnAM yudhi yudhyatAm |
tejastejasi sampRRiktamityevaM vismayaM yayuH
shlokas.51:
atha shalyo gadApANiravatIrya mahArathAt |
sha~Nkhasya chaturo vAhAnahanadbharatarShabha
shlokas.52:
sa hatAshvAdrathAttUrNaM khaDgamAdAya vidrutaH |
bIbhatsoH syandanaM prApya tataH shAntimavindata
shlokas.53:
tato bhIShmarathAttUrNamutpatanti patatriNaH |
yairantarikShaM bhUmishcha sarvataH samavastRRitam
shlokas.54:
pA~nchAlAnatha matsyA.nshcha kekayA.nshcha prabhadrakAn |
bhIShmaH praharatAM shreShThaH pAtayAmAsa mArgaNaiH
shlokas.55:
utsRRijya samare tUrNaM pANDavaM savyasAchinam |
abhyadravata pA~nchAlyaM drupadaM senayA vRRitam
priyaM sambandhinaM rAja~nsharAnavakiranbahUn
shlokas.56:
agnineva pradagdhAni vanAni shishirAtyaye |
sharadagdhAnyadRRishyanta sainyAni drupadasya ha
atiShThata raNe bhIShmo vidhUma iva pAvakaH
shlokas.57:
madhya.ndine yathAdityaM tapantamiva tejasA |
na shekuH pANDaveyasya yodhA bhIShmaM nirIkShitum
shlokas.58:
vIkShAM chakruH samantAtte pANDavA bhayapIDitAH |
trAtAraM nAdhyagachChanta gAvaH shItArditA iva
shlokas.59:
hatavipradrute sainye nirutsAhe vimardite |
hAhAkAro mahAnAsItpANDusainyeShu bhArata
shlokas.60:
tato bhIShmaH shAntanavo nityaM maNDalakArmukaH |
mumocha bANAndIptAgrAnahInAshIviShAniva
shlokas.61:
sharairekAyanIkurvandishaH sarvA yatavrataH |
jaghAna pANDavarathAnAdishyAdishya bhArata
shlokas.62:
tataH sainyeShu bhagneShu mathiteShu cha sarvashaH |
prApte chAstaM dinakare na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.63:
bhIShmaM cha samudIryantaM dRRiShTvA pArthA mahAhave |
avahAramakurvanta sainyAnAM bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kRRite.avahAre sainyAnAM prathame bharatarShabha |
bhIShme cha yudhi sa.nrabdhe hRRiShTe duryodhane tathA
shlokas.2:
dharmarAjastatastUrNamabhigamya janArdanam |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH sarvaiH sarvaishchaiva janeshvaraiH
shlokas.3:
shuchA paramayA yuktashchintayAnaH parAjayam |
vArShNeyamabravIdrAjandRRiShTvA bhIShmasya vikramam
shlokas.4:
kRRiShNa pashya maheShvAsaM bhIShmaM bhImaparAkramam |
sharairdahantaM sainyaM me grIShme kakShamivAnalam
shlokas.5:
kathamenaM mahAtmAnaM shakShyAmaH prativIkShitum |
lelihyamAnaM sainyaM me haviShmantamivAnalam
shlokas.6:
etaM hi puruShavyAghraM dhanuShmantaM mahAbalam |
dRRiShTvA vipradrutaM sainyaM madIyaM mArgaNAhatam
shlokas.7:
shakyo jetuM yamaH kruddho vajrapANishcha sa.nyuge |
varuNaH pAshabhRRichchApi kubero vA gadAdharaH
shlokas.8:
na tu bhIShmo mahAtejAH shakyo jetuM mahAbalaH |
so.ahamevaM gate magno bhIShmAgAdhajale.aplavaH
shlokas.9:
Atmano buddhidaurbalyAdbhIShmamAsAdya keshava |
vanaM yAsyAmi govinda shreyo me tatra jIvitum
shlokas.10:
na tvimAnpRRithivIpAlAndAtuM bhIShmAya mRRityave |
kShapayiShyati senAM me kRRiShNa bhIShmo mahAstravit
shlokas.11:
yathAnalaM prajvalitaM pata~NgAH samabhidrutAH |
vinAshAyaiva gachChanti tathA me sainiko janaH
shlokas.12:
kShayaM nIto.asmi vArShNeya rAjyahetoH parAkramI |
bhrAtarashchaiva me vIrAH karshitAH sharapIDitAH
shlokas.13:
matkRRite bhrAtRRisauhArdAdrAjyAdbhraShTAstathA sukhAt |
jIvitaM bahu manye.ahaM jIvitaM hyadya durlabham
shlokas.14:
jIvitasya hi sheSheNa tapastapsyAmi dushcharam |
na ghAtayiShyAmi raNe mitrANImAni keshava
shlokas.15:
rathAnme bahusAhasrAndivyairastrairmahAbalaH |
ghAtayatyanishaM bhIShmaH pravarANAM prahAriNAm
shlokas.16:
kiM nu kRRitvA kRRitaM me syAdbrUhi mAdhava mAchiram |
madhyasthamiva pashyAmi samare savyasAchinam
shlokas.17:
eko bhImaH paraM shaktyA yudhyatyeSha mahAbhujaH |
kevalaM bAhuvIryeNa kShatradharmamanusmaran
shlokas.18:
gadayA vIraghAtinyA yathotsAhaM mahAmanAH |
karotyasukaraM karma gajAshvarathapattiShu
shlokas.19:
nAlameSha kShayaM kartuM parasainyasya mAriSha |
Arjavenaiva yuddhena vIra varShashatairapi
shlokas.20:
eko.astravitsakhA te.ayaM so.apyasmAnsamupekShate |
nirdahyamAnAnbhIShmeNa droNena cha mahAtmanA
shlokas.21:
divyAnyastrANi bhIShmasya droNasya cha mahAtmanaH |
dhakShyanti kShatriyAnsarvAnprayuktAni punaH punaH
shlokas.22:
kRRiShNa bhIShmaH susa.nrabdhaH sahitaH sarvapArthivaiH |
kShapayiShyati no nUnaM yAdRRisho.asya parAkramaH
shlokas.23:
sa tvaM pashya maheShvAsaM yogIShvara mahAratham |
yo bhIShmaM shamayetsa~Nkhye dAvAgniM jalado yathA
shlokas.24:
tava prasAdAdgovinda pANDavA nihatadviShaH |
svarAjyamanusamprAptA modiShyanti sabAndhavAH
shlokas.25:
evamuktvA tataH pArtho dhyAyannAste mahAmanAH |
chiramantarmanA bhUtvA shokopahatachetanaH
shlokas.26:
shokArtaM pANDavaM j~nAtvA duHkhena hatachetasam |
abravIttatra govindo harShayansarvapANDavAn
shlokas.27:
mA shucho bharatashreShTha na tvaM shochitumarhasi |
yasya te bhrAtaraH shUrAH sarvalokasya dhanvinaH
shlokas.28:
ahaM cha priyakRRidrAjansAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
virATadrupadau vRRiddhau dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
shlokas.29:
tathaiva sabalAH sarve rAjAno rAjasattama |
tvatprasAdaM pratIkShante tvadbhaktAshcha vishAM pate
shlokas.30:
eSha te pArShato nityaM hitakAmaH priye rataH |
senApatyamanuprApto dhRRiShTadyumno mahAbalaH
shikhaNDI cha mahAbAho bhIShmasya nidhanaM kila
shlokas.31:
etachChrutvA tato rAjA dhRRiShTadyumnaM mahAratham |
abravItsamitau tasyAM vAsudevasya shRRiNvataH
shlokas.32:
dhRRiShTadyumna nibodhedaM yattvA vakShyAmi mAriSha |
nAtikramyaM bhavettachcha vachanaM mama bhAShitam
shlokas.33:
bhavAnsenApatirmahyaM vAsudevena saMmataH |
kArttikeyo yathA nityaM devAnAmabhavatpurA
tathA tvamapi pANDUnAM senAnIH puruSharShabha
shlokas.34:
sa tvaM puruShashArdUla vikramya jahi kauravAn |
ahaM cha tvAnuyAsyAmi bhImaH kRRiShNashcha mAriSha
shlokas.35:
mAdrIputrau cha sahitau draupadeyAshcha da.nshitAH |
ye chAnye pRRithivIpAlAH pradhAnAH puruSharShabha
shlokas.36:
tata uddharShayansarvAndhRRiShTadyumno.abhyabhAShata |
ahaM droNAntakaH pArtha vihitaH shambhunA purA
shlokas.37:
raNe bhIShmaM tathA droNaM kRRipaM shalyaM jayadratham |
sarvAnadya raNe dRRiptAnpratiyotsyAmi pArthiva
shlokas.38:
athotkruShTaM maheShvAsaiH pANDavairyuddhadurmadaiH |
samudyate pArthivendre pArShate shatrusUdane
shlokas.39:
tamabravIttataH pArthaH pArShataM pRRitanApatim |
vyUhaH krau~nchAruNo nAma sarvashatrunibarhaNaH
shlokas.40:
yaM bRRihaspatirindrAya tadA devAsure.abravIt |
taM yathAvatprativyUha parAnIkavinAshanam
adRRiShTapUrvaM rAjAnaH pashyantu kurubhiH saha
shlokas.41:
tathoktaH sa nRRidevena viShNurvajrabhRRitA iva |
prabhAte sarvasainyAnAmagre chakre dhana~njayam
shlokas.42:
AdityapathagaH ketustasyAdbhutamanoramaH |
shAsanAtpuruhUtasya nirmito vishvakarmaNA
shlokas.43:
indrAyudhasavarNAbhiH patAkAbhirala~NkRRitaH |
AkAshaga ivAkAshe gandharvanagaropamaH
nRRityamAna ivAbhAti rathacharyAsu mAriSha
shlokas.44:
tena ratnavatA pArthaH sa cha gANDIvadhanvanA |
babhUva paramopetaH svayambhUriva bhAnunA
shlokas.45:
shiro.abhUddrupado rAjA mahatyA senayA vRRitaH |
kuntibhojashcha chaidyashcha chakShuShyAstAM janeshvara
shlokas.46:
dAshArNakAH prayAgAshcha dAsherakagaNaiH saha |
anUpagAH kirAtAshcha grIvAyAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.47:
paTachcharaishcha huNDaishcha rAjanpauravakaistathA |
niShAdaiH sahitashchApi pRRiShThamAsIdyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.48:
pakShau tu bhImasenashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
draupadeyAbhimanyushcha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH
shlokas.49:
pishAchA daradAshchaiva puNDrAH kuNDIviShaiH saha |
maDakA laDakAshchaiva ta~NgaNAH parata~NgaNAH
shlokas.50:
bAhlikAstittirAshchaiva cholAH pANDyAshcha bhArata |
ete janapadA rAjandakShiNaM pakShamAshritAH
shlokas.51:
agniveShyA jagattuNDAH paladAshAshcha bhArata |
shabarAstumbupAshchaiva vatsAshcha saha nAkulaiH
nakulaH sahadevashcha vAmaM pArshvaM samAshritAH
shlokas.52:
rathAnAmayutaM pakShau shirashcha niyutaM tathA |
pRRiShThamarbudamevAsItsahasrANi cha vi.nshatiH
grIvAyAM niyutaM chApi sahasrANi cha saptatiH
shlokas.53:
pakShakoTiprapakSheShu pakShAnteShu cha vAraNAH |
jagmuH parivRRitA rAja.nshchalanta iva parvatAH
shlokas.54:
jaghanaM pAlayAmAsa virATaH saha kekayaiH |
kAshirAjashcha shaibyashcha rathAnAmayutaistribhiH
shlokas.55:
evametaM mahAvyUhaM vyUhya bhArata pANDavAH |
sUryodayanamichChantaH sthitA yuddhAya da.nshitAH
shlokas.56:
teShAmAdityavarNAni vimalAni mahAnti cha |
shvetachChatrANyashobhanta vAraNeShu ratheShu cha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
krau~nchaM tato mahAvyUhamabhedyaM tanayastava |
vyUDhaM dRRiShTvA mahAghoraM pArthenAmitatejasA
shlokas.2:
AchAryamupasa~Ngamya kRRipaM shalyaM cha mAriSha |
saumadattiM vikarNaM cha ashvatthAmAnameva cha
shlokas.3:
duHshAsanAdInbhrAtR^I.nshcha sa sarvAneva bhArata |
anyA.nshcha subahU~nshUrAnyuddhAya samupAgatAn
shlokas.4:
prAhedaM vachanaM kAle harShaya.nstanayastava |
nAnAshastrapraharaNAH sarve shastrAstravedinaH
shlokas.5:
ekaikashaH samarthA hi yUyaM sarve mahArathAH |
pANDuputrAnraNe hantuM sasainyAnkimu saMhatAH
shlokas.6:
aparyAptaM tadasmAkaM balaM bhIShmAbhirakShitam |
paryAptaM tvidameteShAM balaM pArthivasattamAH
shlokas.7:
sa.nsthAnAH shUrasenAshcha veNikAH kukurAstathA |
ArevakAstrigartAshcha madrakA yavanAstathA
shlokas.8:
shatru~njayena sahitAstathA duHshAsanena cha |
vikarNena cha vIreNa tathA nandopanandakaiH
shlokas.9:
chitrasenena sahitAH sahitAH pANibhadrakaiH |
bhIShmamevAbhirakShantu saha sainyapuraskRRitAH
shlokas.10:
tato droNashcha bhIShmashcha tava putrashcha mAriSha |
avyUhanta mahAvyUhaM pANDUnAM pratibAdhane
shlokas.11:
bhIShmaH sainyena mahatA samantAtparivAritaH |
yayau prakarShanmahatIM vAhinIM surarADiva
shlokas.12:
tamanvayAnmaheShvAso bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
kuntalaishcha dashArNaishcha mAgadhaishcha vishAM pate
shlokas.13:
vidarbhairmekalaishchaiva karNaprAvaraNairapi |
sahitAH sarvasainyena bhIShmamAhavashobhinam
shlokas.14:
gAndhArAH sindhusauvIrAH shibayo.atha vasAtayaH |
shakunishcha svasainyena bhAradvAjamapAlayat
shlokas.15:
tato duryodhano rAjA sahitaH sarvasodaraiH |
ashvAtakairvikarNaishcha tathA sharmilakosalaiH
shlokas.16:
daradaishchUchupaishchaiva tathA kShudrakamAlavaiH |
abhyarakShata saMhRRiShTaH saubaleyasya vAhinIm
shlokas.17:
bhUrishravAH shalaH shalyo bhagadattashcha mAriSha |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau vAmaM pArshvamapAlayan
shlokas.18:
saumadattiH susharmA cha kAmbojashcha sudakShiNaH |
shatAyushcha shrutAyushcha dakShiNaM pArshvamAsthitAH
shlokas.19:
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
mahatyA senayA sArdhaM senApRRiShThe vyavasthitAH
shlokas.20:
pRRiShThagopAstu tasyAsannAnAdeshyA janeshvarAH |
ketumAnvasudAnashcha putraH kAshyasya chAbhibhUH
shlokas.21:
tataste tAvakAH sarve hRRiShTA yuddhAya bhArata |
dadhmuH sha~NkhAnmudA yuktAH siMhanAdA.nshcha nAdayan
shlokas.22:
teShAM shrutvA tu hRRiShTAnAM kuruvRRiddhaH pitAmahaH |
siMhanAdaM vinadyochchaiH sha~NkhaM dadhmau pratApavAn
shlokas.23:
tataH sha~NkhAshcha bheryashcha peshyashcha vividhAH paraiH |
AnakAshchAbhyahanyanta sa shabdastumulo.abhavat
shlokas.24:
tataH shvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau |
pradadhmatuH sha~Nkhavarau hemaratnapariShkRRitau
shlokas.25:
pA~nchajanyaM hRRiShIkesho devadattaM dhana~njayaH |
pauNDraM dadhmau mahAsha~NkhaM bhImakarmA vRRikodaraH
shlokas.26:
anantavijayaM rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha sughoShamaNipuShpakau
shlokas.27:
kAshirAjashcha shaibyashcha shikhaNDI cha mahArathaH |
dhRRiShTadyumno virATashcha sAtyakishcha mahAyashAH
shlokas.28:
pA~nchAlyashcha maheShvAso draupadyAH pa~ncha chAtmajAH |
sarve dadhmurmahAsha~NkhAnsiMhanAdA.nshcha nedire
shlokas.29:
sa ghoShaH sumahA.nstatra vIraistaiH samudIritaH |
nabhashcha pRRithivIM chaiva tumulo vyanunAdayat
shlokas.30:
evamete mahArAja prahRRiShTAH kurupANDavAH |
punaryuddhAya sa~njagmustApayAnAH parasparam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
evaM vyUDheShvanIkeShu mAmakeShvitareShu cha |
kathaM praharatAM shreShThAH samprahAraM prachakrire
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
samaM vyUDheShvanIkeShu saMnaddhA ruchiradhvajAH |
apAramiva sa.ndRRishya sAgarapratimaM balam
shlokas.3:
teShAM madhye sthito rAjA putro duryodhanastava |
abravIttAvakAnsarvAnyudhyadhvamiti da.nshitAH
shlokas.4:
te manaH krUramAsthAya samabhityaktajIvitAH |
pANDavAnabhyavartanta sarva evochChritadhvajAH
shlokas.5:
tato yuddhaM samabhavattumulaM lomaharShaNam |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha vyatiShaktarathadvipam
shlokas.6:
muktAstu rathibhirbANA rukmapu~NkhAH sutejanAH |
saMnipeturakuNThAgrA nAgeShu cha hayeShu cha
shlokas.7:
tathA pravRRitte sa~NgrAme dhanurudyamya da.nshitaH |
abhipatya mahAbAhurbhIShmo bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.8:
saubhadre bhImasene cha shaineye cha mahArathe |
kekaye cha virATe cha dhRRiShTadyumne cha pArShate
shlokas.9:
eteShu naravIreShu chedimatsyeShu chAbhitaH |
vavarSha sharavarShANi vRRiddhaH kurupitAmahaH
shlokas.10:
prAkampata mahAvyUhastasminvIrasamAgame |
sarveShAmeva sainyAnAmAsIdvyatikaro mahAn
shlokas.11:
sAditadhvajanAgAshcha hatapravaravAjinaH |
viprayAtarathAnIkAH samapadyanta pANDavAH
shlokas.12:
arjunastu naravyAghro dRRiShTvA bhIShmaM mahAratham |
vArShNeyamabravItkruddho yAhi yatra pitAmahaH
shlokas.13:
eSha bhIShmaH susa~Nkruddho vArShNeya mama vAhinIm |
nAshayiShyati suvyaktaM duryodhanahite rataH
shlokas.14:
eSha droNaH kRRipaH shalyo vikarNashcha janArdana |
dhArtarAShTrAshcha sahitA duryodhanapurogamAH
shlokas.15:
pA~nchAlAnnihaniShyanti rakShitA dRRiDhadhanvanA |
so.ahaM bhIShmaM gamiShyAmi sainyahetorjanArdana
shlokas.16:
tamabravIdvAsudevo yatto bhava dhana~njaya |
eSha tvA prApaye vIra pitAmaharathaM prati
shlokas.17:
evamuktvA tataH shaurI rathaM taM lokavishrutam |
prApayAmAsa bhIShmAya rathaM prati janeshvara
shlokas.18:
cha~nchadbahupatAkena balAkAvarNavAjinA |
samuchChritamahAbhImanadadvAnaraketunA
mahatA meghanAdena rathenAdityavarchasA
shlokas.19:
vinighnankauravAnIkaM shUrasenA.nshcha pANDavaH |
AyAchCharAnnuda~nshIghraM suhRRichChoShavinAshanaH
shlokas.20:
tamApatantaM vegena prabhinnamiva vAraNam |
trAsayAnaM raNe shUrAnpAtayantaM cha sAyakaiH
shlokas.21:
saindhavapramukhairguptaH prAchyasauvIrakekayaiH |
sahasA pratyudIyAya bhIShmaH shAntanavo.arjunam
shlokas.22:
ko hi gANDIvadhanvAnamanyaH kurupitAmahAt |
droNavaikartanAbhyAM vA rathaH sa.nyAtumarhati
shlokas.23:
tato bhIShmo mahArAja kauravANAM pitAmahaH |
arjunaM saptasaptatyA nArAchAnAM samAvRRiNot
shlokas.24:
droNashcha pa~nchavi.nshatyA kRRipaH pa~nchAshatA sharaiH |
duryodhanashchatuHShaShTyA shalyashcha navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.25:
saindhavo navabhishchApi shakunishchApi pa~nchabhiH |
vikarNo dashabhirbhallai rAjanvivyAdha pANDavam
shlokas.26:
sa tairviddho maheShvAsaH samantAnnishitaiH sharaiH |
na vivyathe mahAbAhurbhidyamAna ivAchalaH
shlokas.27:
sa bhIShmaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA kRRipaM cha navabhiH sharaiH |
droNaM ShaShTyA naravyAghro vikarNaM cha tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.28:
ArtAyaniM tribhirbANai rAjAnaM chApi pa~nchabhiH |
pratyavidhyadameyAtmA kirITI bharatarShabha
shlokas.29:
taM sAtyakirvirATashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
draupadeyAbhimanyushcha parivavrurdhana~njayam
shlokas.30:
tato droNaM maheShvAsaM gA~Ngeyasya priye ratam |
abhyavarShata pA~nchAlyaH sa.nyuktaH saha somakaiH
shlokas.31:
bhIShmastu rathinAM shreShThastUrNaM vivyAdha pANDavam |
ashItyA nishitairbANaistato.akroshanta tAvakAH
shlokas.32:
teShAM tu ninadaM shrutvA prahRRiShTAnAM prahRRiShTavat |
pravivesha tato madhyaM rathasiMhaH pratApavAn
shlokas.33:
teShAM tu rathasiMhAnAM madhyaM prApya dhana~njayaH |
chikrIDa dhanuShA rAja.NllakShyaM kRRitvA mahArathAn
shlokas.34:
tato duryodhano rAjA bhIShmamAha janeshvaraH |
pIDyamAnaM svakaM sainyaM dRRiShTvA pArthena sa.nyuge
shlokas.35:
eSha pANDusutastAta kRRiShNena sahito balI |
yatatAM sarvasainyAnAM mUlaM naH parikRRintati
tvayi jIvati gA~Ngeye droNe cha rathinAM vare
shlokas.36:
tvatkRRite hyeSha karNo.api nyastashastro mahArathaH |
na yudhyati raNe pArthaM hitakAmaH sadA mama
shlokas.37:
sa tathA kuru gA~Ngeya yathA hanyeta phalgunaH |
evamuktastato rAjanpitA devavratastava
dhikkShatradharmamityuktvA yayau pArtharathaM prati
shlokas.38:
ubhau shvetahayau rAjansa.nsaktau dRRishya pArthivAH |
siMhanAdAnbhRRishaM chakruH sha~NkhashabdA.nshcha bhArata
shlokas.39:
drauNirduryodhanashchaiva vikarNashcha tavAtmajaH |
parivArya raNe bhIShmaM sthitA yuddhAya mAriSha
shlokas.40:
tathaiva pANDavAH sarve parivArya dhana~njayam |
sthitA yuddhAya mahate tato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.41:
gA~Ngeyastu raNe pArthamAnarChannavabhiH sharaiH |
tamarjunaH pratyavidhyaddashabhirmarmavedhibhiH
shlokas.42:
tataH sharasahasreNa suprayuktena pANDavaH |
arjunaH samarashlAghI bhIShmasyAvArayaddishaH
shlokas.43:
sharajAlaM tatastattu sharajAlena kaurava |
vArayAmAsa pArthasya bhIShmaH shAntanavastathA
shlokas.44:
ubhau paramasaMhRRiShTAvubhau yuddhAbhinandinau |
nirvisheShamayudhyetAM kRRitapratikRRitaiShiNau
shlokas.45:
bhIShmachApavimuktAni sharajAlAni sa~NghashaH |
shIryamANAnyadRRishyanta bhinnAnyarjunasAyakaiH
shlokas.46:
tathaivArjunamuktAni sharajAlAni bhAgashaH |
gA~NgeyasharanunnAni nyapatanta mahItale
shlokas.47:
arjunaH pa~nchavi.nshatyA bhIShmamArchChachChitaiH sharaiH |
bhIShmo.api samare pArthaM vivyAdha tri.nshatA sharaiH
shlokas.48:
anyonyasya hayAnviddhvA dhvajau cha sumahAbalau |
ratheShAM rathachakre cha chikrIDaturari.ndamau
shlokas.49:
tataH kruddho mahArAja bhIShmaH praharatAM varaH |
vAsudevaM tribhirbANairAjaghAna stanAntare
shlokas.50:
bhIShmachApachyutairbANairnirviddho madhusUdanaH |
virarAja raNe rAjansapuShpa iva ki.nshukaH
shlokas.51:
tato.arjuno bhRRishaM kruddho nirviddhaM prekShya mAdhavam |
gA~NgeyasArathiM sa~Nkhye nirbibheda tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.52:
yatamAnau tu tau vIrAvanyonyasya vadhaM prati |
nAshaknutAM tadAnyonyamabhisandhAtumAhave
shlokas.53:
maNDalAni vichitrANi gatapratyAgatAni cha |
adarshayetAM bahudhA sUtasAmarthyalAghavAt
shlokas.54:
antaraM cha prahAreShu tarkayantau mahArathau |
rAjannantaramArgasthau sthitAvAstAM muhurmuhuH
shlokas.55:
ubhau siMharavonmishraM sha~NkhashabdaM prachakratuH |
tathaiva chApanirghoShaM chakratustau mahArathau
shlokas.56:
tayoH sha~NkhapraNAdena rathanemisvanena cha |
dAritA sahasA bhUmishchakampa cha nanAda cha
shlokas.57:
na tayorantaraM kashchiddadRRishe bharatarShabha |
balinau samare shUrAvanyonyasadRRishAvubhau
shlokas.58:
chihnamAtreNa bhIShmaM tu prajaj~nustatra kauravAH |
tathA pANDusutAH pArthaM chihnamAtreNa jaj~nire
shlokas.59:
tayornRRivarayo rAjandRRishya tAdRRikparAkramam |
vismayaM sarvabhUtAni jagmurbhArata sa.nyuge
shlokas.60:
na tayorvivaraM kashchidraNe pashyati bhArata |
dharme sthitasya hi yathA na kashchidvRRijinaM kvachit
shlokas.61:
ubhau hi sharajAlena tAvadRRishyau babhUvatuH |
prakAshau cha punastUrNaM babhUvaturubhau raNe
shlokas.62:
tatra devAH sagandharvAshchAraNAshcha saharShibhiH |
anyonyaM pratyabhAShanta tayordRRiShTvA parAkramam
shlokas.63:
na shakyau yudhi sa.nrabdhau jetumetau mahArathau |
sadevAsuragandharvairlokairapi katha~nchana
shlokas.64:
AshcharyabhUtaM lokeShu yuddhametanmahAdbhutam |
naitAdRRishAni yuddhAni bhaviShyanti katha~nchana
shlokas.65:
nApi shakyo raNe jetuM bhIShmaH pArthena dhImatA |
sadhanushcha rathasthashcha pravapansAyakAnraNe
shlokas.66:
tathaiva pANDavaM yuddhe devairapi durAsadam |
na vijetuM raNe bhIShma utsaheta dhanurdharam
shlokas.67:
iti sma vAchaH shrUyante prochcharantyastatastataH |
gA~NgeyArjunayoH sa~Nkhye stavayuktA vishAM pate
shlokas.68:
tvadIyAstu tato yodhAH pANDaveyAshcha bhArata |
anyonyaM samare jaghnustayostatra parAkrame
shlokas.69:
shitadhAraistathA khaDgairvimalaishcha parashvadhaiH |
sharairanyaishcha bahubhiH shastrairnAnAvidhairyudhi
ubhayoH senayorvIrA nyakRRintanta parasparam
shlokas.70:
vartamAne tathA ghore tasminyuddhe sudAruNe |
droNapA~nchAlyayo rAjanmahAnAsItsamAgamaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM droNo maheShvAsaH pA~nchAlyashchApi pArShataH |
raNe samIyaturyattau tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
diShTameva paraM manye pauruShAdapi sa~njaya |
yatra shAntanavo bhIShmo nAtaradyudhi pANDavam
shlokas.3:
bhIShmo hi samare kruddho hanyAllokA.nshcharAcharAn |
sa kathaM pANDavaM yuddhe nAtaratsa~njayaujasA
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjansthiro bhUtvA yuddhametatsudAruNam |
na shakyaH pANDavo jetuM devairapi savAsavaiH
shlokas.5:
droNastu nishitairbANairdhRRiShTadyumnamayodhayat |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena rathanIDAdapAtayat
shlokas.6:
tasyAtha chaturo vAhA.nshchaturbhiH sAyakottamaiH |
pIDayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho dhRRiShTadyumnasya mAriSha
shlokas.7:
dhRRiShTadyumnastato droNaM navatyA nishitaiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha prahasanvIrastiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.8:
tataH punarameyAtmA bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
sharaiH prachChAdayAmAsa dhRRiShTadyumnamamarShaNam
shlokas.9:
Adade cha sharaM ghoraM pArShatasya vadhaM prati |
shakrAshanisamasparshaM mRRityudaNDamivAparam
shlokas.10:
hAhAkAro mahAnAsItsarvasainyasya bhArata |
tamiShuM sandhitaM dRRiShTvA bhAradvAjena sa.nyuge
shlokas.11:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma dhRRiShTadyumnasya pauruSham |
yadekaH samare vIrastasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.12:
taM cha dIptaM sharaM ghoramAyAntaM mRRityumAtmanaH |
chichCheda sharavRRiShTiM cha bhAradvAje mumocha ha
shlokas.13:
tata uchchukrushuH sarve pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha |
dhRRiShTadyumnena tatkarma kRRitaM dRRiShTvA suduShkaram
shlokas.14:
tataH shaktiM mahAvegAM svarNavaiDUryabhUShitAm |
droNasya nidhanAkA~NkShI chikShepa sa parAkramI
shlokas.15:
tAmApatantIM sahasA shaktiM kanakabhUShaNAm |
tridhA chikShepa samare bhAradvAjo hasanniva
shlokas.16:
shaktiM vinihatAM dRRiShTvA dhRRiShTadyumnaH pratApavAn |
vavarSha sharavarShANi droNaM prati janeshvara
shlokas.17:
sharavarShaM tatastaM tu saMnivArya mahAyashAH |
droNo drupadaputrasya madhye chichCheda kArmukam
shlokas.18:
sa chChinnadhanvA samare gadAM gurvIM mahAyashAH |
droNAya preShayAmAsa girisAramayIM balI
shlokas.19:
sA gadA vegavanmuktA prAyAddroNajighA.nsayA |
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma bhAradvAjasya vikramam
shlokas.20:
lAghavAdvya.nsayAmAsa gadAM hemavibhUShitAm |
vya.nsayitvA gadAM tAM cha preShayAmAsa pArShate
shlokas.21:
bhallAnsunishitAnpItAnsvarNapu~NkhA~nshilAshitAn |
te tasya kavachaM bhittvA papuH shoNitamAhave
shlokas.22:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya dhRRiShTadyumno mahAmanAH |
droNaM yudhi parAkramya sharairvivyAdha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.23:
rudhirAktau tatastau tu shushubhAte nararShabhau |
vasantasamaye rAjanpuShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.24:
amarShitastato rAjanparAkramya chamUmukhe |
droNo drupadaputrasya punashchichCheda kArmukam
shlokas.25:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
avAkiradameyAtmA vRRiShTyA megha ivAchalam
shlokas.26:
sArathiM chAsya bhallena rathanIDAdapAtayat |
athAsya chaturo vAhA.nshchaturbhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.27:
pAtayAmAsa samare siMhanAdaM nanAda cha |
tato.apareNa bhallena hastAchchApamathAchChinat
shlokas.28:
sa chChinnadhanvA viratho hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
gadApANiravArohatkhyApayanpauruShaM mahat
shlokas.29:
tAmasya vishikhaistUrNaM pAtayAmAsa bhArata |
rathAdanavarUDhasya tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.30:
tataH sa vipulaM charma shatachandraM cha bhAnumat |
khaDgaM cha vipulaM divyaM pragRRihya subhujo balI
shlokas.31:
abhidudrAva vegena droNasya vadhakA~NkShayA |
AmiShArthI yathA siMho vane mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.32:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma bhAradvAjasya pauruSham |
lAghavaM chAstrayogaM cha balaM bAhvoshcha bhArata
shlokas.33:
yadenaM sharavarSheNa vArayAmAsa pArShatam |
na shashAka tato gantuM balavAnapi sa.nyuge
shlokas.34:
tatra sthitamapashyAma dhRRiShTadyumnaM mahAratham |
vArayANaM sharaughA.nshcha charmaNA kRRitahastavat
shlokas.35:
tato bhImo mahAbAhuH sahasAbhyapatadbalI |
sAhAyyakArI samare pArShatasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.36:
sa droNaM nishitairbANai rAjanvivyAdha saptabhiH |
pArShataM cha tadA tUrNamanyamAropayadratham
shlokas.37:
tato duryodhano rAjA kali~NgaM samachodayat |
sainyena mahatA yuktaM bhAradvAjasya rakShaNe
shlokas.38:
tataH sA mahatI senA kali~NgAnAM janeshvara |
bhImamabhyudyayau tUrNaM tava putrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.39:
pA~nchAlyamabhisantyajya droNo.api rathinAM varaH |
virATadrupadau vRRiddhau yodhayAmAsa sa~Ngatau
dhRRiShTadyumno.api samare dharmarAjaM samabhyayAt
shlokas.40:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
kali~NgAnAM cha samare bhImasya cha mahAtmanaH
jagataH prakShayakaraM ghorarUpaM bhayAnakam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA pratisamAdiShTaH kali~Ngo vAhinIpatiH |
kathamadbhutakarmANaM bhImasenaM mahAbalam
shlokas.2:
charantaM gadayA vIraM daNDapANimivAntakam |
yodhayAmAsa samare kali~NgaH saha senayA
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
putreNa tava rAjendra sa tathokto mahAbalaH |
mahatyA senayA guptaH prAyAdbhImarathaM prati
shlokas.4:
tAmApatantIM sahasA kali~NgAnAM mahAchamUm |
rathanAgAshvakalilAM pragRRihItamahAyudhAm
shlokas.5:
bhImasenaH kali~NgAnAmArChadbhArata vAhinIm |
ketumantaM cha naiShAdimAyAntaM saha chedibhiH
shlokas.6:
tataH shrutAyuH sa~Nkruddho rAj~nA ketumatA saha |
AsasAda raNe bhImaM vyUDhAnIkeShu chediShu
shlokas.7:
rathairanekasAhasraiH kali~NgAnAM janAdhipaH |
ayutena gajAnAM cha niShAdaiH saha ketumAn
bhImasenaM raNe rAjansamantAtparyavArayat
shlokas.8:
chedimatsyakarUShAshcha bhImasenapurogamAH |
abhyavartanta sahasA niShAdAnsaha rAjabhiH
shlokas.9:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAnakam |
prajAnanna cha yodhAnsvAnparasparajighA.nsayA
shlokas.10:
ghoramAsIttato yuddhaM bhImasya sahasA paraiH |
yathendrasya mahArAja mahatyA daityasenayA
shlokas.11:
tasya sainyasya sa~NgrAme yudhyamAnasya bhArata |
babhUva sumahA~nshabdaH sAgarasyeva garjataH
shlokas.12:
anyonyasya tadA yodhA nikRRintanto vishAM pate |
mahIM chakrushchitAM sarvAM shashashoNitasaMnibhAm
shlokas.13:
yodhA.nshcha svAnparAnvApi nAbhyajAna~njighA.nsayA |
svAnapyAdadate svAshcha shUrAH samaradurjayAH
shlokas.14:
vimardaH sumahAnAsIdalpAnAM bahubhiH saha |
kali~NgaiH saha chedInAM niShAdaishcha vishAM pate
shlokas.15:
kRRitvA puruShakAraM tu yathAshakti mahAbalAH |
bhImasenaM parityajya saMnyavartanta chedayaH
shlokas.16:
sarvaiH kali~NgairAsannaH saMnivRRitteShu chediShu |
svabAhubalamAsthAya na nyavartata pANDavaH
shlokas.17:
na chachAla rathopasthAdbhImaseno mahAbalaH |
shitairavAkiranbANaiH kali~NgAnAM varUthinIm
shlokas.18:
kali~Ngastu maheShvAsaH putrashchAsya mahArathaH |
shakradeva iti khyAto jaghnatuH pANDavaM sharaiH
shlokas.19:
tato bhImo mahAbAhurvidhunvanruchiraM dhanuH |
yodhayAmAsa kAli~NgAnsvabAhubalamAshritaH
shlokas.20:
shakradevastu samare visRRijansAyakAnbahUn |
ashvA~njaghAna samare bhImasenasya sAyakaiH
vavarSha sharavarShANi tapAnte jalado yathA
shlokas.21:
hatAshve tu rathe tiShThanbhImaseno mahAbalaH |
shakradevAya chikShepa sarvashaikyAyasIM gadAm
shlokas.22:
sa tayA nihato rAjankali~Ngasya suto rathAt |
sadhvajaH saha sUtena jagAma dharaNItalam
shlokas.23:
hatamAtmasutaM dRRiShTvA kali~NgAnAM janAdhipaH |
rathairanekasAhasrairbhimasyAvArayaddishaH
shlokas.24:
tato bhImo mahAbAhurgurvIM tyaktvA mahAgadAm |
udbabarhAtha nistri.nshaM chikIrShuH karma dAruNam
shlokas.25:
charma chApratimaM rAjannArShabhaM puruSharShabha |
nakShatrairardhachandraishcha shAtakumbhamayaishchitam
shlokas.26:
kali~Ngastu tataH kruddho dhanurjyAmavamRRijya ha |
pragRRihya cha sharaM ghoramekaM sarpaviShopamam
prAhiNodbhImasenAya vadhAkA~NkShI janeshvaraH
shlokas.27:
tamApatantaM vegena preritaM nishitaM sharam |
bhImaseno dvidhA rAja.nshchichCheda vipulAsinA
udakroshachcha saMhRRiShTastrAsayAno varUthinIm
shlokas.28:
kali~Ngastu tataH kruddho bhImasenAya sa.nyuge |
tomarAnprAhiNochChIghraM chaturdasha shilAshitAn
shlokas.29:
tAnaprAptAnmahAbAhuH khagatAneva pANDavaH |
chichCheda sahasA rAjannasambhrAnto varAsinA
shlokas.30:
nikRRitya tu raNe bhImastomarAnvai chaturdasha |
bhAnumantamabhiprekShya prAdravatpuruSharShabhaH
shlokas.31:
bhAnumA.nstu tato bhImaM sharavarSheNa ChAdayan |
nanAda balavannAdaM nAdayAno nabhastalam
shlokas.32:
na taM sa mamRRiShe bhImaH siMhanAdaM mahAraNe |
tataH svareNa mahatA vinanAda mahAsvanam
shlokas.33:
tena shabdena vitrastA kali~NgAnAM varUthinI |
na bhImaM samare mene mAnuShaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.34:
tato bhImo mahArAja naditvA vipulaM svanam |
sAsirvegAdavaplutya dantAbhyAM vAraNottamam
shlokas.35:
Aruroha tato madhyaM nAgarAjasya mAriSha |
khaDgena pRRithunA madhye bhAnumantamathAchChinat
shlokas.36:
so.antarAyudhinaM hatvA rAjaputramari.ndamaH |
gurubhArasahaskandhe nAgasyAsimapAtayat
shlokas.37:
ChinnaskandhaH sa vinadanpapAta gajayUthapaH |
ArugNaH sindhuvegena sAnumAniva parvataH
shlokas.38:
tatastasmAdavaplutya gajAdbhArata bhArataH |
khaDgapANiradInAtmA atiShThadbhuvi da.nshitaH
shlokas.39:
sa chachAra bahUnmArgAnabhItaH pAtayangajAn |
agnichakramivAviddhaM sarvataH pratyadRRishyata
shlokas.40:
ashvavRRindeShu nAgeShu rathAnIkeShu chAbhibhUH |
padAtInAM cha sa~NgheShu vinighna~nshoNitokShitaH
shyenavadvyacharadbhImo raNe ripubalotkaTaH
shlokas.41:
Chinda.nsteShAM sharIrANi shirA.nsi cha mahAjavaH |
khaDgena shitadhAreNa sa.nyuge gajayodhinAm
shlokas.42:
padAtirekaH sa~NkruddhaH shatrUNAM bhayavardhanaH |
mohayAmAsa cha tadA kAlAntakayamopamaH
shlokas.43:
mUDhAshcha te tamevAjau vinadantaH samAdravan |
sAsimuttamavegena vicharantaM mahAraNe
shlokas.44:
nikRRitya rathinAmAjau ratheShAshcha yugAni cha |
jaghAna rathinashchApi balavAnarimardanaH
shlokas.45:
bhImasenashcharanmArgAnsubahUnpratyadRRishyata |
bhrAntamudbhrAntamAviddhamAplutaM prasRRitaM sRRitam
sampAtaM samudIryaM cha darshayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.46:
kechidagrAsinA ChinnAH pANDavena mahAtmanA |
vinedurbhinnamarmANo nipetushcha gatAsavaH
shlokas.47:
ChinnadantAgrahastAshcha bhinnakumbhAstathApare |
viyodhAH svAnyanIkAni jaghnurbhArata vAraNAH
nipetururvyAM cha tathA vinadanto mahAravAn
shlokas.48:
ChinnA.nshcha tomarA.nshchApAnmahAmAtrashirA.nsi cha |
paristomAni chitrANi kakShyAshcha kanakojjvalAH
shlokas.49:
graiveyANyatha shaktIshcha patAkAH kaNapA.nstathA |
tUNIrANyatha yantrANi vichitrANi dhanUMShi cha
shlokas.50:
agnikuNDAni shubhrANi tottrA.nshchaivA~NkushaiH saha |
ghaNTAshcha vividhA rAjanhemagarbhA.nstsarUnapi
patataH patitA.nshchaiva pashyAmaH saha sAdibhiH
shlokas.51:
ChinnagAtrAvarakarairnihataishchApi vAraNaiH |
AsIttasminsamAstIrNA patitairbhUrnagairiva
shlokas.52:
vimRRidyaivaM mahAnAgAnmamardAshvAnnararShabhaH |
ashvArohavarA.nshchApi pAtayAmAsa bhArata
tadghoramabhavadyuddhaM tasya teShAM cha bhArata
shlokas.53:
khalInAnyatha yoktrANi kashAshcha kanakojjvalAH |
paristomAshcha prAsAshcha RRiShTayashcha mahAdhanAH
shlokas.54:
kavachAnyatha charmANi chitrANyAstaraNAni cha |
tatra tatrApaviddhAni vyadRRishyanta mahAhave
shlokas.55:
prothayantrairvichitraishcha shastraishcha vimalaistathA |
sa chakre vasudhAM kIrNAM shabalaiH kusumairiva
shlokas.56:
Aplutya rathinaH kA.nshchitparAmRRishya mahAbalaH |
pAtayAmAsa khaDgena sadhvajAnapi pANDavaH
shlokas.57:
muhurutpatato dikShu dhAvatashcha yashasvinaH |
mArgA.nshcha charatashchitrAnvyasmayanta raNe janAH
shlokas.58:
nijaghAna padA kA.nshchidAkShipyAnyAnapothayat |
khaDgenAnyA.nshcha chichCheda nAdenAnyA.nshcha bhIShayan
shlokas.59:
Uruvegena chApyanyAnpAtayAmAsa bhUtale |
apare chainamAlokya bhayAtpa~nchatvamAgatAH
shlokas.60:
evaM sA bahulA senA kali~NgAnAM tarasvinAm |
parivArya raNe bhIShmaM bhImasenamupAdravat
shlokas.61:
tataH kali~NgasainyAnAM pramukhe bharatarShabha |
shrutAyuShamabhiprekShya bhImasenaH samabhyayAt
shlokas.62:
tamAyAntamabhiprekShya kali~Ngo navabhiH sharaiH |
bhImasenamameyAtmA pratyavidhyatstanAntare
shlokas.63:
kali~NgabANAbhihatastottrArdita iva dvipaH |
bhImasenaH prajajvAla krodhenAgnirivendhanaiH
shlokas.64:
athAshokaH samAdAya rathaM hemapariShkRRitam |
bhImaM sampAdayAmAsa rathena rathasArathiH
shlokas.65:
tamAruhya rathaM tUrNaM kaunteyaH shatrusUdanaH |
kali~NgamabhidudrAva tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.66:
tataH shrutAyurbalavAnbhImAya nishitA~nsharAn |
preShayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho darshayanpANilAghavam
shlokas.67:
sa kArmukavarotsRRiShTairnavabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
samAhato bhRRishaM rAjankali~Ngena mahAyashAH
sa~nchukrudhe bhRRishaM bhImo daNDAhata ivoragaH
shlokas.68:
kruddhashcha chApamAyamya balavadbalinAM varaH |
kali~NgamavadhItpArtho bhImaH saptabhirAyasaiH
shlokas.69:
kShurAbhyAM chakrarakShau cha kali~Ngasya mahAbalau |
satyadevaM cha satyaM cha prAhiNodyamasAdanam
shlokas.70:
tataH punarameyAtmA nArAchairnishitaistribhiH |
ketumantaM raNe bhImo.agamayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.71:
tataH kali~NgAH sa~NkruddhA bhImasenamamarShaNam |
anIkairbahusAhasraiH kShatriyAH samavArayan
shlokas.73:
saMnivArya sa tAM ghorAM sharavRRiShTiM samutthitAm |
gadAmAdAya tarasA pariplutya mahAbalaH
bhImaH saptashatAnvIrAnanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.75:
evaM sa tAnyanIkAni kali~NgAnAM punaH punaH |
bibheda samare vIraH prekShya bhIShmaM mahAvratam
shlokas.76:
hatArohAshcha mAta~NgAH pANDavena mahAtmanA |
viprajagmuranIkeShu meghA vAtahatA iva
mRRidnantaH svAnyanIkAni vinadantaH sharAturAH
shlokas.77:
tato bhImo mahAbAhuH sha~NkhaM prAdhmApayadbalI |
sarvakAli~NgasainyAnAM manA.nsi samakampayat
shlokas.78:
mohashchApi kali~NgAnAmAvivesha parantapa |
prAkampanta cha sainyAni vAhanAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.79:
bhImena samare rAjangajendreNeva sarvataH |
mArgAnbahUnvicharatA dhAvatA cha tatastataH
muhurutpatatA chaiva saMmohaH samajAyata
shlokas.80:
bhImasenabhayatrastaM sainyaM cha samakampata |
kShobhyamANamasambAdhaM grAheNeva mahatsaraH
shlokas.81:
trAsiteShu cha vIreShu bhImenAdbhutakarmaNA |
punarAvartamAneShu vidravatsu cha sa~NghashaH
shlokas.82:
sarvakAli~NgayodheShu pANDUnAM dhvajinIpatiH |
abravItsvAnyanIkAni yudhyadhvamiti pArShataH
shlokas.83:
senApativachaH shrutvA shikhaNDipramukhA gaNAH |
bhImamevAbhyavartanta rathAnIkaiH prahAribhiH
shlokas.84:
dharmarAjashcha tAnsarvAnupajagrAha pANDavaH |
mahatA meghavarNena nAgAnIkena pRRiShThataH
shlokas.85:
evaM sa~nchodya sarvANi svAnyanIkAni pArShataH |
bhImasenasya jagrAha pArShNiM satpuruShochitAm
shlokas.86:
na hi pA~nchAlarAjasya loke kashchana vidyate |
bhImasAtyakayoranyaH prANebhyaH priyakRRittamaH
shlokas.87:
so.apashyattaM kali~NgeShu charantamarisUdanam |
bhImasenaM mahAbAhuM pArShataH paravIrahA
shlokas.88:
nanarda bahudhA rAjanhRRiShTashchAsItparantapaH |
sha~NkhaM dadhmau cha samare siMhanAdaM nanAda cha
shlokas.89:
sa cha pArAvatAshvasya rathe hemapariShkRRite |
kovidAradhvajaM dRRiShTvA bhImasenaH samAshvasat
shlokas.90:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu taM dRRiShTvA kali~NgaiH samabhidrutam |
bhImasenamameyAtmA trANAyAjau samabhyayAt
shlokas.91:
tau dUrAtsAtyakirdRRiShTvA dhRRiShTadyumnavRRikodarau |
kali~NgAnsamare vIrau yodhayantau manasvinau
shlokas.92:
sa tatra gatvA shaineyo javena jayatAM varaH |
pArthapArShatayoH pArShNiM jagrAha puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.93:
sa kRRitvA kadanaM tatra pragRRihItasharAsanaH |
Asthito raudramAtmAnaM jaghAna samare parAn
shlokas.94:
kali~NgaprabhavAM chaiva mA.nsashoNitakardamAm |
rudhirasyandinIM tatra bhImaH prAvartayannadIm
shlokas.95:
antareNa kali~NgAnAM pANDavAnAM cha vAhinIm |
santatAra sudustArAM bhImaseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.96:
bhImasenaM tathA dRRiShTvA prAkrosha.nstAvakA nRRipa |
kAlo.ayaM bhImarUpeNa kali~NgaiH saha yudhyate
shlokas.97:
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmaH shrutvA taM ninadaM raNe |
abhyayAttvarito bhImaM vyUDhAnIkaH samantataH
shlokas.98:
taM sAtyakirbhImaseno dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
abhyadravanta bhIShmasya rathaM hemapariShkRRitam
shlokas.99:
parivArya cha te sarve gA~NgeyaM rabhasaM raNe |
tribhistribhiH sharairghorairbhIShmamAnarChura~njasA
shlokas.101:
tataH sharasahasreNa saMnivArya mahArathAn |
hayAnkA~nchanasaMnAhAnbhImasya nyahanachCharaiH
shlokas.102:
hatAshve tu rathe tiShThanbhImasenaH pratApavAn |
shaktiM chikShepa tarasA gA~Ngeyasya rathaM prati
shlokas.103:
aprAptAmeva tAM shaktiM pitA devavratastava |
tridhA chichCheda samare sA pRRithivyAmashIryata
shlokas.104:
tataH shaikyAyasIM gurvIM pragRRihya balavadgadAm |
bhImaseno rathAttUrNaM pupluve manujarShabha
shlokas.105:
sAtyako.api tatastUrNaM bhImasya priyakAmyayA |
sArathiM kuruvRRiddhasya pAtayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.106:
bhIShmastu nihate tasminsArathau rathinAM varaH |
vAtAyamAnaistairashvairapanIto raNAjirAt
shlokas.107:
bhImasenastato rAjannapanIte mahAvrate |
prajajvAla yathA vahnirdahankakShamivaidhitaH
shlokas.108:
sa hatvA sarvakAli~NgAnsenAmadhye vyatiShThata |
nainamabhyutsahankechittAvakA bharatarShabha
shlokas.109:
dhRRiShTadyumnastamAropya svarathe rathinAM varaH |
pashyatAM sarvasainyAnAmapovAha yashasvinam
shlokas.110:
sampUjyamAnaH pA~nchAlyairmatsyaishcha bharatarShabha |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM pariShvajya sameyAdatha sAtyakim
shlokas.111:
athAbravIdbhImasenaM sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
praharShayanyaduvyAghro dhRRiShTadyumnasya pashyataH
shlokas.112:
diShTyA kali~NgarAjashcha rAjaputrashcha ketumAn |
shakradevashcha kAli~NgaH kali~NgAshcha mRRidhe hatAH
shlokas.114:
evamuktvA shinernaptA dIrghabAhurari.ndamaH |
rathAdrathamabhidrutya paryaShvajata pANDavam
shlokas.115:
tataH svarathamAruhya punareva mahArathaH |
tAvakAnavadhItkruddho bhImasya balamAdadhat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
gatAparAhNabhUyiShThe tasminnahani bhArata |
rathanAgAshvapattInAM sAdinAM cha mahAkShaye
shlokas.2:
droNaputreNa shalyena kRRipeNa cha mahAtmanA |
samasajjata pA~nchAlyastribhiretairmahArathaiH
shlokas.3:
sa lokaviditAnashvAnnijaghAna mahAbalaH |
drauNeH pA~nchAladAyAdaH shitairdashabhirAshugaiH
shlokas.4:
tataH shalyarathaM tUrNamAsthAya hatavAhanaH |
drauNiH pA~nchAladAyAdamabhyavarShadatheShubhiH
shlokas.5:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tu sa.nsaktaM drauNinA dRRishya bhArata |
saubhadro.abhyapatattUrNaM vikirannishitA~nsharAn
shlokas.6:
sa shalyaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA kRRipaM cha navabhiH sharaiH |
ashvatthAmAnamaShTAbhirvivyAdha puruSharShabha
shlokas.7:
ArjuniM tu tatastUrNaM drauNirvivyAdha patriNA |
shalyo dvAdashabhishchaiva kRRipashcha nishitaistribhiH
shlokas.8:
lakShmaNastava pautrastu tava pautramavasthitam |
abhyavartata saMhRRiShTastato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.9:
dauryodhanistu sa~NkruddhaH saubhadraM navabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha samare rAja.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.10:
abhimanyustu sa~Nkruddho bhrAtaraM bharatarShabha |
sharaiH pa~nchAshatA rAjankShiprahasto.abhyavidhyata
shlokas.11:
lakShmaNo.api tatastasya dhanushchichCheda patriNA |
muShTideshe mahArAja tata uchchukrushurjanAH
shlokas.12:
tadvihAya dhanushChinnaM saubhadraH paravIrahA |
anyadAdattavA.nshchitraM kArmukaM vegavattaram
shlokas.13:
tau tatra samare hRRiShTau kRRitapratikRRitaiShiNau |
anyonyaM vishikhaistIkShNairjaghnatuH puruSharShabhau
shlokas.14:
tato duryodhano rAjA dRRiShTvA putraM mahAratham |
pIDitaM tava pautreNa prAyAttatra janeshvaraH
shlokas.15:
saMnivRRitte tava sute sarva eva janAdhipAH |
ArjuniM rathava.nshena samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.16:
sa taiH parivRRitaH shUraiH shUro yudhi sudurjayaiH |
na sma vivyathate rAjankRRiShNatulyaparAkramaH
shlokas.17:
saubhadramatha sa.nsaktaM tatra dRRiShTvA dhana~njayaH |
abhidudrAva sa~NkruddhastrAtukAmaH svamAtmajam
shlokas.18:
tataH sarathanAgAshvA bhIShmadroNapurogamAH |
abhyavartanta rAjAnaH sahitAH savyasAchinam
shlokas.19:
uddhUtaM sahasA bhaumaM nAgAshvarathasAdibhiH |
divAkarapathaM prApya rajastIvramadRRishyata
shlokas.20:
tAni nAgasahasrANi bhUmipAlashatAni cha |
tasya bANapathaM prApya nAbhyavartanta sarvashaH
shlokas.21:
praNeduH sarvabhUtAni babhUvustimirA dishaH |
kurUNAmanayastIvraH samadRRishyata dAruNaH
shlokas.22:
nApyantarikShaM na disho na bhUmirna cha bhAskaraH |
prajaj~ne bharatashreShTha sharasa~NghaiH kirITinaH
shlokas.23:
sAditadhvajanAgAstu hatAshvA rathino bhRRisham |
vipradrutarathAH kechiddRRishyante rathayUthapAH
shlokas.24:
virathA rathinashchAnye dhAvamAnAH samantataH |
tatra tatraiva dRRishyante sAyudhAH sA~NgadairbhujaiH
shlokas.25:
hayArohA hayA.nstyaktvA gajArohAshcha dantinaH |
arjunasya bhayAdrAjansamantAdvipradudruvuH
shlokas.26:
rathebhyashcha gajebhyashcha hayebhyashcha narAdhipAH |
patitAH pAtyamAnAshcha dRRishyante.arjunatADitAH
shlokas.27:
sagadAnudyatAnbAhUnsakhaDgA.nshcha vishAM pate |
saprAsA.nshcha satUNIrAnsasharAnsasharAsanAn
shlokas.28:
sA~NkushAnsapatAkA.nshcha tatra tatrArjuno nRRiNAm |
nichakarta sharairugrai raudraM bibhradvapustadA
shlokas.29:
parighANAM pravRRiddhAnAM mudgarANAM cha mAriSha |
prAsAnAM bhiNDipAlAnAM nistri.nshAnAM cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.30:
parashvadhAnAM tIkShNAnAM tomarANAM cha bhArata |
varmaNAM chApaviddhAnAM kavachAnAM cha bhUtale
shlokas.31:
dhvajAnAM charmaNAM chaiva vyajanAnAM cha sarvashaH |
ChatrANAM hemadaNDAnAM chAmarANAM cha bhArata
shlokas.32:
pratodAnAM kashAnAM cha yoktrANAM chaiva mAriSha |
rAshayashchAtra dRRishyante vinikIrNA raNakShitau
shlokas.33:
nAsIttatra pumAnkashchittava sainyasya bhArata |
yo.arjunaM samare shUraM pratyudyAyAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.34:
