yo yo hi samare pArthaM patyudyAti vishAM pate |
sa sa vai vishikhaistIkShNaiH paralokAya nIyate
shlokas.35:
teShu vidravamANeShu tava yodheShu sarvashaH |
arjuno vAsudevashcha dadhmaturvArijottamau
shlokas.36:
tatprabhagnaM balaM dRRiShTvA pitA devavratastava |
abravItsamare shUraM bhAradvAjaM smayanniva
shlokas.37:
eSha pANDusuto vIraH kRRiShNena sahito balI |
tathA karoti sainyAni yathA kuryAddhana~njayaH
shlokas.38:
na hyeSha samare shakyo jetumadya katha~nchana |
yathAsya dRRishyate rUpaM kAlAntakayamopamam
shlokas.39:
na nivartayituM chApi shakyeyaM mahatI chamUH |
anyonyaprekShayA pashya dravatIyaM varUthinI
shlokas.40:
eSha chAstaM girishreShThaM bhAnumAnpratipadyate |
vapUMShi sarvalokasya saMharanniva sarvathA
shlokas.41:
tatrAvahAraM samprAptaM manye.ahaM puruSharShabha |
shrAntA bhItAshcha no yodhA na yotsyanti katha~nchana
shlokas.42:
evamuktvA tato bhIShmo droNamAchAryasattamam |
avahAramatho chakre tAvakAnAM mahArathaH
shlokas.43:
tato.avahAraH sainyAnAM tava teShAM cha bhArata |
astaM gachChati sUrye.abhUtsandhyAkAle cha vartati

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prabhAtAyAM tu sharvaryAM bhIShmaH shAntanavastataH |
anIkAnyanusa.nyAne vyAdideshAtha bhArata
shlokas.2:
gAruDaM cha mahAvyUhaM chakre shAntanavastadA |
putrANAM te jayAkA~NkShI bhIShmaH kurupitAmahaH
shlokas.3:
garuDasya svayaM tuNDe pitA devavratastava |
chakShuShI cha bharadvAjaH kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH
shlokas.4:
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva shIrShamAstAM yashasvinau |
trigartairmatsyakaikeyairvATadhAnaishcha sa.nyutau
shlokas.5:
bhUrishravAH shalaH shalyo bhagadattashcha mAriSha |
madrakAH sindhusauvIrAstathA pa~nchanadAshcha ye
shlokas.6:
jayadrathena sahitA grIvAyAM saMniveshitAH |
pRRiShThe duryodhano rAjA sodaraiH sAnugairvRRitaH
shlokas.7:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau kAmbojashcha shakaiH saha |
puchChamAsanmahArAja shUrasenAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.8:
mAgadhAshcha kali~NgAshcha dAsherakagaNaiH saha |
dakShiNaM pakShamAsAdya sthitA vyUhasya da.nshitAH
shlokas.9:
kAnanAshcha viku~njAshcha muktAH puNDrAviShastathA |
bRRihadbalena sahitA vAmaM pakShamupAshritAH
shlokas.10:
vyUDhaM dRRiShTvA tu tatsainyaM savyasAchI parantapaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnena sahitaH pratyavyUhata sa.nyuge
ardhachandreNa vyUhena vyUhaM tamatidAruNam
shlokas.11:
dakShiNaM shRRi~NgamAsthAya bhImaseno vyarochata |
nAnAshastraughasampannairnAnAdeshyairnRRipairvRRitaH
shlokas.12:
tadanveva virATashcha drupadashcha mahArathaH |
tadanantaramevAsInnIlo nIlAyudhaiH saha
shlokas.13:
nIlAdanantaraM chaiva dhRRiShTaketurmahArathaH |
chedikAshikarUShaishcha pauravaishchAbhisa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.14:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha pA~nchAlAshcha prabhadrakAH |
madhye sainyasya mahataH sthitA yuddhAya bhArata
shlokas.15:
tathaiva dharmarAjo.api gajAnIkena sa.nvRRitaH |
tatastu sAtyakI rAjandraupadyAH pa~ncha chAtmajAH
shlokas.16:
abhimanyustatastUrNamirAvA.nshcha tataH param |
bhaimasenistato rAjankekayAshcha mahArathAH
shlokas.17:
tato.abhUddvipadAM shreShTho vAmaM pArshvamupAshritaH |
sarvasya jagato goptA goptA yasya janArdanaH
shlokas.18:
evametanmahAvyUhaM pratyavyUhanta pANDavAH |
vadhArthaM tava putrANAM tatpakShaM ye cha sa~NgatAH
shlokas.19:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM vyatiShaktarathadvipam |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha nighnatAmitaretaram
shlokas.20:
hayaughAshcha rathaughAshcha tatra tatra vishAM pate |
sampatantaH sma dRRishyante nighnamAnAH parasparam
shlokas.21:
dhAvatAM cha rathaughAnAM nighnatAM cha pRRithakpRRithak |
babhUva tumulaH shabdo vimishro dundubhisvanaiH
shlokas.22:
divaspRRi~NnaravIrANAM nighnatAmitaretaram |
samprahAre sutumule tava teShAM cha bhArata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato vyUDheShvanIkeShu tAvakeShvitareShu cha |
dhana~njayo rathAnIkamavadhIttava bhArata
sharairatiratho yuddhe pAtayanrathayUthapAn
shlokas.2:
te vadhyamAnAH pArthena kAleneva yugakShaye |
dhArtarAShTrA raNe yattAH pANDavAnpratyayodhayan
prArthayAnA yasho dIptaM mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.3:
ekAgramanaso bhUtvA pANDavAnAM varUthinIm |
babha~njurbahusho rAja.nste chAbhajyanta sa.nyuge
shlokas.4:
dravadbhiratha bhagnaishcha parivartadbhireva cha |
pANDavaiH kauravaishchaiva na praj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.5:
udatiShThadrajo bhaumaM ChAdayAnaM divAkaram |
dishaH pratidisho vApi tatra jaj~nuH katha~nchana
shlokas.6:
anumAnena sa~nj~nAbhirnAmagotraishcha sa.nyuge |
vartate sma tadA yuddhaM tatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.7:
na vyUho bhidyate tatra kauravANAM katha~nchana |
rakShitaH satyasandhena bhAradvAjena dhImatA
shlokas.8:
tathaiva pANDaveyAnAM rakShitaH savyasAchinA |
nAbhidhyata mahAvyUho bhImena cha surakShitaH
shlokas.9:
senAgrAdabhiniShpatya prAyudhya.nstatra mAnavAH |
ubhayoH senayo rAjanvyatiShaktarathadvipAH
shlokas.10:
hayArohairhayArohAH pAtyante sma mahAhave |
RRiShTibhirvimalAgrAbhiH prAsairapi cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.11:
rathI rathinamAsAdya sharaiH kanakabhUShaNaiH |
pAtayAmAsa samare tasminnatibhaya~Nkare
shlokas.12:
gajArohA gajArohAnnArAchasharatomaraiH |
sa.nsaktAH pAtayAmAsustava teShAM cha sa~NghashaH
shlokas.13:
pattisa~NghA raNe pattInbhiNDipAlaparashvadhaiH |
nyapAtayanta saMhRRiShTAH parasparakRRitAgasaH
shlokas.14:
padAtI rathinaM sa~Nkhye rathI chApi padAtinam |
nyapAtayachChitaiH shastraiH senayorubhayorapi
shlokas.15:
gajArohA hayArohAnpAtayAM chakrire tadA |
hayArohA gajasthA.nshcha tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.16:
gajArohavaraishchApi tatra tatra padAtayaH |
pAtitAH samadRRishyanta taishchApi gajayodhinaH
shlokas.17:
pattisa~NghA hayArohaiH sAdisa~NghAshcha pattibhiH |
pAtyamAnA vyadRRishyanta shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
dhvajaistatrApaviddhaishcha kArmukaistomaraistathA |
prAsaistathA gadAbhishcha parighaiH kampanaistathA
shlokas.19:
shaktibhiH kavachaishchitraiH kaNapaira~Nkushairapi |
nistri.nshairvimalaishchApi svarNapu~NkhaiH sharaistathA
shlokas.20:
paristomaiH kuthAbhishcha kambalaishcha mahAdhanaiH |
bhUrbhAti bharatashreShTha sragdAmairiva chitritA
shlokas.21:
narAshvakAyaiH patitairdantibhishcha mahAhave |
agamyarUpA pRRithivI mA.nsashoNitakardamA
shlokas.22:
prashashAma rajo bhaumaM vyukShitaM raNashoNitaiH |
dishashcha vimalAH sarvAH sambabhUvurjaneshvara
shlokas.23:
utthitAnyagaNeyAni kabandhAni samantataH |
chihnabhUtAni jagato vinAshArthAya bhArata
shlokas.24:
tasminyuddhe mahAraudre vartamAne sudAruNe |
pratyadRRishyanta rathino dhAvamAnAH samantataH
shlokas.25:
tato droNashcha bhIShmashcha saindhavashcha jayadrathaH |
purumitro vikarNashcha shakunishchApi saubalaH
shlokas.26:
ete samaradurdharShAH siMhatulyaparAkramAH |
pANDavAnAmanIkAni babha~njuH sma punaH punaH
shlokas.27:
tathaiva bhImaseno.api rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH |
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha draupadeyAshcha bhArata
shlokas.28:
tAvakA.nstava putrA.nshcha sahitAnsarvarAjabhiH |
drAvayAmAsurAjau te tridashA dAnavAniva
shlokas.29:
tathA te samare.anyonyaM nighnantaH kShatriyarShabhAH |
raktokShitA ghorarUpA virejurdAnavA iva
shlokas.30:
vinirjitya ripUnvIrAH senayorubhayorapi |
vyadRRishyanta mahAmAtrA grahA iva nabhastale
shlokas.31:
tato rathasahasreNa putro duryodhanastava |
abhyayAtpANDavAnyuddhe rAkShasaM cha ghaTotkacham
shlokas.32:
tathaiva pANDavAH sarve mahatyA senayA saha |
droNabhIShmau raNe shUrau pratyudyayurari.ndamau
shlokas.33:
kirITI tu yayau kruddhaH samarthAnpArthivottamAn |
ArjuniH sAtyakishchaiva yayatuH saubalaM balam
shlokas.34:
tataH pravavRRite bhUyaH sa~NgrAmo lomaharShaNaH |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha samare vijigIShatAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataste pArthivAH kruddhAH phalgunaM vIkShya sa.nyuge |
rathairanekasAhasraiH samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.2:
athainaM rathavRRindena koShTakIkRRitya bhArata |
sharaiH subahusAhasraiH samantAdabhyavArayan
shlokas.3:
shaktIshcha vimalAstIkShNA gadAshcha parighaiH saha |
prAsAnparashvadhA.nshchaiva mudgarAnmusalAnapi
chikShipuH samare kruddhAH phalgunasya rathaM prati
shlokas.4:
shastrANAmatha tAM vRRiShTiM shalabhAnAmivAyatim |
rurodha sarvataH pArthaH sharaiH kanakabhUShaNaiH
shlokas.5:
tatra tallAghavaM dRRiShTvA bIbhatsoratimAnuSham |
devadAnavagandharvAH pishAchoragarAkShasAH
sAdhu sAdhviti rAjendra phalgunaM pratyapUjayan
shlokas.6:
sAtyakiM chAbhimanyuM cha mahatyA senayA saha |
gAndhArAH samare shUrA rurudhuH sahasaubalAH
shlokas.7:
tatra saubalakAH kruddhA vArShNeyasya rathottamam |
tilashashchichChiduH krodhAchChastrairnAnAvidhairyudhi
shlokas.8:
sAtyakistu rathaM tyaktvA vartamAne mahAbhaye |
abhimanyo rathaM tUrNamAruroha parantapaH
shlokas.9:
tAvekarathasa.nyuktau saubaleyasya vAhinIm |
vyadhametAM shitaistUrNaM sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.10:
droNabhIShmau raNe yattau dharmarAjasya vAhinIm |
nAshayetAM sharaistIkShNaiH ka~NkapatraparichChadaiH
shlokas.11:
tato dharmasuto rAjA mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
miShatAM sarvasainyAnAM droNAnIkamupAdravan
shlokas.12:
tatrAsItsumahadyuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
yathA devAsuraM yuddhaM pUrvamAsItsudAruNam
shlokas.13:
kurvANau tu mahatkarma bhImasenaghaTotkachau |
duryodhanastato.abhyetya tAvubhAvabhyavArayat
shlokas.14:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma haiDimbasya parAkramam |
atItya pitaraM yuddhe yadayudhyata bhArata
shlokas.15:
bhImasenastu sa~Nkruddho duryodhanamamarShaNam |
hRRidyavidhyatpRRiShatkena prahasanniva pANDavaH
shlokas.16:
tato duryodhano rAjA prahAravaramohitaH |
niShasAda rathopasthe kashmalaM cha jagAma ha
shlokas.17:
taM visa~nj~namatho j~nAtvA tvaramANo.asya sArathiH |
apovAha raNAdrAja.nstataH sainyamabhidyata
shlokas.18:
tatastAM kauravIM senAM dravamANAM samantataH |
nighnanbhImaH sharaistIkShNairanuvavrAja pRRiShThataH
shlokas.19:
pArShatashcha rathashreShTho dharmaputrashcha pANDavaH |
droNasya pashyataH sainyaM gA~Ngeyasya cha pashyataH
jaghnaturvishikhaistIkShNaiH parAnIkavishAtanaiH
shlokas.20:
dravamANaM tu tatsainyaM tava putrasya sa.nyuge |
nAshaknutAM vArayituM bhIShmadroNau mahArathau
shlokas.21:
vAryamANaM hi bhIShmeNa droNena cha vishAM pate |
vidravatyeva tatsainyaM pashyatordroNabhIShmayoH
shlokas.22:
tato rathasahasreShu vidravatsu tatastataH |
tAvAsthitAvekarathaM saubhadrashinipu~Ngavau
saubalIM samare senAM shAtayetAM samantataH
shlokas.23:
shushubhAte tadA tau tu shaineyakurupu~Ngavau |
amAvAsyAM gatau yadvatsomasUryau nabhastale
shlokas.24:
arjunastu tataH kruddhastava sainyaM vishAM pate |
vavarSha sharavarSheNa dhArAbhiriva toyadaH
shlokas.25:
vadhyamAnaM tatastattu sharaiH pArthasya sa.nyuge |
dudrAva kauravaM sainyaM viShAdabhayakampitam
shlokas.26:
dravatastAnsamAlokya bhIShmadroNau mahArathau |
nyavArayetAM sa.nrabdhau duryodhanahitaiShiNau
shlokas.27:
tato duryodhano rAjA samAshvasya vishAM pate |
nyavartayata tatsainyaM dravamANaM samantataH
shlokas.28:
yatra yatra sutaM tubhyaM yo yaH pashyati bhArata |
tatra tatra nyavartanta kShatriyANAM mahArathAH
shlokas.29:
tAnnivRRittAnsamIkShyaiva tato.anye.apItare janAH |
anyonyaspardhayA rAja.NllajjayAnye.avatasthire
shlokas.30:
punarAvartatAM teShAM vega AsIdvishAM pate |
pUryataH sAgarasyeva chandrasyodayanaM prati
shlokas.31:
saMnivRRittA.nstatastA.nstu dRRiShTvA rAjA suyodhanaH |
abravIttvarito gatvA bhIShmaM shAntanavaM vachaH
shlokas.32:
pitAmaha nibodhedaM yattvA vakShyAmi bhArata |
nAnurUpamahaM manye tvayi jIvati kaurava
shlokas.33:
droNe chAstravidAM shreShThe saputre sasuhRRijjane |
kRRipe chaiva maheShvAse dravatIyaM varUthinI
shlokas.34:
na pANDavAH pratibalAstava rAjankatha~nchana |
tathA droNasya sa~NgrAme drauNeshchaiva kRRipasya cha
shlokas.35:
anugrAhyAH pANDusutA nUnaM tava pitAmaha |
yathemAM kShamase vIra vadhyamAnAM varUthinIm
shlokas.36:
so.asmi vAchyastvayA rAjanpUrvameva samAgame |
na yotsye pANDavAnsa~Nkhye nApi pArShatasAtyakI
shlokas.37:
shrutvA tu vachanaM tubhyamAchAryasya kRRipasya cha |
karNena sahitaH kRRityaM chintayAnastadaiva hi
shlokas.38:
yadi nAhaM parityAjyo yuvAbhyAmiha sa.nyuge |
vikrameNAnurUpeNa yudhyetAM puruSharShabhau
shlokas.39:
etachChrutvA vacho bhIShmaH prahasanvai muhurmuhuH |
abravIttanayaM tubhyaM krodhAdudvRRitya chakShuShI
shlokas.40:
bahusho hi mayA rAja.nstathyamuktaM hitaM vachaH |
ajeyAH pANDavA yuddhe devairapi savAsavaiH
shlokas.41:
yattu shakyaM mayA kartuM vRRiddhenAdya nRRipottama |
kariShyAmi yathAshakti prekShedAnIM sabAndhavaH
shlokas.42:
adya pANDusutAnsarvAnsasainyAnsaha bandhubhiH |
miShato vArayiShyAmi sarvalokasya pashyataH
shlokas.43:
evamukte tu bhIShmeNa putrAstava janeshvara |
dadhmuH sha~NkhAnmudA yuktA bherIshcha jaghnire bhRRisham
shlokas.44:
pANDavApi tato rAja~nshrutvA taM ninadaM mahat |
dadhmuH sha~NkhA.nshcha bherIshcha murajA.nshcha vyanAdayan

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
pratij~nAte tu bhIShmeNa tasminyuddhe sudAruNe |
krodhito mama putreNa duHkhitena visheShataH
shlokas.2:
bhIShmaH kimakarottatra pANDaveyeShu sa~njaya |
pitAmahe vA pA~nchAlAstanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
gatapUrvAhNabhUyiShThe tasminnahani bhArata |
jayaM prApteShu hRRiShTeShu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu
shlokas.4:
sarvadharmavisheShaj~naH pitA devavratastava |
abhyayAjjavanairashvaiH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
mahatyA senayA guptastava putraishcha sarvashaH
shlokas.5:
prAvartata tato yuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
asmAkaM pANDavaiH sArdhamanayAttava bhArata
shlokas.6:
dhanuShAM kUjatAM tatra talAnAM chAbhihanyatAm |
mahAnsamabhavachChabdo girINAmiva dIryatAm
shlokas.7:
tiShTha sthito.asmi viddhyenaM nivartasva sthiro bhava |
sthito.asmi praharasveti shabdAH shrUyanta sarvashaH
shlokas.8:
kA~nchaneShu tanutreShu kirITeShu dhvajeShu cha |
shilAnAmiva shaileShu patitAnAmabhUtsvanaH
shlokas.9:
patitAnyuttamA~NgAni bAhavashcha vibhUShitAH |
vyacheShTanta mahIM prApya shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.10:
hRRitottamA~NgAH kechittu tathaivodyatakArmukAH |
pragRRihItAyudhAshchApi tasthuH puruShasattamAH
shlokas.11:
prAvartata mahAvegA nadI rudhiravAhinI |
mAta~NgA~NgashilAraudrA mA.nsashoNitakardamA
shlokas.12:
varAshvanaranAgAnAM sharIraprabhavA tadA |
paralokArNavamukhI gRRidhragomAyumodinI
shlokas.13:
na dRRiShTaM na shrutaM chApi yuddhametAdRRishaM nRRipa |
yathA tava sutAnAM cha pANDavAnAM cha bhArata
shlokas.14:
nAsIdrathapathastatra yodhairyudhi nipAtitaiH |
gajaishcha patitairnIlairgirishRRi~NgairivAvRRitam
shlokas.15:
vikIrNaiH kavachaishchitrairdhvajaishChatraishcha mAriSha |
shushubhe tadraNasthAnaM sharadIva nabhastalam
shlokas.16:
vinirbhinnAH sharaiH kechidantapIDAvikarShiNaH |
abhItAH samare shatrUnabhyadhAvanta da.nshitAH
shlokas.17:
tAta bhrAtaH sakhe bandho vayasya mama mAtula |
mA mAM parityajetyanye chukrushuH patitA raNe
shlokas.18:
AdhAvAbhyehi mA gachCha kiM bhIto.asi kva yAsyasi |
sthito.ahaM samare mA bhairiti chAnye vichukrushuH
shlokas.19:
tatra bhIShmaH shAntanavo nityaM maNDalakArmukaH |
mumocha bANAndIptAgrAnahInAshIviShAniva
shlokas.20:
sharairekAyanIkurvandishaH sarvA yatavrataH |
jaghAna pANDavarathAnAdishyAdishya bhArata
shlokas.21:
sa nRRityanvai rathopasthe darshayanpANilAghavam |
alAtachakravadrAja.nstatra tatra sma dRRishyate
shlokas.22:
tamekaM samare shUraM pANDavAH sRRi~njayAstathA |
anekashatasAhasraM samapashyanta lAghavAt
shlokas.23:
mAyAkRRitAtmAnamiva bhIShmaM tatra sma menire |
pUrvasyAM dishi taM dRRiShTvA pratIchyAM dadRRishurjanAH
shlokas.24:
udIchyAM chainamAlokya dakShiNasyAM punaH prabho |
evaM sa samare vIro gA~NgeyaH pratyadRRishyata
shlokas.25:
na chainaM pANDaveyAnAM kashchichChaknoti vIkShitum |
vishikhAneva pashyanti bhIShmachApachyutAnbahUn
shlokas.26:
kurvANaM samare karma sUdayAnaM cha vAhinIm |
vyAkroshanta raNe tatra vIrA bahuvidhaM bahu
amAnuSheNa rUpeNa charantaM pitaraM tava
shlokas.27:
shalabhA iva rAjAnaH patanti vidhichoditAH |
bhIShmAgnimabhi sa~NkruddhaM vinAshAya sahasrashaH
shlokas.28:
na hi moghaH sharaH kashchidAsIdbhIShmasya sa.nyuge |
naranAgAshvakAyeShu bahutvAllaghuvedhinaH
shlokas.29:
bhinattyekena bANena sumuktena patatriNA |
gajaka~NkaTasaMnAhaM vajreNevAchalottamam
shlokas.30:
dvau trInapi gajArohAnpiNDitAnvarmitAnapi |
nArAchena sutIkShNena nijaghAna pitA tava
shlokas.31:
yo yo bhIShmaM naravyAghramabhyeti yudhi kashchana |
muhUrtadRRiShTaH sa mayA pAtito bhuvi dRRishyate
shlokas.32:
evaM sA dharmarAjasya vadhyamAnA mahAchamUH |
bhIShmeNAtulavIryeNa vyashIryata sahasradhA
shlokas.33:
prakIryata mahAsenA sharavarShAbhitApitA |
pashyato vAsudevasya pArthasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.34:
yatamAnApi te vIrA dravamANAnmahArathAn |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM bhIShmabANaprapIDitAH
shlokas.35:
mahendrasamavIryeNa vadhyamAnA mahAchamUH |
abhajyata mahArAja na cha dvau saha dhAvataH
shlokas.36:
AviddhanaranAgAshvaM patitadhvajakUbaram |
anIkaM pANDuputrANAM hAhAbhUtamachetanam
shlokas.37:
jaghAnAtra pitA putraM putrashcha pitaraM tathA |
priyaM sakhAyaM chAkrande sakhA daivabalAtkRRitaH
shlokas.38:
vimuchya kavachAnanye pANDuputrasya sainikAH |
prakIrya keshAndhAvantaH pratyadRRishyanta bhArata
shlokas.39:
tadgokulamivodbhrAntamudbhrAntarathayUthapam |
dadRRishe pANDuputrasya sainyamArtasvaraM tadA
shlokas.40:
prabhajyamAnaM tatsainyaM dRRiShTvA devakinandanaH |
uvAcha pArthaM bIbhatsuM nigRRihya rathamuttamam
shlokas.41:
ayaM sa kAlaH samprAptaH pArtha yaH kA~NkShitastvayA |
praharAsmai naravyAghra na chenmohAdvimuhyase
shlokas.42:
yattvayA kathitaM vIra purA rAj~nAM samAgame |
bhIShmadroNamukhAnsarvAndhArtarAShTrasya sainikAn
shlokas.43:
sAnubandhAnhaniShyAmi ye mAM yotsyanti sa.nyuge |
iti tatkuru kaunteya satyaM vAkyamari.ndama
shlokas.44:
bIbhatso pashya sainyaM svaM bhajyamAnaM samantataH |
dravatashcha mahIpAlAnsarvAnyaudhiShThire bale
shlokas.45:
dRRiShTvA hi samare bhIShmaM vyAttAnanamivAntakam |
bhayArtAH sampraNashyanti siMhaM kShudramRRigA iva
shlokas.46:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha vAsudevaM dhana~njayaH |
chodayAshvAnyato bhIShmo vigAhyaitadbalArNavam
shlokas.47:
tato.ashvAnrajataprakhyA.nshchodayAmAsa mAdhavaH |
yato bhIShmaratho rAjanduShprekShyo rashmimAniva
shlokas.48:
tatastatpunarAvRRittaM yudhiShThirabalaM mahat |
dRRiShTvA pArthaM mahAbAhuM bhIShmAyodyantamAhave
shlokas.49:
tato bhIShmaH kurushreShThaH siMhavadvinadanmuhuH |
dhana~njayarathaM tUrNaM sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.50:
kShaNena sa rathastasya sahayaH sahasArathiH |
sharavarSheNa mahatA sa~nChanno na prakAshate
shlokas.51:
vAsudevastvasambhrAnto dhairyamAsthAya sattvavAn |
chodayAmAsa tAnashvAnvitunnAnbhIShmasAyakaiH
shlokas.52:
tataH pArtho dhanurgRRihya divyaM jaladanisvanam |
pAtayAmAsa bhIShmasya dhanushChittvA tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.53:
sa chChinnadhanvA kauravyaH punaranyanmahaddhanuH |
nimeShAntaramAtreNa sajyaM chakre pitA tava
shlokas.54:
vichakarSha tato dorbhyAM dhanurjaladanisvanam |
athAsya tadapi kruddhashchichCheda dhanurarjunaH
shlokas.55:
tasya tatpUjayAmAsa lAghavaM shantanoH sutaH |
sAdhu pArtha mahAbAho sAdhu bho pANDunandana
shlokas.56:
tvayyevaitadyuktarUpaM mahatkarma dhana~njaya |
prIto.asmi sudRRiDhaM putra kuru yuddhaM mayA saha
shlokas.57:
iti pArthaM prashasyAtha pragRRihyAnyanmahaddhanuH |
mumocha samare vIraH sharAnpArtharathaM prati
shlokas.58:
adarshayadvAsudevo hayayAne paraM balam |
moghAnkurva~nsharA.nstasya maNDalAnyacharallaghu
shlokas.59:
tathApi bhIShmaH sudRRiDhaM vAsudevadhana~njayau |
vivyAdha nishitairbANaiH sarvagAtreShu mAriSha
shlokas.60:
shushubhAte naravyAghrau tau bhIShmasharavikShatau |
govRRiShAviva nardantau viShANollikhitA~Nkitau
shlokas.61:
punashchApi susa~NkruddhaH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
kRRiShNayoryudhi sa.nrabdho bhIShmo vyAvArayaddishaH
shlokas.62:
vArShNeyaM cha sharaistIkShNaiH kampayAmAsa roShitaH |
muhurabhyutsmayanbhIShmaH prahasya svanavattadA
shlokas.63:
tataH kRRiShNastu samare dRRiShTvA bhIShmaparAkramam |
samprekShya cha mahAbAhuH pArthasya mRRiduyuddhatAm
shlokas.64:
bhIShmaM cha sharavarShANi sRRijantamanishaM yudhi |
pratapantamivAdityaM madhyamAsAdya senayoH
shlokas.65:
varAnvarAnvinighnantaM pANDuputrasya sainikAn |
yugAntamiva kurvANaM bhIShmaM yaudhiShThire bale
shlokas.66:
amRRiShyamANo bhagavAnkeshavaH paravIrahA |
achintayadameyAtmA nAsti yaudhiShThiraM balam
shlokas.67:
ekAhnA hi raNe bhIShmo nAshayeddevadAnavAn |
kimu pANDusutAnyuddhe sabalAnsapadAnugAn
shlokas.68:
dravate cha mahatsainyaM pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
ete cha kauravAstUrNaM prabhagnAndRRishya somakAn
Adravanti raNe hRRiShTA harShayantaH pitAmaham
shlokas.69:
so.ahaM bhIShmaM nihanmyadya pANDavArthAya da.nshitaH |
bhArametaM vineShyAmi pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.70:
arjuno.api sharaistIkShNairvadhyamAno hi sa.nyuge |
kartavyaM nAbhijAnAti raNe bhIShmasya gauravAt
shlokas.71:
tathA chintayatastasya bhUya eva pitAmahaH |
preShayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaH sharAnpArtharathaM prati
shlokas.72:
teShAM bahutvAddhi bhRRishaM sharANAM; disho.atha sarvAH pihitA babhUvuH |
na chAntarikShaM na disho na bhUmi;rna bhAskaro.adRRishyata rashmimAlI
vavushcha vAtAstumulAH sadhUmA; dishashcha sarvAH kShubhitA babhUvuH
shlokas.73:
droNo vikarNo.atha jayadrathashcha; bhUrishravAH kRRitavarmA kRRipashcha |
shrutAyurambaShThapatishcha rAjA; vindAnuvindau cha sudakShiNashcha
shlokas.74:
prAchyAshcha sauvIragaNAshcha sarve; vasAtayaH kShudrakamAlavAshcha |
kirITinaM tvaramANAbhisasru;rnideshagAH shAntanavasya rAj~naH
shlokas.76:
tatastu dRRiShTvArjunavAsudevau; padAtinAgAshvarathaiH samantAt |
abhidrutau shastrabhRRitAM variShThau; shinipravIro.abhisasAra tUrNam
shlokas.77:
sa tAnyanIkAni mahAdhanuShmA;~nshinipravIraH sahasAbhipatya |
chakAra sAhAyyamathArjunasya; viShNuryathA vRRitraniShUdanasya
shlokas.78:
vishIrNanAgAshvarathadhvajaughaM; bhIShmeNa vitrAsitasarvayodham |
yudhiShThirAnIkamabhidravantaM; provAcha sa.ndRRishya shinipravIraH
shlokas.79:
kva kShatriyA yAsyatha naiSha dharmaH; satAM purastAtkathitaH purANaiH |
mA svAM pratij~nAM jahata pravIrAH; svaM vIradharmaM paripAlayadhvam
shlokas.80:
tAnvAsavAnantarajo nishamya; narendramukhyAndravataH samantAt |
pArthasya dRRiShTvA mRRiduyuddhatAM cha; bhIShmaM cha sa~Nkhye samudIryamANam
shlokas.81:
amRRiShyamANaH sa tato mahAtmA; yashasvinaM sarvadashArhabhartA |
uvAcha shaineyamabhiprasha.nsa;ndRRiShTvA kurUnApatataH samantAt
shlokas.82:
ye yAnti yAntveva shinipravIra; ye.api sthitAH sAtvata te.api yAntu |
bhIShmaM rathAtpashya nipAtyamAnaM; droNaM cha sa~Nkhye sagaNaM mayAdya
shlokas.83:
nAsau rathaH sAtvata kauravANAM; kruddhasya muchyeta raNe.adya kashchit |
tasmAdahaM gRRihya rathA~NgamugraM; prANaM hariShyAmi mahAvratasya
shlokas.84:
nihatya bhIShmaM sagaNaM tathAjau; droNaM cha shaineya rathapravIram |
prItiM kariShyAmi dhana~njayasya; rAj~nashcha bhImasya tathAshvinoshcha
shlokas.85:
nihatya sarvAndhRRitarAShTraputrAM;statpakShiNo ye cha narendramukhyAH |
rAjyena rAjAnamajAtashatruM; sampAdayiShyAmyahamadya hRRiShTaH
shlokas.86:
tataH sunAbhaM vasudevaputraH; sUryaprabhaM vajrasamaprabhAvam |
kShurAntamudyamya bhujena chakraM; rathAdavaplutya visRRijya vAhAn
shlokas.87:
sa~NkampayangAM charaNairmahAtmA; vegena kRRiShNaH prasasAra bhIShmam |
madAndhamAjau samudIrNadarpaH; siMho jighA.nsanniva vAraNendram
shlokas.88:
so.abhyadravadbhIShmamanIkamadhye; kruddho mahendrAvarajaH pramAthI |
vyAlambipItAntapaTashchakAshe; ghano yathA khe.achirabhApinaddhaH
shlokas.89:
sudarshanaM chAsya rarAja shaure;stachchakrapadmaM subhujorunAlam |
yathAdipadmaM taruNArkavarNaM; rarAja nArAyaNanAbhijAtam
shlokas.90:
tatkRRiShNakopodayasUryabuddhaM; kShurAntatIkShNAgrasujAtapatram |
tasyaiva dehorusaraHprarUDhaM; rarAja nArAyaNabAhunAlam
shlokas.91:
tamAttachakraM praNadantamuchchaiH; kruddhaM mahendrAvarajaM samIkShya |
sarvANi bhUtAni bhRRishaM vineduH; kShayaM kurUNAmiti chintayitvA
shlokas.92:
sa vAsudevaH pragRRihItachakraH; sa.nvartayiShyanniva jIvalokam |
abhyutpata.NllokagururbabhAse; bhUtAni dhakShyanniva kAlavahniH
shlokas.93:
tamApatantaM pragRRihItachakraM; samIkShya devaM dvipadAM variShTham |
asambhramAtkArmukabANapANI; rathe sthitaH shAntanavo.abhyuvAcha
shlokas.94:
ehyehi devesha jagannivAsa; namo.astu te shAr~NgarathA~NgapANe |
prasahya mAM pAtaya lokanAtha; rathottamAdbhUtasharaNya sa~Nkhye
shlokas.95:
tvayA hatasyeha mamAdya kRRiShNa; shreyaH parasminniha chaiva loke |
sambhAvito.asmyandhakavRRiShNinAtha; lokaistribhirvIra tavAbhiyAnAt
shlokas.96:
rathAdavaplutya tatastvarAvA;npArtho.apyanudrutya yadupravIram |
jagrAha pInottamalambabAhuM; bAhvorhariM vyAyatapInabAhuH
shlokas.97:
nigRRihyamANashcha tadAdidevo; bhRRishaM saroShaH kila nAma yogI |
AdAya vegena jagAma viShNu;rjiShNuM mahAvAta ivaikavRRikSham
shlokas.98:
pArthastu viShTabhya balena pAdau; bhIShmAntikaM tUrNamabhidravantam |
balAnnijagrAha kirITamAlI; pade.atha rAjandashame katha~nchit
shlokas.99:
avasthitaM cha praNipatya kRRiShNaM; prIto.arjunaH kA~nchanachitramAlI |
uvAcha kopaM pratisaMhareti; gatirbhavAnkeshava pANDavAnAm
shlokas.100:
na hAsyate karma yathApratij~naM; putraiH shape keshava sodaraishcha |
antaM kariShyAmi yathA kurUNAM; tvayAhamindrAnuja samprayuktaH
shlokas.101:
tataH pratij~nAM samayaM cha tasmai; janArdanaH prItamanA nishamya |
sthitaH priye kauravasattamasya; rathaM sachakraH punarAruroha
shlokas.102:
sa tAnabhIShUnpunarAdadAnaH; pragRRihya sha~NkhaM dviShatAM nihantA |
vinAdayAmAsa tato dishashcha; sa pA~nchajanyasya raveNa shauriH
shlokas.103:
vyAviddhaniShkA~NgadakuNDalaM taM; rajovikIrNA~nchitapakShmanetram |
vishuddhadaMShTraM pragRRihItasha~NkhaM; vichukrushuH prekShya kurupravIrAH
shlokas.104:
mRRida~NgabherIpaTahapraNAdA; nemisvanA dundubhinisvanAshcha |
sasiMhanAdAshcha babhUvurugrAH; sarveShvanIkeShu tataH kurUNAm
shlokas.105:
gANDIvaghoShaH stanayitnukalpo; jagAma pArthasya nabho dishashcha |
jagmushcha bANA vimalAH prasannAH; sarvA dishaH pANDavachApamuktAH
shlokas.106:
taM kauravANAmadhipo balena; bhIShmeNa bhUrishravasA cha sArdham |
abhyudyayAvudyatabANapANiH; kakShaM didhakShanniva dhUmaketuH
shlokas.107:
athArjunAya prajahAra bhallA;nbhUrishravAH sapta suvarNapu~NkhAn |
duryodhanastomaramugravegaM; shalyo gadAM shAntanavashcha shaktim
shlokas.108:
sa saptabhiH sapta sharapravekA;nsa.nvArya bhUrishravasA visRRiShTAn |
shitena duryodhanabAhumuktaM; kShureNa tattomaramunmamAtha
shlokas.109:
tataH shubhAmApatatIM sa shaktiM; vidyutprabhAM shAntanavena muktAm |
gadAM cha madrAdhipabAhumuktAM; dvAbhyAM sharAbhyAM nichakarta vIraH
shlokas.110:
tato bhujAbhyAM balavadvikRRiShya; chitraM dhanurgANDivamaprameyam |
mAhendramastraM vidhivatsughoraM; prAdushchakArAdbhutamantarikShe
shlokas.111:
tenottamAstreNa tato mahAtmA; sarvANyanIkAni mahAdhanuShmAn |
sharaughajAlairvimalAgnivarNai;rnivArayAmAsa kirITamAlI
shlokas.112:
shilImukhAH pArthadhanuHpramuktA; rathAndhvajAgrANi dhanUMShi bAhUn |
nikRRitya dehAnvivishuH pareShAM; narendranAgendratura~NgamANAm
shlokas.113:
tato dishashchAnudishashcha pArthaH; sharaiH sudhArairnishitairvitatya |
gANDIvashabdena manA.nsi teShAM; kirITamAlI vyathayAM chakAra
shlokas.114:
tasmi.nstathA ghoratame pravRRitte; sha~NkhasvanA dundubhinisvanAshcha |
antarhitA gANDivanisvanena; bhabhUvurugrAshcha raNapraNAdAH
shlokas.115:
gANDIvashabdaM tamatho viditvA; virATarAjapramukhA nRRivIrAH |
pA~nchAlarAjo drupadashcha vIra;staM deshamAjagmuradInasattvAH
shlokas.116:
sarvANi sainyAni tu tAvakAni; yato yato gANDivajaH praNAdaH |
tatastataH saMnatimeva jagmu;rna taM pratIpo.abhisasAra kashchit
shlokas.117:
tasminsughore nRRipasamprahAre; hatAH pravIrAH sarathAH sasUtAH |
gajAshcha nArAchanipAtataptA; mahApatAkAH shubharukmakakShyAH
shlokas.118:
parItasattvAH sahasA nipetuH; kirITinA bhinnatanutrakAyAH |
dRRiDhAhatAH patribhirugravegaiH; pArthena bhallairnishitaiH shitAgraiH
shlokas.119:
nikRRittayantrA nihatendrakIlA; dhvajA mahAnto dhvajinImukheShu |
padAtisa~NghAshcha rathAshcha sa~Nkhye; hayAshcha nAgAshcha dhana~njayena
shlokas.120:
bANAhatAstUrNamapetasattvA; viShTabhya gAtrANi nipetururvyAm |
aindreNa tenAstravareNa rAja;nmahAhave bhinnatanutradehAH
shlokas.121:
tataH sharaughairnishitaiH kirITinA; nRRidehashastrakShatalohitodA |
nadI sughorA naradehaphenA; pravartitA tatra raNAjire vai
shlokas.122:
vegena sAtIva pRRithupravAhA; prasusrutA bhairavArAvarUpA |
paretanAgAshvasharIrarodhA; narAntramajjAbhRRitamA.nsapa~NkA
shlokas.124:
narAshvanAgAsthinikRRittasharkarA; vinAshapAtAlavatI bhayAvahA |
tAM ka~NkamAlAvRRitagRRidhrakahvaiH; kravyAdasa~Nghaishcha tarakShubhishcha
shlokas.126:
te chedipA~nchAlakarUShamatsyAH; pArthAshcha sarve sahitAH praNeduH |
vitrAsya senAM dhvajinIpatInAM; siMho mRRigANAmiva yUthasa~NghAn
vinedatustAvatiharShayuktau; gANDIvadhanvA cha janArdanashcha
shlokas.127:
tato raviM saMhRRitarashmijAlaM; dRRiShTvA bhRRishaM shastraparikShatA~NgAH |
tadaindramastraM vitataM sughora;masahyamudvIkShya yugAntakalpam
shlokas.128:
athApayAnaM kuravaH sabhIShmAH; sadroNaduryodhanabAhlikAshcha |
chakrurnishAM sandhigatAM samIkShya; vibhAvasorlohitarAjiyuktAm
shlokas.129:
avApya kIrtiM cha yashashcha loke; vijitya shatrU.nshcha dhana~njayo.api |
yayau narendraiH saha sodaraishcha; samAptakarmA shibiraM nishAyAm
tataH prajaj~ne tumulaH kurUNAM; nishAmukhe ghorataraH praNAdaH
shlokas.130:
raNe rathAnAmayutaM nihatya; hatA gajAH saptashatArjunena |
prAchyAshcha sauvIragaNAshcha sarve; nipAtitAH kShudrakamAlavAshcha
mahatkRRitaM karma dhana~njayena; kartuM yathA nArhati kashchidanyaH
shlokas.131:
shrutAyurambaShThapatishcha rAjA; tathaiva durmarShaNachitrasenau |
droNaH kRRipaH saindhavabAhlikau cha; bhUrishravAH shalyashalau cha rAjan
svabAhuvIryeNa jitAH sabhIShmAH; kirITinA lokamahArathena
shlokas.132:
iti bruvantaH shibirANi jagmuH; sarve gaNA bhArata ye tvadIyAH |
ulkAsahasraishcha susampradIptai;rvibhrAjamAnaishcha tathA pradIpaiH
kirITivitrAsitasarvayodhA; chakre niveshaM dhvajinI kurUNAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vyuShTAM nishAM bhArata bhAratAnA;manIkinInAM pramukhe mahAtmA |
yayau sapatnAnprati jAtakopo; vRRitaH samagreNa balena bhIShmaH
shlokas.2:
taM droNaduryodhanabAhlikAshcha; tathaiva durmarShaNachitrasenau |
jayadrathashchAtibalo balaughai;rnRRipAstathAnye.anuyayuH samantAt
shlokas.3:
sa tairmahadbhishcha mahArathai;shcha tejasvibhirvIryavadbhishcha rAjan |
rarAja rAjottama rAjamukhyai;rvRRitaH sa devairiva vajrapANiH
shlokas.4:
tasminnanIkapramukhe viShaktA; dodhUyamAnAshcha mahApatAkAH |
suraktapItAsitapANDurAbhA; mahAgajaskandhagatA virejuH
shlokas.5:
sA vAhinI shAntanavena rAj~nA; mahArathairvAraNavAjibhishcha |
babhau savidyutstanayitnukalpA; jalAgame dyauriva jAtameghA
shlokas.6:
tato raNAyAbhimukhI prayAtA; pratyarjunaM shAntanavAbhiguptA |
senA mahogrA sahasA kurUNAM; vego yathA bhIma ivApagAyAH
shlokas.7:
taM vyAlanAnAvidhagUDhasAraM; gajAshvapAdAtarathaughapakSham |
vyUhaM mahAmeghasamaM mahAtmA; dadarsha dUrAtkapirAjaketuH
shlokas.8:
sa niryayau ketumatA rathena; nararShabhaH shvetahayena vIraH |
varUthinA sainyamukhe mahAtmA; vadhe dhRRitaH sarvasapatnayUnAm
shlokas.9:
sUpaskaraM sottarabandhureShaM; yattaM yadUnAmRRiShabheNa sa~Nkhye |
kapidhvajaM prekShya viShedurAjau; sahaiva putraistava kauraveyAH
shlokas.10:
prakarShatA guptamudAyudhena; kirITinA lokamahArathena |
taM vyUharAjaM dadRRishustvadIyA;shchatushchaturvyAlasahasrakIrNam
shlokas.11:
yathA hi pUrve.ahani dharmarAj~nA; vyUhaH kRRitaH kauravanandanena |
tathA tathoddeshamupetya tasthuH; pA~nchAlamukhyaiH saha chedimukhyAH
shlokas.12:
tato mahAvegasamAhatAni; bherIsahasrANi vinedurAjau |
sha~NkhasvanA dundubhinisvanAshcha; sarveShvanIkeShu sasiMhanAdAH
shlokas.13:
tataH sabANAni mahAsvanAni; visphAryamANAni dhanUMShi vIraiH |
kShaNena bherIpaNavapraNAdA;nantardadhuH sha~NkhamahAsvanAshcha
shlokas.14:
tachCha~NkhashabdAvRRitamantarikSha;muddhUtabhaumadrutareNujAlam |
mahAvitAnAvatataprakAsha;mAlokya vIrAH sahasAbhipetuH
shlokas.15:
rathI rathenAbhihataH sasUtaH; papAta sAshvaH sarathaH saketuH |
gajo gajenAbhihataH papAta; padAtinA chAbhihataH padAtiH
shlokas.16:
AvartamAnAnyabhivartamAnai;rbANaiH kShatAnyadbhutadarshanAni |
prAsaishcha khaDgaishcha samAhatAni; sadashvavRRindAni sadashvavRRindaiH
shlokas.17:
suvarNatArAgaNabhUShitAni; sharAvarANi prahitAni vIraiH |
vidAryamANAni parashvadhaishcha; prAsaishcha khaDgaishcha nipetururvyAm
shlokas.18:
gajairviShANairvarahastarugNAH; kechitsasUtA rathinaH prapetuH |
gajarShabhAshchApi ratharShabheNa; nipetire bANahatAH pRRithivyAm
shlokas.19:
gajaughavegoddhatasAditAnAM; shrutvA niShedurvasudhAM manuShyAH |
ArtasvaraM sAdipadAtiyUnAM; viShANagAtrAvaratADitAnAm
shlokas.20:
sambhrAntanAgAshvarathe prasUte; mahAbhaye sAdipadAtiyUnAm |
mahArathaiH samparivAryamANaM; dadarsha bhIShmaH kapirAjaketum
shlokas.21:
taM pa~nchatAlochChritatAlaketuH; sadashvavegoddhatavIryayAtaH |
mahAstrabANAshanidIptamArgaM; kirITinaM shAntanavo.abhyadhAvat
shlokas.22:
tathaiva shakrapratimAnakalpa;mindrAtmajaM droNamukhAbhisasruH |
kRRipashcha shalyashcha vivi.nshatishcha; duryodhanaH saumadattishcha rAjan
shlokas.23:
tato rathAnIkamukhAdupetya; sarvAstravitkA~nchanachitravarmA |
javena shUro.abhisasAra sarvAM;stathArjunasyAtra suto.abhimanyuH
shlokas.24:
teShAM mahAstrANi mahArathAnA;masaktakarmA vinihatya kArShNiH |
babhau mahAmantrahutArchimAlI; sadogataH sanbhagavAnivAgniH
shlokas.25:
tataH sa tUrNaM rudhirodaphenAM; kRRitvA nadIM vaishasane ripUNAm |
jagAma saubhadramatItya bhIShmo; mahArathaM pArthamadInasattvaH
shlokas.26:
tataH prahasyAdbhutadarshanena; gANDIvanirhvAdamahAsvanena |
vipAThajAlena mahAstrajAlaM; vinAshayAmAsa kirITamAlI
shlokas.27:
tamuttamaM sarvadhanurdharANA;masaktakarmA kapirAjaketuH |
bhIShmaM mahAtmAbhivavarSha tUrNaM; sharaughajAlairvimalaishcha bhallaiH
shlokas.28:
eva.nvidhaM kArmukabhImanAda;madInavatsatpuruShottamAbhyAm |
dadarsha lokaH kurusRRi~njayAshcha; taddvairathaM bhIShmadhana~njayAbhyAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
drauNirbhUrishravAH shalyashchitrasenashcha mAriSha |
putraH sA.nyamaneshchaiva saubhadraM samayodhayan
shlokas.2:
sa.nsaktamatitejobhistamekaM dadRRishurjanAH |
pa~nchabhirmanujavyAghrairgajaiH siMhashishuM yathA
shlokas.3:
nAbhilakShyatayA kashchinna shaurye na parAkrame |
babhUva sadRRishaH kArShNernAstre nApi cha lAghave
shlokas.4:
tathA tamAtmajaM yuddhe vikramantamari.ndamam |
dRRiShTvA pArtho raNe yattaH siMhanAdamatho.anadat
shlokas.5:
pIDayAnaM cha tatsainyaM pautraM tava vishAM pate |
dRRiShTvA tvadIyA rAjendra samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.6:
dhvajinIM dhArtarAShTrANAM dInashatruradInavat |
pratyudyayau sa saubhadrastejasA cha balena cha
shlokas.7:
tasya lAghavamArgasthamAdityasadRRishaprabham |
vyadRRishyata mahachchApaM samare yudhyataH paraiH
shlokas.8:
sa drauNimiShuNaikena viddhvA shalyaM cha pa~nchabhiH |
dhvajaM sA.nyamaneshchApi so.aShTAbhirapavarjayat
shlokas.9:
rukmadaNDAM mahAshaktiM preShitAM saumadattinA |
shitenoragasa~NkAshAM patriNA vijahAra tAm
shlokas.10:
shalyasya cha mahAghorAnasyataH shatashaH sharAn |
nivAryArjunadAyAdo jaghAna samare hayAn
shlokas.11:
bhUrishravAshcha shalyashcha drauNiH sA.nyamaniH shalaH |
nAbhyavartanta sa.nrabdhAH kArShNerbAhubalAshrayAt
shlokas.12:
tatastrigartA rAjendra madrAshcha saha kekayaiH |
pa~nchatri.nshatisAhasrAstava putreNa choditAH
shlokas.13:
dhanurvedavido mukhyA ajeyAH shatrubhiryudhi |
sahaputraM jighA.nsantaM parivavruH kirITinam
shlokas.14:
tau tu tatra pitAputrau parikShiptau ratharShabhau |
dadarsha rAjanpA~nchAlyaH senApatiramitrajit
shlokas.15:
sa vAraNarathaughAnAM sahasrairbahubhirvRRitaH |
vAjibhiH pattibhishchaiva vRRitaH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.16:
dhanurvisphArya sa~NkruddhashchodayitvA varUthinIm |
yayau tanmadrakAnIkaM kekayA.nshcha parantapaH
shlokas.17:
tena kIrtimatA guptamanIkaM dRRiDhadhanvanA |
prayuktarathanAgAshvaM yotsyamAnamashobhata
shlokas.18:
so.arjunaM pramukhe yAntaM pA~nchAlyaH kurunandana |
tribhiH shAradvataM bANairjatrudeshe samarpayat
shlokas.19:
tataH sa madrakAnhatvA dashabhirdashabhiH sharaiH |
hRRiShTa eko jaghAnAshvaM bhallena kRRitavarmaNaH
shlokas.20:
damanaM chApi dAyAdaM pauravasya mahAtmanaH |
jaghAna vipulAgreNa nArAchena parantapaH
shlokas.21:
tataH sA.nyamaneH putraH pA~nchAlyaM yuddhadurmadam |
avidhyattri.nshatA bANairdashabhishchAsya sArathim
shlokas.22:
so.atividdho maheShvAsaH sRRikkiNI parisa.nlihan |
bhallena bhRRishatIkShNena nichakartAsya kArmukam
shlokas.23:
athainaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA kShiprameva samarpayat |
ashvA.nshchAsyAvadhIdrAjannubhau tau pArShNisArathI
shlokas.24:
sa hatAshve rathe tiShThandadarsha bharatarShabha |
putraH sA.nyamaneH putraM pA~nchAlyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.25:
sa sa~NgRRihya mahAghoraM nistri.nshavaramAyasam |
padAtistUrNamabhyarChadrathasthaM drupadAtmajam
shlokas.26:
taM mahaughamivAyAntaM khAtpatantamivoragam |
bhrAntAvaraNanistri.nshaM kAlotsRRiShTamivAntakam
shlokas.27:
dIpyantamiva shastrArchyA mattavAraNavikramam |
apashyanpANDavAstatra dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
shlokas.28:
tasya pA~nchAlaputrastu pratIpamabhidhAvataH |
shitanistri.nshahastasya sharAvaraNadhAriNaH
shlokas.29:
bANavegamatItasya rathAbhyAshamupeyuShaH |
tvaransenApatiH kruddho bibheda gadayA shiraH
shlokas.30:
tasya rAjansanistri.nshaM suprabhaM cha sharAvaram |
hatasya patato hastAdvegena nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.31:
taM nihatya gadAgreNa lebhe sa paramaM yashaH |
putraH pA~nchAlarAjasya mahAtmA bhImavikramaH
shlokas.32:
tasminhate maheShvAse rAjaputre mahArathe |
hAhAkAro mahAnAsIttava sainyasya mAriSha
shlokas.33:
tataH sA.nyamaniH kruddho dRRiShTvA nihatamAtmajam |
abhidudrAva vegena pA~nchAlyaM yuddhadurmadam
shlokas.34:
tau tatra samare vIrau sametau rathinAM varau |
dadRRishuH sarvarAjAnaH kuravaH pANDavAstathA
shlokas.35:
tataH sA.nyamaniH kruddhaH pArShataM paravIrahA |
AjaghAna tribhirbANaistottrairiva mahAdvipam
shlokas.36:
tathaiva pArShataM shUraM shalyaH samitishobhanaH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddhastato yuddhamavartata

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
daivameva paraM manye pauruShAdapi sa~njaya |
yatsainyaM mama putrasya pANDusainyena vadhyate
shlokas.2:
nityaM hi mAmakA.nstAta hatAneva hi sha.nsasi |
avyagrA.nshcha prahRRiShTA.nshcha nityaM sha.nsasi pANDavAn
shlokas.3:
hInAnpuruShakAreNa mAmakAnadya sa~njaya |
patitAnpAtyamAnA.nshcha hatAneva cha sha.nsasi
shlokas.4:
yudhyamAnAnyathAshakti ghaTamAnA~njayaM prati |
pANDavA vijayantyeva jIyante chaiva mAmakAH
shlokas.5:
so.ahaM tIvrANi duHkhAni duryodhanakRRitAni cha |
ashrauShaM satataM tAta duHsahAni bahUni cha
shlokas.6:
tamupAyaM na pashyAmi jIyeranyena pANDavAH |
mAmakA vA jayaM yuddhe prApnuyuryena sa~njaya
shlokas.7:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kShayaM manuShyadehAnAM gajavAjirathakShayam |
shRRiNu rAjansthiro bhUtvA tavaivApanayo mahAn
shlokas.8:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu shalyena pIDito navabhiH sharaiH |
pIDayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho madrAdhipatimAyasaiH
shlokas.9:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma pArShatasya parAkramam |
nyavArayata yattUrNaM shalyaM samitishobhanam
shlokas.10:
nAntaraM dadRRishe kashchittayoH sa.nrabdhayo raNe |
muhUrtamiva tadyuddhaM tayoH samamivAbhavat
shlokas.11:
tataH shalyo mahArAja dhRRiShTadyumnasya sa.nyuge |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena pItena nishitena cha
shlokas.12:
athainaM sharavarSheNa ChAdayAmAsa bhArata |
giriM jalAgame yadvajjaladA jaladhAriNaH
shlokas.13:
abhimanyustu sa~Nkruddho dhRRiShTadyumne nipIDite |
abhidudrAva vegena madrarAjarathaM prati
shlokas.14:
tato madrAdhiparathaM kArShNiH prApyAtikopanaH |
ArtAyanimameyAtmA vivyAdha vishikhaistribhiH
shlokas.15:
tatastu tAvakA rAjanparIpsanto.a.arjuniM raNe |
madrarAjarathaM tUrNaM parivAryAvatasthire
shlokas.16:
duryodhano vikarNashcha duHshAsanavivi.nshatI |
durmarShaNo duHsahashcha chitrasenashcha durmukhaH
shlokas.17:
satyavratashcha bhadraM te purumitrashcha bhArata |
ete madrAdhiparathaM pAlayantaH sthitA raNe
shlokas.18:
tAnbhImasenaH sa~Nkruddho dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
draupadeyAbhimanyushcha mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.19:
nAnArUpANi shastrANi visRRijanto vishAM pate |
abhyavartanta saMhRRiShTAH parasparavadhaiShiNaH
te vai samIyuH sa~NgrAme rAjandurmantrite tava
shlokas.20:
tasmindAsharathe yuddhe vartamAne bhayAvahe |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha prekShakA rathino.abhavan
shlokas.21:
shastrANyanekarUpANi visRRijanto mahArathAH |
anyonyamabhinardantaH samprahAraM prachakrire
shlokas.22:
te yattA jAtasa.nrambhAH sarve.anyonyaM jighA.nsavaH |
mahAstrANi vimu~nchantaH samApeturamarShaNAH
shlokas.23:
duryodhanastu sa~Nkruddho dhRRiShTadyumnaM mahAraNe |
vivyAdha nishitairbANaishchaturbhistvarito bhRRisham
shlokas.24:
durmarShaNashcha vi.nshatyA chitrasenashcha pa~nchabhiH |
durmukho navabhirbANairduHsahashchApi saptabhiH
vivi.nshatiH pa~nchabhishcha tribhirduHshAsanastathA
shlokas.25:
tAnpratyavidhyadrAjendra pArShataH shatrutApanaH |
ekaikaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA darshayanpANilAghavam
shlokas.26:
satyavrataM tu samare purumitraM cha bhArata |
abhimanyuravidhyattau dashabhirdashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.27:
mAdrIputrau tu samare mAtulaM mAtRRinandanau |
ChAdayetAM sharavrAtaistadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.28:
tataH shalyo mahArAja svasrIyau rathinAM varau |
sharairbahubhirAnarChatkRRitapratikRRitaiShiNau
ChAdyamAnau tatastau tu mAdrIputrau na chelatuH
shlokas.29:
atha duryodhanaM dRRiShTvA bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
vidhitsuH kalahasyAntaM gadAM jagrAha pANDavaH
shlokas.30:
tamudyatagadaM dRRiShTvA kailAsamiva shRRi~NgiNam |
bhImasenaM mahAbAhuM putrAste prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.31:
duryodhanastu sa~Nkruddho mAgadhaM samachodayat |
anIkaM dashasAhasraM ku~njarANAM tarasvinAm
mAgadhaM purataH kRRitvA bhImasenaM samabhyayAt
shlokas.32:
ApatantaM cha taM dRRiShTvA gajAnIkaM vRRikodaraH |
gadApANiravArohadrathAtsiMha ivonnadan
shlokas.33:
adrisAramayIM gurvIM pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm |
abhyadhAvadgajAnIkaM vyAditAsya ivAntakaH
shlokas.34:
sa gajAngadayA nighnanvyacharatsamare balI |
bhImaseno mahAbAhuH savajra iva vAsavaH
shlokas.35:
tasya nAdena mahatA manohRRidayakampinA |
vyatyacheShTanta saMhatya gajA bhImasya nardataH
shlokas.36:
tatastu draupadIputrAH saubhadrashcha mahArathaH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
shlokas.37:
pRRiShThaM bhImasya rakShantaH sharavarSheNa vAraNAn |
abhyadhAvanta varShanto meghA iva girInyathA
shlokas.38:
kShuraiH kShuraprairbhallaishcha pItaira~njalikairapi |
pAtayantottamA~NgAni pANDavA gajayodhinAm
shlokas.39:
shirobhiH prapatadbhishcha bAhubhishcha vibhUShitaiH |
ashmavRRiShTirivAbhAti pANibhishcha sahA~NkushaiH
shlokas.40:
hRRitottamA~NgAH skandheShu gajAnAM gajayodhinaH |
adRRishyantAchalAgreShu drumA bhagnashikhA iva
shlokas.41:
dhRRiShTadyumnahatAnanyAnapashyAma mahAgajAn |
patitAnpAtyamAnA.nshcha pArShatena mahAtmanA
shlokas.42:
mAgadho.atha mahIpAlo gajamairAvatopamam |
preShayAmAsa samare saubhadrasya rathaM prati
shlokas.43:
tamApatantaM samprekShya mAgadhasya gajottamam |
jaghAnaikeShuNA vIraH saubhadraH paravIrahA
shlokas.44:
tasyAvarjitanAgasya kArShNiH parapura~njayaH |
rAj~no rajatapu~Nkhena bhallenApaharachChiraH
shlokas.45:
vigAhya tadgajAnIkaM bhImaseno.api pANDavaH |
vyacharatsamare mRRidnangajAnindro girIniva
shlokas.46:
ekaprahArAbhihatAnbhImasenena ku~njarAn |
apashyAma raNe tasmingirInvajrahatAniva
shlokas.47:
bhagnadantAnbhagnakaTAnbhagnasakthA.nshcha vAraNAn |
bhagnapRRiShThAnbhagnakumbhAnnihatAnparvatopamAn
shlokas.48:
nadataH sIdatashchAnyAnvimukhAnsamare gajAn |
vimUtrAnbhagnasa.nvignA.nstathA vishakRRito.aparAn
shlokas.49:
bhImasenasya mArgeShu gatAsUnparvatopamAn |
apashyAma hatAnnAgAnniShTanantastathApare
shlokas.50:
vamanto rudhiraM chAnye bhinnakumbhA mahAgajAH |
vihvalanto gatA bhUmiM shailA iva dharAtale
shlokas.51:
medorudhiradigdhA~Ngo vasAmajjAsamukShitaH |
vyacharatsamare bhImo daNDapANirivAntakaH
shlokas.52:
gajAnAM rudhirAktAM tAM gadAM bibhradvRRikodaraH |
ghoraH pratibhayashchAsItpinAkIva pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.53:
nirmathyamAnAH kruddhena bhImasenena dantinaH |
sahasA prAdrava~nshiShTA mRRidnantastava vAhinIm
shlokas.54:
taM hi vIraM maheShvAsAH saubhadrapramukhA rathAH |
paryarakShanta yudhyantaM vajrAyudhamivAmarAH
shlokas.55:
shoNitAktAM gadAM bibhradukShito gajashoNitaiH |
kRRitAnta iva raudrAtmA bhImaseno vyadRRishyata
shlokas.56:
vyAyachChamAnaM gadayA dikShu sarvAsu bhArata |
nRRityamAnamapashyAma nRRityantamiva sha~Nkaram
shlokas.57:
yamadaNDopamAM gurvImindrAshanisamasvanAm |
apashyAma mahArAja raudrAM vishasanIM gadAm
shlokas.58:
vimishrAM keshamajjAbhiH pradigdhAM rudhireNa cha |
pinAkamiva rudrasya kruddhasyAbhighnataH pashUn
shlokas.59:
yathA pashUnAM sa~NghAtaM yaShTyA pAlaH prakAlayet |
tathA bhImo gajAnIkaM gadayA paryakAlayat
shlokas.60:
gadayA vadhyamAnAste mArgaNaishcha samantataH |
svAnyanIkAni mRRidnantaH prAdravanku~njarAstava
shlokas.61:
mahAvAta ivAbhrANi vidhamitvA sa vAraNAn |
atiShThattumule bhImaH shmashAna iva shUlabhRRit

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminhate gajAnIke putro duryodhanastava |
bhImasenaM ghnatetyevaM sarvasainyAnyachodayat
shlokas.2:
tataH sarvANyanIkAni tava putrasya shAsanAt |
abhyadravanbhImasenaM nadantaM bhairavAnravAn
shlokas.3:
taM balaughamaparyantaM devairapi durutsaham |
ApatantaM suduShpAraM samudramiva parvaNi
shlokas.4:
rathanAgAshvakalilaM sha~NkhadundubhinAditam |
athAnantamapAraM cha narendrastimitahradam
shlokas.5:
taM bhImasenaH samare mahodadhimivAparam |
senAsAgaramakShobhyaM veleva samavArayat
shlokas.6:
tadAshcharyamapashyAma shraddheyamapi chAdbhutam |
bhImasenasya samare rAjankarmAtimAnuSham
shlokas.7:
udIrNAM pRRithivIM sarvAM sAshvAM sarathaku~njarAm |
asambhramaM bhImaseno gadayA samatADayat
shlokas.8:
sa sa.nvArya balaughA.nstAngadayA rathinAM varaH |
atiShThattumule bhImo girirmerurivAchalaH
shlokas.9:
tasminsutumule ghore kAle paramadAruNe |
bhrAtarashchaiva putrAshcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
shlokas.10:
draupadeyAbhimanyushcha shikhaNDI cha mahArathaH |
na prAjahanbhImasenaM bhaye jAte mahAbalam
shlokas.11:
tataH shaikyAyasIM gurvIM pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm |
avadhIttAvakAnyodhAndaNDapANirivAntakaH
pothayanrathavRRindAni vAjivRRindAni chAbhibhUH
shlokas.12:
vyacharatsamare bhImo yugAnte pAvako yathA |
vinighnansamare sarvAnyugAnte kAlavadvibhuH
shlokas.13:
Uruvegena sa~NkarShanrathajAlAni pANDavaH |
pramardayangajAnsarvAnnaDvalAnIva ku~njaraH
shlokas.14:
mRRidnanrathebhyo rathino gajebhyo gajayodhinaH |
sAdinashchAshvapRRiShThebhyo bhUmau chaiva padAtinaH
shlokas.15:
tatra tatra hataishchApi manuShyagajavAjibhiH |
raNA~NgaNaM tadabhavanmRRityorAghAtasaMnibham
shlokas.16:
pinAkamiva rudrasya kruddhasyAbhighnataH pashUn |
yamadaNDopamAmugrAmindrAshanisamasvanAm
dadRRishurbhImasenasya raudrAM vishasanIM gadAm
shlokas.17:
Avidhyato gadAM tasya kaunteyasya mahAtmanaH |
babhau rUpaM mahAghoraM kAlasyeva yugakShaye
shlokas.18:
taM tathA mahatIM senAM drAvayantaM punaH punaH |
dRRiShTvA mRRityumivAyAntaM sarve vimanaso.abhavan
shlokas.19:
yato yataH prekShate sma gadAmudyamya pANDavaH |
tena tena sma dIryante sarvasainyAni bhArata
shlokas.20:
pradArayantaM sainyAni balaughenAparAjitam |
grasamAnamanIkAni vyAditAsyamivAntakam
shlokas.21:
taM tathA bhImakarmANaM pragRRihItamahAgadam |
dRRiShTvA vRRikodaraM bhIShmaH sahasaiva samabhyayAt
shlokas.22:
mahatA meghaghoSheNa rathenAdityavarchasA |
ChAdaya~nsharavarSheNa parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn
shlokas.23:
tamAyAntaM tathA dRRiShTvA vyAttAnanamivAntakam |
bhIShmaM bhImo mahAbAhuH pratyudIyAdamarShaNaH
shlokas.24:
tasminkShaNe sAtyakiH satyasandhaH; shinipravIro.abhyapatatpitAmaham |
nighnannamitrAndhanuShA dRRiDhena; sa kampaya.nstava putrasya senAm
shlokas.25:
taM yAntamashvai rajataprakAshaiH; sharAndhamantaM dhanuShA dRRiDhena |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM tadAnIM; sarve gaNA bhArata ye tvadIyAH
shlokas.26:
avidhyadenaM nishitaiH sharAgrai;ralambuso rAjavarArshyashRRi~NgiH |
taM vai chaturbhiH pratividhya vIro; naptA shinerabhyapatadrathena
shlokas.27:
anvAgataM vRRiShNivaraM nishamya; madhye ripUNAM parivartamAnam |
prAvartayantaM kurupu~NgavA.nshcha; punaH punashcha praNadantamAjau
shlokas.28:
nAshaknuvanvArayituM variShThaM; madhya.ndine sUryamivAtapantam |
na tatra kashchinnaviShaNNa AsI;dRRite rAjansomadattasya putrAt
shlokas.29:
sa hyAdadAno dhanurugravegaM; bhUrishravA bhArata saumadattiH |
dRRiShTvA rathAnsvAnvyapanIyamAnA;npratyudyayau sAtyakiM yoddhumichChan

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato bhUrishravA rAjansAtyakiM navabhiH sharaiH |
avidhyadbhRRishasa~Nkruddhastottrairiva mahAdvipam
shlokas.2:
kauravaM sAtyakishchaiva sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
avAkiradameyAtmA sarvalokasya pashyataH
shlokas.3:
tato duryodhano rAjA sodaryaiH parivAritaH |
saumadattiM raNe yattaH samantAtparyavArayat
shlokas.4:
tathaiva pANDavAH sarve sAtyakiM rabhasaM raNe |
parivArya sthitAH sa~Nkhye samantAtsumahaujasaH
shlokas.5:
bhImasenastu sa~Nkruddho gadAmudyamya bhArata |
duryodhanamukhAnsarvAnputrA.nste paryavArayat
shlokas.6:
rathairanekasAhasraiH krodhAmarShasamanvitaH |
nandakastava putrastu bhImasenaM mahAbalam
vivyAdha nishitaiH ShaDbhiH ka~NkapatraiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.7:
duryodhanastu samare bhImasenaM mahAbalam |
AjaghAnorasi kruddho mArgaNairnishitaistribhiH
shlokas.8:
tato bhImo mahAbAhuH svarathaM sumahAbalaH |
Aruroha rathashreShThaM vishokaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.9:
ete mahArathAH shUrA dhArtarAShTrA mahAbalAH |
mAmeva bhRRishasa~NkruddhA hantumabhyudyatA yudhi
shlokas.10:
etAnadya haniShyAmi pashyataste na sa.nshayaH |
tasmAnmamAshvAnsa~NgrAme yattaH sa.nyachCha sArathe
shlokas.11:
evamuktvA tataH pArthaH putraM duryodhanaM tava |
vivyAdha dashabhistIkShNaiH sharaiH kanakabhUShaNaiH
nandakaM cha tribhirbANaiH pratyavidhyatstanAntare
shlokas.12:
taM tu duryodhanaH ShaShTyA viddhvA bhImaM mahAbalam |
tribhiranyaiH sunishitairvishokaM pratyavidhyata
shlokas.13:
bhImasya cha raNe rAjandhanushchichCheda bhAsvaram |
muShTideshe sharaistIkShNaistribhI rAjA hasanniva
shlokas.14:
bhImastu prekShya yantAraM vishokaM sa.nyuge tadA |
pIDitaM vishikhaistIkShNaistava putreNa dhanvinA
shlokas.15:
amRRiShyamANaH sa~Nkruddho dhanurdivyaM parAmRRishat |
putrasya te mahArAja vadhArthaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.16:
samAdatta cha sa.nrabdhaH kShurapraM lomavAhinam |
tena chichCheda nRRipaterbhImaH kArmukamuttamam
shlokas.17:
so.apavidhya dhanushChinnaM krodhena prajvalanniva |
anyatkArmukamAdatta satvaraM vegavattaram
shlokas.18:
sandhatta vishikhaM ghoraM kAlamRRityusamaprabham |
tenAjaghAna sa~Nkruddho bhImasenaM stanAntare
shlokas.19:
sa gADhaviddho vyathitaH syandanopastha Avishat |
sa niShaNNo rathopasthe mUrChAmabhijagAma ha
shlokas.20:
taM dRRiShTvA vyathitaM bhImamabhimanyupurogamAH |
nAmRRiShyanta maheShvAsAH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH
shlokas.21:
tatastu tumulAM vRRiShTiM shastrANAM tigmatejasAm |
pAtayAmAsuravyagrAH putrasya tava mUrdhani
shlokas.22:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
duryodhanaM tribhirviddhvA punarvivyAdha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.23:
shalyaM cha pa~nchavi.nshatyA sharairvivyAdha pANDavaH |
rukmapu~NkhairmaheShvAsaH sa viddho vyapayAdraNAt
shlokas.24:
pratyudyayustato bhImaM tava putrAshchaturdasha |
senApatiH suSheNashcha jalasandhaH sulochanaH
shlokas.25:
ugro bhImaratho bhImo bhImabAhuralolupaH |
durmukho duShpradharShashcha vivitsurvikaTaH samaH
shlokas.26:
visRRijanto bahUnbANAnkrodhasa.nraktalochanAH |
bhImasenamabhidrutya vivyadhuH sahitA bhRRisham
shlokas.27:
putrA.nstu tava samprekShya bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
sRRikkiNI vilihanvIraH pashumadhye vRRiko yathA
senApateH kShurapreNa shirashchichCheda pANDavaH
shlokas.28:
jalasandhaM vinirbhidya so.anayadyamasAdanam |
suSheNaM cha tato hatvA preShayAmAsa mRRityave
shlokas.29:
ugrasya sashirastrANaM shirashchandropamaM bhuvi |
pAtayAmAsa bhallena kuNDalAbhyAM vibhUShitam
shlokas.30:
bhImabAhuM cha saptatyA sAshvaketuM sasArathim |
ninAya samare bhImaH paralokAya mAriSha
shlokas.31:
bhImaM bhImarathaM chobhau bhImaseno hasanniva |
bhrAtarau rabhasau rAjannanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.32:
tataH sulochanaM bhImaH kShurapreNa mahAmRRidhe |
miShatAM sarvasainyAnAmanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.33:
putrAstu tava taM dRRiShTvA bhImasenaparAkramam |
sheShA ye.anye.abhava.nstatra te bhImasya bhayArditAH
vipradrutA disho rAjanvadhyamAnA mahAtmanA
shlokas.34:
tato.abravIchChAntanavaH sarvAneva mahArathAn |
eSha bhImo raNe kruddho dhArtarAShTrAnmahArathAn
shlokas.35:
yathAprAgryAnyathAjyeShThAnyathAshUrA.nshcha sa~NgatAn |
nipAtayatyugradhanvA taM pramathnIta pArthivAH
shlokas.36:
evamuktAstataH sarve dhArtarAShTrasya sainikAH |
abhyadravanta sa~NkruddhA bhImasenaM mahAbalam
shlokas.37:
bhagadattaH prabhinnena ku~njareNa vishAM pate |
apatatsahasA tatra yatra bhImo vyavasthitaH
shlokas.38:
Apatanneva cha raNe bhImasenaM shilAshitaiH |
adRRishyaM samare chakre jImUta iva bhAskaram
shlokas.39:
abhimanyumukhAstatra nAmRRiShyanta mahArathAH |
bhImasyAchChAdanaM sa~Nkhye svabAhubalamAshritAH
shlokas.40:
ta enaM sharavarSheNa samantAtparyavArayan |
gajaM cha sharavRRiShTyA taM bibhiduste samantataH
shlokas.41:
sa shastravRRiShTyAbhihataH prAdravaddviguNaM padam |
prAgjyotiShagajo rAjannAnAli~NgaiH sutejanaiH
shlokas.42:
sa~njAtarudhirotpIDaH prekShaNIyo.abhavadraNe |
gabhastibhirivArkasya sa.nsyUto jalado mahAn
shlokas.43:
sa chodito madasrAvI bhagadattena vAraNaH |
abhyadhAvata tAnsarvAnkAlotsRRiShTa ivAntakaH
dviguNaM javamAsthAya kampaya.nshcharaNairmahIm
shlokas.44:
tasya tatsumahadrUpaM dRRiShTvA sarve mahArathAH |
asahyaM manyamAnAste nAtipramanaso.abhavan
shlokas.45:
tatastu nRRipatiH kruddho bhImasenaM stanAntare |
AjaghAna naravyAghra shareNa nataparvaNA
shlokas.46:
so.atividdho maheShvAsastena rAj~nA mahArathaH |
mUrChayAbhiparItA~Ngo dhvajayaShTimupAshritaH
shlokas.47:
tA.nstu bhItAnsamAlakShya bhImasenaM cha mUrChitam |
nanAda balavannAdaM bhagadattaH pratApavAn
shlokas.48:
tato ghaTotkacho rAjanprekShya bhImaM tathAgatam |
sa~Nkruddho rAkShaso ghorastatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.49:
sa kRRitvA dAruNAM mAyAM bhIrUNAM bhayavardhinIm |
adRRishyata nimeShArdhAdghorarUpaM samAshritaH
shlokas.50:
airAvataM samAruhya svayaM mAyAmayaM kRRitam |
tasya chAnye.api di~NnAgA babhUvuranuyAyinaH
shlokas.51:
a~njano vAmanashchaiva mahApadmashcha suprabhaH |
traya ete mahAnAgA rAkShasaiH samadhiShThitAH
shlokas.52:
mahAkAyAstridhA rAjanprasravanto madaM bahu |
tejovIryabalopetA mahAbalaparAkramAH
shlokas.53:
ghaTotkachastu svaM nAgaM chodayAmAsa taM tataH |
sagajaM bhagadattaM tu hantukAmaH parantapaH
shlokas.54:
te chAnye choditA nAgA rAkShasaistairmahAbalaiH |
paripetuH susa.nrabdhAshchaturdaMShTrAshchaturdisham
bhagadattasya taM nAgaM viShANaiste.abhyapIDayan
shlokas.55:
sampIDyamAnastairnAgairvedanArtaH sharAturaH |
so.anadatsumahAnAdamindrAshanisamasvanam
shlokas.56:
tasya taM nadato nAdaM sughoraM bhImanisvanam |
shrutvA bhIShmo.abravIddroNaM rAjAnaM cha suyodhanam
shlokas.57:
eSha yudhyati sa~NgrAme haiDimbena durAtmanA |
bhagadatto maheShvAsaH kRRichChreNa parivartate
shlokas.58:
rAkShasashcha mahAmAyaH sa cha rAjAtikopanaH |
tau sametau mahAvIryau kAlamRRityusamAvubhau
shlokas.59:
shrUyate hyeSha hRRiShTAnAM pANDavAnAM mahAsvanaH |
hastinashchaiva sumahAnbhItasya ruvato dhvaniH
shlokas.60:
tatra gachChAma bhadraM vo rAjAnaM parirakShitum |
arakShyamANaH samare kShipraM prANAnvimokShyate
shlokas.61:
te tvaradhvaM mahAvIryAH kiM chireNa prayAmahe |
mahAnhi vartate raudraH sa~NgrAmo lomaharShaNaH
shlokas.62:
bhaktashcha kulaputrashcha shUrashcha pRRitanApatiH |
yuktaM tasya paritrANaM kartumasmAbhirachyutAH
shlokas.63:
bhIShmasya tadvachaH shrutvA bhAradvAjapurogamAH |
sahitAH sarvarAjAno bhagadattaparIpsayA
uttamaM javamAsthAya prayayuryatra so.abhavat
shlokas.64:
tAnprayAtAnsamAlokya yudhiShThirapurogamAH |
pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH sArdhaM pRRiShThato.anuyayuH parAn
shlokas.65:
tAnyanIkAnyathAlokya rAkShasendraH pratApavAn |
nanAda sumahAnAdaM visphoTamashaneriva
shlokas.66:
tasya taM ninadaM shrutvA dRRiShTvA nAgA.nshcha yudhyataH |
bhIShmaH shAntanavo bhUyo bhAradvAjamabhAShata
shlokas.67:
na rochate me sa~NgrAmo haiDimbena durAtmanA |
balavIryasamAviShTaH sasahAyashcha sAmpratam
shlokas.68:
naiSha shakyo yudhA jetumapi vajrabhRRitA svayam |
labdhalakShyaH prahArI cha vayaM cha shrAntavAhanAH
pA~nchAlaiH pANDaveyaishcha divasaM kShatavikShatAH
shlokas.69:
tanna me rochate yuddhaM pANDavairjitakAshibhiH |
ghuShyatAmavahAro.adya shvo yotsyAmaH paraiH saha
shlokas.70:
pitAmahavachaH shrutvA tathA chakruH sma kauravAH |
upAyenApayAnaM te ghaTotkachabhayArditAH
shlokas.71:
kauraveShu nivRRitteShu pANDavA jitakAshinaH |
siMhanAdamakurvanta sha~NkhaveNusvanaiH saha
shlokas.72:
evaM tadabhavadyuddhaM divasaM bharatarShabha |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha puraskRRitya ghaTotkacham
shlokas.73:
kauravAstu tato rAjanprayayuH shibiraM svakam |
vrIDamAnA nishAkAle pANDaveyaiH parAjitAH
shlokas.74:
sharavikShatagAtrAshcha pANDuputrA mahArathAH |
yuddhe sumanaso bhUtvA shibirAyaiva jagmire
shlokas.75:
puraskRRitya mahArAja bhImasenaghaTotkachau |
pUjayantastadAnyonyaM mudA paramayA yutAH
shlokas.77:
vinadanto mahAtmAnaH kampayantashcha medinIm |
ghaTTayantashcha marmANi tava putrasya mAriSha
prayAtAH shibirAyaiva nishAkAle parantapAH
shlokas.78:
duryodhanastu nRRipatirdIno bhrAtRRivadhena cha |
muhUrtaM chintayAmAsa bAShpashokasamAkulaH
shlokas.79:
tataH kRRitvA vidhiM sarvaM shibirasya yathAvidhi |
pradadhyau shokasantapto bhrAtRRivyasanakarshitaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bhayaM me sumahajjAtaM vismayashchaiva sa~njaya |
shrutvA pANDukumArANAM karma devaiH suduShkaram
shlokas.2:
putrANAM cha parAbhavaM shrutvA sa~njaya sarvashaH |
chintA me mahatI sUta bhaviShyati kathaM tviti
shlokas.3:
dhruvaM viduravAkyAni dhakShyanti hRRidayaM mama |
yathA hi dRRishyate sarvaM daivayogena sa~njaya
shlokas.4:
yatra bhIShmamukhA~nshUrAnastraj~nAnyodhasattamAn |
pANDavAnAmanIkAni yodhayanti prahAriNaH
shlokas.5:
kenAvadhyA mahAtmAnaH pANDuputrA mahAbalAH |
kena dattavarAstAta kiM vA j~nAnaM vidanti te
yena kShayaM na gachChanti divi tArAgaNA iva
shlokas.6:
punaH punarna mRRiShyAmi hataM sainyaM sma pANDavaiH |
mayyeva daNDaH patati daivAtparamadAruNaH
shlokas.7:
yathAvadhyAH pANDusutA yathA vadhyAshcha me sutAH |
etanme sarvamAchakShva yathAtattvena sa~njaya
shlokas.8:
na hi pAraM prapashyAmi duHkhasyAsya katha~nchana |
samudrasyeva mahato bhujAbhyAM pratarannaraH
shlokas.9:
putrANAM vyasanaM manye dhruvaM prAptaM sudAruNam |
ghAtayiShyati me putrAnsarvAnbhImo na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
na hi pashyAmi taM vIraM yo me rakShetsutAnraNe |
dhruvaM vinAshaH samare putrANAM mama sa~njaya
shlokas.11:
tasmAnme kAraNaM sUta yuktiM chaiva visheShataH |
pRRichChato.adya yathAtattvaM sarvamAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.12:
duryodhano.api yachchakre dRRiShTvA svAnvimukhAnraNe |
bhIShmadroNau kRRipashchaiva saubaleyo jayadrathaH
drauNirvApi maheShvAso vikarNo vA mahAbalaH
shlokas.13:
nishchayo vApi kasteShAM tadA hyAsInmahAtmanAm |
vimukheShu mahAprAj~na mama putreShu sa~njaya
shlokas.14:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannavahitaH shrutvA chaivAvadhAraya |
naiva mantrakRRitaM ki~nchinnaiva mAyAM tathAvidhAm
na vai vibhIShikAM kA~nchidrAjankurvanti pANDavAH
shlokas.15:
yudhyanti te yathAnyAyaM shaktimantashcha sa.nyuge |
dharmeNa sarvakAryANi kIrtitAnIti bhArata
Arabhante sadA pArthAH prArthayAnA mahadyashaH
shlokas.16:
na te yuddhAnnivartante dharmopetA mahAbalAH |
shriyA paramayA yuktA yato dharmastato jayaH
tenAvadhyA raNe pArthA jayayuktAshcha pArthiva
shlokas.17:
tava putrA durAtmAnaH pApeShvabhiratAH sadA |
niShThurA hInakarmANastena hIyanti sa.nyuge
shlokas.18:
subahUni nRRisha.nsAni putraistava janeshvara |
nikRRitAnIha pANDUnAM nIchairiva yathA naraiH
shlokas.19:
sarvaM cha tadanAdRRitya putrANAM tava kilbiSham |
sApahnavAH sadaivAsanpANDavAH pANDupUrvaja
na chainAnbahu manyante putrAstava vishAM pate
shlokas.20:
tasya pApasya satataM kriyamANasya karmaNaH |
samprAptaM sumahadghoraM phalaM kimpAkasaMnibham
sa tadbhu~NkShva mahArAja saputraH sasuhRRijjanaH
shlokas.21:
nAvabudhyasi yadrAjanvAryamANaH suhRRijjanaiH |
vidureNAtha bhIShmeNa droNena cha mahAtmanA
shlokas.22:
tathA mayA chApyasakRRidvAryamANo na gRRihNasi |
vAkyaM hitaM cha pathyaM cha martyaH pathyamivauShadham
putrANAM matamAsthAya jitAnmanyasi pANDavAn
shlokas.23:
shRRiNu bhUyo yathAtattvaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
kAraNaM bharatashreShTha pANDavAnAM jayaM prati
tatte.ahaM kathayiShyAmi yathAshrutamari.ndama
shlokas.24:
duryodhanena sampRRiShTa etamarthaM pitAmahaH |
dRRiShTvA bhrAtR^InraNe sarvAnnirjitAnsumahArathAn
shlokas.25:
shokasaMmUDhahRRidayo nishAkAle sma kauravaH |
pitAmahaM mahAprAj~naM vinayenopagamya ha
yadabravItsutaste.asau tanme shRRiNu janeshvara
shlokas.26:
duryodhana uvAcha||
tvaM cha droNashcha shalyashcha kRRipo drauNistathaiva cha |
kRRitavarmA cha hArdikyaH kAmbojashcha sudakShiNaH
shlokas.27:
bhUrishravA vikarNashcha bhagadattashcha vIryavAn |
mahArathAH samAkhyAtAH kulaputrAstanutyajaH
shlokas.28:
trayANAmapi lokAnAM paryAptA iti me matiH |
pANDavAnAM samastAshcha na tiShThanti parAkrame
shlokas.29:
tatra me sa.nshayo jAtastanmamAchakShva pRRichChataH |
yaM samAshritya kaunteyA jayantyasmAnpade pade
shlokas.30:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanvacho mahyaM yattvAM vakShyAmi kaurava |
bahushashcha mamokto.asi na cha me tattvayA kRRitam
shlokas.31:
kriyatAM pANDavaiH sArdhaM shamo bharatasattama |
etatkShamamahaM manye pRRithivyAstava chAbhibho
shlokas.32:
bhu~njemAM pRRithivIM rAjanbhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH sukhI |
durhRRidastApayansarvAnnandaya.nshchApi bAndhavAn
shlokas.33:
na cha me kroshatastAta shrutavAnasi vai purA |
tadidaM samanuprAptaM yatpANDUnavamanyase
shlokas.34:
yashcha heturavadhyatve teShAmakliShTakarmaNAm |
taM shRRiNuShva mahArAja mama kIrtayataH prabho
shlokas.35:
nAsti lokeShu tadbhUtaM bhavitA no bhaviShyati |
yo jayetpANDavAnsa~Nkhye pAlitA~nshAr~NgadhanvanA
shlokas.36:
yattu me kathitaM tAta munibhirbhAvitAtmabhiH |
purANagItaM dharmaj~na tachChRRiNuShva yathAtatham
shlokas.37:
purA kila surAH sarve RRiShayashcha samAgatAH |
pitAmahamupAseduH parvate gandhamAdane
shlokas.38:
madhye teShAM samAsInaH prajApatirapashyata |
vimAnaM jAjvaladbhAsA sthitaM pravaramambare
shlokas.39:
dhyAnenAvedya taM brahmA kRRitvA cha niyato.a~njalim |
namashchakAra hRRiShTAtmA paramaM parameshvaram
shlokas.40:
RRiShayastvatha devAshcha dRRiShTvA brahmANamutthitam |
sthitAH prA~njalayaH sarve pashyanto mahadadbhutam
shlokas.41:
yathAvachcha tamabhyarchya brahmA brahmavidAM varaH |
jagAda jagataH sraShTA paraM paramadharmavit
shlokas.42:
vishvAvasurvishvamUrtirvishvesho; viShvakseno vishvakarmA vashI cha |
vishveshvaro vAsudevo.asi tasmA;dyogAtmAnaM daivataM tvAmupaimi
shlokas.43:
jaya vishva mahAdeva jaya lokahite rata |
jaya yogIshvara vibho jaya yogaparAvara
shlokas.44:
padmagarbha vishAlAkSha jaya lokeshvareshvara |
bhUtabhavyabhavannAtha jaya saumyAtmajAtmaja
shlokas.45:
asa~NkhyeyaguNAjeya jaya sarvaparAyaNa |
nArAyaNa suduShpAra jaya shAr~Ngadhanurdhara
shlokas.46:
sarvaguhyaguNopeta vishvamUrte nirAmaya |
vishveshvara mahAbAho jaya lokArthatatpara
shlokas.47:
mahoraga varAhAdya harikesha vibho jaya |
harivAsa vishAmIsha vishvAvAsAmitAvyaya
shlokas.48:
vyaktAvyaktAmitasthAna niyatendriya sendriya |
asa~NkhyeyAtmabhAvaj~na jaya gambhIra kAmada
shlokas.49:
ananta viditapraj~na nityaM bhUtavibhAvana |
kRRitakArya kRRitapraj~na dharmaj~na vijayAjaya
shlokas.50:
guhyAtmansarvabhUtAtmansphuTasambhUtasambhava |
bhUtArthatattva lokesha jaya bhUtavibhAvana
shlokas.51:
Atmayone mahAbhAga kalpasa~NkShepatatpara |
udbhAvana manodbhAva jaya brahmajanapriya
shlokas.52:
nisargasargAbhirata kAmesha parameshvara |
amRRitodbhava sadbhAva yugAgne vijayaprada
shlokas.53:
prajApatipate deva padmanAbha mahAbala |
AtmabhUta mahAbhUta karmAtma~njaya karmada
shlokas.54:
pAdau tava dharA devI disho bAhurdivaM shiraH |
mUrtiste.ahaM surAH kAyashchandrAdityau cha chakShuShI
shlokas.55:
balaM tapashcha satyaM cha dharmaH kAmAtmajaH prabho |
tejo.agniH pavanaH shvAsa Apaste svedasambhavAH
shlokas.56:
ashvinau shravaNau nityaM devI jihvA sarasvatI |
vedAH sa.nskAraniShThA hi tvayIdaM jagadAshritam
shlokas.57:
na sa~NkhyAM na parImANaM na tejo na parAkramam |
na balaM yogayogIsha jAnImaste na sambhavam
shlokas.58:
tvadbhaktiniratA deva niyamaistvA samAhitAH |
archayAmaH sadA viShNo parameshaM maheshvaram
shlokas.59:
RRiShayo devagandharvA yakSharAkShasapannagAH |
pishAchA mAnuShAshchaiva mRRigapakShisarIsRRipAH
shlokas.60:
evamAdi mayA sRRiShTaM pRRithivyAM tvatprasAdajam |
padmanAbha vishAlAkSha kRRiShNa duHsvapnanAshana
shlokas.61:
tvaM gatiH sarvabhUtAnAM tvaM netA tvaM jaganmukham |
tvatprasAdena devesha sukhino vibudhAH sadA
shlokas.62:
pRRithivI nirbhayA deva tvatprasAdAtsadAbhavat |
tasmAdbhava vishAlAkSha yaduva.nshavivardhanaH
shlokas.63:
dharmasa.nsthApanArthAya daiteyAnAM vadhAya cha |
jagato dhAraNArthAya vij~nApyaM kuru me prabho
shlokas.64:
yadetatparamaM guhyaM tvatprasAdamayaM vibho |
vAsudeva tadetatte mayodgItaM yathAtatham
shlokas.65:
sRRiShTvA sa~NkarShaNaM devaM svayamAtmAnamAtmanA |
kRRiShNa tvamAtmanAsrAkShIH pradyumnaM chAtmasambhavam
shlokas.66:
pradyumnAchchAniruddhaM tvaM yaM vidurviShNumavyayam |
aniruddho.asRRijanmAM vai brahmANaM lokadhAriNam
shlokas.67:
vAsudevamayaH so.ahaM tvayaivAsmi vinirmitaH |
vibhajya bhAgasho.a.atmAnaM vraja mAnuShatAM vibho
shlokas.68:
tatrAsuravadhaM kRRitvA sarvalokasukhAya vai |
dharmaM sthApya yashaH prApya yogaM prApsyasi tattvataH
shlokas.69:
tvAM hi brahmarShayo loke devAshchAmitavikrama |
taistaishcha nAmabhirbhaktA gAyanti paramAtmakam
shlokas.70:
sthitAshcha sarve tvayi bhUtasa~NghAH; kRRitvAshrayaM tvAM varadaM subAho |
anAdimadhyAntamapArayogaM; lokasya setuM pravadanti viprAH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH sa bhagavAndevo lokAnAM parameshvaraH |
brahmANaM pratyuvAchedaM snigdhagambhIrayA girA
shlokas.2:
viditaM tAta yogAnme sarvametattavepsitam |
tathA tadbhavitetyuktvA tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.3:
tato devarShigandharvA vismayaM paramaM gatAH |
kautUhalaparAH sarve pitAmahamathAbruvan
shlokas.4:
ko nvayaM yo bhagavatA praNamya vinayAdvibho |
vAgbhiH stuto variShThAbhiH shrotumichChAma taM vayam
shlokas.5:
evamuktastu bhagavAnpratyuvAcha pitAmahaH |
devabrahmarShigandharvAnsarvAnmadhurayA girA
shlokas.6:
yattatparaM bhaviShyaM cha bhavitavyaM cha yatparam |
bhUtAtmA yaH prabhushchaiva brahma yachcha paraM padam
shlokas.7:
tenAsmi kRRitasa.nvAdaH prasannena surarShabhAH |
jagato.anugrahArthAya yAchito me jagatpatiH
shlokas.8:
mAnuShaM lokamAtiShTha vAsudeva iti shrutaH |
asurANAM vadhArthAya sambhavasva mahItale
shlokas.9:
sa~NgrAme nihatA ye te daityadAnavarAkShasAH |
ta ime nRRiShu sambhUtA ghorarUpA mahAbalAH
shlokas.10:
teShAM vadhArthaM bhagavAnnareNa sahito vashI |
mAnuShIM yonimAsthAya chariShyati mahItale
shlokas.11:
naranArAyaNau yau tau purANAvRRiShisattamau |
sahitau mAnuShe loke sambhUtAvamitadyutI
shlokas.12:
ajeyau samare yattau sahitAvamarairapi |
mUDhAstvetau na jAnanti naranArAyaNAvRRiShI
shlokas.13:
tasyAhamAtmajo brahmA sarvasya jagataH patiH |
vAsudevo.archanIyo vaH sarvalokamaheshvaraH
shlokas.14:
tathA manuShyo.ayamiti kadAchitsurasattamAH |
nAvaj~neyo mahAvIryaH sha~NkhachakragadAdharaH
shlokas.15:
etatparamakaM guhyametatparamakaM padam |
etatparamakaM brahma etatparamakaM yashaH
shlokas.16:
etadakSharamavyaktametattachChAshvataM mahat |
etatpuruShasa~nj~naM vai gIyate j~nAyate na cha
shlokas.17:
etatparamakaM teja etatparamakaM sukham |
etatparamakaM satyaM kIrtitaM vishvakarmaNA
shlokas.18:
tasmAtsarvaiH suraiH sendrairlokaishchAmitavikramaH |
nAvaj~neyo vAsudevo mAnuSho.ayamiti prabhuH
shlokas.19:
yashcha mAnuShamAtro.ayamiti brUyAtsumandadhIH |
hRRiShIkeshamavaj~nAnAttamAhuH puruShAdhamam
shlokas.20:
yoginaM taM mahAtmAnaM praviShTaM mAnuShIM tanum |
avamanyedvAsudevaM tamAhustAmasaM janAH
shlokas.21:
devaM charAcharAtmAnaM shrIvatsA~NkaM suvarchasam |
padmanAbhaM na jAnAti tamAhustAmasaM janAH
shlokas.22:
kirITakaustubhadharaM mitrANAmabhaya~Nkaram |
avajAnanmahAtmAnaM ghore tamasi majjati
shlokas.23:
evaM viditvA tattvArthaM lokAnAmIshvareshvaraH |
vAsudevo namaskAryaH sarvalokaiH surottamAH
shlokas.24:
evamuktvA sa bhagavAnsarvAndevagaNAnpurA |
visRRijya sarvalokAtmA jagAma bhavanaM svakam
shlokas.25:
tato devAH sagandharvA munayo.apsaraso.api cha |
kathAM tAM brahmaNA gItAM shrutvA prItA divaM yayuH
shlokas.26:
etachChrutaM mayA tAta RRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
vAsudevaM kathayatAM samavAye purAtanam
shlokas.27:
jAmadagnyasya rAmasya mArkaNDeyasya dhImataH |
vyAsanAradayoshchApi shrutaM shrutavishArada
shlokas.28:
etamarthaM cha vij~nAya shrutvA cha prabhumavyayam |
vAsudevaM mahAtmAnaM lokAnAmIshvareshvaram
shlokas.29:
yasyAsAvAtmajo brahmA sarvasya jagataH pitA |
kathaM na vAsudevo.ayamarchyashchejyashcha mAnavaiH
shlokas.30:
vArito.asi purA tAta munibhirvedapAragaiH |
mA gachCha sa.nyugaM tena vAsudevena dhImatA
mA pANDavaiH sArdhamiti tachcha mohAnna budhyase
shlokas.31:
manye tvAM rAkShasaM krUraM tathA chAsi tamovRRitaH |
yasmAddviShasi govindaM pANDavaM cha dhana~njayam
naranArAyaNau devau nAnyo dviShyAddhi mAnavaH
shlokas.32:
tasmAdbravImi te rAjanneSha vai shAshvato.avyayaH |
sarvalokamayo nityaH shAstA dhAtA dharo dhruvaH
shlokas.33:
lokAndhArayate yastrI.nshcharAcharaguruH prabhuH |
yoddhA jayashcha jetA cha sarvaprakRRitirIshvaraH
shlokas.34:
rAjansattvamayo hyeSha tamorAgavivarjitaH |
yataH kRRiShNastato dharmo yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.35:
tasya mAhAtmyayogena yogenAtmana eva cha |
dhRRitAH pANDusutA rAja~njayashchaiShAM bhaviShyati
shlokas.36:
shreyoyuktAM sadA buddhiM pANDavAnAM dadhAti yaH |
balaM chaiva raNe nityaM bhayebhyashchaiva rakShati
shlokas.37:
sa eSha shAshvato devaH sarvaguhyamayaH shivaH |
vAsudeva iti j~neyo yanmAM pRRichChasi bhArata
shlokas.38:
brAhmaNaiH kShatriyairvaishyaiH shUdraishcha kRRitalakShaNaiH |
sevyate.abhyarchyate chaiva nityayuktaiH svakarmabhiH
shlokas.39:
dvAparasya yugasyAnte Adau kaliyugasya cha |
sAtvataM vidhimAsthAya gItaH sa~NkarShaNena yaH
shlokas.40:
sa eSha sarvAsuramartyalokaM; samudrakakShyAntaritAH purIshcha |
yuge yuge mAnuShaM chaiva vAsaM; punaH punaH sRRijate vAsudevaH

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
vAsudevo mahadbhUtaM sarvalokeShu kathyate |
tasyAgamaM pratiShThAM cha j~nAtumichChe pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vAsudevo mahadbhUtaM sambhUtaM saha daivataiH |
na paraM puNDarIkAkShAddRRishyate bharatarShabha
mArkaNDeyashcha govindaM kathayatyadbhutaM mahat
shlokas.3:
sarvabhUtAni bhUtAtmA mahAtmA puruShottamaH |
Apo vAyushcha tejashcha trayametadakalpayat
shlokas.4:
sa sRRiShTvA pRRithivIM devaH sarvalokeshvaraH prabhuH |
apsu vai shayanaM chakre mahAtmA puruShottamaH
sarvatoyamayo devo yogAtsuShvApa tatra ha
shlokas.5:
mukhataH so.agnimasRRijatprANAdvAyumathApi cha |
sarasvatIM cha vedA.nshcha manasaH sasRRije.achyutaH
shlokas.6:
eSha lokAnsasarjAdau devA.nshcharShigaNaiH saha |
nidhanaM chaiva mRRityuM cha prajAnAM prabhavo.avyayaH
shlokas.7:
eSha dharmashcha dharmaj~no varadaH sarvakAmadaH |
eSha kartA cha kAryaM cha pUrvadevaH svayamprabhuH
shlokas.8:
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha pUrvametadakalpayat |
ubhe sandhye dishaH khaM cha niyamaM cha janArdanaH
shlokas.9:
RRiShI.nshchaiva hi govindastapashchaivAnu kalpayat |
sraShTAraM jagatashchApi mahAtmA prabhuravyayaH
shlokas.10:
agrajaM sarvabhUtAnAM sa~NkarShaNamakalpayat |
sheShaM chAkalpayaddevamanantamiti yaM viduH
shlokas.11:
yo dhArayati bhUtAni dharAM chemAM saparvatAm |
dhyAnayogena viprAshcha taM vadanti mahaujasam
shlokas.12:
karNasrotodbhavaM chApi madhuM nAma mahAsuram |
tamugramugrakarmANamugrAM buddhiM samAsthitam
brahmaNo.apachitiM kurva~njaghAna puruShottamaH
shlokas.13:
tasya tAta vadhAdeva devadAnavamAnavAH |
madhusUdanamityAhurRRiShayashcha janArdanam
varAhashchaiva siMhashcha trivikramagatiH prabhuH
shlokas.14:
eSha mAtA pitA chaiva sarveShAM prANinAM hariH |
paraM hi puNDarIkAkShAnna bhUtaM na bhaviShyati
shlokas.15:
mukhato.asRRijadbrAhmaNAnbAhubhyAM kShatriyA.nstathA |
vaishyA.nshchApyUruto rAja~nshUdrAnpadbhyAM tathaiva cha
tapasA niyato devo nidhAnaM sarvadehinAm
shlokas.16:
brahmabhUtamamAvAsyAM paurNamAsyAM tathaiva cha |
yogabhUtaM paricharankeshavaM mahadApnuyAt
shlokas.17:
keshavaH paramaM tejaH sarvalokapitAmahaH |
evamAhurhRRiShIkeshaM munayo vai narAdhipa
shlokas.18:
evamenaM vijAnIhi AchAryaM pitaraM gurum |
kRRiShNo yasya prasIdeta lokAstenAkShayA jitAH
shlokas.19:
yashchaivainaM bhayasthAne keshavaM sharaNaM vrajet |
sadA naraH paTha.nshchedaM svastimAnsa sukhI bhavet
shlokas.20:
ye cha kRRiShNaM prapadyante te na muhyanti mAnavAH |
bhaye mahati ye magnAH pAti nityaM janArdanaH
shlokas.21:
etadyudhiShThiro j~nAtvA yAthAtathyena bhArata |
sarvAtmanA mahAtmAnaM keshavaM jagadIshvaram
prapannaH sharaNaM rAjanyogAnAmIshvaraM prabhum

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu chedaM mahArAja brahmabhUtastavaM mama |
brahmarShibhishcha devaishcha yaH purA kathito bhuvi
shlokas.2:
sAdhyAnAmapi devAnAM devadeveshvaraH prabhuH |
lokabhAvanabhAvaj~na iti tvAM nArado.abravIt
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyaM cha mArkaNDeyo.abhyuvAcha ha
shlokas.3:
yaj~nAnAM chaiva yaj~naM tvAM tapashcha tapasAmapi |
devAnAmapi devaM cha tvAmAha bhagavAnbhRRiguH
purANe bhairavaM rUpaM viShNo bhUtapateti vai
shlokas.4:
vAsudevo vasUnAM tvaM shakraM sthApayitA tathA |
devadevo.asi devAnAmiti dvaipAyano.abravIt
shlokas.5:
pUrve prajAnisargeShu dakShamAhuH prajApatim |
sraShTAraM sarvabhUtAnAma~NgirAstvAM tato.abravIt
shlokas.6:
avyaktaM te sharIrotthaM vyaktaM te manasi sthitam |
devA vAksambhavAshcheti devalastvasito.abravIt
shlokas.7:
shirasA te divaM vyAptaM bAhubhyAM pRRithivI dhRRitA |
jaTharaM te trayo lokAH puruSho.asi sanAtanaH
shlokas.8:
evaM tvAmabhijAnanti tapasA bhAvitA narAH |
AtmadarshanatRRiptAnAmRRiShINAM chApi sattamaH
shlokas.9:
rAjarShINAmudArANAmAhaveShvanivartinAm |
sarvadharmapradhAnAnAM tvaM gatirmadhusUdana
shlokas.10:
eSha te vistarastAta sa~NkShepashcha prakIrtitaH |
keshavasya yathAtattvaM suprIto bhava keshave
shlokas.11:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
puNyaM shrutvaitadAkhyAnaM mahArAja sutastava |
keshavaM bahu mene sa pANDavA.nshcha mahArathAn
shlokas.12:
tamabravInmahArAja bhIShmaH shAntanavaH punaH |
mAhAtmyaM te shrutaM rAjankeshavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
narasya cha yathAtattvaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
yadarthaM nRRiShu sambhUtau naranArAyaNAvubhau
shlokas.14:
avadhyau cha yathA vIrau sa.nyugeShvaparAjitau |
yathA cha pANDavA rAjannagamyA yudhi kasyachit
shlokas.15:
prItimAnhi dRRiDhaM kRRiShNaH pANDaveShu yashasviShu |
tasmAdbravImi rAjendra shamo bhavatu pANDavaiH
shlokas.16:
pRRithivIM bhu~NkShva sahito bhrAtRRibhirbalibhirvashI |
naranArAyaNau devAvavaj~nAya nashiShyasi
shlokas.17:
evamuktvA tava pitA tUShNImAsIdvishAM pate |
vyasarjayachcha rAjAnaM shayanaM cha vivesha ha
shlokas.18:
rAjApi shibiraM prAyAtpraNipatya mahAtmane |
shishye cha shayane shubhre tAM rAtriM bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vyuShitAyAM cha sharvaryAmudite cha divAkare |
ubhe sene mahArAja yuddhAyaiva samIyatuH
shlokas.2:
abhyadhAva.nshcha sa~NkruddhAH parasparajigIShavaH |
te sarve sahitA yuddhe samAlokya parasparam
shlokas.3:
pANDavA dhArtarAShTrAshcha rAjandurmantrite tava |
vyUhau cha vyUhya sa.nrabdhAH samprayuddhAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.4:
arakShanmakaravyUhaM bhIShmo rAjansamantataH |
tathaiva pANDavA rAjannarakShanvyUhamAtmanaH
shlokas.5:
sa niryayau rathAnIkaM pitA devavratastava |
mahatA rathava.nshena sa.nvRRito rathinAM varaH
shlokas.6:
itaretaramanvIyuryathAbhAgamavasthitAH |
rathinaH pattayashchaiva dantinaH sAdinastathA
shlokas.7:
tAndRRiShTvA prodyatAnsa~Nkhye pANDavAshcha yashasvinaH |
shyenena vyUharAjena tenAjayyena sa.nyuge
shlokas.8:
ashobhata mukhe tasya bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
netre shikhaNDI durdharSho dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
shlokas.9:
shIrShaM tasyAbhavadvIraH sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
vidhunvangANDivaM pArtho grIvAyAmabhavattadA
shlokas.10:
akShauhiNyA samagrA yA vAmapakSho.abhavattadA |
mahAtmA drupadaH shrImAnsaha putreNa sa.nyuge
shlokas.11:
dakShiNashchAbhavatpakShaH kaikeyo.akShauhiNIpatiH |
pRRiShThato draupadeyAshcha saubhadrashchApi vIryavAn
shlokas.12:
pRRiShThe samabhavachChrImAnsvayaM rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtRRibhyAM sahito dhImAnyamAbhyAM chAruvikramaH
shlokas.13:
pravishya tu raNe bhImo makaraM mukhatastadA |
bhIShmamAsAdya sa~NgrAme ChAdayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.14:
tato bhIShmo mahAstrANi pAtayAmAsa bhArata |
mohayanpANDuputrANAM vyUDhaM sainyaM mahAhave
shlokas.15:
saMmuhyati tadA sainye tvaramANo dhana~njayaH |
bhIShmaM sharasahasreNa vivyAdha raNamUrdhani
shlokas.16:
parisa.nvArya chAstrANi bhIShmamuktAni sa.nyuge |
svenAnIkena hRRiShTena yuddhAya samavasthitaH
shlokas.17:
tato duryodhano rAjA bhAradvAjamabhAShata |
pUrvaM dRRiShTvA vadhaM ghoraM balasya balinAM varaH
bhrAtR^INAM cha vadhaM yuddhe smaramANo mahArathaH
shlokas.18:
AchArya satataM tvaM hi hitakAmo mamAnagha |
vayaM hi tvAM samAshritya bhIShmaM chaiva pitAmaham
shlokas.19:
devAnapi raNe jetuM prArthayAmo na sa.nshayaH |
kimu pANDusutAnyuddhe hInavIryaparAkramAn
shlokas.20:
evamuktastato droNastava putreNa mAriSha |
abhinatpANDavAnIkaM prekShamANasya sAtyakeH
shlokas.21:
sAtyakistu tadA droNaM vArayAmAsa bhArata |
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.22:
shaineyaM tu raNe kruddho bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
avidhyannishitairbANairjatrudeshe hasanniva
shlokas.23:
bhImasenastataH kruddho bhAradvAjamavidhyata |
sa.nrakShansAtyakiM rAjandroNAchChastrabhRRitAM varAt
shlokas.24:
tato droNashcha bhIShmashcha tathA shalyashcha mAriSha |
bhImasenaM raNe kruddhAshChAdayAM chakrire sharaiH
shlokas.25:
tatrAbhimanyuH sa~Nkruddho draupadeyAshcha mAriSha |
vivyadhurnishitairbANaiH sarvA.nstAnudyatAyudhAn
shlokas.26:
bhIShmadroNau cha sa~NkruddhAvApatantau mahAbalau |
pratyudyayau shikhaNDI tu maheShvAso mahAhave
shlokas.27:
pragRRihya balavadvIro dhanurjaladanisvanam |
abhyavarShachCharaistUrNaM ChAdayAno divAkaram
shlokas.28:
shikhaNDinaM samAsAdya bharatAnAM pitAmahaH |
avarjayata sa~NgrAme strItvaM tasyAnusa.nsmaran
shlokas.29:
tato droNo mahArAja abhyadravata taM raNe |
rakShamANastato bhIShmaM tava putreNa choditaH
shlokas.30:
shikhaNDI tu samAsAdya droNaM shastrabhRRitAM varam |
avarjayata sa~NgrAme yugAntAgnimivolbaNam
shlokas.31:
tato balena mahatA putrastava vishAM pate |
jugopa bhIShmamAsAdya prArthayAno mahadyashaH
shlokas.32:
tathaiva pANDavA rAjanpuraskRRitya dhana~njayam |
bhIShmamevAbhyavartanta jaye kRRitvA dRRiDhAM matim
shlokas.33:
tadyuddhamabhavadghoraM devAnAM dAnavairiva |
jayaM cha kA~NkShatAM nityaM yashashcha paramAdbhutam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
akarottumulaM yuddhaM bhIShmaH shAntanavastadA |
bhImasenabhayAdichChanputrA.nstArayituM tava
shlokas.2:
pUrvAhNe tanmahAraudraM rAj~nAM yuddhamavartata |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha mukhyashUravinAshanam
shlokas.3:
tasminnAkulasa~NgrAme vartamAne mahAbhaye |
abhavattumulaH shabdaH sa.nspRRishangaganaM mahat
shlokas.4:
nadadbhishcha mahAnAgairheShamANaishcha vAjibhiH |
bherIsha~NkhaninAdaishcha tumulaH samapadyata
shlokas.5:
yuyutsavaste vikrAntA vijayAya mahAbalAH |
anyonyamabhigarjanto goShTheShviva maharShabhAH
shlokas.6:
shirasAM pAtyamAnAnAM samare nishitaiH sharaiH |
ashmavRRiShTirivAkAshe babhUva bharatarShabha
shlokas.7:
kuNDaloShNIShadhArINi jAtarUpojjvalAni cha |
patitAni sma dRRishyante shirA.nsi bharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
vishikhonmathitairgAtrairbAhubhishcha sakArmukaiH |
sahastAbharaNaishchAnyairabhavachChAditA mahI
shlokas.9:
kavachopahitairgAtrairhastaishcha samala~NkRRitaiH |
mukhaishcha chandrasa~NkAshai raktAntanayanaiH shubhaiH
shlokas.10:
gajavAjimanuShyANAM sarvagAtraishcha bhUpate |
AsItsarvA samAkIrNA muhUrtena vasundharA
shlokas.11:
rajomeghaishcha tumulaiH shastravidyutprakAshitaiH |
AyudhAnAM cha nirghoShaH stanayitnusamo.abhavat
shlokas.12:
sa samprahArastumulaH kaTukaH shoNitodakaH |
prAvartata kurUNAM cha pANDavAnAM cha bhArata
shlokas.13:
tasminmahAbhaye ghore tumule lomaharShaNe |
vavarShuH sharavarShANi kShatriyA yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.14:
kroshanti ku~njarAstatra sharavarShapratApitAH |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha sa.nyuge bharatottama
ashvAshcha paryadhAvanta hatArohA disho dasha
shlokas.15:
utpatya nipatantyanye sharaghAtaprapIDitAH |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha yodhAnAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.16:
ashvAnAM ku~njarANAM cha rathAnAM chAtivartatAm |
sa~NghAtAH sma pradRRishyante tatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.17:
gadAbhirasibhiH prAsairbANaishcha nataparvabhiH |
jaghnuH parasparaM tatra kShatriyAH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.18:
apare bAhubhirvIrA niyuddhakushalA yudhi |
bahudhA samasajjanta AyasaiH parighairiva
shlokas.19:
muShTibhirjAnubhishchaiva talaishchaiva vishAM pate |
anyonyaM jaghnire vIrAstAvakAH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.20:
virathA rathinashchAtra nistri.nshavaradhAriNaH |
anyonyamabhidhAvanta parasparavadhaiShiNaH
shlokas.21:
tato duryodhano rAjA kali~NgairbahubhirvRRitaH |
puraskRRitya raNe bhIShmaM pANDavAnabhyavartata
shlokas.22:
tathaiva pANDavAH sarve parivArya vRRikodaram |
bhIShmamabhyadravankruddhA raNe rabhasavAhanAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dRRiShTvA bhIShmeNa sa.nsaktAnbhrAtR^InanyA.nshcha pArthivAn |
tamabhyadhAvadgA~NgeyamudyatAstro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.2:
pA~nchajanyasya nirghoShaM dhanuSho gANDivasya cha |
dhvajaM cha dRRiShTvA pArthasya sarvAnno bhayamAvishat
shlokas.3:
asajjamAnaM vRRikSheShu dhUmaketumivotthitam |
bahuvarNaM cha chitraM cha divyaM vAnaralakShaNam
apashyAma mahArAja dhvajaM gANDivadhanvanaH
shlokas.4:
vidyutaM meghamadhyasthAM bhrAjamAnAmivAmbare |
dadRRishurgANDivaM yodhA rukmapRRiShThaM mahArathe
shlokas.5:
ashushruma bhRRishaM chAsya shakrasyevAbhigarjataH |
sughoraM talayoH shabdaM nighnatastava vAhinIm
shlokas.6:
chaNDavAto yathA meghaH savidyutstanayitnumAn |
dishaH samplAvayansarvAH sharavarShaiH samantataH
shlokas.7:
