abhyadhAvata gA~NgeyaM bhairavAstro dhana~njayaH |
dishaM prAchIM pratIchIM cha na jAnImo.astramohitAH
shlokas.8:
kA.ndigbhUtAH shrAntapatrA hatAstrA hatachetasaH |
anyonyamabhisa.nshliShya yodhAste bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
bhIShmamevAbhilIyanta saha sarvaistavAtmajaiH |
teShAmArtAyanamabhUdbhIShmaH shantanavo raNe
shlokas.10:
samutpatanta vitrastA rathebhyo rathinastadA |
sAdinashchAshvapRRiShThebhyo bhUmau chApi padAtayaH
shlokas.11:
shrutvA gANDIvanirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
sarvasainyAni bhItAni vyavalIyanta bhArata
shlokas.12:
atha kAmbojamukhyaistu bRRihadbhiH shIghragAmibhiH |
gopAnAM bahusAhasrairbalairgovAsano vRRitaH
shlokas.13:
madrasauvIragAndhAraistrigartaishcha vishAM pate |
sarvakAli~Ngamukhyaishcha kali~NgAdhipatirvRRitaH
shlokas.14:
nAgA naragaNaughAshcha duHshAsanapuraHsarAH |
jayadrathashcha nRRipatiH sahitaH sarvarAjabhiH
shlokas.15:
hayArohavarAshchaiva tava putreNa choditAH |
chaturdasha sahasrANi saubalaM paryavArayan
shlokas.16:
tataste sahitAH sarve vibhaktarathavAhanAH |
pANDavAnsamare jagmustAvakA bharatarShabha
shlokas.17:
rathibhirvAraNairashvaiH padAtaishcha samIritam |
ghoramAyodhanaM jaj~ne mahAbhrasadRRishaM rajaH
shlokas.18:
tomaraprAsanArAchagajAshvarathayodhinAm |
balena mahatA bhIShmaH samasajjatkirITinA
shlokas.19:
AvantyaH kAshirAjena bhImasenena saindhavaH |
ajAtashatrurmadrANAmRRiShabheNa yashasvinA
sahaputraH sahAmAtyaH shalyena samasajjata
shlokas.20:
vikarNaH sahadevena chitrasenaH shikhaNDinA |
matsyA duryodhanaM jagmuH shakuniM cha vishAM pate
shlokas.21:
drupadashchekitAnashcha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
droNena samasajjanta saputreNa mahAtmanA
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha dhRRiShTaketumabhidrutau
shlokas.22:
evaM prajavitAshvAni bhrAntanAgarathAni cha |
sainyAni samasajjanta prayuddhAni samantataH
shlokas.23:
nirabhre vidyutastIvrA dishashcha rajasAvRRitAH |
prAdurAsanmaholkAshcha sanirghAtA vishAM pate
shlokas.24:
pravavau cha mahAvAtaH pA.nsuvarShaM papAta cha |
nabhasyantardadhe sUryaH sainyena rajasAvRRitaH
shlokas.25:
pramohaH sarvasattvAnAmatIva samapadyata |
rajasA chAbhibhUtAnAmastrajAlaishcha tudyatAm
shlokas.26:
vIrabAhuvisRRiShTAnAM sarvAvaraNabhedinAm |
sa~NghAtaH sharajAlAnAM tumulaH samapadyata
shlokas.27:
prakAshaM chakrurAkAshamudyatAni bhujottamaiH |
nakShatravimalAbhAni shastrANi bharatarShabha
shlokas.28:
ArShabhANi vichitrANi rukmajAlAvRRitAni cha |
sampeturdikShu sarvAsu charmANi bharatarShabha
shlokas.29:
sUryavarNaishcha nistri.nshaiH pAtyamAnAni sarvashaH |
dikShu sarvAsvadRRishyanta sharIrANi shirA.nsi cha
shlokas.30:
bhagnachakrAkShanIDAshcha nipAtitamahAdhvajAH |
hatAshvAH pRRithivIM jagmustatra tatra mahArathAH
shlokas.31:
paripeturhayAshchAtra kechichChastrakRRitavraNAH |
rathAnviparikarShanto hateShu rathayodhiShu
shlokas.32:
sharAhatA bhinnadehA baddhayoktrA hayottamAH |
yugAni paryakarShanta tatra tatra sma bhArata
shlokas.33:
adRRishyanta sasUtAshcha sAshvAH sarathayodhinaH |
ekena balinA rAjanvAraNena hatA rathAH
shlokas.34:
gandhahastimadasrAvamAghrAya bahavo raNe |
saMnipAte balaughAnAM vItamAdadire gajAH
shlokas.35:
satomaramahAmAtrairnipatadbhirgatAsubhiH |
babhUvAyodhanaM ChannaM nArAchAbhihatairgajaiH
shlokas.36:
saMnipAte balaughAnAM preShitairvaravAraNaiH |
nipeturyudhi sambhagnAH sayodhAH sadhvajA rathAH
shlokas.37:
nAgarAjopamairhastairnAgairAkShipya sa.nyuge |
vyadRRishyanta mahArAja sambhagnA rathakUbarAH
shlokas.38:
vishIrNarathajAlAshcha kesheShvAkShipya dantibhiH |
drumashAkhA ivAvidhya niShpiShTA rathino raNe
shlokas.39:
ratheShu cha rathAnyuddhe sa.nsaktAnvaravAraNAH |
vikarShanto dishaH sarvAH sampetuH sarvashabdagAH
shlokas.40:
teShAM tathA karShatAM cha gajAnAM rUpamAbabhau |
saraHsu nalinIjAlaM viShaktamiva karShatAm
shlokas.41:
evaM sa~nChAditaM tatra babhUvAyodhanaM mahat |
sAdibhishcha padAtaishcha sadhvajaishcha mahArathaiH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shikhaNDI saha matsyena virATena vishAM pate |
bhIShmamAshu maheShvAsamAsasAda sudurjayam
shlokas.2:
droNaM kRRipaM vikarNaM cha maheShvAsAnmahAbalAn |
rAj~nashchAnyAnraNe shUrAnbahUnArChaddhana~njayaH
shlokas.3:
saindhavaM cha maheShvAsaM sAmAtyaM saha bandhubhiH |
prAchyA.nshcha dAkShiNAtyA.nshcha bhUmipAnbhUmiparShabha
shlokas.4:
putraM cha te maheShvAsaM duryodhanamamarShaNam |
duHsahaM chaiva samare bhImaseno.abhyavartata
shlokas.5:
sahadevastu shakunimulUkaM cha mahAratham |
pitAputrau maheShvAsAvabhyavartata durjayau
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThiro mahArAja gajAnIkaM mahArathaH |
samavartata sa~NgrAme putreNa nikRRitastava
shlokas.7:
mAdrIputrastu nakulaH shUraH sa~Nkrandano yudhi |
trigartAnAM rathodAraiH samasajjata pANDavaH
shlokas.8:
abhyavartanta durdharShAH samare shAlvakekayAn |
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha saubhadrashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.9:
dhRRiShTaketushcha samare rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH |
putrANAM te rathAnIkaM pratyudyAtAH sudurjayAH
shlokas.10:
senApatirameyAtmA dhRRiShTadyumno mahAbalaH |
droNena samare rAjansamiyAyendrakarmaNA
shlokas.11:
evamete maheShvAsAstAvakAH pANDavaiH saha |
sametya samare shUrAH samprahAraM prachakrire
shlokas.12:
madhya.ndinagate sUrye nabhasyAkulatAM gate |
kuravaH pANDaveyAshcha nijaghnuritaretaram
shlokas.13:
dhvajino hemachitrA~NgA vicharanto raNAjire |
sapatAkA rathA rejurvaiyAghraparivAraNAH
shlokas.14:
sametAnAM cha samare jigIShUNAM parasparam |
babhUva tumulaH shabdaH siMhAnAmiva nardatAm
shlokas.15:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma samprahAraM sudAruNam |
yamakurvanraNe vIrAH sRRi~njayAH kurubhiH saha
shlokas.16:
naiva khaM na disho rAjanna sUryaM shatrutApana |
vidisho vApyapashyAma sharairmuktaiH samantataH
shlokas.17:
shaktInAM vimalAgrANAM tomarANAM tathAsyatAm |
nistri.nshAnAM cha pItAnAM nIlotpalanibhAH prabhAH
shlokas.18:
kavachAnAM vichitrANAM bhUShaNAnAM prabhAstathA |
khaM dishaH pradishashchaiva bhAsayAmAsurojasA
virarAja tadA rAja.nstatra tatra raNA~NgaNam
shlokas.19:
rathasiMhAsanavyAghrAH samAyAntashcha sa.nyuge |
virejuH samare rAjangrahA iva nabhastale
shlokas.20:
bhIShmastu rathinAM shreShTho bhImasenaM mahAbalam |
avArayata sa~NkruddhaH sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.21:
tato bhIShmavinirmuktA rukmapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH |
abhyaghnansamare bhImaM tailadhautAH sutejanAH
shlokas.22:
tasya shaktiM mahAvegAM bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
kruddhAshIviShasa~NkAshAM preShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.23:
tAmApatantIM sahasA rukmadaNDAM durAsadAm |
chichCheda samare bhIShmaH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.24:
tato.apareNa bhallena pItena nishitena cha |
kArmukaM bhImasenasya dvidhA chichCheda bhArata
shlokas.25:
sAtyakistu tatastUrNaM bhIShmamAsAdya sa.nyuge |
sharairbahubhirAnarChatpitaraM te janeshvara
shlokas.26:
tataH sandhAya vai tIkShNaM sharaM paramadAruNam |
vArShNeyasya rathAdbhIShmaH pAtayAmAsa sArathim
shlokas.27:
tasyAshvAH pradrutA rAjannihate rathasArathau |
tena tenaiva dhAvanti manomArutaraMhasaH
shlokas.28:
tataH sarvasya sainyasya nisvanastumulo.abhavat |
hAhAkArashcha sa~njaj~ne pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.29:
abhidravata gRRihNIta hayAnyachChata dhAvata |
ityAsIttumulaH shabdo yuyudhAnarathaM prati
shlokas.30:
etasminneva kAle tu bhIShmaH shAntanavaH punaH |
vyahanatpANDavIM senAmAsurImiva vRRitrahA
shlokas.31:
te vadhyamAnA bhIShmeNa pA~nchAlAH somakaiH saha |
AryAM yuddhe matiM kRRitvA bhIShmamevAbhidudruvuH
shlokas.32:
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhAshchApi pArthAH shAntanavaM raNe |
abhyadhAva~njigIShantastava putrasya vAhinIm
shlokas.33:
tathaiva tAvakA rAjanbhIShmadroNamukhAH parAn |
abhyadhAvanta vegena tato yuddhamavartata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
virATo.atha tribhirbANairbhIShmamArChanmahAratham |
vivyAdha turagA.nshchAsya tribhirbANairmahArathaH
shlokas.2:
taM pratyavidhyaddashabhirbhIShmaH shAntanavaH sharaiH |
rukmapu~NkhairmaheShvAsaH kRRitahasto mahAbalaH
shlokas.3:
drauNirgANDIvadhanvAnaM bhImadhanvA mahArathaH |
avidhyadiShubhiH ShaDbhirdRRiDhahastaH stanAntare
shlokas.4:
kArmukaM tasya chichCheda phalgunaH paravIrahA |
avidhyachcha bhRRishaM tIkShNaiH patribhiH shatrukarshanaH
shlokas.5:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya vegavatkrodhamUrChitaH |
amRRiShyamANaH pArthena kArmukachChedamAhave
shlokas.6:
avidhyatphalgunaM rAjannavatyA nishitaiH sharaiH |
vAsudevaM cha saptatyA vivyAdha parameShubhiH
shlokas.7:
tataH krodhAbhitAmrAkShaH saha kRRiShNena phalgunaH |
dIrghamuShNaM cha niHshvasya chintayitvA muhurmuhuH
shlokas.8:
dhanuH prapIDya vAmena kareNAmitrakarshanaH |
gANDIvadhanvA sa~NkruddhaH shitAnsaMnataparvaNaH
jIvitAntakarAnghorAnsamAdatta shilImukhAn
shlokas.9:
taistUrNaM samare.avidhyaddrauNiM balavatAM varam |
tasya te kavachaM bhittvA papuH shoNitamAhave
shlokas.10:
na vivyathe cha nirbhinno drauNirgANDIvadhanvanA |
tathaiva sharavarShANi pratimu~nchannavihvalaH
tasthau sa samare rAja.nstrAtumichChanmahAvratam
shlokas.11:
tasya tatsumahatkarma shasha.nsuH puruSharShabhAH |
yatkRRiShNAbhyAM sametAbhyAM nApatrapata sa.nyuge
shlokas.12:
sa hi nityamanIkeShu yudhyate.abhayamAsthitaH |
astragrAmaM sasaMhAraM droNAtprApya sudurlabham
shlokas.13:
mamAyamAchAryasuto droNasyAtipriyaH sutaH |
brAhmaNashcha visheSheNa mAnanIyo mameti cha
shlokas.14:
samAsthAya matiM vIro bIbhatsuH shatrutApanaH |
kRRipAM chakre rathashreShTho bhAradvAjasutaM prati
shlokas.15:
drauNiM tyaktvA tato yuddhe kaunteyaH shatrutApanaH |
yuyudhe tAvakAnnighna.nstvaramANaH parAkramI
shlokas.16:
duryodhanastu dashabhirgArdhrapatraiH shilAshitaiH |
bhImasenaM maheShvAsaM rukmapu~NkhaiH samarpayat
shlokas.17:
bhImasenastu sa~NkruddhaH parAsukaraNaM dRRiDham |
chitraM kArmukamAdatta sharA.nshcha nishitAndasha
shlokas.18:
AkarNaprahitaistIkShNairvegitaistigmatejanaiH |
avidhyattUrNamavyagraH kururAjaM mahorasi
shlokas.19:
tasya kA~nchanasUtrastu sharaiH parivRRito maNiH |
rarAjorasi vai sUryo grahairiva samAvRRitaH
shlokas.20:
putrastu tava tejasvI bhImasenena tADitaH |
nAmRRiShyata yathA nAgastalashabdaM samIritam
shlokas.21:
tataH sharairmahArAja rukmapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
bhImaM vivyAdha sa~NkruddhastrAsayAno varUthinIm
shlokas.22:
tau yudhyamAnau samare bhRRishamanyonyavikShatau |
putrau te devasa~NkAshau vyarochetAM mahAbalau
shlokas.23:
chitrasenaM naravyAghraM saubhadraH paravIrahA |
avidhyaddashabhirbANaiH purumitraM cha saptabhiH
shlokas.24:
satyavrataM cha saptatyA viddhvA shakrasamo yudhi |
nRRityanniva raNe vIra ArtiM naH samajIjanat
shlokas.25:
taM pratyavidyaddashabhishchitrasenaH shilImukhaiH |
satyavratashcha navabhiH purumitrashcha saptabhiH
shlokas.26:
sa viddho vikSharanraktaM shatrusa.nvAraNaM mahat |
chichCheda chitrasenasya chitraM kArmukamArjuniH
bhittvA chAsya tanutrANaM shareNorasyatADayat
shlokas.27:
tataste tAvakA vIrA rAjaputrA mahArathAH |
sametya yudhi sa.nrabdhA vivyadhurnishitaiH sharaiH
tA.nshcha sarvA~nsharaistIkShNairjaghAna paramAstravit
shlokas.28:
tasya dRRiShTvA tu tatkarma parivavruH sutAstava |
dahantaM samare sainyaM tava kakShaM yatholbaNam
shlokas.29:
apetashishire kAle samiddhamiva pAvakaH |
atyarochata saubhadrastava sainyAni shAtayan
shlokas.30:
tattasya charitaM dRRiShTvA pautrastava vishAM pate |
lakShmaNo.abhyapatattUrNaM sAtvatIputramAhave
shlokas.31:
abhimanyustu sa~Nkruddho lakShmaNaM shubhalakShaNam |
vivyAdha vishikhaiH ShaDbhiH sArathiM cha tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.32:
tathaiva lakShmaNo rAjansaubhadraM nishitaiH sharaiH |
avidhyata mahArAja tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.33:
tasyAshvA.nshchaturo hatvA sArathiM cha mahAbalaH |
abhyadravata saubhadro lakShmaNaM nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.34:
hatAshve tu rathe tuShTha.NllakShmaNaH paravIrahA |
shaktiM chikShepa sa~NkruddhaH saubhadrasya rathaM prati
shlokas.35:
tAmApatantIM sahasA ghorarUpAM durAsadAm |
abhimanyuH sharaistIkShNaishchichCheda bhujagopamAm
shlokas.36:
tataH svarathamAropya lakShmaNaM gautamastadA |
apovAha rathenAjau sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.37:
tataH samAkule tasminvartamAne mahAbhaye |
abhyadrava~njighA.nsantaH parasparavadhaiShiNaH
shlokas.38:
tAvakAshcha maheShvAsAH pANDavAshcha mahArathAH |
juhvantaH samare prANAnnijaghnuritaretaram
shlokas.39:
muktakeshA vikavachA virathAshChinnakArmukAH |
bAhubhiH samayudhyanta sRRi~njayAH kurubhiH saha
shlokas.40:
tato bhIShmo mahAbAhuH pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
senAM jaghAna sa~Nkruddho divyairastrairmahAbalaH
shlokas.41:
hateshvarairgajaistatra narairashvaishcha pAtitaiH |
rathibhiH sAdibhishchaiva samAstIryata medinI

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
atha rAjanmahAbAhuH sAtyakiryuddhadurmadaH |
vikRRiShya chApaM samare bhArasAdhanamuttamam
shlokas.2:
prAmu~nchatpu~Nkhasa.nyuktA~nsharAnAshIviShopamAn |
prakAshaM laghu chitraM cha darshayannastralAghavam
shlokas.3:
tasya vikShipatashchApaM sharAnanyA.nshcha mu~nchataH |
AdadAnasya bhUyashcha sa.ndadhAnasya chAparAn
shlokas.4:
kShipatashcha sharAnasya raNe shatrUnvinighnataH |
dadRRishe rUpamatyarthaM meghasyeva pravarShataH
shlokas.5:
tamudIryantamAlokya rAjA duryodhanastataH |
rathAnAmayutaM tasya preShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.6:
tA.nstu sarvAnmaheShvAsAnsAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
jaghAna parameShvAso divyenAstreNa vIryavAn
shlokas.7:
sa kRRitvA dAruNaM karma pragRRihItasharAsanaH |
AsasAda tato vIro bhUrishravasamAhave
shlokas.8:
sa hi sa.ndRRishya senAM tAM yuyudhAnena pAtitAm |
abhyadhAvata sa~NkruddhaH kurUNAM kIrtivardhanaH
shlokas.9:
indrAyudhasavarNaM tatsa visphArya mahaddhanuH |
vyasRRijadvajrasa~NkAshA~nsharAnAshIviShopamAn
sahasrasho mahArAja darshayanpANilAghavam
shlokas.10:
sharA.nstAnmRRityusa.nsparshAnsAtyakestu padAnugAH |
na viShehustadA rAjandudruvuste samantataH
vihAya samare rAjansAtyakiM yuddhadurmadam
shlokas.11:
taM dRRiShTvA yuyudhAnasya sutA dasha mahAbalAH |
mahArathAH samAkhyAtAshchitravarmAyudhadhvajAH
shlokas.12:
samAsAdya maheShvAsaM bhUrishravasamAhave |
UchuH sarve susa.nrabdhA yUpaketuM mahAraNe
shlokas.13:
bho bho kauravadAyAda sahAsmAbhirmahAbala |
ehi yudhyasva sa~NgrAme samastaiH pRRithageva vA
shlokas.14:
asmAnvA tvaM parAjitya yashaH prApnuhi sa.nyuge |
vayaM vA tvAM parAjitya prItiM dAsyAmahe pituH
shlokas.15:
evamuktastadA shUraistAnuvAcha mahAbalaH |
vIryashlAghI narashreShThastAndRRiShTvA samupasthitAn
shlokas.16:
sAdhvidaM kathyate vIrA yadevaM matiradya vaH |
yudhyadhvaM sahitA yattA nihaniShyAmi vo raNe
shlokas.17:
evamuktA maheShvAsAste vIrAH kShiprakAriNaH |
mahatA sharavarSheNa abhyavarShannari.ndamam
shlokas.18:
aparAhNe mahArAja sa~NgrAmastumulo.abhavat |
ekasya cha bahUnAM cha sametAnAM raNAjire
shlokas.19:
tamekaM rathinAM shreShThaM sharavarShairavAkiran |
prAvRRiShIva mahAshailaM siShichurjaladA nRRipa
shlokas.20:
taistu muktA~nsharaughA.nstAnyamadaNDAshaniprabhAn |
asamprAptAnasamprAptA.nshchichChedAshu mahArathaH
shlokas.21:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma saumadatteH parAkramam |
yadeko bahubhiryuddhe samasajjadabhItavat
shlokas.22:
visRRijya sharavRRiShTiM tAM dasha rAjanmahArathAH |
parivArya mahAbAhuM nihantumupachakramuH
shlokas.23:
saumadattistataH kruddhasteShAM chApAni bhArata |
chichCheda dashabhirbANairnimeSheNa mahArathaH
shlokas.24:
athaiShAM ChinnadhanuShAM bhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
chichCheda samare rAja~nshirA.nsi nishitaiH sharaiH
te hatA nyapatanbhUmau vajrabhagnA iva drumAH
shlokas.25:
tAndRRiShTvA nihatAnvIrAnraNe putrAnmahAbalAn |
vArShNeyo vinadanrAjanbhUrishravasamabhyayAt
shlokas.26:
rathaM rathena samare pIDayitvA mahAbalau |
tAvanyonyasya samare nihatya rathavAjinaH
virathAvabhivalgantau sameyAtAM mahArathau
shlokas.27:
pragRRihItamahAkhaDgau tau charmavaradhAriNau |
shushubhAte naravyAghrau yuddhAya samavasthitau
shlokas.28:
tataH sAtyakimabhyetya nistri.nshavaradhAriNam |
bhImasenastvaranrAjanrathamAropayattadA
shlokas.29:
tavApi tanayo rAjanbhUrishravasamAhave |
AropayadrathaM tUrNaM pashyatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.30:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne raNe bhIShmaM mahAratham |
ayodhayanta sa.nrabdhAH pANDavA bharatarShabha
shlokas.31:
lohitAyati chAditye tvaramANo dhana~njayaH |
pa~nchavi.nshatisAhasrAnnijaghAna mahArathAn
shlokas.32:
te hi duryodhanAdiShTAstadA pArthanibarhaNe |
samprApyaiva gatA nAshaM shalabhA iva pAvakam
shlokas.33:
tato matsyAH kekayAshcha dhanurvedavishAradAH |
parivavrustadA pArthaM sahaputraM mahAratham
shlokas.34:
etasminneva kAle tu sUrye.astamupagachChati |
sarveShAmeva sainyAnAM pramohaH samajAyata
shlokas.35:
avahAraM tatashchakre pitA devavratastava |
sandhyAkAle mahArAja sainyAnAM shrAntavAhanaH
shlokas.36:
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha parasparasamAgame |
te sene bhRRishasa.nvigne yayatuH svaM niveshanam
shlokas.37:
tataH svashibiraM gatvA nyavisha.nstatra bhArata |
pANDavAH sRRi~njayaiH sArdhaM kuravashcha yathAvidhi

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vihRRitya cha tato rAjansahitAH kurupANDavAH |
vyatItAyAM tu sharvaryAM punaryuddhAya niryayuH
shlokas.2:
tatra shabdo mahAnAsIttava teShAM cha bhArata |
yujyatAM rathamukhyAnAM kalpyatAM chaiva dantinAm
shlokas.3:
saMnahyatAM padAtInAM hayAnAM chaiva bhArata |
sha~NkhadundubhinAdashcha tumulaH sarvato.abhavat
shlokas.4:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA dhRRiShTadyumnamabhAShata |
vyUhaM vyUha mahAbAho makaraM shatrutApanam
shlokas.5:
evamuktastu pArthena dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH |
vyAdidesha mahArAja rathino rathinAM varaH
shlokas.6:
shiro.abhUddrupadastasya pANDavashcha dhana~njayaH |
chakShuShI sahadevashcha nakulashcha mahArathaH
tuNDamAsInmahArAja bhImaseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.7:
saubhadro draupadeyAshcha rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH |
sAtyakirdharmarAjashcha vyUhagrIvAM samAsthitAH
shlokas.8:
pRRiShThamAsInmahArAja virATo vAhinIpatiH |
dhRRiShTadyumnena sahito mahatyA senayA vRRitaH
shlokas.9:
kekayA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha vAmaM pArshvaM samAshritAH |
dhRRiShTaketurnaravyAghraH karakarShashcha vIryavAn
dakShiNaM pakShamAshritya sthitA vyUhasya rakShaNe
shlokas.10:
pAdayostu mahArAja sthitaH shrImAnmahArathaH |
kuntibhojaH shatAnIko mahatyA senayA vRRitaH
shlokas.11:
shikhaNDI tu maheShvAsaH somakaiH sa.nvRRito balI |
irAvA.nshcha tataH puchChe makarasya vyavasthitau
shlokas.12:
evametanmahAvyUhaM vyUhya bhArata pANDavAH |
sUryodaye mahArAja punaryuddhAya da.nshitAH
shlokas.13:
kauravAnabhyayustUrNaM hastyashvarathapattibhiH |
samuchChritairdhvajaishchitraiH shastraishcha vimalaiH shitaiH
shlokas.14:
vyUhaM dRRiShTvA tu tatsainyaM pitA devavratastava |
krau~nchena mahatA rAjanpratyavyUhata vAhinIm
shlokas.15:
tasya tuNDe maheShvAso bhAradvAjo vyarochata |
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva chakShurAstAM nareshvara
shlokas.16:
kRRitavarmA tu sahitaH kAmbojAraTTabAhlikaiH |
shirasyAsInnarashreShThaH shreShThaH sarvadhanuShmatAm
shlokas.17:
grIvAyAM shUrasenastu tava putrashcha mAriSha |
duryodhano mahArAja rAjabhirbahubhirvRRitaH
shlokas.18:
prAgjyotiShastu sahitaH madrasauvIrakekayaiH |
urasyabhUnnarashreShTha mahatyA senayA vRRitaH
shlokas.19:
svasenayA cha sahitaH susharmA prasthalAdhipaH |
vAmaM pakShaM samAshritya da.nshitaH samavasthitaH
shlokas.20:
tuShArA yavanAshchaiva shakAshcha saha chUchupaiH |
dakShiNaM pakShamAshritya sthitA vyUhasya bhArata
shlokas.21:
shrutAyushcha shatAyushcha saumadattishcha mAriSha |
vyUhasya jaghane tasthU rakShamANAH parasparam
shlokas.22:
tato yuddhAya sa~njagmuH pANDavAH kauravaiH saha |
sUryodaye mahArAja tato yuddhamabhUnmahat
shlokas.23:
pratIyU rathino nAgAnnAgAshcha rathino yayuH |
hayArohA hayArohAnrathinashchApi sAdinaH
shlokas.24:
sArathiM cha rathI rAjanku~njarA.nshcha mahAraNe |
hastyArohA rathArohAnrathinashchApi sAdinaH
shlokas.25:
rathinaH pattibhiH sArdhaM sAdinashchApi pattibhiH |
anyonyaM samare rAjanpratyadhAvannamarShitAH
shlokas.26:
bhImasenArjunayamairguptA chAnyairmahArathaiH |
shushubhe pANDavI senA nakShatrairiva sharvarI
shlokas.27:
tathA bhIShmakRRipadroNashalyaduryodhanAdibhiH |
tavApi vibabhau senA grahairdyauriva sa.nvRRitA
shlokas.28:
bhImasenastu kaunteyo droNaM dRRiShTvA parAkramI |
abhyayAjjavanairashvairbhAradvAjasya vAhinIm
shlokas.29:
droNastu samare kruddho bhImaM navabhirAyasaiH |
vivyAdha samare rAjanmarmANyuddishya vIryavAn
shlokas.30:
dRRiDhAhatastato bhImo bhAradvAjasya sa.nyuge |
sArathiM preShayAmAsa yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.31:
sa sa~NgRRihya svayaM vAhAnbhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
vyadhamatpANDavIM senAM tUlarAshimivAnalaH
shlokas.32:
te vadhyamAnA droNena bhIShmeNa cha narottama |
sRRi~njayAH kekayaiH sArdhaM palAyanaparAbhavan
shlokas.33:
tathaiva tAvakaM sainyaM bhImArjunaparikShatam |
muhyate tatra tatraiva samadeva varA~NganA
shlokas.34:
abhidyetAM tato vyUhau tasminvIravarakShaye |
AsIdvyatikaro ghorastava teShAM cha bhArata
shlokas.35:
tadadbhutamapashyAma tAvakAnAM paraiH saha |
ekAyanagatAH sarve yadayudhyanta bhArata
shlokas.36:
pratisa.nvArya chAstrANi te.anyonyasya vishAM pate |
yuyudhuH pANDavAshchaiva kauravAshcha mahArathAH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
evaM bahuguNaM sainyamevaM bahuvidhaM param |
vyUDhamevaM yathAshAstramamoghaM chaiva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
puShTamasmAkamatyantamabhikAmaM cha naH sadA |
prahvamavyasanopetaM purastAddRRiShTavikramam
shlokas.3:
nAtivRRiddhamabAlaM cha na kRRishaM na cha pIvaram |
laghuvRRittAyataprAyaM sAragAtramanAmayam
shlokas.4:
AttasaMnAhashastraM cha bahushastraparigraham |
asiyuddhe niyuddhe cha gadAyuddhe cha kovidam
shlokas.5:
prAsarShTitomareShvAjau parigheShvAyaseShu cha |
bhiNDipAleShu shaktIShu musaleShu cha sarvashaH
shlokas.6:
kampaneShu cha chApeShu kaNapeShu cha sarvashaH |
kShepaNIShu cha chitrAsu muShTiyuddheShu kovidam
shlokas.7:
aparokShaM cha vidyAsu vyAyAmeShu kRRitashramam |
shastragrahaNavidyAsu sarvAsu pariniShThitam
shlokas.8:
Arohe paryavaskande saraNe sAntaraplute |
samyakpraharaNe yAne vyapayAne cha kovidam
shlokas.9:
nAgAshvarathayAneShu bahushaH suparIkShitam |
parIkShya cha yathAnyAyaM vetanenopapAditam
shlokas.10:
na goShThyA nopachAreNa na cha bandhunimittataH |
na sauhRRidabalaishchApi nAkulInaparigrahaiH
shlokas.11:
samRRiddhajanamAryaM cha tuShTasatkRRitabAndhavam |
kRRitopakArabhUyiShThaM yashasvi cha manasvi cha
shlokas.12:
sajayaishcha narairmukhyairbahusho mukhyakarmabhiH |
lokapAlopamaistAta pAlitaM lokavishrutaiH
shlokas.13:
bahubhiH kShatriyairguptaM pRRithivyAM lokasaMmataiH |
asmAnabhigataiH kAmAtsabalaiH sapadAnugaiH
shlokas.14:
mahodadhimivApUrNamApagAbhiH samantataH |
apakShaiH pakShasa~NkAshai rathairnAgaishcha sa.nvRRitam
shlokas.15:
nAnAyodhajalaM bhImaM vAhanormitara~NgiNam |
kShepaNyasigadAshaktisharaprAsasamAkulam
shlokas.16:
dhvajabhUShaNasambAdhaM ratnapaTTena sa~nchitam |
vAhanaiH parisarpadbhirvAyuvegavikampitam
shlokas.17:
apAramiva garjantaM sAgarapratimaM mahat |
droNabhIShmAbhisa~NguptaM guptaM cha kRRitavarmaNA
shlokas.18:
kRRipaduHshAsanAbhyAM cha jayadrathamukhaistathA |
bhagadattavikarNAbhyAM drauNisaubalabAhlikaiH
shlokas.19:
guptaM pravIrairlokasya sAravadbhirmahAtmabhiH |
yadahanyata sa~NgrAme diShTametatpurAtanam
shlokas.20:
naitAdRRishaM samudyogaM dRRiShTavanto.atha mAnuShAH |
RRiShayo vA mahAbhAgAH purANA bhuvi sa~njaya
shlokas.21:
IdRRisho hi balaughastu yuktaH shastrAstrasampadA |
vadhyate yatra sa~NgrAme kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.22:
viparItamidaM sarvaM pratibhAti sma sa~njaya |
yatredRRishaM balaM ghoraM nAtaradyudhi pANDavAn
shlokas.23:
atha vA pANDavArthAya devAstatra samAgatAH |
yudhyante mAmakaM sainyaM yadavadhyanta sa~njaya
shlokas.24:
ukto hi vidureNeha hitaM pathyaM cha sa~njaya |
na cha gRRihNAti tanmandaH putro duryodhano mama
shlokas.25:
tasya manye matiH pUrvaM sarvaj~nasya mahAtmanaH |
AsIdyathAgataM tAta yena dRRiShTamidaM purA
shlokas.26:
atha vA bhAvyamevaM hi sa~njayaitena sarvathA |
purA dhAtrA yathA sRRiShTaM tattathA na tadanyathA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
AtmadoShAttvayA rAjanprAptaM vyasanamIdRRisham |
na hi duryodhanastAni pashyate bharatarShabha
yAni tvaM dRRiShTavAnrAjandharmasa~NkarakArite
shlokas.2:
tava doShAtpurA vRRittaM dyUtametadvishAM pate |
tava doSheNa yuddhaM cha pravRRittaM saha pANDavaiH
tvamevAdya phalaM bhu~NkShva kRRitvA kilbiShamAtmanA
shlokas.3:
AtmanA hi kRRitaM karma Atmanaivopabhujyate |
iha vA pretya vA rAja.nstvayA prAptaM yathAtatham
shlokas.4:
tasmAdrAjansthiro bhUtvA prApyedaM vyasanaM mahat |
shRRiNu yuddhaM yathAvRRittaM sha.nsato mama mAriSha
shlokas.5:
bhImasenastu nishitairbANairbhittvA mahAchamUm |
AsasAda tato vIraH sarvAnduryodhanAnujAn
shlokas.6:
duHshAsanaM durviShahaM duHsahaM durmadaM jayam |
jayatsenaM vikarNaM cha chitrasenaM sudarshanam
shlokas.7:
chAruchitraM suvarmANaM duShkarNaM karNameva cha |
etAnanyA.nshcha subahUnsamIpasthAnmahArathAn
shlokas.8:
dhArtarAShTrAnsusa~NkruddhAndRRiShTvA bhImo mahAbalaH |
bhIShmeNa samare guptAM pravivesha mahAchamUm
shlokas.9:
athAhvayanta te.anyonyamayaM prApto vRRikodaraH |
jIvagrAhaM nigRRihNImo vayamenaM narAdhipAH
shlokas.10:
sa taiH parivRRitaH pArtho bhrAtRRibhiH kRRitanishchayaiH |
prajAsaMharaNe sUryaH krUrairiva mahAgrahaiH
shlokas.11:
samprApya madhyaM vyUhasya na bhIH pANDavamAvishat |
yathA devAsure yuddhe mahendraH prApya dAnavAn
shlokas.12:
tataH shatasahasrANi rathinAM sarvashaH prabho |
ChAdayAnaM sharairghoraistamekamanuvavrire
shlokas.13:
sa teShAM pravarAnyodhAnhastyashvarathasAdinaH |
jaghAna samare shUro dhArtarAShTrAnachintayan
shlokas.14:
teShAM vyavasitaM j~nAtvA bhImaseno jighRRikShatAm |
samastAnAM vadhe rAjanmatiM chakre mahAmanAH
shlokas.15:
tato rathaM samutsRRijya gadAmAdAya pANDavaH |
jaghAna dhArtarAShTrANAM taM balaughamahArNavam
shlokas.16:
bhImasene praviShTe tu dhRRiShTadyumno.api pArShataH |
droNamutsRRijya tarasA prayayau yatra saubalaH
shlokas.17:
vidArya mahatIM senAM tAvakAnAM nararShabhaH |
AsasAda rathaM shUnyaM bhImasenasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.18:
dRRiShTvA vishokaM samare bhImasenasya sArathim |
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja durmanA gatachetanaH
shlokas.19:
apRRichChadbAShpasa.nruddho nisvanAM vAchamIrayan |
mama prANaiH priyatamaH kva bhIma iti duHkhitaH
shlokas.20:
vishokastamuvAchedaM dhRRiShTadyumnaM kRRitA~njaliH |
sa.nsthApya mAmiha balI pANDaveyaH pratApavAn
shlokas.21:
praviShTo dhArtarAShTrANAmetadbalamahArNavam |
mAmuktvA puruShavyAghra prItiyuktamidaM vachaH
shlokas.22:
pratipAlaya mAM sUta niyamyAshvAnmuhUrtakam |
yAvadetAnnihanmyAshu ya ime madvadhodyatAH
shlokas.23:
tato dRRiShTvA gadAhastaM pradhAvantaM mahAbalam |
sarveShAmeva sainyAnAM sa~NgharShaH samajAyata
shlokas.24:
tasmi.nstu tumule yuddhe vartamAne bhayAnake |
bhittvA rAjanmahAvyUhaM pravivesha sakhA tava
shlokas.25:
vishokasya vachaH shrutvA dhRRiShTadyumno.api pArShataH |
pratyuvAcha tataH sUtaM raNamadhye mahAbalaH
shlokas.26:
na hi me vidyate sUta jIvite.adya prayojanam |
bhImasenaM raNe hitvA snehamutsRRijya pANDavaiH
shlokas.27:
yadi yAmi vinA bhImaM kiM mAM kShatraM vadiShyati |
ekAyanagate bhIme mayi chAvasthite yudhi
shlokas.28:
asvasti tasya kurvanti devAH sAgnipurogamAH |
yaH sahAyAnparityajya svastimAnAvrajedgRRihAn
shlokas.29:
mama bhImaH sakhA chaiva sambandhI cha mahAbalaH |
bhakto.asmAnbhaktimA.nshchAhaM tamapyariniShUdanam
shlokas.30:
so.ahaM tatra gamiShyAmi yatra yAto vRRikodaraH |
nighnantaM mAmarInpashya dAnavAniva vAsavam
shlokas.31:
evamuktvA tato vIro yayau madhyena bhAratIm |
bhImasenasya mArgeShu gadApramathitairgajaiH
shlokas.32:
sa dadarsha tato bhImaM dahantaM ripuvAhinIm |
vAtaM vRRikShAniva balAtprabha~njantaM raNe nRRipAn
shlokas.33:
te hanyamAnAH samare rathinaH sAdinastathA |
pAdAtA dantinashchaiva chakrurArtasvaraM mahat
shlokas.34:
hAhAkArashcha sa~njaj~ne tava sainyasya mAriSha |
vadhyato bhImasenena kRRitinA chitrayodhinA
shlokas.35:
tataH kRRitAstrAste sarve parivArya vRRikodaram |
abhItAH samavartanta shastravRRiShTyA samantataH
shlokas.36:
abhidrutaM shastrabhRRitAM variShThaM; samantataH pANDavaM lokavIraiH |
sainyena ghoreNa susa~Ngatena; dRRiShTvA balI pArShato bhImasenam
shlokas.37:
athopagachChachCharavikShatA~NgaM; padAtinaM krodhaviShaM vamantam |
AshvAsayanpArShato bhImasenaM; gadAhastaM kAlamivAntakAle
shlokas.38:
niHshalyamenaM cha chakAra tUrNa;mAropayachchAtmarathaM mahAtmA |
bhRRishaM pariShvajya cha bhImasena;mAshvAsayAmAsa cha shatrumadhye
shlokas.39:
bhrAtR^Inathopetya tavApi putra;stasminvimarde mahati pravRRitte |
ayaM durAtmA drupadasya putraH; samAgato bhImasenena sArdham
taM yAta sarve sahitA nihantuM; mA vo ripuH prArthayatAmanIkam
shlokas.40:
shrutvA tu vAkyaM tamamRRiShyamANA; jyeShThAj~nayA choditA dhArtarAShTrAH |
vadhAya niShpeturudAyudhAste; yugakShaye ketavo yadvadugrAH
shlokas.41:
pragRRihya chitrANi dhanUMShi vIrA; jyAnemighoShaiH pravikampayantaH |
sharairavarShandrupadasya putraM; yathAmbudA bhUdharaM vArijAlaiH
nihatya tA.nshchApi sharaiH sutIkShNai;rna vivyathe samare chitrayodhI
shlokas.42:
samabhyudIrNA.nshcha tavAtmajA.nstathA; nishAmya vIrAnabhitaH sthitAnraNe |
jighA.nsurugraM drupadAtmajo yuvA; pramohanAstraM yuyuje mahArathaH
kruddho bhRRishaM tava putreShu rAja;ndaityeShu yadvatsamare mahendraH
shlokas.43:
tato vyamuhyanta raNe nRRivIrAH; pramohanAstrAhatabuddhisattvAH |
pradudruvuH kuravashchaiva sarve; savAjinAgAH sarathAH samantAt
parItakAlAniva naShTasa~nj~nA;nmohopetA.nstava putrAnnishamya
shlokas.44:
etasminneva kAle tu droNaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
drupadaM tribhirAsAdya sharairvivyAdha dAruNaiH
shlokas.45:
so.atividdhastadA rAjanraNe droNena pArthivaH |
apAyAddrupado rAjanpUrvavairamanusmaran
shlokas.46:
jitvA tu drupadaM droNaH sha~NkhaM dadhmau pratApavAn |
tasya sha~NkhasvanaM shrutvA vitresuH sarvasomakAH
shlokas.47:
atha shushrAva tejasvI droNaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
pramohanAstreNa raNe mohitAnAtmajA.nstava
shlokas.48:
tato droNo rAjagRRiddhI tvarito.abhiyayau raNAt |
tatrApashyanmaheShvAso bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha bhImaM cha vicharantau mahAraNe
shlokas.49:
mohAviShTA.nshcha te putrAnapashyatsa mahArathaH |
tataH praj~nAstramAdAya mohanAstraM vyashAtayat
shlokas.50:
atha pratyAgataprANAstava putrA mahArathAH |
punaryuddhAya samare prayayurbhImapArShatau
shlokas.51:
tato yudhiShThiraH prAha samAhUya svasainikAn |
gachChantu padavIM shaktyA bhImapArShatayoryudhi
shlokas.52:
saubhadrapramukhA vIrA rathA dvAdasha da.nshitAH |
pravRRittimadhigachChantu na hi shudhyati me manaH
shlokas.53:
ta evaM samanuj~nAtAH shUrA vikrAntayodhinaH |
bADhamityevamuktvA tu sarve puruShamAninaH
madhya.ndinagate sUrye prayayuH sarva eva hi
shlokas.54:
kekayA draupadeyAshcha dhRRiShTaketushcha vIryavAn |
abhimanyuM puraskRRitya mahatyA senayA vRRitAH
shlokas.55:
te kRRitvA samare vyUhaM sUchImukhamari.ndamAH |
bibhidurdhArtarAShTrANAM tadrathAnIkamAhave
shlokas.56:
tAnprayAtAnmaheShvAsAnabhimanyupurogamAn |
bhImasenabhayAviShTA dhRRiShTadyumnavimohitA
shlokas.57:
na sandhArayituM shaktA tava senA janAdhipa |
madamUrChAnvitAtmAnaM pramadevAdhvani sthitA
shlokas.58:
te.abhiyAtA maheShvAsAH suvarNavikRRitadhvajAH |
parIpsanto.abhyadhAvanta dhRRiShTadyumnavRRikodarau
shlokas.59:
tau cha dRRiShTvA maheShvAsAnabhimanyupurogamAn |
babhUvaturmudA yuktau nighnantau tava vAhinIm
shlokas.60:
dRRiShTvA cha sahasAyAntaM pA~nchAlyo gurumAtmanaH |
nAsha.nsata vadhaM vIraH putrANAM tava pArShataH
shlokas.61:
tato rathaM samAropya kekayasya vRRikodaram |
abhyadhAvatsusa~Nkruddho droNamiShvastrapAragam
shlokas.62:
tasyAbhipatatastUrNaM bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
kruddhashchichCheda bhallena dhanuH shatruniShUdanaH
shlokas.63:
anyA.nshcha shatasho bANAnpreShayAmAsa pArShate |
duryodhanahitArthAya bhartRRipiNDamanusmaran
shlokas.64:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya pArShataH paravIrahA |
droNaM vivyAdha saptatyA rukmapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.65:
tasya droNaH punashchApaM chichChedAmitrakarshanaH |
hayA.nshcha chaturastUrNaM chaturbhiH sAyakottamaiH
shlokas.66:
vaivasvatakShayaM ghoraM preShayAmAsa vIryavAn |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena preShayAmAsa mRRityave
shlokas.68:
tataH sarathanAgAshvA samakampata vAhinI |
pashyato bhImasenasya pArShatasya cha pashyataH
shlokas.69:
tatprabhagnaM balaM dRRiShTvA droNenAmitatejasA |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM samastAste mahArathAH
shlokas.70:
vadhyamAnaM tu tatsainyaM droNena nishitaiH sharaiH |
vyabhramattatra tatraiva kShobhyamANa ivArNavaH
shlokas.71:
tathA dRRiShTvA cha tatsainyaM jahRRiShe cha balaM tava |
dRRiShTvAchAryaM cha sa~NkruddhaM dahantaM ripuvAhinIm
chukrushuH sarvato yodhAH sAdhu sAdhviti bhArata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato duryodhano rAjA mohAtpratyAgatastadA |
sharavarShaiH punarbhImaM pratyavArayadachyutam
shlokas.2:
ekIbhUtAH punashchaiva tava putrA mahArathAH |
sametya samare bhImaM yodhayAmAsurudyatAH
shlokas.3:
bhImaseno.api samare samprApya svarathaM punaH |
samAruhya mahAbAhuryayau yena tavAtmajaH
shlokas.4:
pragRRihya cha mahAvegaM parAsukaraNaM dRRiDham |
chitraM sharAsanaM sa~Nkhye sharairvivyAdha te sutAn
shlokas.5:
tato duryodhano rAjA bhImasenaM mahAbalam |
nArAchena sutIkShNena bhRRishaM marmaNyatADayat
shlokas.6:
so.atividdho maheShvAsastava putreNa dhanvinA |
krodhasa.nraktanayano vegenotkShipya kArmukam
shlokas.7:
duryodhanaM tribhirbANairbAhvorurasi chArpayat |
sa tathAbhihato rAjA nAchaladgirirADiva
shlokas.8:
tau dRRiShTvA samare kruddhau vinighnantau parasparam |
duryodhanAnujAH sarve shUrAH santyaktajIvitAH
shlokas.9:
sa.nsmRRitya mantritaM pUrvaM nigrahe bhImakarmaNaH |
nishchayaM manasA kRRitvA nigrahItuM prachakramuH
shlokas.10:
tAnApatata evAjau bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
pratyudyayau mahArAja gajaH pratigajAniva
shlokas.11:
bhRRishaM kruddhashcha tejasvI nArAchena samarpayat |
chitrasenaM mahArAja tava putraM mahAyashAH
shlokas.12:
tathetarA.nstava sutA.nstADayAmAsa bhArata |
sharairbahuvidhaiH sa~Nkhye rukmapu~NkhaiH suvegitaiH
shlokas.13:
tataH sa.nsthApya samare svAnyanIkAni sarvashaH |
abhimanyuprabhRRitayaste dvAdasha mahArathAH
shlokas.14:
preShitA dharmarAjena bhImasenapadAnugAH |
pratyudyayurmahArAja tava putrAnmahAbalAn
shlokas.15:
dRRiShTvA rathasthA.nstA~nshUrAnsUryAgnisamatejasaH |
sarvAneva maheShvAsAnbhrAjamAnA~nshriyA vRRitAn
shlokas.16:
mahAhave dIpyamAnAnsuvarNakavachojjvalAn |
tatyajuH samare bhImaM tava putrA mahAbalAH
shlokas.17:
tAnnAmRRiShyata kaunteyo jIvamAnA gatA iti |
anvIya cha punaH sarvA.nstava putrAnapIDayat
shlokas.18:
athAbhimanyuM samare bhImasenena sa~Ngatam |
pArShatena cha samprekShya tava sainye mahArathAH
shlokas.19:
duryodhanaprabhRRitayaH pragRRihItasharAsanAH |
bhRRishamashvaiH prajavitaiH prayayuryatra te rathAH
shlokas.20:
aparAhNe tato rAjanprAvartata mahAnraNaH |
tAvakAnAM cha balinAM pareShAM chaiva bhArata
shlokas.21:
abhimanyurvikarNasya hayAnhatvA mahAjavAn |
athainaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA kShudrakANAM samAchinot
shlokas.22:
hatAshvaM rathamutsRRijya vikarNastu mahArathaH |
Aruroha rathaM rAja.nshchitrasenasya bhAsvaram
shlokas.23:
sthitAvekarathe tau tu bhrAtarau kuruvardhanau |
ArjuniH sharajAlena ChAdayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.24:
durjayo.atha vikarNashcha kArShNiM pa~nchabhirAyasaiH |
vivyadhAte na chAkampatkArShNirmerurivAchalaH
shlokas.25:
duHshAsanastu samare kekayAnpa~ncha mAriSha |
yodhayAmAsa rAjendra tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.26:
draupadeyA raNe kruddhA duryodhanamavArayan |
ekaikastribhirAnarChatputraM tava vishAM pate
shlokas.27:
putro.api tava durdharSho draupadyAstanayAnraNe |
sAyakairnishitai rAjannAjaghAna pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.28:
taishchApi viddhaH shushubhe rudhireNa samukShitaH |
giriprasravaNairyadvadgirirdhAtuvimishritaiH
shlokas.29:
bhIShmo.api samare rAjanpANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
kAlayAmAsa balavAnpAlaH pashugaNAniva
shlokas.30:
tato gANDIvanirghoShaH prAdurAsIdvishAM pate |
dakShiNena varUthinyAH pArthasyArInvinighnataH
shlokas.31:
uttasthuH samare tatra kabandhAni samantataH |
kurUNAM chApi sainyeShu pANDavAnAM cha bhArata
shlokas.32:
shoNitodaM rathAvartaM gajadvIpaM hayormiNam |
rathanaubhirnaravyAghrAH prateruH sainyasAgaram
shlokas.33:
ChinnahastA vikavachA videhAshcha narottamAH |
patitAstatra dRRishyante shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.34:
nihatairmattamAta~NgaiH shoNitaughapariplutaiH |
bhUrbhAti bharatashreShTha parvatairAchitA yathA
shlokas.35:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma tava teShAM cha bhArata |
na tatrAsItpumAnkashchidyo yoddhuM nAbhikA~NkShati
shlokas.36:
evaM yuyudhire vIrAH prArthayAnA mahadyashaH |
tAvakAH pANDavaiH sArdhaM kA~NkShamANA jayaM yudhi

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato duryodhano rAjA lohitAyati bhAskare |
sa~NgrAmarabhaso bhImaM hantukAmo.abhyadhAvata
shlokas.2:
tamAyAntamabhiprekShya nRRivIraM dRRiDhavairiNam |
bhImasenaH susa~Nkruddha idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.3:
ayaM sa kAlaH samprApto varShapUgAbhikA~NkShitaH |
adya tvAM nihaniShyAmi yadi notsRRijase raNam
shlokas.4:
adya kuntyAH parikleshaM vanavAsaM cha kRRitsnashaH |
draupadyAshcha parikleshaM praNotsyAmi hate tvayi
shlokas.5:
yattvaM durodaro bhUtvA pANDavAnavamanyase |
tasya pApasya gAndhAre pashya vyasanamAgatam
shlokas.6:
karNasya matamAj~nAya saubalasya cha yatpurA |
achintya pANDavAnkAmAdyatheShTaM kRRitavAnasi
shlokas.7:
yAchamAnaM cha yanmohAddAshArhamavamanyase |
ulUkasya samAdeshaM yaddadAsi cha hRRiShTavat
shlokas.8:
adya tvA nihaniShyAmi sAnubandhaM sabAndhavam |
samIkariShye tatpApaM yatpurA kRRitavAnasi
shlokas.9:
evamuktvA dhanurghoraM vikRRiShyodbhrAmya chAsakRRit |
samAdAya sharAnghorAnmahAshanisamaprabhAn
shlokas.10:
ShaDvi.nshattarasA kruddho mumochAshu suyodhane |
jvalitAgnishikhAkArAnvajrakalpAnajihmagAn
shlokas.11:
tato.asya kArmukaM dvAbhyAM sUtaM dvAbhyAM cha vivyadhe |
chaturbhirashvA~njavanAnanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.12:
dvAbhyAM cha suvikRRiShTAbhyAM sharAbhyAmarimardanaH |
ChatraM chichCheda samare rAj~nastasya rathottamAt
shlokas.13:
tribhishcha tasya chichCheda jvalantaM dhvajamuttamam |
ChittvA taM cha nanAdochchaistava putrasya pashyataH
shlokas.14:
rathAchcha sa dhvajaH shrImAnnAnAratnavibhUShitaH |
papAta sahasA bhUmiM vidyujjaladharAdiva
shlokas.15:
jvalantaM sUryasa~NkAshaM nAgaM maNimayaM shubham |
dhvajaM kurupateshChinnaM dadRRishuH sarvapArthivAH
shlokas.16:
athainaM dashabhirbANaistottrairiva mahAgajam |
AjaghAna raNe bhImaH smayanniva mahArathaH
shlokas.17:
tatastu rAjA sindhUnAM rathashreShTho jayadrathaH |
duryodhanasya jagrAha pArShNiM satpuruShochitAm
shlokas.18:
kRRipashcha rathinAM shreShThaH kauravyamamitaujasam |
AropayadrathaM rAjanduryodhanamamarShaNam
shlokas.19:
sa gADhaviddho vyathito bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
niShasAda rathopasthe rAjA duryodhanastadA
shlokas.20:
parivArya tato bhImaM hantukAmo jayadrathaH |
rathairanekasAhasrairbhImasyAvArayaddishaH
shlokas.21:
dhRRiShTaketustato rAjannabhimanyushcha vIryavAn |
kekayA draupadeyAshcha tava putrAnayodhayan
shlokas.22:
chitrasenaH suchitrashcha chitrAshvashchitradarshanaH |
chAruchitraH suchArushcha tathA nandopanandakau
shlokas.23:
aShTAvete maheShvAsAH sukumArA yashasvinaH |
abhimanyurathaM rAjansamantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.24:
AjaghAna tatastUrNamabhimanyurmahAmanAH |
ekaikaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
vajramRRityupratIkAshairvichitrAyudhaniHsRRitaiH
shlokas.25:
amRRiShyamANAste sarve saubhadraM rathasattamam |
vavarShurmArgaNaistIkShNairgiriM merumivAmbudAH
shlokas.26:
sa pIDyamAnaH samare kRRitAstro yuddhadurmadaH |
abhimanyurmahArAja tAvakAnsamakampayat
yathA devAsure yuddhe vajrapANirmahAsurAn
shlokas.27:
vikarNasya tato bhallAnpreShayAmAsa bhArata |
chaturdasha rathashreShTho ghorAnAshIviShopamAn
dhvajaM sUtaM hayA.nshchAsya ChittvA nRRityannivAhave
shlokas.28:
punashchAnyA~nsharAnpItAnakuNThAgrA~nshilAshitAn |
preShayAmAsa saubhadro vikarNAya mahAbalaH
shlokas.29:
te vikarNaM samAsAdya ka~NkabarhiNavAsasaH |
bhittvA dehaM gatA bhUmiM jvalanta iva pannagAH
shlokas.30:
te sharA hemapu~NkhAgrA vyadRRishyanta mahItale |
vikarNarudhiraklinnA vamanta iva shoNitam
shlokas.31:
vikarNaM vIkShya nirbhinnaM tasyaivAnye sahodarAH |
abhyadravanta samare saubhadrapramukhAnrathAn
shlokas.32:
abhiyAtvA tathaivAshu rathasthAnsUryavarchasaH |
avidhyansamare.anyonyaM sa.nrabdhA yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.33:
durmukhaH shrutakarmANaM viddhvA saptabhirAshugaiH |
dhvajamekena chichCheda sArathiM chAsya saptabhiH
shlokas.34:
ashvA~njAmbUnadairjAlaiH prachChannAnvAtaraMhasaH |
jaghAna ShaDbhirAsAdya sArathiM chAbhyapAtayat
shlokas.35:
sa hatAshve rathe tiShTha~nshrutakarmA mahArathaH |
shaktiM chikShepa sa~Nkruddho maholkAM jvalitAmiva
shlokas.36:
sA durmukhasya vipulaM varma bhittvA yashasvinaH |
vidArya prAvishadbhUmiM dIpyamAnA sutejanA
shlokas.37:
taM dRRiShTvA virathaM tatra sutasomo mahAbalaH |
pashyatAM sarvasainyAnAM rathamAropayatsvakam
shlokas.38:
shrutakIrtistathA vIro jayatsenaM sutaM tava |
abhyayAtsamare rAjanhantukAmo yashasvinam
shlokas.39:
tasya vikShipatashchApaM shrutakIrtermahAtmanaH |
chichCheda samare rAja~njayatsenaH sutastava
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena prahasanniva bhArata
shlokas.40:
taM dRRiShTvA ChinnadhanvAnaM shatAnIkaH sahodaram |
abhyapadyata tejasvI siMhavadvinadanmuhuH
shlokas.41:
shatAnIkastu samare dRRiDhaM visphArya kArmukam |
vivyAdha dashabhistUrNaM jayatsenaM shilImukhaiH
shlokas.42:
athAnyena sutIkShNena sarvAvaraNabhedinA |
shatAnIko jayatsenaM vivyAdha hRRidaye bhRRisham
shlokas.43:
tathA tasminvartamAne duShkarNo bhrAturantike |
chichCheda samare chApaM nAkuleH krodhamUrChitaH
shlokas.44:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya bhArasAdhanamuttamam |
samAdatta shitAnbANA~nshatAnIko mahAbalaH
shlokas.45:
tiShTha tiShTheti chAmantrya duShkarNaM bhrAturagrataH |
mumocha nishitAnbANA~njvalitAnpannagAniva
shlokas.46:
tato.asya dhanurekena dvAbhyAM sUtaM cha mAriSha |
chichCheda samare tUrNaM taM cha vivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.47:
ashvAnmanojavA.nshchAsya kalmAShAnvItakalmaShaH |
jaghAna nishitaistUrNaM sarvAndvAdashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.48:
athApareNa bhallena sumuktena nipAtinA |
duShkarNaM samare kruddho vivyAdha hRRidaye bhRRisham
shlokas.49:
duShkarNaM nihataM dRRiShTvA pa~ncha rAjanmahArathAH |
jighA.nsantaH shatAnIkaM sarvataH paryavArayan
shlokas.50:
ChAdyamAnaM sharavrAtaiH shatAnIkaM yashasvinam |
abhyadhAvanta sa.nrabdhAH kekayAH pa~ncha sodarAH
shlokas.51:
tAnabhyApatataH prekShya tava putrA mahArathAH |
pratyudyayurmahArAja gajA iva mahAgajAn
shlokas.52:
durmukho durjayashchaiva tathA durmarShaNo yuvA |
shatru~njayaH shatrusahaH sarve kruddhA yashasvinaH
pratyudyAtA mahArAja kekayAnbhrAtaraH samam
shlokas.53:
rathairnagarasa~NkAshairhayairyuktairmanojavaiH |
nAnAvarNavichitrAbhiH patAkAbhirala~NkRRitaiH
shlokas.54:
varachApadharA vIrA vichitrakavachadhvajAH |
vivishuste paraM sainyaM siMhA iva vanAdvanam
shlokas.55:
teShAM sutumulaM yuddhaM vyatiShaktarathadvipam |
avartata mahAraudraM nighnatAmitaretaram
anyonyAgaskRRitAM rAjanyamarAShTravivardhanam
shlokas.56:
muhUrtAstamite sUrye chakruryuddhaM sudAruNam |
rathinaH sAdinashchaiva vyakIryanta sahasrashaH
shlokas.57:
tataH shAntanavaH kruddhaH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
nAshayAmAsa senAM vai bhIShmasteShAM mahAtmanAm
pA~nchAlAnAM cha sainyAni sharairninye yamakShayam
shlokas.58:
evaM bhittvA maheShvAsaH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
kRRitvAvahAraM sainyAnAM yayau svashibiraM nRRipa
shlokas.59:
dharmarAjo.api samprekShya dhRRiShTadyumnavRRikodarau |
mUrdhni chaitAvupAghrAya saMhRRiShTaH shibiraM yayau

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
atha shUrA mahArAja parasparakRRitAgasaH |
jagmuH svashibirANyeva rudhireNa samukShitAH
shlokas.2:
vishramya cha yathAnyAyaM pUjayitvA parasparam |
saMnaddhAH samadRRishyanta bhUyo yuddhachikIrShayA
shlokas.3:
tatastava suto rAja.nshchintayAbhipariplutaH |
visravachChoNitAktA~NgaH paprachChedaM pitAmaham
shlokas.4:
sainyAni raudrANi bhayAnakAni; vyUDhAni samyagbahuladhvajAni |
vidArya hatvA cha nipIDya shUrA;ste pANDavAnAM tvaritA rathaughAH
shlokas.5:
saMmohya sarvAnyudhi kIrtimanto; vyUhaM cha taM makaraM vajrakalpam |
pravishya bhImena nibarhito.asmi; ghoraiH sharairmRRityudaNDaprakAshaiH
shlokas.6:
kruddhaM tamudvIkShya bhayena rAja;nsaMmUrChito nAlabhaM shAntimadya |
ichChe prasAdAttava satyasandha; prAptuM jayaM pANDaveyA.nshcha hantum
shlokas.7:
tenaivamuktaH prahasanmahAtmA; duryodhanaM jAtamanyuM viditvA |
taM pratyuvAchAvimanA manasvI; ga~NgAsutaH shastrabhRRitAM variShThaH
shlokas.8:
pareNa yatnena vigAhya senAM; sarvAtmanAhaM tava rAjaputra |
ichChAmi dAtuM vijayaM sukhaM cha; na chAtmAnaM ChAdaye.ahaM tvadarthe
shlokas.9:
ete tu raudrA bahavo mahArathA; yashasvinaH shUratamAH kRRitAstrAH |
ye pANDavAnAM samare sahAyA; jitaklamAH krodhaviShaM vamanti
shlokas.10:
te neha shakyAH sahasA vijetuM; vIryonnaddhAH kRRitavairAstvayA cha |
ahaM hyetAnpratiyotsyAmi rAja;nsarvAtmanA jIvitaM tyajya vIra
shlokas.11:
raNe tavArthAya mahAnubhAva; na jIvitaM rakShyatamaM mamAdya |
sarvA.nstavArthAya sadevadaityA.N;llokAndaheyaM kimu shatrU.nstaveha
shlokas.12:
tatpANDavAnyodhayiShyAmi rAja;npriyaM cha te sarvamahaM kariShye |
shrutvaiva chaitatparamapratIto; duryodhanaH prItamanA babhUva
shlokas.13:
sarvANi sainyAni tataH prahRRiShTo; nirgachChatetyAha nRRipA.nshcha sarvAn |
tadAj~nayA tAni viniryayurdrutaM; rathAshvapAdAtagajAyutAni
shlokas.14:
praharShayuktAni tu tAni rAja;nmahAnti nAnAvidhashastravanti |
sthitAni nAgAshvapadAtimanti; virejurAjau tava rAjanbalAni
shlokas.15:
vRRindaiH sthitAshchApi susamprayuktA;shchakAshire dantigaNAH samantAt |
shastrAstravidbhirnaradeva yodhai;radhiShThitAH sainyagaNAstvadIyAH
shlokas.16:
rathaishcha pAdAtagajAshvasa~NghaiH; prayAdbhirAjau vidhivatpraNunnaiH |
samuddhataM vai taruNArkavarNaM; rajo babhau ChAdayatsUryarashmIn
shlokas.17:
rejuH patAkA rathadantisa.nsthA; vAteritA bhrAmyamANAH samantAt |
nAnAra~NgAH samare tatra rAja;nmeghairyuktA vidyutaH khe yathaiva
shlokas.18:
dhanUMShi visphArayatAM nRRipANAM; babhUva shabdastumulo.atighoraH |
vimathyato devamahAsuraughai;ryathArNavasyAdiyuge tadAnIm
shlokas.19:
tadugranAdaM bahurUpavarNaM; tavAtmajAnAM samudIrNamevam |
babhUva sainyaM ripusainyahantRRi; yugAntameghaughanibhaM tadAnIm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
athAtmajaM tava punargA~Ngeyo dhyAnamAsthitam |
abravIdbharatashreShThaH sampraharShakaraM vachaH
shlokas.2:
ahaM droNashcha shalyashcha kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
ashvatthAmA vikarNashcha somadatto.atha saindhavaH
shlokas.3:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau bAhlikaH saha bAhlikaiH |
trigartarAjashcha balI mAgadhashcha sudurjayaH
shlokas.4:
bRRihadbalashcha kausalyashchitraseno vivi.nshatiH |
rathAshcha bahusAhasrAH shobhamAnA mahAdhvajAH
shlokas.5:
deshajAshcha hayA rAjansvArUDhA hayasAdibhiH |
gajendrAshcha madodvRRittAH prabhinnakaraTAmukhAH
shlokas.6:
padAtAshcha tathA shUrA nAnApraharaNAyudhAH |
nAnAdeshasamutpannAstvadarthe yoddhumudyatAH
shlokas.7:
ete chAnye cha bahavastvadarthe tyaktajIvitAH |
devAnapi raNe jetuM samarthA iti me matiH
shlokas.8:
avashyaM tu mayA rAja.nstava vAchyaM hitaM sadA |
ashakyAH pANDavA jetuM devairapi savAsavaiH
vAsudevasahAyAshcha mahendrasamavikramAH
shlokas.9:
sarvathAhaM tu rAjendra kariShye vachanaM tava |
pANDavAnvA raNe jeShye mAM vA jeShyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.10:
evamuktvA dadau chAsmai vishalyakaraNIM shubhAm |
oShadhIM vIryasampannAM vishalyashchAbhavattadA
shlokas.11:
tataH prabhAte vimale svenAnIkena vIryavAn |
avyUhata svayaM vyUhaM bhIShmo vyUhavishAradaH
shlokas.12:
maNDalaM manujashreShTha nAnAshastrasamAkulam |
sampUrNaM yodhamukhyaishcha tathA dantipadAtibhiH
shlokas.13:
rathairanekasAhasraiH samantAtparivAritam |
ashvavRRindairmahadbhishcha RRiShTitomaradhAribhiH
shlokas.14:
nAge nAge rathAH sapta sapta chAshvA rathe rathe |
anvashvaM dasha dhAnuShkA dhAnuShke sapta charmiNaH
shlokas.15:
eva.nvyUhaM mahArAja tava sainyaM mahArathaiH |
sthitaM raNAya mahate bhIShmeNa yudhi pAlitam
shlokas.16:
dashAshvAnAM sahasrANi dantinAM cha tathaiva cha |
rathAnAmayutaM chApi putrAshcha tava da.nshitAH
chitrasenAdayaH shUrA abhyarakShanpitAmaham
shlokas.17:
rakShyamANashcha taiH shUrairgopyamAnAshcha tena te |
saMnaddhAH samadRRishyanta rAjAnashcha mahAbalAH
shlokas.18:
duryodhanastu samare da.nshito rathamAsthitaH |
vyabhrAjata shriyA juShTo yathA shakrastriviShTape
shlokas.19:
tataH shabdo mahAnAsItputrANAM tava bhArata |
rathaghoShashcha tumulo vAditrANAM cha nisvanaH
shlokas.20:
bhIShmeNa dhArtarAShTrANAM vyUDhaH pratya~Nmukho yudhi |
maNDalaH sumahAvyUho durbhedyo.amitraghAtinAm
sarvataH shushubhe rAjanraNe.arINAM durAsadaH
shlokas.21:
maNDalaM tu samAlokya vyUhaM paramadAruNam |
svayaM yudhiShThiro rAjA vyUhaM vajramathAkarot
shlokas.22:
tathA vyUDheShvanIkeShu yathAsthAnamavasthitAH |
rathinaH sAdinashchaiva siMhanAdamathAnadan
shlokas.23:
bibhitsavastato vyUhaM niryayuryuddhakA~NkShiNaH |
itaretarataH shUrAH sahasainyAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.24:
bhAradvAjo yayau matsyaM drauNishchApi shikhaNDinam |
svayaM duryodhano rAjA pArShataM samupAdravat
shlokas.25:
nakulaH sahadevashcha rAjanmadreshamIyatuH |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyAvirAvantamabhidrutau
shlokas.26:
sarve nRRipAstu samare dhana~njayamayodhayan |
bhImaseno raNe yatto hArdikyaM samavArayat
shlokas.27:
chitrasenaM vikarNaM cha tathA durmarShaNaM vibho |
ArjuniH samare rAja.nstava putrAnayodhayat
shlokas.28:
prAgjyotiShaM maheShvAsaM haiDimbo rAkShasottamaH |
abhidudrAva vegena matto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.29:
alambusastato rAjansAtyakiM yuddhadurmadam |
sasainyaM samare kruddho rAkShasaH samabhidravat
shlokas.30:
bhUrishravA raNe yatto dhRRiShTaketumayodhayat |
shrutAyuShaM tu rAjAnaM dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.31:
chekitAnastu samare kRRipamevAnvayodhayat |
sheShAH pratiyayuryattA bhImameva mahAratham
shlokas.32:
tato rAjasahasrANi parivavrurdhana~njayam |
shaktitomaranArAchagadAparighapANayaH
shlokas.33:
arjuno.atha bhRRishaM kruddho vArShNeyamidamabravIt |
pashya mAdhava sainyAni dhArtarAShTrasya sa.nyuge
vyUDhAni vyUhaviduShA gA~Ngeyena mahAtmanA
shlokas.34:
yuddhAbhikAmA~nshUrA.nshcha pashya mAdhava da.nshitAn |
trigartarAjaM sahitaM bhrAtRRibhiH pashya keshava
shlokas.35:
adyaitAnpAtayiShyAmi pashyataste janArdana |
ya ime mAM yadushreShTha yoddhukAmA raNAjire
shlokas.36:
evamuktvA tu kaunteyo dhanurjyAmavamRRijya cha |
vavarSha sharavarShANi narAdhipagaNAnprati
shlokas.37:
te.api taM parameShvAsAH sharavarShairapUrayan |
taDAgamiva dhArAbhiryathA prAvRRiShi toyadA
shlokas.38:
hAhAkAro mahAnAsIttava sainye vishAM pate |
ChAdyamAnau bhRRishaM kRRiShNau sharairdRRiShTvA mahAraNe
shlokas.39:
devA devarShayashchaiva gandharvAshcha mahoragAH |
vismayaM paramaM jagmurdRRiShTvA kRRiShNau tathAgatau
shlokas.40:
tataH kruddho.arjuno rAjannaindramastramudIrayat |
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma vijayasya parAkramam
shlokas.41:
shastravRRiShTiM parairmuktAM sharaughairyadavArayat |
na cha tatrApyanirbhinnaH kashchidAsIdvishAM pate
shlokas.42:
teShAM rAjasahasrANAM hayAnAM dantinAM tathA |
dvAbhyAM tribhiH sharaishchAnyAnpArtho vivyAdha mAriSha
shlokas.43:
te hanyamAnAH pArthena bhIShmaM shAntanavaM yayuH |
agAdhe majjamAnAnAM bhIShmastrAtAbhavattadA
shlokas.44:
Apatadbhistu taistatra prabhagnaM tAvakaM balam |
sa~nchukShubhe mahArAja vAtairiva mahArNavaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA pravRRitte sa~NgrAme nivRRitte cha susharmaNi |
prabhagneShu cha vIreShu pANDavena mahAtmanA
shlokas.2:
kShubhyamANe bale tUrNaM sAgarapratime tava |
pratyudyAte cha gA~Ngeye tvaritaM vijayaM prati
shlokas.3:
dRRiShTvA duryodhano rAjanraNe pArthasya vikramam |
tvaramANaH samabhyetya sarvA.nstAnabravInnRRipAn
shlokas.4:
teShAM cha pramukhe shUraM susharmANaM mahAbalam |
madhye sarvasya sainyasya bhRRishaM saMharShayanvachaH
shlokas.5:
eSha bhIShmaH shAntanavo yoddhukAmo dhana~njayam |
sarvAtmanA kurushreShThastyaktvA jIvitamAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
taM prayAntaM parAnIkaM sarvasainyena bhAratam |
sa.nyattAH samare sarve pAlayadhvaM pitAmaham
shlokas.7:
bADhamityevamuktvA tu tAnyanIkAni sarvashaH |
narendrANAM mahArAja samAjagmuH pitAmaham
shlokas.8:
tataH prayAtaH sahasA bhIShmaH shAntanavo.arjunam |
raNe bhAratamAyAntamAsasAda mahAbalam
shlokas.9:
mahAshvetAshvayuktena bhImavAnaraketunA |
mahatA meghanAdena rathenAti virAjata
shlokas.10:
samare sarvasainyAnAmupayAtaM dhana~njayam |
abhavattumulo nAdo bhayAddRRiShTvA kirITinam
shlokas.11:
abhIshuhastaM kRRiShNaM cha dRRiShTvAdityamivAparam |
madhya.ndinagataM sa~Nkhye na shekuH prativIkShitum
shlokas.12:
tathA shAntanavaM bhIShmaM shvetAshvaM shvetakArmukam |
na shekuH pANDavA draShTuM shvetagrahamivoditam
shlokas.13:
sa sarvataH parivRRitastrigartaiH sumahAtmabhiH |
bhrAtRRibhistava putraishcha tathAnyaishcha mahArathaiH
shlokas.14:
bhAradvAjastu samare matsyaM vivyAdha patriNA |
dhvajaM chAsya shareNAjau dhanushchaikena chichChide
shlokas.15:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM virATo vAhinIpatiH |
anyadAdatta vegena dhanurbhArasahaM dRRiDham
sharA.nshchAshIviShAkArA~njvalitAnpannagAniva
shlokas.16:
droNaM tribhiH pravivyAdha chaturbhishchAsya vAjinaH |
dhvajamekena vivyAdha sArathiM chAsya pa~nchabhiH
dhanurekeShuNAvidhyattatrAkrudhyaddvijarShabhaH
shlokas.17:
tasya droNo.avadhIdashvA~nsharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
aShTAbhirbharatashreShTha sUtamekena patriNA
shlokas.18:
sa hatAshvAdavaplutya syandanAddhatasArathiH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM sha~Nkhasya rathinAM varaH
shlokas.19:
tatastu tau pitAputrau bhAradvAjaM rathe sthitau |
mahatA sharavarSheNa vArayAmAsaturbalAt
shlokas.20:
bhAradvAjastataH kruddhaH sharamAshIviShopamam |
chikShepa samare tUrNaM sha~NkhaM prati janeshvara
shlokas.21:
sa tasya hRRidayaM bhittvA pItvA shoNitamAhave |
jagAma dharaNiM bANo lohitArdrIkRRitachChaviH
shlokas.22:
sa papAta rathAttUrNaM bhAradvAjasharAhataH |
dhanustyaktvA sharA.nshchaiva pitureva samIpataH
shlokas.23:
hataM svamAtmajaM dRRiShTvA virATaH prAdravadbhayAt |
utsRRijya samare droNaM vyAttAnanamivAntakam
shlokas.24:
bhAradvAjastatastUrNaM pANDavAnAM mahAchamUm |
dArayAmAsa samare shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.25:
shikhaNDyapi mahArAja drauNimAsAdya sa.nyuge |
AjaghAna bhruvormadhye nArAchaistribhirAshugaiH
shlokas.26:
sa babhau narashArdUlo lalATe sa.nsthitaistribhiH |
shikharaiH kA~nchanamayairmerustribhirivochChritaiH
shlokas.27:
ashvatthAmA tataH kruddho nimeShArdhAchChikhaNDinaH |
sUtaM dhvajamatho rAja.nsturagAnAyudhaM tathA
sharairbahubhiruddishya pAtayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.28:
sa hatAshvAdavaplutya rathAdvai rathinAM varaH |
khaDgamAdAya nishitaM vimalaM cha sharAvaram
shyenavadvyacharatkruddhaH shikhaNDI shatrutApanaH
shlokas.29:
sakhaDgasya mahArAja charatastasya sa.nyuge |
nAntaraM dadRRishe drauNistadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.30:
tataH sharasahasrANi bahUni bharatarShabha |
preShayAmAsa samare drauNiH paramakopanaH
shlokas.31:
tAmApatantIM samare sharavRRiShTiM sudAruNAm |
asinA tIkShNadhAreNa chichCheda balinAM varaH
shlokas.32:
tato.asya vimalaM drauNiH shatachandraM manoramam |
charmAchChinadasiM chAsya khaNDayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shitaiH subahusho rAja.nstaM cha vivyAdha patribhiH
shlokas.33:
shikhaNDI tu tataH khaDgaM khaNDitaM tena sAyakaiH |
Avidhya vyasRRijattUrNaM jvalantamiva pannagam
shlokas.34:
tamApatantaM sahasA kAlAnalasamaprabham |
chichCheda samare drauNirdarshayanpANilAghavam
shikhaNDinaM cha vivyAdha sharairbahubhirAyasaiH
shlokas.35:
shikhaNDI tu bhRRishaM rAja.nstADyamAnaH shitaiH sharaiH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM mAdhavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.36:
sAtyakistu tataH kruddho rAkShasaM krUramAhave |
alambusaM sharairghorairvivyAdha balinaM balI
shlokas.37:
rAkShasendrastatastasya dhanushchichCheda bhArata |
ardhachandreNa samare taM cha vivyAdha sAyakaiH
mAyAM cha rAkShasIM kRRitvA sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.38:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma shaineyasya parAkramam |
nAsambhramadyatsamare vadhyamAnaH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.39:
aindramastraM cha vArShNeyo yojayAmAsa bhArata |
vijayAdyadanuprAptaM mAdhavena yashasvinA
shlokas.40:
tadastraM bhasmasAtkRRitvA mAyAM tAM rAkShasIM tadA |
alambusaM sharairghorairabhyAkirata sarvashaH
parvataM vAridhArAbhiH prAvRRiShIva balAhakaH
shlokas.41:
tattathA pIDitaM tena mAdhavena mahAtmanA |
pradudrAva bhayAdrakSho hitvA sAtyakimAhave
shlokas.42:
tamajeyaM rAkShasendraM sa~Nkhye maghavatA api |
shaineyaH prANadajjitvA yodhAnAM tava pashyatAm
shlokas.43:
nyahanattAvakA.nshchApi sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
nishitairbahubhirbANaiste.adravanta bhayArditAH
shlokas.44:
etasminneva kAle tu drupadasyAtmajo balI |
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja tava putraM janeshvaram
ChAdayAmAsa samare sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.45:
sa~nChAdyamAno vishikhairdhRRiShTadyumnena bhArata |
vivyathe na cha rAjendra tava putro janeshvaraH
shlokas.46:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha samare tUrNaM vivyAdha sAyakaiH |
ShaShTyA cha tri.nshatA chaiva tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.47:
tasya senApatiH kruddho dhanushchichCheda mAriSha |
hayA.nshcha chaturaH shIghraM nijaghAna mahArathaH
sharaishchainaM sunishitaiH kShipraM vivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.48:
sa hatAshvAnmahAbAhuravaplutya rathAdbalI |
padAtirasimudyamya prAdravatpArShataM prati
shlokas.49:
shakunistaM samabhyetya rAjagRRiddhI mahAbalaH |
rAjAnaM sarvalokasya rathamAropayatsvakam
shlokas.50:
tato nRRipaM parAjitya pArShataH paravIrahA |
nyahanattAvakaM sainyaM vajrapANirivAsuram
shlokas.51:
kRRitavarmA raNe bhImaM sharairArChanmahAratham |
prachChAdayAmAsa cha taM mahAmegho raviM yathA
shlokas.52:
tataH prahasya samare bhImasenaH parantapaH |
preShayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaH sAyakAnkRRitavarmaNe
shlokas.53:
tairardyamAno.atirathaH sAtvataH shastrakovidaH |
nAkampata mahArAja bhImaM chArChachChitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.54:
tasyAshvA.nshchaturo hatvA bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
sArathiM pAtayAmAsa dhvajaM cha supariShkRRitam
shlokas.55:
sharairbahuvidhaishchainamAchinotparavIrahA |
shakalIkRRitasarvA~NgaH shvAvidvatsamadRRishyata
shlokas.56:
hatAshvAttu rathAttUrNaM vRRiShakasya rathaM yayau |
syAlasya te mahArAja tava putrasya pashyataH
shlokas.57:
bhImaseno.api sa~Nkruddhastava sainyamupAdravat |
nijaghAna cha sa~Nkruddho daNDapANirivAntakaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bahUnIha vichitrANi dvairathAni sma sa~njaya |
pANDUnAM mAmakaiH sArdhamashrauShaM tava jalpataH
shlokas.2:
na chaiva mAmakaM ka~nchiddhRRiShTaM sha.nsasi sa~njaya |
nityaM pANDusutAnhRRiShTAnabhagnA.nshchaiva sha.nsasi
shlokas.3:
jIyamAnAnvimanaso mAmakAnvigataujasaH |
vadase sa.nyuge sUta diShTametadasa.nshayam
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yathAshakti yathotsAhaM yuddhe cheShTanti tAvakAH |
darshayAnAH paraM shaktyA pauruShaM puruSharShabha
shlokas.5:
ga~NgAyAH suranadyA vai svAdubhUtaM yathodakam |
mahodadhiguNAbhyAsAllavaNatvaM nigachChati
shlokas.6:
tathA tatpauruShaM rAja.nstAvakAnAM mahAtmanAm |
prApya pANDusutAnvIrAnvyarthaM bhavati sa.nyuge
shlokas.7:
ghaTamAnAnyathAshakti kurvANAnkarma duShkaram |
na doSheNa kurushreShTha kauravAngantumarhasi
shlokas.8:
tavAparAdhAtsumahAnsaputrasya vishAM pate |
pRRithivyAH prakShayo ghoro yamarAShTravivardhanaH
shlokas.9:
AtmadoShAtsamutpannaM shochituM nArhase nRRipa |
na hi rakShanti rAjAnaH sarvArthAnnApi jIvitam
shlokas.10:
yuddhe sukRRitinAM lokAnichChanto vasudhAdhipAH |
chamUM vigAhya yudhyante nityaM svargaparAyaNAH
shlokas.11:
pUrvAhNe tu mahArAja prAvartata janakShayaH |
tanmamaikamanA bhUtvA shRRiNu devAsuropamam
shlokas.12:
Avantyau tu maheShvAsau mahAtmAnau mahAbalau |
irAvantamabhiprekShya sameyAtAM raNotkaTau
teShAM pravavRRite yuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.13:
irAvA.nstu susa~Nkruddho bhrAtarau devarUpiNau |
vivyAdha nishitaistUrNaM sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
tAvenaM pratyavidhyetAM samare chitrayodhinau
shlokas.14:
yudhyatAM hi tathA rAjanvisheSho na vyadRRishyata |
yatatAM shatrunAshAya kRRitapratikRRitaiShiNAm
shlokas.15:
irAvA.nstu tato rAjannanuvindasya sAyakaiH |
chaturbhishchaturo vAhAnanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.16:
bhallAbhyAM cha sutIkShNAbhyAM dhanuH ketuM cha mAriSha |
chichCheda samare rAja.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.17:
tyaktvAnuvindo.atha rathaM vindasya rathamAsthitaH |
dhanurgRRihItvA navamaM bhArasAdhanamuttamam
shlokas.18:
tAvekasthau raNe vIrAvAvantyau rathinAM varau |
sharAnmumuchatustUrNamirAvati mahAtmani
shlokas.19:
tAbhyAM muktA mahAvegAH sharAH kA~nchanabhUShaNAH |
divAkarapathaM prApya ChAdayAmAsurambaram
shlokas.20:
irAvA.nstu tataH kruddho bhrAtarau tau mahArathau |
vavarSha sharavarSheNa sArathiM chApyapAtayat
shlokas.21:
tasminnipatite bhUmau gatasattve.atha sArathau |
rathaH pradudrAva dishaH samudbhrAntahayastataH
shlokas.22:
tau sa jitvA mahArAja nAgarAjasutAsutaH |
pauruShaM khyApaya.nstUrNaM vyadhamattava vAhinIm
shlokas.23:
sA vadhyamAnA samare dhArtarAShTrI mahAchamUH |
vegAnbahuvidhA.nshchakre viShaM pItveva mAnavaH
shlokas.24:
haiDimbo rAkShasendrastu bhagadattaM samAdravat |
rathenAdityavarNena sadhvajena mahAbalaH
shlokas.25:
tataH prAgjyotiSho rAjA nAgarAjaM samAsthitaH |
yathA vajradharaH pUrvaM sa~NgrAme tArakAmaye
shlokas.26:
tatra devAH sagandharvA RRiShayashcha samAgatAH |
visheShaM na sma vividurhaiDimbabhagadattayoH
shlokas.27:
yathA surapatiH shakrastrAsayAmAsa dAnavAn |
tathaiva samare rAja.nstrAsayAmAsa pANDavAn
shlokas.28:
tena vidrAvyamANAste pANDavAH sarvatodisham |
trAtAraM nAbhyavindanta sveShvanIkeShu bhArata
shlokas.29:
bhaimaseniM rathasthaM tu tatrApashyAma bhArata |
sheShA vimanaso bhUtvA prAdravanta mahArathAH
shlokas.30:
nivRRitteShu tu pANDUnAM punaH sainyeShu bhArata |
AsInniShTAnako ghorastava sainyeShu sa.nyuge
shlokas.31:
ghaTotkachastato rAjanbhagadattaM mahAraNe |
sharaiH prachChAdayAmAsa meruM girimivAmbudaH
shlokas.32:
nihatya tA~nsharAnrAjA rAkShasasya dhanushchyutAn |
bhaimaseniM raNe tUrNaM sarvamarmasvatADayat
shlokas.33:
sa tADyamAno bahubhiH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
na vivyathe rAkShasendro bhidyamAna ivAchalaH
shlokas.34:
tasya prAgjyotiShaH kruddhastomarAnsa chaturdasha |
preShayAmAsa samare tA.nshcha chichCheda rAkShasaH
shlokas.35:
sa tA.nshChittvA mahAbAhustomarAnnishitaiH sharaiH |
bhagadattaM cha vivyAdha saptatyA ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.36:
tataH prAgjyotiSho rAjanprahasanniva bhArata |
tasyAshvA.nshchaturaH sa~Nkhye pAtayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.37:
sa hatAshve rathe tiShThanrAkShasendraH pratApavAn |
shaktiM chikShepa vegena prAgjyotiShagajaM prati
shlokas.38:
tAmApatantIM sahasA hemadaNDAM suvegitAm |
tridhA chichCheda nRRipatiH sA vyakIryata medinIm
shlokas.39:
shaktiM vinihatAM dRRiShTvA haiDimbaH prAdravadbhayAt |
yathendrasya raNAtpUrvaM namuchirdaityasattamaH
shlokas.40:
taM vijitya raNe shUraM vikrAntaM khyAtapauruSham |
ajeyaM samare rAjanyamena varuNena cha
shlokas.41:
pANDavIM samare senAM saMmamarda saku~njaraH |
yathA vanagajo rAjanmRRidna.nshcharati padminIm
shlokas.42:
madreshvarastu samare yamAbhyAM saha sa~NgataH |
svasrIyau ChAdayAM chakre sharaughaiH pANDunandanau
shlokas.43:
sahadevastu samare mAtulaM vIkShya sa~Ngatam |
avArayachCharaugheNa megho yadvaddivAkaram
shlokas.44:
ChAdyamAnaH sharaugheNa hRRiShTarUpataro.abhavat |
tayoshchApyabhavatprItiratulA mAtRRikAraNAt
shlokas.45:
tataH prahasya samare nakulasya mahArathaH |
ashvAnvai chaturo rAja.nshchaturbhiH sAyakottamaiH
preShayAmAsa samare yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.46:
hatAshvAttu rathAttUrNamavaplutya mahArathaH |
Aruroha tato yAnaM bhrAtureva yashasvinaH
shlokas.47:
ekasthau tu raNe shUrau dRRiDhe vikShipya kArmuke |
madrarAjarathaM kruddhau ChAdayAmAsatuH kShaNAt
shlokas.48:
sa chChAdyamAno bahubhiH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
svasrIyAbhyAM naravyAghro nAkampata yathAchalaH
prahasanniva tAM chApi sharavRRiShTiM jaghAna ha
shlokas.49:
sahadevastataH kruddhaH sharamudyamya vIryavAn |
madrarAjamabhiprekShya preShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.50:
sa sharaH preShitastena garutmAniva vegavAn |
madrarAjaM vinirbhidya nipapAta mahItale
shlokas.51:
sa gADhaviddho vyathito rathopasthe mahArathaH |
niShasAda mahArAja kashmalaM cha jagAma ha
shlokas.52:
taM visa~nj~naM nipatitaM sUtaH samprekShya sa.nyuge |
apovAha rathenAjau yamAbhyAmabhipIDitam
shlokas.53:
dRRiShTvA madreshvararathaM dhArtarAShTrAH parA~Nmukham |
sarve vimanaso bhUtvA nedamastItyachintayan
shlokas.54:
nirjitya mAtulaM sa~Nkhye mAdrIputrau mahArathau |
dadhmaturmuditau sha~Nkhau siMhanAdaM vinedatuH
shlokas.55:
abhidudruvaturhRRiShTau tava sainyaM vishAM pate |
yathA daityachamUM rAjannindropendrAvivAmarau

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA madhyaM prApte divAkare |
shrutAyuShamabhiprekShya chodayAmAsa vAjinaH
shlokas.2:
abhyadhAvattato rAjA shrutAyuShamari.ndamam |
vinighnansAyakaistIkShNairnavabhirnataparvabhiH
shlokas.3:
sa sa.nvArya raNe rAjA preShitAndharmasUnunA |
sharAnsapta maheShvAsaH kaunteyAya samarpayat
shlokas.4:
te tasya kavachaM bhittvA papuH shoNitamAhave |
asUniva vichinvanto dehe tasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.5:
pANDavastu bhRRishaM viddhastena rAj~nA mahAtmanA |
raNe varAhakarNena rAjAnaM hRRidi vivyadhe
shlokas.6:
athApareNa bhallena ketuM tasya mahAtmanaH |
rathashreShTho rathAttUrNaM bhUmau pArtho nyapAtayat
shlokas.7:
ketuM nipatitaM dRRiShTvA shrutAyuH sa tu pArthivaH |
pANDavaM vishikhaistIkShNai rAjanvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.8:
tataH krodhAtprajajvAla dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
yathA yugAnte bhUtAni dhakShyanniva hutAshanaH
shlokas.9:
kruddhaM tu pANDavaM dRRiShTvA devagandharvarAkShasAH |
pravivyathurmahArAja vyAkulaM chApyabhUjjagat
shlokas.10:
sarveShAM chaiva bhUtAnAmidamAsInmanogatam |
trI.NllokAnadya sa~Nkruddho nRRipo.ayaM dhakShyatIti vai
shlokas.11:
RRiShayashchaiva devAshcha chakruH svastyayanaM mahat |
lokAnAM nRRipa shAntyarthaM krodhite pANDave tadA
shlokas.12:
sa cha krodhasamAviShTaH sRRikkiNI parilelihan |
dadhArAtmavapurghoraM yugAntAdityasaMnibham
shlokas.13:
tataH sarvANi sainyAni tAvakAni vishAM pate |
nirAshAnyabhava.nstatra jIvitaM prati bhArata
shlokas.14:
sa tu dhairyeNa taM kopaM saMnivArya mahAyashAH |
shrutAyuShaH prachichCheda muShTideshe mahaddhanuH
shlokas.15:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM nArAchena stanAntare |
nirbibheda raNe rAjA sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.16:
satvaraM charaNe rAja.nstasya vAhAnmahAtmanaH |
nijaghAna sharaiH kShipraM sUtaM cha sumahAbalaH
shlokas.17:
hatAshvaM tu rathaM tyaktvA dRRiShTvA rAj~nastu pauruSham |
vipradudrAva vegena shrutAyuH samare tadA
shlokas.18:
tasmi~njite maheShvAse dharmaputreNa sa.nyuge |
duryodhanabalaM rAjansarvamAsItparA~Nmukham
shlokas.19:
etatkRRitvA mahArAja dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
vyAttAnano yathA kAlastava sainyaM jaghAna ha
shlokas.20:
chekitAnastu vArShNeyo gautamaM rathinAM varam |
prekShatAM sarvasainyAnAM ChAdayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.21:
saMnivArya sharA.nstA.nstu kRRipaH shAradvato yudhi |
chekitAnaM raNe yattaM rAjanvivyAdha patribhiH
shlokas.22:
athApareNa bhallena dhanushchichCheda mAriSha |
sArathiM chAsya samare kShiprahasto nyapAtayat
hayA.nshchAsyAvadhIdrAjannubhau cha pArShNisArathI
shlokas.23:
so.avaplutya rathAttUrNaM gadAM jagrAha sAtvataH |
sa tayA vIraghAtinyA gadayA gadinAM varaH
gautamasya hayAnhatvA sArathiM cha nyapAtayat
shlokas.24:
bhUmiShTho gautamastasya sharA.nshchikShepa ShoDasha |
te sharAH sAtvataM bhittvA prAvishanta dharAtalam
shlokas.25:
chekitAnastataH kruddhaH punashchikShepa tAM gadAm |
gautamasya vadhAkA~NkShI vRRitrasyeva pura.ndaraH
shlokas.26:
tAmApatantIM vimalAmashmagarbhAM mahAgadAm |
sharairanekasAhasrairvArayAmAsa gautamaH
shlokas.27:
chekitAnastataH khaDgaM koshAduddhRRitya bhArata |
lAghavaM paramAsthAya gautamaM samupAdravat
shlokas.28:
gautamo.api dhanustyaktvA pragRRihyAsiM susa.nshitam |
vegena mahatA rAja.nshchekitAnamupAdravat
shlokas.29:
tAvubhau balasampannau nistri.nshavaradhAriNau |
nistri.nshAbhyAM sutIkShNAbhyAmanyonyaM santatakShatuH
shlokas.30:
nistri.nshavegAbhihatau tatastau puruSharShabhau |
dharaNIM samanuprAptau sarvabhUtaniShevitAm
mUrChayAbhiparItA~Ngau vyAyAmena cha mohitau
shlokas.31:
tato.abhyadhAvadvegena karakarShaH suhRRittayA |
chekitAnaM tathAbhUtaM dRRiShTvA samaradurmadam
rathamAropayachchainaM sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.32:
tathaiva shakuniH shUraH syAlastava vishAM pate |
AropayadrathaM tUrNaM gautamaM rathinAM varam
shlokas.33:
saumadattiM tathA kruddho dhRRiShTaketurmahAbalaH |
navatyA sAyakaiH kShipraM rAjanvivyAdha vakShasi
shlokas.34:
saumadattiruraHsthaistairbhRRishaM bANairashobhata |
madhya.ndine mahArAja rashmibhistapano yathA
shlokas.35:
bhUrishravAstu samare dhRRiShTaketuM mahAratham |
hatasUtahayaM chakre virathaM sAyakottamaiH
shlokas.36:
virathaM chainamAlokya hatAshvaM hatasArathim |
mahatA sharavarSheNa ChAdayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.37:
sa cha taM rathamutsRRijya dhRRiShTaketurmahAmanAH |
Aruroha tato yAnaM shatAnIkasya mAriSha
shlokas.38:
chitraseno vikarNashcha rAjandurmarShaNastathA |
rathino hemasaMnAhAH saubhadramabhidudruvuH
shlokas.39:
abhimanyostatastaistu ghoraM yuddhamavartata |
sharIrasya yathA rAjanvAtapittakaphaistribhiH
shlokas.40:
virathA.nstava putrA.nstu kRRitvA rAjanmahAhave |
na jaghAna naravyAghraH smaranbhImavachastadA
shlokas.41:
tato rAj~nAM bahushatairgajAshvarathayAyibhiH |
sa.nvRRitaM samare bhIShmaM devairapi durAsadam
shlokas.42:
prayAntaM shIghramudvIkShya paritrAtuM sutA.nstava |
abhimanyuM samuddishya bAlamekaM mahAratham
vAsudevamuvAchedaM kaunteyaH shvetavAhanaH
shlokas.43:
chodayAshvAnhRRiShIkesha yatraite bahulA rathAH |
ete hi bahavaH shUrAH kRRitAstrA yuddhadurmadAH
yathA na hanyurnaH senAM tathA mAdhava chodaya
shlokas.44:
evamuktaH sa vArShNeyaH kaunteyenAmitaujasA |
rathaM shvetahayairyuktaM preShayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.45:
niShTAnako mahAnAsIttava sainyasya mAriSha |
yadarjuno raNe kruddhaH sa.nyAtastAvakAnprati
shlokas.46:
samAsAdya tu kaunteyo rAj~nastAnbhIShmarakShiNaH |
susharmANamatho rAjannidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.47:
jAnAmi tvAM yudhi shreShThamatyantaM pUrvavairiNam |
paryAyasyAdya samprAptaM phalaM pashya sudAruNam
adya te darshayiShyAmi pUrvapretAnpitAmahAn
shlokas.48:
evaM sa~njalpatastasya bIbhatsoH shatrughAtinaH |
shrutvApi paruShaM vAkyaM susharmA rathayUthapaH
na chainamabravItki~nchichChubhaM vA yadi vAshubham
shlokas.49:
abhi gatvArjunaM vIraM rAjabhirbahubhirvRRitaH |
purastAtpRRiShThatashchaiva pArshvatashchaiva sarvataH
shlokas.50:
parivAryArjunaM sa~Nkhye tava putraiH sahAnagha |
sharaiH sa~nChAdayAmAsa meghairiva divAkaram
shlokas.51:
tataH pravRRittaH sumahAnsa~NgrAmaH shoNitodakaH |
tAvakAnAM cha samare pANDavAnAM cha bhArata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa tudyamAnastu sharairdhana~njayaH; padA hato nAga iva shvasanbalI |
bANena bANena mahArathAnAM; chichCheda chApAni raNe prasahya
shlokas.2:
sa~nChidya chApAni cha tAni rAj~nAM; teShAM raNe vIryavatAM kShaNena |
vivyAdha bANairyugapanmahAtmA; niHsheShatAM teShvatha manyamAnaH
shlokas.3:
nipeturAjau rudhirapradigdhA;ste tADitAH shakrasutena rAjan |
vibhinnagAtrAH patitottamA~NgA; gatAsavashChinnatanutrakAyAH
shlokas.4:
mahIM gatAH pArthabalAbhibhUtA; vichitrarUpA yugapadvineshuH |
dRRiShTvA hatA.nstAnyudhi rAjaputrAM;strigartarAjaH prayayau kShaNena
shlokas.5:
teShAM rathAnAmatha pRRiShThagopA; dvAtri.nshadanye.abyapatanta pArtham |
tathaiva te samparivArya pArthaM; vikRRiShya chApAni mahAravANi
avIvRRiShanbANamahaughavRRiShTyA; yathA giriM toyadharA jalaughaiH
shlokas.6:
sampIDyamAnastu sharaughavRRiShTyA; dhana~njayastAnyudhi jAtaroShaH |
ShaShTyA sharaiH sa.nyati tailadhautai;rjaghAna tAnapyatha pRRiShThagopAn
shlokas.7:
ShaShTiM rathA.nstAnavajitya sa~Nkhye; dhana~njayaH prItamanA yashasvI |
athAtvaradbhIShmavadhAya jiShNu;rbalAni rAj~nAM samare nihatya
shlokas.8:
trigartarAjo nihatAnsamIkShya; mahArathA.nstAnatha bandhuvargAn |
raNe puraskRRitya narAdhipA.nstA;~njagAma pArthaM tvarito vadhAya
shlokas.9:
abhidrutaM chAstrabhRRitAM variShThaM; dhana~njayaM vIkShya shikhaNDimukhyAH |
abhyudyayuste shitashastrahastA; rirakShiShanto rathamarjunasya
shlokas.10:
pArtho.api tAnApatataH samIkShya; trigartarAj~nA sahitAnnRRivIrAn |
vidhva.nsayitvA samare dhanuShmA;ngANDIvamuktairnishitaiH pRRiShatkaiH
bhIShmaM yiyAsuryudhi sa.ndadarsha; duryodhanaM saindhavAdI.nshcha rAj~naH
shlokas.11:
AvArayiShNUnabhisamprayAya; muhUrtamAyodhya balena vIraH |
utsRRijya rAjAnamanantavIryo; jayadrathAdI.nshcha nRRipAnmahaujAH
yayau tato bhImabalo manasvI; gA~NgeyamAjau sharachApapANiH
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThirashchograbalo mahAtmA; samAyayau tvarito jAtakopaH |
madrAdhipaM samabhityajya sa~Nkhye; svabhAgamAptaM tamanantakIrtiH
sArdhaM sa mAdrIsutabhImasenai;rbhIShmaM yayau shAntanavaM raNAya
shlokas.13:
taiH samprayuktaH sa mahArathAgryai;rga~NgAsutaH samare chitrayodhI |
na vivyathe shAntanavo mahAtmA; samAgataiH pANDusutaiH samastaiH
shlokas.14:
athaitya rAjA yudhi satyasandho; jayadratho.atyugrabalo manasvI |
chichCheda chApAni mahArathAnAM; prasahya teShAM dhanuShA vareNa
shlokas.15:
yudhiShThiraM bhImasenaM yamau cha; pArthaM tathA yudhi sa~njAtakopaH |
duryodhanaH krodhaviSho mahAtmA; jaghAna bANairanalaprakAshaiH
shlokas.16:
kRRipeNa shalyena shalena chaiva; tathA vibho chitrasenena chAjau |
viddhAH sharaiste.ativivRRiddhakopai;rdevA yathA daityagaNaiH sametaiH
shlokas.17:
ChinnAyudhaM shAntanavena rAjA; shikhaNDinaM prekShya cha jAtakopaH |
ajAtashatruH samare mahAtmA; shikhaNDinaM kruddha uvAcha vAkyam
shlokas.18:
uktvA tathA tvaM pituragrato mA;mahaM haniShyAmi mahAvrataM tam |
bhIShmaM sharaughairvimalArkavarNaiH; satyaM vadAmIti kRRitA pratij~nA
shlokas.19:
tvayA na chainAM saphalAM karoShi; devavrataM yanna niha.nsi yuddhe |
mithyApratij~no bhava mA nRRivIra; rakShasva dharmaM cha kulaM yashashcha
shlokas.20:
prekShasva bhIShmaM yudhi bhImavegaM; sarvA.nstapantaM mama sainyasa~NghAn |
sharaughajAlairatitigmatejaiH; kAlaM yathA mRRityukRRitaM kShaNena
shlokas.21:
nikRRittachApaH samarAnapekShaH; parAjitaH shAntanavena rAj~nA |
vihAya bandhUnatha sodarA.nshcha; kva yAsyase nAnurUpaM tavedam
shlokas.22:
dRRiShTvA hi bhIShmaM tamanantavIryaM; bhagnaM cha sainyaM dravamANamevam |
bhIto.asi nUnaM drupadasya putra; tathA hi te mukhavarNo.aprahRRiShTaH
shlokas.23:
Aj~nAyamAne.api dhana~njayena; mahAhave samprasakte nRRivIra |
kathaM hi bhIShmAtprathitaH pRRithivyAM; bhayaM tvamadya prakaroShi vIra
shlokas.24:
sa dharmarAjasya vacho nishamya; rUkShAkSharaM vipralApAnubaddham |
pratyAdeshaM manyamAno mahAtmA; pratatvare bhIShmavadhAya rAjan
shlokas.25:
tamApatantaM mahatA javena; shikhaNDinaM bhIShmamabhidravantam |
AvArayAmAsa hi shalya enaM; shastreNa ghoreNa sudurjayena
shlokas.26:
sa chApi dRRiShTvA samudIryamANa;mastraM yugAntAgnisamaprabhAvam |
nAsau vyamuhyaddrupadasya putro; rAjanmahendrapratimaprabhAvaH
shlokas.27:
tasthau cha tatraiva mahAdhanuShmA;~nsharaistadastraM pratibAdhamAnaH |
athAdade vAruNamanyadastraM; shikhaNDyathograM pratighAtAya tasya
tadastramastreNa vidAryamANaM; khasthAH surA dadRRishuH pArthivAshcha
shlokas.28:
bhIShmastu rAjansamare mahAtmA; dhanuH suchitraM dhvajameva chApi |
ChittvAnadatpANDusutasya vIro; yudhiShThirasyAjamIDhasya rAj~naH
shlokas.29:
tataH samutsRRijya dhanuH sabANaM; yudhiShThiraM vIkShya bhayAbhibhUtam |
gadAM pragRRihyAbhipapAta sa~Nkhye; jayadrathaM bhImasenaH padAtiH
shlokas.30:
tamApatantaM mahatA javena; jayadrathaH sagadaM bhImasenam |
vivyAdha ghorairyamadaNDakalpaiH; shitaiH sharaiH pa~nchashataiH samantAt
shlokas.31:
achintayitvA sa sharA.nstarasvI; vRRikodaraH krodhaparItachetAH |
jaghAna vAhAnsamare samastA;nAraTTajAnsindhurAjasya sa~Nkhye
shlokas.32:
tato.abhivIkShyApratimaprabhAva;stavAtmajastvaramANo rathena |
abhyAyayau bhImasenaM nihantuM; samudyatAstraH surarAjakalpaH
shlokas.33:
bhImo.apyathainaM sahasA vinadya; pratyudyayau gadayA tarjamAnaH |
samudyatAM tAM yamadaNDakalpAM; dRRiShTvA gadAM te kuravaH samantAt
shlokas.34:
vihAya sarve tava putramugraM; pAtaM gadAyAH parihartukAmAH |
apakrAntAstumule sa.nvimarde; sudAruNe bhArata mohanIye
shlokas.35:
amUDhachetAstvatha chitraseno; mahAgadAmApatantIM nirIkShya |
rathaM samutsRRijya padAtirAjau; pragRRihya khaDgaM vimalaM cha charma
avaplutaH siMha ivAchalAgrA;jjagAma chAnyaM bhuvi bhUmidesham
shlokas.36:
gadApi sA prApya rathaM suchitraM; sAshvaM sasUtaM vinihatya sa~Nkhye |
jagAma bhUmiM jvalitA maholkA; bhraShTAmbarAdgAmiva sampatantI
shlokas.37:
AshcharyabhUtaM sumahattvadIyA; dRRiShTvaiva tadbhArata samprahRRiShTAH |
sarve vineduH sahitAH samantA;tpupUjire tava putraM sasainyAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
virathaM taM samAsAdya chitrasenaM manasvinam |
rathamAropayAmAsa vikarNastanayastava
shlokas.2:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne tumule sa~Nkule bhRRisham |
bhIShmaH shAntanavastUrNaM yudhiShThiramupAdravat
shlokas.3:
tataH sarathanAgAshvAH samakampanta sRRi~njayAH |
mRRityorAsyamanuprAptaM menire cha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.4:
yidhiShThiro.api kauravyo yamAbhyAM sahitaH prabhuH |
maheShvAsaM naravyAghraM bhIShmaM shAntanavaM yayau
shlokas.5:
tataH sharasahasrANi pramu~nchanpANDavo yudhi |
bhIShmaM sa~nChAdayAmAsa yathA megho divAkaram
shlokas.6:
tena samyakpraNItAni sharajAlAni bhArata |
patijagrAha gA~NgeyaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.7:
tathaiva sharajAlAni bhIShmeNAstAni mAriSha |
AkAshe samadRRishyanta khagamAnAM vrajA iva
shlokas.8:
nimeShArdhAchcha kaunteyaM bhIShmaH shAntanavo yudhi |
adRRishyaM samare chakre sharajAlena bhAgashaH
shlokas.9:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA kauravyasya mahAtmanaH |
nArAchaM preShayAmAsa kruddha AshIviShopamam
shlokas.10:
asamprAptaM tatastaM tu kShurapreNa mahArathaH |
chichCheda samare rAjanbhIShmastasya dhanushchyutam
shlokas.11:
taM tu ChittvA raNe bhIShmo nArAchaM kAlasaMmitam |
nijaghne kauravendrasya hayAnkA~nchanabhUShaNAn
shlokas.12:
hatAshvaM tu rathaM tyaktvA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM nakulasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
yamAvapi susa~NkruddhaH samAsAdya raNe tadA |
sharaiH sa~nChAdayAmAsa bhIShmaH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.14:
tau tu dRRiShTvA mahArAja bhIShmabANaprapIDitau |
jagAmAtha parAM chintAM bhIShmasya vadhakA~NkShayA
shlokas.15:
tato yudhiShThiro vashyAnrAj~nastAnsamachodayat |
bhIShmaM shAntanavaM sarve nihateti suhRRidgaNAn
shlokas.16:
tataste pArthivAH sarve shrutvA pArthasya bhAShitam |
mahatA rathava.nshena parivavruH pitAmaham
shlokas.17:
sa samantAtparivRRitaH pitA devavratastava |
chikrIda dhanuShA rAjanpAtayAno mahArathAn
shlokas.18:
taM charantaM raNe pArthA dadRRishuH kauravaM yudhi |
mRRigamadhyaM pravishyeva yathA siMhashishuM vane
shlokas.19:
tarjayAnaM raNe shUrA.nstrAsayAnaM cha sAyakaiH |
dRRiShTvA tresurmahArAja siMhaM mRRigagaNA iva
shlokas.20:
raNe bharatasiMhasya dadRRishuH kShatriyA gatim |
agnervAyusahAyasya yathA kakShaM didhakShataH
shlokas.21:
shirA.nsi rathinAM bhIShmaH pAtayAmAsa sa.nyuge |
tAlebhya iva pakvAni phalAni kushalo naraH
shlokas.22:
patadbhishcha mahArAja shirobhirdharaNItale |
babhUva tumulaH shabdaH patatAmashmanAmiva
shlokas.23:
tasmi.nstu tumule yuddhe vartamAne sudAruNe |
sarveShAmeva sainyAnAmAsIdvyatikaro mahAn
shlokas.24:
bhinneShu teShu vyUheShu kShatriyA itaretaram |
ekamekaM samAhUya yuddhAyaivopatasthire
shlokas.25:
shikhaNDI tu samAsAdya bharatAnAM pitAmaham |
abhidudrAva vegena tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.26:
anAdRRitya tato bhIShmastaM shikhaNDinamAhave |
prayayau sRRi~njayAnkruddhaH strItvaM chintya shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.27:
sRRi~njayAstu tato hRRiShTA dRRiShTvA bhIShmaM mahAratham |
siMhanAdAnbahuvidhA.nshchakruH sha~NkhavimishritAn
shlokas.28:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM vyatiShaktarathadvipam |
aparAM dishamAsthAya sthite savitari prabho
shlokas.29:
dhRRiShTadyumno.atha pA~nchAlyaH sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
pIDayantau bhRRishaM sainyaM shaktitomaravRRiShTibhiH
shastraishcha bahubhI rAja~njaghnatustAvakAnraNe
shlokas.30:
te hanyamAnAH samare tAvakAH puruSharShabha |
AryAM yuddhe matiM kRRitvA na tyajanti sma sa.nyugam
yathotsAhaM cha samare jaghnurlokaM mahArathAH
shlokas.31:
tatrAkrando mahAnAsIttAvakAnAM mahAtmanAm |
vadhyatAM samare rAjanpArShatena mahAtmanA
shlokas.32:
taM shrutvA ninadaM ghoraM tAvakAnAM mahArathau |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau pArShataM patyupasthitau
shlokas.33:
tau tasya turagAnhatvA tvaramANau mahArathau |
ChAdayAmAsaturubhau sharavarSheNa pArShatam
shlokas.34:
avaplutyAtha pA~nchAlyo rathAttUrNaM mahAbalaH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM sAtyakeH sumahAtmanaH
shlokas.35:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA mahatyA senayA vRRitaH |
Avantyau samare kruddhAvabhyayAtsa parantapau
shlokas.36:
tathaiva tava putro.api sarvodyogena mAriSha |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau parivAryopatasthivAn
shlokas.37:
arjunashchApi sa~NkruddhaH kShatriyAnkShatriyarShabha |
ayodhayata sa~NgrAme vajrapANirivAsurAn
shlokas.38:
droNashcha samare kruddhaH putrasya priyakRRittava |
vyadhamatsarvapA~nchAlA.nstUlarAshimivAnalaH
shlokas.39:
duryodhanapurogAstu putrAstava vishAM pate |
parivArya raNe bhIShmaM yuyudhuH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.40:
tato duryodhano rAjA lohitAyati bhAskare |
abravIttAvakAnsarvA.nstvaradhvamiti bhArata
shlokas.41:
yudhyatAM tu tathA teShAM kurvatAM karma duShkaram |
astaM girimathArUDhe naprakAshati bhAskare
shlokas.42:
prAvartata nadI ghorA shoNitaughatara~NgiNI |
gomAyugaNasa~NkIrNA kShaNena rajanImukhe
shlokas.43:
shivAbhirashivAbhishcha ruvadbhirbhairavaM ravam |
ghoramAyodhanaM jaj~ne bhUtasa~NghasamAkulam
shlokas.44:
rAkShasAshcha pishAchAshcha tathAnye pishitAshanAH |
samantato vyadRRishyanta shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.45:
arjuno.atha susharmAdInrAj~nastAnsapadAnugAn |
vijitya pRRitanAmadhye yayau svashibiraM prati
shlokas.46:
yudhiShThiro.api kauravyo bhrAtRRibhyAM sahitastadA |
yayau svashibiraM rAjA nishAyAM senayA vRRitaH
shlokas.47:
bhImaseno.api rAjendra duryodhanamukhAnrathAn |
avajitya tataH sa~Nkhye yayau svashibiraM prati
shlokas.48:
duryodhano.api nRRipatiH parivArya mahAraNe |
bhIShmaM shAntanavaM tUrNaM prayAtaH shibiraM prati
shlokas.49:
droNo drauNiH kRRipaH shalyaH kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
parivArya chamUM sarvAM prayayuH shibiraM prati
shlokas.50:
tathaiva sAtyakI rAjandhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
parivArya raNe yodhAnyayatuH shibiraM prati
shlokas.51:
evamete mahArAja tAvakAH pANDavaiH saha |
paryavartanta sahitA nishAkAle parantapAH
shlokas.52:
tataH svashibiraM gatvA pANDavAH kuravastathA |
nyavishanta mahArAja pUjayantaH parasparam
shlokas.53:
rakShAM kRRitvAtmanaH shUrA nyasya gulmAnyathAvidhi |
