apanIya cha shalyA.nste snAtvA cha vividhairjalaiH
shlokas.54:
kRRitasvastyayanAH sarve sa.nstUyantashcha bandibhiH |
gItavAditrashabdena vyakrIDanta yashasvinaH
shlokas.55:
muhUrtamiva tatsarvamabhavatsvargasaMnibham |
na hi yuddhakathAM kA~nchittatra chakrurmahArathAH
shlokas.56:
te prasupte bale tatra parishrAntajane nRRipa |
hastyashvabahule rAjanprekShaNIye babhUvatuH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pariNAmya nishAM tAM tu sukhasuptA janeshvarAH |
kuravaH pANDavAshchaiva punaryuddhAya niryayuH
shlokas.2:
tataH shabdo mahAnAsItsenayorubhayorapi |
nirgachChamAnayoH sa~Nkhye sAgarapratimo mahAn
shlokas.3:
tato duryodhano rAjA chitraseno vivi.nshatiH |
bhIShmashcha rathinAM shreShTho bhAradvAjashcha vai dvijaH
shlokas.4:
ekIbhUtAH susa.nyattAH kauravANAM mahAchamUH |
vyUhAya vidadhU rAjanpANDavAnprati da.nshitAH
shlokas.5:
bhIShmaH kRRitvA mahAvyUhaM pitA tava vishAM pate |
sAgarapratimaM ghoraM vAhanormitara~NgiNam
shlokas.6:
agrataH sarvasainyAnAM bhIShmaH shAntanavo yayau |
mAlavairdAkShiNAtyaishcha Avantyaishcha samanvitaH
shlokas.7:
tato.anantaramevAsIdbhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
pulindaiH pAradaishchaiva tathA kShudrakamAlavaiH
shlokas.8:
droNAdanantaraM yatto bhagadattaH pratApavAn |
mAgadhaishcha kali~Ngaishcha pishAchaishcha vishAM pate
shlokas.9:
prAgjyotiShAdanu nRRipaH kausalyo.atha bRRihadbalaH |
mekalaistraipuraishchaiva chichChilaishcha samanvitaH
shlokas.10:
bRRihadbalAttataH shUrastrigartaH prasthalAdhipaH |
kAmbojairbahubhiH sArdhaM yavanaishcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.11:
drauNistu rabhasaH shUrastrigartAdanu bhArata |
prayayau siMhanAdena nAdayAno dharAtalam
shlokas.12:
tathA sarveNa sainyena rAjA duryodhanastadA |
drauNeranantaraM prAyAtsodaryaiH parivAritaH
shlokas.13:
duryodhanAdanu kRRipastataH shAradvato yayau |
evameSha mahAvyUhaH prayayau sAgaropamaH
shlokas.14:
rejustatra patAkAshcha shvetachChatrANi chAbhibho |
a~NgadAnyatha chitrANi mahArhANi dhanUMShi cha
shlokas.15:
taM tu dRRiShTvA mahAvyUhaM tAvakAnAM mahArathaH |
yudhiShThiro.abravIttUrNaM pArShataM pRRitanApatim
shlokas.16:
pashya vyUhaM maheShvAsa nirmitaM sAgaropamam |
prativyUhaM tvamapi hi kuru pArShata mAchiram
shlokas.17:
tataH sa pArShataH shUro vyUhaM chakre sudAruNam |
shRRi~NgATakaM mahArAja paravyUhavinAshanam
shlokas.18:
shRRi~Ngebhyo bhImasenashcha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
rathairanekasAhasraistathA hayapadAtibhiH
shlokas.19:
nAbhyAmabhUnnarashreShThaH shvetAshvo vAnaradhvajaH |
madhye yudhiShThiro rAjA mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.20:
athetare maheShvAsAH sahasainyA narAdhipAH |
vyUhaM taM pUrayAmAsurvyUhashAstravishAradAH
shlokas.21:
abhimanyustataH pashchAdvirATashcha mahArathaH |
draupadeyAshcha saMhRRiShTA rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.22:
evametaM mahAvyUhaM vyUhya bhArata pANDavAH |
atiShThansamare shUrA yoddhukAmA jayaiShiNaH
shlokas.23:
bherIshabdAshcha tumulA vimishrAH sha~NkhanisvanaiH |
kShveDitAsphoTitotkruShTaiH subhImAH sarvatodisham
shlokas.24:
tataH shUrAH samAsAdya samare te parasparam |
netrairanimiShai rAjannavaikShanta prakopitAH
shlokas.25:
manobhiste manuShyendra pUrvaM yodhAH parasparam |
yuddhAya samavartanta samAhUyetaretaram
shlokas.26:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAvaham |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha nighnatAmitaretaram
shlokas.27:
nArAchA nishitAH sa~Nkhye sampatanti sma bhArata |
vyAttAnanA bhayakarA uragA iva sa~NghashaH
shlokas.28:
niShpeturvimalAH shaktyastailadhautAH sutejanAH |
ambudebhyo yathA rAjanbhrAjamAnAH shatahradAH
shlokas.29:
gadAshcha vimalaiH paTTaiH pinaddhAH svarNabhUShitAH |
patantyastatra dRRishyante girishRRi~NgopamAH shubhAH
nistri.nshAshcha vyarAjanta vimalAmbarasaMnibhAH
shlokas.30:
ArShabhANi cha charmANi shatachandrANi bhArata |
ashobhanta raNe rAjanpatamAnAni sarvashaH
shlokas.31:
te.anyonyaM samare sene yudhyamAne narAdhipa |
ashobhetAM yathA daityadevasene samudyate
abhyadravanta samare te.anyonyaM vai samantataH
shlokas.32:
rathAstu rathibhistUrNaM preShitAH paramAhave |
yugairyugAni sa.nshliShya yuyudhuH pArthivarShabhAH
shlokas.33:
dantinAM yudhyamAnAnAM sa~NgharShAtpAvako.abhavat |
danteShu bharatashreShTha sadhUmaH sarvatodisham
shlokas.34:
prAsairabhihatAH kechidgajayodhAH samantataH |
patamAnAH sma dRRishyante girishRRi~NgAnnagA iva
shlokas.35:
pAdAtAshchApyadRRishyanta nighnanto hi parasparam |
chitrarUpadharAH shUrA nakharaprAsayodhinaH
shlokas.36:
anyonyaM te samAsAdya kurupANDavasainikAH |
shastrairnAnAvidhairghorai raNe ninyuryamakShayam
shlokas.37:
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmo rathaghoSheNa nAdayan |
abhyAgamadraNe pANDUndhanuHshabdena mohayan
shlokas.38:
pANDavAnAM rathAshchApi nadanto bhairavasvanam |
abhyadravanta sa.nyattA dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH
shlokas.39:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tava teShAM cha bhArata |
narAshvarathanAgAnAM vyatiShaktaM parasparam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhIShmaM tu samare kruddhaM pratapantaM samantataH |
na shekuH pANDavA draShTuM tapantamiva bhAskaram
shlokas.2:
tataH sarvANi sainyAni dharmaputrasya shAsanAt |
abhyadravanta gA~NgeyaM mardayantaM shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.3:
sa tu bhIShmo raNashlAghI somakAnsahasRRi~njayAn |
pA~nchAlA.nshcha maheShvAsAnpAtayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.4:
te vadhyamAnA bhIShmeNa pA~nchAlAH somakaiH saha |
bhIShmamevAbhyayustUrNaM tyaktvA mRRityukRRitaM bhayam
shlokas.5:
sa teShAM rathinAM vIro bhIShmaH shAntanavo yudhi |
chichCheda sahasA rAjanbAhUnatha shirA.nsi cha
shlokas.6:
virathAnrathinashchakre pitA devavratastava |
patitAnyuttamA~NgAni hayebhyo hayasAdinAm
shlokas.7:
nirmanuShyA.nshcha mAta~NgA~nshayAnAnparvatopamAn |
apashyAma mahArAja bhIShmAstreNa pramohitAn
shlokas.8:
na tatrAsItpumAnkashchitpANDavAnAM vishAM pate |
anyatra rathinAM shreShThAdbhImasenAnmahAbalAt
shlokas.9:
sa hi bhIShmaM samAsAdya tADayAmAsa sa.nyuge |
tato niShTAnako ghoro bhIShmabhImasamAgame
shlokas.10:
babhUva sarvasainyAnAM ghorarUpo bhayAnakaH |
tathaiva pANDavA hRRiShTAH siMhanAdamathAnadan
shlokas.11:
tato duryodhano rAjA sodaryaiH parivAritaH |
bhIShmaM jugopa samare vartamAne janakShaye
shlokas.12:
bhImastu sArathiM hatvA bhIShmasya rathinAM varaH |
vidrutAshve rathe tasmindravamANe samantataH
sunAbhasya shareNAshu shirashchichCheda chArihA
shlokas.13:
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena sa hato nyapatadbhuvi |
hate tasminmahArAja tava putre mahArathe
nAmRRiShyanta raNe shUrAH sodaryAH sapta sa.nyuge
shlokas.14:
AdityaketurbahvAshI kuNDadhAro mahodaraH |
aparAjitaH paNDitako vishAlAkShaH sudurjayaH
shlokas.15:
pANDavaM chitrasaMnAhA vichitrakavachadhvajAH |
abhyadravanta sa~NgrAme yoddhukAmArimardanAH
shlokas.16:
mahodarastu samare bhImaM vivyAdha patribhiH |
navabhirvajrasa~NkAshairnamuchiM vRRitrahA yathA
shlokas.17:
AdityaketuH saptatyA bahvAshI chApi pa~nchabhiH |
navatyA kuNDadhArastu vishAlAkShashcha saptabhiH
shlokas.18:
aparAjito mahArAja parAjiShNurmahArathaH |
sharairbahubhirAnarChadbhImasenaM mahAbalam
shlokas.19:
raNe paNDitakashchainaM tribhirbANaiH samardayat |
sa tanna mamRRiShe bhImaH shatrubhirvadhamAhave
shlokas.20:
dhanuH prapIDya vAmena kareNAmitrakarshanaH |
shirashchichCheda samare shareNa nataparvaNA
shlokas.21:
aparAjitasya sunasaM tava putrasya sa.nyuge |
parAjitasya bhImena nipapAta shiro mahIm
shlokas.22:
athApareNa bhallena kuNDadhAraM mahAratham |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya sarvalokasya pashyataH
shlokas.23:
tataH punarameyAtmA prasandhAya shilImukham |
preShayAmAsa samare paNDitaM prati bhArata
shlokas.24:
sa sharaH paNDitaM hatvA vivesha dharaNItalam |
yathA naraM nihatyAshu bhujagaH kAlachoditaH
shlokas.25:
vishAlAkShashirashChittvA pAtayAmAsa bhUtale |
tribhiH sharairadInAtmA smarankleshaM purAtanam
shlokas.26:
mahodaraM maheShvAsaM nArAchena stanAntare |
vivyAdha samare rAjansa hato nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.27:
AdityaketoH ketuM cha ChittvA bANena sa.nyuge |
bhallena bhRRishatIkShNena shirashchichCheda chArihA
shlokas.28:
bahvAshinaM tato bhImaH shareNa nataparvaNA |
preShayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.29:
pradudruvustataste.anye putrAstava vishAM pate |
manyamAnA hi tatsatyaM sabhAyAM tasya bhAShitam
shlokas.30:
tato duryodhano rAjA bhrAtRRivyasanakarshitaH |
abravIttAvakAnyodhAnbhImo.ayaM yudhi vadhyatAm
shlokas.31:
evamete maheShvAsAH putrAstava vishAM pate |
bhrAtR^Insa.ndRRishya nihatAnprAsmara.nste hi tadvachaH
shlokas.32:
yaduktavAnmahAprAj~naH kShattA hitamanAmayam |
tadidaM samanuprAptaM vachanaM divyadarshinaH
shlokas.33:
lobhamohasamAviShTaH putraprItyA janAdhipa |
na budhyase purA yattattathyamuktaM vacho mahat
shlokas.34:
tathaiva hi vadhArthAya putrANAM pANDavo balI |
nUnaM jAto mahAbAhuryathA hanti sma kauravAn
shlokas.35:
tato duryodhano rAjA bhIShmamAsAdya mAriSha |
duHkhena mahatAviShTo vilalApAtikarshitaH
shlokas.36:
nihatA bhrAtaraH shUrA bhImasenena me yudhi |
yatamAnAstathAnye.api hanyante sarvasainikAH
shlokas.37:
bhavA.nshcha madhyasthatayA nityamasmAnupekShate |
so.ahaM kApathamArUDhaH pashya daivamidaM mama
shlokas.38:
etachChrutvA vachaH krUraM pitA devavratastava |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyamabravItsAshrulochanam
shlokas.39:
uktametanmayA pUrvaM droNena vidureNa cha |
gAndhAryA cha yashasvinyA tattvaM tAta na buddhavAn
shlokas.40:
samayashcha mayA pUrvaM kRRito vaH shatrukarshana |
nAhaM yudhi vimoktavyo nApyAchAryaH katha~nchana
shlokas.41:
yaM yaM hi dhArtarAShTrANAM bhImo drakShyati sa.nyuge |
haniShyati raNe taM taM satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.42:
sa tvaM rAjansthiro bhUtvA dRRiDhAM kRRitvA raNe matim |
yodhayasva raNe pArthAnsvargaM kRRitvA parAyaNam
shlokas.43:
na shakyAH pANDavA jetuM sendrairapi surAsuraiH |
tasmAdyuddhe matiM kRRitvA sthirAM yudhyasva bhArata

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
dRRiShTvA mama hatAnputrAnbahUnekena sa~njaya |
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipashchaiva kimakurvata sa.nyuge
shlokas.2:
ahanyahani me putrAH kShayaM gachChanti sa~njaya |
manye.ahaM sarvathA sUta daivenopahatA bhRRisham
shlokas.3:
yatra me tanayAH sarve jIyante na jayantyuta |
yatra bhIShmasya droNasya kRRipasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.4:
saumadatteshcha vIrasya bhagadattasya chobhayoH |
ashvatthAmnastathA tAta shUrANAM sumahAtmanAm
shlokas.5:
anyeShAM chaiva vIrANAM madhyagAstanayA mama |
yadahanyanta sa~NgrAme kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.6:
na hi duryodhano mandaH purA proktamabudhyata |
vAryamANo mayA tAta bhIShmeNa vidureNa cha
shlokas.7:
gAndhAryA chaiva durmedhAH satataM hitakAmyayA |
nAvabudhyatpurA mohAttasya prAptamidaM phalam
shlokas.8:
yadbhImasenaH samare putrAnmama vichetasaH |
ahanyahani sa~Nkruddho nayate yamasAdanam
shlokas.9:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
idaM tatsamanuprAptaM kShatturvachanamuttamam |
na buddhavAnasi vibho prochyamAnaM hitaM tadA
shlokas.10:
nivAraya sutAndyUtAtpANDavAnmA druheti cha |
suhRRidAM hitakAmAnAM bruvatAM tattadeva cha
shlokas.11:
na shushrUShasi yadvAkyaM martyaH pathyamivauShadham |
tadeva tvAmanuprAptaM vachanaM sAdhu bhAShitam
shlokas.12:
viduradroNabhIShmANAM tathAnyeShAM hitaiShiNAm |
akRRitvA vachanaM pathyaM kShayaM gachChanti kauravAH
shlokas.13:
tadetatsamatikrAntaM pUrvameva vishAM pate |
tasmAnme shRRiNu tattvena yathA yuddhamavartata
shlokas.14:
madhyAhne sumahAraudraH sa~NgrAmaH samapadyata |
lokakShayakaro rAja.nstanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.15:
tataH sarvANi sainyAni dharmaputrasya shAsanAt |
sa.nrabdhAnyabhyadhAvanta bhIShmameva jighA.nsayA
shlokas.16:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
yuktAnIkA mahArAja bhIShmameva samabhyayuH
shlokas.17:
arjuno draupadeyAshcha chekitAnashcha sa.nyuge |
duryodhanasamAdiShTAnrAj~naH sarvAnsamabhyayuH
shlokas.18:
abhimanyustathA vIro haiDimbashcha mahArathaH |
bhImasenashcha sa~Nkruddhaste.abhyadhAvanta kauravAn
shlokas.19:
tridhAbhUtairavadhyanta pANDavaiH kauravA yudhi |
tathaiva kaurave rAjannavadhyanta pare raNe
shlokas.20:
droNastu rathinAM shreShThaH somakAnsRRi~njayaiH saha |
abhyadravata sa~NkruddhaH preShayiShyanyamakShayam
shlokas.21:
tatrAkrando mahAnAsItsRRi~njayAnAM mahAtmanAm |
vadhyatAM samare rAjanbhAradvAjena dhanvinA
shlokas.22:
droNena nihatAstatra kShatriyA bahavo raNe |
viveShTantaH sma dRRishyante vyAdhikliShTA narA iva
shlokas.23:
kUjatAM krandatAM chaiva stanatAM chaiva sa.nyuge |
anishaM shrUyate shabdaH kShutkRRishAnAM nRRiNAmiva
shlokas.24:
tathaiva kauraveyANAM bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
chakAra kadanaM ghoraM kruddhaH kAla ivAparaH
shlokas.25:
vadhyatAM tatra sainyAnAmanyonyena mahAraNe |
prAvartata nadI ghorA rudhiraughapravAhinI
shlokas.26:
sa sa~NgrAmo mahArAja ghorarUpo.abhavanmahAn |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha yamarAShTravivardhanaH
shlokas.27:
tato bhImo raNe kruddho rabhasashcha visheShataH |
gajAnIkaM samAsAdya preShayAmAsa mRRityave
shlokas.28:
tatra bhArata bhImena nArAchAbhihatA gajAH |
petuH sedushcha nedushcha dishashcha paribabhramuH
shlokas.29:
ChinnahastA mahAnAgAshChinnapAdAshcha mAriSha |
krau~nchavadvyanadanbhItAH pRRithivImadhishishyire
shlokas.30:
nakulaH sahadevashcha hayAnIkamabhidrutau |
te hayAH kA~nchanApIDA rukmabhANDaparichChadAH
vadhyamAnA vyadRRishyanta shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.31:
patadbhishcha hayai rAjansamAstIryata medinI |
nirjihvaishcha shvasadbhishcha kUjadbhishcha gatAsubhiH
hayairbabhau narashreShTha nAnArUpadharairdharA
shlokas.32:
arjunena hataiH sa~Nkhye tathA bhArata vAjibhiH |
prababhau vasudhA ghorA tatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.33:
rathairbhagnairdhvajaishChinnaishChatraishcha sumahAprabhaiH |
hArairniShkaiH sakeyUraiH shirobhishcha sakuNDalaiH
shlokas.34:
uShNIShairapaviddhaishcha patAkAbhishcha sarvaShaH |
anukarShaiH shubhai rAjanyoktraishchavyasurashmibhiH
sa~nChannA vasudhA bhAti vasante kusumairiva
shlokas.35:
evameSha kShayo vRRittaH pANDUnAmapi bhArata |
kruddhe shAntanave bhIShme droNe cha rathasattame
shlokas.36:
ashvatthAmni kRRipe chaiva tathaiva kRRitavarmaNi |
tathetareShu kruddheShu tAvakAnAmapi kShayaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vartamAne tathA raudre rAjanvIravarakShaye |
shakuniH saubalaH shrImAnpANDavAnsamupAdravat
shlokas.2:
tathaiva sAtvato rAjanhArdikyaH paravIrahA |
abhyadravata sa~NgrAme pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.3:
tataH kAmbojamukhyAnAM nadIjAnAM cha vAjinAm |
AraTTAnAM mahIjAnAM sindhujAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.4:
vanAyujAnAM shubhrANAM tathA parvatavAsinAm |
ye chApare tittirajA javanA vAtaraMhasaH
shlokas.5:
suvarNAla~NkRRitairetairvarmavadbhiH sukalpitaiH |
hayairvAtajavairmukhyaiH pANDavasya suto balI
abhyavartata tatsainyaM hRRiShTarUpaH parantapaH
shlokas.6:
arjunasyAtha dAyAda irAvAnnAma vIryavAn |
sutAyAM nAgarAjasya jAtaH pArthena dhImatA
shlokas.7:
airAvatena sA dattA anapatyA mahAtmanA |
patyau hate suparNena kRRipaNA dInachetanA
shlokas.8:
bhAryArthaM tAM cha jagrAha pArthaH kAmavashAnugAm |
evameSha samutpannaH parakShetre.arjunAtmajaH
shlokas.9:
sa nAgaloke sa.nvRRiddho mAtrA cha parirakShitaH |
pitRRivyeNa parityaktaH pArthadveShAddurAtmanA
shlokas.10:
rUpavAnvIryasampanno guNavAnsatyavikramaH |
indralokaM jagAmAshu shrutvA tatrArjunaM gatam
shlokas.11:
so.abhigamya mahAtmAnaM pitaraM satyavikramam |
abhyavAdayadavyagro vinayena kRRitA~njaliH
irAvAnasmi bhadraM te putrashchAhaM tavAbhibho
shlokas.12:
mAtuH samAgamo yashcha tatsarvaM pratyavedayat |
tachcha sarvaM yathAvRRittamanusasmAra pANDavaH
shlokas.13:
pariShvajya sutaM chApi so.a.atmanaH sadRRishaM guNaiH |
prItimAnabhavatpArtho devarAjaniveshane
shlokas.14:
so.arjunena samAj~napto devaloke tadA nRRipa |
prItipUrvaM mahAbAhuH svakAryaM prati bhArata
yuddhakAle tvayAsmAkaM sAhyaM deyamiti prabho
shlokas.15:
bADhamityevamuktvA cha yuddhakAla upAgataH |
kAmavarNajavairashvaiH sa.nvRRito bahubhirnRRipa
shlokas.16:
te hayAH kA~nchanApIDA nAnAvarNA manojavAH |
utpetuH sahasA rAjanha.nsA iva mahodadhau
shlokas.17:
te tvadIyAnsamAsAdya hayasa~NghAnmahAjavAn |
kroDaiH kroDAnabhighnanto ghoNAbhishcha parasparam
nipetuH sahasA rAjansuvegAbhihatA bhuvi
shlokas.18:
nipatadbhistathA taishcha hayasa~NghaiH parasparam |
shushruve dAruNaH shabdaH suparNapatane yathA
shlokas.19:
tathaiva cha mahArAja sametyAnyonyamAhave |
parasparavadhaM ghoraM chakruste hayasAdinaH
shlokas.20:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne sa~Nkule tumule bhRRisham |
ubhayorapi sa.nshAntA hayasa~NghAH samantataH
shlokas.21:
prakShINasAyakAH shUrA nihatAshvAH shramAturAH |
vilayaM samanuprAptAstakShamANAH parasparam
shlokas.22:
tataH kShINe hayAnIke ki~nchichCheShe cha bhArata |
saubalasyAtmajAH shUrA nirgatA raNamUrdhani
shlokas.23:
vAyuvegasamasparshA jave vAyusamA.nstathA |
Aruhya shIlasampannAnvayaHsthA.nsturagottamAn
shlokas.24:
gajo gavAkSho vRRiShakashcharmavAnArjavaH shukaH |
ShaDete balasampannA niryayurmahato balAt
shlokas.25:
vAryamANAH shakuninA svaishcha yodhairmahAbalaiH |
saMnaddhA yuddhakushalA raudrarUpA mahAbalAH
shlokas.26:
tadanIkaM mahAbAho bhittvA paramadurjayam |
balena mahatA yuktAH svargAya vijayaiShiNaH
vivishuste tadA hRRiShTA gAndhArA yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.27:
tAnpraviShTA.nstadA dRRiShTvA irAvAnapi vIryavAn |
abravItsamare yodhAnvichitrAbharaNAyudhAn
shlokas.28:
yathaite dhArtarAShTrasya yodhAH sAnugavAhanAH |
hanyante samare sarve tathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.29:
bADhamityevamuktvA te sarve yodhA irAvataH |
jaghnuste vai parAnIkaM durjayaM samare paraiH
shlokas.30:
tadanIkamanIkena samare vIkShya pAtitam |
amRRiShyamANAste sarve subalasyAtmajA raNe
irAvantamabhidrutya sarvataH paryavArayan
shlokas.31:
tADayantaH shitaiH prAsaishchodayantaH parasparam |
te shUrAH paryadhAvanta kurvanto mahadAkulam
shlokas.32:
irAvAnatha nirbhinnaH prAsaistIkShNairmahAtmabhiH |
sravatA rudhireNAktastottrairviddha iva dvipaH
shlokas.33:
urasyapi cha pRRiShThe cha pArshvayoshcha bhRRishAhataH |
eko bahubhiratyarthaM dhairyAdrAjanna vivyathe
shlokas.34:
irAvAnatha sa~NkruddhaH sarvA.nstAnnishitaiH sharaiH |
mohayAmAsa samare viddhvA parapura~njayaH
shlokas.35:
prAsAnuddhRRitya sarvA.nshcha svasharIrAdari.ndamaH |
taireva tADayAmAsa subalasyAtmajAnraNe
shlokas.36:
nikRRiShya nishitaM khaDgaM gRRihItvA cha sharAvaram |
padAtistUrNamAgachChajjighA.nsuH saubalAnyudhi
shlokas.37:
tataH pratyAgataprANAH sarve te subalAtmajAH |
bhUyaH krodhasamAviShTA irAvantamathAdravan
shlokas.38:
irAvAnapi khaDgena darshayanpANilAghavam |
abhyavartata tAnsarvAnsaubalAnbaladarpitaH
shlokas.39:
lAghavenAtha charataH sarve te subalAtmajAH |
antaraM nAdhyagachChanta charantaH shIghragAminaH
shlokas.40:
bhUmiShThamatha taM sa~Nkhye sampradRRishya tataH punaH |
parivArya bhRRishaM sarve grahItumupachakramuH
shlokas.41:
athAbhyAshagatAnAM sa khaDgenAmitrakarshanaH |
upahastAvahastAbhyAM teShAM gAtrANyakRRintata
shlokas.42:
AyudhAni cha sarveShAM bAhUnapi cha bhUShitAn |
apatanta nikRRittA~NgA gatA bhUmiM gatAsavaH
shlokas.43:
vRRiShakastu mahArAja bahudhA parivikShataH |
amuchyata mahAraudrAttasmAdvIrAvakartanAt
shlokas.44:
tAnsarvAnpatitAndRRiShTvA bhIto duryodhanastataH |
abhyabhAShata sa~Nkruddho rAkShasaM ghoradarshanam
shlokas.45:
ArshyashRRi~NgiM maheShvAsaM mAyAvinamari.ndamam |
vairiNaM bhImasenasya pUrvaM bakavadhena vai
shlokas.46:
pashya vIra yathA hyeSha phalgunasya suto balI |
mAyAvI vipriyaM ghoramakArShInme balakShayam
shlokas.47:
tvaM cha kAmagamastAta mAyAstre cha vishAradaH |
kRRitavairashcha pArthena tasmAdenaM raNe jahi
shlokas.48:
bADhamityevamuktvA tu rAkShaso ghoradarshanaH |
prayayau siMhanAdena yatrArjunasuto yuvA
shlokas.49:
svArUDhairyuddhakushalairvimalaprAsayodhibhiH |
vIraiH prahAribhiryuktaH svairanIkaiH samAvRRitaH
nihantukAmaH samare irAvantaM mahAbalam
shlokas.50:
irAvAnapi sa~NkruddhastvaramANaH parAkramI |
hantukAmamamitraghno rAkShasaM pratyavArayat
shlokas.51:
tamApatantaM samprekShya rAkShasaH sumahAbalaH |
tvaramANastato mAyAM prayoktumupachakrame
shlokas.52:
tena mAyAmayAH kL^iptA hayAstAvanta eva hi |
svArUDhA rAkShasairghoraiH shUlapaTTishapANibhiH
shlokas.53:
te sa.nrabdhAH samAgamya dvisAhasrAH prahAriNaH |
achirAdgamayAmAsuH pretalokaM parasparam
shlokas.54:
tasmi.nstu nihate sainye tAvubhau yuddhadurmadau |
sa~NgrAme vyavatiShThetAM yathA vai vRRitravAsavau
shlokas.55:
AdravantamabhiprekShya rAkShasaM yuddhadurmadam |
irAvAnkrodhasa.nrabdhaH pratyadhAvanmahAbalaH
shlokas.56:
samabhyAshagatasyAjau tasya khaDgena durmateH |
chichCheda kArmukaM dIptaM sharAvApaM cha pa~nchakam
shlokas.57:
sa nikRRittaM dhanurdRRiShTvA khaM javena samAvishat |
irAvantamabhikruddhaM mohayanniva mAyayA
shlokas.58:
tato.antarikShamutpatya irAvAnapi rAkShasam |
vimohayitvA mAyAbhistasya gAtrANi sAyakaiH
chichCheda sarvamarmaj~naH kAmarUpo durAsadaH
shlokas.59:
tathA sa rAkShasashreShThaH sharaiH kRRittaH punaH punaH |
sambabhUva mahArAja samavApa cha yauvanam
shlokas.60:
mAyA hi sahajA teShAM vayo rUpaM cha kAmajam |
evaM tadrAkShasasyA~NgaM ChinnaM ChinnaM vyarohata
shlokas.61:
irAvAnapi sa~Nkruddho rAkShasaM taM mahAbalam |
parashvadhena tIkShNena chichCheda cha punaH punaH
shlokas.62:
sa tena balinA vIrashChidyamAna iva drumaH |
rAkShaso vyanadadghoraM sa shabdastumulo.abhavat
shlokas.63:
parashvadhakShataM rakShaH susrAva rudhiraM bahu |
tatashchukrodha balavA.nshchakre vegaM cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.64:
ArshyashRRi~Ngistato dRRiShTvA samare shatrumUrjitam |
kRRitvA ghoraM mahadrUpaM grahItumupachakrame
sa~NgrAmashiraso madhye sarveShAM tatra pashyatAm
shlokas.65:
tAM dRRiShTvA tAdRRishIM mAyAM rAkShasasya mahAtmanaH |
irAvAnapi sa~Nkruddho mAyAM sraShTuM prachakrame
shlokas.66:
tasya krodhAbhibhUtasya sa.nyugeShvanivartinaH |
yo.anvayo mAtRRikastasya sa enamabhipedivAn
shlokas.67:
sa nAgairbahusho rAjansarvataH sa.nvRRito raNe |
dadhAra sumahadrUpamananta iva bhogavAn
tato bahuvidhairnAgaishChAdayAmAsa rAkShasam
shlokas.68:
ChAdyamAnastu nAgaiH sa dhyAtvA rAkShasapu~NgavaH |
sauparNaM rUpamAsthAya bhakShayAmAsa pannagAn
shlokas.69:
mAyayA bhakShite tasminnanvaye tasya mAtRRike |
vimohitamirAvantamasinA rAkShaso.avadhIt
shlokas.70:
sakuNDalaM samukuTaM padmendusadRRishaprabham |
irAvataH shiro rakShaH pAtayAmAsa bhUtale
shlokas.71:
tasmi.nstu nihate vIre rAkShasenArjunAtmaje |
vishokAH samapadyanta dhArtarAShTrAH sarAjakAH
shlokas.72:
tasminmahati sa~NgrAme tAdRRishe bhairave punaH |
mahAnvyatikaro ghoraH senayoH samapadyata
shlokas.73:
hayA gajAH padAtAshcha vimishrA dantibhirhatAH |
rathAshcha dantinashchaiva pattibhistatra sUditAH
shlokas.74:
tathA pattirathaughAshcha hayAshcha bahavo raNe |
rathibhirnihatA rAja.nstava teShAM cha sa~Nkule
shlokas.75:
ajAnannarjunashchApi nihataM putramaurasam |
jaghAna samare shUrAnrAj~nastAnbhIShmarakShiNaH
shlokas.76:
tathaiva tAvakA rAjansRRi~njayAshcha mahAbalAH |
juhvataH samare prANAnnijaghnuritaretaram
shlokas.77:
muktakeshA vikavachA virathAshChinnakArmukAH |
bAhubhiH samayudhyanta samavetAH parasparam
shlokas.78:
tathA marmAtigairbhIShmo nijaghAna mahArathAn |
kampayansamare senAM pANDavAnAM mahAbalaH
shlokas.79:
tena yaudhiShThire sainye bahavo mAnavA hatAH |
dantinaH sAdinashchaiva rathino.atha hayAstathA
shlokas.80:
tatra bhArata bhIShmasya raNe dRRiShTvA parAkramam |
atyadbhutamapashyAma shakrasyeva parAkramam
shlokas.81:
tathaiva bhImasenasya pArShatasya cha bhArata |
raudramAsIttadA yuddhaM sAtvatasya cha dhanvinaH
shlokas.82:
dRRiShTvA droNasya vikrAntaM pANDavAnbhayamAvishat |
eka eva raNe shakto hantumasmAnsasainikAn
shlokas.83:
kiM punaH pRRithivIshUrairyodhavrAtaiH samAvRRitaH |
ityabruvanmahArAja raNe droNena pIDitAH
shlokas.84:
vartamAne tathA raudre sa~NgrAme bharatarShabha |
ubhayoH senayoH shUrA nAmRRiShyanta parasparam
shlokas.85:
AviShTA iva yudhyante rakShobhUtA mahAbalAH |
tAvakAH pANDaveyAshcha sa.nrabdhAstAta dhanvinaH
shlokas.86:
na sma pashyAmahe ka~nchidyaH prANAnparirakShati |
sa~NgrAme daityasa~NkAshe tasminyoddhA narAdhipa

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
irAvantaM tu nihataM dRRiShTvA pArthA mahArathAH |
sa~NgrAme kimakurvanta tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
irAvantaM tu nihataM sa~NgrAme vIkShya rAkShasaH |
vyanadatsumahAnAdaM bhaimasenirghaTotkachaH
shlokas.3:
nadatastasya shabdena pRRithivI sAgarAmbarA |
saparvatavanA rAja.nshchachAla subhRRishaM tadA
antarikShaM dishashchaiva sarvAshcha pradishastathA
shlokas.4:
taM shrutvA sumahAnAdaM tava sainyasya bhArata |
UrustambhaH samabhavadvepathuH sveda eva cha
shlokas.5:
sarva eva cha rAjendra tAvakA dInachetasaH |
sarpavatsamaveShTanta siMhabhItA gajA iva
shlokas.6:
ninadatsumahAnAdaM nirghAtamiva rAkShasaH |
jvalitaM shUlamudyamya rUpaM kRRitvA vibhIShaNam
shlokas.7:
nAnApraharaNairghorairvRRito rAkShasapu~NgavaiH |
AjagAma susa~NkruddhaH kAlAntakayamopamaH
shlokas.8:
tamApatantaM samprekShya sa~NkruddhaM bhImadarshanam |
svabalaM cha bhayAttasya prAyasho vimukhIkRRitam
shlokas.9:
tato duryodhano rAjA ghaTotkachamupAdravat |
pragRRihya vipulaM chApaM siMhavadvinadanmuhuH
shlokas.10:
pRRiShThato.anuyayau chainaM sravadbhiH parvatopamaiH |
ku~njarairdashasAhasrairva~NgAnAmadhipaH svayam
shlokas.11:
tamApatantaM samprekShya gajAnIkena sa.nvRRitam |
putraM tava mahArAja chukopa sa nishAcharaH
shlokas.12:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
rAkShasAnAM cha rAjendra duryodhanabalasya cha
shlokas.13:
gajAnIkaM cha samprekShya meghavRRindamivodyatam |
abhyadhAvanta sa~NkruddhA rAkShasAH shastrapANayaH
shlokas.14:
nadanto vividhAnnAdAnmeghA iva savidyutaH |
sharashaktyRRiShTinArAchairnighnanto gajayodhinaH
shlokas.15:
bhiNDipAlaistathA shUlairmudgaraiH saparashvadhaiH |
parvatAgraishcha vRRikShaishcha nijaghnuste mahAgajAn
shlokas.16:
bhinnakumbhAnvirudhirAnbhinnagAtrA.nshcha vAraNAn |
apashyAma mahArAja vadhyamAnAnnishAcharaiH
shlokas.17:
teShu prakShIyamANeShu bhagneShu gajayodhiShu |
duryodhano mahArAja rAkShasAnsamupAdravat
shlokas.18:
amarShavashamApannastyaktvA jIvitamAtmanaH |
mumocha nishitAnbANAnrAkShaseShu mahAbalaH
shlokas.19:
jaghAna cha maheShvAsaH pradhAnA.nstatra rAkShasAn |
sa~Nkruddho bharatashreShTha putro duryodhanastava
shlokas.20:
vegavantaM mahAraudraM vidyujjihvaM pramAthinam |
sharaishchaturbhishchaturo nijaghAna mahArathaH
shlokas.21:
tataH punarameyAtmA sharavarShaM durAsadam |
mumocha bharatashreShTha nishAcharabalaM prati
shlokas.22:
tattu dRRiShTvA mahatkarma putrasya tava mAriSha |
krodhenAbhiprajajvAla bhaimasenirmahAbalaH
shlokas.23:
visphArya cha mahachchApamindrAshanisamasvanam |
abhidudrAva vegena duryodhanamari.ndamam
shlokas.24:
tamApatantamudvIkShya kAlasRRiShTamivAntakam |
na vivyathe mahArAja putro duryodhanastava
shlokas.25:
athainamabravItkruddhaH krUraH sa.nraktalochanaH |
ye tvayA sunRRisha.nsena dIrghakAlaM pravAsitAH
yachcha te pANDavA rAja.nshChaladyUte parAjitAH
shlokas.26:
yachchaiva draupadI kRRiShNA ekavastrA rajasvalA |
sabhAmAnIya durbuddhe bahudhA kleshitA tvayA
shlokas.27:
tava cha priyakAmena AshramasthA durAtmanA |
saindhavena parikliShTA paribhUya pitR^Inmama
shlokas.28:
eteShAmavamAnAnAmanyeShAM cha kulAdhama |
antamadya gamiShyAmi yadi notsRRijase raNam
shlokas.29:
evamuktvA tu haiDimbo mahadvisphArya kArmukam |
sa.ndashya dashanairoShThaM sRRikkiNI parisa.nlihan
shlokas.30:
sharavarSheNa mahatA duryodhanamavAkirat |
parvataM vAridhArAbhiH prAvRRiShIva balAhakaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tatastadbANavarShaM tu duHsahaM dAnavairapi |
dadhAra yudhi rAjendro yathA varShaM mahAdvipaH
shlokas.2:
tataH krodhasamAviShTo niHshvasanniva pannagaH |
sa.nshayaM paramaM prAptaH putraste bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
mumocha nishitA.nstIkShNAnnArAchAnpa~nchavi.nshatim |
te.apatansahasA rAja.nstasminrAkShasapu~Ngave
AshIviShA iva kruddhAH parvate gandhamAdane
shlokas.4:
sa tairviddhaH sravanraktaM prabhinna iva ku~njaraH |
dadhre matiM vinAshAya rAj~naH sa pishitAshanaH
jagrAha cha mahAshaktiM girINAmapi dAraNIm
shlokas.5:
sampradIptAM maholkAbhAmashanIM maghavAniva |
samudyachChanmahAbAhurjighA.nsustanayaM tava
shlokas.6:
tAmudyatAmabhiprekShya va~NgAnAmadhipastvaran |
ku~njaraM girisa~NkAshaM rAkShasaM pratyachodayat
shlokas.7:
sa nAgapravareNAjau balinA shIghragAminA |
yato duryodhanarathastaM mArgaM pratyapadyata
rathaM cha vArayAmAsa ku~njareNa sutasya te
shlokas.8:
mArgamAvAritaM dRRiShTvA rAj~nA va~Ngena dhImatA |
ghaTotkacho mahArAja krodhasa.nraktalochanaH
udyatAM tAM mahAshaktiM tasmi.nshchikShepa vAraNe
shlokas.9:
sa tayAbhihato rAja.nstena bAhuvimuktayA |
sa~njAtarudhirotpIDaH papAta cha mamAra cha
shlokas.10:
patatyatha gaje chApi va~NgAnAmIshvaro balI |
javena samabhidrutya jagAma dharaNItalam
shlokas.11:
duryodhano.api samprekShya pAtitaM varavAraNam |
prabhagnaM cha balaM dRRiShTvA jagAma paramAM vyathAm
shlokas.12:
kShatradharmaM puraskRRitya AtmanashchAbhimAnitAm |
prApte.apakramaNe rAjA tasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.13:
sandhAya cha shitaM bANaM kAlAgnisamatejasam |
mumocha paramakruddhastasminghore nishAchare
shlokas.14:
tamApatantaM samprekShya bANamindrAshaniprabham |
lAghavAdva~nchayAmAsa mahAkAyo ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.15:
bhUya eva nanAdograH krodhasa.nraktalochanaH |
trAsayansarvabhUtAni yugAnte jalado yathA
shlokas.16:
taM shrutvA ninadaM ghoraM tasya bhIShmasya rakShasaH |
AchAryamupasa~Ngamya bhIShmaH shAntanavo.abravIt
shlokas.17:
yathaiSha ninado ghoraH shrUyate rAkShaseritaH |
haiDimbo yudhyate nUnaM rAj~nA duryodhanena ha
shlokas.18:
naiSha shakyo hi sa~NgrAme jetuM bhUtena kenachit |
tatra gachChata bhadraM vo rAjAnaM parirakShata
shlokas.19:
abhidrutaM mahAbhAgaM rAkShasena durAtmanA |
etaddhi paramaM kRRityaM sarveShAM naH parantapAH
shlokas.20:
pitAmahavachaH shrutvA tvaramANA mahArathAH |
uttamaM javamAsthAya prayayuryatra kauravaH
shlokas.21:
droNashcha somadattashcha bAhlikashcha jayadrathaH |
kRRipo bhUrishravAH shalyashchitraseno vivi.nshatiH
shlokas.22:
ashvatthAmA vikarNashcha Avantyashcha bRRihadbalaH |
rathAshchAnekasAhasrA ye teShAmanuyAyinaH
abhidrutaM parIpsantaH putraM duryodhanaM tava
shlokas.23:
tadanIkamanAdhRRiShyaM pAlitaM lokasattamaiH |
AtatAyinamAyAntaM prekShya rAkShasasattamaH
nAkampata mahAbAhurmainAka iva parvataH
shlokas.24:
pragRRihya vipulaM chApaM j~nAtibhiH parivAritaH |
shUlamudgarahastaishcha nAnApraharaNairapi
shlokas.25:
tataH samabhavadyuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
rAkShasAnAM cha mukhyasya duryodhanabalasya cha
shlokas.26:
dhanuShAM kUjatAM shabdaH sarvatastumulo.abhavat |
ashrUyata mahArAja va.nshAnAM dahyatAmiva
shlokas.27:
shastrANAM pAtyamAnAnAM kavacheShu sharIriNAm |
shabdaH samabhavadrAjannadrINAmiva dIryatAm
shlokas.28:
vIrabAhuvisRRiShTAnAM tomarANAM vishAM pate |
rUpamAsIdviyatsthAnAM sarpANAM sarpatAmiva
shlokas.29:
tataH paramasa~Nkruddho visphArya sumahaddhanuH |
rAkShasendro mahAbAhurvinadanbhairavaM ravam
shlokas.30:
AchAryasyArdhachandreNa kruddhashchichCheda kArmukam |
somadattasya bhallena dhvajamunmathya chAnadat
shlokas.31:
bAhlikaM cha tribhirbANairabhyavidhyatstanAntare |
kRRipamekena vivyAdha chitrasenaM tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.32:
pUrNAyatavisRRiShTena samyakpraNihitena cha |
jatrudeshe samAsAdya vikarNaM samatADayat
nyaShIdatsa rathopasthe shoNitena pariplutaH
shlokas.33:
tataH punarameyAtmA nArAchAndasha pa~ncha cha |
bhUrishravasi sa~NkruddhaH prAhiNodbharatarShabha
te varma bhittvA tasyAshu prAvishanmedinItalam
shlokas.34:
vivi.nshateshcha drauNeshcha yantArau samatADayat |
tau petatU rathopasthe rashmInutsRRijya vAjinAm
shlokas.35:
sindhurAj~no.ardhachandreNa vArAhaM svarNabhUShitam |
unmamAtha mahArAja dvitIyenAchChinaddhanuH
shlokas.36:
chaturbhiratha nArAchairAvantyasya mahAtmanaH |
jaghAna chaturo vAhAnkrodhasa.nraktalochanaH
shlokas.37:
pUrNAyatavisRRiShTena pItena nishitena cha |
nirbibheda mahArAja rAjaputraM bRRihadbalam
sa gADhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upAvishat
shlokas.38:
bhRRishaM krodhena chAviShTo rathastho rAkShasAdhipaH |
chikShepa nishitA.nstIkShNA~nsharAnAshIviShopamAn
bibhiduste mahArAja shalyaM yuddhavishAradam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vimukhIkRRitya tAnsarvA.nstAvakAnyudhi rAkShasaH |
jighA.nsurbharatashreShTha duryodhanamupAdravat
shlokas.2:
tamApatantaM samprekShya rAjAnaM prati vegitam |
abhyadhAvajjighA.nsantastAvakA yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.3:
tAlamAtrANi chApAni vikarShanto mahAbalAH |
tamekamabhyadhAvanta nadantaH siMhasa~Nghavat
shlokas.4:
athainaM sharavarSheNa samantAtparyavArayan |
parvataM vAridhArAbhiH sharadIva balAhakAH
shlokas.5:
sa gADhaviddho vyathitastottrArdita iva dvipaH |
utpapAta tadAkAshaM samantAdvainateyavat
shlokas.6:
vyanadatsumahAnAdaM jImUta iva shAradaH |
dishaH khaM pradishashchaiva nAdayanbhairavasvanaH
shlokas.7:
rAkShasasya tu taM shabdaM shrutvA rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
uvAcha bharatashreShTho bhImasenamidaM vachaH
shlokas.8:
yudhyate rAkShaso nUnaM dhArtarAShTrairmahArathaiH |
yathAsya shrUyate shabdo nadato bhairavaM svanam
atibhAraM cha pashyAmi tatra tAta samAhitam
shlokas.9:
pitAmahashcha sa~NkruddhaH pA~nchAlAnhantumudyataH |
teShAM cha rakShaNArthAya yudhyate phalgunaH paraiH
shlokas.10:
etachChrutvA mahAbAho kAryadvayamupasthitam |
gachCha rakShasva haiDimbaM sa.nshayaM paramaM gatam
shlokas.11:
bhrAturvachanamAj~nAya tvaramANo vRRikodaraH |
prayayau siMhanAdena trAsayansarvapArthivAn
vegena mahatA rAjanparvakAle yathodadhiH
shlokas.12:
tamanvayAtsatyadhRRitiH sauchittiryuddhadurmadaH |
shreNimAnvasudAnashcha putraH kAshyasya chAbhibhUH
shlokas.13:
abhimanyumukhAshchaiva draupadeyA mahArathAH |
kShatradevashcha vikrAntaH kShatradharmA tathaiva cha
shlokas.14:
anUpAdhipatishchaiva nIlaH svabalamAsthitaH |
mahatA rathava.nshena haiDimbaM paryavArayan
shlokas.15:
ku~njaraishcha sadA mattaiH ShaTsahasraiH prahAribhiH |
abhyarakShanta sahitA rAkShasendraM ghaTotkacham
shlokas.16:
siMhanAdena mahatA nemighoSheNa chaiva hi |
khurashabdaninAdaishcha kampayanto vasundharAm
shlokas.17:
teShAmApatatAM shrutvA shabdaM taM tAvakaM balam |
bhImasenabhayodvignaM vivarNavadanaM tathA
parivRRittaM mahArAja parityajya ghaTotkacham
shlokas.18:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tatra tatra mahAtmanAm |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha sa~NgrAmeShvanivartinAm
shlokas.19:
nAnArUpANi shastrANi visRRijanto mahArathAH |
anyonyamabhidhAvantaH samprahAraM prachakrire
vyatiShaktaM mahAraudraM yuddhaM bhIrubhayAvaham
shlokas.20:
hayA gajaiH samAjagmuH pAdAtA rathibhiH saha |
anyonyaM samare rAjanprArthayAnA mahadyashaH
shlokas.21:
sahasA chAbhavattIvraM saMnipAtAnmahadrajaH |
rathAshvagajapattInAM padanemisamuddhatam
shlokas.22:
dhUmrAruNaM rajastIvraM raNabhUmiM samAvRRiNot |
naiva sve na pare rAjansamajAnanparasparam
shlokas.23:
pitA putraM na jAnIte putro vA pitaraM tathA |
nirmaryAde tathA bhUte vaishase lomaharShaNe
shlokas.24:
shastrANAM bharatashreShTha manuShyANAM cha garjatAm |
sumahAnabhavachChabdo va.nshAnAmiva dahyatAm
shlokas.25:
gajavAjimanuShyANAM shoNitAntratara~NgiNI |
prAvartata nadI tatra keshashaivalashAdvalA
shlokas.26:
narANAM chaiva kAyebhyaH shirasAM patatAM raNe |
shushruve sumahA~nshabdaH patatAmashmanAmiva
shlokas.27:
vishiraskairmanuShyaishcha ChinnagAtraishcha vAraNaiH |
ashvaiH sambhinnadehaishcha sa~NkIrNAbhUdvasundharA
shlokas.28:
nAnAvidhAni shastrANi visRRijanto mahArathAH |
anyonyamabhidhAvantaH samprahAraM prachakrire
shlokas.29:
hayA hayAnsamAsAdya preShitA hayasAdibhiH |
samAhatya raNe.anyonyaM nipeturgatajIvitAH
shlokas.30:
narA narAnsamAsAdya krodharaktekShaNA bhRRisham |
urA.nsyurobhiranyonyaM samAshliShya nijaghnire
shlokas.31:
preShitAshcha mahAmAtrairvAraNAH paravAraNAH |
abhighnanti viShANAgrairvAraNAneva sa.nyuge
shlokas.32:
te jAtarudhirApIDAH patAkAbhirala~NkRRitAH |
sa.nsaktAH pratyadRRishyanta meghA iva savidyutaH
shlokas.33:
kechidbhinnA viShANAgrairbhinnakumbhAshcha tomaraiH |
vinadanto.abhyadhAvanta garjanto jaladA iva
shlokas.34:
kechiddhastairdvidhA ChinnaishChinnagAtrAstathApare |
nipetustumule tasmi.nshChinnapakShA ivAdrayaH
shlokas.35:
pArshvaistu dAritairanye vAraNairvaravAraNAH |
mumuchuH shoNitaM bhUri dhAtUniva mahIdharAH
shlokas.36:
nArAchAbhihatAstvanye tathA viddhAshcha tomaraiH |
hatArohA vyadRRishyanta vishRRi~NgA iva parvatAH
shlokas.37:
kechitkrodhasamAviShTA madAndhA niravagrahAH |
rathAnhayAnpadAtA.nshcha mamRRiduH shatasho raNe
shlokas.38:
tathA hayA hayArohaistADitAH prAsatomaraiH |
tena tenAbhyavartanta kurvanto vyAkulA dishaH
shlokas.39:
rathino rathibhiH sArdhaM kulaputrAstanutyajaH |
parAM shaktiM samAsthAya chakruH karmANyabhItavat
shlokas.40:
svaya.nvara ivAmarde prajahruritaretaram |
prArthayAnA yasho rAjansvargaM vA yuddhashAlinaH
shlokas.41:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne sa~NgrAme lomaharShaNe |
dhArtarAShTraM mahatsainyaM prAyasho vimukhIkRRitam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
svasainyaM nihataM dRRiShTvA rAjA duryodhanaH svayam |
abhyadhAvata sa~Nkruddho bhImasenamari.ndamam
shlokas.2:
pragRRihya sumahachchApamindrAshanisamasvanam |
mahatA sharavarSheNa pANDavaM samavAkirat
shlokas.3:
ardhachandraM cha sandhAya sutIkShNaM lomavAhinam |
bhImasenasya chichCheda chApaM krodhasamanvitaH
shlokas.4:
tadantaraM cha samprekShya tvaramANo mahArathaH |
sa.ndadhe nishitaM bANaM girINAmapi dAraNam
tenorasi mahAbAhurbhImasenamatADayat
shlokas.5:
sa gADhaviddho vyathitaH sRRikkiNI parisa.nlihan |
samAlalambe tejasvI dhvajaM hemapariShkRRitam
shlokas.6:
tathA vimanasaM dRRiShTvA bhImasenaM ghaTotkachaH |
krodhenAbhiprajajvAla didhakShanniva pAvakaH
shlokas.7:
abhimanyumukhAshchaiva pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
samabhyadhAvankroshanto rAjAnaM jAtasambhramAH
shlokas.8:
samprekShya tAnApatataH sa~NkruddhA~njAtasambhramAn |
bhAradvAjo.abravIdvAkyaM tAvakAnAM mahArathAn
shlokas.9:
kShipraM gachChata bhadraM vo rAjAnaM parirakShata |
sa.nshayaM paramaM prAptaM majjantaM vyasanArNave
shlokas.10:
ete kruddhA maheShvAsAH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
bhImasenaM puraskRRitya duryodhanamupadrutAH
shlokas.11:
nAnAvidhAni shastrANi visRRijanto jaye ratAH |
nadanto bhairavAnnAdA.nstrAsayantashcha bhUmimAm
shlokas.12:
tadAchAryavachaH shrutvA somadattapurogamAH |
tAvakAH samavartanta pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.13:
kRRipo bhUrishravAH shalyo droNaputro vivi.nshatiH |
chitraseno vikarNashcha saindhavo.atha bRRihadbalaH
Avantyau cha maheShvAsau kauravaM paryavArayan
shlokas.14:
te vi.nshatipadaM gatvA samprahAraM prachakrire |
pANDavA dhArtarAShTrAshcha parasparajighA.nsavaH
shlokas.15:
evamuktvA mahAbAhurmahadvisphArya kArmukam |
bhAradvAjastato bhImaM ShaDvi.nshatyA samArpayat
shlokas.16:
bhUyashchainaM mahAbAhuH sharaiH shIghramavAkirat |
parvataM vAridhArAbhiH sharadIva balAhakaH
shlokas.17:
taM pratyavidhyaddashabhirbhImasenaH shilImukhaiH |
tvaramANo maheShvAsaH savye pArshve mahAbalaH
shlokas.18:
sa gADhaviddho vyathito vayovRRiddhashcha bhArata |
pranaShTasa~nj~naH sahasA rathopastha upAvishat
shlokas.19:
guruM pravyathitaM dRRiShTvA rAjA duryodhanaH svayam |
drauNAyanishcha sa~Nkruddhau bhImasenamabhidrutau
shlokas.20:
tAvApatantau samprekShya kAlAntakayamopamau |
bhImaseno mahAbAhurgadAmAdAya satvaraH
shlokas.21:
avaplutya rathAttUrNaM tasthau giririvAchalaH |
samudyamya gadAM gurvIM yamadaNDopamAM raNe
shlokas.22:
tamudyatagadaM dRRiShTvA kailAsamiva shRRi~NgiNam |
kauravo droNaputrashcha sahitAvabhyadhAvatAm
shlokas.23:
tAvApatantau sahitau tvaritau balinAM varau |
abhyadhAvata vegena tvaramANo vRRikodaraH
shlokas.24:
tamApatantaM samprekShya sa~NkruddhaM bhImadarshanam |
samabhyadhAva.nstvaritAH kauravANAM mahArathAH
shlokas.25:
bhAradvAjamukhAH sarve bhImasenajighA.nsayA |
nAnAvidhAni shastrANi bhImasyorasyapAtayan
sahitAH pANDavaM sarve pIDayantaH samantataH
shlokas.26:
taM dRRiShTvA sa.nshayaM prAptaM pIDyamAnaM mahAratham |
abhimanyuprabhRRitayaH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH
abhyadhAvanparIpsantaH prANA.nstyaktvA sudustyajAn
shlokas.27:
anUpAdhipatiH shUro bhImasya dayitaH sakhA |
nIlo nIlAmbudaprakhyaH sa~Nkruddho drauNimabhyayAt
spardhate hi maheShvAso nityaM droNasutena yaH
shlokas.28:
sa visphArya mahachchApaM drauNiM vivyAdha patriNA |
yathA shakro mahArAja purA vivyAdha dAnavam
shlokas.29:
viprachittiM durAdharShaM devatAnAM bhaya~Nkaram |
yena lokatrayaM krodhAttrAsitaM svena tejasA
shlokas.30:
tathA nIlena nirbhinnaH sumukhena patatriNA |
sa~njAtarudhirotpIDo drauNiH krodhasamanvitaH
shlokas.31:
sa visphArya dhanushchitramindrAshanisamasvanam |
dadhre nIlavinAshAya matiM matimatAM varaH
shlokas.32:
tataH sandhAya vimalAnbhallAnkarmArapAyitAn |
jaghAna chaturo vAhAnpAtayAmAsa cha dhvajam
shlokas.33:
saptamena cha bhallena nIlaM vivyAdha vakShasi |
sa gADhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upAvishat
shlokas.34:
mohitaM vIkShya rAjAnaM nIlamabhrachayopamam |
ghaTotkacho.api sa~Nkruddho bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.35:
abhidudrAva vegena drauNimAhavashobhinam |
tathetare abhyadhAvanrAkShasA yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.36:
tamApatantaM samprekShya rAkShasaM ghoradarshanam |
abhyadhAvata tejasvI bhAradvAjAtmajastvaran
shlokas.37:
nijaghAna cha sa~Nkruddho rAkShasAnbhImadarshanAn |
yo.abhavannagrataH kruddhA rAkShasasya puraHsarAH
shlokas.38:
vimukhA.nshchaiva tAndRRiShTvA drauNichApachyutaiH sharaiH |
akrudhyata mahAkAyo bhaimasenirghaTotkachaH
shlokas.39:
prAdushchakre mahAmAyAM ghorarUpAM sudAruNAm |
mohayansamare drauNiM mAyAvI rAkShasAdhipaH
shlokas.40:
tataste tAvakAH sarve mAyayA vimukhIkRRitAH |
anyonyaM samapashyanta nikRRittAnmedinItale
vicheShTamAnAnkRRipaNA~nshoNitena samukShitAn
shlokas.41:
droNaM duryodhanaM shalyamashvatthAmAnameva cha |
prAyashashcha maheShvAsA ye pradhAnAshcha kauravAH
shlokas.42:
vidhvastA rathinaH sarve gajAshcha vinipAtitAH |
hayAshcha sahayArohA vinikRRittAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.43:
taddRRiShTvA tAvakaM sainyaM vidrutaM shibiraM prati |
mama prAkroshato rAja.nstathA devavratasya cha
shlokas.44:
yudhyadhvaM mA palAyadhvaM mAyaiShA rAkShasI raNe |
ghaTotkachaprayukteti nAtiShThanta vimohitAH
naiva te shraddadhurbhItA vadatorAvayorvachaH
shlokas.45:
tA.nshcha pradravato dRRiShTvA jayaM prAptAshcha pANDavAH |
ghaTotkachena sahitAH siMhanAdAnprachakrire
sha~NkhadundubhighoShAshcha samantAtsasvanurbhRRisham
shlokas.46:
evaM tava balaM sarvaM haiDimbena durAtmanA |
sUryAstamanavelAyAM prabhagnaM vidrutaM dishaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminmahati sa~Nkrande rAjA duryodhanastadA |
gA~Ngeyamupasa~Ngamya vinayenAbhivAdya cha
shlokas.2:
tasya sarvaM yathAvRRittamAkhyAtumupachakrame |
ghaTotkachasya vijayamAtmanashcha parAjayam
shlokas.3:
kathayAmAsa durdharSho viniHshvasya punaH punaH |
abravIchcha tadA rAjanbhIShmaM kurupitAmaham
shlokas.4:
bhavantaM samupAshritya vAsudevaM yathA paraiH |
pANDavairvigraho ghoraH samArabdho mayA prabho
shlokas.5:
ekAdasha samAkhyAtA akShauhiNyashcha yA mama |
nideshe tava tiShThanti mayA sArdhaM parantapa
shlokas.6:
so.ahaM bharatashArdUla bhImasenapurogamaiH |
ghaTotkachaM samAshritya pANDavairyudhi nirjitaH
shlokas.7:
tanme dahati gAtrANi shuShkavRRikShamivAnalaH |
tadichChAmi mahAbhAga tvatprasAdAtparantapa
shlokas.8:
rAkShasApasadaM hantuM svayameva pitAmaha |
tvAM samAshritya durdharShaM tanme kartuM tvamarhasi
shlokas.9:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM rAj~no bharatasattama |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyaM bhIShmaH shAntanavo.abravIt
shlokas.10:
shRRiNu rAjanmama vacho yattvA vakShyAmi kaurava |
yathA tvayA mahArAja vartitavyaM parantapa
shlokas.11:
AtmA rakShyo raNe tAta sarvAvasthAsvari.ndama |
dharmarAjena sa~NgrAmastvayA kAryaH sadAnagha
shlokas.12:
arjunena yamAbhyAM vA bhImasenena vA punaH |
rAjadharmaM puraskRRitya rAjA rAjAnamRRichChati
shlokas.13:
ahaM droNaH kRRipo drauNiH kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
shalyashcha saumadattishcha vikarNashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.14:
tava cha bhrAtaraH shUrA duHshAsanapurogamAH |
tvadarthaM pratiyotsyAmo rAkShasaM taM mahAbalam
shlokas.15:
tasminraudre rAkShasendre yadi te hRRichChayo mahAn |
ayaM vA gachChatu raNe tasya yuddhAya durmateH
bhagadatto mahIpAlaH pura.ndarasamo yudhi
shlokas.16:
etAvaduktvA rAjAnaM bhagadattamathAbravIt |
samakShaM pArthivendrasya vAkyaM vAkyavishAradaH
shlokas.17:
gachCha shIghraM mahArAja haiDimbaM yuddhadurmadam |
vArayasva raNe yatto miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm
rAkShasaM krUrakarmANaM yathendrastArakaM purA
shlokas.18:
tava divyAni chAstrANi vikramashcha parantapa |
samAgamashcha bahubhiH purAbhUdasuraiH saha
shlokas.19:
tvaM tasya rAjashArdUla pratiyoddhA mahAhave |
svabalena vRRito rAja~njahi rAkShasapu~Ngavam
shlokas.20:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM bhIShmasya pRRitanApateH |
prayayau siMhanAdena parAnabhimukho drutam
shlokas.21:
tamAdravantaM samprekShya garjantamiva toyadam |
abhyavartanta sa~NkruddhAH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH
shlokas.22:
bhimaseno.abhimanyushcha rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH |
draupadeyAH satyadhRRitiH kShatradevashcha mAriSha
shlokas.23:
chedipo vasudAnashcha dashArNAdhipatistathA |
supratIkena tA.nshchApi bhagadatto.apyupAdravat
shlokas.24:
tataH samabhavadyuddhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAnakam |
pANDUnAM bhagadattena yamarAShTravivardhanam
shlokas.25:
pramuktA rathibhirbANA bhImavegAH sutejanAH |
te nipeturmahArAja nAgeShu cha ratheShu cha
shlokas.26:
prabhinnAshcha mahAnAgA vinItA hastisAdibhiH |
parasparaM samAsAdya saMnipeturabhItavat
shlokas.27:
madAndhA roShasa.nrabdhA viShANAgrairmahAhave |
bibhidurdantamusalaiH samAsAdya parasparam
shlokas.28:
hayAshcha chAmarApIDAH prAsapANibhirAsthitAH |
choditAH sAdibhiH kShipraM nipeturitaretaram
shlokas.29:
pAdAtAshcha padAtyoghaistADitAH shaktitomaraiH |
nyapatanta tadA bhUmau shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.30:
rathinashcha tathA rAjankarNinAlIkasAyakaiH |
nihatya samare vIrAnsiMhanAdAnvinedire
shlokas.31:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne sa~NgrAme lomaharShaNe |
bhagadatto maheShvAso bhImasenamathAdravat
shlokas.32:
ku~njareNa prabhinnena saptadhA sravatA madam |
parvatena yathA toyaM sravamANena sarvataH
shlokas.33:
kira~nsharasahasrANi supratIkashirogataH |
airAvatastho maghavAnvAridhArA ivAnagha
shlokas.34:
sa bhImaM sharadhArAbhistADayAmAsa pArthivaH |
parvataM vAridhArAbhiH prAvRRiShIva balAhakaH
shlokas.35:
bhImasenastu sa~NkruddhaH pAdarakShAnparaHshatAn |
nijaghAna maheShvAsaH sa~NkruddhaH sharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.36:
tAndRRiShTvA nihatAnkruddho bhagadattaH pratApavAn |
chodayAmAsa nAgendraM bhImasenarathaM prati
shlokas.37:
sa nAgaH preShitastena bANo jyAchodito yathA |
abhyadhAvata vegena bhImasenamari.ndamam
shlokas.38:
tamApatantaM samprekShya pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
abhyavartanta vegena bhImasenapurogamAH
shlokas.39:
kekayAshchAbhimanyushcha draupadeyAshcha sarvashaH |
dashArNAdhipatiH shUraH kShatradevashcha mAriSha
chedipashchitraketushcha sa~NkruddhAH sarva eva te
shlokas.40:
uttamAstrANi divyAni darshayanto mahAbalAH |
tamekaM ku~njaraM kruddhAH samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.41:
sa viddho bahubhirbANairvyarochata mahAdvipaH |
sa~njAtarudhirotpIDo dhAtuchitra ivAdrirAT
shlokas.42:
dashArNAdhipatishchApi gajaM bhUmidharopamam |
samAsthito.abhidudrAva bhagadattasya vAraNam
shlokas.43:
tamApatantaM samare gajaM gajapatiH sa cha |
dadhAra supratIko.api veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.44:
vAritaM prekShya nAgendraM dashArNasya mahAtmanaH |
sAdhu sAdhviti sainyAni pANDaveyAnyapUjayan
shlokas.45:
tataH prAgjyotiShaH kruddhastomarAnvai chaturdasha |
prAhiNottasya nAgasya pramukhe nRRipasattama
shlokas.46:
tasya varma mukhatrANaM shAtakumbhapariShkRRitam |
vidArya prAvishankShipraM valmIkamiva pannagAH
shlokas.47:
sa gADhaviddho vyathito nAgo bharatasattama |
upAvRRittamadaH kShipraM sa nyavartata vegataH
shlokas.48:
pradudrAva cha vegena praNadanbhairavaM svanam |
sa mardamAnaH svabalaM vAyurvRRikShAnivaujasA
shlokas.49:
tasminparAjite nAge pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
siMhanAdaM vinadyochchairyuddhAyaivopatasthire
shlokas.50:
tato bhImaM puraskRRitya bhagadattamupAdravan |
kiranto vividhAnbANA~nshastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.51:
teShAmApatatAM rAjansa~NkruddhAnAmamarShiNAm |
shrutvA sa ninadaM ghoramamarShAdgatasAdhvasaH
bhagadatto maheShvAsaH svanAgaM pratyachodayat
shlokas.52:
a~NkushA~NguShThanuditaH sa gajapravaro yudhi |
tasminkShaNe samabhavatsa.nvartaka ivAnalaH
shlokas.53:
rathasa~NghA.nstathA nAgAnhayA.nshcha saha sAdibhiH |
pAdAtA.nshcha susa~NkruddhaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
amRRidnAtsamare rAjansampradhAva.nstatastataH
shlokas.54:
tena sa.nloDyamAnaM tu pANDUnAM tadbalaM mahat |
sa~nchukocha mahArAja charmevAgnau samAhitam
shlokas.55:
bhagnaM tu svabalaM dRRiShTvA bhagadattena dhImatA |
ghaTotkacho.atha sa~Nkruddho bhagadattamupAdravat
shlokas.56:
vikaTaH puruSho rAjandIptAsyo dIptalochanaH |
rUpaM vibhIShaNaM kRRitvA roSheNa prajvalanniva
shlokas.57:
jagrAha vipulaM shUlaM girINAmapi dAraNam |
nAgaM jighA.nsuH sahasA chikShepa cha mahAbalaH
saviShphuli~NgajvAlAbhiH samantAtpariveShTitam
shlokas.58:
tamApatantaM sahasA dRRiShTvA jvAlAkulaM raNe |
chikShepa ruchiraM tIkShNamardhachandraM sa pArthivaH
chichCheda sumahachChUlaM tena bANena vegavat
shlokas.59:
nipapAta dvidhA ChinnaM shUlaM hemapariShkRRitam |
mahAshaniryathA bhraShTA shakramuktA nabhogatA
shlokas.60:
shUlaM nipatitaM dRRiShTvA dvidhA kRRittaM sa pArthivaH |
rukmadaNDAM mahAshaktiM jagrAhAgnishikhopamAm
chikShepa tAM rAkShasasya tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.61:
tAmApatantIM samprekShya viyatsthAmashanImiva |
utpatya rAkShasastUrNaM jagrAha cha nanAda cha
shlokas.62:
babha~nja chainAM tvarito jAnunyAropya bhArata |
pashyataH pArthivendrasya tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.63:
tadavekShya kRRitaM karma rAkShasena balIyasA |
divi devAH sagandharvA munayashchApi vismitAH
shlokas.64:
pANDavAshcha maheShvAsA bhImasenapurogamAH |
sAdhu sAdhviti nAdena pRRithivImanunAdayan
shlokas.65:
taM tu shrutvA mahAnAdaM prahRRiShTAnAM mahAtmanAm |
nAmRRiShyata maheShvAso bhagadattaH pratApavAn
shlokas.66:
sa visphArya mahachchApamindrAshanisamasvanam |
abhidudrAva vegena pANDavAnAM mahArathAn
visRRijanvimalA.nstIkShNAnnArAchA~njvalanaprabhAn
shlokas.67:
bhImamekena vivyAdha rAkShasaM navabhiH sharaiH |
abhimanyuM tribhishchaiva kekayAnpa~nchabhistathA
shlokas.68:
pUrNAyatavisRRiShTena svarNapu~Nkhena patriNA |
bibheda dakShiNaM bAhuM kShatradevasya chAhave
papAta sahasA tasya sasharaM dhanuruttamam
shlokas.69:
draupadeyA.nstataH pa~ncha pa~nchabhiH samatADayat |
bhImasenasya cha krodhAnnijaghAna tura~NgamAn
shlokas.70:
dhvajaM kesariNaM chAsya chichCheda vishikhaistribhiH |
nirbibheda tribhishchAnyaiH sArathiM chAsya patribhiH
shlokas.71:
sa gADhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upAvishat |
vishoko bharatashreShTha bhagadattena sa.nyuge
shlokas.72:
tato bhImo mahArAja viratho rathinAM varaH |
gadAM pragRRihya vegena prachaskanda mahArathAt
shlokas.73:
tamudyatagadaM dRRiShTvA sashRRi~Ngamiva parvatam |
tAvakAnAM bhayaM ghoraM samapadyata bhArata
shlokas.74:
etasminneva kAle tu pANDavaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
AjagAma mahArAja nighna~nshatrUnsahasrashaH
shlokas.75:
yatra tau puruShavyAghrau pitAputrau parantapau |
prAgjyotiSheNa sa.nsaktau bhImasenaghaTotkachau
shlokas.76:
dRRiShTvA tu pANDavo rAjanyudhyamAnAnmahArathAn |
tvarito bharatashreShTha tatrAyAdvikira~nsharAn
shlokas.77:
tato duryodhano rAjA tvaramANo mahArathaH |
senAmachodayatkShipraM rathanAgAshvasa~NkulAm
shlokas.78:
tAmApatantIM sahasA kauravANAM mahAchamUm |
abhidudrAva vegena pANDavaH shvetavAhanaH
shlokas.79:
bhagadatto.api samare tena nAgena bhArata |
vimRRidnanpANDavabalaM yudhiShThiramupAdravat
shlokas.80:
tadAsIttumulaM yuddhaM bhagadattasya mAriSha |
pA~nchAlaiH sRRi~njayaishchaiva kekayaishchodyatAyudhaiH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
putraM tu nihataM shrutvA irAvantaM dhana~njayaH |
duHkhena mahatAviShTo niHshvasanpannago yathA
shlokas.2:
abravItsamare rAjanvAsudevamidaM vachaH |
idaM nUnaM mahAprAj~no viduro dRRiShTavAnpurA
shlokas.3:
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha kShayaM ghoraM mahAmatiH |
tato nivArayitavAndhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram
shlokas.4:
avadhyA bahavo vIrAH sa~NgrAme madhusUdana |
nihatAH kauravaiH sa~Nkhye tathAsmAbhishcha te hatAH
shlokas.5:
arthahetornarashreShTha kriyate karma kutsitam |
dhigarthAnyatkRRite hyevaM kriyate j~nAtisa~NkShayaH
shlokas.6:
adhanasya mRRitaM shreyo na cha j~nAtivadhAddhanam |
kiM nu prApsyAmahe kRRiShNa hatvA j~nAtInsamAgatAn
shlokas.7:
duryodhanAparAdhena shakuneH saubalasya cha |
kShatriyA nidhanaM yAnti karNadurmantritena cha
shlokas.8:
idAnIM cha vijAnAmi sukRRitaM madhusUdana |
kRRitaM rAj~nA mahAbAho yAchatA sma suyodhanam
rAjyArdhaM pa~ncha vA grAmAnnAkArShItsa cha durmatiH
shlokas.9:
dRRiShTvA hi kShatriyA~nshUrA~nshayAnAndharaNItale |
nindAmi bhRRishamAtmAnaM dhigastu kShatrajIvikAm
shlokas.10:
ashaktamiti mAmete j~nAsyanti kShatriyA raNe |
yuddhaM mamaibhiruchitaM j~nAtibhirmadhusUdana
shlokas.11:
sa~nchodaya hayAnkShipraM dhArtarAShTrachamUM prati |
pratariShye mahApAraM bhujAbhyAM samarodadhim
nAyaM klIbayituM kAlo vidyate mAdhava kvachit
shlokas.12:
evamuktastu pArthena keshavaH paravIrahA |
chodayAmAsa tAnashvAnpANDurAnvAtaraMhasaH
shlokas.13:
atha shabdo mahAnAsIttava sainyasya bhArata |
mArutoddhUtavegasya sAgarasyeva parvaNi
shlokas.14:
aparAhNe mahArAja sa~NgrAmaH samapadyata |
parjanyasamanirghoSho bhIShmasya saha pANDavaiH
shlokas.15:
tato rAja.nstava sutA bhImasenamupAdravan |
parivArya raNe droNaM vasavo vAsavaM yathA
shlokas.16:
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmaH kRRipashcha rathinAM varaH |
bhagadattaH susharmA cha dhana~njayamupAdravan
shlokas.17:
hArdikyo bAhlikashchaiva sAtyakiM samabhidrutau |
ambaShThakastu nRRipatirabhimanyumavArayat
shlokas.18:
sheShAstvanye mahArAja sheShAneva mahArathAn |
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAvaham
shlokas.19:
bhImasenastu samprekShya putrA.nstava janeshvara |
prajajvAla raNe kruddho haviShA havyavADiva
shlokas.20:
putrAstu tava kaunteyaM ChAdayAM chakrire sharaiH |
prAvRRiShIva mahArAja jaladAH parvataM yathA
shlokas.21:
sa chChAdyamAno bahudhA putraistava vishAM pate |
sRRikkiNI vilihanvIraH shArdUla iva darpitaH
shlokas.22:
vyUDhoraskaM tato bhImaH pAtayAmAsa pArthiva |
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena so.abhavadgatajIvitaH
shlokas.23:
apareNa tu bhallena pItena nishitena cha |
apAtayatkuNDalinaM siMhaH kShudramRRigaM yathA
shlokas.24:
tataH sunishitAnpItAnsamAdatta shilImukhAn |
sa sapta tvarayA yuktaH putrA.nste prApya mAriSha
shlokas.25:
preShitA bhImasenena sharAste dRRiDhadhanvanA |
apAtayanta putrA.nste rathebhyaH sumahArathAn
shlokas.26:
anAdhRRiShTiM kuNDabhedaM vairATaM dIrghalochanam |
dIrghabAhuM subAhuM cha tathaiva kanakadhvajam
shlokas.27:
prapatanta sma te vIrA virejurbharatarShabha |
vasante puShpashabalAshchUtAH prapatitA iva
shlokas.28:
tataH pradudruvuH sheShAH putrAstava vishAM pate |
taM kAlamiva manyanto bhImasenaM mahAbalam
shlokas.29:
droNastu samare vIraM nirdahantaM sutA.nstava |
yathAdriM vAridhArAbhiH samantAdvyakirachCharaiH
shlokas.30:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma kuntIputrasya pauruSham |
droNena vAryamANo.api nijaghne yatsutA.nstava
shlokas.31:
yathA hi govRRiSho varShaM sandhArayati khAtpatat |
bhImastathA droNamuktaM sharavarShamadIdharat
shlokas.32:
adbhutaM cha mahArAja tatra chakre vRRikodaraH |
yatputrA.nste.avadhItsa~Nkhye droNaM chaiva nyayodhayat
shlokas.33:
putreShu tava vIreShu chikrIDArjunapUrvajaH |
mRRigeShviva mahArAja charanvyAghro mahAbalaH
shlokas.34:
yathA vA pashumadhyastho drAvayeta pashUnvRRikaH |
vRRikodarastava sutA.nstathA vyadrAvayadraNe
shlokas.35:
gA~Ngeyo bhagadattashcha gautamashcha mahArathaH |
pANDavaM rabhasaM yuddhe vArayAmAsurarjunam
shlokas.36:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya teShAM so.atiratho raNe |
pravIrA.nstava sainyeShu preShayAmAsa mRRityave
shlokas.37:
abhimanyushcha rAjAnamambaShThaM lokavishrutam |
virathaM rathinAM shreShThaM kArayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.38:
viratho vadhyamAnaH sa saubhadreNa yashasvinA |
avaplutya rathAttUrNaM savrIDo manujAdhipaH
shlokas.39:
asiM chikShepa samare saubhadrasya mahAtmanaH |
Aruroha rathaM chaiva hArdikyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.40:
ApatantaM tu nistri.nshaM yuddhamArgavishAradaH |
lAghavAdvya.nsayAmAsa saubhadraH paravIrahA
shlokas.41:
vya.nsitaM vIkShya nistri.nshaM saubhadreNa raNe tadA |
sAdhu sAdhviti sainyAnAM praNAdo.abhUdvishAM pate
shlokas.42:
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhAstvanye tava sainyamayodhayan |
tathaiva tAvakAH sarve pANDusainyamayodhayan
shlokas.43:
tatrAkrando mahAnAsIttava teShAM cha bhArata |
nighnatAM bhRRishamanyonyaM kurvatAM karma duShkaram
shlokas.44:
anyonyaM hi raNe shUrAH kesheShvAkShipya mAriSha |
nakhairdantairayudhyanta muShTibhirjAnubhistathA
shlokas.45:
bAhubhishcha talaishchaiva nistri.nshaishcha susa.nshitaiH |
vivaraM prApya chAnyonyamanayanyamasAdanam
shlokas.46:
nyahanachcha pitA putraM putrashcha pitaraM raNe |
vyAkulIkRRitasa~NkalpA yuyudhustatra mAnavAH
shlokas.47:
raNe chArUNi chApAni hemapRRiShThAni bhArata |
hatAnAmapaviddhAni kalApAshcha mahAdhanAH
shlokas.48:
jAtarUpamayaiH pu~Nkhai rAjataishcha shitAH sharAH |
tailadhautA vyarAjanta nirmuktabhujagopamAH
shlokas.49:
hastidantatsarUnkhaDgA~njAtarUpapariShkRRitAn |
charmANi chApaviddhAni rukmapRRiShThAni dhanvinAm
shlokas.50:
suvarNavikRRitaprAsAnpaTTishAnhemabhUShitAn |
jAtarUpamayAshcharShTIH shaktyashcha kanakojjvalAH
shlokas.51:
apakRRittAshcha patitA musalAni gurUNi cha |
parighAnpaTTishA.nshchaiva bhiNDipAlA.nshcha mAriSha
shlokas.52:
patitA.nstomarA.nshchApi chitrA hemapariShkRRitAH |
kuthAshcha bahudhAkArAshchAmaravyajanAni cha
shlokas.53:
nAnAvidhAni shastrANi visRRijya patitA narAH |
jIvanta iva dRRishyante gatasattvA mahArathAH
shlokas.54:
gadAvimathitairgAtrairmusalairbhinnamastakAH |
gajavAjirathakShuNNAH sherate sma narAH kShitau
shlokas.55:
tathaivAshvanRRinAgAnAM sharIrairAbabhau tadA |
sa~nChannA vasudhA rAjanparvatairiva sarvataH
shlokas.56:
samare patitaishchaiva shaktyRRiShTisharatomaraiH |
nistri.nshaiH paTTishaiH prAsairayaskuntaiH parashvadhaiH
shlokas.57:
parighairbhiNDipAlaishcha shataghnIbhistathaiva cha |
sharIraiH shastrabhinnaishcha samAstIryata medinI
shlokas.58:
niHshabdairalpashabdaishcha shoNitaughapariplutaiH |
gatAsubhiramitraghna vibabhau sa.nvRRitA mahI
shlokas.59:
satalatraiH sakeyUrairbAhubhishchandanokShitaiH |
hastihastopamaishChinnairUrubhishcha tarasvinAm
shlokas.60:
baddhachUDAmaNidharaiH shirobhishcha sakuNDalaiH |
patitairvRRiShabhAkShANAM babhau bhArata medinI
shlokas.61:
kavachaiH shoNitAdigdhairviprakIrNaishcha kA~nchanaiH |
rarAja subhRRishaM bhUmiH shAntArchibhirivAnalaiH
shlokas.62:
vipraviddhaiH kalApaishcha patitaishcha sharAsanaiH |
viprakIrNaiH sharaishchApi rukmapu~NkhaiH samantataH
shlokas.63:
rathaishcha bahubhirbhagnaiH ki~NkiNIjAlamAlibhiH |
vAjibhishcha hataiH kIrNaiH srastajihvaiH sashoNitaiH
shlokas.64:
anukarShaiH patAkAbhirupAsa~Ngairdhvajairapi |
pravIrANAM mahAsha~NkhairviprakIrNaishcha pANDuraiH
shlokas.65:
srastahastaishcha mAta~NgaiH shayAnairvibabhau mahI |
nAnArUpairala~NkAraiH pramadevAbhyala~NkRRitA
shlokas.66:
dantibhishchAparaistatra saprAsairgADhavedanaiH |
karaiH shabdaM vimu~nchadbhiH shIkaraM cha muhurmuhuH
vibabhau tadraNasthAnaM dhamyamAnairivAchalaiH
shlokas.67:
nAnArAgaiH kambalaishcha paristomaishcha dantinAm |
vaiDUryamaNidaNDaishcha patitaira~NkushaiH shubhaiH
shlokas.68:
ghaNTAbhishcha gajendrANAM patitAbhiH samantataH |
vighATitavichitrAbhiH kuthAbhI rA~NkavaistathA
shlokas.69:
graiveyaishchitrarUpaishcha rukmakakShyAbhireva cha |
yantraishcha bahudhA Chinnaistomaraishcha sakampanaiH
shlokas.70:
ashvAnAM reNukapilai rukmachChannairurashChadaiH |
sAdinAM cha bhujaishChinnaiH patitaiH sA~NgadaistathA
shlokas.71:
prAsaishcha vimalaistIkShNairvimalAbhistatharShTibhiH |
uShNIShaishcha tathA ChinnaiH praviddhaishcha tatastataH
shlokas.76:
evamete mahAsene mRRidite tatra bhArata |
parasparaM samAsAdya tava teShAM cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.77:
teShu shrAnteShu bhagneShu mRRiditeShu cha bhArata |
rAtriH samabhavadghorA nApashyAma tato raNam
shlokas.78:
tato.avahAraM sainyAnAM prachakruH kurupANDavAH |
ghore nishAmukhe raudre vartamAne sudAruNe
shlokas.79:
avahAraM tataH kRRitvA sahitAH kurupANDavAH |
nyavishanta yathAkAlaM gatvA svashibiraM tadA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato duryodhano rAjA shakunishchApi saubalaH |
duHshAsanashcha putraste sUtaputrashcha durjayaH
shlokas.2:
samAgamya mahArAja mantraM chakrUrvivakShitam |
kathaM pANDusutA yuddhe jetavyAH sagaNA iti
shlokas.3:
tato duryodhano rAjA sarvA.nstAnAha mantriNaH |
sUtaputraM samAbhAShya saubalaM cha mahAbalam
shlokas.4:
droNo bhIShmaH kRRipaH shalyaH saumadattishcha sa.nyuge |
na pArthAnpratibAdhante na jAne tatra kAraNam
shlokas.5:
avadhyamAnAste chApi kShapayanti balaM mama |
so.asmi kShINabalaH karNa kShINashastrashcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.6:
nikRRitaH pANDavaiH shUrairavadhyairdaivatairapi |
so.ahaM sa.nshayamApannaH prakariShye kathaM raNam
shlokas.7:
tamabravInmahArAja sUtaputro narAdhipam |
mA shucho bharatashreShTha prakariShye priyaM tava
shlokas.8:
bhIShmaH shAntanavastUrNamapayAtu mahAraNAt |
nivRRitte yudhi gA~Ngeye nyastashastre cha bhArata
shlokas.9:
ahaM pArthAnhaniShyAmi sanitAnsarvasomakaiH |
pashyato yudhi bhIShmasya shape satyena te nRRipa
shlokas.10:
pANDaveShu dayAM rAjansadA bhIShmaH karoti vai |
ashaktashcha raNe bhIShmo jetumetAnmahArathAn
shlokas.11:
abhimAnI raNe bhIShmo nityaM chApi raNapriyaH |
sa kathaM pANDavAnyuddhe jeShyate tAta sa~NgatAn
shlokas.12:
sa tvaM shIghramito gatvA bhIShmasya shibiraM prati |
anumAnya raNe bhIShmaM shastraM nyAsaya bhArata
shlokas.13:
nyastashastre tato bhIShme nihatAnpashya pANDavAn |
mayaikena raNe rAjansasuhRRidgaNabAndhavAn
shlokas.14:
evamuktastu karNena putro duryodhanastava |
abravIdbhrAtaraM tatra duHshAsanamidaM vachaH
shlokas.15:
anuyAtraM yathA sajjaM sarvaM bhavati sarvataH |
duHshAsana tathA kShipraM sarvamevopapAdaya
shlokas.16:
evamuktvA tato rAjankarNamAha janeshvaraH |
anumAnya raNe bhIShmamito.ahaM dvipadAM varam
shlokas.17:
AgamiShye tataH kShipraM tvatsakAshamari.ndama |
tatastvaM puruShavyAghra prakariShyasi sa.nyugam
shlokas.18:
niShpapAta tatastUrNaM putrastava vishAM pate |
sahito bhrAtRRibhiH sarvairdevairiva shatakratuH
shlokas.19:
tatastaM nRRipashArdUlaM shArdUlasamavikramam |
ArohayaddhayaM tUrNaM bhrAtA duHshAsanastadA
shlokas.20:
a~NgadI baddhamukuTo hastAbharaNavAnnRRipaH |
dhArtarAShTro mahArAja vibabhau sa mahendravat
shlokas.21:
bhANDIpuShpanikAshena tapanIyanibhena cha |
anuliptaH parArdhyena chandanena sugandhinA
shlokas.22:
arajombarasa.nvItaH siMhakhelagatirnRRipaH |
shushubhe vimalArchiShma~nsharadIva divAkaraH
shlokas.23:
taM prayAntaM naravyAghraM bhIShmasya shibiraM prati |
anujagmurmaheShvAsAH sarvalokasya dhanvinaH
bhrAtarashcha maheShvAsAstridashA iva vAsavam
shlokas.24:
hayAnanye samAruhya gajAnanye cha bhArata |
rathairanye narashreShThAH parivavruH samantataH
shlokas.25:
AttashastrAshcha suhRRido rakShaNArthaM mahIpateH |
prAdurbabhUvuH sahitAH shakrasyevAmarA divi
shlokas.26:
sampUjyamAnaH kurubhiH kauravANAM mahArathaH |
prayayau sadanaM rAjangA~Ngeyasya yashasvinaH
anvIyamAnaH sahitaiH sodaraiH sarvato nRRipaH
shlokas.27:
dakShiNaM dakShiNaH kAle sambhRRitya svabhujaM tadA |
hastihastopamaM shaikShaM sarvashatrunibarhaNam
shlokas.28:
pragRRihNanna~njalInnR^INAmudyatAnsarvatodisham |
shushrAva madhurA vAcho nAnAdeshanivAsinAm
shlokas.29:
sa.nstUyamAnaH sUtaishcha mAgadhaishcha mahAyashAH |
pUjayAnashcha tAnsarvAnsarvalokeshvareshvaraH
shlokas.30:
pradIpaiH kA~nchanaistatra gandhatailAvasechanaiH |
parivavrurmahAtmAnaM prajvaladbhiH samantataH
shlokas.31:
sa taiH parivRRito rAjA pradIpaiH kA~nchanaiH shubhaiH |
shushubhe chandramA yukto dIptairiva mahAgrahaiH
shlokas.32:
ka~nchukoShNIShiNastatra vetrajharjharapANayaH |
protsArayantaH shanakaistaM janaM sarvatodisham
shlokas.33:
samprApya tu tato rAjA bhIShmasya sadanaM shubham |
avatIrya hayAchchApi bhIShmaM prApya janeshvaraH
shlokas.34:
abhivAdya tato bhIShmaM niShaNNaH paramAsane |
kA~nchane sarvatobhadre spardhyAstaraNasa.nvRRite
uvAcha prA~njalirbhIShmaM bAShpakaNTho.ashrulochanaH
shlokas.35:
tvAM vayaM samupAshritya sa.nyuge shatrusUdana |
utsahema raNe jetuM sendrAnapi surAsurAn
shlokas.36:
kimu pANDusutAnvIrAnsasuhRRidgaNabAndhavAn |
tasmAdarhasi gA~Ngeya kRRipAM kartuM mayi prabho
jahi pANDusutAnvIrAnmahendra iva dAnavAn
shlokas.37:
pUrvamuktaM mahAbAho nihaniShyAmi somakAn |
pA~nchAlAnpANDavaiH sArdhaM karUShA.nshcheti bhArata
shlokas.38:
tadvachaH satyamevAstu jahi pArthAnsamAgatAn |
somakA.nshcha maheShvAsAnsatyavAgbhava bhArata
shlokas.39:
dayayA yadi vA rAjandveShyabhAvAnmama prabho |
mandabhAgyatayA vApi mama rakShasi pANDavAn
shlokas.40:
anujAnIhi samare karNamAhavashobhinam |
sa jeShyati raNe pArthAnsasuhRRidgaNabAndhavAn
shlokas.41:
etAvaduktvA nRRipatiH putro duryodhanastava |
novAcha vachanaM ki~nchidbhIShmaM bhImaparAkramam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vAkShalyaistava putreNa so.atividdhaH pitAmahaH |
duHkhena mahatAviShTo novAchApriyamaNvapi
shlokas.2:
sa dhyAtvA suchiraM kAlaM duHkharoShasamanvitaH |
shvasamAno yathA nAgaH praNunno vai shalAkayA
shlokas.3:
udvRRitya chakShuShI kopAnnirdahanniva bhArata |
sadevAsuragandharvaM lokaM lokavidAM varaH
abravIttava putraM tu sAmapUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.4:
kiM nu duryodhanaivaM mAM vAkShalyairupavidhyasi |
ghaTamAnaM yathAshakti kurvANaM cha tava priyam
juhvAnaM samare prANA.nstavaiva hitakAmyayA
shlokas.5:
yadA tu pANDavaH shUraH khANDave.agnimatarpayat |
parAjitya raNe shakraM paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.6:
yadA cha tvAM mahAbAho gandharvairhRRitamojasA |
amochayatpANDusutaH paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.7:
dravamANeShu shUreShu sodareShu tathAbhibho |
sUtaputre cha rAdheye paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.8:
yachcha naH sahitAnsarvAnvirATanagare tadA |
eka eva samudyAtaH paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.9:
droNaM cha yudhi sa.nrabdhaM mAM cha nirjitya sa.nyuge |
karNaM cha tvAM cha drauNiM cha kRRipaM cha sumahAratham
vAsA.nsi sa samAdatta paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.10:
nivAtakavachAnyuddhe vAsavenApi durjayAn |
jitavAnsamare pArthaH paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.11:
ko hi shakto raNe jetuM pANDavaM rabhasaM raNe |
tvaM tu mohAnna jAnIShe vAchyAvAchyaM suyodhana
shlokas.12:
mumUrShurhi naraH sarvAnvRRikShAnpashyati kA~nchanAn |
tathA tvamapi gAndhAre viparItAni pashyasi
shlokas.13:
svayaM vairaM mahatkRRitvA pANDavaiH sahasRRi~njayaiH |
yudhyasva tAnadya raNe pashyAmaH puruSho bhava
shlokas.14:
ahaM tu somakAnsarvAnsapA~nchAlAnsamAgatAn |
nihaniShye naravyAghra varjayitvA shikhaNDinam
shlokas.15:
tairvAhaM nihataH sa~Nkhye gamiShye yamasAdanam |
tAnvA nihatya sa~NgrAme prItiM dAsyAmi vai tava
shlokas.16:
pUrvaM hi strI samutpannA shikhaNDI rAjaveshmani |
varadAnAtpumA~njAtaH saiShA vai strI shikhaNDinI
shlokas.17:
tAmahaM na haniShyAmi prANatyAge.api bhArata |
yAsau prA~NnirmitA dhAtrA saiShA vai strI shikhaNDinI
shlokas.18:
sukhaM svapihi gAndhAre shvo.asmi kartA mahAraNam |
yajjanAH kathayiShyanti yAvatsthAsyati medinI
shlokas.19:
evamuktastava suto nirjagAma janeshvara |
abhivAdya guruM mUrdhnA prayayau svaM niveshanam
shlokas.20:
Agamya tu tato rAjA visRRijya cha mahAjanam |
pravivesha tatastUrNaM kShayaM shatrukShaya~NkaraH
praviShTaH sa nishAM tAM cha gamayAmAsa pArthivaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prabhAtAyAM tu sharvaryAM prAtarutthAya vai nRRipaH |
rAj~naH samAj~nApayata senAM yojayateti ha
adya bhIShmo raNe kruddho nihaniShyati somakAn
shlokas.2:
duryodhanasya tachChrutvA rAtrau vilapitaM bahu |
manyamAnaH sa taM rAjanpratyAdeshamivAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
nirvedaM paramaM gatvA vinindya paravAchyatAm |
dIrghaM dadhyau shAntanavo yoddhukAmo.arjunaM raNe
shlokas.4:
i~Ngitena tu tajj~nAtvA gA~Ngeyena vichintitam |
duryodhano mahArAja duHshAsanamachodayat
shlokas.5:
duHshAsana rathAstUrNaM yujyantAM bhIShmarakShiNaH |
dvAtri.nshattvamanIkAni sarvANyevAbhichodaya
shlokas.6:
idaM hi samanuprAptaM varShapUgAbhichintitam |
pANDavAnAM sasainyAnAM vadho rAjyasya chAgamaH
shlokas.7:
tatra kAryamahaM manye bhIShmasyaivAbhirakShaNam |
sa no guptaH sukhAya syAddhanyAtpArthA.nshcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.8:
abravIchcha vishuddhAtmA nAhaM hanyAM shikhaNDinam |
strIpUrvako hyasau jAtastasmAdvarjyo raNe mayA
shlokas.9:
lokastadveda yadahaM pituH priyachikIrShayA |
rAjyaM sphItaM mahAbAho striyashcha tyaktavAnpurA
shlokas.10:
naiva chAhaM striyaM jAtu na strIpUrvaM katha~nchana |
hanyAM yudhi narashreShTha satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.11:
ayaM strIpUrvako rAja~nshikhaNDI yadi te shrutaH |
udyoge kathitaM yattattathA jAtA shikhaNDinI
shlokas.12:
kanyA bhUtvA pumA~njAtaH sa cha yotsyati bhArata |
tasyAhaM pramukhe bANAnna mu~ncheyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.13:
yuddhe tu kShatriyA.nstAta pANDavAnAM jayaiShiNaH |
sarvAnanyAnhaniShyAmi samprAptAnbANagocharAn
shlokas.14:
evaM mAM bharatashreShTho gA~NgeyaH prAha shAstravit |
tatra sarvAtmanA manye bhIShmasyaivAbhipAlanam
shlokas.15:
arakShyamANaM hi vRRiko hanyAtsiMhaM mahAvane |
mA vRRikeNeva shArdUlaM ghAtayema shikhaNDinA
shlokas.16:
mAtulaH shakuniH shalyaH kRRipo droNo vivi.nshatiH |
yattA rakShantu gA~NgeyaM tasmingupte dhruvo jayaH
shlokas.17:
etachChrutvA tu rAjAno duryodhanavachastadA |
sarvato rathava.nshena gA~NgeyaM paryavArayan
shlokas.18:
putrAshcha tava gA~NgeyaM parivArya yayurmudA |
kampayanto bhuvaM dyAM cha kShobhayantashcha pANDavAn
shlokas.19:
tai rathaishcha susa.nyuktairdantibhishcha mahArathAH |
parivArya raNe bhIShmaM da.nshitAH samavasthitAH
shlokas.20:
yathA devAsure yuddhe tridashA vajradhAriNam |
sarve te sma vyatiShThanta rakShantastaM mahAratham
shlokas.21:
tato duryodhano rAjA punarbhrAtaramabravIt |
savyaM chakraM yudhAmanyuruttamaujAshcha dakShiNam
goptArAvarjunasyaitAvarjuno.api shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.22:
sa rakShyamANaH pArthena tathAsmAbhirvivarjitaH |
yathA bhIShmaM na no hanyAdduHshAsana tathA kuru
shlokas.23:
bhrAtustadvachanaM shrutvA putro duHshAsanastava |
bhIShmaM pramukhataH kRRitvA prayayau senayA saha
shlokas.24:
bhIShmaM tu rathava.nshena dRRiShTvA tamabhisa.nvRRitam |
arjuno rathinAM shreShTho dhRRiShTadyumnamuvAcha ha
shlokas.25:
shikhaNDinaM naravyAghra bhIShmasya pramukhe.anagha |
sthApayasvAdya pA~nchAlya tasya goptAhamapyuta
shlokas.26:
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmo niryayau senayA saha |
vyUhaM chAvyUhata mahatsarvatobhadramAhave
shlokas.27:
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha shaibyashchaiva mahArathaH |
shakuniH saindhavashchaiva kAmbojashcha sudakShiNaH
shlokas.28:
bhIShmeNa sahitAH sarve putraishcha tava bhArata |
agrataH sarvasainyAnAM vyUhasya pramukhe sthitAH
shlokas.29:
droNo bhUrishravAH shalyo bhagadattashcha mAriSha |
dakShiNaM pakShamAshritya sthitA vyUhasya da.nshitAH
shlokas.30:
ashvatthAmA somadatta Avantyau cha mahArathau |
mahatyA senayA yuktA vAmaM pakShamapAlayan
shlokas.31:
duryodhano mahArAja trigartaiH sarvato vRRitaH |
vyUhamadhye sthito rAjanpANDavAnprati bhArata
shlokas.32:
alambuso rathashreShThaH shrutAyushcha mahArathaH |
pRRiShThataH sarvasainyAnAM sthitau vyUhasya da.nshitau
shlokas.33:
evamete tadA vyUhaM kRRitvA bhArata tAvakAH |
saMnaddhAH samadRRishyanta pratapanta ivAgnayaH
shlokas.34:
tathA yudhiShThiro rAjA bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha mAdrIputrAvubhAvapi
agrataH sarvasainyAnAM sthitA vyUhasya da.nshitAH
shlokas.35:
dhRRiShTadyumno virATashcha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
sthitAH sainyena mahatA parAnIkavinAshanAH
shlokas.36:
shikhaNDI vijayashchaiva rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH |
chekitAno mahAbAhuH kuntibhojashcha vIryavAn
sthitA raNe mahArAja mahatyA senayA vRRitAH
shlokas.37:
abhimanyurmaheShvAso drupadashcha mahArathaH |
kekayA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha sthitA yuddhAya da.nshitAH
shlokas.38:
evaM te.api mahAvyUhaM prativyUhya sudurjayam |
pANDavAH samare shUrAH sthitA yuddhAya mAriSha
shlokas.39:
tAvakAstu raNe yattAH sahasenA narAdhipAH |
abhyudyayU raNe pArthAnbhIShmaM kRRitvAgrato nRRipa
shlokas.40:
tathaiva pANDavA rAjanbhImasenapurogamAH |
bhIShmaM yuddhapariprepsuM sa~NgrAme vijigIShavaH
shlokas.41:
kShveDAH kilikilAshabdAnkrakachAngoviShANikAH |
bherImRRida~NgapaNavAnnAdayantashcha puShkarAn
pANDavA abhyadhAvanta nadanto bhairavAnravAn
shlokas.42:
bherImRRida~Ngasha~NkhAnAM dundubhInAM cha nisvanaiH |
utkruShTasiMhanAdaishcha valgitaishcha pRRithagvidhaiH
shlokas.43:
vayaM pratinadantastAnabhyagachChAma satvarAH |
sahasaivAbhisa~NkruddhAstadAsIttumulaM mahat
shlokas.44:
tato.anyonyaM pradhAvantaH samprahAraM prachakrire |
tataH shabdena mahatA prachakampe vasundharA
shlokas.45:
pakShiNashcha mahAghoraM vyAharanto vibabhramuH |
saprabhashchoditaH sUryo niShprabhaH samapadyata
shlokas.46:
vavushcha tumulA vAtAH sha.nsantaH sumahadbhayam |
ghorAshcha ghoranirhrAdAH shivAstatra vavAshire
vedayantyo mahArAja mahadvaishasamAgatam
shlokas.47:
dishaH prajvalitA rAjanpA.nsuvarShaM papAta cha |
rudhireNa samunmishramasthivarShaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.48:
rudatAM vAhanAnAM cha netrebhyaH prApatajjalam |
susruvushcha shakRRinmUtraM pradhyAyanto vishAM pate
shlokas.49:
antarhitA mahAnAdAH shrUyante bharatarShabha |
rakShasAM puruShAdAnAM nadatAM bhairavAnravAn
shlokas.50:
sampatantaH sma dRRishyante gomAyubakavAyasAH |
shvAnashcha vividhairnAdairbhaShantastatra tasthire
shlokas.51:
jvalitAshcha maholkA vai samAhatya divAkaram |
nipetuH sahasA bhUmau vedayAnA mahadbhayam
shlokas.52:
mahAntyanIkAni mahAsamuchChraye; samAgame pANDavadhArtarAShTrayoH |
prakAshire sha~NkhamRRida~NganisvanaiH; prakampitAnIva vanAni vAyunA
shlokas.53:
narendranAgAshvasamAkulAnA;mabhyAyatInAmashive muhUrte |
babhUva ghoShastumulashchamUnAM; vAtoddhutAnAmiva sAgarANAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
abhimanyU rathodAraH pisha~NgaisturagottamaiH |
abhidudrAva tejasvI duryodhanabalaM mahat
vikira~nsharavarShANi vAridhArA ivAmbudaH
shlokas.2:
na shekuH samare kruddhaM saubhadramarisUdanam |
shastraughiNaM gAhamAnaM senAsAgaramakShayam
nivArayitumapyAjau tvadIyAH kurupu~NgavAH
shlokas.3:
tena muktA raNe rAja~nsharAH shatrunibarhaNAH |
kShatriyAnanaya~nshUrAnpretarAjaniveshanam
shlokas.4:
yamadaNDopamAnghorA~njvalanAshIviShopamAn |
saubhadraH samare kruddhaH preShayAmAsa sAyakAn
shlokas.5:
rathinaM cha rathAttUrNaM hayapRRiShThAchcha sAdinam |
gajArohA.nshcha sagajAnpAtayAmAsa phAlguniH
shlokas.6:
tasya tatkurvataH karma mahatsa~Nkhye.adbhutaM nRRipAH |
pUjayAM chakrire hRRiShTAH prashasha.nsushcha phAlgunim
shlokas.7:
tAnyanIkAni saubhadro drAvayanbahvashobhata |
tUlarAshimivAdhUya mArutaH sarvatodisham
shlokas.8:
tena vidrAvyamANAni tava sainyAni bhArata |
trAtAraM nAdhyagachChanta pa~Nke magnA iva dvipAH
shlokas.9:
vidrAvya sarvasainyAni tAvakAni narottamaH |
abhimanyuH sthito rAjanvidhUmo.agniriva jvalan
shlokas.10:
na chainaM tAvakAH sarve viShehurarighAtinam |
pradIptaM pAvakaM yadvatpata~NgAH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.11:
praharansarvashatrubhyaH pANDavAnAM mahArathaH |
adRRishyata maheShvAsaH savajra iva vajrabhRRit
shlokas.12:
hemapRRiShThaM dhanushchAsya dadRRishe charato dishaH |
toyadeShu yathA rAjanbhrAjamAnAH shatahvadAH
shlokas.13:
sharAshcha nishitAH pItA nishcharanti sma sa.nyuge |
vanAtphulladrumAdrAjanbhramarANAmiva vrajAH
shlokas.14:
tathaiva charatastasya saubhadrasya mahAtmanaH |
rathena meghaghoSheNa dadRRishurnAntaraM janAH
shlokas.15:
mohayitvA kRRipaM droNaM drauNiM cha sa bRRihadbalam |
saindhavaM cha maheShvAsaM vyacharallaghu suShThu cha
shlokas.16:
maNDalIkRRitamevAsya dhanuH pashyAma mAriSha |
sUryamaNDalasa~NkAshaM tapatastava vAhinIm
shlokas.17:
taM dRRiShTvA kShatriyAH shUrAH pratapantaM sharArchibhiH |
dviphalgunamimaM lokaM menire tasya karmabhiH
shlokas.18:
tenArditA mahArAja bhAratI sA mahAchamUH |
babhrAma tatra tatraiva yoShinmadavashAdiva
shlokas.19:
drAvayitvA cha tatsainyaM kampayitvA mahArathAn |
nandayAmAsa suhRRido mayaM jitveva vAsavaH
shlokas.20:
tena vidrAvyamANAni tava sainyAni sa.nyuge |
chakrurArtasvaraM ghoraM parjanyaninadopamam
shlokas.21:
taM shrutvA ninadaM ghoraM tava sainyasya mAriSha |
mArutoddhUtavegasya samudrasyeva parvaNi
duryodhanastadA rAjA ArshyashRRi~NgimabhAShata
shlokas.22:
eSha kArShNirmaheShvAso dvitIya iva phalgunaH |
chamUM drAvayate krodhAdvRRitro devachamUmiva
shlokas.23:
tasya nAnyaM prapashyAmi sa.nyuge bheShajaM mahat |
RRite tvAM rAkShasashreShTha sarvavidyAsu pAragam
shlokas.24:
sa gatvA tvaritaM vIraM jahi saubhadramAhave |
vayaM pArthAnhaniShyAmo bhIShmadroNapuraHsarAH
shlokas.25:
sa evamukto balavAnrAkShasendraH pratApavAn |
prayayau samare tUrNaM tava putrasya shAsanAt
nardamAno mahAnAdaM prAvRRiShIva balAhakaH
shlokas.26:
tasya shabdena mahatA pANDavAnAM mahadbalam |
prAchalatsarvato rAjanpUryamANa ivArNavaH
shlokas.27:
bahavashcha narA rAja.nstasya nAdena bhIShitAH |
priyAnprANAnparityajya nipeturdharaNItale
shlokas.28:
kArShNishchApi mudA yuktaH pragRRihItasharAsanaH |
nRRityanniva rathopasthe tadrakShaH samupAdravat
shlokas.29:
tataH sa rAkShasaH kruddhaH samprApyaivArjuniM raNe |
nAtidUre sthitastasya drAvayAmAsa vai chamUm
shlokas.30:
sA vadhyamAnA samare pANDavAnAM mahAchamUH |
pratyudyayau raNe rakSho devasenA yathA balim
shlokas.31:
vimardaH sumahAnAsIttasya sainyasya mAriSha |
rakShasA ghorarUpeNa vadhyamAnasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.32:
tataH sharasahasraistAM pANDavAnAM mahAchamUm |
vyadrAvayadraNe rakSho darshayadvai parAkramam
shlokas.33:
sA vadhyamAnA cha tathA pANDavAnAmanIkinI |
rakShasA ghorarUpeNa pradudrAva raNe bhayAt
shlokas.34:
tAM pramRRidya tataH senAM padminIM vAraNo yathA |
tato.abhidudrAva raNe draupadeyAnmahAbalAn
shlokas.35:
te tu kruddhA maheShvAsA draupadeyAH prahAriNaH |
rAkShasaM dudruvuH sarve grahAH pa~ncha yathA ravim
shlokas.36:
vIryavadbhistatastaistu pIDito rAkShasottamaH |
yathA yugakShaye ghore chandramAH pa~nchabhirgrahaiH
shlokas.37:
prativindhyastato rakSho bibheda nishitaiH sharaiH |
sarvapArashavaistUrNamakuNThAgrairmahAbalaH
shlokas.38:
sa tairbhinnatanutrANaH shushubhe rAkShasottamaH |
marIchibhirivArkasya sa.nsyUto jalado mahAn
shlokas.39:
viShaktaiH sa sharaishchApi tapanIyaparichChadaiH |
ArshyashRRi~Ngirbabhau rAjandIptashRRi~Nga ivAchalaH
shlokas.40:
tataste bhrAtaraH pa~ncha rAkShasendraM mahAhave |
vivyadhurnishitairbANaistapanIyavibhUShitaiH
shlokas.41:
sa nirbhinnaH sharairghorairbhujagaiH kopitairiva |
alambuso bhRRishaM rAjannAgendra iva chukrudhe
shlokas.42:
so.atividdho mahArAja muhUrtamatha mAriSha |
pravivesha tamo dIrghaM pIDitastairmahArathaiH
shlokas.43:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM krodhena dviguNIkRRitaH |
chichCheda sAyakaisteShAM dhvajA.nshchaiva dhanUMShi cha
shlokas.44:
ekaikaM cha tribhirbANairAjaghAna smayanniva |
alambuso rathopasthe nRRityanniva mahArathaH
shlokas.45:
tvaramANashcha sa~Nkruddho hayA.nsteShAM mahAtmanAm |
jaghAna rAkShasaH kruddhaH sArathI.nshcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.46:
bibheda cha susaMhRRiShTaH punashchainAnsusa.nshitaiH |
sharairbahuvidhAkAraiH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.47:
virathA.nshcha maheShvAsAnkRRitvA tatra sa rAkShasaH |
abhidudrAva vegena hantukAmo nishAcharaH
shlokas.48:
tAnarditAnraNe tena rAkShasena durAtmanA |
dRRiShTvArjunasutaH sa~Nkhye rAkShasaM samupAdravat
shlokas.49:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM vRRitravAsavayoriva |
dadRRishustAvakAH sarve pANDavAshcha mahArathAH
shlokas.50:
tau sametau mahAyuddhe krodhadIptau parasparam |
mahAbalau mahArAja krodhasa.nraktalochanau
parasparamavekShetAM kAlAnalasamau yudhi
shlokas.51:
tayoH samAgamo ghoro babhUva kaTukodayaH |
yathA devAsure yuddhe shakrashambarayoriva

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ArjuniM samare shUraM vinighnantaM mahAratham |
alambusaH kathaM yuddhe pratyayudhyata sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
ArshyashRRi~NgiM kathaM chApi saubhadraH paravIrahA |
tanmamAchakShva tattvena yathA vRRittaM sma sa.nyuge
shlokas.3:
dhana~njayashcha kiM chakre mama sainyeShu sa~njaya |
bhImo vA balinAM shreShTho rAkShaso vA ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.4:
nakulaH sahadevo vA sAtyakirvA mahArathaH |
etadAchakShva me sarvaM kushalo hyasi sa~njaya
shlokas.5:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hanta te.ahaM pravakShyAmi sa~NgrAmaM lomaharShaNam |
yathAbhUdrAkShasendrasya saubhadrasya cha mAriSha
shlokas.6:
arjunashcha yathA sa~Nkhye bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha raNe chakruH parAkramam
shlokas.7:
tathaiva tAvakAH sarve bhIShmadroNapurogamAH |
adbhutAni vichitrANi chakruH karmANyabhItavat
shlokas.8:
alambusastu samare abhimanyuM mahAratham |
vinadya sumahAnAdaM tarjayitvA muhurmuhuH
abhidudrAva vegena tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.9:
saubhadro.api raNe rAjansiMhavadvinadanmuhuH |
ArshyashRRi~NgiM maheShvAsaM pituratyantavairiNam
shlokas.10:
tataH sameyatuH sa~Nkhye tvaritau nararAkShasau |
rathAbhyAM rathinAM shreShThau yathA vai devadAnavau
mAyAvI rAkShasashreShTho divyAstraj~nashcha phAlguniH
shlokas.11:
tataH kArShNirmahArAja nishitaiH sAyakaistribhiH |
ArshyashRRi~NgiM raNe viddhvA punarvivyAdha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.12:
alambuso.api sa~NkruddhaH kArShNiM navabhirAshugaiH |
hRRidi vivyAdha vegena tottrairiva mahAdvipam
shlokas.13:
tataH sharasahasreNa kShiprakArI nishAcharaH |
arjunasya sutaM sa~Nkhye pIDayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.14:
abhimanyustataH kruddho navatiM nataparvaNAm |
chikShepa nishitAnbANAnrAkShasasya mahorasi
shlokas.15:
te tasya vivishustUrNaM kAyaM nirbhidya marmaNi |
sa tairvibhinnasarvA~NgaH shushubhe rAkShasottamaH
puShpitaiH ki.nshukai rAjansa.nstIrNa iva parvataH
shlokas.16:
sa dhAraya~nsharAnhemapu~NkhAnapi mahAbalaH |
vibabhau rAkShasashreShThaH sajvAla iva parvataH
shlokas.17:
tataH kruddho mahArAja ArshyashRRi~NgirmahAbalaH |
mahendrapratimaM kArShNiM ChAdayAmAsa patribhiH
shlokas.18:
tena te vishikhA muktA yamadaNDopamAH shitAH |
abhimanyuM vinirbhidya prAvishandharaNItalam
shlokas.19:
tathaivArjuninirmuktAH sharAH kA~nchanabhUShaNAH |
alambusaM vinirbhidya prAvishanta dharAtalam
shlokas.20:
saubhadrastu raNe rakShaH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
chakre vimukhamAsAdya mayaM shakra ivAhave
shlokas.21:
vimukhaM cha tato rakSho vadhyamAnaM raNe.ariNA |
prAdushchakre mahAmAyAM tAmasIM paratApanaH
shlokas.22:
tataste tamasA sarve hRRitA hyAsanmahItale |
nAbhimanyumapashyanta naiva svAnna parAnraNe
shlokas.23:
abhimanyushcha taddRRiShTvA ghorarUpaM mahattamaH |
prAdushchakre.astramatyugraM bhAskaraM kurunandanaH
shlokas.24:
