tataH prakAshamabhavajjagatsarvaM mahIpate |
tAM chApi jaghnivAnmAyAM rAkShasasya durAtmanaH
shlokas.25:
sa~Nkruddhashcha mahAvIryo rAkShasendraM narottamaH |
ChAdayAmAsa samare sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.26:
bahvIstathAnyA mAyAshcha prayuktAstena rakShasA |
sarvAstravidameyAtmA vArayAmAsa phAlguniH
shlokas.27:
hatamAyaM tato rakSho vadhyamAnaM cha sAyakaiH |
rathaM tatraiva santyajya prAdravanmahato bhayAt
shlokas.28:
tasminvinirjite tUrNaM kUTayodhini rAkShase |
ArjuniH samare sainyaM tAvakaM saMmamarda ha
madAndho vanyanAgendraH sapadmAM padminImiva
shlokas.29:
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmaH sainyaM dRRiShTvAbhividrutam |
mahatA rathava.nshena saubhadraM paryavArayat
shlokas.30:
koShThakIkRRitya taM vIraM dhArtarAShTrA mahArathAH |
ekaM subahavo yuddhe tatakShuH sAyakairdRRiDham
shlokas.31:
sa teShAM rathinAM vIraH pitustulyaparAkramaH |
sadRRisho vAsudevasya vikrameNa balena cha
shlokas.32:
ubhayoH sadRRishaM karma sa piturmAtulasya cha |
raNe bahuvidhaM chakre sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.33:
tato dhana~njayo rAjanvinighna.nstava sainikAn |
AsasAda raNe bhIShmaM putraprepsuramarShaNaH
shlokas.34:
tathaiva samare rAjanpitA devavratastava |
AsasAda raNe pArthaM svarbhAnuriva bhAskaram
shlokas.35:
tataH sarathanAgAshvAH putrAstava vishAM pate |
parivavrU raNe bhIShmaM jugupushcha samantataH
shlokas.36:
tathaiva pANDavA rAjanparivArya dhana~njayam |
raNAya mahate yuktA da.nshitA bharatarShabha
shlokas.37:
shAradvatastato rAjanbhIShmasya pramukhe sthitam |
arjunaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA sAyakAnAM samAchinot
shlokas.38:
patyudgamyAtha vivyAdha sAtyakistaM shitaiH sharaiH |
pANDavapriyakAmArthaM shArdUla iva ku~njaram
shlokas.39:
gautamo.api tvarAyukto mAdhavaM navabhiH sharaiH |
hRRidi vivyAdha sa~NkruddhaH ka~NkapatraparichChadaiH
shlokas.40:
shaineyo.api tataH kruddho bhRRishaM viddho mahArathaH |
gautamAntakaraM ghoraM samAdatta shilImukham
shlokas.41:
tamApatantaM vegena shakrAshanisamadyutim |
dvidhA chichCheda sa~Nkruddho drauNiH paramakopanaH
shlokas.42:
samutsRRijyAtha shaineyo gautamaM rathinAM varam |
abhyadravadraNe drauNiM rAhuH khe shashinaM yathA
shlokas.43:
tasya droNasutashchApaM dvidhA chichCheda bhArata |
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM tADayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.44:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya shatrughnaM bhArasAdhanam |
drauNiM ShaShTyA mahArAja bAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.45:
sa viddho vyathitashchaiva muhUrtaM kashmalAyutaH |
niShasAda rathopasthe dhvajayaShTimupAshritaH
shlokas.46:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM droNaputraH pratApavAn |
vArShNeyaM samare kruddho nArAchena samardayat
shlokas.47:
shaineyaM sa tu nirbhidya prAvishaddharaNItalam |
vasantakAle balavAnbilaM sarpashishuryathA
shlokas.48:
tato.apareNa bhallena mAdhavasya dhvajottamam |
chichCheda samare drauNiH siMhanAdaM nanAda cha
shlokas.49:
punashchainaM sharairghoraishChAdayAmAsa bhArata |
nidAghAnte mahArAja yathA megho divAkaram
shlokas.50:
sAtyakishcha mahArAja sharajAlaM nihatya tat |
drauNimabhyapatattUrNaM sharajAlairanekadhA
shlokas.51:
tApayAmAsa cha drauNiM shaineyaH paravIrahA |
vimukto meghajAlena yathaiva tapanastathA
shlokas.52:
sharANAM cha sahasreNa punarenaM samudyatam |
sAtyakishChAdayAmAsa nanAda cha mahAbalaH
shlokas.53:
dRRiShTvA putraM tathA grastaM rAhuNeva nishAkaram |
abhyadravata shaineyaM bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn
shlokas.54:
vivyAdha cha pRRiShatkena sutIkShNena mahAmRRidhe |
parIpsansvasutaM rAjanvArShNeyenAbhitApitam
shlokas.55:
sAtyakistu raNe jitvA guruputraM mahAratham |
droNaM vivyAdha vi.nshatyA sarvapArashavaiH sharaiH
shlokas.56:
tadantaramameyAtmA kaunteyaH shvetavAhanaH |
abhyadravadraNe kruddho droNaM prati mahArathaH
shlokas.57:
tato droNashcha pArthashcha sameyAtAM mahAmRRidhe |
yathA budhashcha shukrashcha mahArAja nabhastale

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM droNo maheShvAsaH pANDavashcha dhana~njayaH |
samIyatU raNe shUrau tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
priyo hi pANDavo nityaM bhAradvAjasya dhImataH |
AchAryashcha raNe nityaM priyaH pArthasya sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
tAvubhau rathinau sa~Nkhye dRRiptau siMhAvivotkaTau |
kathaM samIyaturyuddhe bhAradvAjadhana~njayau
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
na droNaH samare pArthaM jAnIte priyamAtmanaH |
kShatradharmaM puraskRRitya pArtho vA gurumAhave
shlokas.5:
na kShatriyA raNe rAjanvarjayanti parasparam |
nirmaryAdaM hi yudhyante pitRRibhirbhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.6:
raNe bhArata pArthena droNo viddhastribhiH sharaiH |
nAchintayata tAnbANAnpArthachApachyutAnyudhi
shlokas.7:
sharavRRiShTyA punaH pArthashChAdayAmAsa taM raNe |
prajajvAla cha roSheNa gahane.agnirivotthitaH
shlokas.8:
tato.arjunaM raNe droNaH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
vArayAmAsa rAjendra nachirAdiva bhArata
shlokas.9:
tato duryodhano rAjA susharmANamachodayat |
droNasya samare rAjanpArShNigrahaNakAraNAt
shlokas.10:
trigartarADapi kruddho bhRRishamAyamya kArmukam |
ChAdayAmAsa samare pArthaM bANairayomukhaiH
shlokas.11:
tAbhyAM muktAH sharA rAjannantarikShe virejire |
ha.nsA iva mahArAja sharatkAle nabhastale
shlokas.12:
te sharAH prApya kaunteyaM samastA vivishuH prabho |
phalabhAranataM yadvatsvAduvRRikShaM viha~NgamAH
shlokas.13:
arjunastu raNe nAdaM vinadya rathinAM varaH |
trigartarAjaM samare saputraM vivyadhe sharaiH
shlokas.14:
te vadhyamAnAH pArthena kAleneva yugakShaye |
pArthamevAbhyavartanta maraNe kRRitanishchayAH
mumuchuH sharavRRiShTiM cha pANDavasya rathaM prati
shlokas.15:
sharavRRiShTiM tatastAM tu sharavarSheNa pANDavaH |
pratijagrAha rAjendra toyavRRiShTimivAchalaH
shlokas.16:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma bIbhatsorhastalAghavam |
vimuktAM bahubhiH shUraiH shastravRRiShTiM durAsadAm
shlokas.17:
yadeko vArayAmAsa mAruto.abhragaNAniva |
karmaNA tena pArthasya tutuShurdevadAnavAH
shlokas.18:
atha kruddho raNe pArthastrigartAnprati bhArata |
mumochAstraM mahArAja vAyavyaM pRRitanAmukhe
shlokas.19:
prAdurAsIttato vAyuH kShobhayANo nabhastalam |
pAtayanvai tarugaNAnvinighna.nshchaiva sainikAn
shlokas.20:
tato droNo.abhivIkShyaiva vAyavyAstraM sudAruNam |
shailamanyanmahArAja ghoramastraM mumocha ha
shlokas.21:
droNena yudhi nirmukte tasminnastre mahAmRRidhe |
prashashAma tato vAyuH prasannAshchAbhavandishaH
shlokas.22:
tataH pANDusuto vIrastrigartasya rathavrajAn |
nirutsAhAnraNe chakre vimukhAnviparAkramAn
shlokas.23:
tato duryodhano rAjA kRRipashcha rathinAM varaH |
ashvatthAmA tataH shalyaH kAmbojashcha sudakShiNaH
shlokas.24:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau bAhlikashcha sabAhlikaH |
mahatA rathava.nshena pArthasyAvArayandishaH
shlokas.25:
tathaiva bhagadattashcha shrutAyushcha mahAbalaH |
gajAnIkena bhImasya tAvavArayatAM dishaH
shlokas.26:
bhUrishravAH shalashchaiva saubalashcha vishAM pate |
sharaughairvividhaistUrNaM mAdrIputrAvavArayan
shlokas.27:
bhIShmastu sahitaH sarvairdhArtarAShTrasya sainikaiH |
yudhiShThiraM samAsAdya sarvataH paryavArayat
shlokas.28:
ApatantaM gajAnIkaM dRRiShTvA pArtho vRRikodaraH |
lelihansRRikkiNI vIro mRRigarADiva kAnane
shlokas.29:
tatastu rathinAM shreShTho gadAM gRRihya mahAhave |
avaplutya rathAttUrNaM tava sainyamabhIShayat
shlokas.30:
tamudvIkShya gadAhastaM tataste gajasAdinaH |
parivavrU raNe yattA bhImasenaM samantataH
shlokas.31:
gajamadhyamanuprAptaH pANDavashcha vyarAjata |
meghajAlasya mahato yathA madhyagato raviH
shlokas.32:
vyadhamatsa gajAnIkaM gadayA pANDavarShabhaH |
mahAbhrajAlamatulaM mAtarishveva santatam
shlokas.33:
te vadhyamAnA balinA bhImasenena dantinaH |
ArtanAdaM raNe chakrurgarjanto jaladA iva
shlokas.34:
bahudhA dAritashchaiva viShANaistatra dantibhiH |
phullAshokanibhaH pArthaH shushubhe raNamUrdhani
shlokas.35:
viShANe dantinaM gRRihya nirviShANamathAkarot |
viShANena cha tenaiva kumbhe.abhyAhatya dantinam
pAtayAmAsa samare daNDahasta ivAntakaH
shlokas.36:
shoNitAktAM gadAM bibhranmedomajjAkRRitachChaviH |
kRRitA~NgadaH shoNitena rudravatpratyadRRishyata
shlokas.37:
evaM te vadhyamAnAstu hatasheShA mahAgajAH |
prAdravanta disho rAjanvimRRidnantaH svakaM balam
shlokas.38:
dravadbhistairmahAnAgaiH samantAdbharatarShabha |
duryodhanabalaM sarvaM punarAsItparA~Nmukham

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
madhyAhne tu mahArAja sa~NgrAmaH samapadyata |
lokakShayakaro raudro bhIShmasya saha somakaiH
shlokas.2:
gA~Ngeyo rathinAM shreShThaH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
vyadhamannishitairbANaiH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.3:
saMmamarda cha tatsainyaM pitA devavratastava |
dhAnyAnAmiva lUnAnAM prakaraM gogaNA iva
shlokas.4:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha virATo drupadastathA |
bhIShmamAsAdya samare sharairjaghnurmahAratham
shlokas.5:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tato viddhvA virATaM cha tribhiH sharaiH |
drupadasya cha nArAchaM preShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.6:
tena viddhA maheShvAsA bhIShmeNAmitrakarshinA |
chukrudhuH samare rAjanpAdaspRRiShTA ivoragAH
shlokas.7:
shikhaNDI taM cha vivyAdha bharatAnAM pitAmaham |
strImayaM manasA dhyAtvA nAsmai prAharadachyutaH
shlokas.8:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu samare krodhAdagniriva jvalan |
pitAmahaM tribhirbANairbAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.9:
drupadaH pa~nchavi.nshatyA virATo dashabhiH sharaiH |
shikhaNDI pa~nchavi.nshatyA bhIShmaM vivyAdha sAyakaiH
shlokas.10:
so.atividdho mahArAja bhIShmaH sa~Nkhye mahAtmabhiH |
vasante puShpashabalo raktAshoka ivAbabhau
shlokas.11:
tAnpratyavidhyadgA~NgeyastribhistribhirajihmagaiH |
drupadasya cha bhallena dhanushchichCheda mAriSha
shlokas.12:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya bhIShmaM vivyAdha pa~nchabhiH |
sArathiM cha tribhirbANaiH sushitai raNamUrdhani
shlokas.13:
tato bhImo mahArAja draupadyAH pa~ncha chAtmajAH |
kekayA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha sAtyakishchaiva sAtvataH
shlokas.14:
abhyadravanta gA~NgeyaM yudhiShThirahitepsayA |
rirakShiShantaH pA~nchAlyaM dhRRiShTadyumnamukhanraNe
shlokas.15:
tathaiva tAvakAH sarve bhIShmarakShArthamudyatAH |
pratyudyayuH pANDusenAM sahasainyA narAdhipa
shlokas.16:
tatrAsItsumahadyuddhaM tava teShAM cha sa~Nkulam |
narAshvarathanAgAnAM yamarAShTravivardhanam
shlokas.17:
rathI rathinamAsAdya prAhiNodyamasAdanam |
tathetarAnsamAsAdya naranAgAshvasAdinaH
shlokas.18:
anayanparalokAya sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
astraishcha vividhairghoraistatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.19:
rathAshcha rathibhirhInA hatasArathayastathA |
vipradrutAshvAH samare disho jagmuH samantataH
shlokas.20:
mardamAnA narAnrAjanhayA.nshcha subahUnraNe |
vAtAyamAnA dRRishyante gandharvanagaropamAH
shlokas.21:
rathinashcha rathairhInA varmiNastejasA yutAH |
kuNDaloShNIShiNaH sarve niShkA~NgadavibhUShitAH
shlokas.22:
devaputrasamA rUpe shaurye shakrasamA yudhi |
RRiddhyA vaishravaNaM chAti nayena cha bRRihaspatim
shlokas.23:
sarvalokeshvarAH shUrAstatra tatra vishAM pate |
vipradrutA vyadRRishyanta prAkRRitA iva mAnavAH
shlokas.24:
dantinashcha narashreShTha vihInA varasAdibhiH |
mRRidnantaH svAnyanIkAni sampetuH sarvashabdagAH
shlokas.25:
varmabhishchAmaraishChatraiH patAkAbhishcha mAriSha |
kakShyAbhiratha tottraishcha ghaNTAbhistomaraistathA
shlokas.26:
vishIrNairvipradhAvanto dRRishyante sma disho dasha |
nagameghapratIkAshairjaladodayanisvanaiH
shlokas.27:
tathaiva dantibhirhInAngajArohAnvishAM pate |
pradhAvanto.anvapashyAma tava teShAM cha sa~Nkule
shlokas.28:
nAnAdeshasamutthA.nshcha turagAnhemabhUShitAn |
vAtAyamAnAnadrAkShaM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.29:
ashvArohAnhatairashvairgRRihItAsInsamantataH |
dravamANAnapashyAma drAvyamANA.nshcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.30:
gajo gajaM samAsAdya dravamANaM mahAraNe |
yayau vimRRidna.nstarasA padAtInvAjinastathA
shlokas.31:
tathaiva cha rathAnrAjansaMmamarda raNe gajaH |
rathashchaiva samAsAdya padAtiM turagaM tathA
shlokas.32:
vyamRRidnAtsamare rAja.nsturagA.nshcha narAnraNe |
evaM te bahudhA rAjanpramRRidnantaH parasparam
shlokas.33:
tasminraudre tathA yuddhe vartamAne mahAbhaye |
prAvartata nadI ghorA shoNitAntratara~NgiNI
shlokas.34:
asthisa~nchayasa~NghATA keshashaivalashAdvalA |
rathahradA sharAvartA hayamInA durAsadA
shlokas.35:
shIrShopalasamAkIrNA hastigrAhasamAkulA |
kavachoShNIShaphenADhyA dhanurdvIpAsikachChapA
shlokas.36:
patAkAdhvajavRRikShADhyA martyakUlApahAriNI |
kravyAdasa~Nghasa~NkIrNA yamarAShTravivardhinI
shlokas.37:
tAM nadIM kShatriyAH shUrA hayanAgarathaplavaiH |
praterurbahavo rAjanbhayaM tyaktvA mahAhave
shlokas.38:
apovAha raNe bhIrUnkashmalenAbhisa.nvRRitAn |
yathA vaitaraNI pretAnpretarAjapuraM prati
shlokas.39:
prAkroshankShatriyAstatra dRRiShTvA tadvaishasaM mahat |
duryodhanAparAdhena kShayaM gachChanti kauravAH
shlokas.40:
guNavatsu kathaM dveShaM dhArtarAShTro janeshvaraH |
kRRitavAnpANDuputreShu pApAtmA lobhamohitaH
shlokas.41:
evaM bahuvidhA vAchaH shrUyante smAtra bhArata |
pANDavastavasa.nyuktAH putrANAM te sudAruNAH
shlokas.42:
tA nishamya tadA vAchaH sarvayodhairudAhRRitAH |
AgaskRRitsarvalokasya putro duryodhanastava
shlokas.43:
bhIShmaM droNaM kRRipaM chaiva shalyaM chovAcha bhArata |
yudhyadhvamanaha~NkArAH kiM chiraM kurutheti cha
shlokas.44:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM kurUNAM pANDavaiH saha |
akShadyUtakRRitaM rAjansughoraM vaishasaM tadA
shlokas.45:
yatpurA na nigRRihNIShe vAryamANo mahAtmabhiH |
vaichitravIrya tasyedaM phalaM pashya tathAvidham
shlokas.46:
na hi pANDusutA rAjansasainyAH sapadAnugAH |
rakShanti samare prANAnkauravA vA vishAM pate
shlokas.47:
etasmAtkAraNAdghoro vartate sma janakShayaH |
daivAdvA puruShavyAghra tava chApanayAnnRRipa

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
arjunastu naravyAghra susharmapramukhAnnRRipAn |
anayatpretarAjasya bhavanaM sAyakaiH shitaiH
shlokas.2:
susharmApi tato bANaiH pArthaM vivyAdha sa.nyuge |
vAsudevaM cha saptatyA pArthaM cha navabhiH punaH
shlokas.3:
tAnnivArya sharaugheNa shakrasUnurmahArathaH |
susharmaNo raNe yodhAnprAhiNodyamasAdanam
shlokas.4:
te vadhyamAnAH pArthena kAleneva yugakShaye |
vyadravanta raNe rAjanbhaye jAte mahArathAH
shlokas.5:
utsRRijya turagAnkechidrathAnkechichcha mAriSha |
gajAnanye samutsRRijya prAdravanta disho dasha
shlokas.6:
apare tudyamAnAstu vAjinAgarathA raNAt |
tvarayA parayA yuktAH prAdravanta vishAM pate
shlokas.7:
pAdAtAshchApi shastrANi samutsRRijya mahAraNe |
nirapekShA vyadhAvanta tena tena sma bhArata
shlokas.8:
vAryamANAH sma bahushastraigartena susharmaNA |
tathAnyaiH pArthivashreShThairna vyatiShThanta sa.nyuge
shlokas.9:
tadbalaM pradrutaM dRRiShTvA putro duryodhanastava |
puraskRRitya raNe bhIShmaM sarvasainyapuraskRRitam
shlokas.10:
sarvodyogena mahatA dhana~njayamupAdravat |
trigartAdhipaterarthe jIvitasya vishAM pate
shlokas.11:
sa ekaH samare tasthau kiranbahuvidhA~nsharAn |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH sarvaiH sheShA vipradrutA narAH
shlokas.12:
tathaiva paNDavA rAjansarvodyogena da.nshitAH |
prayayuH phalgunArthAya yatra bhIShmo vyavasthitaH
shlokas.13:
jAnanto.api raNe shauryaM ghoraM gANDIvadhanvanaH |
hAhAkArakRRitotsAhA bhIShmaM jagmuH samantataH
shlokas.14:
tatastAladhvajaH shUraH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
ChAdayAmAsa samare sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.15:
ekIbhUtAstataH sarve kuravaH pANDavaiH saha |
ayudhyanta mahArAja madhyaM prApte divAkare
shlokas.16:
sAtyakiH kRRitavarmANaM viddhvA pa~nchabhirAyasaiH |
atiShThadAhave shUraH kiranbANAnsahasrashaH
shlokas.17:
tathaiva drupado rAjA droNaM viddhvA shitaiH sharaiH |
punarvivyAdha saptatyA sArathiM chAsya saptabhiH
shlokas.18:
bhImasenastu rAjAnaM bAhlikaM prapitAmaham |
viddhvAnadanmahAnAdaM shArdUla iva kAnane
shlokas.19:
Arjunishchitrasenena viddho bahubhirAshugaiH |
chitrasenaM tribhirbANairvivyAdha hRRidaye bhRRisham
shlokas.20:
samAgatau tau tu raNe mahAmAtrau vyarochatAm |
yathA divi mahAghorau rAjanbudhashanaishcharau
shlokas.21:
tasyAshvA.nshchaturo hatvA sUtaM cha navabhiH sharaiH |
nanAda balavannAdaM saubhadraH paravIrahA
shlokas.22:
hatAshvAttu rathAttUrNamavaplutya mahArathaH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM durmukhasya vishAM pate
shlokas.23:
droNashcha drupadaM viddhvA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
sArathiM chAsya vivyAdha tvaramANaH parAkramI
shlokas.24:
pIDyamAnastato rAjA drupado vAhinImukhe |
apAyAjjavanairashvaiH pUrvavairamanusmaran
shlokas.25:
bhImasenastu rAjAnaM muhUrtAdiva bAhlikam |
vyashvasUtarathaM chakre sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.26:
sasambhramo mahArAja sa.nshayaM paramaM gataH |
avaplutya tato vAhAdbAhlikaH puruShottamaH
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM lakShmaNasya mahArathaH
shlokas.27:
sAtyakiH kRRitavarmANaM vArayitvA mahArathaH |
sharairbahuvidhai rAjannAsasAda pitAmaham
shlokas.28:
sa viddhvA bhArataM ShaShTyA nishitairlomavAhibhiH |
nanarteva rathopasthe vidhunvAno mahaddhanuH
shlokas.29:
tasyAyasIM mahAshaktiM chikShepAtha pitAmahaH |
hemachitrAM mahAvegAM nAgakanyopamAM shubhAm
shlokas.30:
tAmApatantIM sahasA mRRityukalpAM sutejanAm |
dhva.nsayAmAsa vArShNeyo lAghavena mahAyashAH
shlokas.31:
anAsAdya tu vArShNeyaM shaktiH paramadAruNA |
nyapataddharaNIpRRiShThe maholkeva gataprabhA
shlokas.32:
vArShNeyastu tato rAjansvAM shaktiM ghoradarshanAm |
vegavadgRRihya chikShepa pitAmaharathaM prati
shlokas.33:
vArShNeyabhujavegena praNunnA sA mahAhave |
abhidudrAva vegena kAlarAtriryathA naram
shlokas.34:
tAmApatantIM sahasA dvidhA chichCheda bhArata |
kShuraprAbhyAM sutIkShNAbhyAM sAnvakIryata bhUtale
shlokas.35:
ChittvA tu shaktiM gA~NgeyaH sAtyakiM navabhiH sharaiH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddhaH prahasa~nshatrukarshanaH
shlokas.36:
tataH sarathanAgAshvAH pANDavAH pANDupUrvaja |
parivavrU raNe bhIShmaM mAdhavatrANakAraNAt
shlokas.37:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha samare vijayaiShiNAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dRRiShTvA bhIShmaM raNe kruddhaM pANDavairabhisa.nvRRitam |
yathA meghairmahArAja tapAnte divi bhAskaram
shlokas.2:
duryodhano mahArAja duHshAsanamabhAShata |
eSha shUro maheShvAso bhIShmaH shatruniShUdanaH
shlokas.3:
ChAditaH pANDavaiH shUraiH samantAdbharatarShabha |
tasya kAryaM tvayA vIra rakShaNaM sumahAtmanaH
shlokas.4:
rakShyamANo hi samare bhIShmo.asmAkaM pitAmahaH |
nihanyAtsamare yattAnpA~nchAlAnpANDavaiH saha
shlokas.5:
tatra kAryamahaM manye bhIShmasyaivAbhirakShaNam |
goptA hyeSha maheShvAso bhIShmo.asmAkaM pitAmahaH
shlokas.6:
sa bhavAnsarvasainyena parivArya pitAmaham |
samare duShkaraM karma kurvANaM parirakShatu
shlokas.7:
evamuktastu samare putro duHshAsanastava |
parivArya sthito bhIShmaM sainyena mahatA vRRitaH
shlokas.8:
tataH shatasahasreNa hayAnAM subalAtmajaH |
vimalaprAsahastAnAmRRiShTitomaradhAriNAm
shlokas.9:
darpitAnAM suvegAnAM balasthAnAM patAkinAm |
shikShitairyuddhakushalairupetAnAM narottamaiH
shlokas.10:
nakulaM sahadevaM cha dharmarAjaM cha pANDavam |
nyavArayannarashreShThaM parivArya samantataH
shlokas.11:
tato duryodhano rAjA shUrANAM hayasAdinAm |
ayutaM preShayAmAsa pANDavAnAM nivAraNe
shlokas.12:
taiH praviShTairmahAvegairgarutmadbhirivAhave |
khurAhatA dharA rAja.nshchakampe cha nanAda cha
shlokas.13:
khurashabdashcha sumahAnvAjinAM shushruve tadA |
mahAva.nshavanasyeva dahyamAnasya parvate
shlokas.14:
utpatadbhishcha taistatra samuddhUtaM mahadrajaH |
divAkarapathaM prApya ChAdayAmAsa bhAskaram
shlokas.15:
vegavadbhirhayaistaistu kShobhitaM pANDavaM balam |
nipatadbhirmahAvegairha.nsairiva mahatsaraH
heShatAM chaiva shabdena na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.16:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
pratyaghna.nstarasA vegaM samare hayasAdinAm
shlokas.17:
udvRRittasya mahArAja prAvRRiTkAlena pUryataH |
paurNamAsyAmambuvegaM yathA velA mahodadheH
shlokas.18:
tataste rathino rAja~nsharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
nyakRRintannuttamA~NgAni kAyebhyo hayasAdinAm
shlokas.19:
te nipeturmahArAja nihatA dRRiDhadhanvibhiH |
nAgairiva mahAnAgA yathA syurgirigahvare
shlokas.20:
te.api prAsaiH sunishitaiH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
nyakRRintannuttamA~NgAni vicharanto disho dasha
shlokas.21:
atyAsannA hayArohA RRiShTibhirbharatarShabha |
achChinannuttamA~NgAni phalAnIva mahAdrumAt
shlokas.22:
sasAdino hayA rAja.nstatra tatra niShUditAH |
patitAH pAtyamAnAshcha shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.23:
vadhyamAnA hayAste tu prAdravanta bhayArditAH |
yathA siMhAnsamAsAdya mRRigAH prANaparAyaNAH
shlokas.24:
pANDavAstu mahArAja jitvA shatrUnmahAhave |
dadhmuH sha~NkhA.nshcha bherIshcha tADayAmAsurAhave
shlokas.25:
tato duryodhano dRRiShTvA dInaM sainyamavasthitam |
abravIdbharatashreShTha madrarAjamidaM vachaH
shlokas.26:
eSha pANDusuto jyeShTho jitvA mAtula mAmakAn |
pashyatAM no mahAbAho senAM drAvayate balI
shlokas.27:
taM vAraya mahAbAho veleva makarAlayam |
tvaM hi sa.nshrUyase.atyarthamasahyabalavikramaH
shlokas.28:
putrasya tava tadvAkyaM shrutvA shalyaH pratApavAn |
prayayau rathava.nshena yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.29:
tadApatadvai sahasA shalyasya sumahadbalam |
mahaughavegaM samare vArayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.30:
madrarAjaM cha samare dharmarAjo mahArathaH |
dashabhiH sAyakaistUrNamAjaghAna stanAntare
nakulaH sahadevashcha tribhistribhirajihmagaiH
shlokas.31:
madrarAjo.api tAnsarvAnAjaghAna tribhistribhiH |
yudhiShThiraM punaH ShaShTyA vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
mAdrIputrau cha sa.nrabdhau dvAbhyAM dvAbhyAmatADayat
shlokas.32:
tato bhImo mahAbAhurdRRiShTvA rAjAnamAhave |
madrarAjavashaM prAptaM mRRityorAsyagataM yathA
abhyadravata sa~NgrAme yudhiShThiramamitrajit
shlokas.33:
tato yuddhaM mahAghoraM prAvartata sudAruNam |
aparAM dishamAsthAya dyotamAne divAkare

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH pitA tava kruddho nishitaiH sAyakottamaiH |
AjaghAna raNe pArthAnsahasenAnsamantataH
shlokas.2:
bhImaM dvAdashabhirviddhvA sAtyakiM navabhiH sharaiH |
nakulaM cha tribhirbANaiH sahadevaM cha saptabhiH
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThiraM dvAdashabhirbAhvorurasi chArpayat |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tato viddhvA vinanAda mahAbalaH
shlokas.4:
taM dvAdashArdhairnakulo mAdhavashcha tribhiH sharaiH |
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha saptatyA bhImasenashcha pa~nchabhiH
yudhiShThiro dvAdashabhiH pratyavidhyatpitAmaham
shlokas.5:
droNastu sAtyakiM viddhvA bhImasenamavidhyata |
ekaikaM pa~nchabhirbANairyamadaNDopamaiH shitaiH
shlokas.6:
tau cha taM pratyavidhyetAM tribhistribhirajihmagaiH |
tottrairiva mahAnAgaM droNaM brAhmaNapu~Ngavam
shlokas.7:
sauvIrAH kitavAH prAchyAH pratIchyodIchyamAlavAH |
abhIShAhAH shUrasenAH shibayo.atha vasAtayaH
sa~NgrAme nAjahurbhIShmaM vadhyamAnAH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.8:
tathaivAnye vadhyamAnAH pANDaveyairmahAtmabhiH |
pANDavAnabhyavartanta vividhAyudhapANayaH
tathaiva pANDavA rAjanparivavruH pitAmaham
shlokas.9:
sa samantAtparivRRito rathaughairaparAjitaH |
gahane.agnirivotsRRiShTaH prajajvAla dahanparAn
shlokas.10:
rathAgnyagArashchApArchirasishaktigadendhanaH |
sharasphuli~Ngo bhIShmAgnirdadAha kShatriyarShabhAn
shlokas.11:
suvarNapu~NkhairiShubhirgArdhrapakShaiH sutejanaiH |
karNinAlIkanArAchaishChAdayAmAsa tadbalam
shlokas.12:
apAtayaddhvajA.nshchaiva rathinashcha shitaiH sharaiH |
muNDatAlavanAnIva chakAra sa rathavrajAn
shlokas.13:
nirmanuShyAnrathAnrAjangajAnashvA.nshcha sa.nyuge |
akarotsa mahAbAhuH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.14:
tasya jyAtalanirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
nishamya sarvabhUtAni samakampanta bhArata
shlokas.15:
amoghA hyapatanbANAH pituste bharatarShabha |
nAsajjanta tanutreShu bhIShmachApachyutAH sharAH
shlokas.16:
hatavIrAnrathAnrAjansa.nyuktA~njavanairhayaiH |
apashyAma mahArAja hriyamANAnraNAjire
shlokas.17:
chedikAshikarUShANAM sahasrANi chaturdasha |
mahArathAH samAkhyAtAH kulaputrAstanutyajaH
aparAvartinaH sarve suvarNavikRRitadhvajAH
shlokas.18:
sa~NgrAme bhIShmamAsAdya vyAditAsyamivAntakam |
nimagnAH paralokAya savAjirathaku~njarAH
shlokas.19:
bhagnAkShopaskarAnkA.nshchidbhagnachakrA.nshcha sarvashaH |
apashyAma rathAnrAja~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.20:
savarUthai rathairbhagnai rathibhishcha nipAtitaiH |
sharaiH sukavachaishChinnaiH paTTishaishcha vishAM pate
shlokas.21:
gadAbhirmusalaishchaiva nistri.nshaishcha shilImukhaiH |
anukarShairupAsa~Ngaishchakrairbhagnaishcha mAriSha
shlokas.22:
bAhubhiH kArmukaiH khaDgaiH shirobhishcha sakuNDalaiH |
talatraira~Ngulitraishcha dhvajaishcha vinipAtitaiH
chApaishcha bahudhA ChinnaiH samAstIryata medinI
shlokas.23:
hatArohA gajA rAjanhayAshcha hatasAdinaH |
paripeturdrutaM tatra shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.24:
yatamAnAshcha te vIrA dravamANAnmahArathAn |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM bhIShmabANaprapIDitAn
shlokas.25:
mahendrasamavIryeNa vadhyamAnA mahAchamUH |
abhajyata mahArAja na cha dvau saha dhAvataH
shlokas.26:
AviddharathanAgAshvaM patitadhvajakUbaram |
anIkaM pANDuputrANAM hAhAbhUtamachetanam
shlokas.27:
jaghAnAtra pitA putraM putrashcha pitaraM tathA |
priyaM sakhAyaM chAkrande sakhA daivabalAtkRRitaH
shlokas.28:
vimuchya kavachAnanye pANDuputrasya sainikAH |
prakIrya keshAndhAvantaH pratyadRRishyanta bhArata
shlokas.29:
tadgokulamivodbhrAntamudbhrAntarathaku~njaram |
dadRRishe pANDuputrasya sainyamArtasvaraM tadA
shlokas.30:
prabhajyamAnaM sainyaM tu dRRiShTvA yAdavanandanaH |
uvAcha pArthaM bIbhatsuM nigRRihya rathamuttamam
shlokas.31:
ayaM sa kAlaH samprAptaH pArtha yaH kA~NkShitastava |
praharAsmai naravyAghra na chenmohAtpramuhyase
shlokas.32:
yatpurA kathitaM vIra tvayA rAj~nAM samAgame |
virATanagare pArtha sa~njayasya samIpataH
shlokas.33:
bhIShmadroNamukhAnsarvAndhArtarAShTrasya sainikAn |
sAnubandhAnhaniShyAmi ye mAM yotsyanti sa.nyuge
shlokas.34:
iti tatkuru kaunteya satyaM vAkyamari.ndama |
kShatradharmamanusmRRitya yudhyasva bharatarShabha
shlokas.35:
ityukto vAsudevena tiryagdRRiShTiradhomukhaH |
akAma iva bIbhatsuridaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.36:
avadhyAnAM vadhaM kRRitvA rAjyaM vA narakottaram |
duHkhAni vanavAse vA kiM nu me sukRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.37:
chodayAshvAnyato bhIShmaH kariShye vachanaM tava |
pAtayiShyAmi durdharShaM vRRiddhaM kurupitAmaham
shlokas.38:
tato.ashvAnrajataprakhyA.nshchodayAmAsa mAdhavaH |
yato bhIShmastato rAjanduShprekShyo rashmivAniva
shlokas.39:
tatastatpunarAvRRittaM yudhiShThirabalaM mahat |
dRRiShTvA pArthaM mahAbAhuM bhIShmAyodyantamAhave
shlokas.40:
tato bhIShmaH kurushreShThaH siMhavadvinadanmuhuH |
dhana~njayarathaM shIghraM sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.41:
kShaNena sa rathastasya sahayaH sahasArathiH |
sharavarSheNa mahatA na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.42:
vAsudevastvasambhrAnto dhairyamAsthAya sAtvataH |
chodayAmAsa tAnashvAnvitunnAnbhIShmasAyakaiH
shlokas.43:
tataH pArtho dhanurgRRihya divyaM jaladanisvanam |
pAtayAmAsa bhIShmasya dhanushChittvA shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.44:
sa chChinnadhanvA kauravyaH punaranyanmahaddhanuH |
nimeShAntaramAtreNa sajyaM chakre pitA tava
shlokas.45:
vichakarSha tato dorbhyAM dhanurjaladanisvanam |
athAsya tadapi kruddhashchichCheda dhanurarjunaH
shlokas.46:
tasya tatpUjayAmAsa lAghavaM shantanoH sutaH |
sAdhu pArtha mahAbAho sAdhu kuntIsuteti cha
shlokas.47:
samAbhAShyainamaparaM pragRRihya ruchiraM dhanuH |
mumocha samare bhIShmaH sharAnpArtharathaM prati
shlokas.48:
adarshayadvAsudevo hayayAne paraM balam |
moghAnkurva~nsharA.nstasya maNDalAni vidarshayan
shlokas.49:
shushubhAte naravyAghrau bhIShmapArthau sharakShatau |
govRRiShAviva sa.nrabdhau viShANollikhitA~Nkitau
shlokas.50:
vAsudevastu samprekShya pArthasya mRRiduyuddhatAm |
bhIShmaM cha sharavarShANi sRRijantamanishaM yudhi
shlokas.51:
pratapantamivAdityaM madhyamAsAdya senayoH |
varAnvarAnvinighnantaM pANDuputrasya sainikAn
shlokas.52:
yugAntamiva kurvANaM bhIShmaM yaudhiShThire bale |
nAmRRiShyata mahAbAhurmAdhavaH paravIrahA
shlokas.53:
utsRRijya rajataprakhyAnhayAnpArthasya mAriSha |
kruddho nAma mahAyogI prachaskanda mahArathAt
abhidudrAva bhIShmaM sa bhujapraharaNo balI
shlokas.54:
pratodapANistejasvI siMhavadvinadanmuhuH |
dArayanniva padbhyAM sa jagatIM jagatIshvaraH
shlokas.55:
krodhatAmrekShaNaH kRRiShNo jighA.nsuramitadyutiH |
grasanniva cha chetA.nsi tAvakAnAM mahAhave
shlokas.56:
dRRiShTvA mAdhavamAkrande bhIShmAyodyantamAhave |
hato bhIShmo hato bhIShma iti tatra sma sainikAH
kroshantaH prAdravansarve vAsudevabhayAnnarAH
shlokas.57:
pItakausheyasa.nvIto maNishyAmo janArdanaH |
shushubhe vidravanbhIShmaM vidyunmAlI yathAmbudaH
shlokas.58:
sa siMha iva mAta~NgaM yUtharShabha ivarShabham |
abhidudrAva tejasvI vinadanyAdavarShabhaH
shlokas.59:
tamApatantaM samprekShya puNDarIkAkShamAhave |
asambhramaM raNe bhIShmo vichakarSha mahaddhanuH
uvAcha chainaM govindamasambhrAntena chetasA
shlokas.60:
ehyehi puNDarIkAkSha devadeva namo.astu te |
mAmadya sAtvatashreShTha pAtayasva mahAhave
shlokas.61:
tvayA hi deva sa~NgrAme hatasyApi mamAnagha |
shreya eva paraM kRRiShNa loke.amuShminnihaiva cha
sambhAvito.asmi govinda trailokyenAdya sa.nyuge
shlokas.62:
anvageva tataH pArthastamanudrutya keshavam |
nijagrAha mahAbAhurbAhubhyAM parigRRihya vai
shlokas.63:
nigRRihyamANaH pArthena kRRiShNo rAjIvalochanaH |
jagAma chainamAdAya vegena puruShottamaH
shlokas.64:
pArthastu viShTabhya balAchcharaNau paravIrahA |
nijaghrAha hRRiShIkeshaM katha~nchiddashame pade
shlokas.65:
tata enamuvAchArtaH krodhaparyAkulekShaNam |
niHshvasantaM yathA nAgamarjunaH paravIrahA
shlokas.66:
nivartasva mahAbAho nAnRRitaM kartumarhasi |
yattvayA kathitaM pUrvaM na yotsyAmIti keshava
shlokas.67:
mithyAvAdIti lokastvAM kathayiShyati mAdhava |
mamaiSha bhAraH sarvo hi haniShyAmi yatavratam
shlokas.68:
shape mAdhava sakhyena satyena sukRRitena cha |
antaM yathA gamiShyAmi shatrUNAM shatrukarshana
shlokas.69:
adyaiva pashya durdharShaM pAtyamAnaM mahAvratam |
tArApatimivApUrNamantakAle yadRRichChayA
shlokas.70:
mAdhavastu vachaH shrutvA phalgunasya mahAtmanaH |
naki~nchiduktvA sakrodha Aruroha rathaM punaH
shlokas.71:
tau rathasthau naravyAghrau bhIShmaH shAntanavaH punaH |
vavarSha sharavarSheNa megho vRRiShTyA yathAchalau
shlokas.72:
prANA.nshchAdatta yodhAnAM pitA devavratastava |
gabhastibhirivAdityastejA.nsi shishirAtyaye
shlokas.73:
yathA kurUNAM sainyAni babha~nja yudhi pANDavaH |
tathA pANDavasainyAni babha~nja yudhi te pitA
shlokas.74:
hatavidrutasainyAstu nirutsAhA vichetasaH |
nirIkShituM na shekuste bhIShmamapratimaM raNe
madhyaM gatamivAdityaM pratapantaM svatejasA
shlokas.75:
te vadhyamAnA bhIShmeNa kAleneva yugakShaye |
vIkShAM chakrurmahArAja pANDavA bhayapIDitAH
shlokas.76:
trAtAraM nAdhyagachChanta gAvaH pa~NkagatA iva |
pipIlikA iva kShuNNA durbalA balinA raNe
shlokas.77:
mahArathaM bhArata duShpradharShaM; sharaughiNaM pratapantaM narendrAn |
bhIShmaM na shekuH prativIkShituM te; sharArchiShaM sUryamivAtapantam
shlokas.78:
vimRRidnatastasya tu pANDusenA;mastaM jagAmAtha sahasrarashmiH |
tato balAnAM shramakarshitAnAM; mano.avahAraM prati sambabhUva

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yudhyatAmeva teShAM tu bhAskare.astamupAgate |
sandhyA samabhavadghorA nApashyAma tato raNam
shlokas.2:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA sandhyAM sa.ndRRishya bhArata |
vadhyamAnaM balaM chApi bhIShmeNAmitraghAtinA
shlokas.3:
muktashastraM parAvRRittaM palAyanaparAyaNam |
bhIShmaM cha yudhi sa.nrabdhamanuyAntaM mahArathAn
shlokas.4:
somakA.nshcha jitAndRRiShTvA nirutsAhAnmahArathAn |
chintayitvA chiraM dhyAtvA avahAramarochayat
shlokas.5:
tato.avahAraM sainyAnAM chakre rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
tathaiva tava sainyAnAmavahAro hyabhUttadA
shlokas.6:
tato.avahAraM sainyAnAM kRRitvA tatra mahArathAH |
nyavishanta kurushreShTha sa~NgrAme kShatavikShatAH
shlokas.7:
bhIShmasya samare karma chintayAnAstu pANDavAH |
nAlabhanta tadA shAntiM bhRRishaM bhIShmeNa pIDitAH
shlokas.8:
bhIShmo.api samare jitvA pANDavAnsaha sRRi~njayaiH |
pUjyamAnastava sutairvandyamAnashcha bhArata
shlokas.9:
nyavishatkurubhiH sArdhaM hRRiShTarUpaiH samantataH |
tato rAtriH samabhavatsarvabhUtapramohinI
shlokas.10:
tasminrAtrimukhe ghore pANDavA vRRiShNibhiH saha |
sRRi~njayAshcha durAdharShA mantrAya samupAvishan
shlokas.11:
AtmaniHshreyasaM sarve prAptakAlaM mahAbalAH |
mantrayAmAsuravyagrA mantranishchayakovidAH
shlokas.12:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA mantrayitvA chiraM nRRipa |
vAsudevaM samudvIkShya vAkyametaduvAcha ha
shlokas.13:
pashya kRRiShNa mahAtmAnaM bhIShmaM bhImaparAkramam |
gajaM nalavanAnIva vimRRidnantaM balaM mama
shlokas.14:
na chaivainaM mahAtmAnamutsahAmo nirIkShitum |
lelihyamAnaM sainyeShu pravRRiddhamiva pAvakam
shlokas.15:
yathA ghoro mahAnAgastakShako vai viSholbaNaH |
tathA bhIShmo raNe kRRiShNa tIkShNashastraH pratApavAn
shlokas.16:
gRRihItachApaH samare vimu~ncha.nshcha shitA~nsharAn |
shakyo jetuM yamaH kruddho vajrapANishcha devarAT
shlokas.17:
varuNaH pAshabhRRidvApi sagado vA dhaneshvaraH |
na tu bhIShmaH susa~NkruddhaH shakyo jetuM mahAhave
shlokas.18:
so.ahamevaM gate kRRiShNa nimagnaH shokasAgare |
Atmano buddhidaurbalyAdbhIShmamAsAdya sa.nyuge
shlokas.19:
vanaM yAsyAmi durdharSha shreyo me tatra vai gatam |
na yuddhaM rochaye kRRiShNa hanti bhIShmo hi naH sadA
shlokas.20:
yathA prajvalitaM vahniM pata~NgaH samabhidravan |
ekato mRRityumabhyeti tathAhaM bhIShmamIyivAn
shlokas.21:
kShayaM nIto.asmi vArShNeya rAjyahetoH parAkramI |
bhrAtarashchaiva me shUrAH sAyakairbhRRishapIDitAH
shlokas.22:
matkRRite bhrAtRRisauhArdAdrAjyAtprabhra.nshanaM gatAH |
parikliShTA tathA kRRiShNA matkRRite madhusUdana
shlokas.23:
jIvitaM bahu manye.ahaM jIvitaM hyadya durlabham |
jIvitasyAdya sheSheNa chariShye dharmamuttamam
shlokas.24:
yadi te.ahamanugrAhyo bhrAtRRibhiH saha keshava |
svadharmasyAvirodhena tadudAhara keshava
shlokas.25:
etachChrutvA vachastasya kAruNyAdbahuvistaram |
pratyuvAcha tataH kRRiShNaH sAntvayAno yudhiShThiram
shlokas.26:
dharmaputra viShAdaM tvaM mA kRRithAH satyasa~Ngara |
yasya te bhrAtaraH shUrA durjayAH shatrusUdanAH
shlokas.27:
arjuno bhImasenashcha vAyvagnisamatejasau |
mAdrIputrau cha vikrAntau tridashAnAmiveshvarau
shlokas.28:
mAM vA niyu~NkShva sauhArdAdyotsye bhIShmeNa pANDava |
tvatprayukto hyahaM rAjankiM na kuryAM mahAhave
shlokas.29:
haniShyAmi raNe bhIShmamAhUya puruSharShabham |
pashyatAM dhArtarAShTrANAM yadi nechChati phalgunaH
shlokas.30:
yadi bhIShme hate rAja~njayaM pashyasi pANDava |
hantAsmyekarathenAdya kuruvRRiddhaM pitAmaham
shlokas.31:
pashya me vikramaM rAjanmahendrasyeva sa.nyuge |
vimu~nchantaM mahAstrANi pAtayiShyAmi taM rathAt
shlokas.32:
yaH shatruH pANDuputrANAM machChatruH sa na sa.nshayaH |
madarthA bhavadarthA ye ye madIyAstavaiva te
shlokas.33:
tava bhrAtA mama sakhA sambandhI shiShya eva cha |
mA.nsAnyutkRRitya vai dadyAmarjunArthe mahIpate
shlokas.34:
eSha chApi naravyAghro matkRRite jIvitaM tyajet |
eSha naH samayastAta tArayema parasparam
sa mAM niyu~NkShva rAjendra yAvaddvIpo bhavAmyaham
shlokas.35:
pratij~nAtamupaplavye yattatpArthena pUrvataH |
ghAtayiShyAmi gA~NgeyamityulUkasya saMnidhau
shlokas.36:
parirakShyaM cha mama tadvachaH pArthasya dhImataH |
anuj~nAtaM tu pArthena mayA kAryaM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.37:
atha vA phalgunasyaiSha bhAraH parimito raNe |
nihaniShyati sa~NgrAme bhIShmaM parapura~njayam
shlokas.38:
ashakyamapi kuryAddhi raNe pArthaH samudyataH |
tridashAnvA samudyuktAnsahitAndaityadAnavaiH
nihanyAdarjunaH sa~Nkhye kimu bhIShmaM narAdhipa
shlokas.39:
viparIto mahAvIryo gatasattvo.alpajIvitaH |
bhIShmaH shAntanavo nUnaM kartavyaM nAvabudhyate
shlokas.40:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi mAdhava |
sarve hyete na paryAptAstava veganivAraNe
shlokas.41:
niyataM samavApsyAmi sarvameva yathepsitam |
yasya me puruShavyAghra bhavAnnAtho mahAbalaH
shlokas.42:
sendrAnapi raNe devA~njayeyaM jayatAM vara |
tvayA nAthena govinda kimu bhIShmaM mahAhave
shlokas.43:
na tu tvAmanRRitaM kartumutsahe svArthagauravAt |
ayudhyamAnaH sAhAyyaM yathoktaM kuru mAdhava
shlokas.44:
samayastu kRRitaH kashchidbhIShmeNa mama mAdhava |
mantrayiShye tavArthAya na tu yotsye katha~nchana
duryodhanArthe yotsyAmi satyametaditi prabho
shlokas.45:
sa hi rAjyasya me dAtA mantrasyaiva cha mAdhava |
tasmAddevavrataM bhUyo vadhopAyArthamAtmanaH
bhavatA sahitAH sarve pRRichChAmo madhusUdana
shlokas.46:
tadvayaM sahitA gatvA bhIShmamAshu narottamam |
ruchite tava vArShNeya mantraM pRRichChAma kauravam
shlokas.47:
sa vakShyati hitaM vAkyaM tathyaM chaiva janArdana |
yathA sa vakShyate kRRiShNa tathA kartAsmi sa.nyuge
shlokas.48:
sa no jayasya dAtA cha mantrasya cha dhRRitavrataH |
bAlAH pitrA vihInAshcha tena sa.nvardhitA vayam
shlokas.49:
taM chetpitAmahaM vRRiddhaM hantumichChAmi mAdhava |
pituH pitaramiShTaM vai dhigastu kShatrajIvikAm
shlokas.50:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato.abravInmahArAja vArShNeyaH kurunandanam |
rochate me mahAbAho satataM tava bhAShitam
shlokas.51:
devavrataH kRRitI bhIShmaH prekShitenApi nirdahet |
gamyatAM sa vadhopAyaM praShTuM sAgaragAsutaH
vaktumarhati satyaM sa tvayA pRRiShTo visheShataH
shlokas.52:
te vayaM tatra gachChAmaH praShTuM kurupitAmaham |
praNamya shirasA chainaM mantraM pRRichChAma mAdhava
sa no dAsyati yaM mantraM tena yotsyAmahe parAn
shlokas.53:
evaM saMmantrya vai vIrAH pANDavAH pANDupUrvaja |
jagmuste sahitAH sarve vAsudevashcha vIryavAn
vimuktashastrakavachA bhIShmasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.54:
pravishya cha tadA bhIShmaM shirobhiH pratipedire |
pUjayanto mahArAja pANDavA bharatarShabha
praNamya shirasA chainaM bhIShmaM sharaNamanvayuH
shlokas.55:
tAnuvAcha mahAbAhurbhIShmaH kurupitAmahaH |
svAgataM tava vArShNeya svAgataM te dhana~njaya
svAgataM dharmaputrAya bhImAya yamayostathA
shlokas.56:
kiM kAryaM vaH karomyadya yuShmatprItivivardhanam |
sarvAtmanA cha kartAsmi yadyapi syAtsuduShkaram
shlokas.57:
tathA bruvANaM gA~NgeyaM prItiyuktaM punaH punaH |
uvAcha vAkyaM dInAtmA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.58:
kathaM jayema dharmaj~na kathaM rAjyaM labhemahi |
prajAnAM sa~NkShayo na syAtkathaM tanme vadAbhibho
shlokas.59:
bhavAnhi no vadhopAyaM bravItu svayamAtmanaH |
bhavantaM samare rAjanviShahema kathaM vayam
shlokas.60:
na hi te sUkShmamapyasti randhraM kurupitAmaha |
maNDalenaiva dhanuShA sadA dRRishyo.asi sa.nyuge
shlokas.61:
nAdadAnaM sa.ndadhAnaM vikarShantaM dhanurna cha |
pashyAmastvA mahAbAho rathe sUryamiva sthitam
shlokas.62:
narAshvarathanAgAnAM hantAraM paravIrahan |
ka ivotsahate hantuM tvAM pumAnbharatarShabha
shlokas.63:
varShatA sharavarShANi mahAnti puruShottama |
kShayaM nItA hi pRRitanA bhavatA mahatI mama
shlokas.64:
yathA yudhi jayeyaM tvAM yathA rAjyaM bhavenmama |
bhavetsainyasya vA shAntistanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.65:
tato.abravIchChAntanavaH pANDavAnpANDupUrvaja |
na katha~nchana kaunteya mayi jIvati sa.nyuge
yuShmAsu dRRishyate vRRiddhiH satyametadbravImi vaH
shlokas.66:
nirjite mayi yuddhe tu dhruvaM jeShyatha kauravAn |
kShipraM mayi praharata yadIchChatha raNe jayam
anujAnAmi vaH pArthAH praharadhvaM yathAsukham
shlokas.67:
evaM hi sukRRitaM manye bhavatAM vidito hyaham |
hate mayi hataM sarvaM tasmAdevaM vidhIyatAm
shlokas.68:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brUhi tasmAdupAyaM no yathA yuddhe jayemahi |
bhavantaM samare kruddhaM daNDapANimivAntakam
shlokas.69:
shakyo vajradharo jetuM varuNo.atha yamastathA |
na bhavAnsamare shakyaH sendrairapi surAsuraiH
shlokas.70:
bhIShma uvAcha||
satyametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi pANDava |
nAhaM shakyo raNe jetuM sendrairapi surAsuraiH
shlokas.71:
Attashastro raNe yatto gRRihItavarakArmukaH |
nyastashastraM tu mAM rAjanhanyuryudhi mahArathAH
shlokas.72:
nikShiptashastre patite vimuktakavachadhvaje |
dravamANe cha bhIte cha tavAsmIti cha vAdini
shlokas.73:
striyAM strInAmadheye cha vikale chaikaputrake |
aprasUte cha duShprekShye na yuddhaM rochate mama
shlokas.74:
imaM cha shRRiNu me pArtha sa~NkalpaM pUrvachintitam |
ama~NgalyadhvajaM dRRiShTvA na yudhyeyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.75:
ya eSha draupado rAja.nstava sainye mahArathaH |
shikhaNDI samarAkA~NkShI shUrashcha samiti~njayaH
shlokas.76:
yathAbhavachcha strI pUrvaM pashchAtpu.nstvamupAgataH |
jAnanti cha bhavanto.api sarvametadyathAtatham
shlokas.77:
arjunaH samare shUraH puraskRRitya shikhaNDinam |
mAmeva vishikhaistUrNamabhidravatu da.nshitaH
shlokas.78:
ama~Ngalyadhvaje tasminstrIpUrve cha visheShataH |
na prahartumabhIpsAmi gRRihIteShuM katha~nchana
shlokas.79:
tadantaraM samAsAdya pANDavo mAM dhana~njayaH |
sharairghAtayatu kShipraM samantAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.80:
na taM pashyAmi lokeShu yo mAM hanyAtsamudyatam |
RRite kRRiShNAnmahAbhAgAtpANDavAdvA dhana~njayAt
shlokas.81:
eSha tasmAtpurodhAya ka~nchidanyaM mamAgrataH |
mAM pAtayatu bIbhatsurevaM te vijayo bhavet
shlokas.82:
etatkuruShva kaunteya yathoktaM vachanaM mama |
tato jeShyasi sa~NgrAme dhArtarAShTrAnsamAgatAn
shlokas.83:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
te.anuj~nAtAstataH pArthA jagmuH svashibiraM prati |
abhivAdya mahAtmAnaM bhIShmaM kurupitAmaham
shlokas.84:
tathoktavati gA~Ngeye paralokAya dIkShite |
arjuno duHkhasantaptaH savrIDamidamabravIt
shlokas.85:
guruNA kulavRRiddhena kRRitapraj~nena dhImatA |
pitAmahena sa~NgrAme kathaM yotsyAmi mAdhava
shlokas.86:
krIDatA hi mayA bAlye vAsudeva mahAmanAH |
pA.nsurUShitagAtreNa mahAtmA paruShIkRRitaH
shlokas.87:
yasyAhamadhiruhyA~NkaM bAlaH kila gadAgraja |
tAtetyavochaM pitaraM pituH pANDormahAtmanaH
shlokas.88:
nAhaM tAtastava pitustAto.asmi tava bhArata |
iti mAmabravIdbAlye yaH sa vadhyaH kathaM mayA
shlokas.89:
kAmaM vadhyatu me sainyaM nAhaM yotsye mahAtmanA |
jayo vAstu vadho vA me kathaM vA kRRiShNa manyase
shlokas.90:
shrIkRRiShNa uvAcha||
pratij~nAya vadhaM jiShNo purA bhIShmasya sa.nyuge |
kShatradharme sthitaH pArtha kathaM nainaM haniShyasi
shlokas.91:
pAtayainaM rathAtpArtha vajrAhatamiva drumam |
nAhatvA yudhi gA~NgeyaM vijayaste bhaviShyati
shlokas.92:
diShTametatpurA devairbhaviShyatyavashasya te |
hantA bhIShmasya pUrvendra iti tanna tadanyathA
shlokas.93:
na hi bhIShmaM durAdharShaM vyAttAnanamivAntakam |
tvadanyaH shaknuyAddhantumapi vajradharaH svayam
shlokas.94:
jahi bhIShmaM mahAbAho shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama |
yathovAcha purA shakraM mahAbuddhirbRRihaspatiH
shlokas.95:
jyAyA.nsamapi chechChakra guNairapi samanvitam |
AtatAyinamAmantrya hanyAdghAtakamAgatam
shlokas.96:
shAshvato.ayaM sthito dharmaH kShatriyANAM dhana~njaya |
yoddhavyaM rakShitavyaM cha yaShTavyaM chAnasUyubhiH
shlokas.97:
arjuna uvAcha||
shikhaNDI nidhanaM kRRiShNa bhIShmasya bhavitA dhruvam |
dRRiShTvaiva hi sadA bhIShmaH pA~nchAlyaM vinivartate
shlokas.98:
te vayaM pramukhe tasya sthApayitvA shikhaNDinam |
gA~NgeyaM pAtayiShyAma upAyeneti me matiH
shlokas.99:
ahamanyAnmaheShvAsAnvArayiShyAmi sAyakaiH |
shikhaNDyapi yudhAM shreShTho bhIShmamevAbhiyAsyatu
shlokas.100:
shrutaM te kurumukhyasya nAhaM hanyAM shikhaNDinam |
kanyA hyeShA purA jAtA puruShaH samapadyata
shlokas.101:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityevaM nishchayaM kRRitvA pANDavAH sahamAdhavAH |
shayanAni yathAsvAni bhejire puruSharShabhAH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM shikhaNDI gA~Ngeyamabhyavartata sa.nyuge |
pANDavAshcha tathA bhIShmaM tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH prabhAte vimale sUryasyodayanaM prati |
vAdyamAnAsu bherIShu mRRida~NgeShvAnakeShu cha
shlokas.3:
dhmAyatsu dadhivarNeShu jalajeShu samantataH |
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya niryAtAH pANDavA yudhi
shlokas.4:
kRRitvA vyUhaM mahArAja sarvashatrunibarhaNam |
shikhaNDI sarvasainyAnAmagra AsIdvishAM pate
shlokas.5:
chakrarakShau tatastasya bhImasenadhana~njayau |
pRRiShThato draupadeyAshcha saubhadrashchaiva vIryavAn
shlokas.6:
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha teShAM goptA mahArathaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnastataH pashchAtpA~nchAlairabhirakShitaH
shlokas.7:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA yamAbhyAM sahitaH prabhuH |
prayayau siMhanAdena nAdayanbharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
virATastu tataH pashchAtsvena sainyena sa.nvRRitaH |
drupadashcha mahArAja tataH pashchAdupAdravat
shlokas.9:
kekayA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha dhRRiShTaketushcha vIryavAn |
jaghanaM pAlayAmAsa pANDusainyasya bhArata
shlokas.10:
evaM vyUhya mahatsainyaM pANDavAstava vAhinIm |
abhyadravanta sa~NgrAme tyaktvA jIvitamAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
tathaiva kuravo rAjanbhIShmaM kRRitvA mahAbalam |
agrataH sarvasainyAnAM prayayuH pANDavAnprati
shlokas.12:
putraistava durAdharShai rakShitaH sumahAbalaiH |
tato droNo maheShvAsaH putrashchAsya mahArathaH
shlokas.13:
bhagadattastataH pashchAdgajAnIkena sa.nvRRitaH |
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha bhagadattamanuvratau
shlokas.14:
kAmbojarAjo balavA.nstataH pashchAtsudakShiNaH |
mAgadhashcha jayatsenaH saubalashcha bRRihadbalaH
shlokas.15:
tathetare maheShvAsAH susharmapramukhA nRRipAH |
jaghanaM pAlayAmAsustava sainyasya bhArata
shlokas.16:
divase divase prApte bhIShmaH shAntanavo yudhi |
AsurAnakarodvyUhAnpaishAchAnatha rAkShasAn
shlokas.17:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tava teShAM cha bhArata |
anyonyaM nighnatAM rAjanyamarAShTravivardhanam
shlokas.18:
arjunapramukhAH pArthAH puraskRRitya shikhaNDinam |
bhIShmaM yuddhe.abhyavartanta kiranto vividhA~nsharAn
shlokas.19:
tatra bhArata bhImena pIDitAstAvakAH sharaiH |
rudhiraughapariklinnAH paralokaM yayustadA
shlokas.20:
nakulaH sahadevashcha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
tava sainyaM samAsAdya pIDayAmAsurojasA
shlokas.21:
te vadhyamAnAH samare tAvakA bharatarShabha |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM pANDavAnAM mahadbalam
shlokas.22:
tatastu tAvakaM sainyaM vadhyamAnaM samantataH |
samprAdravaddisho rAjankAlyamAnaM mahArathaiH
shlokas.23:
trAtAraM nAdhyagachChanta tAvakA bharatarShabha |
vadhyamAnAH shitairbANaiH pANDavaiH sahasRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.24:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
pIDyamAnaM balaM pArthairdRRiShTvA bhIShmaH parAkramI |
yadakArShIdraNe kruddhastanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.25:
kathaM vA pANDavAnyuddhe pratyudyAtaH parantapaH |
vinighnansomakAnvIrA.nstanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.26:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
AchakShe te mahArAja yadakArShItpitAmahaH |
pIDite tava putrasya sainye pANDavasRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.27:
prahRRiShTamanasaH shUrAH pANDavAH pANDupUrvaja |
abhyavartanta nighnantastava putrasya vAhinIm
shlokas.28:
taM vinAshaM manuShyendra naravAraNavAjinAm |
nAmRRiShyata tadA bhIShmaH sainyaghAtaM raNe paraiH
shlokas.29:
sa pANDavAnmaheShvAsaH pA~nchAlA.nshcha sasRRi~njayAn |
abhyadravata durdharShastyaktvA jIvitamAtmanaH
shlokas.30:
sa pANDavAnAM pravarAnpa~ncha rAjanmahArathAn |
AttashastrAnraNe yattAnvArayAmAsa sAyakaiH
nArAchairvatsadantaishcha shitaira~njalikaistathA
shlokas.31:
nijaghne samare kruddho hastyashvamamitaM bahu |
rathino.apAtayadrAjanrathebhyaH puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.32:
sAdinashchAshvapRRiShThebhyaH padAtI.nshcha samAgatAn |
gajArohAngajebhyashcha pareShAM vidadhadbhayam
shlokas.33:
tamekaM samare bhIShmaM tvaramANaM mahAratham |
pANDavAH samavartanta vajrapANimivAsurAH
shlokas.34:
shakrAshanisamasparshAnvimu~nchannishitA~nsharAn |
dikShvadRRishyata sarvAsu ghoraM sandhArayanvapuH
shlokas.35:
maNDalIkRRitamevAsya nityaM dhanuradRRishyata |
sa~NgrAme yudhyamAnasya shakrachApanibhaM mahat
shlokas.36:
taddRRiShTvA samare karma tava putrA vishAM pate |
vismayaM paramaM prAptAH pitAmahamapUjayan
shlokas.37:
pArthA vimanaso bhUtvA praikShanta pitaraM tava |
yudhyamAnaM raNe shUraM viprachittimivAmarAH
na chainaM vArayAmAsurvyAttAnanamivAntakam
shlokas.38:
dashame.ahani samprApte rathAnIkaM shikhaNDinaH |
adahannishitairbANaiH kRRiShNavartmeva kAnanam
shlokas.39:
taM shikhaNDI tribhirbANairabhyavidhyatstanAntare |
AshIviShamiva kruddhaM kAlasRRiShTamivAntakam
shlokas.40:
sa tenAtibhRRishaM viddhaH prekShya bhIShmaH shikhaNDinam |
anichChannapi sa~NkruddhaH prahasannidamabravIt
shlokas.41:
kAmamabhyasa vA mA vA na tvAM yotsye katha~nchana |
yaiva hi tvaM kRRitA dhAtrA saiva hi tvaM shikhaNDinI
shlokas.42:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA shikhaNDI krodhamUrChitaH |
uvAcha bhIShmaM samare sRRikkiNI parilelihan
shlokas.43:
jAnAmi tvAM mahAbAho kShatriyANAM kShaya~Nkaram |
mayA shrutaM cha te yuddhaM jAmadagnyena vai saha
shlokas.44:
divyashcha te prabhAvo.ayaM sa mayA bahushaH shrutaH |
jAnannapi prabhAvaM te yotsye.adyAhaM tvayA saha
shlokas.45:
pANDavAnAM priyaM kurvannAtmanashcha narottama |
adya tvA yodhayiShyAmi raNe puruShasattama
shlokas.46:
dhruvaM cha tvA haniShyAmi shape satyena te.agrataH |
etachChrutvA vacho mahyaM yatkShamaM tatsamAchara
shlokas.47:
kAmamabhyasa vA mA vA na me jIvanvimokShyase |
sudRRiShTaH kriyatAM bhIShma loko.ayaM samiti~njaya
shlokas.48:
evamuktvA tato bhIShmaM pa~nchabhirnataparvabhiH |
avidhyata raNe rAjanpraNunnaM vAkyasAyakaiH
shlokas.49:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA savyasAchI parantapaH |
kAlo.ayamiti sa~nchintya shikhaNDinamachodayat
shlokas.50:
ahaM tvAmanuyAsyAmi parAnvidrAvaya~nsharaiH |
abhidrava susa.nrabdho bhIShmaM bhImaparAkramam
shlokas.51:
na hi te sa.nyuge pIDAM shaktaH kartuM mahAbalaH |
tasmAdadya mahAbAho vIra bhIShmamabhidrava
shlokas.52:
ahatvA samare bhIShmaM yadi yAsyasi mAriSha |
avahAsyo.asya lokasya bhaviShyasi mayA saha
shlokas.53:
nAvahAsyA yathA vIra bhavema paramAhave |
tathA kuru raNe yatnaM sAdhayasva pitAmaham
shlokas.54:
ahaM te rakShaNaM yuddhe kariShyAmi parantapa |
vArayanrathinaH sarvAnsAdhayasva pitAmaham
shlokas.55:
droNaM cha droNaputraM cha kRRipaM chAtha suyodhanam |
chitrasenaM vikarNaM cha saindhavaM cha jayadratham
shlokas.56:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau kAmbojaM cha sudakShiNam |
bhagadattaM tathA shUraM mAgadhaM cha mahAratham
shlokas.57:
saumadattiM raNe shUramArshyashRRi~NgiM cha rAkShasam |
trigartarAjaM cha raNe saha sarvairmahArathaiH
ahamAvArayiShyAmi veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.58:
kurU.nshcha sahitAnsarvAnye chaiShAM sainikAH sthitAH |
nivArayiShyAmi raNe sAdhayasva pitAmaham

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM shikhaNDI gA~NgeyamabhyadhAvatpitAmaham |
pA~nchAlyaH samare kruddho dharmAtmAnaM yatavratam
shlokas.2:
ke.arakShanpANDavAnIke shikhaNDinamudAyudham |
tvaramANAstvarAkAle jigIShanto mahArathAH
shlokas.3:
kathaM shAntanavo bhIShmaH sa tasmindashame.ahani |
ayudhyata mahAvIryaH pANDavaiH sahasRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.4:
na mRRiShyAmi raNe bhIShmaM pratyudyAtaM shikhaNDinam |
kachchinna rathabha~Ngo.asya dhanurvAshIryatAsyataH
shlokas.5:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
nAshIryata dhanustasya rathabha~Ngo na chApyabhUt |
yudhyamAnasya sa~NgrAme bhIShmasya bharatarShabha
nighnataH samare shatrU~nsharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.6:
anekashatasAhasrAstAvakAnAM mahArathAH |
rathadantigaNA rAjanhayAshchaiva susajjitAH
abhyavartanta yuddhAya puraskRRitya pitAmaham
shlokas.7:
yathApratij~naM kauravya sa chApi samiti~njayaH |
pArthAnAmakarodbhIShmaH satataM samitikShayam
shlokas.8:
yudhyamAnaM maheShvAsaM vinighnantaM parA~nsharaiH |
pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH sArdhaM sarva evAbhyavArayan
shlokas.9:
dashame.ahani samprApte tatApa ripuvAhinIm |
kIryamANAM shitairbANaiH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.10:
na hi bhIShmaM maheShvAsaM pANDavAH pANDupUrvaja |
ashaknuvanraNe jetuM pAshahastamivAntakam
shlokas.11:
athopAyAnmahArAja savyasAchI parantapaH |
trAsayanrathinaH sarvAnbIbhatsuraparAjitaH
shlokas.12:
siMhavadvinadannuchchairdhanurjyAM vikShipanmuhuH |
sharaughAnvisRRijanpArtho vyacharatkAlavadraNe
shlokas.13:
tasya shabdena vitrastAstAvakA bharatarShabha |
siMhasyeva mRRigA rAjanvyadravanta mahAbhayAt
shlokas.14:
jayantaM pANDavaM dRRiShTvA tvatsainyaM chAbhipIDitam |
duryodhanastato bhIShmamabravIdbhRRishapIDitaH
shlokas.15:
eSha pANDusutastAta shvetAshvaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
dahate mAmakAnsarvAnkRRiShNavartmeva kAnanam
shlokas.16:
pashya sainyAni gA~Ngeya dravamANAni sarvashaH |
pANDavena yudhAM shreShTha kAlyamAnAni sa.nyuge
shlokas.17:
yathA pashugaNAnpAlaH sa~NkAlayati kAnane |
tathedaM mAmakaM sainyaM kAlyate shatrutApana
shlokas.18:
dhana~njayasharairbhagnaM dravamANamitastataH |
bhImo hyeSha durAdharSho vidrAvayati me balam
shlokas.19:
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
abhimanyushcha vikrAnto vAhinIM dahate mama
shlokas.20:
dhRRiShTadyumnastathA shUro rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH |
vyadrAvayetAM sahasA sainyaM mama mahAbalau
shlokas.21:
vadhyamAnasya sainyasya sarvairetairmahAbalaiH |
nAnyAM gatiM prapashyAmi sthAne yuddhe cha bhArata
shlokas.22:
RRite tvAM puruShavyAghra devatulyaparAkrama |
paryAptashcha bhavAnkShipraM pIDitAnAM gatirbhava
shlokas.23:
evamukto mahArAja pitA devavratastava |
chintayitvA muhUrtaM tu kRRitvA nishchayamAtmanaH
tava sandhArayanputramabravIchChantanoH sutaH
shlokas.24:
duryodhana vijAnIhi sthiro bhava vishAM pate |
pUrvakAlaM tava mayA pratij~nAtaM mahAbala
shlokas.25:
hatvA dasha sahasrANi kShatriyANAM mahAtmanAm |
sa~NgrAmAdvyapayAtavyametatkarma mamAhnikam
iti tatkRRitavA.nshchAhaM yathoktaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.26:
adya chApi mahatkarma prakariShye mahAhave |
ahaM vA nihataH sheShye haniShye vAdya pANDavAn
shlokas.27:
adya te puruShavyAghra pratimokShye RRiNaM mahat |
bhartRRipiNDakRRitaM rAjannihataH pRRitanAmukhe
shlokas.28:
ityuktvA bharatashreShThaH kShatriyAnpratapa~nsharaiH |
AsasAda durAdharShaH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.29:
anIkamadhye tiShThantaM gA~NgeyaM bharatarShabha |
AshIviShamiva kruddhaM pANDavAH paryavArayan
shlokas.30:
dashame.ahani tasmi.nstu darshaya~nshaktimAtmanaH |
rAja~nshatasahasrANi so.avadhItkurunandana
shlokas.31:
pa~nchAlAnAM cha ye shreShThA rAjaputrA mahAbalAH |
teShAmAdatta tejA.nsi jalaM sUrya ivA.nshubhiH
shlokas.32:
hatvA dasha sahasrANi ku~njarANAM tarasvinAm |
sArohANAM mahArAja hayAnAM chAyutaM punaH
shlokas.33:
pUrNe shatasahasre dve padAtInAM narottamaH |
prajajvAla raNe bhIShmo vidhUma iva pAvakaH
shlokas.34:
na chainaM pANDaveyAnAM kechichChekurnirIkShitum |
uttaraM mArgamAsthAya tapantamiva bhAskaram
shlokas.35:
te pANDaveyAH sa.nrabdhA maheShvAsena pIDitAH |
vadhAyAbhyadravanbhIShmaM sRRi~njayAshcha mahArathAH
shlokas.36:
sa yudhyamAno bahubhirbhIShmaH shAntanavastadA |
avakIrNo mahAbAhuH shailo meghairivAsitaiH
shlokas.37:
putrAstu tava gA~NgeyaM samantAtparyavArayan |
mahatyA senayA sArdhaM tato yuddhamavartata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
arjunastu raNe rAjandRRiShTvA bhIShmasya vikramam |
shikhaNDinamathovAcha samabhyehi pitAmaham
shlokas.2:
na chApi bhIstvayA kAryA bhIShmAdadya katha~nchana |
ahamenaM sharaistIkShNaiH pAtayiShye rathottamAt
shlokas.3:
evamuktastu pArthena shikhaNDI bharatarShabha |
abhyadravata gA~NgeyaM shrutvA pArthasya bhAShitam
shlokas.4:
dhRRiShTadyumnastathA rAjansaubhadrashcha mahArathaH |
hRRiShTAvAdravatAM bhIShmaM shrutvA pArthasya bhAShitam
shlokas.5:
virATadrupadau vRRiddhau kuntibhojashcha da.nshitaH |
abhyadravata gA~NgeyaM putrasya tava pashyataH
shlokas.6:
nakulaH sahadevashcha dharmarAjashcha vIryavAn |
tathetarANi sainyAni sarvANyeva vishAM pate
samAdravanta gA~NgeyaM shrutvA pArthasya bhAShitam
shlokas.7:
pratyudyayustAvakAshcha sametAstAnmahArathAn |
yathAshakti yathotsAhaM tanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.8:
chitraseno mahArAja chekitAnaM samabhyayAt |
bhIShmaprepsuM raNe yAntaM vRRiShaM vyAghrashishuryathA
shlokas.9:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM mahArAja bhIShmAntikamupAgatam |
tvaramANo raNe yattaM kRRitavarmA nyavArayat
shlokas.10:
bhImasenaM susa~NkruddhaM gA~Ngeyasya vadhaiShiNam |
tvaramANo mahArAja saumadattirnyavArayat
shlokas.11:
tathaiva nakulaM vIraM kirantaM sAyakAnbahUn |
vikarNo vArayAmAsa ichChanbhIShmasya jIvitam
shlokas.12:
sahadevaM tathA yAntaM yattaM bhIShmarathaM prati |
vArayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaH kRRipaH shAradvato yudhi
shlokas.13:
rAkShasaM krUrakarmANaM bhaimaseniM mahAbalam |
bhIShmasya nidhanaM prepsuM durmukho.abhyadravadbalI
shlokas.14:
sAtyakiM samare kruddhamArshyashRRi~NgiravArayat |
abhimanyuM mahArAja yAntaM bhIShmarathaM prati
sudakShiNo mahArAja kAmbojaH pratyavArayat
shlokas.15:
virATadrupadau vRRiddhau sametAvarimardanau |
ashvatthAmA tataH kruddho vArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.16:
tathA pANDusutaM jyeShThaM bhIShmasya vadhakA~NkShiNam |
bhAradvAjo raNe yatto dharmaputramavArayat
shlokas.17:
arjunaM rabhasaM yuddhe puraskRRitya shikhaNDinam |
bhIShmaprepsuM mahArAja tApayantaM disho dasha
duHshAsano maheShvAso vArayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.18:
anye cha tAvakA yodhAH pANDavAnAM mahArathAn |
bhIShmAyAbhimukhaM yAtAnvArayAmAsurAhave
shlokas.19:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu sainyAni prAkroshata punaH punaH |
abhidravata sa.nrabdhA bhIShmamekaM mahAbalam
shlokas.20:
eSho.arjuno raNe bhIShmaM prayAti kurunandanaH |
abhidravata mA bhaiShTa bhIShmo na prApsyate hi vaH
shlokas.21:
arjunaM samare yoddhuM notsahetApi vAsavaH |
kimu bhIShmo raNe vIrA gatasattvo.alpajIvitaH
shlokas.22:
iti senApateH shrutvA pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
abhyadravanta saMhRRiShTA gA~Ngeyasya rathaM prati
shlokas.23:
AgachChatastAnsamare vAryoghAnprabalAniva |
nyavArayanta saMhRRiShTAstAvakAH puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.24:
duHshAsano mahArAja bhayaM tyaktvA mahArathaH |
bhIShmasya jIvitAkA~NkShI dhana~njayamupAdravat
shlokas.25:
tathaiva pANDavAH shUrA gA~Ngeyasya rathaM prati |
abhyadravanta sa~NgrAme tava putrAnmahArathAn
shlokas.26:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma chitrarUpaM vishAM pate |
duHshAsanarathaM prApto yatpArtho nAtyavartata
shlokas.27:
yathA vArayate velA kShubhitaM vai mahArNavam |
tathaiva pANDavaM kruddhaM tava putro nyavArayat
shlokas.28:
ubhau hi rathinAM shreShThAvubhau bhArata durjayau |
ubhau chandrArkasadRRishau kAntyA dIptyA cha bhArata
shlokas.29:
tau tathA jAtasa.nrambhAvanyonyavadhakA~NkShiNau |
samIyaturmahAsa~Nkhye mayashakrau yathA purA
shlokas.30:
duHshAsano mahArAja pANDavaM vishikhaistribhiH |
vAsudevaM cha vi.nshatyA tADayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.31:
tato.arjuno jAtamanyurvArShNeyaM vIkShya pIDitam |
duHshAsanaM shatenAjau nArAchAnAM samArpayat
te tasya kavachaM bhittvA papuH shoNitamAhave
shlokas.32:
duHshAsanastataH kruddhaH pArthaM vivyAdha pa~nchabhiH |
lalATe bharatashreShTha sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.33:
lalATasthaistu tairbANaiH shushubhe pANDavottamaH |
yathA merurmahArAja shRRi~NgairatyarthamuchChritaiH
shlokas.34:
so.atividdho maheShvAsaH putreNa tava dhanvinA |
vyarAjata raNe pArthaH ki.nshukaH puShpavAniva
shlokas.35:
duHshAsanaM tataH kruddhaH pIDayAmAsa pANDavaH |
parvaNIva susa~Nkruddho rAhurugro nishAkaram
shlokas.36:
pIDyamAno balavatA putrastava vishAM pate |
vivyAdha samare pArthaM ka~NkapatraiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.37:
tasya pArtho dhanushChittvA tvaramANaH parAkramI |
AjaghAna tataH pashchAtputraM te navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.38:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya bhIShmasya pramukhe sthitaH |
arjunaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA bAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.39:
tasya kruddho mahArAja pANDavaH shatrukarshanaH |
apraiShIdvishikhAnghorAnyamadaNDopamAnbahUn
shlokas.40:
aprAptAneva tAnbANA.nshchichCheda tanayastava |
yatamAnasya pArthasya tadadbhutamivAbhavat
pArthaM cha nishitairbANairavidhyattanayastava
shlokas.41:
tataH kruddho raNe pArthaH sharAnsandhAya kArmuke |
preShayAmAsa samare svarNapu~NkhA~nshilAshitAn
shlokas.42:
nyamajja.nste mahArAja tasya kAye mahAtmanaH |
yathA ha.nsA mahArAja taDAgaM prApya bhArata
shlokas.43:
pIDitashchaiva putraste pANDavena mahAtmanA |
hitvA pArthaM raNe tUrNaM bhIShmasya rathamAshrayat
agAdhe majjatastasya dvIpo bhIShmo.abhavattadA
shlokas.44:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM putrastava vishAM pate |
avArayattataH shUro bhUya eva parAkramI
shlokas.45:
sharaiH sunishitaiH pArthaM yathA vRRitraH pura.ndaram |
nirbibheda mahAvIryo vivyathe naiva chArjunAt

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sAtyakiM da.nshitaM yuddhe bhIShmAyAbhyudyataM tadA |
ArshyashRRi~NgirmaheShvAso vArayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.2:
mAdhavastu susa~Nkruddho rAkShasaM navabhiH sharaiH |
AjaghAna raNe rAjanprahasanniva bhArata
shlokas.3:
tathaiva rAkShaso rAjanmAdhavaM nishitaiH sharaiH |
ardayAmAsa rAjendra sa~NkruddhaH shinipu~Ngavam
shlokas.4:
shaineyaH sharasa~NghaM tu preShayAmAsa sa.nyuge |
rAkShasAya susa~Nkruddho mAdhavaH paravIrahA
shlokas.5:
tato rakSho mahAbAhuM sAtyakiM satyavikramam |
vivyAdha vishikhaistIkShNaiH siMhanAdaM nanAda cha
shlokas.6:
mAdhavastu bhRRishaM viddho rAkShasena raNe tadA |
dhairyamAlambya tejasvI jahAsa cha nanAda cha
shlokas.7:
bhagadattastataH kruddho mAdhavaM nishitaiH sharaiH |
tADayAmAsa samare tottrairiva mahAgajam
shlokas.8:
vihAya rAkShasaM yuddhe shaineyo rathinAM varaH |
prAgjyotiShAya chikShepa sharAnsaMnataparvaNaH
shlokas.9:
tasya prAgjyotiSho rAjA mAdhavasya mahaddhanuH |
chichCheda shitadhAreNa bhallena kRRitahastavat
shlokas.10:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya vegavatparavIrahA |
bhagadattaM raNe kruddho vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.11:
so.atividdho maheShvAsaH sRRikkiNI sa.nlihanmuhuH |
shaktiM kanakavaiDUryabhUShitAmAyasIM dRRiDhAm
yamadaNDopamAM ghorAM prAhiNotsAtyakAya vai
shlokas.12:
tAmApatantIM sahasA tasya bAhorbaleritAm |
sAtyakiH samare rAja.nstridhA chichCheda sAyakaiH
sA papAta tadA bhUmau maholkeva hataprabhA
shlokas.13:
shaktiM vinihatAM dRRiShTvA putrastava vishAM pate |
mahatA rathava.nshena vArayAmAsa mAdhavam
shlokas.14:
tathA parivRRitaM dRRiShTvA vArShNeyAnAM mahAratham |
duryodhano bhRRishaM hRRiShTo bhrAtR^InsarvAnuvAcha ha
shlokas.15:
tathA kuruta kauravyA yathA vaH sAtyako yudhi |
na jIvanpratiniryAti mahato.asmAdrathavrajAt
asminhate hataM manye pANDavAnAM mahadbalam
shlokas.16:
tattatheti vachastasya parigRRihya mahArathAH |
shaineyaM yodhayAmAsurbhIShmasya pramukhe tadA
shlokas.17:
abhimanyuM tadAyAntaM bhIShmAyAbhyudyataM mRRidhe |
kAmbojarAjo balavAnvArayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.18:
ArjunirnRRipatiM viddhvA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
punareva chatuHShaShTyA rAjanvivyAdha taM nRRipam
shlokas.19:
sudakShiNastu samare kArShNiM vivyAdha pa~nchabhiH |
sArathiM chAsya navabhirichChanbhIShmasya jIvitam
shlokas.20:
tadyuddhamAsItsumahattayostatra parAkrame |
yadabhyadhAvadgA~NgeyaM shikhaNDI shatrutApanaH
shlokas.21:
virATadrupadau vRRiddhau vArayantau mahAchamUm |
bhIShmaM cha yudhi sa.nrabdhAvAdravantau mahArathau
shlokas.22:
ashvatthAmA tataH kruddhaH samAyAdrathasattamaH |
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tava teShAM cha bhArata
shlokas.23:
virATo dashabhirbhallairAjaghAna parantapa |
yatamAnaM maheShvAsaM drauNimAhavashobhinam
shlokas.24:
drupadashcha tribhirbANairvivyAdha nishitaistathA |
guruputraM samAsAdya bhIShmasya purataH sthitam
shlokas.25:
ashvatthAmA tatastau tu vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH |
virATadrupadau vRRiddhau bhIShmaM prati samudyatau
shlokas.26:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma vRRiddhayoshcharitaM mahat |
yaddrauNeH sAyakAnghorAnpratyavArayatAM yudhi
shlokas.27:
sahadevaM tathA yAntaM kRRipaH shAradvato.abhyayAt |
yathA nAgo vane nAgaM matto mattamupAdravat
shlokas.28:
kRRipashcha samare rAjanmAdrIputraM mahAratham |
AjaghAna sharaistUrNaM saptatyA rukmabhUShaNaiH
shlokas.29:
tasya mAdrIsutashchApaM dvidhA chichCheda sAyakaiH |
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM vivyAdha navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.30:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya samare bhArasAdhanam |
mAdrIputraM susaMhRRiShTo dashabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
AjaghAnorasi kruddha ichChanbhIShmasya jIvitam
shlokas.31:
tathaiva pANDavo rAja~nshAradvatamamarShaNam |
AjaghAnorasi kruddho bhIShmasya vadhakA~NkShayA
tayoryuddhaM samabhavadghorarUpaM bhayAvaham
shlokas.32:
nakulaM tu raNe kruddhaM vikarNaH shatrutApanaH |
vivyAdha sAyakaiH ShaShTyA rakShanbhIShmasya jIvitam
shlokas.33:
nakulo.api bhRRishaM viddhastava putreNa dhanvinA |
vikarNaM saptasaptatyA nirbibheda shilImukhaiH
shlokas.34:
tatra tau narashArdUlau bhIShmahetoH parantapau |
anyonyaM jaghnaturvIrau goShThe govRRiShabhAviva
shlokas.35:
ghaTotkachaM raNe yattaM nighnantaM tava vAhinIm |
durmukhaH samare prAyAdbhIShmahetoH parAkramI
shlokas.36:
haiDimbastu tato rAjandurmukhaM shatrutApanam |
AjaghAnorasi kruddho navatyA nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.37:
bhImasenasutaM chApi durmukhaH sumukhaiH sharaiH |
ShaShTyA vIro nadanhRRiShTo vivyAdha raNamUrdhani
shlokas.38:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM raNe yAntaM bhIShmasya vadhakA~NkShiNam |
hArdikyo vArayAmAsa rakShanbhIShmasya jIvitam
shlokas.39:
vArShNeyaH pArShataM shUraM viddhvA pa~nchabhirAyasaiH |
punaH pa~nchAshatA tUrNamAjaghAna stanAntare
shlokas.40:
tathaiva pArShato rAjanhArdikyaM navabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha nishitaistIkShNaiH ka~NkapatraparichChadaiH
shlokas.41:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM bhIShmahetormahAraNe |
anyonyAtishayairyuktaM yathA vRRitramahendrayoH
shlokas.42:
bhImasenamathAyAntaM bhIShmaM prati mahAbalam |
bhUrishravAbhyayAttUrNaM tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.43:
saumadattiratho bhImamAjaghAna stanAntare |
nArAchena sutIkShNena rukmapu~Nkhena sa.nyuge
shlokas.44:
uraHsthena babhau tena bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
skandashaktyA yathA krau~nchaH purA nRRipatisattama
shlokas.45:
tau sharAnsUryasa~NkAshAnkarmAraparimArjitAn |
anyonyasya raNe kruddhau chikShipAte muhurmuhuH
shlokas.46:
bhImo bhIShmavadhAkAnShkI saumadattiM mahAratham |
tathA bhIShmajaye gRRidhnuH saumadattishcha pANDavam
kRRitapratikRRite yattau yodhayAmAsatU raNe
shlokas.47:
yudhiShThiraM mahArAja mahatyA senayA vRRitam |
bhIShmAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM bhAradvAjo nyavArayat
shlokas.48:
droNasya rathanirghoShaM parjanyaninadopamam |
shrutvA prabhadrakA rAjansamakampanta mAriSha
shlokas.49:
sA senA mahatI rAjanpANDuputrasya sa.nyuge |
droNena vAritA yattA na chachAla padAtpadam
shlokas.50:
chekitAnaM raNe kruddhaM bhIShmaM prati janeshvara |
chitrasenastava sutaH kruddharUpamavArayat
shlokas.51:
bhIShmahetoH parAkrAntashchitraseno mahArathaH |
chekitAnaM paraM shaktyA yodhayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.52:
tathaiva chekitAno.api chitrasenamayodhayat |
tadyuddhamAsItsumahattayostatra parAkrame
shlokas.53:
arjuno vAryamANastu bahushastanayena te |
vimukhIkRRitya putraM te tava senAM mamarda ha
shlokas.54:
duHshAsano.api parayA shaktyA pArthamavArayat |
kathaM bhIShmaM paro hanyAditi nishchitya bhArata
shlokas.55:
sA vadhyamAnA samare putrasya tava vAhinI |
loDyate rathibhiH shreShThaistatra tatraiva bhArata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
atha vIro maheShvAso mattavAraNavikramaH |
samAdAya mahachchApaM mattavAraNavAraNam
shlokas.2:
vidhunvAno dhanuH shreShThaM drAvayANo mahArathAn |
pRRitanAM pANDaveyAnAM pAtayAno mahArathaH
shlokas.3:
nimittAni nimittaj~naH sarvato vIkShya vIryavAn |
pratapantamanIkAni droNaH putramabhAShata
shlokas.4:
ayaM sa divasastAta yatra pArtho mahArathaH |
jighA.nsuH samare bhIShmaM paraM yatnaM kariShyati
shlokas.5:
utpatanti hi me bANA dhanuH prasphuratIva me |
yogamastrANi gachChanti krUre me vartate matiH
shlokas.6:
dikShu shAntAsu ghorANi vyAharanti mRRigadvijAH |
nIchairgRRidhrA nilIyante bhAratAnAM chamUM prati
shlokas.7:
naShTaprabha ivAdityaH sarvato lohitA dishaH |
rasate vyathate bhUmiranuShTanati vAhanam
shlokas.8:
ka~NkA gRRidhrA balAkAshcha vyAharanti muhurmuhuH |
shivAshchAshivanirghoShA vedayantyo mahadbhayam
shlokas.9:
papAta mahatI cholkA madhyenAdityamaNDalAt |
sakabandhashcha parigho bhAnumAvRRitya tiShThati
shlokas.10:
pariveShastathA ghorashchandrabhAskarayorabhUt |
vedayAno bhayaM ghoraM rAj~nAM dehAvakartanam
shlokas.11:
devatAyatanasthAshcha kauravendrasya devatAH |
kampante cha hasante cha nRRityanti cha rudanti cha
shlokas.12:
apasavyaM grahAshchakruralakShmANaM nishAkaram |
avAkShirAshcha bhagavAnudatiShThata chandramAH
shlokas.13:
vapUMShi cha narendrANAM vigatAnIva lakShaye |
dhArtarAShTrasya sainyeShu na cha bhrAjanti da.nshitAH
shlokas.14:
senayorubhayoshchaiva samantAchChrUyate mahAn |
pA~nchajanyasya nirghoSho gANDIvasya cha nisvanaH
shlokas.15:
dhruvamAsthAya bIbhatsuruttamAstrANi sa.nyuge |
apAsyAnyAnraNe yodhAnabhyasyati pitAmaham
shlokas.16:
hRRiShyanti romakUpAni sIdatIva cha me manaH |
chintayitvA mahAbAho bhIShmArjunasamAgamam
shlokas.17:
taM chaiva nikRRitipraj~naM pA~nchAlyaM pApachetasam |
puraskRRitya raNe pArtho bhIShmasyAyodhanaM gataH
shlokas.18:
abravIchcha purA bhIShmo nAhaM hanyAM shikhaNDinam |
strI hyeShA vihitA dhAtrA daivAchcha sa punaH pumAn
shlokas.19:
ama~Ngalyadhvajashchaiva yAj~nasenirmahArathaH |
na chAma~NgalaketoH sa praharedApagAsutaH
shlokas.20:
etadvichintayAnasya praj~nA sIdati me bhRRisham |
adyaiva tu raNe pArthaH kuruvRRiddhamupAdravat
shlokas.21:
yudhiShThirasya cha krodho bhIShmArjunasamAgamaH |
mama chAstrAbhisa.nrambhaH prajAnAmashubhaM dhruvam
shlokas.22:
manasvI balavA~nshUraH kRRitAstro dRRiDhavikramaH |
dUrapAtI dRRiDheShushcha nimittaj~nashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.23:
ajeyaH samare chaiva devairapi savAsavaiH |
balavAnbuddhimA.nshchaiva jitaklesho yudhAM varaH
shlokas.24:
vijayI cha raNe nityaM bhairavAstrashcha pANDavaH |
tasya mArgaM pariharandrutaM gachCha yatavratam
shlokas.25:
pashya chaitanmahAbAho vaishasaM samupasthitam |
hemachitrANi shUrANAM mahAnti cha shubhAni cha
shlokas.26:
kavachAnyavadIryante sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
Chidyante cha dhvajAgrANi tomarANi dhanUMShi cha
shlokas.27:
prAsAshcha vimalAstIkShNAH shaktyashcha kanakojjvalAH |
vaijayantyashcha nAgAnAM sa~Nkruddhena kirITinA
shlokas.28:
nAyaM sa.nrakShituM kAlaH prANAnputropajIvibhiH |
yAhi svargaM puraskRRitya yashase vijayAya cha
shlokas.29:
hayanAgarathAvartAM mahAghorAM sudustarAm |
rathena sa~NgrAmanadIM taratyeSha kapidhvajaH
shlokas.30:
brahmaNyatA damo dAnaM tapashcha charitaM mahat |
ihaiva dRRishyate rAj~no bhrAtA yasya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.31:
bhImasenashcha balavAnmAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
vAsudevashcha vArShNeyo yasya nAtho vyavasthitaH
shlokas.32:
tasyaiSha manyuprabhavo dhArtarAShTrasya durmateH |
tapodagdhasharIrasya kopo dahati bhAratAn
shlokas.33:
eSha sa.ndRRishyate pArtho vAsudevavyapAshrayaH |
dArayansarvasainyAni dhArtarAShTrANi sarvashaH
shlokas.34:
etadAlokyate sainyaM kShobhyamANaM kirITinA |
mahorminaddhaM sumahattimineva nadImukham
shlokas.35:
hAhAkilakilAshabdAH shrUyante cha chamUmukhe |
yAhi pA~nchAladAyAdamahaM yAsye yudhiShThiram
shlokas.36:
durlabhaM hyantaraM rAj~no vyUhasyAmitatejasaH |
samudrakukShipratimaM sarvato.atirathaiH sthitaiH
shlokas.37:
sAtyakishchAbhimanyushcha dhRRiShTadyumnavRRikodarau |
parirakShanti rAjAnaM yamau cha manujeshvaram
shlokas.38:
upendrasadRRishaH shyAmo mahAshAla ivodgataH |
eSha gachChatyanIkAni dvitIya iva phalgunaH
shlokas.39:
uttamAstrANi chAdatsva gRRihItvAnyanmahaddhanuH |
pArshvato yAhi rAjAnaM yudhyasva cha vRRikodaram
shlokas.40:
ko hi nechChetpriyaM putraM jIvantaM shAshvatIH samAH |
kShatradharmaM puraskRRitya tatastvA viniyujmahe
shlokas.41:
eSha chApi raNe bhIShmo dahate vai mahAchamUm |
yuddhe susadRRishastAta yamasya varuNasya cha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhagadattaH kRRipaH shalyaH kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau saindhavashcha jayadrathaH
shlokas.2:
chitraseno vikarNashcha tathA durmarShaNo yuvA |
dashaite tAvakA yodhA bhImasenamayodhayan
shlokas.3:
mahatyA senayA yuktA nAnAdeshasamutthayA |
bhIShmasya samare rAjanprArthayAnA mahadyashaH
shlokas.4:
shalyastu navabhirbANairbhImasenamatADayat |
kRRitavarmA tribhirbANaiH kRRipashcha navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.5:
chitraseno vikarNashcha bhagadattashcha mAriSha |
dashabhirdashabhirbhallairbhImasenamatADayan
shlokas.6:
saindhavashcha tribhirbANairjatrudeshe.abhyatADayat |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhiH sharaiH
durmarShaNashcha vi.nshatyA pANDavaM nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.7:
sa tAnsarvAnmahArAja bhrAjamAnAnpRRithakpRRithak |
pravIrAnsarvalokasya dhArtarAShTrAnmahArathAn
vivyAdha bahubhirbANairbhImaseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.8:
shalyaM pa~nchAshatA viddhvA kRRitavarmANamaShTabhiH |
kRRipasya sasharaM chApaM madhye chichCheda bhArata
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM punarvivyAdha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.9:
vindAnuvindau cha tathA tribhistribhiratADayat |
durmarShaNaM cha vi.nshatyA chitrasenaM cha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.10:
vikarNaM dashabhirbANaiH pa~nchabhishcha jayadratham |
viddhvA bhImo.anadaddhRRiShTaH saindhavaM cha punastribhiH
shlokas.11:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya gautamo rathinAM varaH |
bhImaM vivyAdha sa.nrabdho dashabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.12:
sa viddho bahubhirbANaistottrairiva mahAdvipaH |
tataH kruddho mahAbAhurbhImasenaH pratApavAn
gautamaM tADayAmAsa sharairbahubhirAhave
shlokas.13:
saindhavasya tathAshvA.nshcha sArathiM cha tribhiH sharaiH |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya kAlAntakasamadyutiH
shlokas.14:
hatAshvAttu rathAttUrNamavaplutya mahArathaH |
sharA.nshchikShepa nishitAnbhImasenasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.15:
tasya bhImo dhanurmadhye dvAbhyAM chichCheda bhArata |
bhallAbhyAM bharatashreShTha saindhavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.16:
sa chChinnadhanvA viratho hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
chitrasenarathaM rAjannAruroha tvarAnvitaH
shlokas.17:
atyadbhutaM raNe karma kRRitavA.nstatra pANDavaH |
mahArathA~nsharairviddhvA vArayitvA mahArathaH
virathaM saindhavaM chakre sarvalokasya pashyataH
shlokas.18:
nAtIva mamRRiShe shalyo bhImasenasya vikramam |
sa sandhAya sharA.nstIkShNAnkarmAraparimArjitAn
bhImaM vivyAdha saptatyA tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.19:
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha bhagadattashcha mAriSha |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau chitrasenashcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.20:
durmarShaNo vikarNashcha sindhurAjashcha vIryavAn |
bhImaM te vivyadhustUrNaM shalyahetorari.ndamAH
shlokas.21:
sa tu tAnprativivyAdha pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhiH sharaiH |
shalyaM vivyAdha saptatyA punashcha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.22:
taM shalyo navabhirviddhvA punarvivyAdha pa~nchabhiH |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena gADhaM vivyAdha marmaNi
shlokas.23:
vishokaM vIkShya nirbhinnaM bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
madrarAjaM tribhirbANairbAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.24:
tathetarAnmaheShvAsA.nstribhistribhirajihmagaiH |
tADayAmAsa samare siMhavachcha nanAda cha
shlokas.25:
te hi yattA maheShvAsAH pANDavaM yuddhadurmadam |
tribhistribhirakuNThAgrairbhRRishaM marmasvatADayan
shlokas.26:
so.atividdho maheShvAso bhImaseno na vivyathe |
parvato vAridhArAbhirvarShamANairivAmbudaiH
shlokas.27:
shalyaM cha navabhirbANairbhRRishaM viddhvA mahAyashAH |
prAgjyotiShaM shatenAjau rAjanvivyAdha vai dRRiDham
shlokas.28:
tatastu sasharaM chApaM sAtvatasya mahAtmanaH |
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena chichCheda kRRitahastavat
shlokas.29:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya kRRitavarmA vRRikodaram |
AjaghAna bhruvormadhye nArAchena parantapa
shlokas.30:
bhImastu samare viddhvA shalyaM navabhirAyasaiH |
bhagadattaM tribhishchaiva kRRitavarmANamaShTabhiH
shlokas.31:
dvAbhyAM dvAbhyAM cha vivyAdha gautamaprabhRRitInrathAn |
te tu taM samare rAjanvivyadhurnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.32:
sa tathA pIDyamAno.api sarvatastairmahArathaiH |
matvA tRRiNena tA.nstulyAnvichachAra gatavyathaH
shlokas.33:
te chApi rathinAM shreShThA bhImAya nishitA~nsharAn |
preShayAmAsuravyagrAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.34:
tasya shaktiM mahAvegAM bhagadatto mahArathaH |
chikShepa samare vIraH svarNadaNDAM mahAdhanAm
shlokas.35:
tomaraM saindhavo rAjA paTTishaM cha mahAbhujaH |
shataghnIM cha kRRipo rAja~nsharaM shalyashcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.36:
athetare maheShvAsAH pa~ncha pa~ncha shilImukhAn |
bhImasenaM samuddishya preShayAmAsurojasA
shlokas.37:
tomaraM sa dvidhA chakre kShurapreNAnilAtmajaH |
paTTishaM cha tribhirbANaishchichCheda tilakANDavat
shlokas.38:
sa bibheda shataghnIM cha navabhiH ka~NkapatribhiH |
madrarAjaprayuktaM cha sharaM ChittvA mahAbalaH
shlokas.39:
shaktiM chichCheda sahasA bhagadatteritAM raNe |
tathetarA~nsharAnghorA~nsharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.40:
bhImaseno raNashlAghI tridhaikaikaM samAchChinat |
tA.nshcha sarvAnmaheShvAsA.nstribhistribhiratADayat
shlokas.41:
tato dhana~njayastatra vartamAne mahAraNe |
jagAma sa rathenAjau bhImaM dRRiShTvA mahAratham
nighnantaM samare shatrUnyodhayAnaM cha sAyakaiH
shlokas.42:
tau tu tatra mahAtmAnau sametau vIkShya pANDavau |
nAshasha.nsurjayaM tatra tAvakAH puruSharShabha
shlokas.43:
athArjuno raNe bhIShmaM yodhayanvai mahAratham |
bhIShmasya nidhanAkA~NkShI puraskRRitya shikhaNDinam
shlokas.44:
AsasAda raNe yodhA.nstAvakAndasha bhArata |
ye sma bhImaM raNe rAjanyodhayanto vyavasthitAH
bIbhatsustAnathAvidhyadbhImasya priyakAmyayA
shlokas.45:
tato duryodhano rAjA susharmANamachodayat |
arjunasya vadhArthAya bhImasenasya chobhayoH
shlokas.46:
susharmangachCha shIghraM tvaM balaughaiH parivAritaH |
jahi pANDusutAvetau dhana~njayavRRikodarau
shlokas.47:
tachChrutvA shAsanaM tasya trigartaH prasthalAdhipaH |
abhidrutya raNe bhImamarjunaM chaiva dhanvinau
shlokas.48:
rathairanekasAhasraiH parivavre samantataH |
tataH pravavRRite yuddhamarjunasya paraiH saha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
arjunastu raNe shalyaM yatamAnaM mahAratham |
ChAdayAmAsa samare sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.2:
susharmANaM kRRipaM chaiva tribhistribhiravidhyata |
prAgjyotiShaM cha samare saindhavaM cha jayadratham
shlokas.3:
chitrasenaM vikarNaM cha kRRitavarmANameva cha |
durmarShaNaM cha rAjendra Avantyau cha mahArathau
shlokas.4:
ekaikaM tribhirAnarChatka~NkabarhiNavAjitaiH |
sharairatiratho yuddhe pIDayanvAhinIM tava
shlokas.5:
jayadratho raNe pArthaM bhittvA bhArata sAyakaiH |
bhImaM vivyAdha tarasA chitrasenarathe sthitaH
shlokas.6:
shalyashcha samare jiShNuM kRRipashcha rathinAM varaH |
vivyadhAte mahAbAhuM bahudhA marmabhedibhiH
shlokas.7:
chitrasenAdayashchaiva putrAstava vishAM pate |
pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhistUrNaM sa.nyuge nishitaiH sharaiH
AjaghnurarjunaM sa~Nkhye bhImasenaM cha mAriSha
shlokas.8:
tau tatra rathinAM shreShThau kaunteyau bharatarShabhau |
apIDayetAM samare trigartAnAM mahadbalam
shlokas.9:
susharmApi raNe pArthaM viddhvA bahubhirAyasaiH |
nanAda balavannAdaM nAdayanvai nabhastalam
shlokas.10:
anye cha rathinaH shUrA bhImasenadhana~njayau |
vivyadhurnishitairbANai rukmapu~NkhairajihmagaiH
shlokas.11:
teShAM tu rathinAM madhye kaunteyau rathinAM varau |
krIDamAnau rathodArau chitrarUpau vyarochatAm
AmiShepsU gavAM madhye siMhAviva balotkaTau
shlokas.12:
ChittvA dhanUMShi vIrANAM sharA.nshcha bahudhA raNe |
pAtayAmAsaturvIrau shirA.nsi shatasho nRRiNAm
shlokas.13:
rathAshcha bahavo bhagnA hayAshcha shatasho hatAH |
gajAshcha sagajArohAH petururvyAM mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.14:
rathinaH sAdinashchaiva tatra tatra nisUditAH |
dRRishyante bahudhA rAjanveShTamAnAH samantataH
shlokas.15:
hatairgajapadAtyoghairvAjibhishcha nisUditaiH |
rathaishcha bahudhA bhagnaiH samAstIryata medinI
shlokas.16:
Chatraishcha bahudhA Chinnairdhvajaishcha vinipAtitaiH |
a~Nkushairapaviddhaishcha paristomaishcha bhArata
shlokas.17:
keyUraira~NgadairhArai rA~NkavairmRRiditaistathA |
uShNIShairapaviddhaishcha chAmaravyajanairapi
shlokas.18:
tatra tatrApaviddhaishcha bAhubhishchandanokShitaiH |
Urubhishcha narendrANAM samAstIryata medinI
shlokas.19:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma raNe pArthasya vikramam |
sharaiH sa.nvArya tAnvIrAnnijaghAna balaM tava
shlokas.20:
putrastu tava taM dRRiShTvA bhImArjunasamAgamam |
gA~Ngeyasya rathAbhyAshamupajagme mahAbhaye
shlokas.21:
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha saindhavashcha jayadrathaH |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyAvAjagmuH sa.nyugaM tadA
shlokas.22:
tato bhImo maheShvAsaH phalgunashcha mahArathaH |
kauravANAM chamUM ghorAM bhRRishaM dudruvatU raNe
shlokas.23:
tato barhiNavAjAnAmayutAnyarbudAni cha |
dhana~njayarathe tUrNaM pAtayanti sma sa.nyuge
shlokas.24:
tatastA~nsharajAlena saMnivArya mahArathAn |
pArthaH samantAtsamare preShayAmAsa mRRityave
shlokas.25:
shalyastu samare jiShNuM krIDanniva mahArathaH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddho bhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.26:
tasya pArtho dhanushChittvA hastAvApaM cha pa~nchabhiH |
athainaM sAyakaistIkShNairbhRRishaM vivyAdha marmaNi
shlokas.27:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya samare bhArasAdhanam |
madreshvaro raNe jiShNuM tADayAmAsa roShitaH
shlokas.28:
tribhiH sharairmahArAja vAsudevaM cha pa~nchabhiH |
bhImasenaM cha navabhirbAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.29:
tato droNo mahArAja mAgadhashcha mahArathaH |
duryodhanasamAdiShTau taM deshamupajagmatuH
shlokas.30:
yatra pArtho mahArAja bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
kauravyasya mahAsenAM jaghnatustau mahArathau
shlokas.31:
jayatsenastu samare bhImaM bhImAyudhaM yuvA |
vivyAdha nishitairbANairaShTabhirbharatarShabha
shlokas.32:
taM bhImo dashabhirviddhvA punarvivyAdha saptabhiH |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena rathanIDAdapAharat
shlokas.33:
udbhrAntaisturagaiH so.atha dravamANaiH samantataH |
mAgadho.apahRRito rAjA sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.34:
droNastu vivaraM labdhvA bhImasenaM shilImukhaiH |
vivyAdha bANaiH sushitaiH pa~nchaShaShTyA tamAyasaiH
shlokas.35:
taM bhImaH samarashlAghI guruM pitRRisamaM raNe |
vivyAdha navabhirbhallaistathA ShaShTyA cha bhArata
shlokas.36:
arjunastu susharmANaM viddhvA bahubhirAyasaiH |
vyadhamattasya tatsainyaM mahAbhrANi yathAnilaH
shlokas.37:
tato bhIShmashcha rAjA cha saubalashcha bRRihadbalaH |
abhyadravanta sa~NkruddhA bhImasenadhana~njayau
shlokas.38:
tathaiva pANDavAH shUrA dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
abhyadravanraNe bhIShmaM vyAditAsyamivAntakam
shlokas.39:
shikhaNDI tu samAsAdya bhAratAnAM pitAmaham |
abhyadravata saMhRRiShTo bhayaM tyaktvA yatavratam
shlokas.40:
yudhiShThiramukhAH pArthAH puraskRRitya shikhaNDinam |
ayodhayanraNe bhIShmaM saMhatAH saha sRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.41:
tathaiva tAvakAH sarve puraskRRitya yatavratam |
shikhaNDipramukhAnpArthAnyodhayanti sma sa.nyuge
shlokas.42:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM kauravANAM bhayAvaham |
tatra pANDusutaiH sArdhaM bhIShmasya vijayaM prati
shlokas.43:
tAvakAnAM raNe bhIShmo glaha AsIdvishAM pate |
tatra hi dyUtamAyAtaM vijayAyetarAya vA
shlokas.44:
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja sarvasainyAnyachodayat |
abhidravata gA~NgeyaM mA bhaiShTa narasattamAH
shlokas.45:
senApativachaH shrutvA pANDavAnAM varUthinI |
bhIShmamevAbhyayAttUrNaM prANA.nstyaktvA mahAhave
shlokas.46:
bhIShmo.api rathinAM shreShThaH pratijagrAha tAM chamUm |
ApatantIM mahArAja velAmiva mahodadhiH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM shAntanavo bhIShmo dashame.ahani sa~njaya |
ayudhyata mahAvIryaiH pANDavaiH sahasRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.2:
kuravashcha kathaM yuddhe pANDavAnpratyavArayan |
AchakShva me mahAyuddhaM bhIShmasyAhavashobhinaH
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kuravaH pANDavaiH sArdhaM yathAyudhyanta bhArata |
yathA cha tadabhUdyuddhaM tatte vakShyAmi shRRiNvataH
shlokas.4:
preShitAH paralokAya paramAstraiH kirITinA |
ahanyahani samprAptAstAvakAnAM rathavrajAH
shlokas.5:
yathApratij~naM kauravyaH sa chApi samiti~njayaH |
pArthAnAmakarodbhIShmaH satataM samitikShayam
shlokas.6:
kurubhiH sahitaM bhIShmaM yudhyamAnaM mahAratham |
arjunaM cha sapA~nchAlyaM dRRiShTvA sa.nshayitA janAH
shlokas.7:
dashame.ahani tasmi.nstu bhIShmArjunasamAgame |
avartata mahAraudraH satataM samitikShayaH
shlokas.8:
tasminnayutasho rAjanbhUyashcha sa parantapaH |
bhIShmaH shAntanavo yodhA~njaghAna paramAstravit
shlokas.9:
yeShAmaj~nAtakalpAni nAmagotrANi pArthiva |
