te hatAstatra bhIShmeNa shUrAH sarve.anivartinaH
shlokas.10:
dashAhAni tatastaptvA bhIShmaH pANDavavAhinIm |
niravidyata dharmAtmA jIvitena parantapaH
shlokas.11:
sa kShipraM vadhamanvichChannAtmano.abhimukhaM raNe |
na hanyAM mAnavashreShThAnsa~NgrAme.abhimukhAniti
shlokas.12:
chintayitvA mahAbAhuH pitA devavratastava |
abhyAshasthaM mahArAja pANDavaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.13:
yudhiShThira mahAprAj~na sarvashAstravishArada |
shRRiNu me vachanaM tAta dharmyaM svargyaM cha jalpataH
shlokas.14:
nirviNNo.asmi bhRRishaM tAta dehenAnena bhArata |
ghnatashcha me gataH kAlaH subahUnprANino raNe
shlokas.15:
tasmAtpArthaM purodhAya pA~nchAlAnsRRi~njayA.nstathA |
madvadhe kriyatAM yatno mama chedichChasi priyam
shlokas.16:
tasya tanmatamAj~nAya pANDavaH satyadarshanaH |
bhIShmaM pratiyayau yattaH sa~NgrAme saha sRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.17:
dhRRiShTadyumnastato rAjanpANDavashcha yudhiShThiraH |
shrutvA bhIShmasya tAM vAchaM chodayAmAsaturbalam
shlokas.18:
abhidravata yudhyadhvaM bhIShmaM jayata sa.nyuge |
rakShitAH satyasandhena jiShNunA ripujiShNunA
shlokas.19:
ayaM chApi maheShvAsaH pArShato vAhinIpatiH |
bhImasenashcha samare pAlayiShyati vo dhruvam
shlokas.20:
na vai bhIShmAdbhayaM ki~nchitkartavyaM yudhi sRRi~njayAH |
dhruvaM bhIShmaM vijeShyAmaH puraskRRitya shikhaNDinam
shlokas.21:
tathA tu samayaM kRRitvA dashame.ahani pANDavAH |
brahmalokaparA bhUtvA sa~njagmuH krodhamUrChitAH
shlokas.22:
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya pANDavaM cha dhana~njayam |
bhIShmasya pAtane yatnaM paramaM te samAsthitAH
shlokas.23:
tatastava sutAdiShTA nAnAjanapadeshvarAH |
droNena sahaputreNa sahasenA mahAbalAH
shlokas.24:
duHshAsanashcha balavAnsaha sarvaiH sahodaraiH |
bhIShmaM samaramadhyasthaM pAlayAM chakrire tadA
shlokas.25:
tatastu tAvakAH shUrAH puraskRRitya yatavratam |
shikhaNDipramukhAnpArthAnyodhayanti sma sa.nyuge
shlokas.26:
chedibhishcha sapA~nchAlaiH sahito vAnaradhvajaH |
yayau shAntanavaM bhIShmaM puraskRRitya shikhaNDinam
shlokas.27:
droNaputraM shinernaptA dhRRiShTaketustu pauravam |
yudhAmanyuH sahAmAtyaM duryodhanamayodhayat
shlokas.28:
virATastu sahAnIkaH sahasenaM jayadratham |
vRRiddhakShatrasya dAyAdamAsasAda parantapaH
shlokas.29:
madrarAjaM maheShvAsaM sahasainyaM yudhiShThiraH |
bhImasenAbhiguptashcha nAgAnIkamupAdravat
shlokas.30:
apradhRRiShyamanAvAryaM sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam |
droNaM prati yayau yattaH pA~nchAlyaH saha somakaiH
shlokas.31:
karNikAradhvajaM chApi siMhaketurari.ndamaH |
pratyujjagAma saubhadraM rAjaputro bRRihadbalaH
shlokas.32:
shikhaNDinaM cha putrAste pANDavaM cha dhana~njayam |
rAjabhiH samare sArdhamabhipeturjighA.nsavaH
shlokas.33:
tasminnatimahAbhIme senayorvai parAkrame |
sampradhAvatsvanIkeShu medinI samakampata
shlokas.34:
tAnyanIkAnyanIkeShu samasajjanta bhArata |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha dRRiShTvA shAntanavaM raNe
shlokas.35:
tatasteShAM prayatatAmanyonyamabhidhAvatAm |
prAdurAsInmahA~nshabdo dikShu sarvAsu bhArata
shlokas.36:
sha~NkhadundubhighoShaishcha vAraNAnAM cha bRRiMhitaiH |
siMhanAdaishcha sainyAnAM dAruNaH samapadyata
shlokas.37:
sA cha sarvanarendrANAM chandrArkasadRRishI prabhA |
vIrA~NgadakirITeShu niShprabhA samapadyata
shlokas.38:
rajomeghAshcha sa~njaj~nuH shastravidyudbhirAvRRitAH |
dhanuShAM chaiva nirghoSho dAruNaH samapadyata
shlokas.39:
bANasha~NkhapraNAdAshcha bherINAM cha mahAsvanAH |
rathagoShashcha sa~njagmuH senayorubhayorapi
shlokas.40:
prAsashaktyRRiShTisa~Nghaishcha bANaughaishcha samAkulam |
niShprakAshamivAkAshaM senayoH samapadyata
shlokas.41:
anyonyaM rathinaH peturvAjinashcha mahAhave |
ku~njarAH ku~njarA~njaghnuH padAtI.nshcha padAtayaH
shlokas.42:
tadAsItsumahadyuddhaM kurUNAM pANDavaiH saha |
bhIShmahetornaravyAghra shyenayorAmiShe yathA
shlokas.43:
tayoH samAgamo ghoro babhUva yudhi bhArata |
anyonyasya vadhArthAya jigIShUNAM raNAjire

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
abhimanyurmahArAja tava putramayodhayat |
mahatyA senayA yukto bhIShmahetoH parAkramI
shlokas.2:
duryodhano raNe kArShNiM navabhirnataparvabhiH |
AjaghAna raNe kruddhaH punashchainaM tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.3:
tasya shaktiM raNe kArShNirmRRityorghorAmiva svasAm |
preShayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho duryodhanarathaM prati
shlokas.4:
tAmApatantIM sahasA ghorarUpAM vishAM pate |
dvidhA chichCheda te putraH kShurapreNa mahArathaH
shlokas.5:
tAM shaktiM patitAM dRRiShTvA kArShNiH paramakopanaH |
duryodhanaM tribhirbANairbAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.6:
punashchainaM sharairghorairAjaghAna stanAntare |
dashabhirbharatashreShTha duryodhanamamarShaNam
shlokas.7:
tadyuddhamabhavadghoraM chitrarUpaM cha bhArata |
IkShitRRiprItijananaM sarvapArthivapUjitam
shlokas.8:
bhIShmasya nidhanArthAya pArthasya vijayAya cha |
yuyudhAte raNe vIrau saubhadrakurupu~Ngavau
shlokas.9:
sAtyakiM rabhasaM yuddhe drauNirbrAhmaNapu~NgavaH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddho nArAchena parantapaH
shlokas.10:
shaineyo.api guroH putraM sarvamarmasu bhArata |
atADayadameyAtmA navabhiH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.11:
ashvatthAmA tu samare sAtyakiM navabhiH sharaiH |
tri.nshatA cha punastUrNaM bAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.12:
so.atividdho maheShvAso droNaputreNa sAtvataH |
droNaputraM tribhirbANairAjaghAna mahAyashAH
shlokas.13:
pauravo dhRRiShTaketuM cha sharairAsAdya sa.nyuge |
bahudhA dArayAM chakre maheShvAsaM mahAratham
shlokas.14:
tathaiva pauravaM yuddhe dhRRiShTaketurmahArathaH |
tri.nshatA nishitairbANairvivyAdha sumahAbalaH
shlokas.15:
pauravastu dhanushChittvA dhRRiShTaketormahArathaH |
nanAda balavannAdaM vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.16:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya pauravaM nishitaiH sharaiH |
AjaghAna mahArAja trisaptatyA shilImukhaiH
shlokas.17:
tau tu tatra maheShvAsau mahAmAtrau mahArathau |
mahatA sharavarSheNa parasparamavarShatAm
shlokas.18:
anyonyasya dhanushChittvA hayAnhatvA cha bhArata |
virathAvasiyuddhAya sa~Ngatau tau mahArathau
shlokas.19:
ArShabhe charmaNI chitre shatachandrapariShkRRite |
tArakAshatachitrau cha nistri.nshau sumahAprabhau
shlokas.20:
pragRRihya vimalau rAja.nstAvanyonyamabhidrutau |
vAshitAsa~Ngame yattau siMhAviva mahAvane
shlokas.21:
maNDalAni vichitrANi gatapratyAgatAni cha |
cheraturdarshayantau cha prArthayantau parasparam
shlokas.22:
pauravo dhRRiShTaketuM tu sha~Nkhadeshe mahAsinA |
tADayAmAsa sa~NkruddhastiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.23:
chedirAjo.api samare pauravaM puruSharShabham |
AjaghAna shitAgreNa jatrudeshe mahAsinA
shlokas.24:
tAvanyonyaM mahArAja samAsAdya mahAhave |
anyonyavegAbhihatau nipetaturari.ndamau
shlokas.25:
tataH svarathamAropya pauravaM tanayastava |
jayatseno rathe rAjannapovAha raNAjirAt
shlokas.26:
dhRRiShTaketuM cha samare mAdrIputraH parantapaH |
apovAha raNe rAjansahadevaH pratApavAn
shlokas.27:
chitrasenaH susharmANaM viddhvA navabhirAshugaiH |
punarvivyAdha taM ShaShTyA punashcha navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.28:
susharmA tu raNe kruddhastava putraM vishAM pate |
dashabhirdashabhishchaiva vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.29:
chitrasenashcha taM rAja.nstri.nshatA nataparvaNAm |
AjaghAna raNe kruddhaH sa cha taM pratyavidhyata
bhIShmasya samare rAjanyasho mAnaM cha vardhayan
shlokas.30:
saubhadro rAjaputraM tu bRRihadbalamayodhayat |
ArjuniM kosalendrastu viddhvA pa~nchabhirAyasaiH
punarvivyAdha vi.nshatyA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.31:
bRRihadbalaM cha saubhadro viddhvA navabhirAyasaiH |
nAkampayata sa~NgrAme vivyAdha cha punaH punaH
shlokas.32:
kausalyasya punashchApi dhanushchichCheda phAlguNiH |
AjaghAna sharaishchaiva tri.nshatA ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.33:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya rAjaputro bRRihadbalaH |
phAlguniM samare kruddho vivyAdha bahubhiH sharaiH
shlokas.34:
tayoryuddhaM samabhavadbhIShmahetoH parantapa |
sa.nrabdhayormahArAja samare chitrayodhinoH
yathA devAsure yuddhe mayavAsavayorabhUt
shlokas.35:
bhImaseno gajAnIkaM yodhayanbahvashobhata |
yathA shakro vajrapANirdArayanparvatottamAn
shlokas.36:
te vadhyamAnA bhImena mAta~NgA girisaMnibhAH |
nipetururvyAM sahitA nAdayanto vasundharAm
shlokas.37:
girimAtrA hi te nAgA bhinnA~njanachayopamAH |
virejurvasudhAM prApya vikIrNA iva parvatAH
shlokas.38:
yudhiShThiro maheShvAso madrarAjAnamAhave |
mahatyA senayA guptaM pIDayAmAsa sa~NgataH
shlokas.39:
madreshvarashcha samare dharmaputraM mahAratham |
pIDayAmAsa sa.nrabdho bhIShmahetoH parAkramI
shlokas.40:
virATaM saindhavo rAjA viddhvA saMnataparvabhiH |
navabhiH sAyakaistIkShNaistri.nshatA punarardayat
shlokas.41:
virATashcha mahArAja saindhavaM vAhinImukhe |
tri.nshatA nishitairbANairAjaghAna stanAntare
shlokas.42:
chitrakArmukanistri.nshau chitravarmAyudhadhvajau |
rejatushchitrarUpau tau sa~NgrAme matsyasaindhavau
shlokas.43:
droNaH pA~nchAlaputreNa samAgamya mahAraNe |
mahAsamudayaM chakre sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.44:
tato droNo mahArAja pArShatasya mahaddhanuH |
ChittvA pa~nchAshateShUNAM pArShataM samavidhyata
shlokas.45:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya pArShataH paravIrahA |
droNasya miShato yuddhe preShayAmAsa sAyakAn
shlokas.46:
tA~nsharA~nsharasa~Nghaistu saMnivArya mahArathaH |
droNo drupadaputrAya prAhiNotpa~ncha sAyakAn
shlokas.47:
tasya kruddho mahArAja pArShataH paravIrahA |
droNAya chikShepa gadAM yamadaNDopamAM raNe
shlokas.48:
tAmApatantIM sahasA hemapaTTavibhUShitAm |
sharaiH pa~nchAshatA droNo vArayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.49:
sA ChinnA bahudhA rAjandroNachApachyutaiH sharaiH |
chUrNIkRRitA vishIryantI papAta vasudhAtale
shlokas.50:
gadAM vinihatAM dRRiShTvA pArShataH shatrusUdanaH |
droNAya shaktiM chikShepa sarvapArashavIM shubhAm
shlokas.51:
tAM droNo navabhirbANaishchichCheda yudhi bhArata |
pArShataM cha maheShvAsaM pIDayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.52:
evametanmahadyuddhaM droNapArShatayorabhUt |
bhIShmaM prati mahArAja ghorarUpaM bhayAnakam
shlokas.53:
arjunaH prApya gA~NgeyaM pIDayannishitaiH sharaiH |
abhyadravata sa.nyattaM vane mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.54:
pratyudyayau cha taM pArthaM bhagadattaH pratApavAn |
tridhA bhinnena nAgena madAndhena mahAbalaH
shlokas.55:
tamApatantaM sahasA mahendragajasaMnibham |
paraM yatnaM samAsthAya bIbhatsuH pratyapadyata
shlokas.56:
tato gajagato rAjA bhagadattaH pratApavAn |
arjunaM sharavarSheNa vArayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.57:
arjunastu raNe nAgamAyAntaM rajatopamam |
vimalairAyasaistIkShNairavidhyata mahAraNe
shlokas.58:
shikhaNDinaM cha kaunteyo yAhi yAhItyachodayat |
bhIShmaM prati mahArAja jahyenamiti chAbravIt
shlokas.59:
prAgjyotiShastato hitvA pANDavaM pANDupUrvaja |
prayayau tvarito rAjandrupadasya rathaM prati
shlokas.60:
tato.arjuno mahArAja bhIShmamabhyadravaddrutam |
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya tato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.61:
tataste tAvakAH shUrAH pANDavaM rabhasaM raNe |
sarve.abhyadhAvankroshantastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.62:
nAnAvidhAnyanIkAni putrANAM te janAdhipa |
arjuno vyadhamatkAle divIvAbhrANi mArutaH
shlokas.63:
shikhaNDI tu samAsAdya bharatAnAM pitAmaham |
iShubhistUrNamavyagro bahubhiH sa samAchinot
shlokas.64:
somakA.nshcha raNe bhIShmo jaghne pArthapadAnugAn |
nyavArayata sainyaM cha pANDavAnAM mahArathaH
shlokas.65:
rathAgnyagArashchApArchirasishaktigadendhanaH |
sharasa~NghamahAjvAlaH kShatriyAnsamare.adahat
shlokas.66:
yathA hi sumahAnagniH kakShe charati sAnilaH |
tathA jajvAla bhIShmo.api divyAnyastrANyudIrayan
shlokas.67:
suvarNapu~NkhairiShubhiH shitaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
nAdayansa disho bhIShmaH pradishashcha mahAyashAH
shlokas.68:
pAtayanrathino rAjangajA.nshcha saha sAdibhiH |
muNDatAlavanAnIva chakAra sa rathavrajAn
shlokas.69:
nirmanuShyAnrathAnrAjangajAnashvA.nshcha sa.nyuge |
chakAra sa tadA bhIShmaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.70:
tasya jyAtalanirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
nishamya sarvato rAjansamakampanta sainikAH
shlokas.71:
amoghA hyapatanbANAH pituste manujeshvara |
nAsajjanta sharIreShu bhIShmachApachyutAH sharAH
shlokas.73:
chedikAshikarUShANAM sahasrANi chaturdasha |
mahArathAH samAkhyAtAH kulaputrAstanutyajaH
shlokas.74:
aparAvartinaH shUrAH suvarNavikRRitadhvajAH |
sa~NgrAme bhIShmamAsAdya savAjirathaku~njarAH
jagmuste paralokAya vyAditAsyamivAntakam
shlokas.75:
na tatrAsInmahArAja somakAnAM mahArathaH |
yaH samprApya raNe bhIShmaM jIvite sma mano dadhe
shlokas.76:
tA.nshcha sarvAnraNe yodhAnpretarAjapuraM prati |
nItAnamanyanta janA dRRiShTvA bhIShmasya vikramam
shlokas.77:
na kashchidenaM samare pratyudyAti mahArathaH |
RRite pANDusutaM vIraM shvetAshvaM kRRiShNasArathim
shikhaNDinaM cha samare pA~nchAlyamamitaujasam
shlokas.78:
shikhaNDI tu raNe bhIShmamAsAdya bharatarShabha |
dashabhirdashabhirbANairAjaghAna mahAhave
shlokas.79:
shikhaNDinaM tu gA~NgeyaH krodhadIptena chakShuShA |
avaikShata kaTAkSheNa nirdahanniva bhArata
shlokas.80:
strItvaM tatsa.nsmaranrAjansarvalokasya pashyataH |
na jaghAna raNe bhIShmaH sa cha taM nAvabuddhavAn
shlokas.81:
arjunastu mahArAja shikhaNDinamabhAShata |
abhitvarasva tvarito jahi chainaM pitAmaham
shlokas.82:
kiM te vivakShayA vIra jahi bhIShmaM mahAratham |
na hyanyamanupashyAmi ka~nchidyaudhiShThire bale
shlokas.83:
yaH shaktaH samare bhIShmaM yodhayeta pitAmaham |
RRite tvAM puruShavyAghra satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.84:
evamuktastu pArthena shikhaNDI bharatarShabha |
sharairnAnAvidhaistUrNaM pitAmahamupAdravat
shlokas.85:
achintayitvA tAnbANAnpitA devavratastava |
arjunaM samare kruddhaM vArayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.86:
tathaiva cha chamUM sarvAM pANDavAnAM mahArathaH |
apraiShItsamare tIkShNaiH paralokAya mAriSha
shlokas.87:
tathaiva pANDavA rAjansainyena mahatA vRRitAH |
bhIShmaM prachChAdayAmAsurmeghA iva divAkaram
shlokas.88:
sa samantAtparivRRito bhArato bharatarShabha |
nirdadAha raNe shUrAnvanaM vahniriva jvalan
shlokas.89:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma tava putrasya pauruSham |
ayodhayata yatpArthaM jugopa cha yatavratam
shlokas.90:
karmaNA tena samare tava putrasya dhanvinaH |
duHshAsanasya tutuShuH sarve lokA mahAtmanaH
shlokas.91:
yadekaH samare pArthAnsAnugAnsamayodhayat |
na chainaM pANDavA yuddhe vAyarAmAsurulbaNam
shlokas.92:
duHshAsanena samare rathino virathIkRRitAH |
sAdinashcha mahArAja dantinashcha mahAbalAH
shlokas.93:
vinirbhinnAH sharaistIkShNairnipeturdharaNItale |
sharAturAstathaivAnye dantino vidrutA dishaH
shlokas.94:
yathAgnirindhanaM prApya jvaleddIptArchirulbaNaH |
tathA jajvAla putraste pANDavAnvai vinirdahan
shlokas.95:
taM bhAratamahAmAtraM pANDavAnAM mahArathaH |
jetuM notsahate kashchinnApyudyAtuM katha~nchana
RRite mahendratanayaM shvetAshvaM kRRiShNasArathim
shlokas.96:
sa hi taM samare rAjanvijitya vijayo.arjunaH |
bhIShmamevAbhidudrAva sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.97:
vijitastava putro.api bhIShmabAhuvyapAshrayaH |
punaH punaH samAshvasya prAyudhyata raNotkaTaH
arjunaM cha raNe rAjanyodhayansa vyarAjata
shlokas.98:
shikhaNDI tu raNe rAjanvivyAdhaiva pitAmaham |
sharairashanisa.nsparshaistathA sarpaviShopamaiH
shlokas.99:
na cha te.asya rujaM chakruH pitustava janeshvara |
smayamAnashcha gA~NgeyastAnbANA~njagRRihe tadA
shlokas.100:
uShNArto hi naro yadvajjaladhArAH pratIchChati |
tathA jagrAha gA~NgeyaH sharadhArAH shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.101:
taM kShatriyA mahArAja dadRRishurghoramAhave |
bhIShmaM dahantaM sainyAni pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.102:
tato.abravIttava sutaH sarvasainyAni mAriSha |
abhidravata sa~NgrAme phalgunaM sarvato rathaiH
shlokas.103:
bhIShmo vaH samare sarvAnpalayiShyati dharmavit |
te bhayaM sumahattvaktvA pANDavAnpratiyudhyata
shlokas.104:
eSha tAlena dIptena bhIShmastiShThati pAlayan |
sarveShAM dhArtarAShTrANAM raNe sharma cha varma cha
shlokas.105:
tridashApi samudyuktA nAlaM bhIShmaM samAsitum |
kimu pArthA mahAtmAnaM martyabhUtAstathAbalAH
tasmAddravata he yodhAH phalgunaM prApya sa.nyuge
shlokas.106:
ahamadya raNe yatto yodhayiShyAmi phalgunam |
sahitaH sarvato yattairbhavadbhirvasudhAdhipAH
shlokas.107:
tachChrutvA tu vacho rAja.nstava putrasya dhanvinaH |
arjunaM prati sa.nyattA balavanto mahArathAH
shlokas.108:
te videhAH kali~NgAshcha dAsherakagaNaiH saha |
abhipeturniShAdAshcha sauvIrAshcha mahAraNe
shlokas.109:
bAhlikA daradAshchaiva prAchyodIchyAshcha mAlavAH |
abhIShAhAH shUrasenAH shibayo.atha vasAtayaH
shlokas.110:
shAlvAshrayAstrigartAshcha ambaShThAH kekayaiH saha |
abhipetU raNe pArthaM pata~NgA iva pAvakam
shlokas.111:
sa tAnsarvAnsahAnIkAnmahArAja mahArathAn |
divyAnyastrANi sa~nchintya prasandhAya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.112:
sa tairastrairmahAvegairdadAhAshu mahAbalaH |
sharapratApairbIbhatsuH pata~NgAniva pAvakaH
shlokas.113:
tasya bANasahasrANi sRRijato dRRiDhadhanvinaH |
dIpyamAnamivAkAshe gANDIvaM samadRRishyata
shlokas.114:
te sharArtA mahArAja viprakIrNarathadhvajAH |
nAbyavartanta rAjAnaH sahitA vAnaradhvajam
shlokas.115:
sadhvajA rathinaH peturhayArohA hayaiH saha |
gajAH saha gajArohaiH kirITisharatADitAH
shlokas.117:
atha pArtho mahAbAhurdrAvayitvA varUthinIm |
duHshAsanAya samare preShayAmAsa sAyakAn
shlokas.118:
te tu bhittvA tava sutaM duHshAsanamayomukhAH |
dharaNIM vivishuH sarve valmIkamiva pannagAH
hayA.nshchAsya tato jaghne sArathiM cha nyapAtayat
shlokas.119:
vivi.nshatiM cha vi.nshatyA virathaM kRRitavAnprabho |
AjaghAna bhRRishaM chaiva pa~nchabhirnataparvabhiH
shlokas.120:
kRRipaM shalyaM vikarNaM cha viddhvA bahubhirAyasaiH |
chakAra virathA.nshchaiva kaunteyaH shvetavAhanaH
shlokas.121:
evaM te virathAH pa~ncha kRRipaH shalyashcha mAriSha |
duHshAsano vikarNashcha tathaiva cha vivi.nshatiH
samprAdravanta samare nirjitAH savyasAchinA
shlokas.122:
pUrvAhNe tu tathA rAjanparAjitya mahArathAn |
prajajvAla raNe pArtho vidhUma iva pAvakaH
shlokas.123:
tathaiva sharavarSheNa bhAskaro rashmivAniva |
anyAnapi mahArAja pAtayAmAsa pArthivAn
shlokas.124:
parA~NmukhIkRRitya tadA sharavarShairmahArathAn |
prAvartayata sa~NgrAme shoNitodAM mahAnadIm
madhyena kurusainyAnAM pANDavAnAM cha bhArata
shlokas.125:
gajAshcha rathasa~NghAshcha bahudhA rathibhirhatAH |
rathAshcha nihatA nAgairnAgA hayapadAtibhiH
shlokas.126:
antarA ChidhyamAnAni sharIrANi shirA.nsi cha |
nipeturdikShu sarvAsu gajAshvarathayodhinAm
shlokas.127:
ChannamAyodhanaM reje kuNDalA~NgadadhAribhiH |
patitaiH pAtyamAnaishcha rAjaputrairmahArathaiH
shlokas.129:
gajAshvarathasa~NghAshcha paripetuH samantataH |
vishIrNAshcha rathA bhUmau bhagnachakrayugadhvajAH
shlokas.130:
tadgajAshvarathaughAnAM rudhireNa samukShitam |
ChannamAyodhanaM reje raktAbhramiva shAradam
shlokas.131:
shvAnaH kAkAshcha gRRidhrAshcha vRRikA gomAyubhiH saha |
praNedurbhakShyamAsAdya vikRRitAshcha mRRigadvijAH
shlokas.132:
vavurbahuvidhAshchaiva dikShu sarvAsu mArutAH |
dRRishyamAneShu rakShaHsu bhUteShu vinadatsu cha
shlokas.133:
kA~nchanAni cha dAmAni patAkAshcha mahAdhanAH |
dhUmAyamAnA dRRishyante sahasA mAruteritAH
shlokas.134:
shvetachChatrasahasrANi sadhvajAshcha mahArathAH |
vinikIrNAH sma dRRishyante shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
sapatAkAshcha mAta~NgA disho jagmuH sharAturAH
shlokas.135:
kShatriyAshcha manuShyendra gadAshaktidhanurdharAH |
samantato vyadRRishyanta patitA dharaNItale
shlokas.136:
tato bhIShmo mahArAja divyamastramudIrayan |
abhyadhAvata kaunteyaM miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.137:
taM shikhaNDI raNe yattamabhyadhAvata da.nshitaH |
sa~njahAra tato bhIShmastadastraM pAvakopamam
shlokas.138:
etasminneva kAle tu kaunteyaH shvetavAhanaH |
nijaghne tAvakaM sainyaM mohayitvA pitAmaham

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evaM vyUDheShvanIkeShu bhUyiShThamanuvartiShu |
brahmalokaparAH sarve samapadyanta bhArata
shlokas.2:
na hyanIkamanIkena samasajjata sa~Nkule |
na rathA rathibhiH sArdhaM na padAtAH padAtibhiH
shlokas.3:
ashvA nAshvairayudhyanta na gajA gajayodhibhiH |
mahAnvyatikaro raudraH senayoH samapadyata
shlokas.4:
naranAgaratheShvevaM vyavakIrNeShu sarvashaH |
kShaye tasminmahAraudre nirvisheShamajAyata
shlokas.5:
tataH shalyaH kRRipashchaiva chitrasenashcha bhArata |
duHshAsano vikarNashcha rathAnAsthAya satvarAH
pANDavAnAM raNe shUrA dhvajinIM samakampayan
shlokas.6:
sA vadhyamAnA samare pANDusenA mahAtmabhiH |
trAtAraM nAdhyagachChadvai majjamAneva naurjale
shlokas.7:
yathA hi shaishiraH kAlo gavAM marmANi kRRintati |
tathA pANDusutAnAM vai bhIShmo marmANyakRRintata
shlokas.8:
atIva tava sainyasya pArthena cha mahAtmanA |
nagameghapratIkAshAH pAtitA bahudhA gajAH
shlokas.9:
mRRidyamAnAshcha dRRishyante pArthena narayUthapAH |
iShubhistADyamAnAshcha nArAchaishcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.10:
peturArtasvaraM kRRitvA tatra tatra mahAgajAH |
AbaddhAbharaNaiH kAyairnihatAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.11:
ChannamAyodhanaM reje shirobhishcha sakuNDalaiH |
tasminnatimahAbhIme rAjanvIravarakShaye
bhIShme cha yudhi vikrAnte pANDave cha dhana~njaye
shlokas.12:
te parAkrAntamAlokya rAjanyudhi pitAmaham |
na nyavartanta kauravyA brahmalokapuraskRRitAH
shlokas.13:
ichChanto nidhanaM yuddhe svargaM kRRitvA parAyaNam |
pANDavAnabhyavartanta tasminvIravarakShaye
shlokas.14:
pANDavApi mahArAja smaranto vividhAnbahUn |
kleshAnkRRitAnsaputreNa tvayA pUrvaM narAdhipa
shlokas.15:
bhayaM tyaktvA raNe shUrA brahmalokapuraskRRitAH |
tAvakA.nstava putrA.nshcha yodhayanti sma hRRiShTavat
shlokas.16:
senApatistu samare prAha senAM mahArathaH |
abhidravata gA~NgeyaM somakAH sRRi~njayaiH saha
shlokas.17:
senApativachaH shrutvA somakAH saha sRRi~njayaiH |
abhyadravanta gA~NgeyaM shastravRRiShTyA samantataH
shlokas.18:
vadhyamAnastato rAjanpitA shAntanavastava |
amarShavashamApanno yodhayAmAsa sRRi~njayAn
shlokas.19:
tasya kIrtimatastAta purA rAmeNa dhImatA |
sampradattAstrashikShA vai parAnIkavinAshinI
shlokas.20:
sa tAM shikShAmadhiShThAya kRRitvA parabalakShayam |
ahanyahani pArthAnAM vRRiddhaH kurupitAmahaH
bhIShmo dasha sahasrANi jaghAna paravIrahA
shlokas.21:
tasmi.nstu divase prApte dashame bharatarShabha |
bhIShmeNaikena matsyeShu pA~nchAleShu cha sa.nyuge
gajAshvamamitaM hatvA hatAH sapta mahArathAH
shlokas.22:
hatvA pa~ncha sahasrANi rathinAM prapitAmahaH |
narANAM cha mahAyuddhe sahasrANi chaturdasha
shlokas.23:
tathA dantisahasraM cha hayAnAmayutaM punaH |
shikShAbalena nihataM pitrA tava vishAM pate
shlokas.24:
tataH sarvamahIpAnAM kShobhayitvA varUthinIm |
virATasya priyo bhrAtA shatAnIko nipAtitaH
shlokas.25:
shatAnIkaM cha samare hatvA bhIShmaH pratApavAn |
sahasrANi mahArAja rAj~nAM bhallairnyapAtayat
shlokas.26:
ye cha kechana pArthAnAmabhiyAtA dhana~njayam |
rAjAno bhIShmamAsAdya gatAste yamasAdanam
shlokas.27:
evaM dasha disho bhIShmaH sharajAlaiH samantataH |
atItya senAM pArthAnAmavatasthe chamUmukhe
shlokas.28:
sa kRRitvA sumahatkarma tasminvai dashame.ahani |
senayorantare tiShThanpragRRihItasharAsanaH
shlokas.29:
na chainaM pArthivA rAja~nshekuH kechinnirIkShitum |
madhyaM prAptaM yathA grIShme tapantaM bhAskaraM divi
shlokas.30:
yathA daityachamUM shakrastApayAmAsa sa.nyuge |
tathA bhIShmaH pANDaveyA.nstApayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.31:
tathA cha taM parAkrAntamAlokya madhusUdanaH |
uvAcha devakIputraH prIyamANo dhana~njayam
shlokas.32:
eSha shAntanavo bhIShmaH senayorantare sthitaH |
nAnihatya balAdenaM vijayaste bhaviShyati
shlokas.33:
yattaH sa.nstambhayasvainaM yatraiShA bhidyate chamUH |
na hi bhIShmasharAnanyaH soDhumutsahate vibho
shlokas.34:
tatastasminkShaNe rAja.nshchodito vAnaradhvajaH |
sadhvajaM sarathaM sAshvaM bhIShmamantardadhe sharaiH
shlokas.35:
sa chApi kurumukhyAnAmRRiShabhaH pANDaveritAn |
sharavrAtaiH sharavrAtAnbahudhA vidudhAva tAn
shlokas.36:
tena pA~nchAlarAjashcha dhRRiShTaketushcha vIryavAn |
pANDavo bhImasenashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
shlokas.37:
yamau cha chekitAnashcha kekayAH pa~ncha chaiva ha |
sAtyakishcha mahArAja saubhadro.atha ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.38:
draupadeyAH shikhaNDI cha kuntibhojashcha vIryavAn |
susharmA cha virATashcha pANDaveyA mahAbalAH
shlokas.39:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH pIDitA bhIShmasAyakaiH |
samuddhRRitAH phalgunena nimagnAH shokasAgare
shlokas.40:
tataH shikhaNDI vegena pragRRihya paramAyudham |
bhIShmamevAbhidudrAva rakShyamANaH kirITinA
shlokas.41:
tato.asyAnucharAnhatvA sarvAnraNavibhAgavit |
bhIShmamevAbhidudrAva bIbhatsuraparAjitaH
shlokas.42:
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
virATo drupadashchaiva mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
dudruvurbhIShmamevAjau rakShitA dRRiDhadhanvanA
shlokas.43:
abhimanyushcha samare draupadyAH pa~ncha chAtmajAH |
dudruvuH samare bhIShmaM samudyatamahAyudhAH
shlokas.44:
te sarve dRRiDhadhanvAnaH sa.nyugeShvapalAyinaH |
bahudhA bhIShmamAnarChanmArgaNaiH kRRitamArgaNAH
shlokas.45:
vidhUya tAnbANagaNAnye muktAH pArthivottamaiH |
pANDavAnAmadInAtmA vyagAhata varUthinIm
kRRitvA sharavighAtaM cha krIDanniva pitAmahaH
shlokas.46:
nAbhisandhatta pA~nchAlyaM smayamAno muhurmuhuH |
strItvaM tasyAnusa.nsmRRitya bhIShmo bANA~nshikhaNDinaH
jaghAna drupadAnIke rathAnsapta mahArathaH
shlokas.47:
tataH kilakilAshabdaH kShaNena samapadyata |
matsyapA~nchAlachedInAM tamekamabhidhAvatAm
shlokas.48:
te varAshvarathavrAtairvAraNaiH sapadAtibhiH |
tamekaM ChAdayAmAsurmeghA iva divAkaram
bhIShmaM bhAgIrathIputraM pratapantaM raNe ripUn
shlokas.49:
tatastasya cha teShAM cha yuddhe devAsuropame |
kirITI bhIShmamAnarChatpuraskRRitya shikhaNDinam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evaM te paNDavAH sarve puraskRRitya shikhaNDinam |
vivyadhuH samare bhIShmaM parivArya samantataH
shlokas.2:
shataghnIbhiH sughorAbhiH paTTishaiH saparashvadhaiH |
mudgarairmusalaiH prAsaiH kShepaNIbhishcha sarvashaH
shlokas.3:
sharaiH kanakapu~Nkhaishcha shaktitomarakampanaiH |
nArAchairvatsadantaishcha bhushuNDIbhishcha bhArata
atADayanraNe bhIShmaM sahitAH sarvasRRi~njayAH
shlokas.4:
sa vishIrNatanutrANaH pIDito bahubhistadA |
vivyathe naiva gA~Ngeyo bhidyamAneShu marmasu
shlokas.5:
sa dIptasharachApArchirastraprasRRitamArutaH |
neminirhrAdasaMnAdo mahAstrodayapAvakaH
shlokas.6:
chitrachApamahAjvAlo vIrakShayamahendhanaH |
yugAntAgnisamo bhIShmaH pareShAM samapadyata
shlokas.7:
nipatya rathasa~NghAnAmantareNa viniHsRRitaH |
dRRishyate sma narendrANAM punarmadhyagatashcharan
shlokas.8:
tataH pA~nchAlarAjaM cha dhRRiShTaketumatItya cha |
pANDavAnIkinImadhyamAsasAda sa vegitaH
shlokas.9:
tataH sAtyakibhImau cha pANDavaM cha dhana~njayam |
drupadaM cha virATaM cha dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam
shlokas.10:
bhImaghoShairmahAvegairvairivAraNabhedibhiH |
ShaDetAnShaDbhirAnarChadbhAskarapratimaiH sharaiH
shlokas.11:
tasya te nishitAnbANAnsaMnivArya mahArathAH |
dashabhirdashabhirbhIShmamardayAmAsurojasA
shlokas.12:
shikhaNDI tu raNe bANAnyAnmumocha mahAvrate |
te bhIShmaM vivishustUrNaM svarNapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH
shlokas.13:
tataH kirITI sa.nrabdho bhIShmamevAbhyavartata |
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya dhanushchAsya samAchChinat
shlokas.14:
bhIShmasya dhanuShashChedaM nAmRRiShyanta mahArathAH |
droNashcha kRRitavarmA cha saindhavashcha jayadrathaH
shlokas.15:
bhUrishravAH shalaH shalyo bhagadattastathaiva cha |
saptaite paramakruddhAH kirITinamabhidrutAH
shlokas.16:
uttamAstrANi divyAni darshayanto mahArathAH |
abhipeturbhRRishaM kruddhAshChAdayanta sma pANDavAn
shlokas.17:
teShAmApatatAM shabdaH shushruve phalgunaM prati |
udvRRittAnAM yathA shabdaH samudrANAM yugakShaye
shlokas.18:
hatAnayata gRRihNIta yudhyatApi cha kRRintata |
ityAsIttumulaH shabdaH phalgunasya rathaM prati
shlokas.19:
taM shabdaM tumulaM shrutvA pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
abhyadhAvanparIpsantaH phalgunaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.20:
sAtyakirbhImasenashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
virATadrupadau chobhau rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.21:
abhimanyushcha sa~NkruddhaH saptaite krodhamUrChitAH |
samabhyadhAva.nstvaritAshchitrakArmukadhAriNaH
shlokas.22:
teShAM samabhavadyuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
sa~NgrAme bharatashreShTha devAnAM dAnavairiva
shlokas.23:
shikhaNDI tu rathashreShTho rakShyamANaH kirITinA |
avidhyaddashabhirbhIShmaM ChinnadhanvAnamAhave
sArathiM dashabhishchAsya dhvajaM chaikena chichChide
shlokas.24:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya gA~Ngeyo vegavattaram |
tadapyasya shitairbhallaistribhishchichCheda phalgunaH
shlokas.25:
evaM sa pANDavaH kruddha AttamAttaM punaH punaH |
dhanurbhIShmasya chichCheda savyasAchI parantapaH
shlokas.26:
sa chChinnadhanvA sa~NkruddhaH sRRikkiNI parisa.nlihan |
shaktiM jagrAha sa~Nkruddho girINAmapi dAraNIm
tAM cha chikShepa sa~NkruddhaH phalgunasya rathaM prati
shlokas.27:
tAmApatantIM samprekShya jvalantImashanImiva |
samAdatta shitAnbhallAnpa~ncha pANDavanandanaH
shlokas.28:
tasya chichCheda tAM shaktiM pa~nchadhA pa~nchabhiH sharaiH |
sa~Nkruddho bharatashreShTha bhIShmabAhubaleritAm
shlokas.29:
sA papAta parichChinnA sa~Nkruddhena kirITinA |
meghavRRindaparibhraShTA vichChinneva shatahradA
shlokas.30:
ChinnAM tAM shaktimAlokya bhIShmaH krodhasamanvitaH |
achintayadraNe vIro buddhyA parapura~njayaH
shlokas.31:
shakto.ahaM dhanuShaikena nihantuM sarvapANDavAn |
yadyeShAM na bhavedgoptA viShvakseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.32:
kAraNadvayamAsthAya nAhaM yotsyAmi pANDavaiH |
avadhyatvAchcha pANDUnAM strIbhAvAchcha shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.33:
pitrA tuShTena me pUrvaM yadA kAlImudAvahat |
svachChandamaraNaM dattamavadhyatvaM raNe tathA
tasmAnmRRityumahaM manye prAptakAlamivAtmanaH
shlokas.34:
evaM j~nAtvA vyavasitaM bhIShmasyAmitatejasaH |
RRiShayo vasavashchaiva viyatsthA bhIShmamabruvan
shlokas.35:
yatte vyavasitaM vIra asmAkaM sumahatpriyam |
tatkuruShva maheShvAsa yuddhAdbuddhiM nivartaya
shlokas.36:
tasya vAkyasya nidhane prAdurAsIchChivo.anilaH |
anulomaH sugandhI cha pRRiShataishcha samanvitaH
shlokas.37:
devadundubhayashchaiva sampraNedurmahAsvanAH |
papAta puShpavRRiShTishcha bhIShmasyopari pArthiva
shlokas.38:
na cha tachChushruve kashchitteShAM sa.nvadatAM nRRipa |
RRite bhIShmaM mahAbAhuM mAM chApi munitejasA
shlokas.39:
sambhramashcha mahAnAsIttridashAnAM vishAM pate |
patiShyati rathAdbhIShme sarvalokapriye tadA
shlokas.40:
iti devagaNAnAM cha shrutvA vAkyaM mahAmanAH |
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmo bIbhatsuM nAbhyavartata
bhidyamAnaH shitairbANaiH sarvAvaraNabhedibhiH
shlokas.41:
shikhaNDI tu mahArAja bharatAnAM pitAmaham |
AjaghAnorasi kruddho navabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.42:
sa tenAbhihataH sa~Nkhye bhIShmaH kurupitAmahaH |
nAkampata mahArAja kShitikampe yathAchalaH
shlokas.43:
tataH prahasya bIbhatsurvyAkShipangANDivaM dhanuH |
gA~NgeyaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA kShudrakANAM samarpayat
shlokas.44:
punaH sharashatenainaM tvaramANo dhana~njayaH |
sarvagAtreShu sa~NkruddhaH sarvamarmasvatADayat
shlokas.45:
evamanyairapi bhRRishaM vadhyamAno mahAraNe |
na chakruste rujaM tasya rukmapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH
shlokas.46:
tataH kirITI sa.nrabdho bhIShmamevAbhyavartata |
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya dhanushchAsya samAchChinat
shlokas.47:
athainaM dashabhirviddhvA dhvajamekena chichChide |
sArathiM vishikhaishchAsya dashabhiH samakampayat
shlokas.48:
so.anyatkArmukamAdatta gA~Ngeyo balavattaram |
tadapyasya shitairbhallaistridhA tribhirupAnudat
nimeShAntaramAtreNa AttamAttaM mahAraNe
shlokas.49:
evamasya dhanUMShyAjau chichCheda subahUnyapi |
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmo bIbhatsuM nAbhyavartata
shlokas.50:
athainaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA kShudrakANAM samardayat |
so.atividdho maheShvAso duHshAsanamabhAShata
shlokas.51:
eSha pArtho raNe kruddhaH pANDavAnAM mahArathaH |
sharairanekasAhasrairmAmevAbhyasate raNe
shlokas.52:
na chaiSha shakyaH samare jetuM vajrabhRRitA api |
na chApi sahitA vIrA devadAnavarAkShasAH
mAM chaiva shaktA nirjetuM kimu martyAH sudurbalAH
shlokas.53:
evaM tayoH sa.nvadatoH phalguno nishitaiH sharaiH |
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya bhIShmaM vivyAdha sa.nyuge
shlokas.54:
tato duHshAsanaM bhUyaH smayamAno.abhyabhAShata |
atividdhaH shitairbANairbhRRishaM gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.55:
vajrAshanisamasparshAH shitAgrAH sampraveshitAH |
vimuktA avyavachChinnA neme bANAH shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.56:
nikRRintamAnA marmANi dRRiDhAvaraNabhedinaH |
musalAnIva me ghnanti neme bANAH shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.57:
brahmadaNDasamasparshA vajravegA durAsadAH |
mama prANAnArujanti neme bANAH shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.58:
bhujagA iva sa~NkruddhA lelihAnA viSholbaNAH |
mamAvishanti marmANi neme bANAH shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.59:
nAshayantIva me prANAnyamadUtA ivAhitAH |
gadAparighasa.nsparshA neme bANAH shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.60:
kRRintanti mama gAtrANi mAghamAse gavAmiva |
arjunasya ime bANA neme bANAH shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.61:
sarve hyapi na me duHkhaM kuryuranye narAdhipAH |
vIraM gaNDIvadhanvAnamRRite jiShNuM kapidhvajam
shlokas.62:
iti bruva~nshAntanavo didhakShuriva pANDavam |
saviShphuli~NgAM dIptAgrAM shaktiM chikShepa bhArata
shlokas.63:
tAmasya vishikhaishChittvA tridhA tribhirapAtayat |
pashyatAM kuruvIrANAM sarveShAM tatra bhArata
shlokas.64:
charmAthAdatta gA~Ngeyo jAtarUpapariShkRRitam |
khaDgaM chAnyataraM prepsurmRRityoragre jayAya vA
shlokas.65:
tasya tachChatadhA charma vyadhamadda.nshitAtmanaH |
rathAdanavarUDhasya tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.66:
vinadyochchaiH siMha iva svAnyanIkAnyachodayat |
abhidravata gA~NgeyaM mAM vo.astu bhayamaNvapi
shlokas.67:
atha te tomaraiH prAsairbANaughaishcha samantataH |
paTTishaishcha sanistri.nshairnAnApraharaNaistathA
shlokas.68:
vatsadantaishcha bhallaishcha tamekamabhidudruvuH |
siMhanAdastato ghoraH pANDavAnAmajAyata
shlokas.69:
tathaiva tava putrAshcha rAjanbhIShmajayaiShiNaH |
tamekamabhyavartanta siMhanAdA.nshcha nedire
shlokas.70:
tatrAsIttumulaM yuddhaM tAvakAnAM paraiH saha |
dashame.ahani rAjendra bhIShmArjunasamAgame
shlokas.71:
AsIdgA~Nga ivAvarto muhUrtamudadheriva |
sainyAnAM yudhyamAnAnAM nighnatAmitaretaram
shlokas.72:
agamyarUpA pRRithivI shoNitAktA tadAbhavat |
samaM cha viShamaM chaiva na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.73:
yodhAnAmayutaM hatvA tasminsa dashame.ahani |
atiShThadAhave bhIShmo bhidyamAneShu marmasu
shlokas.74:
tataH senAmukhe tasminsthitaH pArtho dhana~njayaH |
madhyena kurusainyAnAM drAvayAmAsa vAhinIm
shlokas.75:
vayaM shvetahayAdbhItAH kuntIputrAddhana~njayAt |
pIDyamAnAH shitaiH shastraiH pradravAma mahAraNAt
shlokas.76:
sauvIrAH kitavAH prAchyAH pratIchyodIchyamAlavAH |
abhIShAhAH shUrasenAH shibayo.atha vasAtayaH
shlokas.77:
shAlvAshrayAstrigartAshcha ambaShThAH kekayaiH saha |
dvAdashaite janapadAH sharArtA vraNapIDitAH
sa~NgrAme na jahurbhIShmaM yudhyamAnaM kirITinA
shlokas.78:
tatastamekaM bahavaH parivArya samantataH |
parikAlya kurUnsarvA~nsharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.79:
nipAtayata gRRihNIta vidhyatAtha cha karShata |
ityAsIttumulaH shabdo rAjanbhIShmarathaM prati
shlokas.80:
abhihatya sharaughaistaM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
na tasyAsIdanirbhinnaM gAtreShva~NgulamAtrakam
shlokas.81:
evaM vibho tava pitA sharairvishakalIkRRitaH |
shitAgraiH phalgunenAjau prAkShirAH prApatadrathAt
ki~nchichCheShe dinakare putrANAM tava pashyatAm
shlokas.82:
hA heti divi devAnAM pArthivAnAM cha sarvashaH |
patamAne rathAdbhIShme babhUva sumahAnsvanaH
shlokas.83:
taM patantamabhiprekShya mahAtmAnaM pitAmaham |
saha bhIShmeNa sarveShAM prApatanhRRidayAni naH
shlokas.84:
sa papAta mahAbAhurvasudhAmanunAdayan |
indradhvaja ivotsRRiShTaH ketuH sarvadhanuShmatAm
dharaNIM nAspRRishachchApi sharasa~NghaiH samAchitaH
shlokas.85:
sharatalpe maheShvAsaM shayAnaM puruSharShabham |
rathAtprapatitaM chainaM divyo bhAvaH samAvishat
shlokas.86:
abhyavarShata parjanyaH prAkampata cha medinI |
patansa dadRRishe chApi kharvitaM cha divAkaram
shlokas.87:
sa~nj~nAM chaivAlabhadvIraH kAlaM sa~nchintya bhArata |
antarikShe cha shushrAva divyAM vAchaM samantataH
shlokas.88:
kathaM mahAtmA gA~NgeyaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
kAlaM kartA naravyAghraH samprApte dakShiNAyane
shlokas.89:
sthito.asmIti cha gA~NgeyastachChrutvA vAkyamabravIt |
dhArayAmAsa cha prANAnpatito.api hi bhUtale
uttarAyaNamanvichChanbhIShmaH kurupitAmahaH
shlokas.90:
tasya tanmatamAj~nAya ga~NgA himavataH sutA |
maharShInha.nsarUpeNa preShayAmAsa tatra vai
shlokas.91:
tataH sampAtino ha.nsAstvaritA mAnasaukasaH |
AjagmuH sahitA draShTuM bhIShmaM kurupitAmaham
yatra shete narashreShThaH sharatalpe pitAmahaH
shlokas.92:
te tu bhIShmaM samAsAdya munayo ha.nsarUpiNaH |
apashya~nsharatalpasthaM bhIShmaM kurupitAmaham
shlokas.93:
te taM dRRiShTvA mahAtmAnaM kRRitvA chApi pradakShiNam |
gA~NgeyaM bharatashreShThaM dakShiNena cha bhAskaram
shlokas.94:
itaretaramAmantrya prAhustatra manIShiNaH |
bhIShma eva mahAtmA sansa.nsthAtA dakShiNAyane
shlokas.95:
ityuktvA prasthitAnha.nsAndakShiNAmabhito disham |
samprekShya vai mahAbuddhishchintayitvA cha bhArata
shlokas.96:
tAnabravIchChAntanavo nAhaM gantA katha~nchana |
dakShiNAvRRitta Aditye etanme manasi sthitam
shlokas.97:
gamiShyAmi svakaM sthAnamAsIdyanme purAtanam |
udagAvRRitta Aditye ha.nsAH satyaM bravImi vaH
shlokas.98:
dhArayiShyAmyahaM prANAnuttarAyaNakA~NkShayA |
aishvaryabhUtaH prANAnAmutsarge niyato hyaham
tasmAtprANAndhArayiShye mumUrShurudagAyane
shlokas.99:
yashcha datto varo mahyaM pitrA tena mahAtmanA |
Chandato mRRityurityevaM tasya chAstu varastathA
shlokas.100:
dhArayiShye tataH prANAnutsarge niyate sati |
ityuktvA tA.nstadA ha.nsAnasheta sharatalpagaH
shlokas.101:
evaM kurUNAM patite shRRi~Nge bhIShme mahaujasi |
pANDavAH sRRi~njayAshchaiva siMhanAdaM prachakrire
shlokas.102:
tasminhate mahAsattve bharatAnAmamadhyame |
na ki~nchitpratyapadyanta putrAste bharatarShabha
saMmohashchaiva tumulaH kurUNAmabhavattadA
shlokas.103:
nRRipA duryodhanamukhA niHshvasya rurudustataH |
viShAdAchcha chiraM kAlamatiShThanvigatendriyAH
shlokas.104:
dadhyushchaiva mahArAja na yuddhe dadhire manaH |
UrugrAhagRRihItAshcha nAbhyadhAvanta pANDavAn
shlokas.105:
avadhye shantanoH putre hate bhIShme mahaujasi |
abhAvaH sumahAnrAjankurUnAgAdatandritaH
shlokas.106:
hatapravIrAshcha vayaM nikRRittAshcha shitaiH sharaiH |
kartavyaM nAbhijAnImo nirjitAH savyasAchinA
shlokas.107:
pANDavAstu jayaM labdhvA paratra cha parAM gatim |
sarve dadhmurmahAsha~NkhA~nshUrAH parighabAhavaH
somakAshcha sapa~nchAlAH prAhRRiShyanta janeshvara
shlokas.108:
tatastUryasahasreShu nadatsu sumahAbalaH |
AsphoTayAmAsa bhRRishaM bhImaseno nanarta cha
shlokas.109:
senayorubhayoshchApi gA~Ngeye vinipAtite |
saMnyasya vIrAH shastrANi prAdhyAyanta samantataH
shlokas.110:
prAkroshanprApata.nshchAnye jagmurmohaM tathApare |
kShatraM chAnye.abhyanindanta bhIShmaM chaike.abhyapUjayan
shlokas.111:
RRiShayaH pitarashchaiva prashasha.nsurmahAvratam |
bharatAnAM cha ye pUrve te chainaM prashasha.nsire
shlokas.112:
mahopaniShadaM chaiva yogamAsthAya vIryavAn |
japa~nshAntanavo dhImAnkAlAkA~NkShI sthito.abhavat

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathamAsa.nstadA yodhA hInA bhIShmeNa sa~njaya |
balinA devakalpena gurvarthe brahmachAriNA
shlokas.2:
tadaiva nihatAnmanye kurUnanyA.nshcha pArthivAn |
na prAharadyadA bhIShmo ghRRiNitvAddrupadAtmaje
shlokas.3:
tato duHkhataraM manye kimanyatprabhaviShyati |
yadadya pitaraM shrutvA nihataM mama durmateH
shlokas.4:
ashmasAramayaM nUnaM hRRidayaM mama sa~njaya |
shrutvA vinihataM bhIShmaM shatadhA yanna dIryate
shlokas.5:
punaH punarna mRRiShyAmi hataM devavrataM raNe |
na hato jAmadagnyena divyairastraiH sma yaH purA
shlokas.6:
yadadya nihatenAjau bhIShmeNa jayamichChatA |
cheShTitaM narasiMhena tanme kathaya sa~njaya
shlokas.7:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sAyAhne nyapatadbhUmau dhArtarAShTrAnviShAdayan |
pA~nchAlAnAM dadaddharShaM kuruvRRiddhaH pitAmahaH
shlokas.8:
sa shete sharatalpastho medinImaspRRisha.nstadA |
bhIShmo rathAtprapatitaH prachyuto dharaNItale
shlokas.9:
hA heti tumulaH shabdo bhUtAnAM samapadyata |
sImAvRRikShe nipatite kurUNAM samitikShaye
shlokas.10:
ubhayoH senayo rAjankShatriyAnbhayamAvishat |
bhIShmaM shantanavaM dRRiShTvA vishIrNakavachadhvajam
kuravaH paryavartanta pANDavAshcha vishAM pate
shlokas.11:
khaM tamovRRitamAsIchcha nAsIdbhAnumataH prabhA |
rarAsa pRRithivI chaiva bhIShme shAntanave hate
shlokas.12:
ayaM brahmavidAM shreShTho ayaM brahmavidAM gatiH |
ityabhAShanta bhUtAni shayAnaM bharatarShabham
shlokas.13:
ayaM pitaramAj~nAya kAmArtaM shantanuM purA |
UrdhvaretasamAtmAnaM chakAra puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.14:
iti sma sharatalpasthaM bharatAnAmamadhyamam |
RRiShayaH paryadhAvanta sahitAH siddhachAraNaiH
shlokas.15:
hate shAntanave bhIShme bharatAnAM pitAmahe |
na ki~nchitpratyapadyanta putrAstava cha bhArata
shlokas.16:
vivarNavadanAshchAsangatashrIkAshcha bhArata |
atiShThanvrIDitAshchaiva hriyA yuktA hyadhomukhAH
shlokas.17:
pANDavAshcha jayaM labdhvA sa~NgrAmashirasi sthitAH |
sarve dadhmurmahAsha~NkhAnhemajAlapariShkRRitAn
shlokas.18:
bhRRishaM tUryaninAdeShu vAdyamAneShu chAnagha |
apashyAma raNe rAjanbhImasenaM mahAbalam
AkrIDamAnaM kaunteyaM harSheNa mahatA yutam
shlokas.19:
nihatya samare shatrUnmahAbalasamanvitAn |
saMmohashchApi tumulaH kurUNAmabhavattadA
shlokas.20:
karNaduryodhanau chApi niHshvasetAM muhurmuhuH |
tathA nipatite bhIShme kauravANAM dhurandhare
hAhAkAramabhUtsarvaM nirmaryAdamavartata
shlokas.21:
dRRiShTvA cha patitaM bhIShmaM putro duHshAsanastava |
uttamaM javamAsthAya droNAnIkaM samAdravat
shlokas.22:
bhrAtrA prasthApito vIraH svenAnIkena da.nshitaH |
prayayau puruShavyAghraH svasainyamabhichodayan
shlokas.23:
tamAyAntamabhiprekShya kuravaH paryavArayan |
duHshAsanaM mahArAja kimayaM vakShyatIti vai
shlokas.24:
tato droNAya nihataM bhIShmamAchaShTa kauravaH |
droNastadapriyaM shrutvA sahasA nyapatadrathAt
shlokas.25:
sa sa~nj~nAmupalabhyAtha bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
nivArayAmAsa tadA svAnyanIkAni mAriSha
shlokas.26:
vinivRRittAnkurUndRRiShTvA pANDavApi svasainikAn |
dUtaiH shIghrAshvasa.nyuktairavahAramakArayan
shlokas.27:
vinivRRitteShu sainyeShu pAramparyeNa sarvashaH |
vimuktakavachAH sarve bhIShmamIyurnarAdhipAH
shlokas.28:
vyupAramya tato yuddhAdyodhAH shatasahasrashaH |
upatasthurmahAtmAnaM prajApatimivAmarAH
shlokas.29:
te tu bhIShmaM samAsAdya shayAnaM bharatarShabham |
abhivAdya vyatiShThanta pANDavAH kurubhiH saha
shlokas.30:
atha pANDUnkurU.nshchaiva praNipatyAgrataH sthitAn |
abhyabhAShata dharmAtmA bhIShmaH shAntanavastadA
shlokas.31:
svAgataM vo mahAbhAgAH svAgataM vo mahArathAH |
tuShyAmi darshanAchchAhaM yuShmAkamamaropamAH
shlokas.32:
abhinandya sa tAnevaM shirasA lambatAbravIt |
shiro me lambate.atyarthamupadhAnaM pradIyatAm
shlokas.33:
tato nRRipAH samAjahrustanUni cha mRRidUni cha |
upadhAnAni mukhyAni naichChattAni pitAmahaH
shlokas.34:
abravIchcha naravyAghraH prahasanniva tAnnRRipAn |
naitAni vIrashayyAsu yuktarUpANi pArthivAH
shlokas.35:
tato vIkShya narashreShThamabhyabhAShata pANDavam |
dhana~njayaM dIrghabAhuM sarvalokamahAratham
shlokas.36:
dhana~njaya mahAbAho shiraso me.asya lambataH |
dIyatAmupadhAnaM vai yadyuktamiha manyase
shlokas.37:
sa saMnyasya mahachchApamabhivAdya pitAmaham |
netrAbhyAmashrupUrNAbhyAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.38:
Aj~nApaya kurushreShTha sarvashastrabhRRitAM vara |
preShyo.ahaM tava durdharSha kriyatAM kiM pitAmaha
shlokas.39:
tamabravIchChAntanavaH shiro me tAta lambate |
upadhAnaM kurushreShTha phalgunopanayasva me
shayanasyAnurUpaM hi shIghraM vIra prayachCha me
shlokas.40:
tvaM hi pArtha mahAbAho shreShThaH sarvadhanuShmatAm |
kShatradharmasya vettA cha buddhisattvaguNAnvitaH
shlokas.41:
phalgunastu tathetyuktvA vyavasAyapurojavaH |
pragRRihyAmantrya gANDIvaM sharA.nshcha nataparvaNaH
shlokas.42:
anumAnya mahAtmAnaM bharatAnAmamadhyamam |
tribhistIkShNairmahAvegairudagRRihNAchChiraH sharaiH
shlokas.43:
abhiprAye tu vidite dharmAtmA savyasAchinA |
atuShyadbharatashreShTho bhIShmo dharmArthatattvavit
shlokas.44:
upadhAnena dattena pratyanandaddhana~njayam |
kuntIputraM yudhAM shreShThaM suhRRidAM prItivardhanam
shlokas.45:
anurUpaM shayAnasya pANDavopahitaM tvayA |
yadyanyathA pravartethAH shapeyaM tvAmahaM ruShA
shlokas.46:
evametanmahAbAho dharmeShu pariniShThitam |
svaptavyaM kShatriyeNAjau sharatalpagatena vai
shlokas.47:
evamuktvA tu bIbhatsuM sarvA.nstAnabravIdvachaH |
rAj~nashcha rAjaputrA.nshcha pANDavenAbhi sa.nsthitAn
shlokas.48:
shayeyamasyAM shayyAyAM yAvadAvartanaM raveH |
ye tadA pArayiShyanti te mAM drakShyanti vai nRRipAH
shlokas.49:
dishaM vaishravaNAkrAntAM yadA gantA divAkaraH |
archiShmAnpratapa.NllokAnrathenottamatejasA
vimokShye.ahaM tadA prANAnsuhRRidaH supriyAnapi
shlokas.50:
parikhA khanyatAmatra mamAvasadane nRRipAH |
upAsiShye vivasvantamevaM sharashatAchitaH
upAramadhvaM sa~NgrAmAdvairANyutsRRijya pArthivAH
shlokas.51:
upAtiShThannatho vaidyAH shalyoddharaNakovidAH |
sarvopakaraNairyuktAH kushalAste sushikShitAH
shlokas.52:
tAndRRiShTvA jAhnavIputraH provAcha vachanaM tadA |
dattadeyA visRRijyantAM pUjayitvA chikitsakAH
shlokas.53:
eva~Ngate na hIdAnIM vaidyaiH kAryamihAsti me |
kShatradharmaprashastAM hi prApto.asmi paramAM gatim
shlokas.54:
naiSha dharmo mahIpAlAH sharatalpagatasya me |
etaireva sharaishchAhaM dagdhavyo.ante narAdhipAH
shlokas.55:
tachChrutvA vachanaM tasya putro duryodhanastava |
vaidyAnvisarjayAmAsa pUjayitvA yathArhataH
shlokas.56:
tataste vismayaM jagmurnAnAjanapadeshvarAH |
sthitiM dharme parAM dRRiShTvA bhIShmasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.57:
upadhAnaM tato dattvA pitustava janeshvara |
sahitAH pANDavAH sarve kuravashcha mahArathAH
shlokas.58:
upagamya mahAtmAnaM shayAnaM shayane shubhe |
te.abhivAdya tato bhIShmaM kRRitvA chAbhipradakShiNam
shlokas.59:
vidhAya rakShAM bhIShmasya sarva eva samantataH |
vIrAH svashibirANyeva dhyAyantaH paramAturAH
niveshAyAbhyupAgachChansAyAhne rudhirokShitAH
shlokas.60:
niviShTAnpANDavA.nshchApi prIyamANAnmahArathAn |
bhIShmasya patanAddhRRiShTAnupagamya mahArathAn
uvAcha yAdavaH kAle dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.61:
diShTyA jayasi kauravya diShTyA bhIShmo nipAtitaH |
avadhyo mAnuShaireSha satyasandho mahArathaH
shlokas.62:
atha vA daivataiH pArtha sarvashastrAstrapAragaH |
tvAM tu chakShurhaNaM prApya dagdho ghoreNa chakShuShA
shlokas.63:
evamukto dharmarAjaH pratyuvAcha janArdanam |
tava prasAdAdvijayaH krodhAttava parAjayaH
tvaM hi naH sharaNaM kRRiShNa bhaktAnAmabhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.64:
anAshcharyo jayasteShAM yeShAM tvamasi keshava |
raShkitA samare nityaM nityaM chApi hite rataH
sarvathA tvAM samAsAdya nAshcharyamiti me matiH
shlokas.65:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha smayamAno janArdanaH |
tvayyevaitadyuktarUpaM vachanaM pArthivottama

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vyuShTAyAM tu mahArAja rajanyAM sarvapArthivAH |
pANDavA dhArtarAShTrAshcha abhijagmuH pitAmaham
shlokas.2:
taM vIrashayane vIraM shayAnaM kurusattamam |
abhivAdyopatasthurvai kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabham
shlokas.3:
kanyAshchandanachUrNaishcha lAjairmAlyaishcha sarvashaH |
striyo bAlAstathA vRRiddhAH prekShakAshcha pRRithagjanAH
samabhyayuH shAntanavaM bhUtAnIva tamonudam
shlokas.4:
tUryANi gaNikA vArAstathaiva naTanartakAH |
upAnRRitya~njagushchaiva vRRiddhaM kurupitAmaham
shlokas.5:
upAramya cha yuddhebhyaH saMnAhAnvipramuchya cha |
AyudhAni cha nikShipya sahitAH kurupANDavAH
shlokas.6:
anvAsata durAdharShaM devavratamari.ndamam |
anyonyaM prItimantaste yathApUrvaM yathAvayaH
shlokas.7:
sA pArthivashatAkIrNA samitirbhIShmashobhitA |
shushubhe bhAratI dIptA divIvAdityamaNDalam
shlokas.8:
vibabhau cha nRRipANAM sA pitAmahamupAsatAm |
devAnAmiva deveshaM pitAmahamupAsatAm
shlokas.9:
bhIShmastu vedanAM dhairyAnnigRRihya bharatarShabha |
abhitaptaH sharaishchaiva nAtihRRiShTamanAbravIt
shlokas.10:
sharAbhitaptakAyo.ahaM sharasantApamUrChitaH |
pAnIyamabhikA~NkShe.ahaM rAj~nastAnpratyabhAShata
shlokas.11:
tataste kShatriyA rAjansamAjahruH samantataH |
bhakShyAnuchchAvachA.nstatra vArikumbhA.nshcha shItalAn
shlokas.12:
upanItaM cha taddRRiShTvA bhIShmaH shAntanavo.abravIt |
nAdya tAta mayA shakyaM bhogAnkA.nshchana mAnuShAn
shlokas.13:
upabhoktuM manuShyebhyaH sharashayyAgato hyaham |
pratIkShamANastiShThAmi nivRRittiM shashisUryayoH
shlokas.14:
evamuktvA shAntanavo dInavAksarvapArthivAn |
dhana~njayaM mahAbAhumabhyabhAShata bhArata
shlokas.15:
athopetya mahAbAhurabhivAdya pitAmaham |
atiShThatprA~njaliH prahvaH kiM karomIti chAbravIt
shlokas.16:
taM dRRiShTvA pANDavaM rAjannabhivAdyAgrataH sthitam |
abhyabhAShata dharmAtmA bhIShmaH prIto dhana~njayam
shlokas.17:
dahyate.adaH sharIraM me sa.nsyUto.asmi maheShubhiH |
marmANi paridUyante vadanaM mama shuShyati
shlokas.18:
hlAdanArthaM sharIrasya prayachChApo mamArjuna |
tvaM hi shakto maheShvAsa dAtumambho yathAvidhi
shlokas.19:
arjunastu tathetyuktvA rathamAruhya vIryavAn |
adhijyaM balavatkRRitvA gANDIvaM vyAkShipaddhanuH
shlokas.20:
tasya jyAtalanirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
vitresuH sarvabhUtAni shrutvA sarve cha pArthivAH
shlokas.21:
tataH pradakShiNaM kRRitvA rathena rathinAM varaH |
shayAnaM bharatashreShThaM sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.22:
sandhAya cha sharaM dIptamabhimantrya mahAyashAH |
parjanyAstreNa sa.nyojya sarvalokasya pashyataH
avidhyatpRRithivIM pArthaH pArshve bhIShmasya dakShiNe
shlokas.23:
utpapAta tato dhArA vimalA vAriNaH shivA |
shItasyAmRRitakalpasya divyagandharasasya cha
shlokas.24:
atarpayattataH pArthaH shItayA vAridhArayA |
bhIShmaM kurUNAmRRiShabhaM divyakarmaparAkramaH
shlokas.25:
karmaNA tena pArthasya shakraShyeva vikurvataH |
vismayaM paramaM jagmustataste vasudhAdhipAH
shlokas.26:
tatkarma prekShya bIbhatsoratimAnuShamadbhutam |
samprAvepanta kuravo gAvaH shItArditA iva
shlokas.27:
vismayAchchottarIyANi vyAvidhyansarvato nRRipAH |
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShaistumulaM sarvato.abhavat
shlokas.28:
tRRiptaH shAntanavashchApi rAjanbIbhatsumabravIt |
sarvapArthivavIrANAM saMnidhau pUjayanniva
shlokas.29:
naitachchitraM mahAbAho tvayi kauravanandana |
kathito nAradenAsi pUrvarShiramitadyutiH
shlokas.30:
vAsudevasahAyastvaM mahatkarma kariShyasi |
yannotsahati devendraH saha devairapi dhruvam
shlokas.31:
vidustvAM nidhanaM pArtha sarvakShatrasya tadvidaH |
dhanurdharANAmekastvaM pRRithivyAM pravaro nRRiShu
shlokas.32:
manuShyA jagati shreShThAH pakShiNAM garuDo varaH |
sarasAM sAgaraH shreShTho gaurvariShThA chatuShpadAm
shlokas.33:
AdityastejasAM shreShTho girINAM himavAnvaraH |
jAtInAM brAhmaNaH shreShThaH shreShThastvamasi dhanvinAm
shlokas.34:
na vai shrutaM dhArtarAShTreNa vAkyaM; sambodhyamAnaM vidureNa chaiva |
droNena rAmeNa janArdanena; muhurmuhuH sa~njayenApi choktam
shlokas.35:
parItabuddhirhi visa~nj~nakalpo; duryodhano nAbhyanandadvacho me |
sa sheShyate vai nihatashchirAya; shAstrAtigo bhImabalAbhibhUtaH
shlokas.36:
tataH shrutvA tadvachaH kauravendro; duryodhano dInamanA babhUva |
tamabravIchChAntanavo.abhivIkShya; nibodha rAjanbhava vItamanyuH
shlokas.37:
dRRiShTaM duryodhanedaM te yathA pArthena dhImatA |
jalasya dhArA janitA shItasyAmRRitagandhinaH
etasya kartA loke.asminnAnyaH kashchana vidyate
shlokas.38:
AgneyaM vAruNaM saumyaM vAyavyamatha vaiShNavam |
aindraM pAshupataM brAhmaM pArameShThyaM prajApateH
dhAtustvaShTushcha saviturdivyAnyastrANi sarvashaH
shlokas.39:
sarvasminmAnuShe loke vettyeko hi dhana~njayaH |
kRRiShNo vA devakIputro nAnyo vai veda kashchana
na shakyAH pANDavAstAta yuddhe jetuM katha~nchana
shlokas.40:
amAnuShANi karmANi yasyaitAni mahAtmanaH |
tena sattvavatA sa~Nkhye shUreNAhavashobhinA
kRRitinA samare rAjansandhiste tAta yujyatAm
shlokas.41:
yAvatkRRiShNo mahAbAhuH svAdhInaH kurusa.nsadi |
tAvatpArthena shUreNa sandhiste tAta yujyatAm
shlokas.42:
yAvachchamUM na te sheShAM sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
nAshayatyarjunastAvatsandhiste tAta yujyatAm
shlokas.43:
yAvattiShThanti samare hatasheShAH sahodarAH |
nRRipAshcha bahavo rAja.nstAvatsandhiH prayujyatAm
shlokas.44:
na nirdahati te yAvatkrodhadIptekShaNashchamUm |
yudhiShThiro hi tAvadvai sandhiste tAta yujyatAm
shlokas.45:
nakulaH sahadevashcha bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
yAvachchamUM mahArAja nAshayanti na sarvashaH
tAvatte pANDavaiH sArdhaM saubhrAtraM tAta rochatAm
shlokas.46:
yuddhaM madantamevAstu tAta sa.nshAmya pANDavaiH |
etatte rochatAM vAkyaM yadukto.asi mayAnagha
etatkShemamahaM manye tava chaiva kulasya cha
shlokas.47:
tyaktvA manyumupashAmyasva pArthaiH; paryAptametadyatkRRitaM phalgunena |
bhIShmasyAntAdastu vaH sauhRRidaM vA; samprashleShaH sAdhu rAjanprasIda
shlokas.48:
rAjyasyArdhaM dIyatAM pANDavAnA;mindraprasthaM dharmarAjo.anushAstu |
mA mitradhrukpArthivAnAM jaghanyaH; pApAM kIrtiM prApsyase kauravendra
shlokas.49:
mamAvasAnAchChAntirastu prajAnAM; sa~NgachChantAM pArthivAH prItimantaH |
pitA putraM mAtulaM bhAgineyo; bhrAtA chaiva bhrAtaraM praitu rAjan
shlokas.50:
na chedevaM prAptakAlaM vacho me; mohAviShTaH pratipatsyasyabuddhyA |
bhIShmasyAntAdetadantAH stha sarve; satyAmetAM bhAratImIrayAmi
shlokas.51:
etadvAkyaM sauhRRidAdApageyo; madhye rAj~nAM bhArataM shrAvayitvA |
tUShNImAsIchChalyasantaptamarmA; yatvAtmAnaM vedanAM saMnigRRihya

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataste pArthivAH sarve jagmuH svAnAlayAnpunaH |
tUShNImbhUte mahArAja bhIShme shantanunandane
shlokas.2:
shrutvA tu nihataM bhIShmaM rAdheyaH puruSharShabhaH |
IShadAgatasantrAsaH tvarayopajagAma ha
shlokas.3:
sa dadarsha mahAtmAnaM sharatalpagataM tadA |
janmashayyAgataM devaM kArttikeyamiva prabhum
shlokas.4:
nimIlitAkShaM taM vIraM sAshrukaNThastadA vRRiShaH |
abhyetya pAdayostasya nipapAta mahAdyutiH
shlokas.5:
rAdheyo.ahaM kurushreShTha nityaM chAShkigatastava |
dveShyo.atyantamanAgAH sanniti chainamuvAcha ha
shlokas.6:
tachChrutvA kuruvRRiddhaH sa balAtsa.nvRRittalochanaH |
shanairudvIkShya sasnehamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.7:
rahitaM dhiShNyamAlokya samutsArya cha rakShiNaH |
piteva putraM gA~NgeyaH pariShvajyaikabAhunA
shlokas.8:
ehyehi me vipratIpa spardhase tvaM mayA saha |
yadi mAM nAbhigachChethA na te shreyo bhaveddhruvam
shlokas.9:
kaunteyastvaM na rAdheyo vidito nAradAnmama |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanAchchaiva keshavAchcha na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
na cha dveSho.asti me tAta tvayi satyaM bravImi te |
tejovadhanimittaM tu paruShANyahamuktavAn
shlokas.11:
akasmAtpANDavAnhi tvaM dviShasIti matirmama |
yenAsi bahusho rUkShaM choditaH sUryanandana
shlokas.12:
jAnAmi samare vIryaM shatrubhirduHsahaM tava |
brahmaNyatAM cha shauryaM cha dAne cha paramAM gatim
shlokas.13:
na tvayA sadRRishaH kashchitpuruSheShvamaropama |
kulabhedaM cha matvAhaM sadA paruShamuktavAn
shlokas.14:
iShvastre bhArasandhAne lAghave.astrabale tathA |
sadRRishaH phalgunenAsi kRRiShNena cha mahAtmanA
shlokas.15:
karNa rAjapuraM gatvA tvayaikena dhanuShmatA |
tasyArthe kururAjasya rAjAno mRRiditA yudhi
shlokas.16:
tathA cha balavAnrAjA jarAsandho durAsadaH |
samare samarashlAghI tvayA na sadRRisho.abhavat
shlokas.17:
brahmaNyaH satyavAdI cha tejasArka ivAparaH |
devagarbho.ajitaH sa~Nkhye manuShyairadhiko bhuvi
shlokas.18:
vyapanIto.adya manyurme yastvAM prati purA kRRitaH |
daivaM puruShakAreNa na shakyamativartitum
shlokas.19:
sodaryAH pANDavA vIrA bhrAtaraste.arisUdana |
sa~NgachCha tairmahAbAho mama chedichChasi priyam
shlokas.20:
mayA bhavatu nirvRRittaM vairamAdityanandana |
pRRithivyAM sarvarAjAno bhavantvadya nirAmayAH
shlokas.21:
karNa uvAcha||
jAnAmyahaM mahAprAj~na sarvametanna sa.nshayaH |
yathA vadasi durdharSha kaunteyo.ahaM na sUtajaH
shlokas.22:
avakIrNastvahaM kuntyA sUtena cha vivardhitaH |
bhuktvA duryodhanaishvaryaM na mithyA kartumutsahe
shlokas.23:
vasu chaiva sharIraM cha yadudAraM tathA yashaH |
sarvaM duryodhanasyArthe tyaktaM me bhUridakShiNa
kopitAH pANDavA nityaM mayAshritya suyodhanam
shlokas.24:
avashyabhAvI vai yo.artho na sa shakyo nivartitum |
daivaM puruShakAreNa ko nivartitumutsahet
shlokas.25:
pRRithivIkShayasha.nsIni nimittAni pitAmaha |
bhavadbhirupalabdhAni kathitAni cha sa.nsadi
shlokas.26:
pANDavA vAsudevashcha viditA mama sarvashaH |
ajeyAH puruShairanyairiti tA.nshchotsahAmahe
shlokas.27:
anujAnIShva mAM tAta yuddhe prItamanAH sadA |
anuj~nAtastvayA vIra yudhyeyamiti me matiH
shlokas.28:
duruktaM vipratIpaM vA sa.nrambhAchchApalAttathA |
yanmayApakRRitaM ki~nchittadanukShantumarhasi
shlokas.29:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na chechChakyamathotsraShTuM vairametatsudAruNam |
anujAnAmi karNa tvAM yudhyasva svargakAmyayA
shlokas.30:
vimanyurgatasa.nrambhaH kuru karma nRRipasya hi |
yathAshakti yathotsAhaM satAM vRRitteShu vRRittavAn
shlokas.31:
ahaM tvAmanujAnAmi yadichChasi tadApnuhi |
kShatradharmajitA.NllokAnsamprApsyasi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.32:
yudhyasva niraha~NkAro balavIryavyapAshrayaH |
dharmo hi yuddhAchChreyo.anyatkShatriyasya na vidyate
shlokas.33:
prashame hi kRRito yatnaH suchirAtsuchiraM mayA |
na chaiva shakitaH kartuM yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.34:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evaM bruvantaM gA~NgeyamabhivAdya prasAdya cha |
rAdheyo rathamAruhya prAyAttava sutaM prati
